jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
Unsere Opportunity
Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immoblien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.
Deine Mission
Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du die Führung unseres aktuell rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams und baust es weiter aus. Du hilfst deinem Team, ambitioniert zu liefern: kontinuierliche Verbesserungen für unsere bestehenden Kunden, aber auch neue Prototypen und Innovationen, die unser Geschäftsmodell erweitern. Gleichzeitig sorgst du für Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden.
Du bist ein starker Sparringspartner und denkst in Systemen: Gemeinsam mit unserem C-Level, dem Product- und Data-Team sowie unseren Kunden entwickelst du unsere Produktstrategie weiter und findest technisch tragfähige, smarte Lösungen. Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik.
Technisch baust du unsere Architektur so, dass sie mit uns skaliert und Raum für Innovation lässt - etwa bei der Integration von AI-Komponenten und Datenpipelines. Dabei hast du bei uns freie Hand: Neues ausprobieren, den Tech-Stack weiterentwickeln und auch Kapazität für technisches Fundament und Tech Debt einplanen.
So hilfst du auch unseren Sales- und Customer-Success-Teams, neue Kunden zu gewinnen - und baust dir damit deine eigene User- und Fan-Base auf. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.
Tech-Stack: TypeScript (Full Stack, React im Frontend, NestJS im Backend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL RDS, AWS ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, Claude
Woran wir Erfolg messen
Du holst das Beste aus agentic engineering raus und erweiterst zusammen mit deinem Team die Plattform um eine 360°-Sicht auf die Immobilie.
Du hast das Team schneller liefern lassen - indem du es unterstützt, die Can-do-Mentalität stärkst und den Fokus auf die wirklich wichtigen Dinge setzt - bei Produkten und Architektur-Projekten.
Du hast das Team um starke Talente erweitert.
Du weißt, was jede Person in deinem Team antreibt - und hast ihr geholfen, die eigene Performance aufs nächste Level zu heben.
Was du mitbringst
Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Software-Engineering-Führung und -Architektur, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Skalieren von Engineering-Teams bei gleichzeitig hoher Shipping-Geschwindigkeit - idealerweise in einem Nicht-Konzernumfeld.
Du liebst es, Teams wachsen zu lassen, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen und ihnen gleichzeitig ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen.
Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit den genannten Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie modernen Tech-Stacks - nicht, indem du alles selbst codest, sondern indem du dein Team befähigst.
Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme konsequent aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive.
Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau bzw. C1 und fließend Englisch.
Warum Predium?
Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Team, Architektur, ein Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar: im Revenue, im Produkt und darin, wie das Engineering-Team in einem Jahr arbeitet.
Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 4 Tage/Woche.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliances
jobs.text:
Identity has become a critical to an organizations security posture. This is true across their entire digital landscape include cloud, traditional on prem and emerging technologies like agentic ai.Britive is at the forefront of a modern approach to delivering identity security with the only modern privileged access management platform that provides unified Privileged Access Visibility, Dynamic Privilege Management and Secrets Governance across infrastructure, platforms & SaaS.
Our patent-pending technology is deployed at companies of all sizes around the world, including Fortune 500 companies. We have repeatedly ranked among the hottest Cloud Security startups. Britive is founded by CyberSecurity industry veterans with a successful prior exit and is backed by top-tier VCs.
About Britive
Britive is the cloud-native Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform built to secure human, machine, and agentic identities across multi-cloud and hybrid environments. Founded on a Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) model, Britive replaces static, standing entitlements with just-in-time, ephemeral access — closing off the identity attack surface that traditional PAM and IAM tools leave exposed. Recognized as an architect of Third-Gen PAM, Britive is API-first and built to serve as the identity security control plane for modern, cloud-first enterprises.
Role Summary
Britive is hiring a Director, Technology Alliances to build and lead our technology partner ecosystem across the identity and security landscape. This is a revenue-focused role: the mandate is to identify, prioritize, and build partnerships with technology vendors (IAM, IGA, SIEM/SOAR, cloud security, DevOps/CI-CD, ITSM, and adjacent categories) whose customer bases, integrations, and go-to-market motions can generate measurable pipeline and revenue for Britive — not partnerships that are simply interesting from a technology standpoint.
The ideal candidate brings deep, credible knowledge of the identity and security technology landscape and an established network of relationships with alliance, product, and BD leaders at relevant vendors. They will independently evaluate partnership opportunities against commercial criteria, build the business case and integration requirements for the partnerships worth pursuing, and work cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and sales to bring those partnerships to market.
Key Responsibilities
Partnership Strategy & Prioritization
Maintain a prioritized view of the identity and security technology landscape (IAM/IGA, PAM, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM/CNAPP, ITSM, DevOps/CI-CD, cloud service providers) and identify which vendors represent the highest-value alliance opportunities for Britive.
Score and rank prospective partners against clear commercial criteria — overlapping customer base, co-sell motion, deal size influence, and pipeline/revenue potential — rather than technical novelty alone.
Say no to partnerships that lack a credible path to revenue, even when they are technically compelling, and be able to articulate why.
Deal Development & Business Casing
For each prioritized partner, define and document the value proposition: what joint problem is solved, why customers would buy the combined solution, and how the partnership differentiates Britive competitively.
Author the business requirements for how the two platforms should integrate — use cases, API/data touchpoints, deployment model, and shared customer workflows — in partnership with product and engineering.
Define the monetization model for each partnership (co-sell, referral, OEM/embed, marketplace, technology royalty, etc.) and the commercial terms needed to make it work for both parties.
Negotiate and close partnership agreements, working with legal and finance as needed.
Go-To-Market Execution
Translate signed partnerships into active go-to-market programs: joint solution briefs, co-sell playbooks, enablement for sales and SEs, and marketing campaigns.
Partner with sales leadership to build pipeline generation motions with alliance partners and track sourced/influenced revenue.
Represent Britive at partner and industry events, and build/maintain executive relationships with key alliance contacts.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Act as the primary interface between Britive and partner alliance, product, and BD teams.
Brief product and engineering leadership on partner-driven integration requirements and advocate for roadmap investment where it unlocks revenue.
Report regularly to sales and executive leadership on alliance pipeline, partnership health, and revenue impact.
What Success Looks Like
A short list of active, well-documented technology partnerships — each with a clear value proposition, integration requirements, and monetization model — rather than a long list of loosely-defined technical integrations.
Measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue within the first 6–12 months.
Strong working relationships with key alliance and BD leaders across the identity and security ecosystem.
What You’ll Need
Required Qualifications
7+ years in technology alliances, business development, or partnerships, with at least 3 years focused on identity, security, or adjacent enterprise infrastructure categories.
Deep working knowledge of the identity and security technology landscape — IAM, PAM, IGA, SIEM/SOAR, CNAPP/CSPM, and how these categories intersect with cloud infrastructure and DevOps.
An existing, active network of contacts among alliance, product, and BD leaders at relevant technology vendors.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate partnerships commercially — building business cases, prioritizing against revenue potential, and saying no to low-value opportunities.
Experience defining integration requirements and working directly with product/engineering teams to scope joint solutions.
Experience in a solution design / architecture role listening to and translating client requirements into proposed designs including those with integrations to other products.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives internally and externally.
Willingness to travel for partner and industry events (estimated 20–30%).
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience at a cybersecurity or identity-focused SaaS company, ideally in a high-growth or startup environment.
Experience building tech alliances from the ground up.
Familiarity with cloud-native and Zero Standing Privileges / just-in-time access concepts.
Existing relationships with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) marketplace and partner teams.
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief note describing a technology partnership they built or led — including the commercial rationale, integration scope, and revenue outcome.
The estimated base salary for this role is $140,000 - $180,000 annually. This position is also eligible for variable compensation tied to the performance of technology partnerships. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including experience, expertise, location, and other factors.
Perks + Benefits:
Work from anywhere in the US! We are fully remote (US only, other areas are subject to review).
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid parental leave benefits
401k (U.S.)
Flexible + Unlimited PTO (U.S.)
Career development opportunities and paths
Home office and connectivity stipends
Team socials + Offsites

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management (US)
jobs.text:
About Prilenia
Prilenia, a private biopharmaceutical company with a highly committed and talented global team, is seeking a Vice President, Data Management in the US.
Prilenia has a simple but urgent mission - to bring transformative medicines to people affected by devastating neurodegenerative diseases. Unwavering in our commitment to scientific excellence, Prilenia is developing pridopidine, a potent and selective sigma-1 receptor (S1R) agonist investigational therapy, which stimulates key neuroprotective mechanisms impaired in neurodegenerative diseases such as ALS and Huntington’s disease (HD). Prilenia, along with its partner Ferrer, has commenced, in 2026, two pivotal late-stage trials to support potential approval globally in ALS and in HD.
To learn more about our story and company culture, visit us at
About the role
The Vice President, Data Management, Chief Data Scientis will lead the strategy, build-out, and execution of clinical data management across the company’s clinical development portfolio, with direct responsibility for ensuring that data supporting the company’s marketing authorization applications globally are complete, accurate, consistent, and submission-ready. This role owns data management planning, electronic data capture (EDC) systems, data standards (CDISC/SDTM/ADaM), database lock, and CRO/vendor oversight, and partners closely with Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and Quality to ensure the clinical database will withstand Regulatory Authority scrutiny , including pre-approval inspection. The VP will build and lead a fit-for-purpose data management team (internal staff and/or outsourced functions) and establish the SOPs, systems, and governance needed to scale as the company advances toward and beyond potential approval.
Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & NDA Readiness
Serve as the senior data management leader and subject matter expert for all data management, supporting the company’s preparations for marketing authorization applications globally.
Collaborate with the Chief Data Protection Officer to ensure overall date integrity and compliance globally.
Develop and execute the clinical data management strategy across ongoing and planned trials, aligned with the company’s regulatory timeline and submission milestones.
Own end-to-end database lock planning and execution for pivotal trials, ensuring on-time, audit-ready locks that support statistical analysis and NDA filing timelines.
Represent data management in FDA interactions (e.g., Type B/C meetings, briefing document preparation) and any other relevant meetings with other Regulatory Authorities, and respond to information requests during regulatory review.
Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Biostatistics to ensure the submission data package (SDTM, ADaM, define.xml, reviewer’s guides) meets FDA Technical Rejection Criteria and current CDISC standards, and any other relevant regulations.
Data Management Operations
Oversee development of Data Management Plans (DMPs), CRF/eCRF design, edit check specifications, and data validation plans for all studies.
Ensure timely and high-quality data cleaning, query management, SAE reconciliation, and coding (MedDRA, WHO-DD) across all active protocols.
Establish and monitor key data quality metrics (query rates, query aging, data entry lag, protocol deviations affecting data) and drive continuous improvement.
Oversee external data reconciliation (central lab, ECG, imaging, ePRO/eCOA, IRT/IWRS) and third-party data integration.
Systems, Standards & Technology
Ensure company-wide adherence to CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM) and maintain a standards governance process across studies and vendors.
Partner with IT and other relevant functions to ensure relevant systems and processes comply with 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR/HIPAA as applicable, and company data privacy and information security policies.
Vendor & CRO Oversight
Manage relationships with data management CROs, EDC vendors, and specialty data vendors, including scope, budget, timelines, and quality oversight via service level agreements and metrics.
Lead vendor selection (RFP process, bid defense) for data management services and systems as the portfolio scales.
In collaboration with Quality, conduct or oversee relevant vendor audits and ensure timely resolution of findings related to data management deliverables.
Quality, Compliance & Inspection Readiness
Ensure data management practices comply with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and company SOPs; maintain inspection-ready documentation (Trial Master File data management sections, audit trails, data management plans).
Lead data management readiness for regulatory authorities (including FDA) pre-approval inspections (PAI) and sponsor audits, including mock inspections and CAPA management.
Review for completeness and maintain data management SOPs, working practices, and training materials; ensure staff and vendor training compliance.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage a hybrid internal/outsourced model, appropriate to the size and stage currently of Prilenia.
Partner closely with Biostatistics and Statistical Programming on analysis-ready data timelines, and with Clinical Operations on site-level data quality and monitoring plans.
Manage the data management function’s budget, resourcing, and vendor spend; report progress and risks to senior leadership and, as appropriate, the Board.
Contribute and serve as data management SME in cross-functional, alliance management and BD activities, as may be required from time to time.
Qualifications:
Advanced degree in life sciences, health informatics, statistics, computer science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
12+ years of progressive clinical data management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
Direct experience leading data management through at least one successful NDA, BLA, or MAA submission, including database lock and submission data package delivery.
Deep working knowledge of CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM) and experience ensuring submission-ready datasets.
Hands-on experience with major EDC/CDMS platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault CDMS, Oracle InForm/Clinical One).
Strong knowledge of FDA regulations, ICH-GCP, and 21 CFR Part 11 as applied to clinical data management.
Demonstrated success managing CROs and data management vendors, including budget and timeline accountability.
Experience supporting or leading through an FDA pre-approval inspection or comparable regulatory audit.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and interacting with regulatory agencies.
Skills:
Experience in a small and/or mid-size clinical-stage biotech environment, including building a data management function, including direct experience in US marketing authorization submission.
Therapeutic area experience relevant to Prilenia’s pipeline (e.g., neurology, rare disease, CNS).
Experience with risk-based quality management (RBQM) and centralized statistical monitoring approaches.
Excellent knowledge of regulatory frameworks and requirements for data management including but not limited to FDA and EMA
Familiarity with real-world data sources, patient registries, or external control arms.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Proficient in EDC/CDMS platforms
Familiarity with the evolving roll of AI and Computational Science as it relates to clinical and regulatory activities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
Strong attention to detail
Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure
Highly organized and self-motivated
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and tasks
Ability to work effectively in a global collaborative team environment
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships
Location/Time Zones:
This is a full-time remote position in US.
Flexible schedule with interactions across North America, Europe and Israel time zones.
Up to 15%, including CRO and site visits, investigator meetings, and regulatory interactions
Prilenia operates across the United States, Canada, Europe and Israel, is incorporated in the Netherlands and backed by leading life sciences investors. We are a highly flexible organization that is mostly remote and encourages team members to work in the ways that make them most effective, with a focus on our common goals and getting the job done.
Prilenia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace for all.

jobs.title: Senior Product Director, AI & Agent (Chatbot)
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
AI is not a feature at OKX. It is the next fundamental layer of how we serve users, operate at scale, and maintain trust in a regulated, global market.
We are hiring a Senior Directort of Product, AI & Agent (Chatbot) to own OKX's full AI product agenda — outward, through a crypto-native AI assistant that transforms how users experience our platform; and inward, through agentic systems that make our operations intelligent, auditable, and scalable. This is a single role with a unified mandate: building the AI layer that defines OKX's next decade.
What You’ll Be Doing
User-Facing AI Lead the strategy and execution of OKX's conversational AI assistant — an experience that lets users onboard, trade, stay informed, and get support through natural language. You will define what this product is, how it earns user trust, and how it deepens over time.
Operational AI & Agent Systems Own the agentic AI roadmap for OKX's internal functions — compliance, risk, fraud, and operations. You will identify the highest-leverage workflows, lead their systematic transformation into agent-driven systems, and ensure every output is traceable and regulatorily defensible.
AI Platform Own the product design of shared infrastructure that powers both mandates — orchestration, evaluation, safety architecture, and the governance layer that makes AI products configurable and auditable across all markets.
What We Look For In You
12+ years in product & tech, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning technically complex products at scale
Proven track record shipping conversational AI or agentic AI products — as the owner, not a contributor
Deep familiarity with LLM product architecture: multi-agent systems, RAG, tool use, evaluation, and safety design
Experience operating in regulated environments where auditability and explainability are hard requirements
Strong consumer product instinct alongside operational product rigor
Fluency in financial markets and what it takes to earn user and institutional trust
Executive-level communication in English and Mandarin
Nice-To-Haves
Background in crypto, fintech, or financial services at global scale
Graduate degree in a technical field
Experience with successful Conversational AI or Agentic AI products
Why this role
OKX operates at a scale where the gap between what AI can do and what we have built is still enormous. This role exists to close that gap — on both sides of the platform, simultaneously. If that is the kind of problem you want to own, we want to talk.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

#LI-ONSITE

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Data - GSA (m/w/d)
jobs.text:
Vollzeit, ab sofort, unbefristet, Standort Berlin
Die/Der Head of Data, GSA führt die Data-Intelligence-Unit für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz und spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung einer datengestützten Unternehmenskultur. In dieser Matrixfunktion agiert die/der Head of Data an der Schnittstelle zwischen lokalen Business Units und den regionalen sowie globalen Data-Intelligence-Teams. Die Position verbindet strategische Beratung der Business Units, analytische und technische Führung, die Entwicklung von Talenten sowie die Zusammenarbeit über Länder- und Funktionsgrenzen hinweg. Die/Der Head of Data stellt sicher, dass Daten und Insights einen messbaren Beitrag zu den regionalen Businessprioritäten leisten und gleichzeitig im Einklang mit den Data-Intelligence-Strategien auf regionaler und globaler Ebene stehen.
Was du machst
Du übersetzt komplexe Daten durch regelmäßige und Ad-hoc-Analysen in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis der geschäftlichen Prioritäten in den betreuten Märkten.
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Analytics von deskriptiven hin zu diagnostischen und prädiktiven Ansätzen voran und bleibst dabei eng in analytische Fragestellungen eingebunden, indem du Methoden, Herangehensweisen und Best Practices aktiv mitgestaltest.
Du setzt die regionale Data-Intelligence-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz um und überführst strategische Prioritäten in konkrete Maßnahmen für Reporting, Tools, Datenprodukte und Capability Building.
Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Datenteams über mehrere Märkte hinweg, förderst den Austausch von Best Practices und stellst Konsistenz bei KPI-Definitionen, Reporting-Standards und Governance sicher.
Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Implementierung regionaler KPI-Frameworks, Dashboards und Reporting-Standards sowie die Migration auf moderne Datenplattformen und KI-gestützte Workflows.
Du befähigst Business-Teams durch Trainings zu Datentools, Dashboards und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen und fungierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und technischen Teams.
Du agierst als vertrauenswürdige:r Sparringspartner:in für Senior Stakeholder in der GSA-Region, vertrittst lokale Perspektiven und Geschäftsanforderungen in regionalen und globalen Data-Initiativen und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Balance zwischen lokalen Bedürfnissen und übergeordneten strategischen Zielsetzungen.
Du schaffst die Balance zwischen regionalen Standards und lokalen Marktanforderungen, überzeugst Stakeholder durch klare Kommunikation und datenbasiertes Storytelling und förderst die Akzeptanz datengetriebener Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen der Organisation.
Du förderst eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams und stellst eine effektive Priorisierung sowie Ressourcenplanung sicher.
Wer du bist
Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung in Analytics, Data Science, Insights oder vergleichbaren Bereichen, idealerweise in einem regionalen oder Multi-Markt-Umfeld.
Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten sowie geschäftliche Herausforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
Du hast deine Führungsstärke sowohl durch die direkte Führung von Mitarbeitenden als auch durch die fachliche Leitung von Projekten und funktionsübergreifenden Teams unter Beweis gestellt.
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Reporting-Lösungen, Dashboards, KPI-Frameworks sowie im Umgang mit Data-Governance-Prinzipien mit.
Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte analytische und technische Expertise sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL (Snowflake), Python und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Streamlit, Tableau oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
Du arbeitest kollaborativ, proaktiv und möchtest Verantwortung in einem strategischen und internationalen Umfeld übernehmen und weiter ausbauen.
Erfahrung in der Musikindustrie ist von Vorteil, insbesondere ein gutes Verständnis von Streaming-Geschäftsmodellen, digitalem Musikkonsum und den wesentlichen Marktdynamiken.
Wir bieten dir
Raum für Vielfalt und für Innovation. Die Freiheit, Prozesse und Methoden zu challengen und zu revolutionieren.
Individuelle Benefits-Pakete kombinierbar aus ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Job-Rad und einem Sport-Abo.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein Streaming-Abo deiner Wahl.
Sowie Konzerte und Events in ganz Deutschland und in unserem schicken Headquarter mitten in Schöneberg.
Exklusive Trainings in der hauseigenen Academy.
Sowie das Vertrauen, deine Projekte in Eigenregie zum Erfolg zu führen.
Wie du dich bewirbst
Dein Foto, Alter, Familienstand, deine Herkunft, Zeugnisse, die Jobs deiner Eltern und andere Merkmale benötigen wir nicht.
Zeige uns in einem CV oder einer anderen kreativen Form, was dich ausmacht, was du kannst und warum Sony Music mit dir besser klingt!
Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Analytics von deskriptiven hin zu diagnostischen und prädiktiven Ansätzen voran und bleibst dabei eng in analytische Fragestellungen eingebunden, indem du Methoden, Herangehensweisen und Best Practices aktiv mitgestaltest.

Du setzt die regionale Data-Intelligence-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz um und überführst strategische Prioritäten in konkrete Maßnahmen für Reporting, Tools, Datenprodukte und Capability Building.

Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Datenteams über mehrere Märkte hinweg, förderst den Austausch von Best Practices und stellst Konsistenz bei KPI-Definitionen, Reporting-Standards und Governance sicher.
Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Implementierung regionaler KPI-Frameworks, Dashboards und Reporting-Standards sowie die Migration auf moderne Datenplattformen und KI-gestützte Workflows.
Du befähigst Business-Teams durch Trainings zu Datentools, Dashboards und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen und fungierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und technischen Teams.

Du agierst als vertrauenswürdige:r Sparringspartner:in für Senior Stakeholder in der GSA-Region, vertrittst lokale Perspektiven und Geschäftsanforderungen in regionalen und globalen Data-Initiativen und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Balance zwischen lokalen Bedürfnissen und übergeordneten strategischen Zielsetzungen.

Du förderst eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams und stellst eine effektive Priorisierung sowie Ressourcenplanung sicher.

Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten sowie geschäftliche Herausforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
Du hast deine Führungsstärke sowohl durch die direkte Führung von Mitarbeitenden als auch durch die fachliche Leitung von Projekten und funktionsübergreifenden Teams unter Beweis gestellt.
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Reporting-Lösungen, Dashboards, KPI-Frameworks sowie im Umgang mit Data-Governance-Prinzipien mit.

Erfahrung in der Musikindustrie ist von Vorteil, insbesondere ein gutes Verständnis von Streaming-Geschäftsmodellen, digitalem Musikkonsum und den wesentlichen Marktdynamiken.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Technology (AI) (m/w/d)
jobs.text:
Auf einen Blick
Arbeitsort: deutschlandweit oder in einem unserer Büros in München und Berlin
Arbeitsmodell: Remote deutschlandweit und zusätzlich bis zu drei Monate pro Jahr innerhalb Europas.
Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit
Vertragsart: unbefristete Festanstellung
Vergütung: 120.000 - 150.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr auf Vollzeitbasis. Die konkrete Einordnung innerhalb der Spanne richtet sich nach relevanter Berufserfahrung, nachgewiesener fachlicher Tiefe und dem Umfang vergleichbarer Verantwortung.
Warum gibt es diese Stelle?
PIABO entwickelt eine eigene Softwareplattform, die internes Wissen und Abläufe für die Teams nutzbar macht. Erste Anwendungen sind bereits im Einsatz. Unser Anspruch ist, daraus ein verlässliches Produktportfolio zu entwickeln: Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag genutzt werden, einen nachvollziehbaren Nutzen stiften und sich bei belegter Wirkung für weitere Teams, Kundenprojekte oder neue Angebote eignen.
Damit diese Entwicklung gelingt, braucht es klare Entscheidungen darüber, welche Probleme Priorität haben und welche Lösungen verlässlich in den Einsatz kommen. Die Rolle verbindet Produkt- und Technologieentwicklung, gibt dem bestehenden fünfköpfigen Team aus Development und Project Management eine gemeinsame Richtung und verantwortet zugleich PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft.
Drei Must-haves für die Stelle
Produkt- und Business-Urteil: Du verbindest Produktentscheidungen mit konkretem Geschäftsnutzen.
Hands-on Engineering: Du bringst eigene Entwicklungserfahrung mit und beurteilst technische Qualität praktisch.
Führung und operative Verantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Führung und einen verlässlichen IT-Betrieb.
Was du bei uns tust und wie
Portfolio und Priorisierung: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen. Du bewertest Vorhaben nach Geschäftswirkung, Machbarkeit, Risiken und Kapazität und übersetzt priorisierte Themen in realistische Umsetzungsetappen. Wenn Nutzen oder Voraussetzungen nicht tragen, machst du das transparent und empfiehlst Alternativen.
Use Cases und Erfolgskriterien: Gemeinsam mit den nutzenden Teams nimmst du konkrete Abläufe und Probleme auf, grenzt den Bedarf ein und legst fest, welchen Nutzen die Lösung schaffen soll und woran erfolgreiche Nutzung erkennbar wird.
Software entwickeln: Du baust selbst Prototypen und produktive Software mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen, darunter Coding Agents und LLM-APIs. Du testest Annahmen früh und führst tragfähige Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.
Technische Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest technische Konzepte und Qualitätsmaßstäbe: von Architektur, APIs, Datenflüssen und Integrationen bis zu Tests, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Übergabe in den Betrieb.
Team führen und entwickeln: Du führst das fünfköpfige Team aus Development und Project Management disziplinarisch. Du setzt gemeinsame Prioritäten und Qualitätsmaßstäbe, gibst Feedback und entwickelst Zusammenarbeit und fachliche Stärke weiter.
Einführung und Wirkung nachhalten: Du begleitest die Einführung in den nutzenden Teams und prüfst anhand der vereinbarten Erfolgssignale und Rückmeldungen, ob die Lösung im Alltag genutzt wird und den erwarteten Nutzen liefert. Daraus leitest du ab, was weiterentwickelt, skaliert oder beendet wird.
Operative IT verantworten: Du verantwortest PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft und koordinierst die zuständigen internen und externen Spezialist:innen. Du hältst Zuständigkeiten für verlässlichen Betrieb, Zugriffe, Security und Datenschutz klar und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen mit der nötigen Expertise bearbeitet werden.
Das bringst du mit
Die folgenden Erfahrungen sind für die Rolle erforderlich; unterschiedliche Karrierewege können passen:
Du bringst mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Software- und Produktentwicklung sowie mehrere Jahre eigene Entwicklungspraxis mit – zum Beispiel mit Node.js/TypeScript, Python oder Go. Du hast produktive Systeme selbst gebaut und betrieben.
Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding Agents und LLM-APIs (Agentic Engineering) und kannst ihre Leistungsfähigkeit und Grenzen einschätzen.
Du hast mindestens ein digitales Produkt von der Idee bis in den Betrieb verantwortet. An einem konkreten Beispiel kannst du zeigen, wie du bei offenen Anforderungen Vision, Roadmap und Prioritäten festgelegt, die Lösung in produktive Nutzung gebracht und anhand messbarer Ergebnisse die nächsten Schritte gesteuert hast.
Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt und Mitarbeitende fachlich weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest mit Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Development auf Augenhöhe und challengst Anforderungen, wenn sie nicht zum Ziel beitragen.
Du hast den IT-Betrieb selbst verantwortet oder eng gesteuert – einschließlich Security, Zugriffsmanagement und Datenschutz.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gut Englisch (B2).
Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
Du hast als CTO oder CPO in einem Startup gearbeitet oder ein technisches Unternehmen mit aufgebaut.
Du hast AI-Produkte oder -Plattformen über mehrere Geschäftsbereiche hinweg in die Nutzung gebracht oder skaliert.
Du hast SaaS-Produkte oder wiederverwendbare Software für Kundenprojekte verantwortet.
What’s in it for you?
Du steigst in ein bestehendes AI-Produktsetup ein: Erste Anwendungen sind im Einsatz und ein fünfköpfiges Team ist vorhanden. So kannst du die nächste Entwicklungsstufe mitgestalten, statt bei null anzufangen.
Nähe zur Geschäftsführung: Du tauschst dich direkt mit der Geschäftsführung aus und bringst deine Empfehlungen zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen ein.
Business Impact: Deine Arbeit wirkt in PIABOs internen Abläufen, im New Business, in Kundenprojekten und in neuen Leistungsangeboten.
AI-Lernen: AI Bootcamp, moderner Tech Stack und Raum, AI in der eigenen Arbeit praktisch einzusetzen.
Umfeld: Eine Organisation, die etabliert und zugleich beweglich ist und AI als Grundlage für Produkte, Prozesse und Zusammenarbeit versteht.
Ausstattung und Benefits: Mac-Ausstattung, Urban Sports Club, JobRad und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
Mehr zu unseren Benefits findest du hier.
Kontakt
Deine Ansprechperson: Dorian Baro
Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Teile stattdessen ein konkretes Beispiel aus deiner Produkt- oder Engineering-Arbeit. Links zu Demos, Produkten oder Code sind willkommen, sofern du sie teilen darfst.

jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
The Vice President of Software Engineering is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the technical vision, strategy, and execution for the company’s entire software engineering. VP of Software Engineering leads multiple engineering teams, drives innovation in product development, ensures high-quality scalable systems, and aligns engineering efforts with overall business objectives. The VP of Software Engineering plays a critical role in building high-performing engineering culture, attracting top talent, and delivering technology solutions that support centralized corporate functions and innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the long-term technical strategy and roadmap in alignment with company goals. Partner closely with Business Units, Shared Services, Operations, Finance, and other business leaders to prioritize initiatives.
Engineering Organization Management: Lead, mentor, and grow a diverse engineering organization of data, digital, and AI skills. Oversee multiple teams including Enterprise Architecture, Full stack development, platform, infrastructure, DevOps, and data engineering.
Technical Excellence: Ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, secure, and reliable software systems. Champion best practices in software architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security.
Talent Acquisition & Development: Attract, retain, and develop world-class engineering talent. Build strong engineering leadership bench strength, establish career growth frameworks, and foster a culture of inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.
Process & Delivery: Implement and improve agile/lean development processes, engineering metrics (DORA, SPACE, etc.), and delivery predictability while maintaining velocity.
Innovation & Technology: Stay ahead of industry trends (cloud-native, AI/ML, microservices, etc.) and evaluate new technologies that can drive business value.
Risk & Compliance: Oversee technical risk management, data privacy, security standards, and regulatory compliance (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, etc. as applicable).
Budget & Operations: Manage the engineering budget, vendor relationships, and infrastructure costs. Optimize resource allocation across projects and initiatives.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a key member of the leadership team, providing technical guidance to other business leaders and the C-suite when needed.
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
Experience: 12+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with at least 5–7 years in senior engineering leadership roles (Director or above). Experience leading engineering organizations in SaaS, consumer tech, fintech, or enterprise software environments is strongly preferred.
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success shipping complex, high-scale products and platforms used by thousands of Enterprise users.
Leadership Style: Servant leader with a track record of building high-trust, high-performance engineering cultures.
Required Skills & Competencies
Deep expertise in modern software architecture, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), distributed systems, and DevOps practices.
Strong people leadership skills with experience managing managers and directors.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities — able to translate technical concepts for non-technical executives.
Strategic thinking combined with strong execution and operational rigor.
Data-driven decision making using engineering metrics and KPIs.
Experience with AI/ML integration or modern frontend/mobile stacks is a plus.
What Success Looks Like
Engineering organization consistently delivers high-impact features on time with high quality.
Low employee turnover and strong employer brand in the technical talent market.
Technology platform is reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient.
Engineering is viewed as a strategic partner across the company, not just a delivery function.
About us
SLR are global leaders in environmental and advisory solutions helping our clients achieve their sustainability goals. We are a consultancy with over 5,000 staff across 6 regions. SLR’s ‘one team’ culture is at the heart of our business; providing a collaborative and supportive environment for professional development.
Competitive compensation package, benefits, and wellness initiatives. Final package will vary according to which region the successful candidate resides in.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution
Requirements
Non-Negotiable
Deep, production-level experience with n8n automation systems
Strong full-stack development skills (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases)
Proven experience leading engineers while remaining hands-on
Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code in development workflows
Strong working experience with Clay for data enrichment, signal detection, or GTM automation
Experience building and scaling AI/LLM systems in production
Strong systems architecture thinking (scalability, reliability, fault tolerance)
Executive-level mindset with the ability to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Preferred Experience
Agency or services background with multi-client automation systems
Experience building SaaS or productized internal tools
Familiarity with tools like Airtable, HubSpot, Slack APIs, and outbound infrastructure
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.)
Benefits
💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams
🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services
🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network
🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement
💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Odin
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.
Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.
We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.
The Role
This is the role for an engineer with high agency, a disdain for bureaucracy, and an instinct to drive things forward without waiting for structure to be put in place. If you've been senior at a slow-moving company and you're frustrated by the gap between what should be possible and what actually ships, this is the antidote.
Odin is post-PMF, revenue-generating, and preparing to scale into the US. We're hiring our founding Head of Engineering.At our stage there's no such thing as a leader who isn't hands-on. The strongest technical contributor in the room should be you. We don't have capacity for non-technical middle management.
Responsibilities
Engineering execution. Accountable for what engineering ships and how. About half the role is hands-on in the codebase - owning features and the harder calls in the system.
Engineering standards. Code quality, testing, code review, documentation, post-mortems, on-call - the bar gets set here, and held.
Performance management. Give direct, specific, technical feedback quickly when someone isn't performing, and make the hard calls. Grow people through high standards and direct feedback - not frameworks, PIPs, or formal coaching programmes.
Hiring and team growth. Hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers as the team grows from six to ~15-20 over the next two years.
AI productivity. Turning individual AI productivity gains into team-level output that customers feel - through how the team works, what gets built, and what gets measured.
Engineering reliability. Root-cause discipline, pre-mortems before customer-facing launches, on-call, incident response - the practices that make shipping bug-free a system, not a hope. Especially important given the financial accuracy required across multiple jurisdictions.
Working with Product. Product owns what we ship; engineering owns how it's built so we can ship regularly and reliably. The answers to "why is it built this way?" live here.
Technical partner relationships. Engineering counterpart on banking, KYC, custodians, and vendor diligence. Build-vs-buy calls sit here too.
The kind of person who thrives here
The right person is intense in the best way: action-oriented, curious, direct, and frustrated by slow delivery. A through-and-through builder - you still write code in your spare time, you're naturally pulled to the hardest problems, and you can't stop until you've shipped the solution.
Senior engineers respect you because you've earned it through your work, not because of your title. They want to be managed by you because you're the strongest engineer in the room and the one who gives direct, useful feedback. You can call something out and have it taken on board - the team already knows you're brilliant at the actual work. Feedback runs both ways: just as direct when it's coming at you.
Weighing engineering decisions by customer impact, not engineering aesthetics. The question is "how does this actually affect the customers of the business?" - not "is this technically nice."
Pragmatic risk judgement: engineering effort proportional to consequence. Comfortable saying "this is fine" when risk is genuinely low; equally comfortable holding the line where money or compliance is involved.
Tailoring communication to the audience - engineers, product, leadership, founders. Same person, different register. You ask questions until things genuinely make sense; "disagree and commit" while still confused isn't your move.
If you've built engineering before - as a founder, a CTO, a Head of Engineering, or an engineering leader without the formal title - this is the chance to do it at the right stage. Post-PMF, revenue-generating, six engineers, plenty still to figure out, and the engineering org genuinely yours to shape. If you hear someone has 50x'd their output with AI and your instinct is to dig in rather than scoff, even better.
Bottom line
This role shapes how engineering grows at Odin - what gets shipped, how it gets shipped, who joins, who stays, and what we expect of each other. The team will rise to meet the bar you set. Your job is to make sure the bar is high enough to matter, and to hold it.
The Hiring Process
Our process is entirely real-time - no take-home assignments, no async tasks. We want to see how you actually think and work, including how you use AI in your day-to-day. The final stages happen in-person.
You start with a call with Imani, our Head of People, to unpack the role and learn more about us.
Then a few different conversations with Mary, Paddy, and our external technical advisor - covering culture and values, working through real technical problems together, and digging into how you think about hiring, performance management, and technical depth.
The process typically runs over two weeks. We share detailed feedback within 24 hours of each stage and aim to line up next steps quickly so momentum isn't lost.
Salary
The salary band for this role is £140,000 - £170,000 + equity options. During the hiring process, we'll assess your experience and capabilities to determine your starting salary.
Working at Odin
Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in the UK with quarterly trips to London.
Benefits
Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support
Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness
Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave
Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options
Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)
Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally
Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave
Compensation: £140K – £200K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.text:
🚀 Why Midnite?
Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.
We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.
Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.
We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.
Not your grandad’s bookie.
👀 The Role
Title: Head of Product Design
Team: Design
Location: Remote, UK
Experience quality is one of the clearest ways Midnite differentiates in a category that too often settles for functional and familiar. As Head of Product Design, you will ensure craft, quality and ambition remain central to how we build, as we scale. You will lead Product Design, shape company wide experience direction, and embed Design in the most important product decisions. This is a role with real influence, accountable for how Midnite feels across every surface and responsible for raising the bar as we grow.
You will:
Lead and develop our Product Design team, line managing five designers and setting a clear standard for craft, judgement and ownership.
Define and uphold the experience bar across all product surfaces, from customer facing native and web to back office platforms.
Ensure coherence across squads and journeys so Midnite feels like one joined up system rather than a collection of features.
Shape the long term experience direction and codify principles that guide teams toward a shared north star.
Mature and drive adoption of our design systems to enable both speed and consistency at scale.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership on strategy, early problem framing and complex trade offs.
Contribute hands on to Midnite’s most complex and high impact initiatives, elevating outcomes through strong visual and interaction design.
Collaborate with Brand, Creative, Growth, CRM and Games to ensure the end to end customer experience is cohesive and well crafted.
Explore and integrate emerging technologies, including AI, where they meaningfully improve how we design and build.
Strengthen the structures and standards that allow experience quality to scale as the company grows
The next Midniter:
Sets and defends a high bar for visual and interaction design, with exceptional taste and strong product instincts.
Has operated at scale, shaping design direction across multiple teams and surfaces.
Has built or matured design systems that improve consistency and enable teams to move faster without sacrificing quality.
Brings hands on craft capability and is comfortable directly contributing to high stakes initiatives.
Is a trusted strategic partner to Product and Engineering leaders, contributing meaningfully to roadmap direction and key decisions.
Develops designers through thoughtful feedback, coaching and hiring, steadily raising overall team capability.
Communicates clearly and practically, influencing across disciplines and levels of seniority.
Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and thoughtful about where they add real value.
Cares deeply about building well designed digital products, from simplifying complex systems to refining interaction, motion and hierarchy.
💰 Winnings
Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.
Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.
Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.
Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.
Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.
Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.
Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.
Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.
At Midnite, we are committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.
We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (all identities)
jobs.text:
What to Expect
Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. At the same time, we are progressing towards medical-device obligations and expanding AI-enabled ways of working.
As CTO, you will own Technology and Engineering at C-level. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO.
Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice.
This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany.
Your Challenges
Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points.
Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation.
Build a strong leadership layer, clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies.
Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies.
Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified.
Plan the Engineering budget and capacity. Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity.
Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance.
Make credible commitments with Product. Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments.
Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early. Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights.
Establish clear data contracts with Data. Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science.
Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board.
What success looks like
In your first year, you will:
Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems
Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings
Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence
Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective
Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality
Your Profile
You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition.
You have owned technology strategy, budget, capacity and build, buy or outsource decisions at executive level, with evidence of their impact.
You have led Engineering in regulated, security-critical or high-availability systems. Medical-device or digital-health experience is a plus, not a prerequisite.
You have built and scaled cloud-SaaS products, ideally in a regulated environment. Health-tech or medical-device experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. You also bring broad systems depth across backend services, web and mobile clients, APIs and integrations, data flows, observability, security and operations. Our exact stack is not a hard filter.
You currently work hands-on with agentic development workflows and can show how you used, constrained or rejected AI output and made it scale
You have shipped products that achieved meaningful customer and business outcomes and bring product judgement and pace, not only engineering rigor. You can challenge Product constructively, make business and technical trade-offs explicit and protect credible commitments under pressure.
You build trust with teams, customers, partners, auditors, investors and boards without acting as a rescuer or creating dependence on yourself.
You are business-fluent in German and English.
A university degree or fixed number of years is not required. We care about demonstrated impact, judgement and responsibility you have personally carried.
Why Caspar Health?
A genuine C-level mandate with ownership of Engineering and company technology strategy.
The opportunity to combine speed and rigor for digital clinical workflows and make a tangible difference to care.
A clear Product-Technology peer model with shared decisions instead of hidden hand-offs.
Remote-first within Germany with flexible working hours. Regular in-person leadership in Berlin is part of the role. There is no fixed weekly office quota. You will spend time with clinics, partners and at important meetings when useful.
A virtual equity package (VSOP) with meaningful participation in the company's value growth, plus 30 vacation days, a home-office allowance, meal subsidy and a budget for learning, conferences and coaching.
High level of ownership and decision-making freedom – no micromanagement. We hire experts who know what they’re doing. #MakeAnImpact!
Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus!
Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether!
And yes – all the snacks your heart desires, group sports sessions, a never-empty drinks fridge, and a healthy dose of humor are included too
Your Contact
Dana Kussatz; People Business Partner TECH
Please submit your application online. We are also interested in knowing your earliest possible start date and your salary expectations. If you have further questions please reach out to ----- We will get in touch with you as soon as we can.
Our product CASPAR Health is used in the environment of medical institutions, patients, doctors and therapists. Working with (sensitive) personal data (e.g. health data) is part of our daily work. Therefore, we require a high level of commitment to the protection of personal data from our employees in order to protect the rights of the data subjects as best as possible.
Diversity and Inclusion:
At Caspar Health, we strive to provide a friendly, safe and welcoming environment for all Casparians* regardless of ethnic origin, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations of any kind, physical appearance, social background, age or religion (or lack thereof).
When you apply, we purely focus on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (picture, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc). We value and treat all applications equally.
We are looking forward to getting to know you!
Data privacy notice:
Please apply exclusively via our application link, as this is the only way we can ensure the protection of your data. You can find our privacy policy here

jobs.title: Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics
jobs.text:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).
HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.
HackerOne Values
HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics
Remote role for candidates located in HackerOne's San Francisco Bay, CA Austin, TX or Seattle, WA hiring hubs
Position Summary
Compensation, benefits, systems, and analytics are how a company keeps its promises to the people who build it — and at HackerOne, you'll own all four. As Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics, you'll design how we pay, reward, and understand our global workforce, turning a fast-scaling People function into one that runs on trusted data and durable systems. This is a rare chance to build the reward philosophy, the HR technology backbone, and the people-analytics practice of a company trusted by Anthropic, GitHub, Goldman Sachs, and the U.S. Department of Defense — and to shape the standards our leaders use to make every talent decision.
In this role, you'll lead the Total Rewards, People Systems, and People Analytics department and set the multi-year strategy for compensation, benefits, HRIS (Workday), and workforce reporting. You'll translate company strategy into departmental goals, own org design and hiring within your teams, and partner closely with Finance, Legal, and the executive team on pay equity, annual compensation cycles, board-ready workforce metrics, and the systems roadmap that makes all of it scale. Along the way, you'll develop the managers and specialists on your teams into the next generation of People leaders.
At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role for candidates based on the West Coast of the United States (Pacific time zone). We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.
Primary Responsibilities
Success in the Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.
Own HackerOne's global Total Rewards strategy — compensation structure, pay bands and leveling, equity, and benefits — aligning it to company priorities and holding the function accountable for outcomes, not just plans, demonstrating Own the Outcome through clear tradeoffs, durable ownership systems, and results leaders can trust.
Lead and grow the Total Rewards, People Systems, and People Analytics teams, shaping the department's structure through scalable systems, strategic delegation, and people development — Multiplying Your Impact by developing managers and specialists into future People leaders and representing the function in cross-org forums.
Build the People Analytics practice that gives HackerOne a single, trusted view of its workforce — headcount, attrition, pay equity, and engagement — embedding Data-Driven Decision Making by creating scalable outcome tracking, aligning cross-functionally on definitions and standards, and holding teams to evidence over assumption.
Own the People technology roadmap anchored on Workday, connecting AI-native redesign priorities to how you allocate resources so the function becomes AI Native rather than AI-augmented — and making the quality of AI-assisted work part of how the team's performance is evaluated.
Run the annual compensation and benefits cycles - market benchmarking, merit, bonus, and equity planning - and re-architect them from First Principles rather than short-term workarounds, simplifying the interfaces between People, Finance, and managers so the process scales as the company grows.
Operationalize change across the function as HackerOne scales — designing Total Rewards and systems processes that respond to change without friction, committing resources with the information available, and equipping managers to lead their teams through change with Change Agility.
Partner with Finance, Legal, and the executive team on pay equity, budget and headcount planning, executive and board compensation materials, and regulatory compliance across the regions where HackerOne operates.
Establish the data governance, controls, and auditability that keep compensation and people data accurate, secure, and defensible — the foundation every downstream talent decision depends on.
Minimum Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Total Rewards, compensation, analytics including designing and running compensation and benefits programs at scale.
5+ years of people-leadership experience, including managing managers or team leads.
Hands-on ownership of an HRIS (Workday strongly preferred) and the surrounding People technology stack, including data integrity, integrations, and reporting.
Demonstrated experience building People analytics and workforce reporting that executives rely on to make decisions.
Experience partnering with Finance and Legal on pay equity, compensation cycles, and multi-region compliance.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting executive and/or board-level compensation.
Global Total Rewards experience across multiple countries (e.g., the US and India).
Familiarity with market benchmarking frameworks such as Radford or Pave
Experience redesigning People workflows around AI capabilities.
At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of San Francisco, CA. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*
Equity stock options
Retirement plans
