Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics
Remote role for candidates located in HackerOne's San Francisco Bay, CA Austin, TX or Seattle, WA hiring hubs
Position Summary

Compensation, benefits, systems, and analytics are how a company keeps its promises to the people who build it — and at HackerOne, you'll own all four. As Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics, you'll design how we pay, reward, and understand our global workforce, turning a fast-scaling People function into one that runs on trusted data and durable systems. This is a rare chance to build the reward philosophy, the HR technology backbone, and the people-analytics practice of a company trusted by Anthropic, GitHub, Goldman Sachs, and the U.S. Department of Defense — and to shape the standards our leaders use to make every talent decision.

In this role, you'll lead the Total Rewards, People Systems, and People Analytics department and set the multi-year strategy for compensation, benefits, HRIS (Workday), and workforce reporting. You'll translate company strategy into departmental goals, own org design and hiring within your teams, and partner closely with Finance, Legal, and the executive team on pay equity, annual compensation cycles, board-ready workforce metrics, and the systems roadmap that makes all of it scale. Along the way, you'll develop the managers and specialists on your teams into the next generation of People leaders.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role for candidates based on the West Coast of the United States (Pacific time zone). We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.
Primary Responsibilities

Success in the Director, Total Rewards, Systems & Analytics role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

Own HackerOne's global Total Rewards strategy — compensation structure, pay bands and leveling, equity, and benefits — aligning it to company priorities and holding the function accountable for outcomes, not just plans, demonstrating Own the Outcome through clear tradeoffs, durable ownership systems, and results leaders can trust.

Lead and grow the Total Rewards, People Systems, and People Analytics teams, shaping the department's structure through scalable systems, strategic delegation, and people development — Multiplying Your Impact by developing managers and specialists into future People leaders and representing the function in cross-org forums.

Build the People Analytics practice that gives HackerOne a single, trusted view of its workforce — headcount, attrition, pay equity, and engagement — embedding Data-Driven Decision Making by creating scalable outcome tracking, aligning cross-functionally on definitions and standards, and holding teams to evidence over assumption.

Own the People technology roadmap anchored on Workday, connecting AI-native redesign priorities to how you allocate resources so the function becomes AI Native rather than AI-augmented — and making the quality of AI-assisted work part of how the team's performance is evaluated.

Run the annual compensation and benefits cycles - market benchmarking, merit, bonus, and equity planning - and re-architect them from First Principles rather than short-term workarounds, simplifying the interfaces between People, Finance, and managers so the process scales as the company grows.

Operationalize change across the function as HackerOne scales — designing Total Rewards and systems processes that respond to change without friction, committing resources with the information available, and equipping managers to lead their teams through change with Change Agility.

Partner with Finance, Legal, and the executive team on pay equity, budget and headcount planning, executive and board compensation materials, and regulatory compliance across the regions where HackerOne operates.
Establish the data governance, controls, and auditability that keep compensation and people data accurate, secure, and defensible — the foundation every downstream talent decision depends on.
Minimum Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Total Rewards, compensation, analytics including designing and running compensation and benefits programs at scale.
5+ years of people-leadership experience, including managing managers or team leads.
Hands-on ownership of an HRIS (Workday strongly preferred) and the surrounding People technology stack, including data integrity, integrations, and reporting.
Demonstrated experience building People analytics and workforce reporting that executives rely on to make decisions.
Experience partnering with Finance and Legal on pay equity, compensation cycles, and multi-region compliance.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting executive and/or board-level compensation.
Global Total Rewards experience across multiple countries (e.g., the US and India).
Familiarity with market benchmarking frameworks such as Radford or Pave
Experience redesigning People workflows around AI capabilities.

jobs.title: AVP, Data Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.
The Assistant Vice President, Data Solutions Engineering will be responsible for building operational data pipelines and delivering fully documented datasets that account for data integrations. This role is engaged and aligned with our business partners to understand their needs and build data engineering solutions to address these needs. The role will report to the VP, Data Solutions Engineering.
This role will be based remotely.
What You Will Do:
Deliver well-architected data solutions in partnership with data platform engineers, data governance, data science, and data analytics/visualization peers.
Partner with business teams to design data solutions with the ability to mentor early career data engineers.
Lead build-out and deployment of data pipelines.
Ensure reliability, scalability and governance of data pipelines.
What You Will Have:
Bachelor's degree in Math, Computer Science or Engineering.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, Cloud, data operations.
Domain knowledge of Actuarial, Investment and Finance within Insurance/Reinsurance industry is a plus.
Minimum experience of seven years in a growing data engineering role, with at least five years in programming (Python) and SQL.
Robust knowledge of data lakes, data governance and modern data quality techniques.
Excellent analytical, problem solving and conceptual skills.
Strong verbal and written skills.
The base salary range for this role is listed below and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, all employees are eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.
Base Salary Range
$160,000—$180,000 USD
At Fortitude Re, our strength has always come from our people. Our success is deeply rooted in our ability to embrace the unique attributes, perspectives and experiences of every individual within our company. Fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging where everyone—regardless of background, race, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity—feels valued and respected is a foundation of our culture.
We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer and evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, diversity of thought and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
To all recruitment agencies: Unless you have been requested to work on this position, or other positions with Fortitude Re, please do not forward any resumes to Fortitude Re employees. Fortitude Re is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
Check us out on YouTube: About Fortitude Re (youtube.com)
By submitting your application, you agree that Fortitude Re may collect your personal data for recruiting purposes. For more on how we handle your personal data, please review our Applicant Privacy Notice. Concerned about recruitment fraud? Learn how to verify Fortitude Re's recruitment process: Recruitment Fraud Notice

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
You
Are passionate about technology, wake up every morning to experiment, learn and develop new solutions!
You Will
Work on latest edge Cloud computing to solve difficult, manual and repeatable tasks for users adopting Cloud technologies like AWS, Salesforce, Microsoft and more
Use the latest trends on building SaaS applications using multitenancy, scalability large data volumes / Big Data and more
Develop and expand our portfolio to support most popular Cloud apps (200+)
Develop understanding of not just software development, but also how to design, develop and launch a product from concept to high customer use.
About Us
At DBSync we provide opportunity to use technology that creates innovative and next generation data integration products which helps our employees to cultivate their creativity and sense of belonging. DBSync is a leading provider for data integration and Data warehousing services for both cloud/SAAS-based-on-demand applications. We were incubated by Salesforce.com (as a part of Avankia), before getting spunned off as a separate company. DBSync provides data integration as a SAAS-based, Standalone or hosted integration at a competitive price with a plethora of benefits for business users.
Our main motto is to provide a strong foundation for businesses in solving complex problems and automating their workflows while acting as a pillar of support for all their data integrations needs. At DBSync we encourage innovation and creativity and our team is diverse comprising of a nice mix of cultural blends. We are a family where each talent is recognised and honed for the best of the individual and the company as a whole. We maintain a very professional, learn and excel vision with a hint of a start-up-like environment making each individual feel important and responsible with an equal opportunity to grow to the sky’s limit!
If you have a spirit of enthusiasm to grow beyond horizons, a determination to work hard, confidence to achieve success and influence future visions and products and be a successful part of the next gen trend, DBSync is the place for you!
Our Value System
We genuinely care
We do not waste time on manual or mundane task
We have a fun environment
We own it
We are experts on what we do
We win together
DBSync has been:
We have been rated 4.7 / 5 on G2. We have got around 125 reviews in 2023.
Based on the reviews G2 has awarded DBSync following badges.
- Best Relationship- Winter 2024
- Leader Americas Winter 2024
- Best Results - Winter 2024
- Best Usability - Winter 2024
About the Role
We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for working directly with development, support, implementation, and other internal teams as well as external vendors and clients. The Head of Engineering will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the engineering department within the organization. This role requires strong leadership skills, technical expertise, and a strategic mindset to drive innovation and ensure the successful delivery of engineering projects.
You will work directly with the CEO/CTO and will act as both a technology and business expert, making decisions that will impact the current and future operations of the company.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Manage multiple engineering projects and ensure successful delivery of products on time and within budget
Lead a team of engineers and provide guidance on technical issues
Collaborate with other teams such as product, design, and customer support to ensure smooth product development and delivery
Ensure coding standards, best practices, and security protocols are followed by the team
Hire, train, and mentor engineers and support staff
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve the engineering process
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and partners to ensure projects are completed successfully
Must have successfully delivered at least two projects end-to-end.
Oversight of the full software development lifecycle required for a group of developers and testers in an agile environment.
Leading staff to implement clients in the most efficient, time driven manner. The manager is responsible for the total quality of the technical deliverables in their domain, making sure that they are secure, defect-free.
Mentoring technical staff during projects to ensure continuous improvement. Includes working with each resource to define and act upon career paths and obtain appropriate training. Is responsible for the hiring, training, staff development, performance appraisals, corrective action and pay review of technical personnel.
Developing and establishing department standards and procedures.
Recommends the most efficient ways to ensure best implementation practices of new upgraded products.
Evaluates and reports progress and results.
Skills and Qualifications Required:
Must have hands-on experience in Java, Front end technologies like Bootstrap, jQuery, AWS, Modular software development, multi-tenant architecture and highly scalable systems.
Proficient with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Must have a minimum of 8-10 years of experience demonstrating required skills and competencies in engineering
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MS/MBA or other relevant graduate degree is a plus.
Must have hands on Full stack architecture experience
Have in-depth conceptual functional and non-functional knowledge of Docker Containers, Kubernetes Cluster management and orchestration, microservice architectures, DevOps practices and tooling.
Previous leadership or management experience required
Strong communication skills are a requirement, as this position must build consensus with numerous internal and external resources and effectively influence the technical direction of projects in order to be successful.
Ability to determine the best implementation approach/methodology for assigned project(s) based on established guidelines and best practices and determine appropriate strategy for ensuring desired objectives.
Must be very flexible with learning new technology quickly.
Location: Bangalore (Remote)
Shift Timings: U.K. Shift (1:30 PM IST - 10:30 PM IST)
For more information about DBSync, visit www.mydbsync.com.
Video: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJzycdoERLoekPWNkXEsuih807TQAEnnB

jobs.title: Director, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.text:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.
Why you’ll love this role
Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the AI/ML engineering strategy, build and develop the team, and make the decisions that move our highest-impact opportunities forward. You’ll partner with Product, Data Science, and business leaders to decide where we invest, what we build, and how we measure success.
What you’ll do
Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.
About you
10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.
7+ years of practical ML or data science experience, including experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, search, or recommendation systems.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.
Clear, compelling communication and the ability to influence senior leaders, make tough prioritization decisions, and turn ambiguity into action.
Nice to have skills
Experience managing managers or leading multiple ML engineering or applied science teams.
Marketplace, e-commerce, or Supply Chain experience, particularly in search, recommendations, computer vision, or fraud and trust and safety.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; experience with AWS and shared ML platforms.
About StockX
StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment.

As Associate Director you will manage security design consulting engagements to a professional standard; independently and in support of other senior colleagues, and the Director. jobs.title: Associate Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Become a part of our caring community
The Associate Director, Product Management leads the Product Management function for Associate Technology Experience (ATX), developing product talent and strengthening the practices, capabilities, and operating model needed to deliver measurable associate and business outcomes. This leader guides Product Managers in discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, data-driven decision-making, and product performance measurement.
Working across Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, Operations, and other partners, the Associate Director improves how product teams identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and deliver value. Success is measured by stronger product teams, better product decisions and outcomes, and a more mature and effective Product Management organization.
The Associate Director, Product Management leads the Product Management function for Associate Technology Experience (ATX). This role is responsible for developing product talent, strengthening product management capabilities, and improving how teams use customer insights, experience data, and performance measures to deliver measurable outcomes for associates and the business.
Leading a team of Product Managers, this leader establishes and advances the practices, expectations, and operating model that enable high-quality discovery, roadmap development, product decision-making, and outcome measurement across the ATX product portfolio. The successful candidate brings experience leading Product Managers, improving product management practices, and building high-performing product organizations that use customer insights and data to make better product decisions.
Working closely with Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, Operations, and other cross-functional partners, the Associate Director improves how product teams identify opportunities, prioritize investments, measure outcomes, and deliver value for associates. Success in this role is defined by stronger product teams, better product decisions, improved product outcomes, and a more mature and effective Product Management organization.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the Product Management function for Associate Technology Experience (ATX), establishing clear expectations, standards, and accountability for the product team.
Develop, coach, and grow a high-performing team of Product Managers through hiring, performance management, mentorship, and career development.
Improve the quality and consistency of product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, and product decision-making, ensuring teams focus on the highest-value opportunities for associates and the business.
Advance product management maturity by defining and evolving product practices, operating mechanisms, governance, and ways of working that improve effectiveness, transparency, and organizational alignment.
Strengthen the integration of customer research, experience measurement, analytics, operational insights, and market trends into product decisions, prioritization, and investment recommendations.
Establish and continuously evolve the product performance framework for ATX, defining outcome measures, product health indicators, adoption metrics, customer experience signals, and operational measures.
Strengthen product go-to-market and lifecycle practices by ensuring new capabilities are effectively communicated, customer impacts are understood, adoption strategies are defined, and product value is clearly demonstrated.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, Operations, and other cross-functional leaders to align priorities, inform tradeoff decisions, and improve product outcomes.
Provide product leadership and recommendations that inform strategic planning, roadmap direction, and organizational priorities while ensuring product teams remain aligned to ATX objectives.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree.
8+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, including responsibility for product discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and measurement of customer and business outcomes.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, talent development, and building high-performing teams.
Experience leading Product Managers responsible for enterprise technology products, services, or platforms, including products that are configured, integrated, or enabled through third-party technologies and vendor solutions.
Demonstrated success advancing product management maturity through the development of product practices, operating models, governance, performance measurement, and talent capabilities.
Experience building and scaling product organizations that use customer insights, experience data, analytics, and outcome measures to inform product decisions and prioritization.
Demonstrated ability to define, monitor, and use product health metrics, adoption measures, customer experience indicators, and business outcomes to evaluate performance and guide investment decisions.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Research, Analytics, and Operations leaders to align priorities and improve product outcomes.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders and build alignment across complex, matrixed organizations.
Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, operational considerations, and technical constraints.
Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing enterprise technology products, employee experiences, digital workplace capabilities, or internal-facing product portfolios, including products and services enabled through vendor platforms, commercial software, or third-party technology ecosystems.
Experience with service management, knowledge management, employee support, onboarding, productivity, or workplace technology experiences.
Experience introducing, scaling, or managing AI-enabled products, copilots, intelligent assistants, or enterprise productivity technologies.
Experience establishing or leading Product Operations capabilities, including product planning, governance, product performance measurement, and portfolio visibility.
Experience working within large, highly matrixed organizations where product success depends on influencing stakeholders across multiple business and technology teams.
MBA or advanced degree in Business, Technology, Product Management, Human-Centered Design, or a related field and/or experience.
Use your skills to make an impact
Typically requires Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent, 6+ years of product management and 3+ years of management experience.

Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

jobs.title: CTO Cofounder - PreSeed PropTech Berlin
jobs.text:
Founders Factory × Nua Materials
Co-Founder & CTO
Founders Factory baut und finanziert gemeinsam mit außergewöhnlichen Gründer:innen und führenden Unternehmen neue Start-ups; unser Gründerteam verfügt über eigene Exit-/IPO-Erfahrung, und unsere mehr als 300 Portfoliounternehmen haben seit 2015 über 900 Mio. USD an Anschlussfinanzierung eingeworben.
Für Nua Materials suchen wir eine:n technische:n Co-Founder & CTO, der oder die gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Gründer aus einem validierten Konzept ein skalierbares Produkt und Unternehmen aufbaut.
Die Chance
Neuartige und nachhaltige Baustoffe gibt es längst, doch viele schaffen den Weg in reale Bauprojekte nur langsam. Für Bauunternehmen, Wohnungsunternehmen und Projektentwickler sind Informationen und Nachweise fragmentiert, Produkte schwer vergleichbar und neue Materialien mit zusätzlichen technischen, wirtschaftlichen und organisatorischen Risiken verbunden. Gleichzeitig steigt der regulatorische Druck: Wesentliche Teile der neuen EU-Bauprodukteverordnung gelten seit 2026, der Digitale Produktpass für Bauprodukte kommt.
Viele bestehende Lösungen setzen bei Dokumentation, Nachweisen und Zertifizierung an – nicht bei der eigentlichen Auswahl- und Kaufentscheidung. Genau dort setzt Nua Materials an. Ein zentraler Baustein ist der Nua Score, der bereits in einer ersten Version vorliegt. Bisherige Gespräche mit Herstellern, Bauunternehmen, Projektentwicklern und Gebäudeeigentümern bestätigen den Bedarf und zeigen Interesse an Pilotprojekten.
Was du aufbauen wirst
Als Co-Founder & CTO verantwortest du in der frühen Phase Produkt und Technologie.
Du definierst mit Nutzer:innen die entscheidenden Abläufe und baust den ersten nutzbaren Prototypen.
Du entwickelst den Nua Score weiter und baust eine robuste Daten- und Systemarchitektur für unterschiedliche externe Datenquellen.
Du entscheidest, was jetzt gebaut, später ergänzt oder automatisiert werden sollte – und was bewusst nicht ins Produkt gehört.
Du arbeitest direkt mit ersten Kund:innen und Partnern und baust später ein kleines Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam auf.
Die ersten Monate sind sehr operativ: Wir suchen eine:n technische:n Gründer:in, der oder die selbst baut und Produktentscheidungen mitträgt.
Wen wir suchen
Produktentwicklung: Du kannst aus einem noch unscharfen Kundenproblem einen klaren, testbaren Produktansatz entwickeln und technisch umsetzen.
Datenbasierte Produkte: Du hast Erfahrung mit datengetriebenen Plattformen, Bewertungs- oder Vergleichssystemen und kannst konkrete Fehlerquellen, Datenqualitätsprobleme und Validierungsentscheidungen beschreiben.
Technische Breite: Du bist stark in Backend und Datenarchitektur und kommst im Frontend weit genug, um frühe Produktversionen selbst auszuliefern.
Vertrauen im B2B: Du baust nachvollziehbare Systeme, die bei risikoaversen Unternehmenskunden, langen Entscheidungswegen und hohen Nachweisanforderungen bestehen.
Gründermentalität und Marktverständnis: Du hast gegründet, warst eine:r der ersten technischen Mitarbeiter:innen eines Start-ups oder hast vergleichbare Verantwortung übernommen. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, professionelles Englisch und Erfahrung im DACH-Markt sind wichtig.
Besonders interessant, aber kein Muss
Erfahrung in Construction Tech oder PropTech
Hintergrund in Bauingenieurwesen oder Materialwissenschaften, idealerweise mit LCA-/EPD-Erfahrung
Erfahrung mit Vergleichsplattformen oder Marktplätzen
Was wir bieten
Kapital und Gründerfinanzierung für die Aufbauphase
Enge Unterstützung durch Founders Factory in Produkt, Daten, Wachstum, Finanzierung, Recht und Personal – auf Basis bestehender Markt-, Kunden- und Produktarbeit
Zugang zu ersten potenziellen Kund:innen und Partnern in Bau- und Wohnungswirtschaft sowie zu unserem internationalen Netzwerk
-------------------
In English:
Founders Factory × Nua Materials
Co-Founder & CTO
Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.
For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.
The opportunity
New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.
Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. A core component is the Nua Score, which already exists in an initial version. Conversations with manufacturers, construction companies, developers and asset owners have confirmed the need and shown interest in pilots.
What you will build
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.
Define the critical workflows with users and build the first usable product.
Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.
Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.
Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.
The first months will be highly hands-on: we are looking for a technical founder who builds personally and helps shape the product, not a CTO who starts by delegating.
Who we are looking for
Product development: You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear, testable product approach and build it.
Data-driven products: You have experience with data-heavy platforms, scoring or comparison systems and can talk concretely about failure modes, data-quality issues and validation decisions you have encountered.
Technical range: You are strong in backend and data architecture and capable enough on the frontend to ship early product versions yourself.
Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.
Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.
Especially relevant, but not required
Experience in ConTech or PropTech
Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience
Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces
What we offer
Capital and founder funding for the build phase
Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work
Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

Du entscheidest, was jetzt gebaut, später ergänzt oder automatisiert werden sollte – und was bewusst nicht ins Produkt gehört.
Du arbeitest direkt mit ersten Kund:innen und Partnern und baust später ein kleines Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam auf.
Die ersten Monate sind sehr operativ: Wir suchen eine:n technische:n Gründer:in, der oder die selbst baut und Produktentscheidungen mitträgt.
Wen wir suchen
Produktentwicklung: Du kannst aus einem noch unscharfen Kundenproblem einen klaren, testbaren Produktansatz entwickeln und technisch umsetzen.

Datenbasierte Produkte: Du hast Erfahrung mit datengetriebenen Plattformen, Bewertungs- oder Vergleichssystemen und kannst konkrete Fehlerquellen, Datenqualitätsprobleme und Validierungsentscheidungen beschreiben.
Technische Breite: Du bist stark in Backend und Datenarchitektur und kommst im Frontend weit genug, um frühe Produktversionen selbst auszuliefern.
Vertrauen im B2B: Du baust nachvollziehbare Systeme, die bei risikoaversen Unternehmenskunden, langen Entscheidungswegen und hohen Nachweisanforderungen bestehen.

Gründermentalität und Marktverständnis: Du hast gegründet, warst eine:r der ersten technischen Mitarbeiter:innen eines Start-ups oder hast vergleichbare Verantwortung übernommen. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, professionelles Englisch und Erfahrung im DACH-Markt sind wichtig.
Besonders interessant, aber kein Muss
Erfahrung in Construction Tech oder PropTech
Hintergrund in Bauingenieurwesen oder Materialwissenschaften, idealerweise mit LCA-/EPD-Erfahrung
Erfahrung mit Vergleichsplattformen oder Marktplätzen
Was wir bieten
Kapital und Gründerfinanzierung für die Aufbauphase
Enge Unterstützung durch Founders Factory in Produkt, Daten, Wachstum, Finanzierung, Recht und Personal – auf Basis bestehender Markt-, Kunden- und Produktarbeit
Zugang zu ersten potenziellen Kund:innen und Partnern in Bau- und Wohnungswirtschaft sowie zu unserem internationalen Netzwerk
In English:
Founders Factory × Nua Materials
Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.
For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.
The opportunity

New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.

Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. A core component is the Nua Score, which already exists in an initial version. Conversations with manufacturers, construction companies, developers and asset owners have confirmed the need and shown interest in pilots.
What you will build
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.
Define the critical workflows with users and build the first usable product.
Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.
Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.
Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.
The first months will be highly hands-on: we are looking for a technical founder who builds personally and helps shape the product, not a CTO who starts by delegating.
Who we are looking for
Product development: You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear, testable product approach and build it.

Data-driven products: You have experience with data-heavy platforms, scoring or comparison systems and can talk concretely about failure modes, data-quality issues and validation decisions you have encountered.
Technical range: You are strong in backend and data architecture and capable enough on the frontend to ship early product versions yourself.
Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.

Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.
Especially relevant, but not required
Experience in ConTech or PropTech
Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience
Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces
What we offer
Capital and founder funding for the build phase
Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work
Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

jobs.title: Director, Scientific Data
jobs.text:
About the Role
Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve >250 R&D institutions, including most of the top global biotech & pharma companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.
The Director, Scientific Data will own the integrity, structure, and evolution of Drug Hunter’s scientific data across our knowledge platform and scientific databases. You will lead the scientific data team within our Technical organization and be the bridge between our scientists and our engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary internal subject-matter expert for cheminformatics and scientific data, with sufficient breadth across bioinformatics and drug discovery data to guide data decisions spanning chemistry and biology.
Own the scientific strategy for how Drug Hunter acquires, represents, integrates, normalizes, and maintains scientific data, partnering with Engineering on the architecture and systems that operationalize that strategy and Science on both automated and manual data curation processes.
Define how chemical entities are represented, registered, standardized, and resolved across sources, and establish curation standards, controlled vocabularies, QA rules, and tooling that allows data curation to take place at scale
Define approaches for extracting structured scientific information from unstructured content, including chemical structures, text, and tables from literature and patents, and establish how extracted information should be linked to canonical entities.
Own the scientific semantics, entity resolution, and ontology strategy that unifies compound synonyms, target and gene nomenclature, disease terms, organizations, assays, and other scientific concepts across sources, including approaches for handling ambiguity and conflicting source assertions.
Evaluate scientific data sources across chemistry, biology, DMPK, drug, and clinical domains, assessing their coverage, scientific quality, overlap, limitations, licensing considerations, and update characteristics, and determine how they should contribute to Drug Hunter's data.
Establish standards for scientific data quality, provenance, validation, completeness, and freshness, and ensure the Data team has effective processes for identifying and resolving data-quality issues.
Partner closely with Science to translate scientific expertise and curation decisions into consistent, maintainable data models, standards, and processes.
Partner with Engineering to define data models and technical approaches that accurately represent complex scientific information and support the Drug Hunter platform, jointly evaluating architectural decisions and trade-offs where data and application systems intersect.
Partner with Product Management to translate scientific and technical requirements into project specifications for the data team and communicate the trade-offs the technical decisions carry.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for scientific datasets, chem- and bio-informatics capabilities, and data tooling, partnering with Engineering where decisions involve shared technical infrastructure or application architecture.
Lead the Data team in translating scientific data priorities into executable projects, remaining sufficiently involved in day-to-day work to understand progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and workload.
Provide scientific and technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data team, creating, hiring, and managing roles as needed.

jobs.title: Interim Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Who are we?
StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds.
Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators.
About the role
The Interim Head of Engineering is responsible for defining and executing the engineering strategy, capability and delivery model across the organisation during a critical phase of growth. Leading multiple engineering teams, this role combines technical leadership, operational excellence and people leadership to ensure the delivery of scalable, secure and high-quality products. The role partners closely with Product, Design, Production, QA and Executive stakeholders to align technology investment with business objectives, build high-performing teams and drive continuous improvement.
Main Duties & Responsibilities
Engineering Strategy & Technical Vision
Strategy Alignment: Define and own the engineering strategy aligned to core company objectives.
Technical Direction: Establish long-term system architecture and technology roadmaps.
Governance Frameworks: Define engineering standards, compliance, and quality metrics.
Risk & Speed Balance: Drive technical decisions that balance delivery speed, code quality, scalability, and risk.
Leadership & People Management
Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and grow engineering managers, principal engineers, and senior talent.
High-Performance Culture: Build a collaborative, accountable culture focused on continuous learning.
Workforce Planning: Oversee hiring pipelines, succession planning, and performance management.
Delivery & Operational Excellence
Delivery Outcomes: Own end-to-end execution and project delivery across all engineering teams.
Predictable Execution: Ensure effective planning processes and highly predictable roadmap execution.
Productivity Optimization: Remove organisational blockers and improve developer velocity using performance metrics.
Architecture, Quality & Security
System Resilience: Ensure production systems are highly scalable, resilient, and easily maintainable.
Security & Quality: Establish rigid standards for code quality, rigorous testing, DevOps, and security infrastructure.
Platform Health: Oversee technical debt management, optimization strategies, and overall platform health.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Executive Partnership: Partner with Product, Design, QA, and Production leadership to drive business outcomes.
Technical Translation: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive-level recommendations.
Strategic Influence: Leverage technology insights and industry innovation to directly influence company strategy.
Innovation & Department Growth
Emerging Tech: Identify emerging technologies to capture distinct competitive market advantages.
Modern Workflows: Drive organizational adoption of advanced engineering practices, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.
Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience
Core
• 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in engineering leadership.
• Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams and managers.
• Strong understanding of software architecture, cloud platforms, DevOps and modern development practices.
• Track record of delivering complex products at scale.
• Experience establishing engineering KPIs, delivery metrics and quality standards.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication and strategic planning skills.
• Experience managing budgets, hiring plans and organisational growth.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.
Preferred
• Experience within gaming, digital products or SaaS environments.
• Master's degree in a relevant discipline.
• Experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth.
• Experience with AI-assisted development tooling and platform modernisation.
• Experience leading distributed or international engineering teams.

VP Product Management - AI
PRIMARY PURPOSE
Leads enterprise product strategy, portfolio direction, and delivery execution across multiple product domains. Responsible for aligning product investments to business objectives, driving transformational initiatives, and ensuring products deliver measurable value for clients, colleagues, and the organization. Partners closely with business, technology, and operational leaders to shape roadmap priorities, accelerate innovation, and drive adoption of AI-enabled solutions while ensuring scalable, high-quality delivery aligned with strategic goals.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Establishes and owns enterprise-level product vision and multi-year roadmaps across product portfolios, aligning investments and priorities with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and platform direction.
Leads strategic planning and investment prioritization, balancing innovation, client value, operational needs, technical health, and long-term scalability.
Partners with business, technology, and operational leaders to align priorities, funding, sequencing, and product outcomes across the enterprise.
Defines and monitors enterprise-level product objectives and performance measures, communicating strategy, progress, risks, and business impact to executive stakeholders.
Execution & Transformation Delivery
Provides executive oversight of product delivery, portfolio execution, and capacity planning, ensuring alignment between product strategy, technical execution, client needs, and business outcomes.
Leads execution of high-value transformational initiatives, translating business objectives into actionable plans, measurable outcomes, and sustainable operating practices.
Collaborates across internal business leaders, operations teams, technology partners, and external stakeholders to drive alignment, remove barriers, and accelerate delivery of strategic priorities.
Engages directly with clients and key stakeholders to gather insights, validate solutions, and ensure products and initiatives deliver meaningful business value.
Owns accountability for product performance, business outcomes, operational efficiency, client impact, and portfolio-level key performance indicators.
Ensures appropriate prioritization and execution of technical health, platform modernization, risk mitigation, and non-functional requirements alongside product enhancements and new development.
Enterprise Leadership & Innovation
Maintains an enterprise-wide view of business processes, operating models, platforms, data, and system ecosystems impacting product strategy and execution.
Evaluates and approves major product, platform, and operating model changes, assessing enterprise impact, risks, dependencies, adoption, and return on investment.
Acts as a senior escalation point, resolving complex cross-functional challenges involving priorities, stakeholder alignment, organizational change, dependencies, and delivery risk.
Identifies and champions opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, decision-making, and business performance.
Partners across business and technology teams throughout the AI Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), supporting the design, implementation, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of AI-enabled solutions.
ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Performs other duties as assigned.
Travels as required.
QUALIFICATIONS
Education & Licensing
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university required.
Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
Relevant certifications in Product Management, Agile, AI, Digital Transformation, or related disciplines preferred.
Experience
Ten (10+) years of progressive experience in product strategy, product management, portfolio leadership, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience leading Directors, senior product leaders, and large, complex product organizations.
Proven success managing enterprise-level product portfolios, strategic investments, and large-scale transformation initiatives.
Experience driving cross-functional execution across business, operations, and technology organizations.
Experience leading or supporting AI-enabled products, capabilities, or transformation initiatives preferred.
Skills & Knowledge
Expertise in enterprise product strategy, portfolio management, and investment governance.
Ability to translate corporate strategy into product vision, operating models, roadmaps, and execution frameworks.
Strong executive judgment balancing growth, client value, technical health, risk, and financial outcomes.
Advanced ability to lead complex, high-stakes discussions with executive business and technology leaders.
Deep understanding of modern product operating models, technology platforms, architecture considerations, and system ecosystems.
Knowledge of AI capabilities, AI governance principles, and AI Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) practices.
Proven capability to lead leaders, influence enterprise decisions, build high-performing teams, and drive organizational change.
Work Environment
When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.
Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress, manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
Physical: Computer keyboarding; travel as required.
Auditory/Visual: Hearing, vision, and verbal communication.

jobs.title: Head of Data & AI
jobs.text:
Trade Nation is seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Head of Data & AI to lead our data and artificial intelligence strategy across the organisation. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role combines two interconnected mandates: enabling self-service access to data across the business and embedding AI into everyday operations.
As a multi-jurisdictional CFD and spread betting broker with regulated entities across the UK, Australia, the EU, the Bahamas and Seychelles, we are looking for a leader who can build on our existing data foundations, scale successful initiatives, simplify organically grown processes and drive measurable business impact through AI.
The role is weighted approximately 60% towards AI and 40% towards Data, leading a team of Data Analysts while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Compliance and senior business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Own and drive Trade Nation's AI strategy from opportunity identification through to deployment, adoption and value realisation
Redesign business workflows around AI, focusing on practical outcomes rather than tool adoption.
Build AI capability through training, prompt libraries, templates and a network of AI champions.
Measure and report AI adoption, success metrics and lessons learned.
Own the business-facing gold layer of the data warehouse, including metrics, definitions and quality standards.
Develop and extend the semantic data model to ensure consistent, trusted access to business data.
Champion data self-service, empowering teams to answer their own questions efficiently.
Establish and maintain best practices for analytics engineering, including testing, version control, documentation and code reviews.
Simplify and improve the quality of the data estate.
Deliver proactive insights and recommendations to senior leadership.

As Head of Software Engineering (f/m/d) at orderbird, you will take overall responsibility for the organization, resource planning, and leadership of our engineering department. jobs.title: Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.text:
About Nebius:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
About Nebius
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role
Nebius builds the infrastructure serious AI teams run on - GPU clusters, inference runtimes, agent development environments, data pipelines - all of it purpose-built for the most demanding AI workloads. What we are now building is the ecosystem function that ensures the world's best AI companies are successful on Nebius.
As Director of Forward Deployed Engineering, you will build and scale the organization that makes those companies successful on our platform. You will recruit exceptional FDEs, establish the operating model, ensure technical excellence, and turn partner engagements into product improvements and reusable platform assets.
This is not a Sales Engineering leader, Professional Services manager, or traditional Engineering manager role. It sits at the intersection of engineering leadership, AI platform architecture, ecosystem partnerships, and product strategy.
You're welcome to work remotely in the United States.
Your responsibilities will include
Organization Building & Talent
Build, hire, and develop a world-class Forward Deployed Engineering organization across AI applications, inference, infrastructure, and data.
Define the talent bar, team structure, career paths, and leadership expectations for the function.
Coach engineers and managers toward greater independence while maintaining a consistently high technical standard.
Build an organization and leadership system that scales without depending on individual heroics.
Operating Model & Technical Excellence
Establish scalable operating models for partner engagement, technical scoping, architecture reviews, escalation, and delivery health.
Set the technical bar for integrations, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and partner assessments produced by the team.
Review architectures across AI applications, managed inference, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms, bringing in deeper experts where needed.
Balance speed with engineering quality and ensure the team builds production-quality work rather than disposable demonstrations.
Executive & Ecosystem Leadership
Engage credibly with founders, CTOs, senior engineering leaders, and enterprise technical executives as Nebius's senior FDE leader.
Build trusted relationships across AI platforms, cloud providers, ISVs, open source communities, and strategic technology partners.
Represent Forward Deployed Engineering in platform planning, ecosystem strategy, and executive investment decisions.
Create a strong external technical presence through workshops, reference architectures, open source work, events, and developer advocacy.
Field-to-Product & Reusable Leverage
Treat partner engagements as a continuous product discovery engine and convert field learning into roadmap priorities and shipped platform improvements.
Ensure every engagement creates reusable value through platform capabilities, reference architectures, tooling, benchmarks, documentation, or automation.
Prevent the function from becoming one-off consulting work by setting clear boundaries and rewarding reusable outcomes.
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to close the loop on recurring friction and improve the experience for customers beyond the original engagement.
We expect you to have
12-18+ years of experience across engineering, solutions architecture, customer engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed engineering.
3-7+ years leading technical field organizations, including experience building a new function or materially scaling an existing team.
A strong record of hiring, coaching, and scaling Customer Engineering, FDE, Solutions Architecture, or Field CTO teams.
Earlier hands-on engineering experience in cloud, infrastructure, AI, or developer platforms.
Technical judgment to review and elevate architectures across AI applications, inference, infrastructure, and data platforms.
A proven track record of converting customer and partner feedback into shipped platform improvements.
Executive presence and credibility as a trusted advisor to founders, CTOs, and enterprise technical executives.
Experience leading across cloud providers, AI platforms, ISVs, open source communities, and strategic technology partners.
The ability to hire experts, evaluate their work, and set a high technical standard without needing to be the deepest specialist in every domain.
It will be an added bonus if you have
Strong relationships across the AI and cloud ecosystem.
Public technical leadership through talks, workshops, reference architectures, open source projects, or developer advocacy.
Built a Forward Deployed Engineering, Customer Engineering, or Field Engineering organization from zero to one.
Scaled a technical field organization across regions or ecosystem domains without lowering the hiring or engineering bar.
Experience as a founder, VP Engineering, Field CTO, Head of Customer Engineering, or early FDE leader.
Led production architecture and execution for demanding AI application, training, inference, or platform workloads.
Key Employee Benefits
Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.
Pay Transparency
We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.
Base Compensation Range: $270,800 - $310,000 USD
Benefits & Perks
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Director of Technology & AI
jobs.text:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY
321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.
Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.
The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.
You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Technology Leadership & Team Development
Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio
Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security
Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions
MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture
Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch
AI Enablement & Automation
Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients
Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure
Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems
Client Engagement & Agency Growth
Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings
WHAT YOU HAVE
8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience
REPORTING STRUCTURE
The Director of Technology reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team.
