blocks.text: ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.
ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Technology Leadership & Team Development

items: Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio

blocks.text: Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security

items: Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions

blocks.text: MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture

items: Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch

blocks.text: AI Enablement & Automation

items: Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients

blocks.text: Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure

items: Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems

blocks.text: Client Engagement & Agency Growth

items: Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings

blocks.text: WHAT YOU HAVE

items: 8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

jobs.title: Head of Cloud Platform Development - Kubernetes / OpenStack (m/w/d)
jobs.text:
Für einen etablierten deutschen Cloud- und IT-Infrastrukturanbieter suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die die strategische und technische Weiterentwicklung moderner Cloud-Plattformen auf Basis von Kubernetes und OpenStack verantwortet.
In dieser Rolle verbindest du technologische Expertise mit strategischem Weitblick und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team zukunftsfähige Plattformlösungen.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung der Kubernetes- und OpenStack-basierten Cloud-Plattformen.
Du entwickelst technische Roadmaps, definierst Entwicklungsprioritäten und begleitest Architekturentscheidungen.
Du führst dein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch und förderst die Weiterentwicklung deiner Mitarbeitenden.
Du arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um Anforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.
Du stellst die Qualität der Plattformlösungen und deren strukturierte Übergabe an den Operations-Bereich sicher.
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Bereich Cloud Engineering, Platform Development oder vergleichbaren technischen Bereichen.
Fundierte Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen und deren Architektur sowie Weiterentwicklung.
Gutes Verständnis von Kubernetes, Container-Technologien und modernen Cloud-Infrastrukturen.
Kenntnisse in Linux, Netzwerk, Storage, Virtualisierung und verteilten Systemen.
Strategisches Denken, Hands-on-Mentalität und ausgeprägte Führungskompetenz.
Kenntnisse in OpenStack sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Benefits
Verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
Technologisch anspruchsvolles Cloud-Umfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive.
Hybrides Arbeiten und moderne Arbeitsplätze.
Individuelle Weiterbildungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
30 Tage Urlaub sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.
This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.
The Position
We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.
Key Accountabilities
Leadership and Operations:
Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.
Solution Engineering:
Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.
Customer Support Operations:
Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.
Who You Are
Skills/Knowledge:
Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.
Requirements:
BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team
Preferred Skills:
SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.
Join Us
We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.
We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.
In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.
Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!
At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:
•All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
• We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
• We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
• Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.
Learn more about how to spot recruitment scams and protect yourself - FBI warning:
Claritas Rx is committed to transparency, integrity, and a safe hiring experience for every candidate. Learn more

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will provide strategic and operational leadership for the organisation's Technology function, driving innovation, digital transformation and technology enabled business performance. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team (SLT), the CTO will be responsible for defining and delivering the organisation's technology strategy, ensuring technology investments align with business objectives and support long term growth.
The role will lead the development and implementation of digital transformation initiatives, including the adoption of emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), the modernisation of systems and processes, and the reduction of reliance on legacy systems and tools. The CTO will champion digital innovation, enhancing operational efficiency, improving customer and member experiences, and enabling effective decision making through technology and data.
The CTO will provide strategic and operational leadership across multiple functions, including:
Development
Testing
Project Management
Cyber and Information Security
Business Information and Data
Infrastructure and Networks
IT Service Delivery and Support
Why Join Logistics UK?
Logistics UK, formerly the Freight Transport Association is one of the biggest business groups in the UK, representing the entire industry with members from the road, rail, sea, and air industries, as well as the buyers of freight services such as retailers and manufacturers whose businesses depend on the efficient movement of goods.
An effective supply chain is vital to Keep Britain Trading, directly impacting over 7 million people employed in making, selling and moving the goods that affect everyone everywhere. With Brexit, technology and other disruptive forces driving changes in the way goods move across borders and through the supply chain, logistics has never been more important to UK PLC.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Digital Transformation
Develop and deliver the organisation's Digital and Technology Strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Lead digital transformation programmes, including AI adoption and system modernisation.
Drive the modernisation of business systems and processes, leading the replacement of legacy systems and tools with innovative, future focused solutions that enhance organisational capability and efficiency.
Drive innovation to improve operational efficiency, customer and member experience, and employee productivity.
Advise senior leaders on technology opportunities, risks and emerging trends.
Technology Operations & Service Delivery
Provide leadership across Software Development, Testing, Project Management, Cyber and Information Security, Data & Business Information, Infrastructure & Networks, and IT Support.
Ensure technology systems are secure, reliable, scalable and fit for purpose.
Oversee the delivery of technology projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget and deliver business value.
Manage technology suppliers, contracts and service level agreements.
Cyber and Information Security, Data & Governance
Ensure the security, integrity and resilience of all systems, applications and data.
Develop and maintain IT policies, standards and governance frameworks.
Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory and cyber security requirements.
Lead data governance and business intelligence initiatives to support effective decision-making.
Ability to identify technological threats and the need to evolve and improve systems to prevent risks.
Resource Management
Develop and manage the departmental budget, ensuring value for money and effective resource allocation.
Prepare annual departmental plans, objectives and performance reports.
Monitor departmental performance against agreed plans, budgets and key deliverables.
Ensure efficient management of departmental resources and technology investments.
Stakeholder & Business Partnership
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technology solutions.
Collaborate with senior leaders and departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and digital innovation.
Lead engagement with external technology partners and suppliers to maximise service quality and performance.
Communicate a technology strategy, progress and outcomes to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Leadership & People Management
Lead and develop a high performing department.
Manage performance, coaching, succession planning and professional development across the function.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Cyber and Information Security
Business Information and Data

IT Service Delivery and Support

blocks.text: Why Join Logistics UK?

Logistics UK, formerly the Freight Transport Association is one of the biggest business groups in the UK, representing the entire industry with members from the road, rail, sea, and air industries, as well as the buyers of freight services such as retailers and manufacturers whose businesses depend on the efficient movement of goods.

An effective supply chain is vital to Keep Britain Trading, directly impacting over 7 million people employed in making, selling and moving the goods that affect everyone everywhere. With Brexit, technology and other disruptive forces driving changes in the way goods move across borders and through the supply chain, logistics has never been more important to UK PLC.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Driftrock is hiring a Head of Product to set the direction for our platform and lead the team building the products that help automotive brands and dealers deliver the world's best experience for finding, buying and owning a car.
Quick facts
Team: Product, leading our Product team and working daily with Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Commercial
Product: The whole Driftrock platform across Capture, Convert and Connect, plus our internal tooling
Reports to: CEO
Direct reports: Our Product Manager(s), with room to grow the team
Location: Fully remote, UK or abroad, with a few hours of daily UK overlap
Contract: Full time, permanent
Salary: £85,000 to £105,000, plus share options
Start date: As soon as you're ready
Why this role exists
Driftrock powers customer acquisition for some of the world's biggest automotive brands and dealers, including BMW, BYD, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo. Since 2013 we've built a platform that captures enquiries from every channel a car buyer touches, validates them in real time, nurtures them through messaging journeys, and measures everything through to the vehicle sale.
That work enables billions of euros in vehicle sales every year and makes buying a car a better experience for consumers.
The next 12 months are set to be the biggest in our history. We're preparing to launch our boldest products yet, growing across Europe, bringing our platform to more customers, and putting AI at the heart of how our products work.
This calls for a product leader who can set a clear direction, make the big calls on where we focus, and build a product team that turns strategy into shipped, measured outcomes. As our Product team scales, this role will take increasing ownership of product direction and decision-making from the CEO. Reporting to the CEO, you'll shape the future of the platform and help define how car buyers and car sellers connect.
What you'll own
You'll be accountable for Driftrock's product strategy and the results it delivers. That means deciding why and what we build across the whole platform and our internal tooling, leading and growing the product team that delivers it, and making sure every major bet ships and moves the metrics that matter to our customers and our business. You'll work closely with the CEO as ownership of day-to-day product leadership transitions into the Product team.
*Your first 90 days*
By day 30: you've met customers, partners and every team, used the platform end to end, got to know the Product team, and mapped the current landscape: our products, how brands and dealers use them, how product work flows today, and where the biggest opportunities sit.
By day 60: you've agreed a product strategy and 12-month roadmap with the CEO and leadership team, set up a clear product operating rhythm with Engineering and Design, and agreed goals and development plans with each person in your team.
By day 90: discovery to delivery runs on a predictable cadence, the whole company can see what's coming and why, your first measurable product win has shipped, and you have a plan for how the product team grows next. You and the CEO are aligned on the direction for the next stage of Driftrock's product growth.
What you'll be doing
Set the product vision and strategy for the Driftrock platform, turning company goals into a clear, evidence-backed roadmap the whole company understands.
Lead, coach and grow the Product team, setting high standards for discovery, decision-making and delivery, and hiring well as the team expands. We're open to strong Senior or Lead Product Managers who are ready to step up into broader product leadership.
Make the big prioritisation calls across customer-facing products and internal tooling, balancing customer value, commercial impact and technical health so Engineering always works on what matters most.
Take new products from first discovery to market, each with a clear launch plan and success measures.
Solution design alongside Product Managers and other stakeholders. We are a small team, so this Head of Product role is a chance to be hands-on whilst leading and growing the team.
Stay close to customers, spending time with brands, dealers and partners every month so real evidence shapes every major decision.
Build a product operating model that scales, with shared rituals, metrics and tools that help a remote team move quickly and stay aligned.
Partner with Commercial, Marketing and Customer Success on pricing, packaging, positioning and launches, so what we build lands well and grows revenue.
Report on product performance to the CEO and board, showing clearly what we shipped, what it changed and what we learned.
What you'll bring
A track record of leading product for a B2B SaaS platform, ideally combined with experience in consumer product or product-led growth, with a strategy that measurably grew revenue, retention or a core customer metric.
Experience managing and developing product managers, and building a team where people do their best work. Strong Senior or Lead Product Managers ready to take this next step are encouraged to apply.
Evidence of taking a new product or major bet from first discovery through to a successful launch.
Strong product judgement: you make clear, well-reasoned calls on what not to build as well as what to build, and bring people with you.
A habit of regular customer discovery, and comfort combining customer insight with product and commercial data to make decisions. You have a strong experimental and data-driven mindset.
The ability to work closely with engineering and design leaders on technical trade-offs, sequencing and delivery.
Clear written and spoken communication, from a one-page strategy to a board update, in a remote, async-friendly team.
Comfort being hands-on when it helps, from writing a brief to digging into the data yourself. You take a collaborative, pragmatic approach to leadership and are comfortable getting into the details when needed.
Experience working in a smaller, fast-growing company rather than exclusively in a large, highly structured enterprise environment.
Bonus points
Experience with marketing technology, lead generation, messaging or CRM-adjacent products.
Knowledge of the automotive or e-mobility industry, especially how brands and dealers work together.
Experience shipping AI-powered products, or using AI tools heavily across discovery and delivery.
Experience launching products into new markets.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for a SaaS product
Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We value different perspectives, backgrounds and career paths, and we're interested in what you could bring to the role, not just whether you've followed a traditional route into product leadership.
Why Driftrock
Driftrock's mission is to become the world-leading automotive and e-mobility marketing software platform, and help accelerate the transition to clean transport.
We work with some of the world's biggest brands, including BMW, BYD, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo, and partner with the world's leading platforms, including Meta, Google, mobile.de and Auto Trader.
We've been building since 2013, and our work enables billions of euros in vehicle sales every year.
We're a close, fully remote team of 45 people across engineering, design, customer success, performance and commercial, spread across the world.
That means your work has a real, visible impact on our product, our culture and how we operate.
We're at the cutting edge of marketing technology, with plenty of room to unlock value from data and to help speed up the shift to electric vehicles.
How we work is shaped by four values:
We care: about our team, our customers, and the people who see the marketing messages that we power. Work isn't done until we can prove it's useful to both the consumer and the customer.
Be that person: if something needs fixing, fix it. It's never someone else's problem.
People-first: we put people at the core of everything, and never compromise security or privacy for results.
Be better today than you were yesterday: we bake learning and continuous improvement into everything we do, for ourselves and our customers.
In practice, this looks like weekly Monday Showcases where we share what we're learning, regular retros, a budget to attend the courses and conferences that grow you, Donut coffee pairings to stay connected, and an annual company Summit that brings the whole global team together in person.
What's in it for you
We're remote-first and flexible about how and where you work, with co-working space available if you want it. Alongside your salary:
Share options in Driftrock, on founder-friendly, tax-efficient EMI terms, including the option to retain vested options after leaving (at board discretion).
Comprehensive Vitality health cover: medical, dental, vision, hearing, mental-health support and therapy, cancer cover, a free Headspace subscription and Vitality rewards.
24 to 28 days' holiday (24 + 1 extra each year, capped at 28), plus bank holidays.
Pension contributions, life assurance (3x salary) and income protection.
Electric car salary-sacrifice scheme (Octopus): save up to ~40%, with insurance, servicing and a charging perk included.
Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
A learning budget for books, courses and conferences, plus time for personal goals.
Perks and discounts via CharlieHR, and a BMW Group employee discount programme.
Outside the UK?
We're remote-first and hire globally. While some UK-specific benefits are delivered differently abroad, we strive for genuine parity. Wherever you are, the standard package includes a comprehensive health plan, pension contributions, paid time off including local bank holidays, share options, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, a learning budget, and our flexible working culture. International team members are employed compliantly via an Employer of Record (Remote.com).
Our hiring process
A short intro call with our team.
A conversation with our CEO about the role and how you lead the product.
A live, interactive workshop or pairing session based on a real Driftrock product challenge, rather than a take-home task.
A final conversation with the team, including Engineering and Product.
Inclusion at Driftrock
Driftrock is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, identity and life experience, and we're building a team that reflects the people our marketing reaches. We don't make decisions based on age, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process to do your best, just let us know, and we're glad to help.
We will not be considering recruitment agencies for this role.
By applying for this job you give us permission to store your data on our secure applicant tracking system and to contact you about Driftrock job opportunities. We process your data for recruitment purposes only and keep it until this role is filled, after which we will delete it or, with your agreement, keep it for similar future roles for up to 12 months. See our privacy policy at driftrock.com/privacy-policy for how we comply with GDPR, including how to access, correct, delete or restrict the data we hold. You can lodge a complaint with the UK supervisory authority (the Information Commissioner's Office), or contact our DPO for any concerns.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations
jobs.text:
Career-defining. Life-changing.
At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career
About This Role:
The Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations will lead iRhythm’s enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture, operations, and modernization across cloud, networking, data center and hardware, end-user computing, and security infrastructure. This role will ensure that iRhythm’s technology foundation is resilient, secure, compliant, and scalable enough to support 24/7 clinical operations, manufacturing, global commercial growth, and the company’s expanding data and AI capabilities. This senior leadership role combines executive leadership, hands-on technical depth, organizational development, financial stewardship, and close partnership with the Chief Data Officer and head of IT, CISO, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering, and business leaders. The role works hand in hand with the CISO: Security defines the requirements and provides oversight, while Infrastructure delivers and operates the platforms, controls, and services that enable the business.
What You Will Be Doing
Strategy & Leadership
Define and execute a multi-year enterprise infrastructure strategy and roadmap aligned to iRhythm’s business, clinical, data, and AI objectives.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure organization across cloud, network, operations, end-user services, and managed service partners.
Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and operating models across business units and geographies.
Serve as the senior infrastructure advisor to executive leadership, translating strategy, risk, investment, and performance into business terms.
Cloud Infrastructure
Own the enterprise multi-cloud strategy across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Microsoft 365, including landing zones, account and project structure, identity integration, and guardrails.
Lead cloud platform engineering using Infrastructure as Code, automation, infrastructure CI/CD, and policy-as-code.
Drive FinOps practices, including cost visibility, optimization, reserved-capacity strategy, and chargeback/showback.
Enable modern data and AI platforms—including Snowflake, enterprise AI and search platforms, and ML/GPU workloads—with secure, scalable, well-governed infrastructure and private connectivity patterns.
Lead workload migration and modernization from on-premises environments to cloud where appropriate.
Networking & Connectivity
Own enterprise network architecture across corporate offices, clinical and IDTF sites, manufacturing facilities, data centers, and cloud environments, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, and load balancing.
Design secure hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity using Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, and transit architectures.
Implement network segmentation and isolation for manufacturing/OT and clinical environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles.
Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, and capacity planning for mission-critical clinical and patient-facing services.
Data Center, Hardware & End-User Computing
Oversee on-premises and colocation data centers, compute, storage, backup, and virtualization platforms, including lifecycle management and rationalization.
Own the hardware asset lifecycle, including procurement, standards, refresh cycles, and secure disposal.
Lead end-user computing across endpoints, MDM, collaboration tools, service desk, and conference room technology to deliver a secure and productive employee experience.
Support infrastructure for manufacturing sites and clinical operations, including device and equipment connectivity where applicable.
Security Infrastructure
Implement, operate, and maintain infrastructure security controls in alignment with the security strategy, policies, and standards set by the CISO.
Own the day-to-day engineering and operation of network and platform security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, proxies/SASE, NAC, and VPN, with the CISO’s team defining requirements, configuration standards, and monitoring.
Embed security by design across infrastructure through hardening baselines, secure configurations, and Infrastructure-as-Code guardrails.
Own timely vulnerability remediation and patching across infrastructure assets, meeting SLAs defined by the Security team.
Operate identity and directory infrastructure, including SSO, MFA, and directory services, in support of the CISO-led Zero Trust and identity roadmap.
Partner with the CISO’s organization during security incidents by providing infrastructure expertise, containment, remediation, logs, telemetry, and integrations needed for detection and response.
Compliance, Quality & Regulated Environments
Ensure infrastructure meets applicable regulatory and compliance obligations, including FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and other international requirements.
Partner with the CISO, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain infrastructure controls and evidence for audits, with Security owning the control framework and this role owning control execution for infrastructure.
Support computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for GxP-relevant infrastructure, along with change control and audit readiness.
Lead infrastructure responses during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
Protect patient health information through appropriate data residency, encryption, access controls, and logging.
Resilience, Operations & Service Management
Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, with defined RTO/RPO targets for clinical and business-critical systems and regular DR testing.
Build observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using SRE principles, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
Mature ITSM processes for incident, problem, change, and configuration management using ITIL-aligned practices and tools such as ServiceNow.
Drive automation to reduce toil and improve reliability, speed, and consistency.
Vendor & Financial Management
Own the infrastructure budget across OpEx and CapEx, including forecasting, business cases, and cost optimization.
Manage strategic vendor, cloud provider, telecom, and managed service relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.
Evaluate emerging technologies and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.
Technology Environment
Our environment spans enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, end-user computing, data, AI, and regulated clinical and manufacturing systems. Experience with every named technology is not required.
Cloud and platform: AWS, GCP, Azure, Microsoft 365, landing zones, Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, policy-as-code, containers, virtualization, and GPU infrastructure.
Netorking and connectivity: LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, load balancing, Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, transit architectures, NAC, firewalls, and WAF.
Data, AI, and analytics infrastructure: Snowflake, Databricks, enterprise AI and search platforms, ML/GPU workloads, private connectivity, and governed data products.
Security and identity: SSO, MFA, directory services, Zero Trust, endpoint management, vulnerability management, security telemetry, logging, and incident response integrations.

blocks.text: Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career
About This Role:

The Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations will lead iRhythm’s enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture, operations, and modernization across cloud, networking, data center and hardware, end-user computing, and security infrastructure. This role will ensure that iRhythm’s technology foundation is resilient, secure, compliant, and scalable enough to support 24/7 clinical operations, manufacturing, global commercial growth, and the company’s expanding data and AI capabilities. This senior leadership role combines executive leadership, hands-on technical depth, organizational development, financial stewardship, and close partnership with the Chief Data Officer and head of IT, CISO, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering, and business leaders. The role works hand in hand with the CISO: Security defines the requirements and provides oversight, while Infrastructure delivers and operates the platforms, controls, and services that enable the business.
What You Will Be Doing
Strategy & Leadership

items: Define and execute a multi-year enterprise infrastructure strategy and roadmap aligned to iRhythm’s business, clinical, data, and AI objectives.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure organization across cloud, network, operations, end-user services, and managed service partners.
Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and operating models across business units and geographies.
Serve as the senior infrastructure advisor to executive leadership, translating strategy, risk, investment, and performance into business terms.

blocks.text: Cloud Infrastructure

items: Own the enterprise multi-cloud strategy across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Microsoft 365, including landing zones, account and project structure, identity integration, and guardrails.
Lead cloud platform engineering using Infrastructure as Code, automation, infrastructure CI/CD, and policy-as-code.
Drive FinOps practices, including cost visibility, optimization, reserved-capacity strategy, and chargeback/showback.

Enable modern data and AI platforms—including Snowflake, enterprise AI and search platforms, and ML/GPU workloads—with secure, scalable, well-governed infrastructure and private connectivity patterns.
Lead workload migration and modernization from on-premises environments to cloud where appropriate.

blocks.text: Networking & Connectivity

items: Own enterprise network architecture across corporate offices, clinical and IDTF sites, manufacturing facilities, data centers, and cloud environments, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, and load balancing.
Design secure hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity using Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, and transit architectures.
Implement network segmentation and isolation for manufacturing/OT and clinical environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles.
Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, and capacity planning for mission-critical clinical and patient-facing services.

blocks.text: Data Center, Hardware & End-User Computing

items: Oversee on-premises and colocation data centers, compute, storage, backup, and virtualization platforms, including lifecycle management and rationalization.
Own the hardware asset lifecycle, including procurement, standards, refresh cycles, and secure disposal.
Lead end-user computing across endpoints, MDM, collaboration tools, service desk, and conference room technology to deliver a secure and productive employee experience.
Support infrastructure for manufacturing sites and clinical operations, including device and equipment connectivity where applicable.

blocks.text: Security Infrastructure

items: Implement, operate, and maintain infrastructure security controls in alignment with the security strategy, policies, and standards set by the CISO.

Own the day-to-day engineering and operation of network and platform security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, proxies/SASE, NAC, and VPN, with the CISO’s team defining requirements, configuration standards, and monitoring.
Embed security by design across infrastructure through hardening baselines, secure configurations, and Infrastructure-as-Code guardrails.
Own timely vulnerability remediation and patching across infrastructure assets, meeting SLAs defined by the Security team.
Operate identity and directory infrastructure, including SSO, MFA, and directory services, in support of the CISO-led Zero Trust and identity roadmap.
Partner with the CISO’s organization during security incidents by providing infrastructure expertise, containment, remediation, logs, telemetry, and integrations needed for detection and response.

blocks.text: Compliance, Quality & Regulated Environments

items: Ensure infrastructure meets applicable regulatory and compliance obligations, including FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and other international requirements.

Partner with the CISO, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain infrastructure controls and evidence for audits, with Security owning the control framework and this role owning control execution for infrastructure.
Support computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for GxP-relevant infrastructure, along with change control and audit readiness.
Lead infrastructure responses during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
Protect patient health information through appropriate data residency, encryption, access controls, and logging.

blocks.text: Resilience, Operations & Service Management

items: Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, with defined RTO/RPO targets for clinical and business-critical systems and regular DR testing.
Build observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using SRE principles, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
Mature ITSM processes for incident, problem, change, and configuration management using ITIL-aligned practices and tools such as ServiceNow.
Drive automation to reduce toil and improve reliability, speed, and consistency.

Manage strategic vendor, cloud provider, telecom, and managed service relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.
Evaluate emerging technologies and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Buscamos una persona para incorporarse como Vice President of Engineering y liderar la estrategia tecnológica, la organización de ingeniería y la evolución de nuestros productos digitales.
La posición tendrá un papel clave en la definición de la visión técnica, el escalado de los equipos y la construcción de una cultura de alto rendimiento, colaboración y mejora continua. Trabajarás estrechamente con Product, Business y otros equipos directivos en un entorno internacional y de rápido crecimiento.
Responsabilidades
Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de ingeniería en alineación con los objetivos de negocio y producto.
Liderar, desarrollar y hacer crecer equipos multidisciplinares de ingeniería, incluyendo Engineering Managers, Tech Leads y perfiles técnicos especializados.
Establecer una visión tecnológica clara, garantizando la escalabilidad, seguridad, fiabilidad y mantenibilidad de la plataforma.
Impulsar buenas prácticas de desarrollo de software, arquitectura, testing, observabilidad, DevOps y entrega continua.
Garantizar la calidad y previsibilidad de la entrega, mejorando los procesos de planificación, priorización y seguimiento de proyectos.
Colaborar con Product, Design, Data, Operations y el equipo directivo para convertir las necesidades de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas efectivas.
Participar en decisiones estratégicas relacionadas con arquitectura, tecnología, inversión, contratación y organización de equipos.
Promover una cultura de ownership, innovación, transparencia y excelencia técnica.
Identificar riesgos técnicos y operativos, definiendo planes de mitigación y mejora a medio y largo plazo.
Representar la función de ingeniería ante stakeholders internos, partners y otros interlocutores relevantes.
Requisitos
Experiencia sólida liderando organizaciones de ingeniería en posiciones como VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, Engineering Director o similares.
Trayectoria demostrable en el desarrollo y escalado de productos digitales, plataformas SaaS o entornos tecnológicos complejos.
Experiencia gestionando equipos distribuidos y organizaciones en crecimiento.
Conocimientos profundos de arquitectura de software, desarrollo de producto, cloud computing, DevOps y prácticas modernas de ingeniería.
Capacidad para conectar la estrategia tecnológica con los objetivos comerciales y las necesidades de los clientes.
Experiencia contratando, desarrollando y reteniendo talento técnico.
Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo, comunicación y gestión de stakeholders.
Capacidad para tomar decisiones complejas, priorizar de forma efectiva y trabajar con autonomía.
Orientación a resultados, pensamiento estratégico y enfoque práctico para resolver problemas.
Inglés profesional fluido para trabajar en un entorno internacional. El español u otros idiomas serán valorados positivamente.
Qué encontrarás
Una posición estratégica con impacto directo en la evolución del producto y del negocio.
La oportunidad de construir y desarrollar una organización de ingeniería de alto nivel.
Un entorno internacional, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.
Autonomía para definir procesos, equipos y prioridades tecnológicas.
Colaboración cercana con el equipo directivo y las principales áreas de la compañía.
Un proyecto con posibilidades reales de crecimiento profesional y transformación tecnológica.
Qué buscamos
Buscamos una persona líder, estratégica y cercana, capaz de combinar una sólida visión técnica con excelentes habilidades de gestión. Alguien que disfrute construyendo equipos, desarrollando talento y creando las condiciones necesarias para que la ingeniería genere un impacto sostenible en el negocio.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

blocks.text: ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:

items: Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

blocks.text: ABOUT THE ROLE:

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will

items: Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.

Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

blocks.text: This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

items: Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.

jobs.title: Director Product - R37
jobs.text:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.
All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.
As our Director of Product, you will lead the strategy, development, and launch of a new AI-enabled physician accounts receivable product within R37. This role will extend the value of our existing healthcare revenue cycle technology investments into a new market opportunity, leveraging proven capabilities to deliver a solution for physician revenue cycle operations. Partnering closely with product, engineering, operations, and business leaders, you will help bring the product from concept to adoption while building alignment across a highly cross-functional organization. Reporting directly to product leadership, you will play a central role in shaping roadmap priorities, driving cross-functional alignment, and establishing the foundation for a growing physician revenue cycle product offering.
Every day, you will guide product strategy and execution, partner closely with engineering and operational teams, and drive alignment across stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes. To thrive in this role, you must combine healthcare revenue cycle expertise and product development experience with exceptional communication skills, executive presence, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives through influence, collaboration, and structured problem solving.
Here's what you will experience working as a Director of Product:
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution plan for a new physician accounts receivable solution, balancing customer needs, operational opportunities, and business objectives to drive measurable outcomes.
Partner closely with engineering, operations, commercial, and executive stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, define requirements, manage releases, and ensure successful adoption of product capabilities.
Lead product development through agile delivery practices, providing vision, product direction, acceptance criteria, and release readiness decisions while maintaining alignment across teams.
Identify opportunities to maximize value from existing R37 and healthcare revenue cycle technologies, accelerating innovation while minimizing unnecessary development and operational complexity.
Serve as a trusted product leader, building strong cross-functional relationships, incorporating voice-of-customer insights, developing product narratives, and helping teams translate strategy into execution.
Required Skills:
Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of product leadership experience building and scaling complex technology products.
Deep healthcare domain expertise with strong preference for revenue cycle management experience, including physician billing, accounts receivable, patient accounting, or related financial operations.
Proven track record of identifying market opportunities and translating customer insights into successful products and measurable business outcomes.
Strong command of Agile product development and cross-functional execution, with experience leading products from concept through launch and adoption.
Exceptional ability to influence without authority, navigate ambiguity, and drive alignment across executive, business, operational, and technical stakeholders.
For this US-based position, the base pay range is $189,000.00 - $364,500.00 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 20.00%
The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.
Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.

The Company’s employment practices , including those regarding recruitment, hiring, assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline, and termination shall not be based on any person’s age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Furthermore, the Company is dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment based on any of the foregoing protected categories.
If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the job application process, please contact us at 312-496-7709 for assistance.
