Job Title:PSD07K - Sr. Director, Product Management - PAS Technology
Brief Description:
We are seeking a Senior Director of Product Management to lead the definition of technology solutions that support UBC’s Patient Services offerings, specifically focusing on Patient Access, Adherence, and Affordability. In this role, you will define the why and what of new products and act as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders, operations and technology leadership, industry leaders, and clients, ensuring our products deliver measurable value to patients, clients, and care providers. You will lead the definition of the product vision, prioritization of the product backlog, and translating business needs into actionable requirements for the development teams. You will represent and/or oversee communications related to critical and strategic clients and work with internal teams and external clients to continue ongoing business, enhance and improve our product offerings, and grow UBC’s book of business.
Specific job duties:
Continuously monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy and maintain market relevance.
Inform and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition for UBC solutions supporting patient access, adherence, and affordability.
Own and manage the product backlog to ensure development efforts are aligned with strategic business goals, client needs, and patient-centric outcomes.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, project management, regulatory, development, quality) to gather, refine, and prioritize requirements.
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and agile development teams, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and feedback loops.
Engage regularly with clients and key stakeholders to deeply understand their needs, pain points, and priorities, ensuring the product backlog reflects real-world user requirements.
Collaborate with finance and pricing teams to understand product cost structures, pricing strategies, and profitability drivers, ensuring business viability informs product decisions.
Partner with marketing to develop and refine go-to-market strategies, ensuring product positioning, messaging, and launch plans are aligned with customer needs and business objectives.
Ensure project, scrum, and business teams are aware of new product enhancements and functionality.
Work closely with data and analytics teams to incorporate real-world evidence and insights that enhance patient engagement and retention.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, data security, and healthcare regulations, including HIPAA.
Contribute to business development activities including RFI and RFP responses, project pricing and estimation, client presentations, and strategic planning.
Monitor product performance, user feedback, industry trends, and competitor activity to drive continuous improvement and keep the product portfolio aligned with current market expectations.
Collaborate with project management and delivery leadership during program startup to ensure approved scope, product intent, client commitments, decision history, budget assumptions, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations are clearly transferred to the delivery organization.
Serve as an executive-facing productsolution leader in strategic client meetings, bid defenses, governance forums, quarterly business reviews, and portfolio-level client discussions where future functionality, scope, roadmap direction, or product investment may be discussed.
Ensure proposed client commitments are evaluated for scope, feasibility, regulatory impact, validation impact, budget requirements, resource needs, and delivery risk before commitments are finalized.
Sponsor business cases and technology/AI governance review materials that define product objectives, target users/stakeholders, expected value, costs, dependencies, risks, assumptions, success measures, and decision points.
Partner with architecture, engineering, information security, privacy, quality, compliance, and data governance stakeholders to ensure product direction aligns with enterprise standards and regulated-life-sciences operating requirements.
Establish relationships with Pharma clients to develop co-definition, co-development, idea exchange, and early adoption outside of traditional engagement during the RFP process.
Supervisory Responsibility:
May manage Product Business Analysts.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field (Master’s preferred).
8+ years of experience as a Product Manager, preferably in healthcare, life sciences, or patient support services. Certification as a Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent is a plus.
Familiarity with specialty pharmacy services, patient access programs, or affordability solutions (e.g., copay cards, patient assistance programs).
Ability to make difficult product decisions and prioritize features based on business value
Experience with backlog management and user story writing.
Excellent skills in translating complex business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to balance technical constraints, business priorities, and regulatory requirements.
Passionate about delivering high-quality software products
Customer-focused mindset
Collaborative team player
Resilient under pressure and adaptable to changing priorities and requirements
Excellent time management and organizational skills
UBC Benefits:
At UBC, employee growth and well-being are always at the forefront. We offer an extensive range of benefits to ensure that you have everything you need to thrive personally and professionally. Here are some of the exciting perks UBC offers:
Remote opportunities
Competitive salaries

Tuition reimbursement (after 90 days of employment)

Paid Holidays

HSA/FSA

Wellness program

Long-term disability

We are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that fosters respect for each other, our clients, and our patients.

jobs.title: Development Director
jobs.text:
Crytek is looking for an experienced Development Director to lead delivery on a game development project in our Frankfurt office.
Reporting to the COO, you will own end-to-end project delivery and the operational model of the project. You will be responsible for ensuring the team is structured, staffed, and run effectively to deliver on time, within budget, and at the required quality level.
You will balance the production plan against creative ambition, technical constraints, and business priorities, working with your peers in the leadership team, and define how the team operates: decision-making and ways of working to drive clarity, accountability, and consistent execution at scale.
Responsibilities
Define and evolve the project’s operational model, including team structures, roles, processes, and pipelines, to ensure alignment with studio goals and optimal performance
Build, lead, and scale a high-performing development team, ensuring clear ownership, proper staffing, and empowerment across all areas of responsibility
End-to-end delivery performance by proactively identifying risks and obstacles, driving mitigation, and ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcome
Project planning and execution, including roadmap, PBS/WBS, scheduling, and milestone alignment, with a strong focus on player value and business objective
Stakeholder management, including budgeting, team allocation, external partner integration, and alignment on quality expectations (e.g. UX, performance, live ops)
Retrospectives to continuously improve team effectiveness, strengthening cross-functional collaboration, and fostering a culture of accountability and performance
Requirements
10+ years leading large-scale game development with full delivery accountability (time, budget, quality), including shipping at least one impactful title from inception to release
Deep expertise in building and operating effective development models (team structures, resource & budget planning, governance, execution), beyond applying standard frameworks (Agile, SAFe, etc.)
Strong leadership capability with a clear history of building, aligning, and holding teams accountable, while improving performance through structures, processes, and ways of working
Excellent stakeholder and leadership management skills, with the ability to create alignment and facilitate decisions at senior and executive levels

jobs.title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
jobs.text:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
The opportunity
Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.
More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.
For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.
This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.
We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.
What you will build and lead
As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.
Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:
access to care, search and booking;
patient messaging and teleconsultation;
the Patient Health Record and patient context;
the app homepage and daily health experience;
health content and prevention;
recommendations, reminders and care plans;
new patient services and subscription experiences;
conversational and AI-powered experiences.
The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.
Your mandate
You will:
Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.
Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.
Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.
Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.
Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.
Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.
Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.
Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.
Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.
Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.
What success looks like
In your first year, you will have:
established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;
raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;
helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;
strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;
developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;
helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.
What we are looking for
You are likely to bring:
Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..
Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.
A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.
Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.
Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.
Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.
A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.
Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.
The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.
A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.
Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.
Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.
A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.
Why Doctolib, why now?
Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.
The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.
You will join at a defining moment:
Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.
AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.
The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.
The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.
The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.
This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.
Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.
Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.
Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Senior Vice President of Engineering to lead Koalafi’s entire engineering organization, including our Consumer and Merchant Experience, Core Engineering, and Application Experience groups, as well as our Data & AI Platform and Architecture functions.
Reporting to the Chief Product and Technology Officer, you will partner closely with the CPTO and Head of Product to set engineering direction, translate company priorities into execution, and build an organization that delivers meaningful business results. Your scope spans the platforms, applications, services, and data infrastructure that power our customer experiences, merchant relationships, and internal operations.
This is a company leadership role, not solely an engineering leadership role. You will help shape business decisions, influence across functions, and bring a clear perspective on how technology can support growth, improve efficiency, and strengthen the customer experience. You must be equally credible in a technical discussion with engineers and a strategic discussion with the executive team or the board—and move comfortably between those two modes.
We’re also looking for an active AI practitioner who will help evolve how Koalafi works. You should be building and experimenting with AI tools yourself, with a thoughtful perspective on how to apply them across engineering and the broader business. The goal is not simply to increase adoption of tools or token usage, but to drive real, measurable business outcomes by embracing a willingness to fundamentally change how the business operates. You will lead this transformation through practical application, sound judgment, and measurable results.
What You’ll Do
Set engineering direction and own execution
Partner with the CPTO, Head of Product, and cross-functional leaders to translate company objectives into a clear engineering strategy, investment priorities, and execution plans. Ensure teams understand the outcomes they are accountable for, make realistic commitments, and surface risks and tradeoffs early. Own the engineering response when delivery is at risk, aligning leaders on corrective action and following through.
Lead as a business executive
Build strong partnerships across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance, Sales, and other functions. Contribute to company decisions beyond engineering, connecting technical choices to growth, customer experience, operating efficiency, and risk. Communicate complex topics clearly and bring well-vetted recommendations – not simply issues or requests – to executive discussions.
Apply technical depth with sound leadership judgment
Earn the team’s trust through technical expertise, thoughtful questions, and the ability to engage deeply in consequential architectural and engineering decisions. Recognize when an initiative, technical risk, or team challenge needs your direct involvement, and engage early enough to make a difference. Balance that involvement with clear delegation, strengthening your leaders’ ownership rather than becoming a bottleneck or doing their jobs for them.
Build and develop a strong leadership team
Lead, coach, and hold accountable engineering leaders and managers across the organization. Set clear expectations for their technical judgment, business understanding, people leadership, and execution. Invest in succession planning, leadership development, and hiring, while addressing performance gaps directly. Continually evaluate team structure, responsibilities, and leadership capacity so the organization can operate effectively as priorities evolve.
Own architecture, data foundations, and pragmatic modernization
Guide the evolution of our applications, core services, and data platforms, balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, reliability, and scale. Modernize the tech stack where it creates clear business value and be able to defend the ROI. Partner with Risk, Analytics, and Data Science to ensure our data engineering and AI foundations support reliable access, clear ownership, and effective use of data across the company.
Drive engineering excellence and responsible investment
Strengthen quality, test automation, delivery practices, observability, and operational readiness. Establish useful measures of delivery effectiveness, reliability, cost, and business impact, and use them to guide improvement. Own engineering budget and capacity planning in partnership with the CPTO and Finance, challenging staffing and technology proposals against business needs and credible alternatives. Partner closely with IT and Information Security to build and operate secure, resilient systems.
Lead AI adoption through hands-on practice
Maintain an active practice of building, prototyping, and experimenting with AI tools yourself. Use that experience to help teams improve how they design, build, test, deploy, and operate software—not just how they write code. Stay current with emerging capabilities, distinguish useful advances from hype, and turn promising experiments into repeatable practices with measurable improvements in speed, quality, or capacity, with the ultimate goal being to drive better business outcomes for the company.
Help the broader company work more effectively through AI
Partner with business leaders to identify where generative AI, automation, and better internal tools can improve workflows and outcomes. Help teams move from ideas and pilots to solutions people actually use. Ensure adoption is supported by appropriate data access, technical foundations, training, and safeguards, in partnership with Information Security, Risk, and Legal and Compliance.
About You
An experienced engineering executive. You bring 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including substantial experience leading managers and senior engineering leaders across multiple teams. You have owned organization-wide strategy, delivery, talent, and investment decisions, not just an individual product or technical function.
Technically credible and comfortable going deep. You have strong architectural judgment across complex applications, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms. You can challenge assumptions, assess tradeoffs, and help teams work through difficult technical decisions without needing to be the expert in every technology.
Business-minded and influential across functions. You understand how engineering decisions affect revenue, cost, customer experience, and risk. You can earn the confidence of executive peers, navigate competing priorities, and build alignment without relying on reporting lines or authority.
A leader with strong situational judgment. You know when to delegate, when to coach, when to challenge, and when to get directly involved. You maintain enough visibility to recognize emerging problems and take ownership before they become escalations, without micromanaging your team.
A committed developer of leaders. You have a track record of building inclusive, high-performing organizations and helping managers become stronger leaders. You set a high bar, provide candid feedback, address difficult people decisions, and create clear accountability.
An active AI practitioner. You can point to things you have personally built, workflows you have redesigned, or experiments you have run using AI tools. You have informed views on their capabilities and limitations, and experience helping others apply them effectively. Your interest extends beyond coding productivity to how AI can improve the way an entire company operates.
Pragmatic and accountable for outcomes. You can balance modernization with delivery, speed with reliability, and ambition with available capacity. You communicate clearly, make decisions with imperfect information, and follow through on commitments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or other regulated, transaction-intensive environments is a plus, as is experience with customer- and merchant-facing products, servicing platforms, and internal business systems such as Salesforce.
Familiarity with technologies in our environment—including Go, Node.js, React, AWS, Kubernetes, and native iOS and Android development—is helpful. We value strong engineering fundamentals and architectural judgment over expertise in any single stack.
Fluency in the modern AI stack and in how it is changing the way software is built. That includes frontier models, coding agents, and the harnesses, evaluations, and guardrails that make them reliable in production. You should understand how the developer workflow is shifting from writing code to designing and supervising agentic loops, where agents plan, build, test, and verify work against clear specifications. We standardize on Claude, but regularly evaluate new frontier models and tools, and knowing which advances actually matter, is a core part of the job.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.
Salary Range: $275,000-$325,000 per year (depending on experience and location)
Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.
The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.
Applications will be accepted until position is filled.
Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.
Benefits:
At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays
401(k) retirement with company matching
Student Loan & Tuition Reimbursement
Commuter assistance
Parental leave (maternal + paternal)
Inclusion and Associate Engagement Programs
Who we are & what we value:
We focus on what’s most important
We set clear expectations and deliver
We embrace challenges to reach our full potential
We ask, “How can this be better?”
We move fast together

Use that experience to help teams improve how they design, build, test, deploy, and operate software—not just how they write code. Stay current with emerging capabilities, distinguish useful advances from hype, and turn promising experiments into repeatable practices with measurable improvements in speed, quality, or capacity, with the ultimate goal being to drive better business outcomes for the company.
Help the broader company work more effectively through AI

Partner with business leaders to identify where generative AI, automation, and better internal tools can improve workflows and outcomes. Help teams move from ideas and pilots to solutions people actually use. Ensure adoption is supported by appropriate data access, technical foundations, training, and safeguards, in partnership with Information Security, Risk, and Legal and Compliance.
About You

An experienced engineering executive. You bring 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including substantial experience leading managers and senior engineering leaders across multiple teams. You have owned organization-wide strategy, delivery, talent, and investment decisions, not just an individual product or technical function.

Technically credible and comfortable going deep. You have strong architectural judgment across complex applications, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms. You can challenge assumptions, assess tradeoffs, and help teams work through difficult technical decisions without needing to be the expert in every technology.

Business-minded and influential across functions. You understand how engineering decisions affect revenue, cost, customer experience, and risk. You can earn the confidence of executive peers, navigate competing priorities, and build alignment without relying on reporting lines or authority.

A leader with strong situational judgment. You know when to delegate, when to coach, when to challenge, and when to get directly involved. You maintain enough visibility to recognize emerging problems and take ownership before they become escalations, without micromanaging your team.

A committed developer of leaders. You have a track record of building inclusive, high-performing organizations and helping managers become stronger leaders. You set a high bar, provide candid feedback, address difficult people decisions, and create clear accountability.

An active AI practitioner. You can point to things you have personally built, workflows you have redesigned, or experiments you have run using AI tools. You have informed views on their capabilities and limitations, and experience helping others apply them effectively. Your interest extends beyond coding productivity to how AI can improve the way an entire company operates.

Pragmatic and accountable for outcomes. You can balance modernization with delivery, speed with reliability, and ambition with available capacity. You communicate clearly, make decisions with imperfect information, and follow through on commitments.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or other regulated, transaction-intensive environments is a plus, as is experience with customer- and merchant-facing products, servicing platforms, and internal business systems such as Salesforce.

Familiarity with technologies in our environment—including Go, Node.js, React, AWS, Kubernetes, and native iOS and Android development—is helpful. We value strong engineering fundamentals and architectural judgment over expertise in any single stack.

Fluency in the modern AI stack and in how it is changing the way software is built. That includes frontier models, coding agents, and the harnesses, evaluations, and guardrails that make them reliable in production. You should understand how the developer workflow is shifting from writing code to designing and supervising agentic loops, where agents plan, build, test, and verify work against clear specifications. We standardize on Claude, but regularly evaluate new frontier models and tools, and knowing which advances actually matter, is a core part of the job.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.
Salary Range: $275,000-$325,000 per year (depending on experience and location)
Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.
Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

jobs.title: Director, Technology Risk Management
jobs.text:
About Us
Finance of America helps homeowners 55+ access the equity they’ve built while staying in full control of their home and their financial future. Through a range of reverse mortgage solutions, we help customers shape the retirement they’ve earned while continuing to evolve how we serve and work together.
Joining Finance of America now means stepping into a period of momentum and growth, with teams actively shaping what comes next and opportunities to make an impact and grow your career.
To learn more about us, visit
Purpose of Role
Responsible for leading the identification, assessment, and proactive management of technology risk across the enterprise, ensuring alignment with defined risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and business objectives. Drives a forward-looking, data-driven risk management approach across cloud, cybersecurity, AI, and third-party ecosystems, while embedding risk management into day-to-day technology and product decision-making. Partners across the enterprise to strengthen control maturity, enable responsible innovation, and provide clear, actionable risk insights to senior leadership.
Key Responsibilities and Expectations
Technology Risk Strategy & Governance
Leads execution of the Technology Risk Management framework, aligned to industry standards (e.g., NIST CSF, FFIEC, SOX ITGC).
Translates regulatory expectations into pragmatic, delivery-aligned controls and practices across Technology and Product teams.
Drives definition, operationalization, and monitoring of technology risk appetite, tolerances, and KRIs.
Risk Identification, Assessment & Insights
Oversees enterprise-wide identification and assessment of technology risks across: Cloud and Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and data protection, AI and emerging technologies, and Third-party/vendor ecosystems.
Delivers data-driven risk insights and reporting, that clearly articulate risk posture, trends, and emerging risks to senior leadership.
Evolves risk reporting from static outputs to forward-looking, decision-enabling intelligence.
Control Environment & Regulatory Compliance
Drives continuous improvement of control maturity to meet regulatory expectations, including sustained SOX ITGC effectiveness.
Partners with Technology teams to design and implement scalable, automated controls.
Ensures timely and high-quality execution of regulatory exams, internal audits, and remediation commitments.
Issue & Remediation Management
Oversees end-to-end issue management lifecycle, including identification, prioritization, root cause analysis, and sustainable remediation.
Drives accountability for timely remediation of high-risk issues and reduction of aged items.
Ensures systemic fixes over point-in-time remediation.
Technology & Process Enablement
Leads adoption of automation and tooling to enhance risk identification, monitoring, and reporting
Evaluates and improve end-to-end technology processes to reduce risk, increase resilience, and enhance operational efficiency.
Promotes integration of risk management into SDLC, product development, and change management processes.
Emerging Risk & Innovation Oversight
Establishes governance and risk oversight for AI and emerging technologies, ensuring alignment with internal standards and evolving regulatory expectations.
Assesses risks associated with new technology initiatives and provide actionable guidance to enable safe adoption.
Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
Serves as a trusted partner to Technology and Business leaders to proactively manage risk.
Leads engagement with Internal Audit, External Audit, and second line of defense functions.
Builds and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Reports To
VP, Technology Risk Management
Direct Reports
(1-3) Direct: Technology Risk Management team members
Qualifications - Experience/Skills/Competencies
Minimum 10 years of experience in Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, IT Audit or related disciplines within financial services or regulated environments.
Proven experience operating in or alongside first line technology functions, with strong business partnership orientation.
Demonstrated success in evolving risk programs to strategic, insight-driven functions.
Deep understanding of technology risk domains, including: Cloud and infrastructure risk, Cybersecurity and data protection, Third-party/vendor risk, and AI/emerging technology risk.
Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks (FFIEC, NIST CSF, SOX ITGC).
Ability to translate complex technical risks into clear, concise executive-level reporting.
Strong judgement, with the ability to balance risk management with business enablement.
Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership and regulators.
Able to drive accountability, foster collaboration, and promote a culture of continuous improvement.
Qualifications - Education - Required
Bachelor's Degree
Qualifications - Education - Field(s)/Profession(s)
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP).
Compensation
The base salary range for this position is ($150,000 - $200,000) inclusive of all geographical differences in the labor market. The base salary for the position will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, skills, education, and experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members in determining any final offer. We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time-off benefits, flexible spending account, 401(k) with employer match, and ESPP.
Additional Information
The application deadline for this job opportunity is 11/26/2026.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, religion, creed, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Head / Vice President - Engineering
jobs.text:
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role with a growing startup and a young, energetic team of engineers. We're looking for a leader who can balance strategic thinking with technical execution, helping shape the company's technology direction while mentoring and growing the team. Engineering leaders with 812 years of industry experience will be highly desirable.
Primary Responsibilities:
Serve as a hands-on technical leader, overseeing the engineering function including architecture, design, development processes, and infrastructure while making individual contributions when needed.
Define and execute strategies to drive innovation, scale technology solutions, and uphold product quality and performance standards.
Monitor and improve key engineering metrics such as sprint velocity, delivery timelines, incident resolution, and defect rates to ensure team efficiency and alignment with business goals.
Collaborate with product, design, and other cross-functional teams to shape the product roadmap and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.
Own technical decision-making for major projects, ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of the technology stack.
Foster a high-performance culture rooted in technical excellence, agility, and continuous learning.
Play a strategic role in company growth by contributing technical insight to long-term planning and business decisions.
Keep the engineering team aligned with evolving industry trends, introducing modern tools, frameworks, and best practices where relevant.
Support leadership development within the team by mentoring engineering managers and individual contributors.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
8 - 12 years of industry experience, with proven success in engineering leadership roles in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Strong technical foundation with experience across software development, systems architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
Proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing engineering teams, particularly in startup or early-stage environments.
Deep knowledge of modern development practices and the full software development lifecycle.
Experience in designing and managing distributed systems and cloud-native solutions.
Strategic thinker with strong communication and collaboration skills; able to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Passionate about fostering team growth, innovation, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: VP, Subscription Product
jobs.text:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.
ABOUT THE ROLE
iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and VP, Subscription Product is the leader who sets its direction. You own the product vision, the differentiation thesis, and the AI and personalization philosophy.
You report to the Chief Subscription Officer. You partner with the CSO on where the vision product roadmap. You work as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Retention, Content, and Analytics leaders, who operate as first class members of the model.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Product vision and differentiation. Set and defend the product vision, the member experience vision, and the defensibility thesis. Make the final call on the AI and personalization philosophy.
Product prioritization/Roadmap. Set the quarterly percentage split across Core, Growth, and Partner work with the CSO investment lens and Engineering capacity reality. Set the platform and tech debt percentage, which Engineering defines and spends.
Product strategy. Decide product strategy across domains and review domain roadmaps, PRDs, and the single backlog (one queue, three lanes) for coherence.
Monetization innovation. Own the concept pipeline for new revenue ideas. Build the business case, make a clear recommendation, and drive the CSO to a decision on pricing, plans, packaging, and investment.
Innovation pipeline. Own future state concepts and the innovation pipeline, in consultation with Design, Engineering, and Analytics.
Product leadership. Lead and develop the Core Product Leader, Growth Product Leader, and Partner Product Leader. Hold each accountable for outcomes: engagement for Core, funnel for Growth, and partner experiences for Partner.
HOW YOU DECIDE
Decides - Product vision, member experience vision, AI and personalization philosophy, differentiation thesis, innovation pipeline, product strategy, and the quarterly capacity split.
Consulted on - Pricing, plans and packaging, investment decisions, domain roadmaps, retention strategy, content strategy, and acquisition strategy.
Informed on - Commercial partner negotiations, partner sales, paid acquisition, and brand and campaigns.
Does not own - The subscription P&L, pricing, or commercial deals, Architecture and delivery, The retention number, The experiment gate,
OPERATING RHYTHM
Quarterly planning: set the capacity split with the CSO and Engineering, with Analytics arriving with the insights agenda.
Ongoing: review domain roadmaps and resolve cross domain conflicts, then communicate decisions directly and in public.
Regular readouts to the CSO and executive team on product outcomes, bets, and tradeoffs.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.
Best in class engagement and retention results.
Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.
Building the #1 app in Fitness
Three domain leaders who own their slices and escalate only when they should.
WHAT YOU BRING
12 or more years in product, with 5 or more years leading product leaders at a consumer subscription, mobile, or connected fitness company.
Proven record of setting product vision and turning it into a prioritized portfolio with real tradeoffs.
Deep fluency in subscription economics: conversion, retention, LTV, CAC, and pricing and packaging.
Hands on experience shaping an AI and personalization strategy for consumers.
Comfort making direct decisions and holding the tiebreaker without losing partnership with Design, Engineering, and Marketing.
Experience running experimentation programs with an analytics gate.
Executive presence and the ability to present to the CEO and board.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven products.
Experience with partner ecosystems, integrations, and platform products.
Experience scaling a product organization through a reorganization or operating model change.
DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.
Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. Current list of states where iFIT may consider hiring: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.
Subject to applicable state laws, your employment at iFIT is "at-will". At-will employment means that you and the company each have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any cause or for no cause at all.
Pay Range:
$200,000—$225,000 USD
iFIT does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ancestry, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY
321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.
Technology is central to how 321 competes and grows. From our CRM and automation programs to 321 AIM, our proprietary performance marketing platform, the systems we build are a core part of the value we deliver. The Chief Technology Officer is the executive who sets the vision for that technology and turns it into a lasting competitive advantage.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Chief Technology Officer at 321, you will own the agency's technology vision, strategy, and execution at the executive level. This is a C-suite role with company-wide authority — you'll shape how 321 builds, buys, secures, and monetizes technology, lead the technology organization, and help define the agency's direction as a member of the executive leadership team.
The right person for this role thinks in platforms and business models, not just systems. You understand that the right architecture decisions compound over years, that proprietary technology and data can become defensible products, and that AI is reshaping what an agency can deliver and how it should be priced. You're as comfortable advising on a High Level or Salesforce architecture as you are presenting a multi-year technology strategy to ownership, investors, or enterprise clients — and you build the organization that executes it.
You'll provide executive technology leadership in partnership with 321 AIM, guiding platform architecture, scalability, and roadmap decisions so that our proprietary technology and client service delivery grow together.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Executive Leadership & Technology Vision
Define and own the agency's multi-year technology vision and strategy, aligned with company growth goals, service offerings, and market positioning
Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, contributing to company strategy, annual planning, and major business decisions
Own the technology budget, including platform, licensing, infrastructure, and headcount investments, with clear return-on-investment expectations
Lead build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for major platforms and capabilities
Report on technology performance, risk, and investment outcomes to ownership and, where applicable, investors or a board
Technology Organization & Talent
Build, lead, and scale the technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration
Design the organizational structure, leadership roles, and hiring plan needed to support the agency's growth
Set the culture, engineering standards, and operating principles for how technology is built, shipped, and supported across the agency
Develop leaders within the technology organization through coaching, succession planning, and clear career paths
Proprietary Platforms & Product Strategy
Provide executive technology leadership for 321 AIM in partnership with its leadership, guiding platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and roadmap priorities
Identify opportunities to turn repeatable agency solutions, data assets, and automations into proprietary products, platforms, or productized services
Oversee product development practices, including requirements, release management, quality assurance, and technical documentation
Protect and grow the agency's technology intellectual property
AI Strategy & Innovation
Set the company-wide AI strategy, positioning 321 as a leader in AI-powered marketing, CRM, and performance services
Govern responsible AI use, including data privacy, model selection, accuracy standards, and client disclosure practices
Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that create new service lines, improve margins, or strengthen client outcomes
Partner with department leaders to embed AI into creative, paid media, CRM, reporting, and agency operations
Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk
Own the agency's enterprise architecture across internal systems, client platforms, data infrastructure, and integrations
Lead the information security program, including policies, access management, vendor risk, incident response, and business continuity
Ensure agency and client technology meets regulatory and contractual requirements in healthcare, insurance, legal, and other regulated industries, including HIPAA, business associate agreements, TCPA, GDPR, and CCPA
Guide the agency toward formal security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 as client and growth needs require
Data Strategy & Measurement
Define the agency's data strategy, including how client, campaign, and performance data is collected, governed, stored, and used
Oversee the measurement and attribution infrastructure that connects marketing activity to closed revenue for clients
Build the data foundation needed to support performance-based pricing, benchmarking, and predictive insights across the client portfolio
Client, Partner & Agency Growth
Serve as the agency's senior technology executive with clients, partners, and prospects — including CMO, CIO, and ownership-level audiences
Lead the technology narrative in new business pitches, RFP responses, and strategic client relationships
Build and manage strategic technology partnerships with platforms such as High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, and Meta
Lead technical due diligence for partnerships, acquisitions, or major client engagements as the agency grows
WHAT YOU HAVE
12+ years of experience in technology leadership, with demonstrated depth in MarTech, CRM architecture, data infrastructure, and platform or product development — agency, MarTech, or SaaS experience strongly preferred
At least 5 years in an executive or senior technology leadership role (CTO, VP of Technology or Engineering, or Director overseeing multiple teams), including building and scaling technology organizations
Proven track record of setting technology strategy and delivering measurable business results, including revenue growth, margin improvement, or new product lines
Experience leading the development of proprietary platforms or software products, from architecture and roadmap through launch and scale
Deep understanding of CRM and marketing automation ecosystems — High Level strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot also valued
Strong command of enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure), APIs, integrations, and data platforms
Experience leading security and compliance programs in regulated industries, including HIPAA; SOC 2 or similar framework experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated leadership in AI strategy and adoption, including LLM-powered products or workflows, with sound judgment on governance and responsible use
Experience owning technology budgets, vendor strategy, and build-versus-buy decisions
Executive-level communication skills — able to present technology strategy to ownership, investors, boards, and enterprise clients with clarity and credibility
Comfort operating in a fast-growing, remote, multi-client environment with competing priorities
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience; advanced degree a plus
REPORTING STRUCTURE
The Chief Technology Officer reports directly to the CEO and is a member of the agency's executive leadership team. This role leads the full technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration. The CTO partners with 321 AIM leadership on platform strategy and works closely with the SVP of Strategy, Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director to align technology with client delivery and agency growth.
COMPENSATION
Salary Range: $120K+ annually, based on experience
321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, company impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated executive experience, organizational leadership, and a track record of technology-driven business results. Executive performance bonus eligibility applies.
321 BENEFITS
100% remote work environment
Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
Professional development and platform/tool access budget
Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
Opportunity to shape the technology strategy and proprietary platforms of a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology
Salary: $120,000+ based on experience

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.text:
Founded in 1981 in partnership with whistleblowers, the Project On Government Oversight (POGO) is a nonpartisan independent watchdog that works to expose waste, corruption, abuse of power, and other instances where the government fails to serve the public. We champion reforms to achieve a more effective, ethical, and accountable federal government that safeguards constitutional principles. POGO has an over $7 million annual budget that supports a staff of over 50 employees.
POGO is looking for a talented Director of Information Technology to play a crucial role in advancing POGO’s mission by providing strategic leadership on IT and oversight of our IT systems and infrastructure. You will help POGO better leverage technology by being responsible for: developing and implementing IT strategies to support the organization's goals; ensuring the security, compliance, and integrity of our systems and data; and optimizing technology resources to enhance not only operational efficiency but also the impact of our work. This position reports directly to the Vice President (VP) of Finance and Administration.
We encourage potential applicants to apply even if they only have experience or familiarity in some of the areas described below. We fully recognize that many great candidates will not have experience in all of the areas we list, or may have relevant experiences and skills that we have not listed or considered.
Responsibilities include:
Set POGO’s multi-year technology strategy and roadmap in alignment with the strategic plan, and translate it into annual priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes.
Advise the executive leadership team on the organization’s technology posture, including the tradeoffs among operational stability, speed of adoption, cost, compliance obligations, and organizational capacity, and bring recommendations with clear options and costs.
Own the organization’s cybersecurity program: set the risk posture and security roadmap, direct the virtual CISO engagement, oversee risk assessment and penetration testing, maintain cyber insurance readiness, and report on risk to executive leadership.
Author and maintain the organization’s technology, data governance, cybersecurity, and acceptable use policies, and lead their adoption across the organization in coordination with Legal and Human Resources.
Define POGO’s compliance posture for data protection and privacy, accessibility, PCI DSS, and related obligations, and serve as the organization’s internal advisor on technology-related legal and regulatory questions in partnership with Legal.
Identify where technology can materially increase the impact of POGO’s investigative, policy, and advocacy work, and scope, source, or build solutions — including data collection, pipelines, automation, and analysis tooling — in partnership with program leadership.
Set the organizational framework for information architecture, records, and data management, and lead cross-departmental adoption of technology standards, with teams owning their own structures within it.
Lead the IT team: supervise and develop the IT team, set priorities and service standards for the function, and ensure they have the capacity, skills, and succession depth to meet organizational needs.
Qualifications include:
Minimum of 8 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role with responsibility for technology strategy, budget and staff, preferably at a nonprofit, law firm, or other organization with comparable sensitivity around data.
Demonstrated experience setting and executing technology strategy aligned to organizational goals, and presenting options and recommendations to executive leadership.
Demonstrated experience owning a cybersecurity program, including risk assessment, policy development, incident response planning, and directing external security advisors.
Demonstrated experience with technology governance and compliance, including data protection and privacy, PCI, and accessibility obligations, and working in partnership with legal counsel.
Demonstrated experience owning a technology budget, leading vendor selection and contract negotiation, and making build, buy, and sourcing decisions.
Strong working knowledge of modern cloud-first enterprise environments, including Microsoft 365 and Entra, sufficient to direct, evaluate, and hold accountable technical work performed by others.
Demonstrated experience supervising and developing technical staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical matters for non-technical executives and staff and to build consensus across departments.
Commitment to creating, maintaining, and otherwise fostering an inclusive work environment.
Commitment to justice, equity, diversity and inclusion.
(+) Legal, compliance, or privacy background or credential (e.g., CIPP), or experience serving as a technology advisor to legal teams preferred but not required
(+) Experience identifying and delivering technology solutions that increase program impact in research, policy, advocacy, or investigative settings, including data pipelines, automation, and analysis tooling preferred but not required.
Compensation, benefits, and other information:
This position is eligible for remote work from anywhere within the United States provided you are available during POGO’s work hours of 9AM-6PM in the Eastern Time Zone. Otherwise, the position and POGO are based in Washington, DC.
This is a full-time position and includes the listed benefits:
Competitive nonprofit salary in the range of $128K - $140K
Health, dental, and vision insurance
403(b) employee investment plan available, with employer retirement contribution once eligible
Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage
Paid holiday, vacation, and sick leave
To Apply: Resume required, cover letter welcomed but not required. If you'd like to share context on transferable experience or your interest in POGO's mission, we'd love to read it.No phone calls please.
Application Deadline: October 20, 2026
POGO is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We encourage all interested and qualified individuals to apply.
Salary: $128,000 – $140,000 / year
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Product Director, Client Engagement Group
jobs.text:
At Squarespace, we empower our product teams to solve hard problems in ways that our customers love and strengthen our business. As Senior Director of Product for the Client Engagement Group (CEG), you will lead the product strategy and execution for Squarespace's customer engagement platform: the CRM, email campaigns, automations, and transactional communications that enable our merchants to build lasting customer relationships and grow their businesses on Squarespace.
The Client Engagement Group sits at the center of Squarespace's growth strategy. Our marketing tools are a critical lever in increasing product attach, reducing merchant churn, and building a differentiated position in the service commerce landscape. You will own the vision for transforming our current communications offering into a unified customer engagement hub… one that competes with best-in-class tools while leveraging Squarespace's unique data and ecosystem advantages.
You will report directly to the President of Squarespace and serve as a member of the Product leadership team. You will have the option of working on-site (hybrid) at our NYC headquarters or remotely within the U.S.
You’ll Get To…
Define and drive the multi-year product vision and strategy for CEG - spanning CRM, email campaigns, automations, transactional communications, and emerging channels including SMS - with a clear line of sight to revenue growth and platform impact
Own the Email Campaigns business line end-to-end: report on revenue performance, develop engagement and GTM strategies, and lead roadmap decisions in close partnership with commercial and marketing stakeholders
Build toward a competitive, full-featured customer engagement platform by prioritizing investments in business CRM, transactional automations, flexible communication channels, and advanced segmentation that meet the sophisticated needs of today's service sellers
Lead, grow, and mentor a team of product managers across multiple product lines, setting a high bar for hypothesis-driven development, roadmap rigor, and customer-centricity
Partner with Engineering and Design functional leads to deliver outcomes across the team; step in to remove blockers and maintain velocity on high-priority initiatives
Collaborate across the Squarespace ecosystem - with Commerce, Growth, Financial Solutions, and GTM - to ensure CEG products are deeply integrated into the broader platform
Champion the use of Squarespace data and AI to create smarter automation flows, personalized outreach, and differentiated customer engagement experiences that competitors cannot easily replicate
Shape the process, craft, and standards for senior product leadership at Squarespace
Who We’re Looking For
12+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent building and scaling customer engagement, CRM, marketing, or communications products
5+ years leading and developing teams of product managers in complex, multi-product environments
Deep familiarity with the customer engagement and email service provider landscape; informed perspective on what it takes to compete with and differentiate from best-in-class marketing and CRM tools
Demonstrated ability to own a revenue-generating product line with accountability for business outcomes, not just product delivery
Strong strategic instincts paired with a bias for execution; comfortable operating at the intersection of vision-setting and unblocking day-to-day team work
Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner with the credibility to influence senior leadership and align stakeholders across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing functions
Experience applying hypothesis-driven development and experimentation to accelerate product-market fit and grow adoption
Benefits & Perks
A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision
Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans
Fertility and adoption benefits
Headspace mindfulness app subscription
Global Employee Assistance Program
Retirement benefits with employer match
Flexible paid time off
12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave
Pretax commuter benefit
Education reimbursement
Employee donation match to community organizations
7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
Dog-friendly workplace
Free lunch and snacks
Private rooftop
Hack week twice per year
US Cash Compensation Range
Cash Compensation Range: $323,000 - $435,000 USD
The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.
In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.
About Squarespace
Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers.
Our Commitment
Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

You will report directly to the President of Squarespace and serve as a member of the Product leadership team. You will have the option of working on-site (hybrid) at our NYC headquarters or remotely within the U.S.
You’ll Get To…

items: Define and drive the multi-year product vision and strategy for CEG - spanning CRM, email campaigns, automations, transactional communications, and emerging channels including SMS - with a clear line of sight to revenue growth and platform impact

Own the Email Campaigns business line end-to-end: report on revenue performance, develop engagement and GTM strategies, and lead roadmap decisions in close partnership with commercial and marketing stakeholders

Build toward a competitive, full-featured customer engagement platform by prioritizing investments in business CRM, transactional automations, flexible communication channels, and advanced segmentation that meet the sophisticated needs of today's service sellers
Lead, grow, and mentor a team of product managers across multiple product lines, setting a high bar for hypothesis-driven development, roadmap rigor, and customer-centricity
Partner with Engineering and Design functional leads to deliver outcomes across the team; step in to remove blockers and maintain velocity on high-priority initiatives
Collaborate across the Squarespace ecosystem - with Commerce, Growth, Financial Solutions, and GTM - to ensure CEG products are deeply integrated into the broader platform
Champion the use of Squarespace data and AI to create smarter automation flows, personalized outreach, and differentiated customer engagement experiences that competitors cannot easily replicate
Shape the process, craft, and standards for senior product leadership at Squarespace

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that power every marketing, product and commercial decision across the business. We're looking for a Data Science leader who believes machine learning only creates value when it changes business decisions.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a commercially driven Data Science function that delivers measurable improvements in customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term business growth.
You'll lead a growing team of Data Scientists while partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Product and Commercial teams to ensure predictive models become trusted, production-ready products that drive measurable commercial outcomes. As we continue investing in first-party data, AI, machine learning and advanced marketing measurement, we're looking for an experienced Data Science leader to help shape the next phase of our commercial Data Science capability.
Responsibilties:
Commercial Data Science: Lead the strategy and delivery of predictive models that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term commercial value. You'll shape capabilities including lifetime value modelling, propensity modelling, customer segmentation, forecasting and value-based bidding, ensuring every model is linked to measurable business outcomes.
Marketing Science & Decision Science: Partner with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to apply Data Science to real business problems. You'll help define how predictive analytics, experimentation and AI improve campaign performance, customer understanding and strategic decision making across platforms including Google and Meta.
Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to ensure models become reliable, production-ready products rather than one-off analyses. You'll champion reproducible experimentation, scalable deployment, model monitoring, retraining strategies and continuous improvement throughout the model lifecycle.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while building trusted relationships across the business. You'll translate complex modelling into clear commercial recommendations, influence senior stakeholders through evidence, and help establish Data Science as a trusted driver of business strategy and commercial growth.
Innovation & Industry Leadership: Represent Forbes in strategic conversations with technology partners including Google and Meta while staying connected to advances in AI, machine learning and marketing science. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, bring new ideas into the organisation and help ensure our Data Science capability remains commercially relevant and technically leading.
Qualifications:
Experience leading commercial Data Science, Marketing Science or Decision Science teams.
Strong expertise in predictive analytics, customer analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling.
Experience applying Data Science to marketing performance, customer acquisition, lifetime value or value-based bidding.
Experience productionising machine learning solutions within modern cloud environments and working closely with Engineering and ML Ops teams.
Strong understanding of SQL, Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
Experience working with Google Ads, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
Experience building and developing high-performing Data Science teams.
Strong commercial judgement, balancing technical excellence with measurable business impact.
A pragmatic approach to AI, applying emerging technologies where they create genuine commercial value.
Nice to Have
Experience within affiliate marketing, digital publishing or lead-generation businesses.
Experience working in financial services, insurance or regulated industries.
Experience working directly with Google or Meta Data Science teams.
Experience with attribution modelling and marketing measurement.
Experience building optimisation algorithms for DSPs or advertising platforms.
Experience with causal inference, experimentation frameworks or incrementality testing.
Experience forecasting marketing or commercial performance.
Experience with Vertex AI or equivalent cloud-based machine learning platforms.
Forbes Advisor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
