jobs.title: Director, Management & Technology (DACH) - CPG/Retail
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
About Celonis
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.
The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.
Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.
About the Role
Based at our global headquarters in Munich, as a Management & Technology Consulting Manager / Director (internal title: Value Engineering Manager / Director) for CPG & Retail, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.
In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.
Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.
What Sets Our Patch Apart
The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.
As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth: Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
People Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
Executive Advisory & Player-Coach: Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
Enterprise AI Champion: Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
Ecosystem & Partner Strategy: Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
Thought Leadership: Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.
Leadership Behaviors We Value
Deliver Business Outcomes: Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent: Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
Lead by Example: Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
Think BIG, Be BOLD: Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.
Qualifications & Scope
Language Skills: Native or business-fluent German (spoken and written) and fluent English are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
Location Presence: Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
Proven Leadership Experience: Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
Domain Expertise: Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
People Management: Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
Executive Presence: Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.
About Us:
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
Celonis Inclusion Statement:
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
Your Privacy:
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

Executive Advisory & Player-Coach: Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.

Enterprise AI Champion: Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.

Ecosystem & Partner Strategy: Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.

items: Deliver Business Outcomes: Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.

jobs.title: Data Director, EU
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available
About our Data Discipline
We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.
Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.
Our EU team ⭐
Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo.
Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.
You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.
Shaping product and commercial strategy:
You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.
Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:
You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.
Changing how decisions get made:
You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.
Building and leading a high-performing team:
You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!
You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.
You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.
You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.
You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.
You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.
You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.
🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
30 minute recruiter call
45 minute call with the hiring manager
4 x 1-hour video calls with various team members, including the General Manager for Payments
A meet and greet with a member of EU Executive Committee
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.
What’s in it for you:
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options and benefits
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London or Barcelona office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team
📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.
➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.
#LI-JH1 #LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Account CTO
jobs.text:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.
If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.
Engineering at Lambda is responsible for building and scaling our cloud offering. Our scope includes the Lambda website, cloud APIs and systems as well as internal tooling for system deployment, management and maintenance.
What You’ll Do
Strategic Technology Leadership for Key Accounts
Serve as the primary technical liaison for Lambda's strategic Superintelligence accounts
Cultivate and sustain executive level technical relationships, establishing Lambda as a trusted technology partner and strategic advisor
Drive multi-year technology roadmaps aligned with customer business objectives and Lambda's product portfolio
Influence customer technology strategy and adoption at the executive level
Represent Lambda at executive briefings, board meetings, and strategic planning sessions
Own Technical Strategy and Business Outcomes
Partner with Global Account teams to drive strategic account growth and expansion
Lead architectural reviews and technology assessments at the enterprise level
Define and articulate business value propositions, ROI models, and TCO analyses for executive stakeholders
Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and Product Management
Own technical escalations and serve as the Executive Technical Sponsor for critical customer initiatives
Drive adoption of Lambda's strategic initiatives within key accounts
Technology Vision and Thought Leadership
Establish yourself as a trusted advisor on AI/ML transformation and cloud strategy
Guide customers through digital transformation journeys and emerging technology adoption
Publish thought leadership content, speak at industry events, and represent Lambda in executive forums
Influence Lambda's product strategy based on strategic customer needs and market trends
Mentor and develop technical talent across the organization
You
Have 15+ years of experience designing, deploying and scaling cloud infrastructure
Have 6+ years of experience working directly with C-suite executives and senior leadership teams in advisory or consultative capacities
Have 5+ years driving cloud transformation initiatives at enterprise scale
Have proven track record of influencing C-suite executives and board-level stakeholders
Have deep expertise in AI/ML technologies and their business applications
Have experience with NVIDIA DGX/HGX/MGX systems, InfiniBand &RoCE networking, and large-scale GPU cluster deployments
Have experience with storage architectures including distributed file systems, object storage, high-performance parallel file systems, and NVMe-based solutions
Have hands-on experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, and inference at scale
Have experience with enterprise architecture frameworks and governance models
Have experience managing or influencing deals worth $1B+ annually
Have strong business acumen with ability to translate technology into business outcomes
Have experience navigating complex organizational dynamics and driving consensus
Have track record of building strategic partnerships and alliances
Excel at executive communication, presentation, and storytelling
Demonstrate thought leadership through publications, speaking engagements, or industry recognition
Nice to Have
MBA or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
Experience as a CTO, VP of Engineering, Chief Architect, or Technical Fellow at a technology company with $100M+ revenue
Track record working with AI labs, research institutions, or frontier model companies
Board advisory experience for technology companies
Published peer-reviewed research, whitepapers, or patents specifically in distributed computing, GPU acceleration, or large-scale ML training infrastructure
Salary Range Information
The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.
About Lambda
Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
We offer generous cash & equity compensation
Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use
Equal Opportunity Employer
Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

Head of AI Engineering – Bilingual English C1
Full-Time | Remote | Colombia
About the Company
We are an AI strategy and integration firm that builds production AI systems for B2B companies in private equity, wholesale lending, real estate, and SaaS.
We work with high-growth businesses globally, helping them move revenue, compress costs, and automate the work that used to take entire teams — through AI systems that are built to last and designed to perform.
About the Role
We are seeking a Head of AI Engineering to own all engineering delivery at our Colombia engineering hub.
This is the senior-most technical leadership role in the organization. You will lead a high-performing team of AI, ML, MLOps, and Data Engineers while setting the technical bar personally. You'll translate ambitious client goals into scalable, production-ready AI systems — and build the processes, platforms, and culture needed to operate at scale.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of deploying AI systems that moved real business KPIs, is comfortable being client-facing, and knows what it means to own the whole problem — not just manage a piece of it.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Delivery & Leadership
Own all engineering deliverables — quality, scalability, and on-time execution
Lead and manage the full engineering organization: AI Engineers, ML Engineers, MLOps, and Data Engineers
Establish and run Agile/Scrum processes: sprints, backlog grooming, ticketing, and release planning
Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement
AI/ML Strategy & Architecture
Define and standardize best practices across the full AI/ML lifecycle — from experimentation through deployment and monitoring
Architect and oversee a full ML platform: infrastructure, scalability, reliability, and rapid iteration
Design and build scalable, end-to-end ML solutions for predictions, recommendations, search, and growth systems
Evaluate experiments, document findings, select winning approaches, and roll them out team-wide
Technical Execution
Contribute directly to system architecture and key technical decisions
Oversee model training, optimization, deployment, and performance monitoring
Drive data excellence: clean pipelines, strong governance, and actionable insights
Establish frameworks that integrate generative AI into engineering workflows
Client Engagement
Join client calls as a senior technical voice, shaping solutions and building stakeholder trust
Partner with product managers and business leaders to translate business objectives into technical roadmaps
Present trade-offs clearly so clients understand what's being built and why it will move their business
Team Development
Hire, coach, and mentor top-tier AI-first engineers and engineering leaders
Establish clear career paths, feedback loops, and performance standards
Scale the AI function across MLE, MLOps, and Data Engineering as the company grows
Requirements
10+ years of engineering experience with significant and proven leadership responsibility
Track record managing large engineering teams in fast-moving, high-accountability environments
Deep expertise in AI/ML systems — generative AI, model training, and production deployment
Strong command of Agile/Scrum and the operational discipline to run a high-output engineering org
Experience architecting and scaling ML platforms and data infrastructure
Comfortable being client-facing and translating complex technical concepts into business value
English proficiency at C1 level or above
Nice to Have
Former founder or early engineering leader who has operated with full ownership of a technical function
Experience in consulting, professional services, or client-facing technical leadership
Track record of deploying AI systems that moved a business KPI — revenue gained, cost saved, or time eliminated
Active in the AI community — writing, speaking, or building in public
Skills
Machine Learning, Generative AI, and model optimization
MLOps, CI/CD, and ML lifecycle management
Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Data engineering, pipelines, and analytics
Scalable system design and architecture
Exceptional communication across engineering, client, and executive audiences

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Why Tenna?
We take pride that our roots are in the construction industry. With this experience and knowledge, we have built a platform revolutionizing construction equipment fleet operations. We provide innovative solutions to customers looking for competitive ways to better manage and track their assets, such as heavy and light equipment, large fleets, tools, and materials.
At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible.
When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets on one comprehensive platform anytime, anywhere.
Position Description
Tenna is searching for a Vice President of Product to partner with our Executive Team to define and execute the product strategy for our B2B SaaS, mobile, and hardware-enabled platform. This leader will translate Tenna’s product vision into practical, actionable plans and ensure our product teams deliver solutions that create measurable value for customers.
The VP of Product will lead multiple teams, establish clear priorities, and bring structure and accountability to product execution. This is not a strategy-only position. We are looking for a hands-on, outcomes-oriented leader who stays close to the work, regularly checks progress, removes obstacles, and ensures our commitments are met.
The right candidate is an analytical, low-ego leader who listens well, communicates clearly, and is equally comfortable with engaging executives, product and engineering teams, and prospective and existing customers. They will bring experience developing complex, high-value B2B products within industrial markets and supporting solutions deployed across thousands of users.
Your Responsibilities
Partner with the Executive Team to define and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy aligned with Tenna’s business goals, market opportunities, and customer needs.
Translate long-term product strategy into clear roadmaps, priorities, timelines, and executable plans for product, design, engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
Lead, and develop multiple and distributed product teams.
Maintain close visibility into product development, regularly reviewing progress, identifying risks, removing blockers, and ensuring teams deliver against commitments.
Oversee the development and evolution of Tenna’s web, native mobile, SaaS, and hardware-enabled product offerings.
Ensure products are designed to support large-scale deployment across thousands of users and complex customer environments.
Establish and monitor meaningful product metrics, using data to evaluate performance, prioritize investments, and communicate progress.
Present product plans, performance data, tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to executive leadership and other key stakeholders.
Promote disciplined product development best practices while adapting processes to meet the needs of the business.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations.
Develop and improve the tools, systems, and operating rhythms used to manage product work and communicate progress.
Cultivate a practical, customer-focused product culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and execution.
Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proventrack record of success in launching and scaling B2B technology products in a fast-paced environment.
2+ years of experience in senior leadership roles
Significant product management and product leadership experience within a B2B SaaS organization.
Demonstrated success leading multiple product teams, including teams or stakeholders operating across different regions or countries.
Experience developing and delivering complex B2B products within industrial verticals.
Strong record of moving beyond strategy to drive execution, monitor progress, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Experience with web applications and native mobile application development, including products deployed at scale to thousands of users.
Experience working with hardware-enabled products and connected software ecosystems.
Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud-based platforms, multi-tenant systems, and product development.
Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and understand how technologies and programming languages such as JavaScript, Java, Python, Swift, and Kotlin support product development. This role is not expected to read or write production code.
Experience reporting to and communicating directly with senior executives, including C-suite leaders.
Ability to synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative information into clear recommendations, priorities, and decisions.
Experience using sophisticated product and project management tools to manage work, analyze data, and communicate plans and timelines.
Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Figma, Zeplin, or comparable platforms.
Experience directly engaging prospective and existing customers about current products, future offerings, and unmet needs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and persuasively.
Strong people-management skills and a demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and align high-performing teams.
Analytical, practical, and execution-oriented approach to leadership.
Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information
Full-time opportunity.
Opportunity is remote – nationwide.
Competitive compensation package.
Travel is required, up to 25%.
Robust, low-cost benefit packages.
Benefit coverage begins the first date of employment.
Dependent Care.
401k match.
Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Director of Product & Technology, ACCC Subsidiary
jobs.text:
The Director of Product & Technology leads the end-to-end build and ongoing evolution of the digital platform for ACCC's subsidiary. This is a hands-on, builder role: the Director is accountable for the technical architecture, UI/UX, API integrations, infrastructure, and AI-based data solutions that bring the platform to life, while also setting the strategic technology roadmap needed to support the subsidiary's growth and scale.
This role owns the platform roadmap and provides leadership across the full build lifecycle — from architecture and vendor selection through design, development, integration, testing, launch, and continuous improvement. The Director acts as the subsidiary's hands-on technology lead: scouting and managing IT partners and consultants, coordinating UI/UX and website development, and translating the subsidiary's business and growth needs into well-built, scalable, and measurable technology solutions.
Operating within the subsidiary's build phase, the Director owns the Product & Technology function and is responsible for establishing clear priorities, build milestones, scorecard measures, operating rhythms, and team or vendor accountabilities.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
This job description does not limit management’s ability to assign or adjust duties and responsibilities at any time.
Develop and maintain ACCC’s digital product vision, strategy, multiyear roadmap, translating organizational priorities, client needs, and operational needs into actionable initiatives.
Establish product goals, business outcomes, success measures, and value propositions in partnership with business leaders.
Lead a structured process for evaluating, prioritizing and managing digital product requests based on strategic alignment, user impact, risk, effort, and expected value.
Balance new product development with enhancements, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies, platform maintenance, and defect resolution.
Identify opportunities to improve digital client experiences, employee tools, self-service capabilities, and operational workflows.
Own end-to-end technical architecture and infrastructure decisions (hosting, security, scalability) for the subsidiary's platform.
Coordinate UI/UX design and the overall user experience across the platform, working with designers and consultants as needed.
Scope, evaluate, and manage API integrations with third-party data, marketing, and financial-wellness platforms.
Lead website development and ongoing technical build-out of the ConsumerCredit.com platform.
Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-based data solutions to support personalization, lead qualification, and intelligent routing.
Own technical feasibility assessment, architecture decisions, and solution design — directly or in partnership with outsourced development and infrastructure partners — translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Oversee user acceptance testing, launch readiness, communications, training coordination, implementation, and post-launch support.
Monitor product performance, adoption, user feedback, and business impact, using results to drive continuous improvement.
Maintain visibility into product priorities, active initiatives, risks, dependencies, and progress, and communicate recommendations to senior leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop the Product & Technology team, and manage outsourced development and consulting partners.
Scout, evaluate, and manage relationships with IT vendors, development agencies, and technology consultants supporting the platform build.
Ensure digital products incorporate accessibility, privacy, security, compliance, and operational considerations.

Arise is a globally active weight-loss app with over 10 million downloads and a 4.6 rating on the App Store. Our mission is simple but ambitious: empower millions of people to become healthier and happier.
We're looking for a CTO who is a true architect on both iOS and Android — someone deeply skilled in iOS who can take full ownership of our existing app and raise it further, and who can also build our Android app from scratch. You'll develop primarily through AI rather than by hand, and you'll thrive on ownership, precision, and long-term thinking. This role is for someone who ships high-quality code today while foreseeing how today's decisions shape the app for years ahead — technically, strategically, and financially.
Today Arise is iOS-only, so this is where you'll start and where you'll prove yourself: owning, deepening, and future-proofing a mature codebase used by millions. From there, you'll architect and build our Android app from the ground up.
If you excel at structured, autonomous work, build with AI as your default way of working, understand the importance of monetization, and want to own the technology behind a product used by millions, we'd love to hear from you.
Your Role
Own and architect the existing iOS app — maintain, optimize, deepen, and future-proof a codebase used by millions.
Build the Arise Android app from scratch — architecture, delivery, and long-term ownership.
Ensure cross-platform consistency and a coherent technical vision across both platforms.
Develop and test features that enhance the Arise experience.
Use AI agents and automated workflows as your primary means of building, testing, and shipping — not as an occasional helper.
Anticipate technical pitfalls and proactively design solutions.
Collaborate with design to refine usability for a smooth user experience.
Support monetization by integrating features with measurable business impact.
Requirements
Proven track record architecting and shipping production mobile apps, ideally as a senior engineer, lead, or technical founder.
Deep, architect-level iOS expertise — you can own a mature codebase end to end and make the hard structural calls with confidence.
Demonstrated ability to build an Android app from scratch to the same standard.
Hands-on fluency building through AI — agentic coding tools, LLM-driven workflows, automated testing and release. You've actually shipped this way, not just experimented.
Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
Comfortable working fully in English.
Technical Skills
Expert-level iOS/Swift — architecture, patterns, performance, and the judgment to keep a large app maintainable as it grows.
Strong Android development (Kotlin) with the ability to architect a new app end to end.
Familiarity with mobile build and release tooling (e.g. Fastlane).
Deep understanding of Apple and Android design principles, patterns, and best practices.
Ability to write clean, well-documented, maintainable code — and to direct AI to do the same.
Who You Are
A decisive builder who takes a problem and runs with it — you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for certainty.
Direct and results-driven, comfortable owning outcomes and making the call.
Energized by autonomy and full ownership of the technology.
Allergic to bureaucracy — "meetings that should have been emails" are your enemy.
Why You'll Love Working with Us
High autonomy: own the entire tech stack from idea to release.
Clear decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
Work with the newest hardware and technologies.
Complimentary Claude Max subscription.
Flexible, remote-first role (full-time).
Paid annual leave.
Direct collaboration with the founder — your work will have visible impact from day one.
How to Apply
Send us your application including:
Your CV
A history of the mobile apps you've built (iOS and Android)
Salary expectations
(Optional) Code samples or GitHub repositories
Help us build and refine a product that runs like a well-oiled machine — and improves millions of lives in the process.

jobs.title: Head of Simulation Engineering (Expression of Interest)
jobs.text:
Expression of Interest · Inquire First
We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest.
Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment.
Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership
Turn simulation research into an experimental engine that can be inspected, reproduced, and improved. Lead the engineering function at the boundary between scientific methods and dependable software.
Why Subconscious
Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need.
The function you will build
Own simulation implementation, experiment execution semantics, reproducibility standards, and the simulation engineering hiring plan. Partner with causal research on method design, evaluation on quality, and infrastructure on reliable operation.
This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed.
Proposed first 90 days after joining
Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start.
Trace an experiment from configuration to output and document which inputs, model versions, random states, and artifacts are required to reproduce it.
Establish an implementation contract for treatments, populations, execution, and result aggregation, with meaningful correctness checks.
Profile a representative workload and improve its largest quality, throughput, or cost constraint without silently changing the experimental question.
Build a research-to-production path with versioned interfaces, reviewable changes, and explicit failure handling.
How we will judge progress
Research ideas become reusable capabilities with explainable behavior. Track reproducibility, correctness under independently specified test cases, experiment throughput, and cost. Make changes in model behavior distinguishable from execution defects.
What you bring
You have led research engineering, simulation, scientific computing, or ML systems work and shipped robust implementations of complex methods.
You can reason about stochastic systems, numerical behavior, experiment design, and performance while writing and reviewing production code.
You can lead a technical roadmap across researchers and engineers and make explicit tradeoffs between exploration and stability.
We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.
Compensation and funding
We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.
Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.
How we work
Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed. Expect direct collaboration with the founders, work across scientific and commercial boundaries, and responsibility for doing the early work yourself. The current role does not include visa sponsorship. Confirm practical collaboration hours and any travel expectations during the initial conversation.
Start with work you already own
Describe a research method you brought into production. What could go wrong in the translation, how did you test correctness, and what did you change after real use?
Please do not share confidential employer or customer materials. Bring your questions about our product, evidence, team, finances, and the authority attached to the role. Mutual diligence matters for a decision of this size.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Engineering - Cloud Detection Platform
jobs.text:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
About the Role
CrowdStrike stops breaches, and detection content is how we do it. The Cloud Detection Platform team builds the engines that execute detection logic in the cloud at massive scale, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet.
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for our cloud detection engines (scheduled, real-time, and retrospective execution across first- and third-party data) and the supporting infrastructure: content management and deployment pipelines, rule lifecycle and exception management, testing and validation environments, and the observability, quotas, and SLOs that keep rule execution reliable and cost-effective for customers.
This is a high-leverage role at the center of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Your platform serves detection engineers across endpoint, cloud, identity, and next-gen SIEM, and every improvement you ship translates directly into faster, higher-quality protection for thousands of customers.
What You'll Do
Own the multi-year strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the Cloud Detection Platform, from detection engines to the content delivery infrastructure that supports them
Lead and grow an organization of managers and senior engineers across multiple teams, owning the full talent lifecycle: hiring, coaching, performance, and succession
Be accountable for the reliability, latency, and cost of detection rule execution at fleet scale, including SLO definition, capacity and quota management, and COGS
Drive the evolution toward a unified multi-engine detection architecture, balancing scheduled search, real-time, and retrospective execution across engines
Partner closely with detection engineering, content, product management, and data platform teams to prioritize and deliver against roadmap commitments
Build the guardrails that make shipping detection content safe: pre-release validation, staged deployment, rollback, exclusion management, and end-to-end testing
Anticipate and manage escalations and cross-team dependencies, and represent the platform in architecture and planning forums across the product organization
Drive annual operating plan and organizational planning for your area, and reflect CrowdStrike's culture in how your teams operate
What You'll Need
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and 2+ years managing managers
Experience owning large-scale distributed systems in production, ideally data-intensive platforms such as query/search engines, streaming systems, or rule/event processing pipelines
A track record of being fully accountable for strategic outcomes over one-to-two-year horizons, not just project delivery
Strong architectural judgment: you can engage credibly in design reviews, influence technical direction, and make build/buy/consolidate calls
Experience managing operational excellence for customer-facing services: SLOs, incident response, capacity planning, and cost management
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, including organizational change, competing priorities, and cross-team dependencies
Excellent communication skills with executives, peers, and engineers
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Bonus Points
Domain experience in security, detection engineering, SIEM, or threat intelligence
Experience with detection-as-code, content management systems, or rule authoring platforms
Experience with multi-tenant capacity management, fair-usage models, or COGS optimization at cloud scale
Experience integrating AI-assisted or agentic workflows into engineering practice
Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:
Market leader in compensation and equity awards
Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
Paid parental and adoption leaves
Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe
CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.
CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.

jobs.title: IT Director - Enterprise Applications, Data, and PMO
jobs.text:
Infleqtion is seeking an IT Director to define and execute the strategy for enterprise applications, data and analytics, and the Program Management Office (PMO). Reporting to the CIO, this leader will translate business priorities into coordinated technology roadmaps, lead major application and data initiatives, and establish a consistent approach to evaluating, prioritizing and delivering technology investments.
The role combines strategic leadership with practical execution. The Director will partner with business leaders to improve core processes, strengthen data quality and decision-making, and build a PMO that provides clear ownership, predictable delivery and visibility into results. This leader will balance new programs with the reliability and continuous improvement of existing systems.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Applications
Define and maintain the enterprise applications strategy and roadmap with business process owners, aligning ERP, CRM and other business systems with company priorities, growth and operating needs.
Lead application selection, implementation, integration, modernization and lifecycle management; evaluate opportunities to simplify the application portfolio and reduce unnecessary complexity.
Lead and oversee major application programs with business sponsors, establish accountable delivery owners, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and ensure effective transition into ongoing support.
Establish expectations for application reliability, support, documentation and continuous improvement, with clear escalation paths and measures of service performance.
Data & Analytics Strategy and Delivery
Define and execute a data and analytics strategy and roadmap, aligning governance, integration, data quality, business intelligence and reporting with business priorities.
Establish data ownership, stewardship, common definitions and quality measures; coordinate master-data practices and reliable information flows across enterprise systems.
Lead reporting, analytics and data integration initiatives with business owners; deliver trusted dashboards, consistent performance metrics and insights that support planning and operational decisions.
Partner with security and business owners to ensure appropriate data access, handling and lifecycle controls are built into solutions.
Program Management Office
Establish and lead the PMO, including a standard process for demand intake, business cases, prioritization, capacity planning, funding decisions, delivery and benefits tracking.
Implement a common software development lifecycle (SDLC) framework covering requirements, design, development or configuration, testing, business acceptance, release and operational handover, with rigor appropriate to each initiative.
Maintain an integrated portfolio view of scope, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies and risks; provide concise reporting and decision recommendations to the CIO and business sponsors.
Set standards for project governance, change control, documentation, organizational readiness and lessons learned; coach program and project leads in their use.
Leadership and Business Partnership
Build and develop the capabilities needed across applications, data and program delivery, using internal teams and external partners effectively.
Manage assigned budgets and vendor relationships, including delivery commitments, service levels, costs and performance.
Partner with finance, operations, engineering and other functions to make investment tradeoffs, secure business ownership and ensure adoption of new capabilities.
Work with security, finance and control owners to incorporate access governance, change approvals, testing evidence and applicable internal controls into application and data delivery.

jobs.title: Head of Product Engineering (Expression of Interest)
jobs.text:
Expression of Interest · Inquire First
We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest.
Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment.
Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership
Build the product through which companies turn questions into experiments and evidence into decisions. Lead product engineering from architecture and customer workflows through reliable delivery and a growing team.
Why Subconscious
Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need.
The function you will build
Own product engineering architecture, delivery standards, technical prioritization, and the product engineering hiring plan. Partner with design on usability, simulation engineering on experimental capabilities, and infrastructure on production operations.
This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed.
Proposed first 90 days after joining
Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start.
Trace a customer workflow end to end and identify the largest obstacles to completing a useful study.
Ship a focused improvement that connects interface, API, data model, and experimental execution, with observable behavior and clear failure states.
Establish engineering practices for tenant boundaries, data handling, testing, rollout, and recovery appropriate to enterprise use.
Build a roadmap that balances customer needs, maintainability, and research integration, with explicit staffing and budget proposals.
How we will judge progress
Customers complete workflows reliably and new capabilities reach them with fewer manual handoffs. Measure task completion, production defects, delivery lead time, and support burden. Keep critical product behavior understandable and maintainable as the team grows.
What you bring
You have led engineering for a production enterprise or technical product and can show architecture and delivery decisions you personally owned.
You can work across frontend, backend, APIs, and data systems while giving engineers clear direction and useful code review.
You can build a team, collaborate with designers and researchers, and stay hands-on when an important customer problem requires it.
We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.
Compensation and funding
We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.
Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.
How we work
Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed. Expect direct collaboration with the founders, work across scientific and commercial boundaries, and responsibility for doing the early work yourself. The current role does not include visa sponsorship. Confirm practical collaboration hours and any travel expectations during the initial conversation.
Start with work you already own
Describe a product you shipped and operated. What did you own, which architectural tradeoff mattered most, and what did customer behavior or production evidence teach you?
Please do not share confidential employer or customer materials. Bring your questions about our product, evidence, team, finances, and the authority attached to the role. Mutual diligence matters for a decision of this size.

jobs.title: Director, Machine Learning Engineering, Ads Quality
jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where hundreds of millions of people come to find inspiration and decide what to try, buy, or do next. Our Ads Quality organization builds the machine-learning systems that make ads relevant and valuable to Pinners while delivering meaningful outcomes for advertisers.
We are seeking a Director of Machine Learning Engineering to lead a broad portfolio of Ads Quality modeling teams focused on engagement, conversion, ROAS optimization, ranking, representation learning, and ML-powered experimentation.
In this role, you will shape and drive a unified technical strategy across Ads Quality, leading teams responsible for engagement ranking, oCPM and conversion modeling, ROAS optimization, lightweight ranking and retrieval models, foundation model adoption, sequence and multimodal modeling, and the quality and efficiency of production machine learning systems.
What you’ll do:
Set the technical vision and multi-year strategy for Ads Quality machine learning, connecting model innovation to Pinner value, advertiser performance, revenue, and marketplace health.
Lead and develop a group of engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and machine-learning engineers across multiple modeling domains.
Establish a coherent modeling roadmap across engagement, conversion, ROAS, relevance, ranking, and foundation-model initiatives.
Drive improvements in model quality, calibration, generalization, cold-start performance, attribution, and robustness across Pinterest surfaces.
Guide the evolution of Ads models toward larger, more generalizable architectures, including foundation models, distillation, long-context sequence modeling, multimodal representations, and cross-domain learning.
Ensure that modeling investments translate into reliable production outcomes through strong offline evaluation, online experimentation, launch discipline, and post-launch monitoring.
Partner closely with Ads Product, Ads Data Science, Ads Signals, Ads Retrieval, Ads Delivery, Measurement, Core, ATG, and ML Infrastructure.
Set expectations for training-serving parity, data quality, privacy, reliability, latency, capacity, and cost efficiency.
Improve engineering velocity through better experimentation workflows, reusable modeling infrastructure, automation, and agentic development tools.
Build a culture of technical excellence, candid collaboration, inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning.
Represent Ads Quality ML in senior leadership forums and communicate strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
What we’re looking for:
Minimum 12 years of experience building and deploying machine-learning systems, including significant experience leading managers and multi-team organizations.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale recommendation, ranking, advertising, search, marketplace, or personalization ML teams.
Strong understanding of modern deep-learning and recommender-system techniques, including sequence models, embeddings, multimodal models, multi-task learning, foundation models, distillation, and reinforcement learning.
Experience with conversion, value, ROAS, bidding, or other lower-funnel optimization problems is strongly preferred.
Proven ability to connect modeling objectives and offline metrics to online experiments and business outcomes.
Experience operating production ML systems with demanding requirements for latency, availability, calibration, privacy, reliability, and cost.
Strong judgment in balancing near-term product delivery with foundational technical investments.
Track record of building high-performing organizations, developing senior leaders, and creating effective operating mechanisms.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
In-Office Requirement Statement:
We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2x per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from one of the following offices: Palo Alto, San Francisco.

jobs.text:
Axos Bank
Target Range:
$120,000.00 /Yr. - $145,000.00 /Yr.
Actual starting pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.
Eligible for an Annual Discretionary Cash Bonus Target: 15%Eligible for an Annual Discretionary Restricted Stock Units Bonus Target: 15%
These discretionary target bonuses may be awarded semi-annually based upon your achievement of performance goals and targets.
About This Job
Axos was born digital, providing consumer banking services without any brick-and-mortar locations and has continued evolving since. The Axos consumer product team drives the vision and roadmap for this evolution and is adding an AVP, Product Management - Proxy Account Opening (Deposits, Brokerage, Credit Card, etc.) to the team.
This individual will be responsible for contributing to and driving the Proxy Account Opening roadmap. This individual will work closely with delivery teams across the enterprise to own the delivery of critical projects and release best-in-class experiences to our clients. This role will report to the FVP of Account Opening and will lead product owner(s) in day-to-day SDLC activities.
Responsibilities:
Product Roadmap: Understanding the strategic vision for your area of responsibility and defining a roadmap to achieve the vision
Problem Solving: Working with product leaders and business stakeholders to understand market trends, business objectives, and key customer segments to define product solutions
Definition: Defining workflows, process maps, and data flows to document product requirements
Feature Prioritization: Prioritizing feature releases to optimize business outcomes
Leadership: Leading product owners, designers, and solution architects to define product requirements
Supporting operational readiness activities (documentation, training, and staffing)
Analysis: Analyzing business metrics and customer feedback to improve product performance
Testing: Performing User acceptance testing
Collecting customer feedback / pain points
Presenting to leadership on project status, roadmaps, features, kpi, etc.
To be successful in this role, you will:
Be expected to think both strategically and tactically.
Possess a strong understanding of product discovery, product lifecycle, and SDLC processes.
Effectively communicate with subject matter experts across business, technology, analytics, risk, and operations to define solutions to complex challenges.
Passionately drive initiatives to meet key milestone dates.
Work well autonomously and collaboratively within cross‑functional teams.
Build consensus when there are differing opinions and priorities.
Work with autonomy to meet aggressive timelines in a dynamic environment.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree
5+ years building/managing technical products
Knowledge of the Product Development Lifecycle and SDLC
Experience working in an agile / scrum environment
Experience with issue and development tracking software such as Microsoft DevOps or Jira
Experience with KYC, KYB, and other Identity verification and fraud prevention solutions
Axos Employee Benefits May Include:
Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
Paid Sick Leave, 3 weeks’ Vacation, and Holidays (about 11 a year)
HSA or FSA account and other voluntary benefits
401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with Employer Match Program and 529 Savings Plan
Employee Mortgage Loan Program and free access to an Axos Bank Account with Self-Directed Trading
About Axos
Born digital-first, Axos delivers financial tools and services that allow individuals, small businesses, and companies to access and manage their money how, when, and where they want. We’re a diverse team of dynamic, insightful, and independent innovators who are excited to provide technology-driven solutions that offer unbeatable value to our customers.
Axos Financial is our holding company and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "AX" (NYSE: AX).
Learn more about working at Axos
Pre-Employment Background Check and Drug Test:
All offers are contingent upon the candidate successfully passing a credit check, criminal background check, and pre-employment drug screening, which includes screening for marijuana. Axos Bank is a federally regulated banking institution. At the federal level, marijuana is an illegal schedule 1 drug; therefore, we will not employ any person who tests positive for marijuana, regardless of state legalization.
Equal Employment Opportunity:
Axos is an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, breast feeding and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military and veteran status, marital status, age, protected medical condition, genetic information, physical disability, mental disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
Job Functions and Work Environment:
While performing the duties of this position, the employee is required to sit for extended periods of time. Manual dexterity and coordination are required while operating standard office equipment such as computer keyboard and mouse, calculator, telephone, copiers, etc.
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
E-Verify and Right to Work Notices
Axos participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States. The E-Verify program is an internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services.
