jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - Digital Applications (London, GB)
jobs.text:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
About Atos Group
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
Role Purpose
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) for the Digital Business Line (BL) is responsible for defining and delivering the technical vision and strategy, driving the transformation agenda which we have embarked on.
As the Technical leader, you will share client engagements, aligning the client’s needs with business objectives and technology execution.
This senior leadership role drives the transformation agenda, leads technical business development, shapes client engagements, and ensures the successful delivery of complex solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Transformation
- Shape and deliver the BL’s transformation vision, integrating product lifecycle management and AI into the operating model.
- Lead engagement with Global BL and Geo technology teams to ensure coordinated execution of the transformation strategy.
- Lead the evolution of engineering delivery from a traditional SDLC to a product/service-oriented capability model.
2. Technical Business Development
- Act as a senior technical advisor to strategic clients, shaping their thinking on Digital Applications services.
- Position the BL as a leader in AI-enabled SDLC services in partnership with Industry teams and customers.
- Provide technical leadership across bids and proposals, ensuring approaches align to modern software engineering and product delivery methods.
- Partner with the presales solutioning team to support business development activities, shaping solution approaches and integrating new service offers into the Digital portfolio.
3. Technology Strategy & Architecture
- Define and maintain the enterprise technology strategy for SDLC and AI platforms.
- Establish architectural standards and governance to ensure security, scalability, and consistency across solutions.
- Evaluate emerging technologies and trends, providing strategic recommendations aligned with policy and legislation.
4. Technical Leadership & Team Management
- Lead and develop high-performing engineering teams and associated technical functions.
- Promote a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.
5. Delivery Assurance & Governance
- Oversee technical delivery across major programmes, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and quality expectations.
- Lead gated approval processes across solution design, implementation, and deployment.
Required Skills that we’d like you to bring
- Deep knowledge of AI and its application in transforming SDLC practices.
- Expert understanding of product lifecycle management and full-stack engineering.
- Influencing senior stakeholders, including C-suite and business line leadership.
- Eligibility for, or holding, UK Security Clearance (SC).
- Experience representing organisations at industry events, roundtables, and forums, and contributing to thought leadership.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with partners, suppliers, and SMEs to drive innovation and growth.
- A track record of fostering innovation through emerging technology
Additional Requirements
Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC clearance.
Location: UK-based. Remote working is available, with national mobility required.
Benefits
25 days paid leave + National Holidays
Pension Scheme - contributions matched up to 10%
Private Medical Cover
Income Protection
Life Assurance
Flex Benefits Program
We are a care leaver friendly employer, if you require additional support with your application, please contact our recruiter or send an email to our dedicated email.
As a Disability Confident employer, we encourage applications from all applicants, especially, differently abled applicants. We aim to ensure that those who meet the minimum criteria for this position will be offered an interview. We are committed and willing to making reasonable adjustments to the application and assessment process to accommodate your needs.
If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via our dedicated mailbox: or directly to the responsible recruiter Elvira Dupcheva on
Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.
Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.
Choose your future. Choose Atos.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Cloud & Reliability
jobs.text:
Who is Boulevard?
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.
Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.
We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.
Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.
Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.
We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Cloud & Reliability to lead our infrastructure transformation and establish industry leading reliability practices. This role will be instrumental in evolving Boulevard's infrastructure into a scalable, reliable, secure, and highly available platform that supports our rapid growth and customer needs across a spectrum of market segments (Small Business, Franchises, Enterprises).
Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations.
You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth.
Domains of Ownership
Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code
DevOps & CI/CD - Transform deployment pipelines, implement container orchestration, and enable rapid, reliable software delivery
Observability & Reliability - Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog and related tools
Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity - Establish DR infrastructure, failover systems, and business continuity planning across all Boulevard services
Infrastructure Automation - Build self-service infrastructure capabilities and advanced automation using Terraform and GitOps practices
Security & Compliance - Establish comprehensive security practices, manage compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and implement security-by-design principles
Key Projects & Initiatives
EKS Migration & Containerization: Lead the migration from current infrastructure to Amazon EKS, implementing container orchestration and services-ready architecture
Multi-Region DR Implementation: Design and implement hot-hot disaster recovery with automated failover, load balancing, and regular testing procedures
CI/CD Pipeline Transformation: Modernize deployment pipelines to support faster, more reliable deployments
Advanced Observability: Enhance comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog, enabling proactive issue detection and resolution
Security Framework: Establish enterprise-grade security practices, compliance frameworks, and automation to support Data team's governance requirements
Infrastructure-as-Code Evolution: Scale Terraform usage, implement GitOps practices, and create self-service infrastructure capabilities
Database Scaling: Address current RDS limitations and implement scalable database architecture
What you'll do here:
Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term infrastructure and security strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Boulevard grows
Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of operational excellence
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Services and Data Engineering teams to provide the infrastructure foundation for their initiatives
Architecture & Design: Drive architectural decisions for cloud infrastructure, security systems, and operational practices
Operational Excellence: Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices that ensure high availability and performance
Compliance Management: Ensure compliance with industry standards (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and implement security controls
What you'll need to thrive:
10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with 5+ years leading infrastructure teams of 5-15 engineers
Deep experience with AWS services including EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and infrastructure automation using Terraform
Proven experience migrating applications to Kubernetes/EKS and implementing container-based architectures
Strong background in security practices, compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and security automation
Experience transforming CI/CD pipelines, implementing GitOps practices, and enabling rapid software delivery
Expertise with monitoring and observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana) and implementing comprehensive alerting strategies
Proven ability to work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Platform Services teams to enable their technical initiatives
How we'll take care of you:
At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $209,500 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.
In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.
✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.
Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.
Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month.
Family planning resources and specialized support programs.
Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.
Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.
We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life!
Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
About Augintel: We exist to give child welfare leadership and staff a deeper understanding of the people they care for. By building SaaS software applications that apply cutting-edge artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques, we help clinicians in social services, behavioral health and child welfare – government, private and nonprofit – unlock the value of their unstructured data to improve their understanding, save them time, and help them deliver better outcomes to the people and communities they serve.
Location: Remote (US). Ability to support customers across multiple time zones is required.
Reports To: CEO
Job Summary:
Over the last six years Augintel has built a new category in Child Welfare and has transformed how caseworkers and supervisors do their jobs. We’ve been first to market with an industry-defining product, enjoy exceptional customer retention, and continue to win new business. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need to strengthen both our strategic vision as well as our day-to-day execution.
The Chief Product Officer will be the executive responsible for aligning Augintel’s strategy and product direction and associated operating cadence and cross-functional execution.
This leader will help Augintel maintain the speed and customer intimacy of a founder-led company while building the clarity, accountability, prioritization discipline, and operating infrastructure required for sustainable growth.
At the product level, this leader will own the translation of Augintel’s vision into a cohesive 12–36 month product strategy and roadmap. They will ensure that new products and features do not simply ship, but land in the market with clear positioning, customer value, adoption plans, enablement, and measurable revenue impact.
At the operating level, this leader will build the company-wide rhythms that connect annual strategy to quarterly execution, commitments to operating plans, and customer commitments to product, engineering, and commercial capacity.
The right person is both strategic and hands-on. They can articulate a compelling multi-year product vision, but they also care deeply about roadmap discipline, prioritization, launch quality, customer feedback loops, commercial enablement, financial outcomes, and execution predictability.
The ideal candidate thrives in founder-led organizations transitioning from early-stage success to operational maturity. They excel at balancing customer commitments with long-term strategic investments and are energized by solving complex scaling challenges.
This is a role for a builder, operator, product strategist, and trusted CEO partner. This role is part of the executive team and reports to the CEO.
Responsibilities:
Enterprise Operating Rhythm & Execution
Translate annual strategic product objectives into measurable quarterly execution
Lead company-wide planning processes, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and operating reviews
Establish and maintain a consistent cadence of product and go-to-market execution and accountability across the organization
Monitor progress against company objectives and proactively identify execution risks
Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership
Own Augintel’s product strategy in partnership with the CEO, Engineering, Revenue, Marketing and Customer Impact
Translate CEO vision and market insight into a cohesive 12–36 month product roadmap
Balance near-term customer commitments with long-term strategic product investments
Ensure roadmap decisions are grounded in customer value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and time-to-market
Establish clear prioritization frameworks that guide what Augintel starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes
Elevate product discovery, customer understanding, design discipline, experimentation, and product decision-making across the company
Represent Product at the executive and board level with clarity, structure, and strategic insight
Cross-Functional Leadership
Facilitate product alignment on priorities, trade-offs, and resource allocation
Drive resolution of cross-functional issues that impede execution
Foster a culture of transparency, constructive debate, and shared ownership
Strategic Portfolio Management
Partner with executive leadership to balance customer commitments, innovation initiatives, and operational investments
Establish frameworks for prioritization and governance
Ensure product investment decisions align with strategic objectives, customer value, and financial outcomes
Drive disciplined decision-making around what the organization starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes
Growth & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Revenue, Marketing and Customer Success leaders to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the commercial engine
Partner with Customer Success Team to identify opportunities to accelerate time-to-value, improve expansion outcomes, and increase customer retention
Partner with Customer Success, Revenue and Marketing to ensure customer insights, adoption trends, and implementation learnings inform company strategy, product priorities, and operational improvements
Support enterprise deal strategy where cross-functional leadership is required
Organizational Scale & Effectiveness
Design and evolve product operating mechanisms appropriate for the company's stage of growth
Clarify product and roadmap related decision rights, ownership models, and escalation paths
Develop scalable product management processes that increase organizational effectiveness without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy
Metrics & Performance Management
Define and monitor the critical metrics that drive performance
Use data to identify emerging risks and opportunities
Ensure the organization focuses on outcomes rather than activity
CEO Partnership
Act as a trusted thought partner to the CEO
Drive follow-through on strategic product initiatives and board commitments
Prepare materials and insights related to product, roadmap and the market for executive and board discussions
Augintel is proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to a stronger workplace and a better product for our users. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to join us in transforming how human services agencies support children, families, and communities.

jobs.text:
Job Summary
The Head of Engineering leads the organization's software engineering and technology development function, responsible for building, modernizing, scaling, and maintaining secure and reliable technology products and platforms.
Within Insurance & Investments, the role oversees engineering across insurance platforms, investment systems, customer-facing applications, APIs, enterprise integrations, digital channels, data-intensive applications, and technology modernization initiatives.

Define and execute the engineering strategy, roadmap, architecture, and delivery model.

APIs and microservices
Insurance platforms

Integration platforms

Manage engineering budgets, technology vendors, contractors, and strategic technology partners.
Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering leaders and technical teams.
Establish engineering KPIs, SLAs, quality metrics, and delivery standards.
Ensure technology development complies with relevant security, regulatory, risk, and governance requirements.

Strong product/business orientation and ability to connect engineering strategy with business objectives.
Excellent executive stakeholder and vendor-management skills.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
jobs.text:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.
As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.
We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact.
Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning it with broader company and platform goals.
Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems.
Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.
Who You Are
You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively.
You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical.
You bring strong system design and architectural decision-making experience in distributed systems.
You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs in high-impact environments.
You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations.
You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations.
You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences.
You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows and apply that thinking pragmatically.
You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in Stockholm or London
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Compensation
Additional Information

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, LP
jobs.text:
As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27,000+ employees in 35 countries. Some 20,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
Job Description
Director of Product Management, LP
Job Summary
Intralinks, Inc. is seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Limited Partner (LP) focused solutions. This role will be instrumental in defining and delivering innovative products that meet the evolving needs of our LP clients within the alternative investments industry.
Job Responsibilities
* **Product Strategy & Vision:** Define and champion the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Intralinks' LP-focused product suite, aligning with company objectives and market opportunities.
* **Market & Customer Research:** Conduct thorough market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews to identify key LP pain points, unmet needs, and emerging trends. Translate these insights into compelling product requirements and use cases.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, marketing, and client success teams to ensure successful product development and go-to-market execution.
* **Roadmap Definition & Prioritization:** Develop and maintain a detailed product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* **Requirements Gathering & Specification:** Translate high-level business requirements into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.
* **Performance Monitoring & Analysis:** Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for LP products, monitor product usage and performance, and leverage data to inform future product decisions and iterations.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Effectively communicate product strategy, progress, and outcomes to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and external partners.
* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Potentially lead and mentor a team of product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Job Qualifications
* **Experience:** 10+ years of progressive experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role (e.g., Director, Senior Manager).
* **Industry Expertise:** Strong understanding of the alternative investments industry, particularly the workflows, challenges, and needs of Limited Partners (LPs). Experience with private equity, venture capital, real estate, or hedge fund operations is highly desirable.
* **Technical Acumen:** Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum preferred) and the ability to effectively collaborate with engineering teams.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Proven ability to develop and execute comprehensive product strategies that drive business growth and customer satisfaction.
* **Analytical Skills:** Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* **Communication & Presentation:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
* **Leadership & Influence:** Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and inspire a shared vision.
* **Customer Focus:** A deep commitment to understanding and serving customer needs, with a track record of delivering user-centric products.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. MBA or relevant Master's degree is a plus.

Job Description
Director of Product Management, LP
Job Summary

Intralinks, Inc. is seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Limited Partner (LP) focused solutions. This role will be instrumental in defining and delivering innovative products that meet the evolving needs of our LP clients within the alternative investments industry.
Job Responsibilities

* **Product Strategy & Vision:** Define and champion the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Intralinks' LP-focused product suite, aligning with company objectives and market opportunities.

* **Market & Customer Research:** Conduct thorough market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews to identify key LP pain points, unmet needs, and emerging trends. Translate these insights into compelling product requirements and use cases.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, marketing, and client success teams to ensure successful product development and go-to-market execution.
* **Roadmap Definition & Prioritization:** Develop and maintain a detailed product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* **Requirements Gathering & Specification:** Translate high-level business requirements into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.

* **Performance Monitoring & Analysis:** Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for LP products, monitor product usage and performance, and leverage data to inform future product decisions and iterations.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Effectively communicate product strategy, progress, and outcomes to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and external partners.
* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Potentially lead and mentor a team of product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Job Qualifications
* **Experience:** 10+ years of progressive experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role (e.g., Director, Senior Manager).

* **Industry Expertise:** Strong understanding of the alternative investments industry, particularly the workflows, challenges, and needs of Limited Partners (LPs). Experience with private equity, venture capital, real estate, or hedge fund operations is highly desirable.
* **Technical Acumen:** Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum preferred) and the ability to effectively collaborate with engineering teams.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Proven ability to develop and execute comprehensive product strategies that drive business growth and customer satisfaction.
* **Analytical Skills:** Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* **Communication & Presentation:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
* **Leadership & Influence:** Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and inspire a shared vision.
* **Customer Focus:** A deep commitment to understanding and serving customer needs, with a track record of delivering user-centric products.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. MBA or relevant Master's degree is a plus.

jobs.text:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technology?
Do you want an opportunity to lead an amazing team of managers and engineers?
Join our Akamai Platform IAM team!
The Platform IAM team is part of Akamai's Cloud Technology Group. We design and operate customer-facing platforms enabling customers to configure and control their delivery, security, and cloud assets. This team owns the IAM tool sets for Akamai's customers using the Akamai Control Center website and the Cloud Manager website. We ensure customers have what they need to configure users for quality, safety, and performance.
Partner with the best
As the Director of Engineering, you will be in a high-impact, global leadership role responsible for steering the engineering strategy, architecture, and execution of Akamai's IAM platform. This leader will scale a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization to deliver massive-scale, feature-rich, and performant IAM systems.
As the Director of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Managing mentoring, and growing a large, multidisciplinary global team of managers, software engineers, and architects
Driving the technical roadmap for the IAM platform, ensuring the platform is highly scalable, resilient, and optimized for global, low-latency AuthZ
Overseeing the end-to-end software development lifecycle to ensure all code meets our high standards for quality, safety and performance.
Partnering closely with other teams to translate business vision into concrete technical milestones,
Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:
Have 15 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or its equivalent
Have extensive experience leading large, distributed software engineering teams with a track record of delivering innovative software products
Possess a deep understanding of the IAM ecosystem
Have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven track record of aligning remote, global teams
About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
FlexBase adapts to your job's needs
Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!
Compensation
Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $203,600 - $366,400/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Deployment and Support
jobs.text:
Datavant is a data platform company and the world’s leader in health data exchange. Our vision is that every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.
Our platform is powered by the largest, most diverse health data network in the U.S., enabling data to be secure, accessible and usable to inform better health decisions. Datavant is trusted by the world’s leading life sciences companies, government agencies, and those who deliver and pay for care.
By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a high-performing, values-driven team. Together, we’re rising to the challenge of tackling some of healthcare’s most complex problems with technology-forward solutions. Datavanters bring a diversity of professional, educational and life experiences to realize our bold vision for healthcare.
Main Duties and Responsibilities Include:
Lead strategic planning and execution across technology deployment, endpoint engineering, IT asset management (HAM & SAM), ITSM processes, and tooling—including full ownership of Jira Service Management workflows, configuration, and lifecycle optimization.
Oversee the design, development, and optimization of desktop engineering solutions, including OS imaging, configuration management, endpoint security posture, automation capabilities, and enterprise deployment standards.
Own the enterprise ITAM program, ensuring full lifecycle governance for hardware and software assets, accuracy of asset records, compliance with licensing agreements, and alignment with audit, security, and procurement requirements.
Partner with the ITAM vendor to ensure high-quality delivery, compliance adherence, data accuracy, and continuous process improvement across asset lifecycle management workflows.
Serve as the senior escalation point for endpoint deployment challenges, tooling issues, and asset management discrepancies, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts and driving systemic remediation.
Establish and refine ITSM processes—including incident, request, change, problem, knowledge, and configuration management—ensuring efficiency, cross-team adoption, and alignment with best practices.
Develop, document, and maintain SOPs, engineering standards, deployment playbooks, and operational workflows to ensure consistency, predictability, and scalability across all technical deployment and support functions.
Drive enterprise rollout of new endpoint technologies, software packages, and productivity tools, including planning, communication, change management, testing frameworks, and success measurement.
Collaborate with IT, Security, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure end-to-end alignment across deployment programs, asset lifecycle governance, configuration standards, and compliance requirements.
Oversee vendor performance related to endpoint engineering, ITAM services, deployment support, and tooling platforms, including SLA governance, contract considerations, and operational reviews.
Lead major technical initiatives such as OS upgrades, security hardening programs, tooling migrations, directory modernization, and automation-driven efficiency improvements.
Monitor deployment metrics, asset data health, software utilization trends, configuration drift, and platform performance to identify improvement opportunities and implement durable solutions.
Guide the strategic evolution of ITSM tooling, including workflow automation, integration expansion, reporting maturity, and self-service capability development.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team responsible for engineering, deployment, process governance, and tooling administration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, innovation, and operational excellence.
Manage budget planning, resource forecasting, tooling investments, and vendor costs to ensure responsible financial oversight and prioritization of impactful initiatives.
Qualifications:
10+ years of experience in desktop engineering, endpoint management, IT asset management, ITSM process development, or enterprise technology deployment.
5+ years leading multi-disciplinary technical teams, including engineering, asset management, or ITSM platform ownership.
Strong expertise in ITAM principles (both HAM and SAM), asset lifecycle governance, software licensing, audit readiness, procurement alignment, and inventory accuracy.
Deep experience administering, optimizing, and governing ITSM platforms—preferably Jira Service Management—including workflow design, automation, integrations, data models, and service catalog development.
Hands-on experience with endpoint engineering technologies (Intune, Jamf/Mosyle, SCCM, MDM/UEM platforms), OS lifecycle management, and automated deployment processes.

blocks.text: Datavant is a data platform company and the world’s leader in health data exchange. Our vision is that every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.

Our platform is powered by the largest, most diverse health data network in the U.S., enabling data to be secure, accessible and usable to inform better health decisions. Datavant is trusted by the world’s leading life sciences companies, government agencies, and those who deliver and pay for care.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a high-performing, values-driven team. Together, we’re rising to the challenge of tackling some of healthcare’s most complex problems with technology-forward solutions. Datavanters bring a diversity of professional, educational and life experiences to realize our bold vision for healthcare.
Main Duties and Responsibilities Include:

items: Lead strategic planning and execution across technology deployment, endpoint engineering, IT asset management (HAM & SAM), ITSM processes, and tooling—including full ownership of Jira Service Management workflows, configuration, and lifecycle optimization.

Oversee the design, development, and optimization of desktop engineering solutions, including OS imaging, configuration management, endpoint security posture, automation capabilities, and enterprise deployment standards.

Own the enterprise ITAM program, ensuring full lifecycle governance for hardware and software assets, accuracy of asset records, compliance with licensing agreements, and alignment with audit, security, and procurement requirements.
Partner with the ITAM vendor to ensure high-quality delivery, compliance adherence, data accuracy, and continuous process improvement across asset lifecycle management workflows.

Serve as the senior escalation point for endpoint deployment challenges, tooling issues, and asset management discrepancies, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts and driving systemic remediation.
Establish and refine ITSM processes—including incident, request, change, problem, knowledge, and configuration management—ensuring efficiency, cross-team adoption, and alignment with best practices.

Develop, document, and maintain SOPs, engineering standards, deployment playbooks, and operational workflows to ensure consistency, predictability, and scalability across all technical deployment and support functions.
Drive enterprise rollout of new endpoint technologies, software packages, and productivity tools, including planning, communication, change management, testing frameworks, and success measurement.

Collaborate with IT, Security, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure end-to-end alignment across deployment programs, asset lifecycle governance, configuration standards, and compliance requirements.
Oversee vendor performance related to endpoint engineering, ITAM services, deployment support, and tooling platforms, including SLA governance, contract considerations, and operational reviews.
Lead major technical initiatives such as OS upgrades, security hardening programs, tooling migrations, directory modernization, and automation-driven efficiency improvements.
Monitor deployment metrics, asset data health, software utilization trends, configuration drift, and platform performance to identify improvement opportunities and implement durable solutions.
Guide the strategic evolution of ITSM tooling, including workflow automation, integration expansion, reporting maturity, and self-service capability development.

Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team responsible for engineering, deployment, process governance, and tooling administration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, innovation, and operational excellence.
Manage budget planning, resource forecasting, tooling investments, and vendor costs to ensure responsible financial oversight and prioritization of impactful initiatives.

jobs.title: SVP, Platform (Engineering & Product)
jobs.text:
We are hiring a Senior Vice President (SVP) of Platform to work with our Platform Product and Engineering organizations to help us build, scale, and secure the foundational capabilities of our core B2B SaaS platform, reporting directly to the CEO. Serving as the unified executive leader over both Product Management and Software Engineering disciplines for our platform ecosystem, you will ensure our underlying architecture, data infrastructure, and emerging AI technologies directly empower our applications team and accelerate long-term enterprise growth.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a deeply technical, visionary executive who bridges the gap between complex platform infrastructure, enterprise-grade scalability, and practical business value. You see potential in the platform to scale massively to new scenarios, new roles, new geographies and new business models. You understand that extensibility today cannot occur without deeply integrating AI technology both into the platform and the tooling that surrounds it so that those who work with the platform can execute at speeds never dreamed of before. You have been re-tooling yourself over the last several years and have developed significant expertise in AI technology and are ready to challenge yourself to integrate AI technologies into a highly successful and loved security and compliance platform treasured by its customers and partners across the world.
You are a data-driven, hands-on leader who operates with a relentless focus on foundational software quality, developer experience (DX), data integrity, and strict operational metrics. In this role, you’ll eliminate traditional silos by directly managing both product and engineering tracks into a singular, high-velocity infrastructure and platform machine. You deeply care about making both our internal engineering teams and developer partners successful, championing platform design, modern frameworks, and robust developer tools to ensure Hyperproof scales smoothly. You understand how crucial it is to architect data pipelines that integrate into modern systems for crucial workflows from AI ingestion to dashboarding to analytics.
You stretch beyond AI and extensibility into hands on software infrastructure, leading and operating a world class developer operations team that deliver mission critical developer tooling and build automation to the rest of the organization and our partners. You architect these systems for speed of execution, quality and compliance with our FedRAMP Moderate obligations.
You will partner closely with Applications, Security, Data, Architecture, Operations, and Risk Governance teams to ensure Hyperproof's infrastructure is secure, governed, observable, reliable, and cost-effective as we scale to meet the demands of the modern enterprise market.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
You'll provide unified executive leadership, mentorship, and technical direction to a globally distributed organization of platform architects, product managers, and software engineers.
You'll define and lead the technical roadmap for Hyperproof’s enterprise platform and AI engineering capabilities, ensuring absolute synchronization with overarching corporate strategy, security standards, and governance expectations.
You'll take direct business and financial accountability for platform-led growth, designing infrastructure strategies that directly drive and support ARR, NRR, and GRR expansion across our enterprise customer base.
You'll drive the unification and standardization of core, enterprise-grade platform capabilities—specifically centralizing and scaling Authentication, Roles/Permissions, Tasks, Workflows, and comprehensive system Logging.
You'll architect and oversee the strategic multi-cloud convergence of our Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) application, successfully deploying it into new cloud environments.
You'll champion developer experience (DX) and productivity by building reusable components, application engineering patterns, and technical playbooks that enable rapid adoption.
You'll evaluate cloud services, frameworks, data architectures, and AI platform tools with a rigorous focus on developer self-service, reuse, interoperability, cost optimization, and enterprise scalability.
You'll establish repeatable technical patterns and platform standards for moving core data pipelines and advanced AI/GenAI capabilities safely from experimentation to production-grade implementation.
You'll instill a culture of relentless quality control, implementing robust testing frameworks, automated verification, and performance SLAs to ensure enterprise-grade stability and zero critical regression escapes.
You'll design and roll out a unified 6-month product-engineering platform roadmap that introduces secure-by-design architectural patterns, model orchestration layers, and reusable accelerators.
You'll deliver a highly predictable, metric-driven platform delivery pipeline by the end of the year, characterized by top-tier platform stability, high team accountability, and optimized engineering throughput.
HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU ARE SUCCESSFUL (Key KPIs)
Platform Scalability & Efficiency: Achieving clear improvements in infrastructure utilization, API performance, and data processing throughput while systematically lowering cost-per-tenant as enterprise usage scales.
Developer Experience & Internal Adoption: Maximizing internal developer velocity and minimizing onboarding friction by delivering highly reusable platform components, templates, and frameworks that drastically reduce rework for application teams.
Platform Predictability & Commitments: Reaching a 90% or higher predictability rate on quarterly platform roadmap commitments across both infrastructure engineering and product management milestones.
System Availability & Core SLAs: Meeting or exceeding a 99.9% uptime SLA and establishing robust disaster recovery, predictive monitoring, and business continuity metrics for core cloud services.
Platform Quality & Defect Leakage: Minimizing post-release infrastructure bugs and maintaining a zero-tolerance standard for critical regressions in production.
Own timely and quality delivery of platform features that manifest directly to end users, ensuring tight alignment and shared accountability of GRR, efficiency and other important business metrics.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
Experience: 10+ years of experience leading software product and/or engineering organizations within a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, with at least 5+ years in an executive-level leadership role (SVP, VP, or equivalent).
Unified Leadership Background: Proven track record of directly managing both Product Management and Software Engineering teams simultaneously, successfully synchronizing both disciplines into a single platform delivery organization.
Technical Foundation: 12+ years of progressive technology experience across software engineering, platform engineering, enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure, or data platforms.
Developer Productivity Focus: Demonstrated track record of delivering production-grade enterprise platforms, reusable engineering frameworks, integration patterns, or developer productivity solutions that raise engineering standards.
AI & Platform Fluency: Strong technical depth in cloud-native platform design, APIs, microservices, and modern data architectures alongside foundational familiarity with emerging AI/GenAI engineering patterns (e.g., model orchestration, RAG, embeddings).
Scale & Operations: Extensive experience managing multi-tiered organizations consisting of VPs, Directors, and Managers across distributed geographic locations.
Metric-Driven Management: Deep expertise establishing and leading through thorough platform performance and engineering metrics (e.g., DORA metrics, system availability, cloud spend efficiency, quality assurance KPIs).
Authorization: Note: you must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
Preferred Qualifications
Industry Domain: Deep domain experience working in highly regulated environments (such as GRC, cybersecurity, or fintech) with strict privacy, risk, compliance, and operational readiness expectations.
Cloud Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience scaling complex enterprise architectures on public cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS and/or MS Azure.
Advanced Technology Execution: Demonstrated experience taking advanced AI/Agentic workflows, model context protocols, or complex multi-tenant data pipelines out of proof-of-concept stages and into secure, production-grade enterprise software.
Education: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
OUR TECH
Hyperproof's core cloud platform operates in a highly secure, distributed architecture. Our platform stack utilizes robust back-end microservices, modern cloud infrastructure, and secure, cloud-native relational, non-relational, and vector database services optimized for high-throughput data pipelines, deep compliance mapping, and secure enterprise AI integration.
LOCATION
We are a fully remote company! Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live.
Travel Expectations: Travel for executive off-sites, strategic alignment sessions, engineering hackathons, and annual company-wide events.
CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE
We value your time and want you to know what to expect from us. For this interview, we expect to ask you to participate in:
Initial Screening: Recruiter Consultation (30 mins)
Hiring Manager Interview: Strategic Alignment Sync with our CEO (45 mins)
Internal Stakeholder Interviews: Discussions regarding Architecture & Infrastructure Design, Metric Mastery, Platform Product Strategy, and Leadership sessions with key engineering, product, and executive stakeholders (approx. 3-4 hours total)
Executive Final Interview: Sync with members of the Executive Leadership Team (60 mins)
We expect this entire process to be completed in approximately 5-6 hours of interview time.
Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience and certifications.

$222,000—$291,000 USD

$222,000—$291,000 USD
Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience and certifications.

$222,000—$291,000 USD
Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience and certifications.
USA pay input
$222,000—$291,000 USD
WHERE YOU’LL GO
Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you’re looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.
WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES
Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ
Annual compensation reviews + equity
Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects
$500 home office stipend - at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed.
$100 quarterly paid wellness stipend
Pet insurance discount
Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)
It’s an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.
At Hyperproof’s core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.
We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) do the right things so the wrong things don’t happen.
Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.
A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS
We’re committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process.
Here’s what that means for you:
We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process.
You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background.
For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.
These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace — it’s one of our core values! Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.
To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is not a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

AI & Platform Fluency: Strong technical depth in cloud-native platform design, APIs, microservices, and modern data architectures alongside foundational familiarity with emerging AI/GenAI engineering patterns (e.g., model orchestration, RAG, embeddings).
Scale & Operations: Extensive experience managing multi-tiered organizations consisting of VPs, Directors, and Managers across distributed geographic locations.

Metric-Driven Management: Deep expertise establishing and leading through thorough platform performance and engineering metrics (e.g., DORA metrics, system availability, cloud spend efficiency, quality assurance KPIs).
Authorization: Note: you must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

items: Industry Domain: Deep domain experience working in highly regulated environments (such as GRC, cybersecurity, or fintech) with strict privacy, risk, compliance, and operational readiness expectations.

jobs.title: Medical Director, Clinical Program Design
jobs.text:
Job Title: Medical Director, Clinical Program Design
Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA
About the Company
Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com.
About the Role
We're hiring a Medical Director to own the protocols driving our virtual on-demand, urgent, and convenience care lines. You'll also lead and scale the QA program that measures their success. It's fast-moving work inside a practice built with modern, AI-powered tools.
What You’ll Do
Care protocols. Write, update, and refine the clinical protocols behind Wheel's care programs. Integrate them across all our partners, scale them effectively, and translate them into the logic our platform runs on.
Quality Assurance. Lead Wheel's clinical QA program. Integrate AI to enable further scale, and turn its findings into feedback the network can act on.
Outcomes and iteration. Develop the frameworks and procedures that track patient and clinical outcomes across these care programs, and use that data to improve care over time.
Patient safety. Manage clinical patient-safety escalation protocols and active escalations, keeping Wheel's clinical standards consistent and on target.
Who You Are
MD or DO from an accredited institution, board-certified in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Emergency Medicine. Primary care experience preferred.
Substantial clinical practice experience, including virtual care or telemedicine.
Prior clinical leadership experience managing teams directly in telehealth, digital health, or a high-volume virtual practice.
Hands-on experience with clinical quality assurance — building, running, or auditing a QA program.
Experience authoring and maintaining clinical protocols.
Basic proficiency with AI tools & software
You're energized by where medicine is heading — new evidence, new modalities, new models of care — and you want to help build the next version of it.
You want to work closely with product and engineering as clinical tooling gets built.
You reach for the data. You're at home reasoning from dashboards, cohorts, and outcomes, and you'd rather measure than guess.
Active medical license in good standing in one or more states.
Able to pass NCQA credentialing and Wheel's standardized background checks.
Nice to have
Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.
Experience integrating AI or automation into clinical quality or protocol workflows.
Comfort with EHR configuration, clinical decision support, or point-of-care tooling.
Multi-state licensure.
ABOM Certification or expertise in cardio-metabolic conditions.
Salary and Perks
Pay Range: $250,000 - $290,000 plus a 15% bonus.
Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.
Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.
As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:
Medical, Dental and Vision
Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability
401K match
Flexible PTO
Parental Leave
Stock options
Additional programs and perks
Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.
This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.
The Position
We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.
Key Accountabilities
Leadership and Operations:
Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.
Solution Engineering:
Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.
Customer Support Operations:
Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.
Who You Are
Skills/Knowledge:
Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.
Requirements:
BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team
Preferred Skills:
SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.
Join Us
We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.
We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.
In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.
Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!
At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:
•All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
• We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
• We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
• Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.
Learn more about how to spot recruitment scams and protect yourself - FBI warning: https://bit.ly/4aDF5wU
Claritas Rx is committed to transparency, integrity, and a safe hiring experience for every candidate. Learn more
https://www.claritasrx.com/about/careers/
