jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance - Product & Technology - Digital Business (Remote, US)
jobs.text:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role
Lumen is seeking a strategic, forward-thinking Senior Director of Finance to serve as the CFO and trusted business partner for our Product & Technology organization. This executive-level leader will provide financial leadership across a dynamic portfolio of digital, software, platform, cloud, and technology investments, helping shape decisions that accelerate growth, enhance profitability, and maximize shareholder value.
In this highly visible role, you will partner directly with executive leadership to drive financial strategy, long-range planning, investment prioritization, and business performance. You will lead a high-performing finance organization while influencing critical decisions related to product innovation, technology investments, resource allocation, and long-term growth.
Responsibilities
Serve as the strategic finance leader and key business partner to Product & Technology leadership, translating business priorities into actionable financial strategies.
Lead financial management across a complex portfolio, including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount planning, capital investments, EBITDA, and free cash flow.
Drive annual planning, long-range planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis to support business growth and investment decisions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Corporate Strategy leaders to align financial plans with business objectives.
Provide executive-level insights and recommendations regarding portfolio prioritization, organizational investments, profitability, and operational performance.
Establish and govern key SaaS and digital business metrics, including recurring revenue, retention, customer economics, and product profitability.
Evaluate strategic investments, product initiatives, acquisitions, and technology programs, ensuring disciplined capital allocation and measurable returns.
Lead, develop, and inspire a world-class Product Finance organization focused on strategic decision support, business partnership, and financial excellence.
Qualifications
Minimum
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or Product Finance.
Experience supporting SaaS, software, cloud, digital platform, or technology-driven businesses.
Demonstrated success leading complex P&Ls and driving business performance in large, matrixed organizations.
Experience partnering with executive leadership teams on strategic planning, investment decisions, and financial performance management.
Deep understanding of SaaS business models, subscription and consumption economics, product development lifecycles, and software investment strategies.
Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing finance teams and future leaders.
Exceptional financial acumen, executive presence, communication, and influencing skills.
Preferred
MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced business or finance credentials.
Experience serving as a Finance Leader, CFO, or senior finance executive within a SaaS, cloud, enterprise software, or high-growth technology environment.
Experience supporting Product, Engineering, or Technology organizations at scale.
Knowledge of software capitalization, cloud infrastructure economics, hosting and delivery models, and digital business performance metrics.
Experience evaluating mergers, acquisitions, integrations, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
Background in telecommunications, cloud networking, digital platforms, AI infrastructure, or related technology sectors.
Proven track record influencing outcomes across complex organizations without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to balance growth investments with disciplined financial management and value creation.
Compensation
This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.
Location Based Pay Ranges
$174,876 - $233,168 in these states: AL AR AZ FL GA IA ID IN KS KY LA ME MO MS MT ND NE NM OH OK PA SC SD TN UT VT WI WV WY
$183,621 - $244,827 in these states: CO HI MI MN NC NH NV OR RI
$192,364 - $256,486 in these states: AK CA CT DC DE IL MA MD NJ NY TX VA WA
Lumen offers a comprehensive package featuring a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle benefits and other perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing. We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short-term incentives, long-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.

Life at Lumen
Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.
To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:

If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. For more information on these checks, please refer to the Post Offer section of our FAQ page. Job-related concerns identified during the background screening may disqualify you from the new position or your current role. Background results will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Equal Employment Opportunities
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all persons regardless of race, color, ancestry, citizenship, national origin, religion, veteran status, disability, genetic characteristic or information, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, family status, pregnancy, or other legally protected status (collectively, “protected statuses”). To review Lumen’s Global Employment Applicant and Talent Community Privacy Notice, please visit:

The job responsibilities described above indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not intended to include a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities for this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on evolving business needs and conditions.
In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Please be advised that Lumen does not require any form of payment from job applicants during the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings will be posted on our official website or communicated through official company email addresses. If you encounter any job offers that request payment in exchange for employment at Lumen, they are not for employment with us, but may relate to another company with a similar name.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Us
BTC Inc. is the parent company of Bitcoin Magazine, The Bitcoin Conference, and Bitcoin for Corporations. Our mission is Hyperbitcoinization, the global adoption of Bitcoin as the world's preferred monetary network. We believe Bitcoin opens the door to a global monetary network free from poor incentives, censorship, and government manipulation. Our journey to success involves decades of complex problem-solving, product development, and service creation in order to onboard billions of people into a future where money is more accessible, borderless, and inclusive. If you enjoy working on challenging problems, fast-paced sprints, and navigating ambiguity, you'll find our mission and type of work inspiring and rewarding.
The Role
We are seeking a product-minded Chief Technology Officer to architect and build the data platform that powers BTC Inc's next generation of products. You will lead the design and delivery of our core data infrastructure and consumer app architecture, own engineering standards across the company, and build the engineering organization behind them. You will report directly to the CEO and operate as a peer to product leadership, sharing one joint platform roadmap.
The ideal candidate has personally built, not just managed, a data platform that powers a revenue product. You are a senior IC at heart who has grown into leadership without losing your hands. You read an engineering plan and immediately want to redline it. You are wary of frameworks, transformation roadmaps, and any first-90-days plan that does not include shipping code. You have built or shepherded a modern data stack (BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, identity resolution, BI) and shipped data products that customers paid for. You are Bitcoin-literate or genuinely curious. You are comfortable being the first engineering hire and the last call on architecture.
The Work
Platform Architecture
Own the technical architecture of our data platform: warehouse, ingestion pipelines, identity resolution, and a unified data model across the business.
Make the early infrastructure calls: ETL tooling, dbt structure, BI layer, orchestration, and data governance posture.
Sequence the platform buildout to ship a working unified dataset within the first few months.
Consumer App & Data Connectivity
Define the technical relationship between our consumer app and our data platform: what gets captured, how identity flows, what gets enriched, and what flows back to the user.
Partner with the app engineering team (initially contractor, transitioning to FTE) on the consumer surface and event credentialing.
Ensure event credentialing is production-grade and survives tens of thousands of users on day one.
Engineering Leadership & Standards
Hire and develop the engineering team. Model constraint before headcount: automate, simplify, and ship before you hire.
Establish the engineering culture: code review, on-call, observability, technical writing, and a high IC bar.
Be the technical interviewer and bar-raiser on every engineering hire.
Set and enforce engineering standards company-wide, favoring shipped reference implementations over policy memos.
Own standards on day one; the broader technology portfolio consolidates under you as systems mature.
Surface technical constraints to the leadership team in plain language, and carry commercial constraints back into engineering planning.
Security, Compliance & Data Governance
Stand up SOC 2 readiness on a timeline that supports enterprise-grade commercial products.
Own GDPR, consent tiering, and right-to-erasure capability across the platform from day one.
Make vendor and tooling decisions that survive audit and scale.
Work with existing technology team to architect and enact future IT infrastructure and steward technical philosophies org wide.
Your Experience
10+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years as the senior-most technical leader at a startup, data-intelligence company, fintech, or media-intelligence business.
Personally architected and shipped a data platform that powered a revenue product.
Deep, current expertise in a modern data stack: BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran or Airbyte, an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster), and a BI layer (Looker, Hex, Metabase).
Track record hiring and growing senior ICs in a small, high-trust environment; no preference for command-and-control management styles.
Comfortable making product and commercial trade-offs, not just technical ones; able to push back on commercial leadership when the engineering reality requires it.
Bitcoin-literate, or genuinely curious about Bitcoin as a monetary network, the Bitcoin treasury thesis, and the Lightning/x402 stack.
Strongly preferred: AI native with experience building consumer mobile, agent-facing APIs (MCP, x402), or research/intelligence data products at production scale.
Additional Benefits
In addition to working on a meaningful mission in a challenging environment, we also provide the following:
Unlimited Vacation
Company MacBook
Health, Dental, and Vision
Remote First / Your Schedule
100% Paid Life Insurance and Disability
Work alongside a talented, fast-paced team solving complex problems
The opportunity to connect and network with the Bitcoin industry and leaders in the space.

jobs.title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation
jobs.text:
Job Title: Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation
Reports To:Chief Technology Officer
Location: Remote – US
Job Type: Full-Time, Regular Position
Company Overview:
Asymchem, Inc., is part of Asymchem Laboratories Co. Ltd., founded in 1995 as a global integrated Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) providing drug R&D and manufacturing for leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Our mission is to drive smarter, greener, and more cost-effective manufacturing to support clinical research and commercialization. Asymchem currently operates R&D and manufacturing facilities in China, the U.S., and the U.K., offering solutions ranging from early clinical stage to commercial stage, including R&D, cGMP production of advanced intermediates, APIs, formulations, and clinical research services. Asymchem Group, headquartered in Tianjin, P.R. China, is a publicly traded company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 002821.SZ/6821.HK).
Asymchem Company Information and Social Media
Job Overview:
The Vice President, Chemical Engineering & Process Innovation advance Asymchem’s chemical engineering capabilities to support the next generation of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Building on Asymchem’s existing technical strengths, this leader will work with teams across the organization to advance process engineering, expand continuous manufacturing, and accelerate progress toward more automated, data-driven operations. The role will extend successful technologies and practices across client programs and global sites. Working closely with the Chief Technology Officer and existing technical and operational leaders, this VP will shape technology priorities, develop talent, and guide investments that connect scientific innovation with manufacturing execution. The opportunity is to influence Asymchem’s technology direction while delivering measurable progress in engineering capability and manufacturing performance.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Partner with technical and operational leaders to continuously improve engineering capabilities, technical practices, and cross-site collaboration. Translate shared priorities into a roadmap with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
Support the development of engineering talent across the US, Europe, and China. Mentor technical leaders, share effective methods, and contribute to recruitment aligned with evolving business needs.
Strengthen process understanding, measurement, modeling, and control to enable reliable automation. Connect laboratory development with manufacturing requirements from the outset.
Partner with manufacturing, automation, and digital teams to develop and validate approaches that integrate PAT, process models, and data-driven decisions. Apply AI where it offers demonstrable process value.
Prioritize opportunities for automated and continuous processing, demonstrate their value, and lead the engineering work required for adoption in manufacturing.
Advance capabilities in reaction engineering, continuous processing, crystallization, solid-form and particle engineering, and separation and isolation. Select technologies against process needs, safety, robustness, and economics.
Translate successful approaches into platforms that can be reused across client programs. Extend relevant capabilities from small molecules to peptides, oligonucleotides, and emerging modalities.
Guide critical engineering decisions through scale-up, technology transfer, and commercialization. Work with process chemistry, analytical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams to resolve complex process challenges.
Engage clients on technical strategy and due diligence. Translate engineering capabilities into credible development and manufacturing solutions that strengthen client confidence and business opportunities.
Partner with the CTO and functional leaders to identify opportunities for technology advancement, shape long-term priorities, and guide investment in people, equipment, and external partnerships.
Evaluate emerging technologies with scientific rigor and implementation discipline. Build academic and industry collaborations, develop future technical leaders, and represent Asymchem in senior technical discussions.
Experience Requirements - Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities (KSAs):
PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Substantial pharmaceutical development, engineering, or manufacturing experience, typically 15+ years, with increasing leadership responsibility. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and CDMO backgrounds are welcome.
Demonstrated success advancing engineering capabilities or technology platforms, developing talent, and translating technical progress into sustained operational results.
Strong chemical engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more relevant process technologies, and the breadth to lead specialists. A record of successful scale-up, technology transfer, or commercial implementation is essential.
A collaborative leader who develops talent, earns trust across functions, and advances technical priorities through shared ownership and disciplined implementation.
Credibility with clients, technical experts, and executives; sound process safety and quality judgment; and the ability to lead across functions, cultures, and locations.
Bilingual English and Mandarin a plus, but not required.
Experience implementing process automation, advanced controls, or continuous manufacturing is desirable.
Experience with peptides or oligonucleotides and external technology partnerships are desirable.
Domestic and International Travel as required. Approximately 40%
Benefits:
Day 1 Coverage for Medical, Vision (Co. Paid), and Dental Insurance
Paid Life Insurance; Short-Term Disability (STD) & Long-Term Disability (LTD)
Paid Holidays, Vacation, Sick Time, and Maternity Leave
Matching 401K

jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.text:
Welcome to Destination Pet. We are One Pack- a united team working together to elevate the love and lives of pet families. Our pet-obsessed professionals create a connected care network of trustworthy partners who bring creative innovation every day. We are revolutionizing the pet industry. Join us!
Destination Pet is launching a new, PE-backed business unit focused on building a differentiated data platform for the pet health and pet services ecosystem.
This new business unit will collect, organize, analyze, and commercialize data related to dogs and cats through veterinary partners, pet care centers, boarding and daycare facilities, grooming locations, wellness providers, and other pet care channels.
We are seeking a Director of Data Science to help build the analytical foundation of this business from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to operate in a newly formed, high-growth business while benefiting from the backing, scale, and resources of an established, private-equity-backed platform.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on data science leader who can work with complex and fragmented data, build commercially valuable insights, and help turn pet health and pet care data into scalable products.
We are looking to add a Data Science Director to our team!
LOCATION: Remote US
TRAVEL:Less than 10%
REPORTS TO: Chief Executive Officer
PAY: $180 K -$210K + 20 %Bonus
Destination Pet does not provide any Visa Sponsorship.
Role Overview:
Destination Pet is launching a new, PE-backed business unit focused on building a differentiated data platform for the pet health and pet services ecosystem.
This new business unit will collect, organize, analyze, and commercialize data related to dogs and cats through veterinary partners, pet care centers, boarding and daycare facilities, grooming locations, wellness providers, and other pet care channels.
We are seeking a Director of Data Science to help build the analytical foundation of this business from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to operate in a newly formed, high-growth business while benefiting from the backing, scale, and resources of an established, private-equity-backed platform.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on data science leader who can work with complex and fragmented data, build commercially valuable insights, and help turn pet health and pet care data into scalable products.
CORE RESPONSIBILITES:
Help define and build the data science strategy for a newly formed pet health data business unit.
Analyze large, complex, and multi-source datasets related to pet health, veterinary care, pet services, customer behavior, and service utilization.
Build predictive models, segmentation models, forecasting tools, and other analytical solutions to identify trends, patterns, and commercial opportunities.
Partner with product, technology, commercial, operations, and executive stakeholders to identify data products and insights that can be monetized.
Support the development of data products that may be sold to external customers, partners, or industry stakeholders.
Work with internal and external data sources, including veterinary partners, pet care centers, customer systems, and third-party datasets.
Lead cross-functional efforts in data cleaning, normalization, deduplication, taxonomy creation, and quality control to ensure data integrity and support ongoing monitoring.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
Help establish best practices for responsible data use, privacy, governance, de-identification, and data quality.
Operate comfortably in an entrepreneurial environment where business models are still being developed.
Drive the creation of novel, statistically differentiated predictive models, supported by a strong track record in research and data science.
Help shape the future structure, tools, and capabilities of the data science function as the business scales.
REQUIREMENTS:
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Bioinformatics, or a related quantitative field.
6-10+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative role.
Strong proficiency in Python and/or R.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
Experience working with messy, fragmented, or multi-source data and turning it into usable analytical assets.
Demonstrated experience building predictive models, segmentation frameworks, forecasting models, machine learning models, or other advanced analytical solutions.
Strong understanding of data quality, feature engineering, statistical inference, experimentation, model validation, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to executive, commercial, product, and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfort working in a newly formed business, startup-like environment, or high-growth setting with ambiguity and evolving priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline.
Experience in a newly formed company, startup, venture-backed company, PE-backed company, or corporate incubation environment.
Experience building data products, commercial analytics products, data platforms, data marketplaces, or monetizable insight products.
Experience in healthcare, veterinary medicine, pet care, life sciences, insurance, consumer health, retail, marketplace businesses, or multi-site services.
Experience working with regulated, sensitive, privacy-conscious, or consumer data environments.
Familiarity with privacy-preserving analytics, de-identification, aggregation, consent frameworks, and responsible data-use practices.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar.
Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Sigma, or similar.
Experience partnering with product, engineering, commercial, legal, operations, and executive teams.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Builder mindset with the ability to create structure in an early-stage environment.
Commercially curious and interested in turning data into revenue-generating products.
Comfortable working hands-on while also helping define strategy and future team capabilities.
Strong business judgment and ability to prioritize the highest-value analytical opportunities.
Comfortable operating in a PE-backed environment with a focus on speed, accountability, value creation, and measurable outcomes.
Able to work independently in a fully remote environment while collaborating effectively across functions.
Passionate about the opportunity to transform pet health and pet care data into meaningful insights.
Skills
Data science and machine learning
Predictive modeling and statistical analysis
SQL, Python, and/or R
Data cleaning, normalization, and quality control
Data product development
Commercial analytics and data monetization
Executive-level storytelling and insight presentation
Privacy-aware and ethical data use
Cloud data platforms
Startup, new business unit, or PE-backed operating experience
Cross-functional collaboration
Why Join Us
Join at the ground floor of a newly formed, PE-backed business unit.
Help build a new data platform in the pet health and pet services ecosystem.
Work on a commercially meaningful opportunity with the potential to shape a new category of pet health intelligence.
Build the data science foundation, analytical roadmap, and future data products from the beginning.
Operate with startup-like agility while benefiting from the backing of an established platform.
Help turn fragmented pet care data into insights, products, and long-term enterprise value.
PERKS:
Health, vision, dental, long & short-term disability, and Life insurance
A Startup mentality company with stable funding
401k match
Pet Care discounts
Flexible Time Off
Opportunity to grow your career with a network of like-minded professionals
Destination Pet LLC affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled.
Destination Pet LLC endeavors to make our employment website and application process accessible to all users and applicants. In doing so, we provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation or assistance completing the application process, please contact a member of our recruitment team.
At Destination Pet, we're all about creating a workplace that's bursting with diversity and inclusivity. We don't play favorites or judge folks based on skin color, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristics. Our hiring decisions are solely based on what you can bring to the team. So, we're throwing the door wide open for all like-minded candidates who believe in celebrating and honoring diversity and inclusion. Ready to join our pack?

jobs.text:
We are a leading global asset management firm with over 3,000 employees across 20 offices in 15 countries; we help millions of investors around the world pursue their financial goals.
We hire critical thinkers. People who thrive in a collaborative culture like ours where we solve real problems while building the future of finance.
You
Are excited to be part of a vibrant engineering community that values diversity, hard work, and continuous learning.
Love solving complex real-world business problems.
Recognize that cross-functional collaboration is a core component of success for the team.
Believe there are multiple ways to solve most technical problems and are willing to debate the trade-offs.
Have become a stronger engineer by making mistakes and learning from them.
Are a doer, someone who wants to grow their career and gain experience across technologies and business functions.
We
Continuously invest in a high-performance and inclusive culture, in which a diversity of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints are celebrated and valued.
Encourage career mobility, so you can benefit from learning different functions and technologies, and we gain the benefits of your experience across teams.
Run technology pro bono programs that help the non-profit community and give our engineering community opportunities to volunteer and participate.
Offer education reimbursements and ongoing training in technology, communication, and diversity & inclusion.
Embrace knowledge sharing through lunch-and-learns, demos, and technical forums.
Consider our people to be our greatest asset—we will help you learn what PIMCO Technology has to offer so you can participate in activities that benefit your career while delivering impactful technology solutions.
We are seeking a VPlevel Senior Software Developer to lead development and implementation of analytics tools and APIs for quants and portfolio managers.
You will provide technical leadership while remaining handson: design, build, test, and deploy scalable frontend UIs, highperformance backend services, and APIs; translate quant and portfoliomanager requirements into technical designs; collaborate with engineering, quant teams, and portfolio managers to define scope and priorities; own delivery, production reliability, and incident response; and mentor peers.
Required Experience
Strong Python proficiency, advanced SQL for complex data analysis, 10+ years of software engineering experience delivering production systems, and experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
Familiarity with quantitative workflows or direct experience working with quant teams is required.
Preferred: distributed systems or largescale data processing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD. Frontend JavaScript experience is a plus.
The role requires clear communication, results orientation, and willingness to take on multiple roles to deliver solutions under time pressure.
Technical Skills/Qualifications
BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or related technical field.
10+ years of hands-on software development experience.
Strong Python Proficiency is essential.
Strong Pandas and SQL proficiency is essential.
Familiarity with distributed systems, large scale data processing, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) a plus.
Front end development experience a plus.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) is a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Digital Product & Technology
jobs.text:
Antenna Group is a leading international content, media and entertainment organization, owning and operating a diverse portfolio of global media assets across a variety of platforms: Television, Pay TV, OTT, Radio, Cinema Exhibition, Digital, Music, Publishing and Education, throughout Europe, North America and Australia. Antenna Group is currently seeking, to cover the following position:
Head of Digital Product & Technology
About the Role
The Digital Product & Technology Manager is a senior, hands-on role responsible for the technical performance, reliability and continuous evolution of ANTENNA Group’s digital products.
The role goes beyond technical operations and platform stability. It combines strong technical expertise with a product-oriented mindset, translating business and product requirements into practical technical solutions and ensuring their successful implementation.
Working closely with Product, Editorial, Audience & Growth, SEO, Development and external technology partners, the role will help deliver new digital capabilities, integrations and user-facing products across ANTENNA’s digital ecosystem.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable troubleshooting a critical platform issue, evaluating a third-party technology, designing the technical approach for a new digital feature and working with Product teams to bring a new idea into production.
Job Description
Digital Product Implementation & Development
Work closely with the Product Manager to translate product requirements into technical specifications, implementation plans and production-ready solutions.
Lead or coordinate the technical implementation of new digital products, features and services across ANTENNA’s digital properties.
Support the implementation of products and features such as newsletters, registration and login systems, commenting platforms, web push notifications, personalization, recommendation engines, gamification mechanics, live scores and other interactive services.
Design the technical approach for new features, identifying required APIs, integrations, CMS capabilities, data flows and third-party services.
Assess whether solutions should be developed internally, implemented through existing platform capabilities or delivered through external technology providers.
Manage technical testing, QA, deployment and post-launch monitoring of new products and features.
Identify dependencies, technical risks and scalability requirements early in the product development process.
Technology Scouting & Product Innovation
Continuously research emerging technologies, tools and digital product solutions relevant to media and publishing.
Monitor international publishers and digital platforms to identify new features, technologies and implementation approaches that could be relevant to ANTENNA.
Proactively propose technology-driven product improvements and new capabilities.
Research and evaluate potential technology providers for services such as AI-powered audio/text-to-speech, personalization, commenting, live data, sports data, recommendation systems and audience engagement tools.
Run technical evaluations and Proofs of Concept (PoCs) before recommending new technologies or vendors.
Maintain awareness of developments in AI and automation that could improve editorial workflows, content distribution and user experience.
SEO, Performance & Growth Technology
Work closely with SEO, Performance and Audience & Growth teams to ensure that technical implementation supports audience and business objectives.
Conduct technical reviews related to site speed, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexation, structured data and overall technical SEO.
Support the implementation and technical validation of analytics, attribution, consent, audience measurement and experimentation tools.
Identify technical improvements that can increase discoverability, engagement, retention and conversion.
Ensure new features and third-party integrations do not negatively affect site performance, SEO, privacy or user experience.
Platform & Technical Operations
Own the availability, performance and stability of ANTENNA’s digital properties.
Coordinate incident management, rapid resolution and post-incident analysis.
Ensure platforms can scale effectively during major news events, live broadcasts and traffic spikes.
Oversee technical monitoring, alerting and performance measurement across digital services.
Coordinate deployments, platform updates and technical changes with internal and external development teams.
Ensure appropriate disaster recovery, security and business continuity processes are in place.
Streaming & Content Delivery
Manage and continuously improve live-streaming and video delivery operations for ANTENNA digital properties.
Collaborate with broadcast engineering and technology teams to integrate digital and traditional broadcast workflows.
Monitor video quality and delivery performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate streaming technologies, CDN solutions and video-related technology partners.
Vendor & Technology Partner Management
Act as a key technical point of contact for technology vendors, development partners and third-party platforms.
Translate business and product needs into clear technical requirements for external providers.
Evaluate vendor solutions from a technical, operational, performance and integration perspective.
Challenge vendor proposals and validate recommended architectures and implementation approaches.
Coordinate technical onboarding and integration of new services.
Work with Product, Procurement and Legal teams on vendor selection, contracts, SLAs and renewals.
Monitor vendor performance and manage technical escalations when required.
Security, Compliance & Data
Ensure digital implementations comply with GDPR and relevant data protection requirements.
Work with relevant teams on consent management, security, access control and data governance.
Ensure third-party integrations meet ANTENNA’s security, privacy and performance standards.
Support vulnerability management, security patching and disaster recovery planning.
Reporting & Cost Governance
Monitor technical KPIs, platform performance and service availability.
Provide clear reporting on technical performance, risks, incidents and development priorities.
Evaluate infrastructure, SaaS, API and third-party technology costs and identify opportunities for optimization.
Support technical and commercial assessment of new technology investments.

jobs.title: Head of Electrical Engineering - RES & Substation O&M
jobs.text:
TERNA ENERGY, a member of the MASDAR Group, is seeking:
Head of Electrical Engineering - RES & Substation O&M
Role Overview
The Head of Electrical Engineering – RES & Substation O&M leads and oversees the electrical engineering activities across RES and energy substation facilities, ensuring their safe, reliable and efficient operation. The role focuses on maintenance effectiveness, fault analysis, asset performance optimization and the coordination of technical teams and external partners.
Key Responsibilities
Coordinate and supervise the Operation & Maintenance (O&M) activities of renewable energy facilities and substations in Evia.
Monitor the day-to-day operation and performance of the assets under responsibility.
Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of electrical faults and failures, identify underlying causes and recommend appropriate corrective and improvement actions.
Oversee the planning and execution of preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance activities.
Develop technical guidelines and recommendations for additional inspections and controls resulting from fault analyses and operational findings.
Coordinate the activities of contractors and suppliers and monitor the fulfilment of their contractual obligations.
Ensure the safety of facilities, personnel and maintenance activities.
Ensure the proper implementation of the Company's Quality, Environmental, and Health & Safety Management Systems.
Communicate and collaborate effectively with relevant stakeholders, including technical consultants, local public authorities and other external parties.
Work closely with other Company departments and functions, including Licensing, Insurance, Energy Resource Management and Construction, as required.
Support the technical development and training of newly hired electrical engineers.
Candidate Profile
University degree in Electrical Engineering.
At least 3 years of professional experience in maintenance organization, including planning, scheduling and execution, as well as maintenance schedule optimization, with a focus on cost control and optimal operational performance.
Relevant professional experience in the energy sector or a comparable heavy industrial environment.
Valid authorization/license for the operation and handling of Medium Voltage (MV) / High Voltage (HV) electrical installations.
Knowledge of protection systems for MV and HV electrical networks.
Knowledge and experience in analyzing operational data from Historian databases and SCADA systems.
Knowledge of PLC and SCADA programming, electrical panel design using EPLAN, and ERP systems such as SAP will be considered a strong asset.
Very good command of English, both written and spoken, including technical terminology.
Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of the technical and operational requirements of the role.
Ability to take initiative, identify issues and drive solutions.
Strong communication and negotiation skills.
Demonstrated team management and leadership experience.
Results-oriented mindset, with persistence and a structured approach to achieving objectives.
Ability to perform effectively under pressure and within demanding deadlines.
Flexibility and adaptability to evolving operational and technical requirements.
Ability to develop and implement appropriate action plans.
Strong project organization and coordination skills, including team coordination, task allocation, scheduling and progress monitoring.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
jobs.text:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap—encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability—while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform—ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.
As a Director of Engineering, Data Products, you will:
Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.
Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.
Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.
Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.
Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards.
Success in this role looks like:
Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.
Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.
Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities
Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.

You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).
Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments.
Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.
Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.
Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.
Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.
Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.

Proven track record of directly hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering managers, Tech Leads (TLs), and Principal Engineers (PELs).
Demonstrated ability to cultivate a high-performance engineering culture focused on velocity, quality, and psychological safety.
Experience leading organizational change, including structural re-orgs and process evolution.
Strong proficiency in strategic resource allocation, capacity planning, and managing technical debt in a fast-paced product environment.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, actionable business strategies (e.g., impact on HEDIS/RADV outcomes) for non-technical leadership.

Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.

Reimbursement for office setup expenses
Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
Paid parental leave for all new parents
And much more!

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.text:
This is a remote position.
We invite you to join our team in making this mission a reality for our students as ourDIRECTOR OF TECHNOLOGY. The Director of Technology is responsible for leading the technology team whose primary focus is to develop and enact a mission-aligned VPA technology vision in collaboration with members of our VPA community from faculty, staff, administration, parents, and students.
SPECIFIC DUTIES
IT Operations
Oversee and evaluate the deployment of all hardware, software, and systems from various perspectives, including cost-effectiveness; customer satisfaction; compliance; asset management; migration, rollout, and transition; and performance
Develop and implement the department budget; evaluate internal IT systems for performance, efficiency, and customer satisfaction; and oversee and manage all accounts, contracts and financial issues related to the department
Ensure IT data security, risk management, disaster recovery and planning processes are in place and receive regular review for currency and adequacy
Data / Systems
Oversee the maintenance and reliability of the school's enterprise data / systems environment, including major systems such as: SIS, LMS, CMS, financial and accounting, and advancement
Work with senior leadership and various operational and academic departments to ensure they have the necessary access to, and reporting of, data
Coordinate technology projects with other departments and outside entities
Serve as the school's primary project manager for enterprise-wide data transitions
Leadership and Strategy
Oversee the hiring, supervision, evaluation and growth of all technology staff, and ensure that the department structure supports the school’s needs and goals
Develop and maintain strategic and operational plans for technology that are aligned with departmental needs, school values, and organizational culture
Lead and direct IT governance, planning, policy development, and procedures, including those for architecture, security, disaster recovery, standards, purchasing hardware and software deployment, and service provision
Anticipate the needs of diverse constituents, monitoring trends and innovations in the industry and making actionable recommendations
Requirements
Professional Qualifications:
A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is a minimum requirement, though a graduate degree is highly desirable
Prior enterprise technology leadership experience, preferably in a school
Leadership and Personal Qualities:
Extensive technical knowledge in areas of IT security, network components, computer operating systems, protocols and standards
Excellent budgeting skills with the ability to plan strategically and cost-effectively and prioritize resources
Proven supervisory and staff development skills, coupled with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of constituents in a diverse community
Inspirational, pragmatic, diplomatic and patient leadership
An enjoyment from working in a youth-centered academic environment
Flexibility, creativity, and sense of humor
Benefits
Vanguard Preparatory Academy offers a competitive salary and excellent benefit package. Offers are contingent upon successfully passing required background checks.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
About Upstart
At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.
As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.
We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.
If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
The Team:
Upstart’s Data Platform organization builds and operates the data infrastructure and platforms that enable teams across the company to move, store, and use data reliably. The organization currently includes Database Engineering, Data Capture, Data Curation, and Production Experience & Data Governance, with approximately 35 people and 4 managers.
This is a platform-focused organization: the team builds the infrastructure and tooling that enable engineering teams to build and own their own data pipelines rather than embedding data engineers directly within product teams. Data is foundational to how Upstart operates, making this organization an important partner across Engineering, Analytics, Analytics Engineering, and Machine Learning Platform.
As the Senior Director of Data Platform Engineering, you will lead this organization and set the strategy for Upstart’s data infrastructure. For a Senior Director-level hire, the scope may expand to include Analytics Engineering, bringing the organization to approximately 50 people and five direct reports.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead and evolve Upstart’s data platform organization, including Database Engineering, Data Capture, Data Curation, and Production Experience & Data Governance, building platforms and tooling that enable engineering teams to develop and manage reliable data pipelines.
Set the strategy and roadmap for Upstart’s data infrastructure, developing deep context on business and technical priorities and translating that context into high-impact infrastructure investments.
Modernize Upstart’s operational data architecture, partnering with engineering teams to simplify systems, improve reliability and data quality, and reduce technical debt.
Develop engineering leaders and teams, establishing clear ownership, operating practices, and technical standards across the data platform organization.
Partner across Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Engineering, and Machine Learning Platform to understand shared needs, establish priorities, and evolve Upstart’s data ecosystem.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of direct people management experience.
Experience leading a data engineering or data platform organization, including managing managers and multiple engineering teams.
Experience leading the development and operation of shared data platforms or infrastructure that enable engineering teams to build and manage their own data pipelines.
Experience owning strategy and technical roadmaps for large-scale data infrastructure, database platforms, or distributed data systems.
Experience leading data infrastructure modernization, architecture evolution, or technical-debt reduction in a production environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Knowledge of database engineering, data governance, data quality, and operational data architecture.
Experience partnering with or leading an Analytics Engineering function.
Experience working in a regulated or data-intensive industry, such as financial services or lending.
Ability to connect data infrastructure investments to business priorities and translate needs across technical and non-technical partners.
Experience leading organizations through changes in data architecture, operating models, or platform ownership.
Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote
Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.
Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.
At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).
United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$261,000—$357,200 USD
What you'll love
At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:
Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City
For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.
Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.
If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email

jobs.title: SVP AI Engineering
jobs.text:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
Certified as a Great Place to Work®
Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance
VP AI Engineering
Job Responsibilities
Define and execute the enterprise AI engineering strategy aligned to Sedgwick’s claims, risk, and client service transformation goals.
Lead the architecture, development, and deployment of applied AI and agentic AI solutions across global operations.
Build and scale a high-performing AI engineering organization, including Applied AI Engineers, Agentic AI Engineers, ML Engineers, and AI Platform teams.
Establish standards for LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent orchestration, workflow automation, and model lifecycle management.
Oversee the design of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems that support claims intake, coverage analysis, fraud detection, compliance review, and operational optimization.
Drive enterprise architecture decisions for AI platforms, including model hosting, orchestration layers, vector databases, evaluation frameworks, and observability tooling.
Ensure scalable, secure integration of AI systems with claims platforms, policy systems, document repositories, and enterprise data environments.
Define and enforce engineering best practices for prompt engineering, tool use, memory design, guardrails, structured outputs, and deterministic validation.
Establish governance frameworks for Responsible AI, explainability, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
Partner with cybersecurity, legal, compliance, and data governance teams to mitigate AI-related operational and regulatory risks.
Develop robust evaluation and benchmarking methodologies to measure reasoning quality, workflow completion rates, hallucination risk, and system reliability.
Oversee AI production operations including performance monitoring, drift detection, cost management, and service reliability.
Translate executive-level business priorities into scalable AI platform capabilities and delivery roadmaps.
Collaborate with Claims Operations, IT, Digital, and Product teams to identify high-impact AI use cases and drive measurable ROI.
Lead build-versus-buy decisions for AI tooling, foundation models, orchestration frameworks, and enterprise integrations.
Manage vendor relationships related to AI platforms, cloud providers, and model providers.
Drive adoption of AI solutions across adjusters, supervisors, and client-facing teams through strong partnership and change management alignment.
Mentor engineering leaders and establish a strong culture of technical excellence, innovation, and operational discipline.
Present AI strategy, progress, risks, and outcomes to executive leadership and board-level stakeholders.
Develop long-term AI capability roadmaps that position Sedgwick as a technology leader in claims and risk management.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or platform architecture.
5+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing technical teams.
Demonstrated experience deploying LLM-powered systems and agentic AI solutions in enterprise environments.
Deep expertise in RAG architectures, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and workflow automation systems.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and microservices design.
Experience building secure integrations with enterprise systems and legacy platforms.
Proven ability to design and implement AI governance, auditability, and Responsible AI frameworks.
Experience operating in regulated industries such as insurance, healthcare, or financial services preferred.
Strong financial and operational acumen with the ability to manage budgets and measure ROI.
Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical executives and business stakeholders.
Demonstrated track record of delivering large-scale, production AI systems with measurable business impact.
Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive alignment across cross-functional enterprise teams.
Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: VP Product Management, Teaching and Learning (OnCourse)
jobs.text:
Clarivate is seeking a Vice President, Teaching & Learning to shape and scale onCourse, our AI-native platform designed to help higher education institutions transform teaching, learning, curriculum intelligence, and student success. This is a high-impact opportunity for a product-led, commercially minded executive to build a new growth business by pairing deep higher education market expertise with Clarivate’s trusted university relationships, differentiated content and data assets, global commercial reach, and scale.
About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments
10+ years of leadership experience in higher education technology, enterprise edtech, digital learning, curriculum technology, SaaS, or a closely related market.
5+ years of experience leading product management, product strategy, business unit, or general management functions.
Demonstrated experience launching, building, repositioning, or scaling a software product, product line, platform, or new venture.
Experience owning or contributing to product strategy, roadmap prioritization, pricing, go-to-market planning, pipeline development, or sales enablement.
Experience working directly with higher education institutions, university leaders, enterprise customers, strategic partners, design partners, or early adopters.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across product management, product marketing, sales, technology, finance, operations, or customer-facing functions.
It would be great if you also have . . .
Business-unit, general management, founder, or startup leadership experience.
Experience taking a business from early validation to meaningful commercial scale.
Familiarity with AI-enabled teaching and learning, curriculum intelligence, learning analytics, or emerging education platforms.
Strong understanding of institutional buying, enterprise sales cycles, customer adoption, implementation realities, and commercial execution.
Established relationships and credibility across the higher education market, including a network of institutional leaders, partners, influencers, or potential early adopters.
Ability to influence investment decisions, align senior stakeholders, and communicate clearly with executives, customers, partners, and internal teams.
What will you be doing in this role?
Own the business strategy, product direction, market development, commercialization, customer adoption, and revenue growth for onCourse and related Teaching & Learning opportunities.
Define market focus, customer segments, value proposition, growth model, investment priorities, and the path from launch to repeatable adoption and revenue scale.
Set product vision and roadmap priorities in partnership with Technology, grounded in customer needs, market opportunity, and commercial goals.
Lead customer discovery, design partner engagement, and product-market fit validation to focus on capabilities that drive adoption.
Own the revenue plan, go-to-market approach, pricing, pipeline strategy, and sales enablement model in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Technology.
Develop executive relationships with universities, design partners, early adopters, and strategic prospects to accelerate validation, pipeline creation, and market credibility.
Drive pipeline creation, deal progression, customer conversion, and predictable commercial performance.
Lead an integrated team across sales, product management, and product marketing while partnering closely with technology, content, AI, finance, and operations.
Align senior leaders around the business case, market opportunity, investment needs, and path to growth.
About the Team
The Teaching & Learning business is focused on creating AI-powered solutions that help higher education institutions improve teaching, learning, curriculum intelligence, adoption, and student success. This role will work closely with leaders and teams across product management, product marketing, sales, technology, content, AI, finance, and operations to bring onCourse and related opportunities to market.
Hours of Work
This is a full-time position, primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to adjust to various global time zones as needed. Work arrangement and office expectations should be confirmed based on the approved posting location.
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

jobs.title: VP, Enterprise Product Management - Enterprise Integration & Platform Modernizat
jobs.text:
Position Location: Remote Nationwide
Position Purpose:
Product Portfolio: Enterprise Integration & Common Core Platforms
This executive will lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Centene's Common Core platform portfolio, providing the foundational capabilities that enable enterprise modernization, operational visibility, and system interoperability. The role is accountable for establishing enterprise integration standards, standardized data models, event-driven architectures, observability capabilities, and reusable platform services that connect fragmented systems and simplify operations. Working across business, operations, technology, and data organizations, this leader will accelerate system modernization, improve traceability and reconciliation, reduce integration complexity, and create the foundation required for future platform consolidation and enterprise transformation. Success will be measured through improved operational transparency, reduced manual effort, faster business change adoption, and increased enterprise agility.
Establishes and maintains enterprise-wide product vision aligned to corporate strategy.
Defines multi-year transformation roadmaps across interconnected products, experiences, and capabilities.
Prioritizes investments that maximize enterprise value and strategic differentiation.
Drives alignment across business units, markets, and corporate functions.
Develops clear business cases and value realization plans for transformational initiatives.
Establishes enterprise product management standards spanning discovery, product definition, requirements, prioritization, delivery, release, adoption, performance measurement, optimization, and lifecycle management
Owns the integrated dependency map and sequencing across structural products, enabled initiatives, lines of business, data capabilities, platforms, and enterprise architecture.
Owns end-to-end outcomes across complex customer and business journeys.
Leads redesign of enterprise capabilities through integration of: People, Process, Technology, Data, Governance, and Performance management
Chairs cross-functional governance forums to resolve competing priorities across organizations while maintaining focus on enterprise value creation.
Partners with technology to establish and maintain an integrated delivery roadmap, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resourcing assumptions, acceptance criteria, and release plans.
Holds business and technology partners accountable for execution against approved requirements, scope, milestones, quality standards, dependencies, and intended business outcomes.
Maintains accountability beyond implementation through stabilization, optimization, ongoing product performance, support-model readiness, lifecycle management, and value realization.
Serves as the accountable business counterpart to Tech Product Owners and technology delivery leaders across the product lifecycle.
Translates business strategy, user needs, operational requirements, and regulatory obligations into clear, prioritized, and testable product requirements and business acceptance criteria.
Leads enterprise adoption and operational readiness efforts so that delivered capabilities are embedded within day-to-day operations and produce intended business outcomes.
Travel up to 25%
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.
Education/Experience:
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 10+ years experience in leading large-scale transformation initiatives and enterprise product management.
Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.
Pay Range: $207,000.00 - $392,100.00 per year
At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.
Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.
Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act
