jobs.title: Head of Technology - LA
jobs.text:
Head of Technology (Full‑Time, Remote) (LA)
About the Company
We’re CatchCo, makers of Mystery Tackle Box — the original fishing subscription box since 2012. Our mission is to Rescue Humanity From the Indoors. Today, we help millions get outside with products sold at Walmart, Dick’s Sporting Goods, Amazon, and direct-to-consumer. We’ve moved past the venture-backed hype and are now under new ownership, building a lean, profitable, and lasting business. If you believe in getting people outdoors and doing work that matters, you’ll fit right in.
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Head of Technology to lead our systems and technology execution for our fully remote organization. This role is ideal for a tech leader who can bridge high-level strategy with hands-on work, driving both day-to-day development and big-picture architecture. We don’t expect anyone to be experienced with all of the systems in our tech stack. Instead, this role is a fit for someone who is never intimidated by new tools or technologies.
Our company’s platform is in the midst of exciting changes – phasing out legacy systems, implementing a new ERP, and leveraging AI (LLMs) as force-multipliers for our team's productivity. If you are passionate about the technology powering commerce, and pushing into the AI era, we'd love to hear from you.
As the Head of Technology, you will be the technical anchor and strategic driver for the company. This means balancing leadership with hands-on contribution. On any given day you might review pull requests, troubleshoot a critical bug, or write a small feature alongside the team. At the same time, you'll set the architectural vision, plan large-scale system improvements, and make key decisions to align technology with business goals. You will coordinate among colleagues, developers and vendor teams to execute projects, ensuring everyone is working towards cohesive goals. This role involves significant cross-functional collaboration – working with management, marketing, operations, and other departments – to deliver technology initiatives smoothly in a remote environment.
Our Tech Stack & Environment
Platform: Proprietary Order Management System built on .NET 6 (C#) application using ASP.NET Core, with patterns like MediatR and data access via Entity Framework Core and Dapper.
Cloud Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure – heavy use of Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Blob Storage, and Azure SQL Database for scalable, serverless processing.
Messaging: RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus powering our event-driven architecture and inter-service communication.
Integrations: Shopify (with Recharge for subscriptions), QuickBooks (finance), Extensiv WMS for warehouse management, and SPS Commerce (EDI) – ensuring smooth data flow across e-commerce, accounting, and fulfillment.
Data & Analytics: Snowflake as our data warehouse, fed by Fivetran/Stitch pipelines; transformations managed in dbt; reporting and analytics via Looker.
Marketing Tech: Klaviyo for customer engagement and marketing automation. Google GTM, Elevar, and other tools of consumer web and ad tech.
AI & Automation: We aggressively embrace AI tools (especially modern large language models) to automate workflows and enhance developer productivity.
Key Initiatives
Legacy Modernization: Lead the effort to retire or refactor legacy systems and transition to a more streamlined, modern architecture that improves reliability and scalability.
ERP Implementation: Oversee the successful integration of a new ERP system into our tech ecosystem, aligning it with existing platforms and ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
AI Integration: Champion the use of AI/LLM-based solutions to improve personal and team productivity, from automating routine tasks to enabling smarter decision-making in our applications and workflows.
Scalability & Performance: Continuously evaluate and enhance system performance, ensuring our platform and infrastructure can scale with a growing user base and data volume.
Core responsibilities
Technical Leadership: Own the overall technology strategy and system architecture. Define and enforce best practices in software design, code quality, and DevOps, ensuring our .NET/Azure-based platform remains robust and maintainable.
Hands-On Development: Contribute to development tasks when needed – from coding and code reviews to debugging and performance tuning. Stay involved in the technical work to lead by example and to support the team on complex issues.
Project Management: Lead the planning and delivery of major technical projects, such as the ERP implementation and other high-impact initiatives. Break down big projects into achievable milestones and drive them to completion on schedule.
Team Coordination: Manage and coordinate a distributed team of developers, including external freelancers and vendors. Mentor engineers, remove blockers, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
System Integrations: Oversee the design and maintenance of integrations between our platform and external systems (e.g. Shopify, QuickBooks, WMS), ensuring data flows reliably and securely across all parts of the business.
Cloud Operations: Ensure our Azure cloud infrastructure is well-architected and cost-efficient. Oversee deployments, monitor system health, and guide the team in leveraging Azure services (Functions, Service Bus, etc.) optimally.
Innovation & AI Enablement: Stay curious and forward-looking in evaluating new technologies. Experiment with and implement tools (especially AI/LLM-driven solutions) that can improve our workflow or product capabilities. Encourage the team to adopt automation and AI where it can make us faster or more effective.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with other departments (e.g. Product, Finance, Operations, Marketing) to align technology deliverables with business needs. Translate technical plans and progress into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders.
What makes you the right fit
We are not expecting a candidate to know it all. We are looking for the candidate that is excited to come in, make sense of it all, and use all available resources to take our tech stack to the next generation, simplifying wherever possible. Attitude trumps experience with any of these specific technologies.
AI Enthusiasm: Highly curious and quick to learn new tools. Excited about the potential of AI and LLMs, and fearless in experimenting with them to improve processes and productivity.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Capable of diving into the details to debug issues, as well as stepping back to plan strategically.
.NET Experience: Proven expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem (we use .NET 6 and ASP.NET Core). You have designed and built complex applications in .NET and stay up-to-date with the latest frameworks and best practices.
Azure Cloud Mastery: Hands-on experience deploying and running applications on Microsoft Azure. Proficient with serverless components like Azure Functions, event/messaging services like Service Bus, and managing Azure SQL databases and storage.
Systems Integration Skills: Strong background in integrating systems and designing APIs. Experience connecting cloud services, third-party platforms, and internal applications in a secure, scalable way.
Architecture & Design: Ability to architect scalable, maintainable software systems. Familiarity with patterns like CQRS/mediator (MediatR) and ORM/SQL tools (Entity Framework Core, Dapper) for efficient data access.
Data & Analytics Orientation: Understanding of modern data pipelines and analytics platforms. Exposure to tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran/Stitch, dbt, or Looker is a plus.
Leadership & Execution: Demonstrated success in a technical leadership role (e.g. Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, Head of Technology) managing software teams and delivering complex projects. You are execution-oriented and can drive multiple initiatives to completion.
Remote Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable leading and coordinating work across a remote, cross-functional team. Able to keep stakeholders informed and projects on track in a distributed environment.
Education: Practical experience is most highly valued. BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field is preferred.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands atsaas.group.
Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within thesaas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike.
Profile Overview
Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find.
To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter.
This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way.
You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources fromsaas.group's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you.
So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries.
We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies.
Your responsibilities
Technology Vision and Strategy:
Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces.
Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend.
Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting.
Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market.
Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability.
Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team.
Security and Compliance:
Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible.
Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure.
Team Management and Growth:
Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here.
Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them.
Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization.
Execution and Delivery:
Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence.
Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems.
Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows.
Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands.
Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management:
Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board.
Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs.
Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth.
Ownership & Autonomy:
Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships.
Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made.
Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement.
What You bring to the table
10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company.
Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned.
Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity, with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume.
Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation.
A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick.
A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed.
Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility.
Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else.
Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing.
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings.
Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously.
Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across thesaas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise.
Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to.
Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources.
Prerender is part ofsaas.group, and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
SWIVEL is seeking a talented individual to serve as Director of Product Management. This person is responsible for defining and executing product strategy, driving product performance, and leading a team of Product Managers and a Product Designer. This role owns the success of one or more product portfolios, balancing long-term strategic direction with hands-on product leadership and execution.
The Director is accountable for delivering customer value, revenue growth, market competitiveness, adoption, pricing and monetization strategies, and go-to-market readiness. The role leads a team of four to five individuals and may oversee supporting functions including Competitive Intelligence, Market Research, and Product Commercialization.
Working closely with Executive Leadership, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Legal, and Compliance, the Director ensures that product investments align with company objectives and market opportunities while driving measurable business outcomes.
Why you'll love this role:
As Director of Product Management, you will help shape the future of SWIVEL's product portfolio while leading a talented team of product professionals. You will influence company strategy, drive customer and commercial outcomes, and own products from concept through commercialization. This role is ideal for a product leader who enjoys balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution and believes product success is measured not only by what is built, but by the business and customer value it delivers.
Essential duties include the following:
Defines and owns the strategic direction, vision, and multi-year roadmap for assigned product portfolios.
Identifies market opportunities, competitive threats, customer needs, and emerging industry trends to inform investment decisions.
Partners with Director of Technical Product Management and Executive Leadership to align product strategy with company objectives, financial targets, and growth initiatives.
Establishes portfolio priorities and makes investment tradeoff decisions across competing opportunities.
Ensures product roadmaps are aligned with customer value, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and strategic objectives.
Owns product business outcomes, including revenue growth, adoption, retention, customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share.
Develops and refines pricing, packaging, monetization, and commercialization strategies.
Partners with Finance and Executive Leadership on business cases, product investments, and return-on-investment analysis.

jobs.title: VP, Engineering
jobs.text:
TL;DR
Fast-growing measurement company looking to fill a newly created VP of Engineering role. This person will own software and infrastructure development for all products and services that enable the AU and support our clients. We have an engineering team of 10 that is fully remote and spans across media measurement, web application production and support, data pipelines, ML model application, and cloud ops. Our engineering is vital and a key component that links data science, product, client services and sales all together.
Who we are
Adelaide is the leader in one of the fastest-growing areas of advertising: attention measurement and activation.
Since 2020, we've become the trusted media quality measurement partner for 40% of Fortune 50 brands who rely on our award-winning AU metric to plan smarter campaigns, invest in high-quality inventory, and dive stronger business outcomes. Adweek has called Adelaide's AU "the attention economy's most widely recognized metric," and AdExchanger named it "Best measurement/Analytics Capability."
Our business continues to scale rapidly, outperforming the industry with a 35% three-year CAGR. What began as a 9-person startup in 2019 is now a team of more than 75.
The past year brought meaningful expansion. We launched the AU ecosystem, giving brands, media agencies, and publishers a unified way to leverage and transact on AU. We broadened our programmatic footprint with custom bidding in GoogleDV360 and pre-bid targeting in The Trade Desk, and grew our partner roster to over 125 platforms and publishers. Leading brands like Dell, Diageo, an Jaguar Land Rover—along with premium publishers such as Hearst, Spotify, and The New York Times—continue to demonstrate AU's value across the media lifecycle.
Adelaide is backed by prominent investors such as Human Ventures (Joe Marchese), Aperiam Ventures (Joe Zawadzki & Eric Franchi), WGI (Jonah Goodhart), and Irwin Gotlieb.
We have a NYC office and a London WeWork, but operates as a remote-friendly company with flexible work options.
How we work
We're a team of action-oriented doers—management rolls up their sleeves and contributes every day. Our culture is rooted in curiosity and rigor: opinions are held lightly, debated openly, and strengthened through testing. Everyone is encouraged to play a role in shaping planning and strategy.
We're built on belonging and growth—94% of employees report a strong sense of belonging, and 81% say they’re happy at work.
Position overview
This position reports to the CEO and is responsible for leading Adelaide's engineering function—setting technical direction, scaling the infrastructure and platforms behind AU, and building the team that ships it.
In this role, you'll own the engineering strategy and day-to-day delivery while partnering closely with Product, Data Science, and the executive team to translate company goals into shipped systems. You'll be equally comfortable operating at the architecture level and in the details—Adelaide rewards leaders who can take an idea from conception to production without hand-offs getting in the way.
Day-to-day activities range from setting engineering strategy alongside the executive team, owning the roadmap and delivery cadence, architecting data and application infrastructure, managing and mentoring engineering managers, recruiting senior talent, and ensuring the systems behind AU meet the reliability and quality standards our clients expect.
We're seeking a candidate with 10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including multiple years leading teams in high-growth environments. We're looking for someone who can operate as an end-to-end owner—setting the plan, shipping the work, and recruiting the people who will do the same.
This is a fully remote role within the United States, with opportunities to connect with colleagues at our New York office. You'll need to be in NYC a few times per year.
Compensation
Base + Bonus: $300,000+
This role includes a competitive compensation package consisting of base salary, performance-based bonus, and equity. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, level, and location.
What you'll learn
An important part of our culture is continuous learning and the open sharing of ideas. We offer:
Access to a broad network of investors and advisors who can help you and your team succeed
Mentorship from executives with decades of experience in adtech and media
Regular internal knowledge-sharing sessions
An education budget to support ongoing professional growth and development
In this role you'll learn:
The economics and architecture behind attention-based media measurement
How executive teams use technical decisions to drive strategy, growth, and competitive advantage
Best practices for building durable engineering foundations in a scaling startup
How a high-growth adtech company scales its engineering organization and technical infrastructure
Core responsibilities
Engineering Strategy & Leadership
Develop and execute Adelaide's engineering strategy aligned with company objectives
Provide technical insights and strategic recommendations to the executive team
Lead and mentor the engineering function while building a high-ownership, high-performance culture
Act as an end-to-end owner — take technical initiatives from concept to shipped outcome without requiring oversight to move
Architecture & Infrastructure
Own the architecture of Adelaide's data infrastructure, measurement platforms, and application systems
Maintain the fidelity, efficiency, and scalability of the systems behind AU
Ensure infrastructure decisions balance speed, cost, and long-term durability
Roadmap & Delivery
Own the engineering roadmap and delivery cadence in partnership with Product and the executive team
Translate company goals into shipped systems on predictable timelines
Drive prioritization tradeoffs and resourcing decisions across engineering teams
Team Building & Talent
Recruit, mentor, and retain a high-performing engineering team — including other end-to-end owners who will drive initiatives independently
Develop engineering managers and senior ICs, and create clear paths for growth
Build a culture of ownership, craft, and accountability across the function
Operational Excellence
Maintain Adelaide codebases and software to a high standard of quality, security, and reliability
Own production system health, on-call posture, and incident response
Establish engineering practices that scale — review, testing, deployment, and observability
Cross-functional Partnership
Partner with Product, Data Science, Research, and Customer Success to ship features that drive AU adoption and renewal
Serve as a key technical voice with the executive team and, where relevant, the Board of Directors
Represent engineering to customers, partners, and the market when needed
What you'll bring
10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including leadership of engineering teams
Proven ability to take initiatives from architecture through to production—an operator who owns outcomes, not just areas
Experience architecting and operating scalable systems, services, and data infrastructure
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to operate with the executive team and represent engineering to the business
Proven track record of recruiting and retaining senior engineering talent
High level of integrity, accountability, and ownership
Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities
Bachelor’s degree required; Masters or PhD preferred.
What will set you apart
Experience building or scaling engineering operations in a startup or growth-stage company
Digital media, adtech, or measurement industry experience
Big data infrastructure experience — warehousing, pipelines, and streaming at scale
Looker or other BI tool experience (Tableau, et al.)
Prior experience working closely with founders or executive teams on technical strategy
Track record of building teams of end-to-end owners, not just individual contributors
Benefits
Health & Wellness
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Employee development & wellness stipend
Holiday break
Volunteer time off
Financial & Compensation
Competitive salary
Performance-based quarterly bonus
Stock options
401(k) retirement plan
Workplace & Equipment
Remote-first environment
New York office access
Access to available WeWork spaces
Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement
Adelaide is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
Our commitment to equal opportunity employment extends beyond basic compliance to encompass the active cultivation of a workplace that values different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Product
jobs.text:
Goodwall
Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.
Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.
As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.
Your Role
You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.
Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.
What you will do
Scale a product members love returning to. Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
Accelerate member acquisition. Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
Bring Product and Growth together. Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.
Set the standard for every detail. Take responsibility for the quality of the entire member experience, from the clarity of a notification and the simplicity of a product flow to the strength of an ad hook. Combine sharp copy, thoughtful design and precise execution.
Experiment with purpose. Speak with members, understand where they lose interest and test ways to keep them engaged. Run A/B tests, assess retention over time and use the findings to decide what to scale, improve or stop.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution
jobs.text:
Trustmark’s mission is to improve wellbeing – for everyone. It is a mission grounded in a belief in equality and born from our caring culture. It is a culture we can only realize by building trust. Trust established by ensuring associates feel respected, valued and heard. At Trustmark, you’ll work collaboratively to transform lives and help people, communities and businesses thrive. Flourish in a culture of diversity and inclusion where appreciation, mutual respect and trust are constants, not just for our customers but for ourselves. At Trustmark, we have a commitment to welcoming people, no matter their background, identity or experience, to a workplace where they feel safe being their whole, authentic selves. A workplace made up of diverse, empowered individuals that allows ideas to thrive and enables us to bring the best to our colleagues, clients and communities.
About the role
Trustmark is looking for an Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution. Please apply if you are qualified and would like to be considered for the role.
Responsible for driving new product development through deep market research, trend analysis, and customer insight to establish and sustain competitive advantage. Identifies emerging market opportunities and translates data-driven insights into a clear product vision and prioritized roadmap aligned with business strategy for group and individual products. . By leveraging continuous discovery and validation, ensures products solve meaningful customer problems while minimizing risk and accelerating time to market. Partners cross-functionally to align innovation efforts with long-term growth objectives and operational execution. Builds repeatable systems for market intelligence, feedback, and performance measurement to support ongoing optimization. Through disciplined governance and outcome-driven decision-making, enables scalable innovation and long-term health product portfolio success.
Key Accountabilities:
Product Development & Leadership
Ensures the health product portfolio is top tier in market; proactively identifies portfolio gaps and leads product prioritization and development to ensure the right offerings are available to sell.
Strong knowledge and insight into the voluntary benefits marketplace, building relationships throughout the voluntary market and deepening understanding of evolving trends.
Primary storyteller in supporting field partners, making sure products are effectively sold, understood, and communicated across teams and channels.
Leads all facets of the product development process including research, product design, sales strategy, market analysis, documentation of product requirements, cost benefit analysis and implementation.
Leads risk analysis on key issues including internal and external resources and capabilities needed to bring new products successfully to market.
Establishes and manages budgets, operational plans for products under development and management.
Leads development of health product claims strategy, including claims integration solutions, as well as ongoing customer experience opportunities.
Responsible for overall value-add/care delivery strategies relative to supplemental health products; manages relationships with external vendors and partners; responsible for RFP/finalist process in partner selection, leading overall process and collaborating internally to identify best options.
Owns product strategy from concept to market by leveraging deep market and competitive analysis to define, position, and champion new product offerings that strengthen the company’s product and business position
Product Execution
Collaboratively works with underwriting, sales and marketing teams to competitively position and build awareness of new products with producers.
Leads as the central point of expertise on product knowledge and market needs, enabling associates to successfully sell and administer the product.
Product Management
Accountable for ensuring all product line initiatives achieve targeted return on investment goals, being adaptive and nimble to drive expected results.
Coaches direct reports on how to maintain product health across the organization; ultimately responsible for success, prioritization, and driving initiatives with internal technology and project partners.
Develops and owns KPIs that measure the success of new product initiatives, providing actionable insights that enable data‑driven decisions and rapid course correction throughout the product lifecycle.
Ensures all products are compliant and timely action is taken to address regulatory changes.
Other duties as needed/assigned.
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree.
7-10 years of experience in industry with some experience across product development, product management and implementation.
Experience developing or managing voluntary and/or group products.
Ability to lead/influence without direct oversight.
Proven ability to develop and revise strategy and tactics to propel business growth.
Ability to analyze and interpret challenging concepts and resolve complex issues.
Ability to inspire, lead, and coach both leaders and employees.
Experience working collaboratively across the organization to build consensus and synergies that support attainment of division goals, handle conflicts, negotiate, and promote team spirit.
Must be innovative and creative in looking for ways to improve current processes.
Integrity and strength of character.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Preferred:
Deep broker/market connections in voluntary benefits and adjacent markets.
Sales-related experience, including any client-facing roles – technology, partnerships, account executive/account management, or similar.
Expertise in leading research projects and synthesizing consumer insights.
The compensation range for this role is (based on the corporate location in Lake Forest, Illinois):
$136,933 - $204,463 per year
The final salary offer will be determined based on factors such as location, qualifications, experience, skill set, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus. We understand that compensation is an important factor when considering a new opportunity, and we strive to provide a competitive salary within the market.
Brand: Trustmark
In addition to compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Health/dental/vision, life insurance, FSA and HSA, 401(k) plan, Employee Assistant Program, Back-up Care for Children, Adults and Elders and many health and wellness initiatives. We also offer a Wellness program that enables employees to participate in health initiatives to reduce their insurance premiums. For questions about compensation and benefits, please speak to the Recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.
Trustmark is committed to leveraging the talent of a diverse workforce to create great opportunities for our people and our business. We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: AI Product Director, FinOps/ITFM
jobs.text:
About brightfin:
Brightfin is the AI-native enterprise platform helping Fortune 500 and mid-market companies optimize IT spend across IT Financial Management (ITFM), Technology Expense Management (TEM), and FinOps. We are growing aggressively, with a clear and ambitious path ahead. Our customers include large healthcare systems, financial institutions, federal government agencies, and global enterprises spanning both domestic and international markets — organizations where data security and trust are non-negotiable.
Job summary
FinOps AI / ITFM+ — cloud spend and AI cost/usage management — is brightfin's third product pillar, built alongside our core TEM and ITFM/FinOps platform. This is a build-to-scale role. The AI Product Director will land the initial AI SKU and packaging decision, prove it with early design partners, and take revenue from first dollar to meaningful ARR.
Today, the AI Product Director is an individual contributor role. You define the roadmap, make the pricing call, run the design partner engagements, and close the first deals yourself. As the pillar scales and a team is built around it, this role grows into VP, GTM for FinOps AI — owning go-to-market for the pillar, and eventually its P&L as it matures into its own line of business.
The market is moving toward “AI value and ROI” layers stacked on top of legacy cost reporting — the model several legacy vendors are building. brightfin's bet is different: unified cost optimization across every dollar of technology spend, with AI as the mechanism that finds the waste and models the trade-off, not a feature added on top. This role owns proving that bet in market.
What you'll own
Product strategy and positioning
Own product strategy and roadmap for FinOps AI / ITFM+, spanning cloud spend and AI cost/usage management.
Position the pillar against the market's shift toward “AI value and ROI” layers stacked on top of legacy cost reporting, and make the case for brightfin's unified cost-optimization differentiation instead.
Packaging and pricing
Decide packaging: a standalone AI SKU versus embedding AI capability in existing ITFM/TEM SKUs, and build the business case behind each option.
Price for outcome and reasoning value, not for model access — a different problem than pricing a standard SaaS feature, and one this role owns end to end.
0-to-1 execution
Define the MVP, run design partner engagements, and validate pricing hands-on, without a team, through the pillar's earliest phase.
Take the pillar from first dollar of revenue to meaningful ARR, then build the plan for the team and go-to-market motion that follow.
What you'll need
Experience
10+ years of product leadership experience, AI-native: you've built or led a product whose core value proposition is AI — agentic workflows, reasoning or automation, ML-driven decisioning — not a traditional product with AI added later.
Product leadership experience at a direct or adjacent competitor in the ITFM/TEM/FinOps space, with firsthand knowledge of how those platforms package and price AI capability.
A track record taking an AI-native product from MVP through design partners to $0–10M in revenue, including pricing an AI feature or agent when the underlying model cost isn't the customer's only line item.
Real go-to-market ownership, not exposure: you've personally driven ICP definition, pricing and packaging decisions, sales enablement, and competitive positioning — not handed a feature list to marketing and moved on.
Skills and competencies
Comfortable operating as an individual contributor through a 0-to-1 phase. This role starts as a solo builder, not a manager of one.
Fluent in enterprise requirements: auditability, governance, role-based access, and explainable output. Black-box AI is a disqualifier for our buyers.
Ideally, experience displacing an incumbent during an ownership or acquisition disruption window category.
Education
Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
This isn't the right fit if
Your background is roadmap and backlog product management, without pricing or GTM ownership.
Your AI experience is limited to shipping prompts or features, without ever making a packaging or monetization call.
Your career is built on traditional SaaS product management with AI as a recent addition, not the core of what you've shipped.
You need a built-out team to be effective. This role starts as a solo builder.
You have no exposure to enterprise security or compliance requirements around AI in financial systems.
Your GTM background is limited to supporting sales calls or writing collateral, without owning pricing, packaging, or positioning decisions.
Compensation & Benefits:
brightfin offers a comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits package.
Paid time off. We strongly believe in work-life balance and taking time for yourself.
401K with employer match
Salary Range: $200,000-240,000 OTE
Location: Remote first, US based
FLSA Status: US Exempt
Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. brightfin is an equal opportunity employer. The company will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran or military status, age, genetic information or other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local applicable law. Candidates are subject to a background check. All employees must adhere to brightfin’s Information Security and Privacy policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Director - Product Management
jobs.text:
Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence
EarthDaily | U.S. Remote | Washington Metropolitan Area preferred | Full-Time
Reports to: VP Product
About EarthDaily
EarthDaily is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company delivering daily, scientifically calibrated, AI-
ready imagery of the planet through the EarthDaily Constellation. Capturing 22 spectral bands across nearly
all of Earth's landmass and maritime regions at the same time every day, EarthDaily powers broad-area
change detection, advanced analytics, and mission applications for governments and industries worldwide.
About the Role
The Director, Product Management – Defense and Intelligence, is the senior product leader responsible for
defining and driving EarthDaily's product strategy for defense and intelligence markets. The Director will
identify high-value mission problems and translate them into differentiated, scalable products that combine
EarthDaily's Earth observation data, analytics, AI/ML, contextual data, and workflow capabilities. This role is
highly outward-facing and will spend substantial time with government users, commercial customers,
acquisition stakeholders, Sales & Business Development, and industry partners to understand the market and
translate those insights into clear product priorities and requirements.
The role is part of EarthDaily's Analytics Product organization and works in close partnership with EarthDaily
Federal, Analytics line of business, and Engineering to develop defense and intelligence products for U.S.
Government and international defense agencies and customers. The Director owns the product problem,
customer outcome, product strategy, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, packaging, and commercial
product case. EarthDaily Federal and EarthDaily Analytics market teams along with Sales lead customer
relationships, capture, opportunity strategy, contracting, and revenue execution, while Engineering owns
technical design, delivery planning, sprint management, and implementation. The Director is expected to
move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, develop evidence-driven roadmaps that drive
revenue, stay close to customers and technical teams, and maintain a high level of responsiveness and
accountability.
Minimum Requirements
Location preferred: Washington Metropolitan Area (WMA).
• Senior or Director-level product management experience with demonstrated ownership of product
strategy, discovery, prioritization, and commercialization.
• Must be a U.S. Citizen.
• Must hold a minimum active Secret clearance; active TS/SCI strongly preferred.
• Must have strong knowledge of U.S. Government mission needs, budgets, spending cycles, acquisition
pathways, and commercial GEOINT/EO adoption, with experience in one or more of imagery, geospatial
analytics, AI/ML, or mission workflow solutions.
• Must be able to engage credibly with mission users, program offices, acquisition stakeholders, senior
government leaders, and technical teams and translate among those audiences.
What You'll Own
Defense product strategy: Set and continuously refine the product strategy, roadmap, and investment
priorities for EarthDaily's defense and intelligence portfolio, including Earth observation data, analytics,
AI/ML, contextual data, workflow solutions, and mission applications.
EarthDaily | Director, Product Management - Defense & Intelligence | 2
Market and customer discovery: Maintain a continuous external discovery process with U.S. Government
users, buyers, mission owners, partners, and influencers to understand unmet needs, mission priorities,
buying behavior, competitive alternatives, and emerging demand.
• Mission-to-product translation: Translate customer problems and operational workflows into clear
product requirements, desired outcomes, priorities, and success measures that technical teams can act
on.
Productization and reuse: Identify common requirements across customers, programs, and mission areas
and translate them into scalable products, reusable capabilities, and configurable workflows. Distinguish
between strategic product investments, reusable customer-driven capabilities, and one-off custom
development.

package, partner for, or explicitly not pursue based on customer value, market size, differentiation,

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.text:
We are seeking a hands-on Director of Technology to lead day-to-day execution across
infrastructure, applications, IT operations, and technical vendors. This leader will help scale the
company’s technology function during a period of significant growth by improving reliability,
delivery, business alignment, and operational discipline. The ideal candidate is equally
comfortable driving strategy, managing budgets across capex and opex, and stepping into the
details when needed.
What You Will Own
Lead day-to-day technology operations across infrastructure, business systems, internal IT, and
application delivery.
Oversee both infrastructure and applications, ensuring stability, scalability, security, and business
alignment.
Manage technology budgets across operating expenses and capital expenditures, including software,
cloud, infrastructure, telecom, and technical services.
Drive vendor management, renewal planning, cost optimization, and accountability for third-party
partners and contractors.
Build practical operating discipline for service delivery, change management, escalation,
documentation, and release coordination.
Partner with operations, finance, and executive leadership to prioritize initiatives that improve
visibility, efficiency, and growth.
Support systems integration, acquired business onboarding, and scaling efforts as the company grows
through 2029.
Develop KPIs, reporting rhythms, and execution follow-through for the technology function.
What We Are Looking For
8+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.
Experience leading both infrastructure and applications or business systems in a growing business.
Strong operational mindset with the ability to execute in a lean environment without relying on a large
internal team.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, technical roadmaps, and cross-functional priorities.
Ability to communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and translate technical work into
business value.
Comfort balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.
Preferred Background
Experience in multi-site, field service, industrial, facilities, compliance, construction, or similarly
operational businesses.
Experience in a PE-backed, high-growth, or acquisition-oriented environment.
Track record of improving reliability, delivery discipline, and scale in a small or mid-sized organization.
Experience leading internal staff as well as external vendors, contractors, or managed service partners.
Why This Role Matters
This role is designed for a growing business that is building a stronger technology foundation to
support meaningful expansion over the next several years. The Director of Technology will be a key
operating partner to the VP of Technology and will help transform technology into a scalable business
capability across both infrastructure and applications.
Salary: 150,000-180,000

jobs.title: Head of Hardware Engineering - Combustion Systems - Remote
jobs.text:
About Roadrunner Venture Studios
Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation's leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in frontier technology. We partner with scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs to turn deep technology into real companies. Our work spans energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, quantum computing, aerospace, advanced materials, artificial intelligence, and high performance computing.
About the Role
Roadrunner Venture Studios is recruiting a Head of Hardware Engineering for a portfolio company developing rainfall enhancement technology.
You will lead the deployment system from architecture and prototyping through operational qualification and production-scale manufacturing.
You will apply aerospace rigor to industrial hardware that must operate reliably in the field and support repeatable manufacturing at automotive scale. The work spans mechanical, thermal, combustion, fluid, structural, controls, and instrumentation systems.
This is a hands-on role. You will work with internal science and field teams and lead external engineering firms, fabricators, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
This role includes significant equity.
This is an early-stage startup building something that has not been built before. Priorities will change quickly. If this working environment does not excite you, this role is probably not for you.
What You Will Do
Technical Leadership
System Architecture: Own requirements and architecture across mechanical, thermal, combustion, structural, fluid, gas-handling, controls, and instrumentation systems.
Hardware Development: Lead the system from early design through prototypes, integrated builds, field-ready hardware, and production planning.
Combustion and Thermal Systems: Lead the design and qualification of combustion hardware, fuel and gas handling, flow and pressure systems, and thermal management.
Qualification and Field Operations: Define verification methods and lead shop tests, integrated system tests, field qualification, troubleshooting, and failure reviews.
Manufacturing and External Partners
Turn engineering concepts into computer aided design models, drawings, bills of materials, supplier packages, build instructions, and acceptance criteria.
Lead design for manufacturing and assembly so prototypes can mature into reliable production hardware.
Manage engineering, procurement, and construction firms, fabricators, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other external partners.
Use test data, field observations, supplier feedback, and failure analysis to drive design improvements and production readiness.
Business and Team Management
Outcome Ownership: Own the hardware schedule, budget, qualification timeline, technical quality, partner deliverables, and production plan.
Team Building: Recruit, mentor, and manage a small team of hardware engineers.
Work across science, field operations, business, and external partners to resolve technical risks and keep the hardware program moving.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or a related field.
Experience leading complex hardware from concept through prototype builds, operational qualification, and production planning.
High proficiency with computer aided design software such as SolidWorks or NX and product lifecycle management systems.
Experience with engineering release processes, configuration control, drawings, bills of materials, and supplier documentation.
Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly for industrial, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy, or other complex hardware.
Experience with combustion hardware, thermal systems, fluid systems, gas handling, pressure systems, large field equipment, or power systems.
Experience with test instrumentation, data acquisition, controls interfaces, inspection methods, qualification plans, and operational readiness reviews.
Experience managing engineering firms, fabrication shops, suppliers, contract manufacturers, or engineering, procurement, and construction partners.
Experience supporting field tests or deployments and making engineering decisions under changing operating conditions.
At least three years of experience leading hardware development and developing engineering talent.
Ability to move quickly, take broad ownership, and solve complex problems with limited resources in a startup environment.
Experience with computational fluid dynamics (CFD), especially for combustion, heat transfer, fluid flow, or gas-handling systems.
Experience taking hardware from prototype builds into first-article or low-rate production.
Experience with aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, robotics, or other high-reliability hardware programs.
Experience building a hardware engineering function at an early-stage company.
Location
This role is remote but may be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, or New Mexico if you would like to be near on of our hubs. The balance between in-person and remote work can be tailored to the candidate and team needs. Frequent travel is required.

jobs.title: VP, Data Science
jobs.text:
WHAT WE DO MATTERS:
At The Knot Worldwide, we champion celebration - and that starts with celebrating our people. Our employees are passionate dreamers, thoughtful doers, and lifelong learners who power meaningful moments for millions around the world. We’re united by authentic connection, shared purpose, and a deep commitment to the global community we serve. Here, flexibility and belonging go hand in hand with high performance. Driven by our core values, we believe the best ideas come from empowered teams: those who consistently collaborate with intention to design solutions, spark ideas, and drive impact. Our people are at the heart of our success.
ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:
The VP of Data Science & Analytics will lead experimentation, business intelligence, and advanced analytics across our global two-sided marketplace. This role is accountable for driving measurable business outcomes — including growth in couple engagement, marketplace liquidity, vendor ROI, and long-term customer value.
You will own the company’s experimentation strategy and enterprise BI function, ensuring executives and frontline teams alike have trusted, actionable insights. This role will partner closely with data engineering to build reliable, scalable end-to-end data pipelines that power experimentation, analytics, and executive reporting.
You will be the architect of our measurement engine — turning data into durable competitive advantage in a complex, two-sided marketplace. This is a highly visible leadership role reporting to the CPO and partnering across Product, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Sales.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Experimentation & Measurement
Define and scale experimentation strategy across a complex two-sided marketplace (couples and vendors).
Ensure rigorous A/B testing, incrementality measurement, and causal inference across growth, monetization, ranking, and lifecycle initiatives.
Build frameworks that account for cross-side marketplace effects and long-term LTV impact.
Establish clear accountability for experimentation outcomes tied to business performance.
Enterprise BI & Analytics
Own executive dashboards and enterprise reporting from Board-level metrics to team-level KPIs.
Develop and maintain a trusted metrics layer with clear governance and definitions.
Improve forecasting, driver trees, and performance diagnostics tied to CPAs, GMV, and marketplace health.
Enable scalable self-serve analytics capabilities across the organization.
Advanced Data Science
Lead applied data science across personalization, marketplace dynamics, pricing, segmentation, and lifecycle modeling.
Develop robust LTV and marketplace health models.
Partner with ML teams to ensure strong model evaluation and business impact measurement.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner closely with Data Engineering to design scalable experimentation infrastructure and data pipelines.
Influence architecture decisions without directly owning DE.
Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on data-driven growth strategy.
SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATES HAVE:
Experience
15+ years in Data Science, Analytics, or quantitative leadership roles.
Experience leading BI and analytics in a large, global organization.
Demonstrated success operating within a two-sided marketplace or platform business.
Proven experience owning experimentation strategy and delivering measurable business impact.
Experience partnering with C-suite and Board stakeholders.
Technical Expertise
Deep knowledge of experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling.
Experience building scalable experimentation and analytics ecosystems.
Strong fluency in SQL and modern data tools (e.g., Snowflake, Looker, Sigma, Tableau).
Strong understanding of marketplace unit economics and LTV modeling.
Leadership
Experience building and scaling high-performing Data Science and Analytics teams.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills in matrixed environments.
Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into clear business insights.
WORK MODEL:
This role is fully remote and not tied to any specific office location. While there are no regular in-office requirements, we encourage our remote team members to gather intentionally for key company and team events to stay connected and engaged.
#executive-track
Starting pay is determined based on a combination of factors which may include location/market, education, experience, skills, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, commissions, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. We also offer benefits to eligible employees including medical, dental, retirement, and generous leave policies.
Annual salary range
$235,200—$336,000 USD
At The Knot Worldwide, we believe you are more than a resume and invite you to go for it, take the leap of faith, and apply for this job. Together, we have an incredible opportunity to make it even easier for our customers to plan life’s most meaningful moments and for our small business owners to grow and scale. We would love to have you with us on our journey.
WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:
Commit to our customers: You act as one team on behalf of our customers. You lead with head and heart, and build what matters for life's most meaningful moments.
Raise the bar: You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
Be all in: You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
Celebrate impact: You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way. You love to win, together.
WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:
We believe in a wide range of holistic offerings to support our employees so that they can live our values day in and day out. From mental wellbeing, physical health and financial planning, to engaging perks and discounts, we are in the business of celebrating and supporting the Moments that Matter, both in and out of the office.. We offer flexible vacation, generous parental leave, and prioritize initiatives that support the growth, development, and happiness of our people.
Together@TKWW is our approach to hybrid work. It’s designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is Together@TKWW-eligible or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.
For Together@TKWW-eligible roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
For roles not eligible for in-office expectations, we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.
To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England; New York, NY; and Washington, D.C.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Operations
jobs.text:
Joining McNees Wallace & Nurick LLC means becoming part of a team that values your voice, your growth, and your impact on clients, colleagues, and the communities we serve. Since 1935, McNees has been a trusted, client-focused law firm delivering practical, results-driven legal solutions with integrity and a client-first philosophy. We are a full-service firm with more than 170 attorneys and 350 professionals, committed to excellence across a wide range of practice areas and industries.
At McNees, we are guided by our core values of authentic relationships, excellence, growth, and balance to foster collaboration and innovation. We support your success through mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning opportunities. Our commitment to community runs deep, with a strong tradition of stewardship through pro bono work, charitable initiatives, and civic engagement. We also prioritize flexibility and well-being with a family-focused culture, reasonable revenue hour expectations, and technology that drives efficiency.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to do meaningful work with people who value integrity and collaboration, you’ll feel at home at McNees.
McNees, Wallace & Nurick is actively seeking a Director of Technology Operations to join our Information Technology department. At McNees, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a culture of integrity, innovation, and collaboration - where your ideas matter, and your contributions make a real impact. This position would lead the day-to-day delivery, reliability, and continuous improvement of technology services that support attorneys and professional staff across multiple offices. Reporting directly to the CIO, this leadership role oversees technology training, service desk operations, and cloud and infrastructure services while helping shape the future of technology through innovation, automation, and scalable operational strategies.
Responsibilities
Lead, mentor, and develop teams across technology training, service desk, and cloud & infrastructure operations.
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence.
Partner with the CIO to establish operational priorities, budgets, and technology roadmaps aligned with firm objectives.
Oversee the successful delivery and adoption of new technology initiatives and organizational change management efforts.
Manage vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and service level performance.
Define, monitor, and report on KPIs and SLAs across technology operations.
Lead workforce planning, hiring, employee development, and succession planning initiatives.
Serve as a key liaison between IT and business stakeholders to ensure technology solutions support evolving organizational needs.
Drive automation and AI-enabled operational improvements that enhance efficiency and reduce resolution times.
Ensure effective technology onboarding, user training, and ongoing educational programs that maximize technology adoption and proficiency.
Oversee the delivery of responsive, high-quality end-user support and continuous improvement of the IT service management program.
Guide cloud infrastructure strategy, network operations, security, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, endpoint management, and compliance initiatives.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Information Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership or management role.
Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, project management, and process improvement.
Strong leadership, coaching, and team-development capabilities.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
Service-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering an exceptional user experience.
Working knowledge of enterprise networking, virtualization, endpoint management, and information security best practices.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, network technologies, conference systems, and security foundations.
Proven success managing SLAs, KPIs, operational budgets, and technology service delivery.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL v4 Foundation, PMP, Microsoft Azure certifications, Security+, or CISSP are preferred.
Experience in a law firm or professional services environment is preferred, including familiarity with legal technology platforms.
Ability to support critical incidents outside normal business hours and travel occasionally to regional offices as needed.
About McNees
Headquartered in Harrisburg, Pa., McNees operates offices across Pennsylvania, Maryland, Ohio, and Washington, D.C., giving our team a broad regional footprint and diverse opportunities for collaboration. We are ranked among the NLJ 500, Best Law Firms, and Best Lawyers, and nationally recognized for excellence in areas such as construction litigation and energy law.
Our attorneys deliver tailored strategies to businesses, individuals, and organizations across industries, including real estate, energy, healthcare, banking and finance, insurance, construction, and technology. We also have a strong presence in public sector law, advocating for clients in regulatory and legislative matters at all levels of government.
Our services span corporate law, real estate and construction, labor and employment, litigation, tax, intellectual property, energy and environmental, estate planning, and public sector law, complemented by affiliated businesses like Apollo Communications (strategic marketing and PR), Keystone Municipal Solutions (municipal consulting), and Pine Street Land Company (title and settlement services).
McNees offers an engaging work environment, robust opportunities for professional development, challenging and rewarding career paths, and competitive compensation. McNees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any trait protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
As the Director, Product Management, you will lead product strategy and execution for North America B2B cashflow capabilities. You will use market, customer, and data insights to develop and launch products, with a focus on financial services, data, and identity-related solutions.
You will report to the SVP of Product Management.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Define and execute the North America B2B cashflow product strategy and roadmap.
Lead new product launches using market intelligence, customer feedback, and opportunity size.
Use customer and stakeholder insights to identify needs and prioritize product opportunities.
Track the competitive landscape, evolving customer needs, and emerging data use cases, including identity data.
Partner with Sales and other teams on go-to-market plans, market feedback, and product adoption.
Identify data, partner, and integration opportunities that expand product capabilities and revenue.
Represent the product with clients and external audiences and contribute product thought leadership.
Collaborate across regional and global teams, business units, and partners to grow and protect the business.
Your background:
8+ years of product management experience.
Experience in financial services or data strategy.
Demonstrated people management experience.
Experience working with identity solutions, identity data, or adjacent domains is preferred.
Experience working with both existing and emerging data products.
Experience engaging senior stakeholders, including Director- and VP-level audiences.
Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, and other internal teams; comfortable engaging directly with the market and clients.
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. jobs.title: Head of Data Practitioner
jobs.text:
(This role can be based from anywhere in Europe on a fully remote basis)
Head of Data Practitioner
What we believe
Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.
Our role
We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.
Our approach
The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.
What we value
Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.
If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.
About the role
Crosslake is looking for a Head of Data to lead data engagements. In this role, you will work with private equity investors and portfolio company leadership teams to turn data opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
You will own senior client relationships on complex data engagements, building credibility with CDOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders while leading the work from strategic diagnosis through to practical delivery.
The ideal candidate combines the breadth of a strong consulting leader with deep expertise in data strategy, data transformation and modern data platforms.
You will be expected to shape the problem, develop the data strategy, lead complex transformations, manage senior stakeholders, drive the storyline and own delivery, while credibly challenging clients and specialists on the substance of the work.
This is a role for someone who can move confidently between business, technology and data conversations, connecting strategic ambition to the data capabilities, operating-model changes, investment choices and delivery roadmap required to realise value.
Role responsibilities
Own client relationships on data engagements, establishing trusted partnerships with senior business and technology leaders and acting as a credible advisor to CDOs, CTOs and executive teams.
Lead the development of data strategies that align business priorities, value-creation opportunities, target data capabilities, technology choices, operating model and delivery roadmap.
Lead complex data transformations from diagnosis through to implementation planning, including data platform modernisation, data governance, data quality, data product and analytics initiatives.
Bring structure to ambiguous data challenges, defining the key questions, building the workplan, managing workstreams and keeping the team focused on the issues that matter most to the client.
Develop compelling executive-level narratives that synthesise analysis, client input and specialist perspectives into practical recommendations and clear decisions.
Translate effectively between commercial and technical audiences, ensuring recommendations reflect business priorities, data realities, architecture implications, delivery feasibility and execution risk.
Link data initiatives to value creation economics, including opportunity sizing, business cases, investment requirements, benefits, trade-offs and dependencies.
Challenge assumptions, pressure-test recommendations and identify where deeper expertise is needed across data engineering, architecture, governance, analytics, AI or transformation.
Drive engagements beyond analysis towards prioritised actions, accountable delivery plans and a pragmatic path from recommendation to execution.
What we’re looking for
Experience operating at a level comparable to a high-performing consulting Director, Associate Director or Senior Consultant, with a track record of leading complex data engagements and senior client relationships.
A strong consulting toolkit, ideally developed in a leading strategy, digital, data or transformation consultancy, or through comparable experience in high-stakes advisory or transformation environments.
Deep expertise in data strategy and data transformation, with practical experience across areas such as modern data platforms, data architecture, governance, quality, data products, analytics or AI enablement.
Proven ability to take ambiguous business and data problems, impose structure, develop hypotheses, lead rigorous analysis, manage teams and translate findings into a clear executive storyline.
Credibility with senior executives and functional leaders, including CDOs, CTOs, CIOs, CEOs and leaders across data, technology, product and transformation.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to size opportunities, build business cases, quantify benefits, understand investment needs and evaluate strategic trade-offs.
Experience leading complex data programmes or transformations, with sufficient technical depth to challenge decisions on data architecture, platforms, governance, operating models and delivery approaches.
A hands-on leadership style: senior enough to build confidence with executives, while close enough to the work to guide analysis, challenge team thinking and personally shape the strategy and storyline.
A practical, action-oriented mindset aligned with Crosslake’s values of service, curiosity, credibility, commitment and creativity.
