jobs.title: Director, Product Engineering
jobs.text:
May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.
Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.
Job Description
The Director of Product will help oversee and direct several activities for May Mobility as it relates to product development, product strategy, competitive positioning and product marketing. This will lead and guide product strategy & planning to identify and take advantage of market, industry and economic opportunities while mitigating risks. This leader will share our values to solve one of the toughest problems in mobility while providing the highest level of service to our customers - with a passion for technology and finding ways to improve mobility to make people's lives better.
Essential Responsibilities
Lead a team of product managers that span across autonomous driving technology, application software, data & analytics, and vehicle hardware
Create compelling & inspiring product visions, strategies and roadmaps for several areas by collaborating with internal stakeholders and leveraging market, behavior & technology trends
Collaborate across other key stakeholders in product management, engineering, BD, customer success, etc. on product vision & strategy.
Implement a unified product development process based on being a highly iterative, learning organization and by managing internal and external resources throughout the product life cycle (customer insights→ launch→ post-launch improvements→ end-of-life).
Ensure that product roadmaps are customer and innovation driven and create compelling and lasting competitive advantage
Ensure pricing and value analysis is developed to maximize competitiveness, volume and profit for all products while meeting budget requirements.
Communicate product vision, strategy, positioning and plans with other leaders and stakeholders.
Define OKRs for team and products and deliver on them
Ensure collaboration of cross-functional teams to develop refined and improved KPI processes.
Set market research objectives and ensure the market research team serves May Mobility to the highest possible level.
Provide support with special projects as requested.
Skills and Abilities
Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:
Autonomy System Expertise: Proven experience with autonomous vehicle technology is required for effectively debating technical tradeoffs with engineering leaders.
Technical Translator: This role requires the ability to translate complex business goals into precise, engineering-ready technical requirements (PRDs/MRDs).
Data-Driven Decision Making: Proficiency in analyzing vehicle telemetry and operational metrics is essential for justifying and pivoting roadmap decisions.
Stakeholder Alignment: This individual must have proven ability to manage conflict and drive consensus among senior cross-functional leaders.
Prioritization Rigor: Demonstrated ability to be "ruthless" in prioritization is necessary to balance partner value against foundational autonomy investment.
Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and efficiently at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Organization: Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written and organizational skills.
Driven: Ability to work effectively and meet objectives without day-to-day direction.
Qualifications and Experience
Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:
10+ years experience in the field of autonomy, robotics and commercialization of products.
BA/BS degree or equivalent.
Experience in Automotive, Transportation, Software as a Service and/or AI industries highly preferred.
The candidate must possess direct operational knowledge of ride-hail, PUDO logistics, and the last-mile problem.
Must have solid experience in launching green field products and managing the complete product life cycles (customer insights→ idea→ build→ launch→ measure→ learn→ continuously improve in-market→ end-of-life)
Experience leading, managing, and developing teams of product and engineering personnel.
Proven success working in a start-up/small business where there are minimal resources, nothing comes easy and things don't always work as planned.
Experience building and maintaining strong, long-lasting client relationships.
Ability to undergo a driving record check
Physical Requirements
Standard office working conditions which includes but is not limited to:
Prolonged sitting
Prolonged standing
Prolonged computer use
Travel required? - Moderate: 11%-25%
Benefits and Perks
Comprehensive healthcare suite including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans. Domestic partners who have been residing together at least one year are also eligible to participate.
Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.
Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match.
Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work.
Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays.
Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and/or people of color are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every qualification. At May Mobility, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workforce, so if you’re excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway! You may be the perfect candidate for this or another role at May.
Want to learn more about our culture & benefits? Check out our website!
May Mobility is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetics or any other legally protected basis. Below, you have the opportunity to share your preferred gender pronouns, gender, ethnicity, and veteran status with May Mobility to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring and recruitment processes. Completion of these questions is entirely voluntary. Any information you choose to provide will be kept confidential, and will not impact the hiring decision in any way. If you believe that you will need any type of accommodation, please let us know.
Note to Recruitment Agencies: May Mobility does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Furthermore, May Mobility does not pay placement fees for candidates submitted by any agency other than its approved partners.
Salary Range
$160,000—$230,000 USD
May Mobility uses automated tools to support — but not replace — human judgment in our recruiting process, to find out more please click here

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Current Al is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already committed $400 millions in funds through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.
Role Overview
Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.
As Head of Product, you will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. Reporting to the VP Movement, you will partner with the engineering team to translate the vision into roadmaps and PRDs, and you will run the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organisations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will help determine what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.
What you will be working on
AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:
Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.
Your first six months
Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha
How we will measure success
Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.
What you’ll do
The Head of Product will be responsible for the following:
Product Strategy & Execution
Translate the CEO's vision into product designs, prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
Own the product roadmap, bringing technical options and tradeoffs to leadership .
Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
Internal & External Alignment
Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.
Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.
Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.
Organizational Leadership
Work with Operation and Leadership teams to ensure product initiatives are funded and staffed at the right level, in a way that accelerates ecosystem progress.
Cultivate a builder-oriented culture centered on innovation, execution, and openness, ensuring product decisions are grounded in user needs and mission impact.
Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives
Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.
Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment
Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.
Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.
What we’re looking for
Essential Qualifications
10-12+ years of experience in Product Management roles, including AI systems
Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
Nice-to-haves
Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
French proficiency is a strong plus
Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.
Character traits
We’re looking for people who:
Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.
How to apply
Please apply via the button in the top right corner and answer the prompted questions in no more than [500] words in total
Salary: Paris: €140,000-€180,000 depending on experience and adjusted on location

jobs.title: VP of Product Management
jobs.text:
A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.
At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc).
Our platform gives the world's most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.
We are looking for a highly motivated Director/VP of Product (f/d/m). You will report directly to company leadership, lead a small and senior product team, and work hand in hand with our SVP Tech in a collaborative, fast-moving, VC-funded startup.
Our revenue is concentrated in a small number of large, long-term commitments. What we sell is certainty: that a portfolio we design today still holds in five years. The platform is how that promise stays credible as the number of deals grows faster than the team. Owning whether that holds is the job.
Your mission
Own our product strategy and hold it against the business: where we win, where we lose, where margin can grow and where we can run more efficiently, tested against deal data, RFP outcomes, customer conversations and delivery obligations, and revised when the evidence says otherwise.
Act as a strategic counterpart to our leadership team on commercial mechanics: what drives revenue, how spread and gross margin actually behave, and what is really behind renewal and retention.
Lead and develop our product team across product management and design, from mid-level to principal. Set a high quality bar and build it with the team through hands-on review of the work.
Drive prioritization together with the product team: decide what gets built, dropped and sequenced based on data, make the trade-offs explicit to leadership, and grow each PM's ability to make these calls on their own.
Turn complex cross-functional workflows spanning sales, risk screening, sourcing, operations and finance into a platform that opens up new growth and makes the business we already have more efficient.
Partner closely with our SVP Tech on architecture, data and automation, and set the strategy and priorities for our data and automation work together. Bring enough technical depth to shape sequencing, cost and trade-offs together.
Spend real time with enterprise buyers and internal teams to understand the procurement and portfolio lifecycle first-hand.
What you need to succeed
Curiosity for a complex scientific, operational and financial domain, and the drive to build rare expertise in a market still being defined.
8+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading PMs and designers in complex B2B, marketplace, fintech, logistics, procurement or other regulated and operationally heavy environments.
Proven experience with products where the workflow is the product and part of the delivery is a human service.
Proven experience leading a team while staying hands-on, and growing PMs and Product Designers through coaching and structured feedback.
Exceptional analytical skills and a love for detail, with the ability to go from the data, the deal and the customer call to a clear strategy.
Skilled in building product systems and rituals that keep a team fast, decisions grounded in data, and delivery working as the company grows.
Clear communicator, comfortable building trust with C-level stakeholders and enterprise customers.
Based in Berlin, with a valid working permit in Germany.
The hiring process
An intro call with the People Team.
A deep-dive conversation with our CPO, Hannes.
A call with our CEO, Magnus.
A deep dive case study with our CPO, CEO and additional stakeholders.
A short artefact review session with Hannes and our Principal Product Manager.
What's in it for you at CEEZER?
A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.
Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence.
True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.
An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.
Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.
A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.
Create an impact with us
We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.
Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.
If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.
About us
CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Trusted by major organizations including Deutsche Telekom, LGT, and Nasdaq, CEEZER provides the confidence needed to implement effective climate action strategies. For more information, visit .

jobs.title: Director of Business Systems Product Management
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Role
This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.
Verkada runs on four value streams — Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.
The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth.
Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole — including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.
This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ
What You'll Do
Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Recruit and coach 6–10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.
Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6–10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.
Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.
Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.
Finance: Oversee NetSuite order-to-cash and financial close systems.
Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.
Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.
Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.
What You Bring
Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Finance, Business, or another technical/analytical field.
10+ years in product management, business systems, or a related technical role, including 3+ years leading product managers. Experience managing managers is a plus.
Track record owning enterprise systems end to end across more than one business function, accountable for the outcome rather than the delivery alone.
Experience across both external-facing and internal-facing systems, and a clear point of view on why the quality bar should be the same for both.
Experience designing for multiple personas on a shared surface, where a seller, an admin, and a finance user all need the product to work without it becoming a compromise for all three.
Depth in at least two of: quote-to-cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, supply chain planning and fulfillment, or the employee lifecycle — with credible curiosity about the rest.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday, or comparable platforms, and with the integration patterns that connect them.
Basic SQL, Python, JavaScript and HTML. You should be able to interrogate the data yourself.
Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and experience partnering with design. You can review a wireframe and tell the difference between a workflow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around.
Experience preparing and delivering to executive leadership, including defending a roadmap and a make-versus-buy recommendation.
An ideal candidate handles ambiguity, moves fast, and builds alignment across a demanding stakeholder group — keeping leadership informed and bought in along the way.
Employee Benefits
Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits
Additional Information

blocks.text: Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Role
This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada runs on four value streams — Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.

The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth.

Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole — including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.
This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ
What You'll Do

items: Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.
Recruit and coach 6–10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.
Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6–10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.
Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.
Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.

Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.
Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.
Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Mission Summary:
Reporting to the VP, Commercialization, the Director of Product Management will serve as the strategic leader for Motional’s product team and lead the design and execution of product vision and design to ensure every rider has the best rider experience possible. Working closely with executive and senior leaders and a team of product managers, you will build out our product vision and oversee the design of our entire AV system of systems. You will incorporate feedback from riders, executives, shareholders and customers and leverage these insights to ensure we are providing the best possible experience with a sustainable business mindset. This includes aligning roadmaps and products across Autonomy, Engineering, Operations, Mission Support, and Commercial teams.
This is a pivotal time to join Motional because we are at a historic stage of transitioning from developing an autonomous vehicle to deploying and operating a commercial driverless service. As we transition from development to deployment in Las Vegas in 2026, we are setting the stage to scale our technology globally. This role requires a visionary product leader who can zoom out to build a cohesive Motional point of view on the product experience, while zooming in to untangle complex technical dependencies between hardware, AI, and operations. You will ultimately lead our product teams, establishing a high-velocity development loop that ensures every release is safer, more performant, and more commercially viable than the last and our tools develop and scale for growth.
This role will be expected to travel up to 50% of the time depending on the business purpose and product deliverables.
What you'll be doing:
Build and Lead the Product Organization: Attract, hire, and inspire a small and mighty world-class team of Product Managers. You will establish a product culture focused on analytical rigor, cross-functional collaboration, and high-quality execution.
Define the Motional Product POV: Lead the development of a unified product vision that spans the entire rider journey and technical stack on and off the AV. You will consolidate disparate roadmaps into a single, unified strategy for Motional’s robotaxi service. You have expertise at managing all aspects of the product life-cycle, from conceptualization to market introduction and production, and product dimensions including technical, commercial/business, financial, legal and legislative.
Establish Prioritization Frameworks: Create and enforce rigorous, data-driven frameworks to balance competing priorities across Engineering, Fleet Operations, and Commercial teams. You will make the hard trade-offs between technical capability, system complexity, and time-to-market.
Catalyze Autonomous Performance & Developer Velocity: Oversee the product strategy for our underlying autonomy tools and data pipelines. Partner deeply with leads to identify workflow bottlenecks, improve strategies, and ensure engineering teams can rapidly iterate on performance.
Orchestrate Hardware & Software Synergy: Own the feedback loop between the in-vehicle experience, the physical fleet, and the backend software. Ensure the product roadmap maximizes the capabilities of our vehicle platform and scales effectively for daily operations. Influence and support the current and future generation platforms with OEMs, help execute commercial and go-to-market strategies for expansion and prepare for growth.
Lead Strategic Internal Collaborations: Establish the product organization's "rhythm of business," including roadmap reviews, resource allocation meetings, and executive briefings. You will act as the primary operational bridge aligning internal technical execution with external commercial obligations.
Customer and Partner Obsession: You will collaborate to define the integration scope and milestones with partners. Your team will own the technical customer-facing aspects of our integrations with ride-hail partners and owners and operators, ensuring a seamless and successful partnership.
Define Success & Track KPIs: Define what "winning" looks like across Safety, Progress, and Comfort. Track and report on key performance indicators, ensuring our engineering velocity translates directly into measurable improvements in the Operational Design Domain (ODD) and rider experience.
What we're looking for:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent field, or commensurate professional experience.
10+ years relevant professional experience in Product Management, with a minimum of 5+ years leading product teams within Autonomous Vehicles, Ride-Hail, robotics, or complex AI/ML industries.
Systems-Level Thinking: You have a proven ability to unify fragmented workflows and consolidate disparate product strategies into a single cohesive vision.
Technical Authority: Deep foundational understanding of the ML development lifecycle, data curation, and autonomous systems. You can hold your own in architecture reviews and engage with engineers on data pipelines and algorithmic requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership: You possess a proven track record of orchestrating complex projects across highly technical and non-technical teams, translating commercial needs into clear directives for Autonomy and Operations.
Executive Presence: You possess superb communication skills and can command a room. You are experienced in leading executive presentations, strategy discussions, and high-visibility roadmap reviews with polish and professionalism.
Strategic & Operational Balance: You can set the multi-year vision for the product while also sweating the details of short-term technical execution and developer efficiency.
Interpersonal Savvy: Soft skills that earn the confidence of leaders and peers, including empathy, organization, clear communication, influencing without authority, low ego, and the ability to build trust.
Bonus points (preferred, not required):
Ecosystem Experience: Direct experience building and scaling product organizations at a leading Level 4 autonomous vehicle or advanced robotics company.
Commercial Launch and Scale Experience: Experience coordinating the commercial side of a complex, physical-world product launch in a new market and scale.
This role is based in our Pittsburgh office and requires in-office days each week.
#LI-AM1
The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.
Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.
Salary Range
$212,000—$291,500 USD
Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

jobs.text:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Artificial Intelligence (AI) Required, Work From Home
We are looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who can think clearly about systems, make strong technical decisions, and help build the engineering organization from the ground up. The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will be part of founding team to shape the technical direction of the company, while helping build a strong engineering team across the globe. This position is 100% Remote.
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Responsibilities:
Technical Direction:
Define the long-term architecture for AI systems, infrastructure, and developer platform.
Evaluate trade-offs between speed of iteration and long-term system design.
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, and long-term evolution.
Guide key decisions across model integration, data pipelines, distributed systems, and product architecture.
Engineering Leadership:
Work with engineers to translate product direction into clear technical execution.
Help structure engineering workstreams and keep teams aligned on priorities.
Maintain high engineering standards while keeping the team focused on shipping.
Establish engineering culture, development practices, and technical standards across the company.
Building the Team:
Build and scale a world-class engineering team across key talent hubs including China and US.
Identify strong technical leaders and help build a high-quality engineering organization.
Define hiring standards and interview processes to maintain a high engineering bar.
Coordination and Execution:
Work closely with product, research, and leadership teams.
Ensure technical workstreams move forward smoothly across teams and locations.
Help resolve cross-team technical and execution challenges.
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Qualifications:
Strong technical foundation in system architecture, large-scale systems, distributed architecture.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) experience required.
Ability to reason clearly about complex systems and make pragmatic technical decisions.
Experience building or leading high-performing engineering teams.
Strong judgment on technical trade-offs and engineering priorities.
Comfortable operating in early-stage environments with high ambiguity.
Clear communication and ability to align teams.
We are particularly interested in candidates who enjoy building teams, superior products and shaping engineering organizations.
Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Director, Trading Products
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.
We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.
What We Look For In You
Domain Depth
5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.
Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.
Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.
End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.
Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.
Ways of Working
Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.
You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.
You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.
Nice-To-Haves
Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.
Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.
Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Technology and Security Risk Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated Technology and Security Risk Manager within the Second Line of Defence (2LOD). You will be responsible for continuously refining and scaling the Technology and Security oversight program, guiding first-line of defence (1LOD) execution, and providing independent risk challenge.
You will be a key member of OKX's Risk team, helping to shape and scale the firm’s 2LOD Security & Data Risk programs. You’ll work closely with stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.
You will play a key role in developing and implementing a comprehensive Technology and Security Risk Management program. This includes 2LOD oversight of technology defects, issues, and incidents, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), key risk indicators (KRIs) and reporting.
The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Technology Risk (including Technology Resilience, Change Management, SDLC, CI/CD pipeline, and software quality assurance) and Cybersecurity (covering internal and external threat vectors, control weaknesses, and organisational cyber hygiene). We are looking for a candidate with a strong drive for improvement and career growth.
What You’ll Be Doing
Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the company to proactively identify, escalate, assess, and mitigate Technology and Security risks, ensuring adherence to the Technology Risk Policy.
Providing oversight of Technology and Security Risk incidents and issues, and partnering with 1LOD stakeholders to enhance related processes and ensure effective oversight
Lead the Technology Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process from a 2LOD perspective, ensuring adherence to the ERM RCSA methodology, and providing effective challenge and oversight of 1LOD Security risks and controls.
Support the Security Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) definition, monitoring, and reporting.
Supporting the implementation and ongoing enhancement of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems to enable effective risk oversight
Advocate and support the implementation of Risk Management frameworks for technology stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor for the first line.
Stay up to date on emerging trends and regulations in the digital asset space, proactively identifying and addressing new risk considerations.
What We Look For In You
8+ years in information security, with a strong security architecture or technical security background; fintech, crypto or cloud-native experience preferred.
Practical experience designing, implementing or reviewing cloud, IAM, cryptographic, network or application security controls.
Experience in risk oversight, or readiness to transition, with the technical judgement to challenge controls and recommend proportionate improvements.
Ability to threat-model systems and assess technical evidence, including architecture diagrams, IAM policies, logging configurations and dependencies.
Working knowledge of cloud resilience, multi-region/AZ failover, RTO/RPO and disaster recovery testing.
Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and relevant privacy requirements, including GDPR and PDPA, and their application to technical controls.
Ability to independently assess and test controls, evaluate incidents and drive remediation with engineering and security teams; GRC platform experience desirable.
Clear written and verbal communication, translating technical findings into prioritised actions for business stakeholders and governance committees.
Strong stakeholder management skills, providing constructive challenge and collaborating across functions and geographies.
A proactive, adaptable approach, with confidence taking ownership and improving practices in a fast-paced environment.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; CISSP, CCSP, cloud security/architecture, CISA or CISM qualifications desirable.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliance Partnerships
jobs.text:
About Acquia
Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.
Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it!
Career Exploration at Acquia
Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia
You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.
About the Role
We are looking for a Director to own Acquia's Technology Alliance Partnerships (TAP) ecosystem end to end. Our TAP program is large, diverse and growing: It includes large platform ISVs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, key Martech integrations for our DAM and other products, cloud platforms like AWS, OEM relationships such as Cloudflare and Akamai, and a new class of content-creation partners like Figma.
You will set and own the overall Technology Alliance Partnership strategy with Product for how these partners integrate with and extend the Acquia platform, drive go-to-market with our most important existing partners, and recruit and launch the next key integrations. This is a builder's role for someone who can operate as both a strategist and an operator: shaping the vision, then landing the partnerships and executing the business models that prove it out. You will lead a team and partner closely with Partner team, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
What You Will Do
Develop and own the Technology Alliance Partner strategy across ISV, DAM, platform, OEM, and content-creator partner types.
Manage Acquia's most strategic technology partnerships including joint planning.
Own the AWS partnership, including co-sell, marketplace, and platform alignment.
Build and execute joint go-to-market plans with key partners that generate qualified leads and sourced pipeline.
Identify, recruit, and launch new technology partners, from initial evaluation through integration and GTM readiness.
Build out a new business model for OEM relationships that scales revenue and clarifies packaging, pricing, and motion.
Work cross-functionally with Product to understand the roadmap, prioritize key integrations, and align partner investments to where the platform is going.
Partner with Marketing on joint campaigns and participation in marketing and partner events.
Partner with Sales on OEM partnerships and co-sell deals, supporting the field where partner leverage moves opportunities forward.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of technology alliance managers.
What You Bring
5+ years in technology alliances, ISV partnerships, business development, or ecosystem strategy, with progressive leadership responsibility.
A track record of building and scaling technology partner programs and generating measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
Direct experience owning or building co-sell motions with a hyperscaler (AWS strongly preferred) and familiarity with cloud marketplace mechanics.
Fluency across multiple partner models: ISV integrations, OEM and embed relationships, and platform alliances.
Strong cross-functional influence with Product, Marketing, and Sales, and comfort operating at the executive level internally and with partners.
Commercial sensibility: you can construct partnership business models, not just relationships.
Nice to Have
Experience in DXP, CMS, DAM, martech, or adjacent SaaS categories.
Familiarity with the Drupal or open-source ecosystem.
Prior experience standing up or reshaping an OEM business model.
People-leadership experience, with a history of hiring, developing, and retaining strong alliance talent.
What Success Looks Like
A clear, prioritized technology alliance strategy adopted across the partnership org and validated by Product and Sales.
A functioning OEM business model with named partners generating revenue.
A high-performing, well-run team.
We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals.
Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more!
Final compensation will be commensurate with your experience and will be determined by a variety of factors, including city of residence, relevant skillset, and job-related knowledge. This role is also eligible for variable compensation.
Acquia is an equal opportunity (EEO) employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veterans status or any other protected status or characteristic under federal, state or local law unrelated to the ability to perform the job.
Pay Range
$170,000—$180,000 USD

Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it!
Career Exploration at Acquia

Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia
You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.
About the Role

We are looking for a Director to own Acquia's Technology Alliance Partnerships (TAP) ecosystem end to end. Our TAP program is large, diverse and growing: It includes large platform ISVs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, key Martech integrations for our DAM and other products, cloud platforms like AWS, OEM relationships such as Cloudflare and Akamai, and a new class of content-creation partners like Figma.

You will set and own the overall Technology Alliance Partnership strategy with Product for how these partners integrate with and extend the Acquia platform, drive go-to-market with our most important existing partners, and recruit and launch the next key integrations. This is a builder's role for someone who can operate as both a strategist and an operator: shaping the vision, then landing the partnerships and executing the business models that prove it out. You will lead a team and partner closely with Partner team, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
What You Will Do

items: Develop and own the Technology Alliance Partner strategy across ISV, DAM, platform, OEM, and content-creator partner types.
Manage Acquia's most strategic technology partnerships including joint planning.
Own the AWS partnership, including co-sell, marketplace, and platform alignment.
Build and execute joint go-to-market plans with key partners that generate qualified leads and sourced pipeline.
Identify, recruit, and launch new technology partners, from initial evaluation through integration and GTM readiness.
Build out a new business model for OEM relationships that scales revenue and clarifies packaging, pricing, and motion.
Work cross-functionally with Product to understand the roadmap, prioritize key integrations, and align partner investments to where the platform is going.
Partner with Marketing on joint campaigns and participation in marketing and partner events.
Partner with Sales on OEM partnerships and co-sell deals, supporting the field where partner leverage moves opportunities forward.
Lead, coach, and grow a team of technology alliance managers.

Direct experience owning or building co-sell motions with a hyperscaler (AWS strongly preferred) and familiarity with cloud marketplace mechanics.
Fluency across multiple partner models: ISV integrations, OEM and embed relationships, and platform alliances.
Strong cross-functional influence with Product, Marketing, and Sales, and comfort operating at the executive level internally and with partners.

A high-performing, well-run team.

jobs.title: Director of Forensic Engineering
jobs.text:
The Role:
The Director of Engineering provides technical and people leadership within YA Engineering Services’ forensic engineering practice, focusing on the evaluation of damaged building structures and related mechanical and electrical systems for insurance carriers, law firms, and other stakeholders. The position leads and mentors engineers while remaining hands on throughout the project lifecycle—from coordinating site visits and conducting field inspections to performing engineering analysis, interpreting applicable building codes, and producing clear, defensible reports that determine the cause and extent of building distress or failure. Work is field based and investigative in nature, emphasizing physical assets, materials, environmental factors, and building performance rather than information technology systems. The ideal candidate has an established client network and has a strong track record of building rapport and maintaining lasting client relationships. Please note that this position is not an IT or Software Engineering role.
In This Role, You Will:
Lead and mentor a team of engineers, supporting their development and project work
Reviews junior consultants’ work to ensure accurate, high-quality, and timely deliverables before client submission.
Ensure project budgets and scope are timely communicated to clients and strictly adhered to.
Drive timely delivery of all project milestones, consistently meeting or surpassing established deadlines.
Coordinates with clients to set up site visits and complete deliverables on projects
Produces project reports that synthesize data collected from our onsite inspections with environmental factors, material properties, and engineering analysis to determine the most likely cause and scope of distress and failures to buildings and components.
Performs site visits to collect field data on residential and commercial properties.
Reviews and interprets the relevant building codes as necessary for issues pertaining to our scope of work.
Assist in business development activities. Work with business development representatives to attend conferences, events, dinners, lunches, when applicable, to promote the company and your personal capabilities.
Performs additional duties as assigned.
What You Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
Active PE license
15 + years of forensic engineering experience
Proven ability to write comprehensive technical reports on inspection results
Willingness to travel up to 50%
Who We Are:
YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. YA Engineering Services (“YAES”) is a national forensic multi-disciplinary consulting firm. YAES provides immediate response to new assignments, performs investigations in a timely manner, and provides comprehensive reports that are clear, concise, and backed by reasonable analyses and recommendations. YAES offers a team of highly qualified, technically excellent engineering professionals who work seamlessly together to service the needs of our clients in the model of an engineering cooperative.
What We Offer:
Employee-focused culture
Strong commitment to work-life balance
100% Remote work
Flexible vacation & Paid holidays
Paid family care/sick leave
Parental leave
Comprehensive benefits
401k w/match
Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:
Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding your application will come from or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us directly at .
Disclosures:
As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist—rather than replace—human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Head of Enterprise Clinical AI & Technology - Remote - The Cign
jobs.text:
Location: Flexible Location; Chicago, IL, Bloomfield, CT, Philadelphia, PA, St. Louis, MO preferred.
This position is open to candidates located anywhere within the United States. Candidates who reside within approximately 50 miles of a designated office location may be expected to work onsite in accordance with the company's In-Person Presence guidelines. Candidates residing outside of the designated commuting radius may work remotely.
POSITION SUMMARY: The Head of Enterprise Clinical AI + Technology is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping, designing, and advancing The Cigna Group’s enterprise clinical AI and technology agenda. Reporting to the Managing Director, Enterprise Clinical Strategy and Operations, this leader will operate at the intersection of clinical expertise, product and solution design, artificial intelligence, and operational execution. The role will partner across clinical, technology, data and analytics, operations, legal, compliance, and business teams to translate enterprise clinical priorities into scalable AI-enabled solutions that improve clinical quality, clinician experience, operational efficiency, affordability, and patient health outcomes.
IMPACT STATEMENT: This role is pivotal in accelerating the enterprise clinical AI roadmap by ensuring solutions are clinically grounded, responsibly designed, operationally scalable, and aligned to measurable business and clinical outcomes. The Senior Director will help position the enterprise clinical organization as a strategic growth engine by moving high-priority AI and technology opportunities from concept through design, implementation, adoption, and performance management.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the development and execution of enterprise clinical AI and technology strategies that advance clinical quality, affordability, operational performance, clinician experience, and patient health outcomes across Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth businesses.
Serve as a senior clinical and strategic advisor to business, clinical, technology, data science, and operations leaders, translating complex clinical needs and enterprise priorities into actionable AI-enabled solution roadmaps.
Oversee the design and refinement of differentiated clinical AI and technology solutions, including use cases related to agentic AI, clinical workflow automation, care management, utilization management, documentation support, clinical decision support, and clinician-facing productivity tools.
Apply clinical expertise and human-centered solution design principles to ensure AI-enabled capabilities are grounded in real clinical workflows, user needs, evidence-based practice, regulatory expectations, and operational feasibility.
Partner with product, technology, data and analytics, operations, legal, compliance, privacy, information protection, and business teams to move priority AI and technology initiatives from opportunity identification through design, incubation, implementation, adoption, and scale.
Provide thought leadership on emerging AI, digital health, interoperability, and clinical technology trends to identify opportunities, risks, and partnership options that support enterprise clinical strategy and market differentiation.
Develop business cases, impact models, success metrics, and performance management routines to measure clinical, operational, financial, adoption, and user-experience outcomes for AI and technology initiatives.
Establish strong execution discipline, governance routines, and executive-level reporting to manage progress, surface risks, drive decisions, and ensure alignment across a highly matrixed environment.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team, including direct management of colleagues responsible for clinical AI strategy, solution design, program execution, stakeholder engagement, and performance management.
Create executive-level communications, presentations, decision documents, and stakeholder updates that distill ambiguity into clear recommendations and action-oriented next steps.
REQUIRED SKILLS:
Active or prior clinical training and credential required, such as MD, DO, RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or other relevant licensed clinical background.
15+ years of progressive healthcare leadership experience, including experience in clinical strategy, clinical operations, digital health, product or solution design, technology-enabled transformation, or healthcare AI.
Demonstrated experience designing or leading AI, machine learning, automation, digital health, or advanced analytics solutions in healthcare, preferably in payer, provider, pharmacy, care management, utilization management, or integrated delivery environments.
Strong understanding of clinical workflows and the ability to translate clinician, customer, patient, and business needs into scalable technology-enabled solutions.
Proven ability to lead direct reports and matrixed teams, build talent, create accountability, and develop a high-performing team culture in a complex and fast-paced environment.
Strong executive presence and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and drive decisions across senior clinical, business, technology, data, legal, compliance, and operations stakeholders.
Comfort operating in ambiguity, structuring complex problems, making pragmatic tradeoffs, and moving strategic priorities into execution.
Strong financial and business acumen, including experience developing business cases, impact models, KPIs, ROI assumptions, and performance management routines.
Excellent communication skills, including ability to translate complex clinical, technical, AI, and operational topics into clear, concise, executive-ready materials.
Bachelor’s degree and advanced clinical, healthcare, business, public health, informatics, or related degree required.
If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 193,300 - 322,100 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.
This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus and long term incentive plan.
At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.
About The Cigna Group
Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Through our divisions Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.
