jobs.title: Director, Technology Operations & Security
jobs.text:
Position Summary
Perry Homes is seeking a Director of Technology Operations & Security to lead the technology services that keep our business secure, reliable, and productive.
Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, this leader will have enterprise responsibility for technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity, identity and access management, Service Desk and field support, disaster recovery, telecommunications, and operational governance.
This is a leadership role requiring someone who can balance strategy with execution. The successful candidate will strengthen operational disciplines, improve service delivery, advance Perry Homes' cybersecurity capabilities, develop the team, and ensure technology services remain reliable as the company continues to grow.
The Director will lead an organization of approximately 14 technology professionals through Service Desk and Infrastructure/Security leadership and will work closely with business leaders, technology teams, vendors, and executive leadership.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Operations & Service Delivery
· Lead enterprise technology operations including infrastructure, cloud, networking, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, telecommunications, and end-user support.
· Establish clear service levels, operational metrics, accountability, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
· Ensure technology services are reliable, scalable, secure, and responsive to business needs.
· Develop and execute infrastructure and technology operations roadmaps and lifecycle plans.
· Establish strong incident, problem, and change management practices.
· Lead major technology incidents and ensure clear, timely communication with business and executive leadership.
Cybersecurity & Risk
· Provide leadership and accountability for Perry Homes' cybersecurity program.
· Establish and maintain security policies, standards, processes, and operational controls.
· Oversee security monitoring, vulnerability management, identity and access management, incident response, and security remediation.
· Strengthen Perry Homes' security posture through measurable risk reduction and continuous improvement.
· Partner with Legal, Internal Audit, Risk, business leaders, and external security partners on assessments and remediation activities.
· Ensure cybersecurity incident response and recovery plans are documented, tested, and maintained.
· Support effective security awareness and education across the company.
Infrastructure & Cloud
· Own the operational performance of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, networking, servers, endpoints, backup and recovery, and related infrastructure platforms.
· Develop infrastructure strategies that improve reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
· Ensure appropriate monitoring, capacity planning, lifecycle management, architecture, and operational readiness.
· Lead modernization initiatives and evaluate emerging technologies where they provide meaningful business value.
Service Desk & Field Support
· Lead Service Desk and Field Support organizations supporting corporate offices, sales environments, and field operations.
· Build a customer-focused service culture centered on responsiveness, ownership, and problem resolution.
· Improve service levels, response and resolution times, knowledge management, and customer satisfaction.
· Ensure effective employee onboarding, technology provisioning, offboarding, asset management, and endpoint lifecycle processes.
· Use service data and recurring issue analysis to identify opportunities for permanent improvement.
Resilience & Business Continuity
· Own technology disaster recovery planning, testing, and readiness.
· Ensure critical technology platforms have defined recovery objectives, documented recovery procedures, and appropriate backup strategies.
· Conduct periodic recovery exercises and ensure identified gaps are remediated.
· Partner with business leadership on technology resilience and continuity planning.
Vendor & Financial Management
· Manage strategic vendors and managed service providers supporting infrastructure, cloud, security, telecommunications, and technology operations.
· Establish clear service expectations and hold partners accountable for performance and contractual commitments.
· Develop and manage operating budgets and technology investment recommendations.
· Identify opportunities to improve service while controlling or reducing operating costs.
· Participate in contract negotiations, technology lifecycle planning, and vendor strategy.
Leadership & Team Development
· Lead and develop a high-performing Technology Operations and Security organization.
· Establish clear roles, accountability, performance expectations, and development plans.
· Develop managers and technical leaders while maintaining appropriate technical depth within the organization.
· Build a culture of ownership, urgency, collaboration, customer service, and continuous improvement.
· Develop internal capabilities and reduce unnecessary dependence on outside providers.
What Success Looks Like
· Reliable and resilient technology services.
· Improved cybersecurity maturity and measurable reduction of technology risk.
· Strong Service Desk performance and employee satisfaction.
· Reduced frequency and impact of recurring technology incidents.
· Effective major incident management and root cause resolution.
· Demonstrated disaster recovery readiness.
· Strong vendor performance and cost management.
· Effective employee onboarding and technology provisioning.
· Development and retention of a strong technology operations team.
· Execution of a clear infrastructure, security, and operations roadmap.

Position Description & Requirements
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is pioneering a new imaging paradigm—shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, decision-driven care. Through our AI-native platform, MosaicOS™, we unite fragmented technologies into a single, intelligent ecosystem designed to help clinical teams work faster, think smarter and deliver better care.
Built cloud-native and designed for continuous iteration, MosaicOS™ is engineered to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges. Our platform expands clinical capacity, improves diagnostic quality by combining human expertise with AI, and turns operational complexity into strategic advantage through seamless integration or replacement of legacy imaging systems.
Every AI tool within MosaicOS™ is validated across tens of millions of exams to ensure safe, reliable and meaningful clinical impact. With a ransomware-resistant design and built-in redundancy, our platform is designed to ensure continuity of care and protect both patients and operations.
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is building technology that evolves with clinicians to advance clinical excellence and improve patient outcomes. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of medical imaging, join us!
VP, DATA STRATEGY AND ALLIANCES - POSITION SUMMARY:
Develop and own the company's radiology data strategy—defining the vision for how Mosaic builds, accesses, and leverages imaging data assets to sustain long-term AI leadership.
Identify, structure, and negotiate strategic data alliances with radiology practices, imaging centers, PACS vendors, health systems, academic medical centers, IDNs, and other partners; own these relationships from business development through execution.
Drive data access across Mosaic's partner network—developing scalable frameworks for securing data use rights and ensuring alignment with commercial and contractual processes.
Evaluate and pursue opportunities with third-party data providers, research networks, and data intermediaries that can expand or diversify Mosaic's data footprint.
Partner with Legal to structure data use agreements, BAAs, and alliance contracts that protect Mosaic's interests while making it easy for partners to say yes.
Collaborate with AI/ML and Product teams to translate data strategy into concrete requirements—ensuring the alliances you build directly fuel model development and competitive differentiation.
Serve as an internal and external authority on Mosaic's radiology data assets; communicate their strategic value to senior leadership, partners, and the board.
Up to 50% travel; this role demands frequent engagement with external partners, health systems, and vendors across the US and internationally.
DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Understanding of the radiology and imaging data landscape: PACS/RIS ecosystems, DICOM standards, and the dynamics of imaging data at scale.
Demonstrated business development or related experience structuring and negotiating complex data agreements, including data use agreements, BAAs, and multi-party alliance contracts.
Familiarity with AI/ML model development, real-world evidence strategies, and the role of data in building sustainable AI competitive advantage.
Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills; experience engaging C-suite stakeholders at health systems, academic centers, or large provider organizations.
Strategic thinker with the ability to move from vision to execution—comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving results without a fully defined playbook.
Executive presence and relationship-building skills; ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders at health systems.
WHY MOSAIC CLINICAL TECHNOLOGIES:
Competitive Benefits package – Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from.
Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities
Flexible Remote Schedules - NASHVILLE, TN PREFERRED
Generous PTO Plans and Paid Holidays
Proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work for Five Consecutive Years
COMPENSATION:
The salary range for this position is $250,000 - $280,000. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).
Mosaic Clinical Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. MCT is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.
CCPA Notice: When you submit a job application or resume, you are providing Mosaic Clinical Technologies with the following categories of personal information that the Company will use for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for employment: (1) Personal Identifiers; and (2) Education and Employment History.
Mosaic Clinical Technologies participates in E-verify.
Beware of Fraudulent Messages:
Mosaic Clinical Technologies or Radiology Partners will never request payment, banking or other financial information in exchange for interviews or as part of the hiring process. Additionally, we will not send checks for deposit into your bank account at any stage of recruitment. All communication during the interview and hiring process should come from an email address ending in “@radpartners.com.” If you suspect you are receiving a fraudulent job offer or solicitation from Radiology Partners or one of our local practices, please email to notify our team.

jobs.text:
Job Title: Senior Director of Qualitative Data Collection and Analysis
Job Location: Remote, United Kingdom
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
Environmental Conditions: Office
Work Schedule: Standard (Mon-Fri)
Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)
Environmental Conditions
Office
Job Description
Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group helps sponsors to integrate the patient voice in all relevant healthcare decisions, from development over regulatory to reimbursement and product launch. For that, PCR uses a unique combination of scientific fields, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, health economics and others. Our work has helped identify and clarify unmet clinical needs, assess burden of illness and evaluate patient outcomes, preference and/or adherence, while supporting promotional and labeling claims on a global scale.
The Senior Director of Qualitative Data Collection and Analysis (QDA) is primarily responsible for the collection, organization and analysis of qualitative data on PCR projects, including: moderation of interviews and focus groups, management of vendors for dedicated qualitative research services, oversight of qualitative research technologies (incl., AI-enabled solutions), and qualitative data analysis. As part of this remit the Senior Director will be responsible for leading the development, improvement and implementation of quality and compliance assurance processes. The aim of this exciting role is to build a best-in-class qualitative research center of excellence that supports our scientific solution teams with its methodological expertise.
This role is critical for our mission to provide a full suite of services and offerings to achieve patient focused drug development.
Essential Functions
Develop and implement annual QDA business plans, including identifying and implementing a best-in-class qualitative delivery model.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Central Europe
jobs.text:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best-in-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.
Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Head of Product, Central Europe to join our ever evolving SMB Product team within Global Payments and help shape the future of global commerce.
This senior leadership role is accountable for defining and delivering the Central Europe SMB solutions strategy across Joint Venture partnerships. You will work through influence across a complex partner ecosystem, aligning Global Payments, JV partners, EU market leadership, and global product and technology teams around clear priorities, funded roadmaps, and sustainable commercial outcomes.
What you’ll own
Define and lead the Central Europe SMB solutions strategy across Joint Venture partnerships, translating customer needs, market insights, competitive trends, and platform opportunities into a clear 3 to 5-year product vision that supports sustainable growth across the region.
Establish and drive strong governance frameworks across Global Payments and JV partners, ensuring alignment on product priorities, investment decisions, roadmap execution, funding models, and expected business outcomes.
Own the product roadmap and prioritisation process, balancing strategic objectives, commercial impact, customer value, technology capacity, and partner-specific requirements to maximise overall portfolio performance.
Build alignment across product, technology, commercial, and executive stakeholders, proactively managing dependencies, resolving competing priorities, and influencing decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
Ensure product initiatives deliver measurable business impact by connecting delivery outcomes to revenue growth, market expansion, customer success, operational efficiency, and long-term value creation for both Global Payments and JV partners.
What you’ll bring
15+ years of product leadership experience delivering end-to-end product strategy, development, and lifecycle management within payments, fintech, banking, software platforms, commerce technology, or similarly complex industries, with a strong track record of translating market opportunities into scalable product solutions.
Proven ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed, and multi-entity environments, aligning product, technology, commercial, and executive stakeholders around shared objectives and driving outcomes without direct authority.
Extensive experience in product governance, roadmap prioritisation, and portfolio management, including balancing strategic objectives, managing cross-functional dependencies, navigating investment trade-offs, and ensuring successful execution across multiple businesses, markets, or partners.
Strong commercial acumen and partnership leadership, with experience developing business cases, connecting product investments to revenue outcomes, managing portfolio performance, and successfully collaborating with Joint Ventures, strategic partners, or other complex stakeholder ecosystems.
Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, combined with a people-first, high-accountability mindset, enabling the development of trusted relationships, effective decision-making, and successful collaboration across countries, cultures, and organisational boundaries.
It’s a bonus if you have
Experience working within Joint Ventures, strategic partnerships, or other multi-entity environments, with an understanding of complex governance structures, funding models, and stakeholder management requirements.
Strong knowledge of payment ecosystems, fintech, banking, commerce technology, or SMB-focused solutions, with the ability to connect market opportunities to product strategy and execution.
Experience operating across multiple countries and markets, balancing local customer and partner requirements with broader regional or global product objectives.
Familiarity with API-first platforms, target architecture models, platform modernisation initiatives, and scalable product delivery approaches that support long-term business growth.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to align diverse executive stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and drive outcomes without direct authority.
About the team
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
What makes a Globalpayer?
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Well, hello there 👋
Castify (Creators of Screencastify) is a leading technology company dedicated to improving communication and learning outcomes with video. We have established ourselves as a leader in the K-12 education sector in the United States and we are critical in helping scale a teacher and improve student outcomes. We are also actively expanding into new and exciting markets outside of K-12 including bringing our tested solution into companies and organizations. Castify is used by over 15M people today and is seeking a VP of Engineering to join our Squad!
About this role
What started as the simplest and most reliable screen recorder in the world, with millions of users, is now a multi-product, AI-first platform. Our near future is full of ambitious new goals, features, and products that will enable us to further improve how we provide service to our users and accelerate growth. ​
We prioritize fast iteration without compromising quality while maintaining attention to detail that creates the kind of seamless, high-quality experiences we’re known for. We’re looking for an experienced, strategic VP of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization as we continue building innovative products that impact millions of users worldwide.
This role will partner with Product and GTM teams to define and execute our technical vision, strengthen engineering operations, and help shape the future of video communication and AI-powered learning experiences.
What you'll do:
Lead a high-performing Engineering organization across multiple product areas and platforms.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Partner with Product leadership to define technical strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
Drive engineering excellence by establishing scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Shape and evolve our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Head of Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
At Universal Quantum, we are building the next generation of quantum computers - machines capable of solving problems once thought impossible. Our technology has the potential to transform industries from healthcare to aerospace, materials science, and beyond. As we scale from breakthrough R&D to global delivery, resilient execution becomes as critical as technical innovation.
We are looking for a Head of Systems Engineering who will be accountable for the definition, and implementation of complex quantum computing systems. The role leads multidisciplinary systems engineering across electronic, mechanical, cryogenic, vacuum, optical, software, and control domains, ensuring that product requirements are translated into coherent, testable, and deployable system solutions.
The position combines senior technical leadership, organisational development, and programme delivery. It owns system-level engineering rigour from concept through customer deployment, while building an effective, collaborative engineering organisation across UK and international locations.
What You'll Accomplish
Systems engineering leadership: Define and implement the systems engineering strategy, lifecycle, standards, governance, and toolset, including requirements management, traceability, modelling, simulation, configuration control, and MBSE where appropriate.
System definition and architecture: Lead system-level design and requirements decomposition, working with Product, Architecture, Quantum, Hardware, Software, and Control teams to establish clear interfaces, budgets, specifications, trade-offs, and acceptance criteria.
Technical assurance: Establish and chair proportionate design, readiness, test, and acceptance reviews; ensure risks, non-conformances, failure investigations, and corrective actions are managed to closure.
Programme delivery: Maintain system-level plans, dependencies, technical risks, and performance measures so programmes achieve agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality, and performance objectives.
Team leadership: Build, lead, and mentor multidisciplinary systems engineering and integration teams; set objectives and KPIs, develop capability, support recruitment, and establish clear accountability.
Cross-functional execution: Create effective working relationships across research, engineering, product, programme, quality, supply chain, and customer-facing teams, ensuring timely decisions and transparent communication.
Integration, verification, and validation: Contribute to the definition of the verification and test strategy for integrated assembly and systems.
Quality, safety, and compliance: Ensure systems meet applicable reliability, safety, regulatory, contractual, and quality requirements, with evidence appropriate to each programme.
Strategy and roadmap: Contribute to technical strategy and product roadmaps, identifying opportunities to improve system performance, modularity, manufacturability, serviceability, and scalability.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Operations (009-01361)
jobs.text:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates
Job Role: Head of Product and Operations
Work Schedule: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Australian Business Hours
Compensation range: $3,000 AUD - $4,500 AUD / Monthly (before tax and deductions)
Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.
Who The Client Is: We’re a community-driven platform built to connect local businesses with fundraisers in a way that benefits everyone. By making it easy for merchants to share offers and for groups to raise funds, we create a simple, win-win model that drives growth, engagement, and impact without the usual barriers. Our mission is to keep commerce and community working hand in hand, making support effortless and rewarding.
Role Overview: We are not looking for a virtual assistant, general administrator or software developer.
We’re looking for a senior Product & Operations leader with previous experience working within a SaaS, marketplace, membership, subscription, fintech, loyalty/rewards, or comparable digital platform.
The successful candidate will take significant responsibility away from the Founder, owning the day-to-day operation of the platform and coordinating the technology, systems, and processes required for the company to scale.
This role requires someone who can identify problems, investigate root causes, determine effective solutions, and follow them through to completion with minimal direction.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Ownership
Own and maintain the company’s product roadmap.
Translate commercial requirements into clear development specifications.
Prioritise features, improvements and bugs.
Manage external developers and technology partners.
Challenge development estimates and timelines where appropriate.
Establish acceptance criteria for development.
Coordinate releases.
Maintain product and technical documentation.
QA & Technology Management
Take ownership of QA and regression testing.
Test development before production release.
Maintain bugs and issue registers.
Manage development priorities and delivery.
Understand web/mobile applications, APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure sufficiently to manage technical suppliers.
Coordinate security, backups, platform reliability and technical issues.
The successful candidate does not need to code, but must be technically confident enough to manage developers effectively.
Fundraiser Operations
Manage the operational process from:
Signed → Onboarding → Setup → Launch → Active
Including fundraiser accounts, pages, payment configuration, dashboards, reporting and support.
Merchant Operations
Manage:
Signed → Onboarding → Offer Setup → Approval → Live → Ongoing Management
Including merchant information, locations, offers, codes, terms and offer accuracy.
Member & Payment Operations
Oversee:
Registration → Payment → Fundraiser Allocation → Membership Activation → Usage → Renewal
Including Stripe/payment issues, failed payments, refunds, membership status and reconciliation.
Customer Support
Establish and manage support processes for:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Build systems, FAQs, documentation and automation that reduce repetitive support requirements.
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain management reporting covering:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Membership sales
Revenue
Fundraising distributions
Payments
Renewals
Customer support
Product development
Platform performance
Management should have a clear weekly view of the health of the business.
Automation & Scalability
A major part of this role is identifying manual processes and progressively automating them.
We want someone constantly asking:
“How can the company support 1,000 fundraisers and 100,000+ members without needing a huge operations team?"

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - India
jobs.text:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
About the role
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
What you’ll do
Sell
Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements
Deliver
Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time
Manage People
Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume
You may be a fit if
You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliances
jobs.text:
Grow Your Career with GTT!
Join GTT to be part of a global mission to simply and securely connect people and data through innovative, AI-driven solutions. We empower curious, adaptive professionals to take ownership of their work, offering a culture where your ideas have a visible, real-world reach. If you are energized by complex challenges and a supportive team that lifts each other up, GTT is the place to build a rewarding career.
Shape strategic technology partnerships that drive innovation, strengthen market differentiation, and accelerate business growth.
We are looking for a Director, Technology Alliances to lead and expand a portfolio of strategic technology partnerships that support our product strategy and long-term growth objectives.
About the Role
As Director, Technology Alliances, you will be responsible for developing alliance strategies, managing executive-level partner relationships, and driving collaborative go-to-market initiatives. You will play a key role in influencing vendor roadmaps, identifying new growth opportunities, and ensuring that partnerships deliver commercial value, operational effectiveness, and differentiated customer outcomes. Success in this role requires strong relationship management, commercial acumen, and the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Alliance Management
Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key technology vendors, software partners, and industry ecosystem participants.
Create and execute alliance strategies aligned with product portfolio objectives and company growth priorities.
Establish executive-level engagement models and governance frameworks with strategic partners.
Conduct regular business reviews, roadmap reviews, and strategic planning sessions with vendors.
Manage partner tiering and classification models to ensure appropriate focus and investment.
Business Development & Go-to-Market
Develop joint business plans and partnership growth strategies.
Support co-marketing initiatives, sales enablement activities, joint customer engagements, and lead generation programs.
Work with Marketing and Sales teams to develop compelling joint value propositions and solution positioning.
Identify and support revenue-generating opportunities that leverage partner technologies and programmes.
Coordinate participation in partner programmes, certifications, designations, and incentive schemes.
Commercial & Operational Management
Support negotiation of commercial agreements, partnership terms, incentives, and business commitments.
Collaborate with Procurement and Legal teams on contracts, renewals, governance structures, and compliance requirements.
Monitor partner performance, commitments, and value realization against agreed objectives and KPIs.
Manage escalation processes and resolve operational or commercial issues affecting partnership success.
Ensure partnership investments deliver measurable business outcomes and customer value.
What We're Looking For
Essential Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in technology alliances, partner management, product management, business development, vendor management, or strategic partnerships.
Experience managing relationships with technology vendors in networking, cloud, cybersecurity, software, or managed services.
Familiarity with major technology partner ecosystems, including HPE Aruba, Fortinet, and Palo Alto.
Demonstrated experience influencing executive stakeholders and managing strategic partnerships.
Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and business case development experience.
Understanding of technology product lifecycle management and go-to-market processes.
Ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional organisations.
Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Experience in Telecommunications, Technology, or complex B2B services environments.
Nice to have
Relevant industry certifications and alliance programme accreditations.
Hours / Travel / Shift
Normal Office Hours. Remote with flexibility to travel as and when required for customer/team meetings.
Why Join GTT?
At GTT, you’ll join a global, collaborative culture built around ownership, customer focus and continuous learning.
Adaptive mindset: We meet change head-on to build the capabilities we need now. We take personal ownership of our professional development to keep pace with change and actively drive it.
Collective impact: We treat innovation as a team sport, working powerfully together to create extraordinary impact. We collaborate openly and with a shared purpose and amplify our unique human strengths to solve complex challenges that technology alone cannot.
Customer ownership: We own our customers’ success, whether an internal stakeholder or an external client. We take full accountability, anticipate their needs and create smooth experiences to build trust with every touchpoint. In an automated world, personal ownership is GTT’s competitive edge.
You’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact, grow your career and help shape how GTT delivers value to enterprise customers worldwide.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Director, Real World Data (RWD)
jobs.text:
About this opportunity:
As the Senior Director of Real World Data (RWD), you will be accountable for defining, developing, and implementing our RWD strategy, platform, and data pipeline to transform diverse real-world datasets into regulatory-grade, research-ready assets that drive our clinical development, evidence generation, digital health products and product offerings. You will play a key role informing regulatory decisions, improving clinical trial efficiency, evaluating and implementing AI/agentic workflows to strengthen our RWD platform and help bridge the gap between clinical research and medical practice to improve patient outcomes and advance our vision of a world without disease.
The Senior Director will lead all informatics aspects of developing and maintaining a “regulatory-grade” RWD pipeline. Specifically, the Senior Director will lead the RWD Informatics team in turning electronic health records (EHR), claims, imaging, and other RWD sources into research-ready datasets accessible by our biostatisticians,computational scientists and other end users while ensuring data quality, operational efficiency, and scalability.
These efforts will contribute to developing and commercializing a portfolio of early cancer detection products — based on both clinical and multiomics data — and digital health solutions that will enable payers, providers, and patients to catch cancers early when curative intervention is most achievable.
The role reports to the Chief Product Officer. This role will be a Remote role.
What you’ll do:
Lead the operations and continuous improvement of our RWD curation pipeline, managing internal and external resources as needed. Evaluate and integrate agentic workflows and AI to ensure accuracy, augment the interpretability and quality, and drive efficiencies across our RWD efforts. This includes:
Designing and implementing processes, analytical methods, and AI tools to integrate a variety of RWD sources.
Preparing data for analysis, including data cleaning and mapping.
Ensuring “regulatory-grade” data quality where required.
Developing a scalable unstructured data curation operation, leveraging automation as much as possible and only transiently leveraging manual techniques with a roadmap towards eliminating these steps as appropriate.
Create a comprehensive, multi-year strategy for the acquisition, management, curation, and use of RWD to support regulatory submissions, clinical evidence generation, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and commercial efforts such as patient identification and care navigation.
Architect, build, and maintain a robust, efficient, and scalable RWD platform and pipeline capable of ingesting, linking, harmonizing, and curating large, complex, and disparate real-world datasets such as Electronic Health Records (EHRs), claims data, imaging, and registries of structured and unstructured data.
Lead clinical data analyses to support product strategy, development and commercialization to improve Freenome’s access to RWD and enhance future product offerings for HCOs.
Serve as the RWD expert, proactively collaborating with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Engineering, Science and Product and Commercial teams to ensure the RWD pipeline meets diverse end-user needs, clinical, scientific and commercial objectives.
Contribute to defining the strategic direction of Freenome's data initiatives, in partnership with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Support data acquisition by conducting technical due diligence, facilitating data acquisition agreements and defining data delivery specifications and lead data product implementation efforts into Freenome’s platforms with strategic partners and customers.
Oversee the translation of raw RWD datasets into research-ready, regulatory-grade datasets, following OMOP or other industry-standard models, suitable for rigorous statistical analysis and real-world evidence (RWE) generation.
Foster a quality mindset through data quality checks, governance policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure the integrity, privacy, security, and traceability of all RWD assets to meet regulatory requirements.
Develop the team, building technical and leadership capabilities and coaching for high-performance proficiency.
Directly lead a team of clinical informaticists and data analysts through clear direction and priorities and hands-on management to enable focused execution in alignment with company objectives.
Manage the RWD department budget, ensuring efficient resource utilization and allocation of expenditures.
Build and maintain a culture of collaboration and inclusivity both within RWD and cross-functionally across Freenome.
Must haves:
Master’s or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
At least 12 years of progressive experience in clinical informatics, including experience with:
EHR, claims, other structured and unstructured RWD, and molecular data.
Applying RWD to device, therapeutic and/or software product development.
RWD across multiple disease areas, including oncology.
At least 10 years of experience building and leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary teams.
Demonstrated success operating within a matrixed organization and proactively collaborating with teams of internal and external partners to guide product delivery from concept to completion.
Passion for getting in the trenches, leading by example, and scaling technical platforms and teams.
Excellent written and verbal communicator with strong stakeholder management capabilities and problem-solving skills.
Experience leading data modeling, terminology normalization, data curation and/or unstructured data abstraction via natural language processing (NLP).
Deep knowledge of ontologies commonly used by health systems and payers (ICD-10, HCPCS, CPT, LOINC, RxNorm).
Experience with Python, R, and/or SQL.
Nice to haves:
Experience supporting real-world evidence FDA submissions or payer/guideline dossiers.
Clinical background (MD, NP, RN, or similar) and/or degree in health informatics.
Experience with cloud-based data storage and processing environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience working directly with health systems or data vendors on data licensing and ingestion projects.
Benefits and additional information:
The US target range of our base salary rate for new hires is $236,300 - $335,475. You will also be eligible to receive equity, cash bonuses, and a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the position offered. Please note that individual total compensation for this position will be determined at the Company’s sole discretion and may vary based on several factors, including but not limited to, location, skill level, years and depth of relevant experience, and education. We invite you to check out our career page @ for additional company information.
Freenome is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, and we value diversity. Freenome does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.
Family & Medical Leave Act (FMLA)

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
We are building a Digital Concierge Platform for 2–4 star hotels that transforms every hotel room into a digital sales channel for local services. Guests discover and book experiences, wellness, dining, and more via a simple QR code—while hotels unlock new revenue streams without additional operational effort.
The founding team consists of two experienced and successful entrepreneurs with a strong track record in building and scaling companies.
Our next step: build the MVP → launch pilot hotels and partners → raise seed funding.
Your Role
As CTO, you are a technical co-founder responsible for building the entire platform—from architecture to launch.
You will work directly with the founders and have full ownership of the product and tech vision.
Tasks
Your Mission (0–6 months)
Phase 1: MVP (0–3 months)
Define and build the technical architecture
Develop a mobile-first web or app MVP
Implement core features:
QR-based entry experience
Location-based content delivery
Booking and payment flows (via APIs)
Rapid iteration with real pilot customers
Phase 2: Validation & Fundraising
Stabilize and scale the platform
Integrate initial partners (via APIs or manual onboarding)
Support technical due diligence with investors
Requirements
Strong full-stack engineering background (e.g., React / Next.js / Node / Python or
similar)
Proven experience building MVPs and scalable platforms
Product mindset—you think in solutions, not just features
Ideally experience with:
Marketplace models
Booking and payment integrations
Location-based services
Hands-on builder mentality with the ability to scale into a leadership role
Startup mindset: speed over perfection
Benefits
What We Offer
Equity-based co-founder role
Opportunity to build a globally scalable product from scratch
Close collaboration with experienced serial entrepreneurs
Clear vision with a strong, revenue-driven business model
Compensation
No salary for the first 3–4 months
Focus: build MVP & secure funding
Salary and team expansion after successful fundraising
Why This Is Exciting
Large, clearly defined global market (hotels worldwide)
Immediate monetization potential (commission-based model)
Not a “nice-to-have,” but a revenue engine for hotels
Strong go-to-market strategy (QR + co-branding + local partnerships)

jobs.title: Director of Product, EQA
jobs.text:
Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) is seeking a Director of Product to lead and scale a high-performing product organization responsible for both defining the future of our portfolio growth investments and delivering strong in-market performance today.
In this role, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle of hardware and software products in the healthcare equipment quality assurance market. You will lead a team of Product Managers and Product Planners to ensure clear decisions on what to build, when to build it, and how to win in-market.
You will operate at both the strategic and business operations level, balancing long-term growth strategy with near-term results and influencing key stakeholders across the organization. Success in this role requires the ability to drive transformation, scale teams and processes, and consistently deliver measurable business outcomes.
Who You Are
Product leader with a demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels across a complex portfolio
Strong decision-maker who drives clarity on investment priorities, portfolio tradeoffs, and resource allocation
Builder of high-performing and engaged teams
results oriented leader, focused on driving growth, profitability, and competitive advantage
Influential communicator who can align senior stakeholders on a path for action
Key Responsibilities Portfolio Leadership & Business Performance
Own the end-to-end performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, margin, growth, and competitive positioning
Drive strategic alignment between maximizing new product introductions and sustaining investments across product lines.
Establish accountability for delivering business outcomes across the organization
Ensure data-driven and financially grounded roadmap decisions through innovation funnel stage gate processes
Product Strategy & Innovation Oversight
Lead front-end innovation and product planning, ensuring focus on high-impact opportunities
Drive use of market insights, Voice of Customer, and competitive intelligence in decisions
Oversee product strategies, business cases, and portfolio roadmaps
Drive enterprise-level prioritization and tradeoff decisions
Portfolio Execution & Lifecycle Management
Ensure successful execution of price changes, launching new products, and end-of-life transitions
Ensure timely investment required to sustain mature product lines
Ensure responsiveness to market and competitive dynamics
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers and Product Planners
Evolve product organization structure to support scale and growth for hardware and software products
Establish clear expectations, metrics, and development pathways for your team
Build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Cross-Functional Leadership & Operating Cadence
Partner with Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, and Quality to achieve business outcomes
Drive consistent operating cadence across teams including portfolio management and operations reviews
Align priorities, tradeoffs, and execution plans
Represent product leadership in executive forums
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of product management or portfolio leadership experience
Proven track record of delivering results through a team in a matrix org structure
Experience across strategy, product development, and business operations processes
Ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders
Growth mindset and adaptability
Preferred
MBA or equivalent strategic leadership experience
Experience in biomedical, healthcare, or technical product markets
Experience with continuous improvement tools and methodologies
Key Skills & Attributes
Strong portfolio leadership and business ownership mindset
Ability to integrate strategy and execution
Strong decision-making under ambiguity
Organizational leadership and team-building skills
Results-oriented with focus on business outcomes
What Success Looks Like
Lead and develop a high-performing product organization
Strong revenue growth, margin, and competitiveness in the marketplace
Robust pipeline of innovation opportunities
Aligned and well-executed product strategies that incorporate hardware and software
Effective product launches and product lifecycle management
Fortive Corporation Overview
Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.
We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.
At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.
At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.
Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.
About Fluke Health Solutions
Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. LANDAUER measures radiation exposure with dosimeter and radiation monitoring badges. RaySafe is the worldwide leader of X-ray test equipment, real-time staff dosimetry, and radiation survey meters. And Victoreen instruments are the trusted source for radiation monitoring systems and quality assurance for nuclear power professionals.At FHS, we believe in your potential — your ability to learn, grow and contribute in meaningful ways. And we believe in giving you the opportunity, accountability, and visibility to do just that.
We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .
Bonus or Equity
This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.
Pay Range
The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 133,600.00 - 248,500.00

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.text:
Sobre a Clicksign
Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.
Como trabalhamos:
Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.
Descrição da vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a)Diretor(a) de Tecnologia, que fará parte da liderança executiva da empresa, atuando em parceria com Produto e demais áreas do Negócio, para acelerar a execução da estratégia da companhia, no âmbito da Tecnologia e Inteligência Artificial. Procuramos uma liderança capaz de construir uma organização de Tecnologia de alta performance; desenvolver pessoas, incluindo lideranças; e preparar o time para escalar de forma sustentável. Seu dia a dia contará com:
Definir e executar a estratégia de Tecnologia, garantindo uma plataforma moderna, escalável, resiliente e preparada para o crescimento da empresa.
Desenvolver e potencializar as lideranças de Tecnologia, formando sucessores e construindo uma organização capaz de escalar de forma sustentável.
Atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, fortalecendo uma cultura de alta performance, autonomia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.
Liderar a evolução da empresa para uma organização AI-First, incorporando Inteligência Artificial aos produtos, processos e ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
Garantir o alinhamento entre Tecnologia, Produto e Negócio, transformando estratégia em execução consistente e geração de valor para clientes e empresa.
Promover excelência técnica por meio de práticas modernas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento de software, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, Observabilidade e Continuous Delivery.
Gerenciar Tecnologia como um portfólio de investimentos, equilibrando inovação, evolução da plataforma, dívida técnica, segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência operacional.
Gerenciar orçamento, infraestrutura e decisões estratégicas de investimento, buscando o melhor equilíbrio entre custo, inovação e crescimento.
Experiência
Experiência consolidada em posições executivas de Tecnologia.
Histórico na construção e escalabilidade de organizações de Tecnologia de alta performance.
Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de líderes, formação de sucessores e evolução organizacional.
Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, liderando plataformas de alta escala e produtos digitais.
Experiência atuando em parceria com Produto e áreas de negócio na definição e execução de estratégias corporativas.
Qualificações técnicas
Sólido conhecimento em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e cloud computing.
Sólida experiência com Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, Observabilidade e Continuous Delivery.
Conhecimento em métricas de engenharia, como DORA, SPACE e Flow Metrics.
Experiência na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial para ganho de produtividade, automação e inovação.
Vivência em gestão financeira de Tecnologia, orçamento e alocação estratégica de investimentos.
Competências
Capacidade comprovada de desenvolver líderes e construir organizações de alta performance.
Visão estratégica e forte orientação para resultados.
Excelente comunicação e influência junto à liderança executiva.
Pensamento sistêmico para equilibrar inovação, velocidade, qualidade e eficiência.
Perfil colaborativo, com foco em desenvolvimento organizacional e cultura.
Diferenciais
Experiência em empresas SaaS, B2B ou B2B2C de alto crescimento.
Vivência em transformação organizacional e modernização tecnológica.
Experiência na implementação de estratégias AI-First.
Conhecimento em Engineering Economics e gestão de portfólio de investimentos.
Informações adicionais
O que você pode esperar da gente?
Trabalho 100% remoto.
Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

jobs.title: VP, Product Strategy & Operations
jobs.text:
Overview
We are looking for a VP of Product Strategy & Program Management to build and lead the operational and strategic backbone of our Product organization. This leader will own the connective tissue between product strategy and product execution - ensuring our roadmap is grounded in rigorous market intelligence, our launches land with commercial and customer impact, our cross-functional programs run predictably, and our product documentation is accurate, discoverable, and enterprise-grade.
This is a builder role. You'll stand up and mature four disciplines - Market Analysis, Launch Excellence, Program Management, and Product Documentation - inside a product organization that is scaling its maturity and rigor. You'll partner directly with the CPO, product line leaders, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to make sure great products actually reach the market and the market actually understands them.
Responsibilities
What You'll Own
Market Strategy & Analysis
Lead competitive intelligence, market sizing, and segmentation analysis that directly informs roadmap prioritization and portfolio strategy
Build repeatable frameworks for tracking market dynamics, buyer needs, and competitive positioning
Translate market insight into inputs product leaders and executives can act on - not just reports that sit on a shelf
Launch Excellence
Own the end-to-end launch framework: readiness criteria, cross-functional launch plans, tiering models, and post-launch retrospectives
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success to ensure every release has a commercial and adoption plan, not just a ship date
Establish the metrics that define launch success and hold the org accountable to them
Program Management
Build and lead a program management function that drives predictability across complex, cross-functional product initiatives
Own portfolio-level visibility: roadmap execution tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and executive reporting
Instill lightweight but durable operating rhythms (planning cycles, status reporting, escalation paths) appropriate for a scaling PM organization
Product Documentation
Lead the team responsible for product documentation, release notes, and internal/external knowledge resources
Ensure documentation quality keeps pace with product complexity, particularly for enterprise and technical buyers
Build scalable documentation processes that reduce support burden and improve customer self-sufficiency
Team & Organizational Leadership
Hire, develop, and lead a team of market analysis, launch, program management, and documentation specialists
Define career pathing and craft standards for a discipline that is often under-resourced and under-defined - you'll be building the operating model, not inheriting one
Act as a force multiplier for the CPO, translating strategic priorities into operational execution across the product org
Qualifications
Qualifications
10+ years in product strategy, product operations, program management, or a related discipline, with at least 3–5 years leading teams
Track record of building or significantly maturing a product operations, strategy, or program management function inside a scaling or transforming organization
Strong command of market analysis and competitive intelligence methods, and comfort turning ambiguous market signals into clear strategic recommendations
Demonstrated success running high-stakes product launches with measurable commercial outcomes
Program management rigor - you can run a portfolio, not just a project - with fluency in tools and frameworks for tracking cross-functional execution
Experience overseeing or partnering closely with technical documentation functions; you understand what “good” looks like for enterprise/technical audiences
Excellent executive communication skills; you can operate comfortably in front of the C-suite and PE/board audiences
Comfortable operating in an organization where product management maturity is still being built - you thrive on creating structure, not just working within it
Experience in enterprise software, legal technology, eDiscovery, or another complex B2B/enterprise domain is a plus
Why This Role Matters
Product strategy without execution rigor is just a slide deck. This role exists to make sure that doesn't happen - that every roadmap decision is grounded in real market understanding, every launch has a plan behind it, every cross-functional initiative has an owner and a rhythm, and every customer-facing document reflects the quality of the product itself. You'll report directly to the CPO and have a direct hand in shaping how the product organization operates as it scales.
Consilio’s True North Values
Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.
Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Vice President of Enterprise Technology
jobs.text:
About AutoRABIT
AutoRABIT is revolutionizing DevOps and data protection for Salesforce teams operating in complex, highly regulated environments. Our platform integrates CI/CD, compliance, release orchestration, and AI powered automation to improve software delivery, reduce risk, and increase velocity. With a foundation in Lean principles, we are focused on eliminating waste, driving innovation, and delivering scalable value for our customers.
Position Summary
AutoRABIT is seeking a strategic and hands on Vice President of Enterprise Technology to lead the organization's Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Corporate IT functions. This executive will be responsible for scaling and operating a secure, highly available, and scalable AI-focused technology environment that supports both our internal teams and our global customer base.
This role is instrumental in advancing AutoRABIT's operational maturity while supporting our FedRAMP authorization efforts and ongoing compliance with federal security requirements. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for operational excellence in global high growth SaaS environments.
Working closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, the Vice President of Enterprise Technology will define the technology operations strategy, strengthen enterprise production infrastructure and internal technical stack, and ensure our systems meet the reliability, security, and performance expectations of enterprise and government customers.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Technology Leadership
Lead the SRE and Corporate IT organizations while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop and execute the enterprise technology strategy in partnership with the CTO.
Build and mentor high performing technical leaders and engineering teams.
Drive organizational maturity through scalable operational processes, automation, and modern technology practices.
Site Reliability Engineering & Operations
Own platform reliability, availability, incident response, observability, compliance, and operational readiness.
Establish and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and operational KPIs.
Lead major incident management, root cause analysis, and post incident reviews.
Champion automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Enterprise Infrastructure & IT
Lead the strategy and execution of enterprise IT services including identity management, endpoint management, networking, collaboration platforms, and corporate systems.
Ensure secure, scalable technology solutions that support a distributed workforce.
Oversee IT service delivery, ensuring timely resolution of support requests while actively managing and assisting with IT tickets and escalations as needed.
Evaluate and modernize enterprise technology platforms to improve employee productivity and operational efficiency.
Security, Compliance & FedRAMP
Partner with Security and Compliance teams to support FedRAMP authorization and ongoing compliance initiatives.
Ensure operational processes align with NIST 800-53 controls and other regulatory frameworks.
Collaborate with Engineering to embed security, governance, and compliance into operational workflows.
Support audits, continuous monitoring activities, and customer security assessments.
Executive Leadership
Partner with executive leadership to align enterprise technology initiatives with company objectives.
Present operational metrics, risks, and strategic recommendations to the executive team.
Manage departmental budgets, resource planning, and vendor relationships.
Serve as the executive leader during critical customer escalations and major production incidents.
Required Skills & Experience
10+ years of experience leading enterprise infrastructure, cloud operations, SRE, platform engineering, or enterprise technology organizations.
5+ years of executive or senior leadership experience managing multiple technical organizations.
Proven experience leading Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Enterprise Operations teams.
Hands on technical expertise with modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience supporting FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, or other regulated compliance frameworks.
Strong understanding of enterprise IT, cloud architecture, networking, identity management, and security best practices.
Experience with Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and DevSecOps methodologies.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience leading remote, geographically distributed technical teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading enterprise technology organizations within a SaaS company.
Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps or enterprise software delivery platforms.
Experience supporting enterprise or government customers.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Security Specialty, or similar certifications are preferred.
Compensation
Base Salary: $250,000 to $280,000 USD + variable
Must be a US citizen/permanent resident, and capable of obtaining a Government Security clearance if required and live in and work from the US. Green card holders qualify, but H1B or other work visa holders do not qualify for this role.
THIS IS A 100% REMOTE JOB, but requires 10% travel and an in-person component to the interview process.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President - Data Analytics – Retirement Division - Remote
jobs.text:
Symetra is seeking an Assistant Vice President, Data Analytics to help drive our transformation into a data‑driven enterprise focusing on our annuities and retirement solutions division. In this senior leadership role, you’ll shape strategy, lead high‑impact analytics initiatives, and guide teams that build the insights and capabilities powering our business decisions.
About the role
In this role, you will lead cross‑functional teams—including data engineers, architects, developers, BI analysts, and data scientists—to deliver analytics solutions that make a meaningful impact across Symetra. You’ll partner closely with business and technology leaders to understand needs, design data‑driven strategies, and execute plans that support innovation, efficiency, revenue growth, and an exceptional customer experience.
What You will Do
Strategic Leadership & Partnership
Develop and implement Symetra’s data and analytics strategy in collaboration with IT leaders and business partners.
Build strong partnerships across sales, marketing, customer experience, underwriting, claims, actuarial, innovation, and other teams.
Find opportunities to improve efficiency, generate revenue, and enhance customer experience through analytics.
Establish clear key performance indicators, return on investment metrics, and data literacy initiatives across the organization.
Advanced Analytics, AI & Modeling
Drive innovation by leading both hands on and coaching efforts in descriptive analytics, predictive modeling, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
Apply sound judgment in selecting the right modeling approach—from simple to complex—based on business need and data maturity.
Data Management, Governance & BI
Supervise the creation and maintenance of a stable, trusted, and scalable enterprise data environment.
Promote high quality reporting and BI solutions that enable self-service analytics.
Ensure responsible data usage and compliance with privacy guidelines.
Enhance enterprise data assets through thoughtful integration of third-party data.
Team Leadership & Development
Lead and mentor technical teams, including direct and matrixed reports.
Set clear responsibilities, foster collaboration, and develop team talent.
Model a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and innovation.
Why Work at Symetra
Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:
“If you want to work for a company that is always considering its employees while working towards sustainable growth this is that company. Within Symetra, there is always innovation, empowerment, and growth opportunities, all while providing us with a great work/life balance and incredible benefits for a very reasonable cost!” - Cindy J. G., Sr. Product Owner
"Symetra will spoil you. There aren't many companies that will put as much effort into you being a success as Symetra. The culture will challenge you but simultaneously put you at ease. Failure is seen as integral to the learning process so there is less reason to be fearful of it." - Kerry S., Sr. Systems Analyst
What we offer you
Benefits and Perks
We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.
Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview
Compensation
Salary Range: $188,500 - $314,100 plus eligibility for annual bonus program and long-term incentive plan
Who You Are
10+ years of proven experience in data analytics, data science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience leading, mentoring and developing technical teams.
Hands on technical expertise with Python, DBT, and Snowflake.
Proficiency with modern data mining, analytics, and visualization tools.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex concepts clearly.
Strategic problem solver with a track record of motivating change and building consensus.
Demonstrated curiosity and familiarity with AI and its implications at the enterprise level of an organization.
Skilled relationship‑builder who can influence at all levels of the organization.
Continuous learner who stays current on industry trends and emerging technologies.
High School Diploma required, bachelor’s degree or higher preferred.
Ability to travel occasionally as needed.
Travel:
Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.
Reasonable Accommodations
Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
