jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect / Technical Architect Director - Data Foundation Deli
jobs.text:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Customer Success
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.
This role leads the advisory, architecture, and delivery of enterprise Data Foundation engagements for Salesforce Professional Services customers. Drawing on deep data experience (10+ years for the Senior Technical Architect level; 15+ years for the Director level), you run discovery, set the technical vision, design/approve the target architecture, and drive delivery across a progressive, customer-calibrated maturity journey — advising customer stakeholders (up to CxO level at the Director tier) along the way.
You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.
You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. This is a customer-billable delivery role — a hands-on/senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
Advisory & Strategy
Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)
Represent the practice in complex, high-stakes engagements
Architecture & Delivery
Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines
Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)
Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management
AI-Augmented Delivery
Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP
Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)
Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery
Governance & Enablement
Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)
What You Bring (Preferred Experience)
Unified Identity & Harmonization — identity resolution, match/merge, golden records
Master Data Management — domains, survivorship, hierarchies, 360 views
Unstructured Data Management — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, RAG grounding
Data Architecture & Semantic Modeling — conceptual/logical/physical models, semantic layer, glossary
Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events, activation
Data Trust, Security & Privacy — classification, access control, masking, Einstein Trust Layer
Data Governance & Stewardship — catalog, lineage, data quality, stewardship & policy
Industry Data Models & Accelerators — FSC, Health Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud blueprints
Data Platform & Infrastructure — lakehouse, compute, catalog, cloud foundation
Analytics, BI & Data Observability — dashboards, self-service BI, freshness/quality monitoring
Required Qualifications
10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)
Executive-grade communication, up to proven CxO-level advisory at senior levels; ability to guide delivery teams and lead multi-workstream delivery
Experience integrating a vendor platform into heterogeneous/complex enterprise landscapes — balancing platform-agnostic and platform-centric approaches
Hands-on-to-deep fluency with AI-augmented delivery — using AI tools as a core part of the workflow and building reusable prompt/skill/agent assets
A forward-looking, and at senior levels recognized/published, perspective on enterprise data, AI, and the agentic future of SaaS
Certifications
Certifications are preferred, not required — a proven delivery and thought-leadership track record carries the most weight.
Preferred Certifications
Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
Salesforce Certified Data Architect
Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Director)
MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Sr. Architect level)
TOGAF (Director)
Additional Pluses
Informatica IDMC / MDM certification
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (Sr. Architect level)
MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect (Director level)
DAMA CDMP or CDMC
Preferred / Differentiating Strengths
Experience/track record delivering agentic AI / RAG on a governed data foundation
Industry depth/expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing (industry data models)
Track record/history building reusable accelerators and prompt/skill/agent libraries
Prior Professional Services / customer-facing advisory or leadership experience at enterprise scale
How Success Is Measured (First 12 Months)
Certification Attainment: complete required certifications to be compliant and ready for customer engagements
Discovery-to-roadmap / Customer impact: consistently produce customer-calibrated maturity assessments and roadmaps that secure signed charters; ramp quickly to be billable on one or more engagements
Delivery / Architecture standard: ship working, governed capability increments each phase, with consistent, governed, dual-purpose foundations across the portfolio
Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels
Thought leadership: bring a credible agentic-SaaS-future perspective into engagements; at Director level, own a defined, published practice POV shaping customer engagements and market positioning
Governance / Enablement: leave every engagement with a sustainable stewardship and operating model; delivery teams ramped and productive through technical leadership
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
Accommodations
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
Posting Statement
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $313,700 annually. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.
Founded by the team that scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ in ARR and secured more than $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.
Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely.We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Product Engineering organization, the team responsible for Turnkey's core product. This spans our TEE- and HSM-based key verification and signing systems, the APIs, SDKs, and interfaces built on top of them, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable. This is a senior leadership role reporting to our CTO/Co-Founder Jack Kearney, owning both the technical direction and the people leadership of the org. If you're excited about the potential that web3 has to radically change the world for the better and have a sincere desire to help facilitate that change, join us as we redefine decentralized development.
What You'll Do
Strategic Vision and Leadership
Own the engineering strategy and technical vision for Turnkey's Product Engineering organization, spanning key management, the APIs and interfaces built on top of it, transaction processing, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable.
Build, manage, and grow a high-performing engineering org, including hiring and developing engineering managers and senior ICs
Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to translate customer and market needs into a clear technical roadmap
Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends in web3 and guide their integration into our product
Contribute to company-wide strategic planning and technical decision-making as a member of the engineering leadership team
Organizational & People Leadership
Define and evolve the org structure, leveling, and career paths for the Product Engineering team as it scales
Drive recruitment, onboarding, and retention of top engineering talent across the org
Set and uphold engineering rituals (planning, incident review, on-call, etc.) that keep the org fast-moving and accountable
Coach and develop managers and senior engineers, building a durable leadership bench
Architectural Oversight & Technical Direction
Provide technical guidance across security-critical product systems, ensuring intelligent architectural decisions that scale with customer demand without compromising trust
Oversee the design and implementation of TEE- and HSM-based key management and signing systems, the APIs, SDKs, and dashboards built on top of them, transaction construction and broadcast systems, and the infrastructure that makes our security guarantees independently verifiable
Ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of product infrastructure, addressing the complexities of decentralized systems and adversarial threat models
Define and drive processes that ensure quality and consistency across product development, from design through deployment
What We're Looking For
Proven experience managing engineering managers and/or leading a multi-team engineering org (not just individual teams)
Deep understanding of modern application architectures and security-critical systems (e.g., HSMs, TEEs, key management), with the ability to lead in-depth technical discussions and make final calls on tradeoffs
A track record of shipping security-critical or developer-facing products (key management, signing infrastructure, APIs, or SDKs) at scale
Excellence at holding a high bar on software quality and engineering process, even while moving fast
A healthy amount of paranoia :-)
Style Points
Prior experience working in fast-paced crypto/web3 and/or FinTech companies, especially with exposure to custody, key management, or HSM/enclave-based systems
Experience scaling an engineering org through a significant growth stage (e.g., Series B → C, or comparable)
Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going
Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.
Compensation range
$250,000—$290,000 USD

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
Description
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.
We are seeking a VP of Product to lead our entire product & engineering organisation. This is one of the most expansive and demanding product leadership roles you will find in the market: the person in this role will own PM, Engineering, Design, Data, and PMM under a single umbrella — a scope typically reserved for C-suite executives at much larger companies.
The organisation you will lead includes 1 Director of Product, 8 PMs, 1 Director of UX & Design, 3 Designers, 1 Director of Data & Analytics, 6 data analysts, 1 data engineer, 1 Lead PMM, 1 VP of Engineering, and 30+ Engineers & QAs across two product tracks- Core Track and AI Clinic Track.
We have already shipped multiple AI initiatives:
AI Scribe that helps clinicians save time on writing progress notes
Chart Review AI that highlights deviations from clinical protocols
Agentic AI Receptionist that owns internal support processes
The role reports directly to the CEO.
We expect the person in this role to bring rare, genuine depth across product strategy, behavioural design, applied AI, data-driven decision making, and people leadership - and to operate effectively at both the executive and hands-on levels simultaneously.
Responsibilities
Define, refine, and execute the long-term AI-first product vision and strategy for MEDvidi
Lead, coach, and manage the full product & engineering organisation across both product tracks
Set and maintain a high bar for product quality and execution speed across all teams
Facilitate quarterly strategy and OKR planning at the executive level
Resolve cross-functional blockers and identify opportunities through direct day-to-day engagement with teams
Continuously improve product & engineering culture and processes
Collaborate with other department heads and the CEO on company-level initiatives
Requirements
10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple product teams
Experience leading cross-functional organisations that include design, data, and/or engineering - not just PM
Strong product sense: proven track record of both growing existing products and building new ones from 0 to 1
Hands-on experience building AI-first products, including practical knowledge of RAG systems, Agentic AI, and AI Evals
Ability to build an AI product prototype independently, without involving engineering
Experience with behavioural design - building product experiences that drive user behaviour, not just ship features
Executive-level communication skills: ability to bring clarity to complex, uncertain situations
Experience driving company-level strategy and quarterly OKR planning
Data-driven mindset: ability to diagnose issues with data using a segment → root cause → fix approach
Structured problem solving using issue trees, hypothesis trees, or equivalent frameworks
Culture fit: ownership, focus, radical transparency, evidence-based decisions
Advanced English (C1+) and fluent Russian
What we offer
High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
Time off: 22 paid vacation days annually, 5 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.
Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.
MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
Who we are and what you’ll do
HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products.
Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment.
Main objectives of the role
As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO.
Your role and responsibilities
Strategic Software Vision & Architecture: Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces.
Execution & High-Stakes Delivery: Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel
High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams: Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways.
Business-First Leadership: Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value.
Operational Leadership & Partnering: Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction.
AI Strategy & Development Workflows: Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities.
Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery.
Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use.
What you need to succeed in this role
Engineering Leadership: Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments
Deep-Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services.
Track Record of Ownership: Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.
Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders.
Pragmatic Decision-Making: Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction.
AI-Driven Development Strategy: Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows.
Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user.
We offer you
At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.
You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate.

jobs.title: Data Management Office Director
jobs.text:
We are seeking an experienced leader to join a Government Entity in Saudi Arabia as:
Data Management Office Director
The Data Management Office Director will be responsible for leading the organization’s data management and governance agenda, establishing the required frameworks, policies, and operating models to ensure data quality, compliance, and effective utilization of data across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the development and implementation of the organization’s Data Strategy and Data Management Office roadmap in alignment with organizational objectives and national data regulations and standards.
• Establish and oversee data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
• Lead initiatives related to data quality, data classification, data protection, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
• Oversee the development and continuous improvement of policies and procedures governing data management practices.
• Enable effective use of data to support executive decision-making, organizational performance, and strategic initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with applicable national data management, governance, and protection requirements.
• Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across business functions.
• Oversee initiatives related to data sharing, open data, master and reference data, and other relevant data management domains.
• Define and monitor Data Management Office KPIs, data maturity indicators, compliance metrics, and data quality performance.
• Promote a data-driven culture and increase organizational awareness of data governance and management practices.
• Build, lead, and develop the Data Management Office team while ensuring effective delivery against strategic priorities.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
CancerNavigator is a healthcare startup dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief
Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. Our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who help members get to fantastic experts for their care and help them through the thousands of other problems that arise across the cancer journey.
Join us to serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
The “VP of Engineering” Role
Role and Team:
As VP of Engineering, you’ll join CancerNavigator at a pivotal stage of growth and have the opportunity to shape what our engineering function becomes. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll initially operate as a highly hands-on technical leader—setting the technical strategy, defining the roadmap, and building alongside the team. Over time, you’ll take on leadership of our existing technical resources and build out the engineering organization needed to support our next stage of scale.
This is not a role where you’ll inherit a mature engineering organization or a predefined roadmap. You’ll work closely with leaders across the business to understand how our service operates today, identify the highest-impact opportunities for technology, and determine what we should build, buy, automate, or redesign.
Daily Work:
This is a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership role. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape both what we build and how engineering operates at CancerNavigator. You will:
Partner with our CEO and functional leaders to set the technical strategy and roadmap for the business.
Identify the highest-impact opportunities to use technology and AI to help our team serve more patients at scale.
Design and build foundational systems, particularly in the early stages of the role.
Lead the development of tools across patient navigation, communication, research, and healthcare data processing.
Grow and lead our engineering function, establishing the team, infrastructure, and practices we’ll need for our next stage of growth.
The Requirements
Engineering leadership experience, ideally in a VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar role within a health tech company.
Strong experience building technology in healthcare, with a deep understanding of HIPAA and the security, privacy, and data considerations that come with handling sensitive health information.
A track record of taking complex technical problems from strategy through architecture and hands-on execution.
Experience building and scaling technology for a tech-enabled service or other operationally complex business.
Experience with modern data infrastructure and cloud-based systems, with familiarity in Python and SQL.
Experience applying AI to automate back-end workflows, augment human operations, and build real-world products.
An entrepreneurial, hands-on approach—you’re comfortable setting the strategy, operating with ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves to build.
Strongly preferred: Experience working with medical claims, prior authorization, or other complex healthcare data.
Compensation and Benefits
Competitive salary and stock option package
Performance-based incentive compensation
Remote-first work; live where you want within the U.S.
All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year
Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
Unlimited PTO
Our Culture & Values, In Brief
We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.
We have three company values, which guide our company:
Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.
At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
jobs.text:
At DUAL North America, our core values dictate how we live and work. We are a group with independence and people at its heart and we are a home for talent with a unique culture: the biggest small company in the world.
The focus on being a People First business has always been at the very heart of the Group; Our vision was to create an independent business with a unique culture and one that would survive and thrive as a business controlled by the people working for it. And finding the most talented and entrepreneurial people to join the Group has been and will continue to be key.
DUAL North America, Inc. is seeking a
AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
Location: Remote
Classification: Exempt
Reports to: SVP Service Strategy
Travel: 10-15%
Salary range: $160,000-$180,000
Role overview
DUAL North America is seeking an AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management to lead enterprise technology delivery, release governance, and strategic project execution across the organization. This role requires a strong leader who can drive the successful planning, coordination, communication, and delivery of technology initiatives while ensuring alignment with business objectives.
The AVP will oversee a team of product owners, analysts and project professionals, manage complex cross-functional technology programs, establish release management best practices, and partner closely with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable solutions that support operational excellence and business growth.
Role responsibilities
Leadership and Strategy
Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for requirements management, release management, and project execution.
Partner with senior business and technology leaders to prioritize initiatives, manage delivery portfolios, and align technology investments with business outcomes.
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and execution excellence.
Release Management and Governance
Own and mature the enterprise release management function, including release planning, scheduling, governance, risk management, and deployment readiness.
Establish standardized release management processes, controls, and reporting to improve delivery predictability and quality.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of technology releases across applications, infrastructure, and business systems.
Drive release readiness reviews, dependency management, risk mitigation planning, and post-release assessments.
Ensure releases are delivered in accordance with organizational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.
Release Communications and Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating technical concepts into business-relevant information.
Develop and execute comprehensive release communication plans for business and technology stakeholders.
Provide timely updates regarding release schedules, impacts, milestones, risks, and deployment activities.
Present program status, release outcomes, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Technical Requirements Management
Lead the gathering, prioritization, and validation of technical and functional requirements for strategic technology initiatives.
Collaborate with architects, engineers and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are clearly defined and actionable.
Establish best practices for requirements management to improve solution quality, reduce rework, and accelerate delivery.
Ensure technical requirements align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and business objectives.
Project and Program Management
Lead complex technology projects and programs from initiation through implementation and operational transition.
Ensure delivery teams maintain alignment with scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business goals.
Drive cross-functional coordination to remove obstacles, resolve issues, and maintain project momentum.
Utilize SAFe Agile 6.0, and traditional project delivery methodologies as appropriate to maximize successful outcomes.
Data-Driven Delivery Excellence
Leverage reporting and analytics to monitor progress, identify risks, and support executive decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on performance trends and lessons learned.
Change Leadership and Organizational Readiness
Support organizational readiness activities that support successful adoption of new technology solutions and capabilities.
Partner with business stakeholders to ensure alignment between project delivery objectives and operational execution.
Promote best practices that improve delivery efficiency, team effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Key requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology delivery, project/program management, release management, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
PMP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Release Train Engineer (RTE), or equivalent certifications preferred.
Experience implementing enterprise release management frameworks and governance models preferred.
Extensive experience leading large-scale technology programs, enterprise initiatives, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Demonstrated expertise in Release Management, Project Management, and Technical Requirements Management within complex enterprise environments.
Strong knowledge of Agile SAFe 6, and traditional project management methodologies.
Proven success managing technology portfolios, release governance processes, and organizational transformation initiatives.
Experience working closely with architecture, engineering, infrastructure and business teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions.
Strong understanding of IT operations, software delivery lifecycles, governance frameworks, and technology strategy.
Demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, and competing priorities across multiple initiatives.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a focus on delivering measurable business value through technology.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing strategic planning with operational execution.
What we offer:
A career that you define. Yes, we offer all the usual rewards and benefits - including medical, dental, vision, a wide variety of wellbeing offers, competitive salary, unlimited PTO, 401k with company match, paid volunteer days and more.
We provide an environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated, where people who want to have a real hand in our success thrive. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.
EEO Statement:
We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect. DUAL North America provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. DUAL will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

jobs.title: Head of Product (B2B SaaS | EU)
jobs.text:
Synder is already a working, revenue-generating product used daily by ~5,000 businesses. Now we’re looking for someone who can take it further - grow MRR, improve retention, and reduce churn in a meaningful, measurable way.
We’re hiring a Head of Product who wants real ownership - not just roadmap management, but actual impact on the business.
About Synder
Synder is an accounting platform helping accounting professionals and business owners record, reconcile and recognize online sales and subscriptions.
For additional background:
Alumni of Y Combinator, a leading startup accelerator;
Alumni of the AICPA accelerator program for accounting innovations;
Platinum partner of Intuit QuickBooks;
Spotlighted as “Popular with Businesses in the United States” on the Shopify App Store;
$10B+ worth of transactions were processed by the platform in 2025.
What you'll do:
Own and drive product strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals
Take full responsibility for MRR growth, retention, and churn reduction
Lead and mentor Product team and partner with Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Sales to deliver impact
Use data, experimentation, and customer insights to drive decisions
Define and track core SaaS metrics (MRR, retention, churn, activation)
Improve onboarding, activation, and long-term product engagement
Ensure clear communication with leadership and stakeholders
Drive continuous improvement of product quality, scalability, and user experience
What we expect:
5+ years in Product Management in B2B SaaS companies
Proven experience leading product teams and mentoring PMs
Strong ownership of business metrics (MRR, retention, churn)
Experience managing and scaling mature, revenue-generating products
Deep understanding of product lifecycle: discovery → delivery → iteration
Strong analytical and structured thinking
Excellent communication skills (English C1+)
Comfortable working directly with founders/executives
Based in the European Union (mandatory)
Nice to have:
Experience in accounting, fintech, or payments
Familiarity with tools like QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, or NetSuite
Background in e-commerce or integrations-heavy products
What we offer:
Competitive compensation
$120/month allowance for insurance, sports, or wellness
30 business days of compensated break (full-time)
Fully remote setup
High-ownership culture with direct impact on company growth
Hiring Process:
HR Interview
Test Task
Final Interview with CEO
Reference Check & Offer
Ready to join?
If you’re excited to take full ownership of product strategy, drive growth metrics, and build a high-performing product team - we’d love to connect.
Apply now and let’s build the next stage of Synder together.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Payments and Wallet
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The Payments and Wallet team owns how money moves on Roblox starting with how players pay in, ending with how developers get paid out, and the wallet infrastructure that connects the two. Consumer facing payments are also the high impact area for driving revenue growth for the company. As Director of Product for Payments and Wallet, you will own this business end to end: setting the long-term strategy, standing up new banking and wallet products from zero users to all developers, and running the P&L for a meaningful revenue line at Roblox. You will lead a team of product managers and partner closely with Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Business Development to build payment and wallet products that work at global scale. This is a builder's role for someone who has taken a financial product from an idea to a business and wants to do it again on one of the largest user-generated platforms in the world.
This role is based in San Mateo, CA (hybrid with Tues-Thurs in office) and reports to the Sr. Director Product, Monetization and Payments.
You will:
Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Wallet, spanning consumer payment methods, developer and creator payouts, and the underlying wallet platform. This role also encompasses risk management and payment operations leadership.
Launch new banking and wallet products from 0 to 1, and scale it into a durable revenue stream.
Own the P&L for the Payments and Wallet business, including revenue and margin targets, cost of payments, and the investment tradeoffs required to hit them.
Build, lead, and grow a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, execution, and career development.
Ensure operational excellence for risk ops and payment ops
Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business Development to expand payment coverage internationally and to launch products that meet regulatory and licensing requirements in each market.
Establish the strategy for payments risk and fraud management, balancing authorization rates and user experience against loss, chargeback, and compliance exposure.
Represent the Payments and Wallet business to Roblox executive leadership and to external partners including processors, banking partners, and payment networks.
You have:
10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading and growing product teams.
A track record of launching a banking, wallet, or financial product from 0 to 1 and growing it into a meaningful business.
Direct P&L ownership, with demonstrated results driving revenue and managing cost structure for a product line.
Experience building and scaling global payments products, including working with processors, banking partners, alternative payment methods, and cross-border money movement.
Risk management and fraud expertise, including chargebacks, authorization optimization, KYC/AML, and regulatory compliance in financial products.
A technical approach: comfort going deep on platform and implementation details, and the ability to partner with engineering on scalable, extensible architecture.
A data-driven approach: proficiency identifying, defining, tracking, and acting on the metrics that move a financial business, plus familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing.
Strong written and verbal communication skills: the ability to convey strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs to an executive audience, and to produce clear, detailed product specifications for the team.
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a technical, business, or related field.
You are:
Entrepreneurial: you propose ambitious ideas and then go build them, without waiting for permission.
Comfortable operating with incomplete information and making the call anyway.
Rigorous about risk without being slowed by it; you know where to hold the line and where to move fast.
A strong collaborator who can align Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Business Development behind a single plan.
Hands-on, creative, data-obsessed, and detail-oriented.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$383,120—$439,280 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product, Security and Privacy
jobs.text:
About Neo4j:
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
Our Vision:
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
We are seeking a Product Counsel to partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and Go-To-Market teams to ensure our products are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with applicable laws and aligned with our risk tolerance.
This role is embedded in the product lifecycle, from roadmap planning and feature design through launch, customer adoption, and ongoing iteration, and is critical to enabling fast, responsible innovation in a global, enterprise software environment.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Engineering Support
Act as the primary legal partner for product and engineering teams across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid offerings.
Advise on legal issues throughout the product development lifecycle, including feature design, data flows, APIs, integrations, and platform architecture.
Review and help shape product requirements, specifications, and launch plans to proactively manage legal risk.
Open Source & Licensing
Advise on open-source software (OSS) usage, contributions, and licensing models (e.g., GPL, AGPL, Apache, MIT, dual licensing).
Support compliance with open-source obligations and guide product teams on inbound and outbound licensing strategies.
Partner with engineering and security on OSS governance and tooling.
Privacy, Security & Data
Provide guidance on privacy and data protection matters (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, global data transfer frameworks).
Advise on product-embedded privacy features, security controls, and data-handling practices.
Partner with Security, Trust, and Compliance teams on incident response, customer security inquiries, and audits.
Commercial & GTM Enablement
Support product-led go-to-market initiatives.
Help develop scalable legal frameworks that enable enterprise sales while supporting self-serve and cloud motions.
Regulatory & Risk Management
Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting enterprise software, AI, data, and cloud services, and translate them into practical guidance for product teams.
Identify and assess legal risks associated with new technologies, features, and business models, and propose mitigation strategies.
Contribute to internal policies, guidelines, and playbooks related to product development and delivery.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior product and engineering leaders.
Educate and empower non-legal stakeholders through training and clear, pragmatic guidance.
Help scale legal processes to support a fast-growing, global organization.
Qualifications
Required
JD or equivalent law degree; licensed and in good standing in at least one jurisdiction.
10+ years of relevant legal experience, with a significant focus on product, technology, or commercial matters.
Experience supporting enterprise software, cloud services, or developer-focused products.
Strong working knowledge of:
Software licensing and SaaS models

blocks.text: About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
Our Vision:
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

We are seeking a Product Counsel to partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and Go-To-Market teams to ensure our products are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with applicable laws and aligned with our risk tolerance.

This role is embedded in the product lifecycle, from roadmap planning and feature design through launch, customer adoption, and ongoing iteration, and is critical to enabling fast, responsible innovation in a global, enterprise software environment.

items: Act as the primary legal partner for product and engineering teams across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid offerings.

Help develop scalable legal frameworks that enable enterprise sales while supporting self-serve and cloud motions.

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.text:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
The Role:
We are looking for a visionary and strategic Field CTO with a "learn-it-all" mindset to serve as a high-impact technical advisor for our most strategic prospects and customers. In this role, you will act as a peer to client executives, translating complex business transformations into scalable technical strategies. You will drive innovation by championing Process Intelligence ,Agentic AI and Enterprise Modernization, ensuring our technology aligns with the evolving needs of the global market.
The work you’ll do:
Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, aligning their long-term strategic goals with the Celonis technical vision.
Strategic Architecture & Roadmap: Lead the overarching data, cloud, and innovation strategy for our largest global accounts, utilizing methodologies like Capability Mapping to identify high-value opportunities.
Innovation Leadership: Architect "first-of-a-kind" solutions using emergent technologies like Agentic AI to solve complex enterprise challenges.
Sales & Business Impact: Partner with Sales and Value Engineering driving revenue through new customer acquisition and strategic up-selling.
Product Advocacy: Act as a critical feedback loop between our Product & Engineering teams and the market, ensuring the voice of the customer shapes our future offerings.
Thought Leadership: Develop and deliver customer-facing position papers, assets, and presentations that establish our brand as a leader in architecture and innovation.
The qualifications you need:
Experience: 15 to 20 years of relevant experience, ideally having served as a CTO at a consulting firm, as Field CTO at a software vendor, or Director/VP of Enterprise Architecture within a major corporation.
Strategic Communication: Proven track record of presenting complex technical visions to C-suite stakeholders in a way that emphasizes business value.
Modernization Expertise: Deep experience in Enterprise Modernization, EA Methodologies, and a robust understanding of Agentic AI.
Technical Versatility: Ability to pivot from high-level architecture diagrams to hands-on demo.
Technical Foundation: Excellent background in Data Architecture, API ecosystems, and cloud-native SaaS solutions like Salesforce and ServiceNow.
ERP/Domain: Strong knowledge of Oracle
Education: MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent IT-related field.
Preferred:
Tech Stack: Celonis, OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
Certifications: TOGAF/Zachmann , AWS/Azure/GCP , and ESB/ETL certifications (e.g., Mulesoft, Informatica).
Industry Breadth: Experience across at least two domains (e.g., Finance, Supply Chain) and two industries (e.g., Pharma, Banking, Aerospace)
Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
About Us:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

jobs.title: Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.
The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis.
Mission Summary:
As the Director of Data Science, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for extracting intelligence from petabyte-scale on-road fleet data and simulation ecosystems. This leadership role is centered on building advanced data-driven methodologies, developing predictive and generative models, and serving as the primary analytical anchor supporting not only the Systems Readiness and Performance/Metrics teams but the whole company. You will drive the statistical rigor necessary to translate raw road data into high-fidelity performance metrics that directly inform vehicle launch readiness and safety-critical decisions.
What You'll Be Doing:

jobs.title: Head of Product, AI Enablement (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
Purpose of Position
Own the product agenda for how AI creates real, measurable value across Awin — translating AI capability into shipped product outcomes, not experiments.
Context
Thousands of advertisers and publishers who stay on Awin platform because of the people and product behind the service. The next chapter of Awin's product strategy is defined by how deliberately we put AI to work — not as a slogan, but as a set of practical capabilities embedded into what we build and how the business runs.
Most companies treat AI as a layer bolted onto existing product thinking. We want the opposite: a Head of Product who treats AI as core to the product strategy itself — where it belongs, what it should never touch, and how it compounds value over time rather than producing one-off wins.
What you'll own
Product strategy for AI-driven value. Define where AI genuinely changes the economics or experience of our product — and where it doesn't. Prioritise like a product leader: value creation and value capture, not novelty.
Translate capability into roadmap. Convert what AI can practically do today into a prioritised, sequenced product agenda with clear outcomes — not a lab of disconnected pilots.
Own outcomes, not outputs. Every initiative under your remit is judged on measurable business impact — adoption, efficiency, revenue, or customer outcome — not on whether something "uses AI."
Partner at exec level. Work directly with leadership to align AI investment with company priorities, and defend that investment in commercial terms.
Lead a product team. Hire and develop the product talent needed to execute — with real ownership over people and budget.
Set the standard for build vs. buy. Make disciplined calls on when to adopt existing AI tooling versus build proprietary capability, with opportunity cost as the deciding factor.
Champion practical adoption over theatre. Internal and external users are your test of success — if a capability isn't used, it isn't done.
Who you are
Product leader with technical fluency. You've run product organisations and you understand, in practical terms, where AI creates leverage versus where it's a distraction.
Outcome-obsessed. You think in business impact first, technology second.
Commercially sharp. You can defend a roadmap in P&L terms as comfortably as in a product review.
Credible with engineering. You can go deep enough on data, APIs, and model capability to make good calls, without needing to be the one building it.
A builder of teams, not just plans — you know how to hire and develop product talent that ships.
What success looks like
A clear, prioritised AI product agenda in place; first initiatives shipped with measurable adoption.
A functioning product team; multiple AI-enabled capabilities live and driving demonstrable business outcomes.
AI is a defining, differentiated part of Awin's product experience — not a side initiative, but core to how the product wins in market.
What this role is not
Not an automation function. Not a central bureaucracy that runs projects for other teams. Not a lab for AI experimentation without a business case. This is a product leadership role — where AI is the primary lens, not a side interest.
Our Offer
Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.
Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.
Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.
Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.
Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why
Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.
