jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.
About Bobtail
Bobtail is dedicated to increasing happiness by eliminating inefficiencies in the supply chain. We envision a supply chain without friction, fraud, waste, and abuse where companies succeed based on the value they create.
We work in a unique way at Bobtail, where we value teams over individuals and encourage experimentation and iteration to constantly improve. Teams are given flexibility in working towards a shared purpose and given the freedom to decide how they will accomplish their goals.
If you are an out of the box thinker that takes a proactive approach in collaborating with others to solve problems and achieve your goals - we would love to talk to you.
The things we value:
Mission
Teams over individuals
Collaboration
Communication
Iteration
Experimentation and failing fast
Initiative and solutions oriented approach
Documentation
Data
Mental health and work life balance
Diversity
Transparency
We're hiring a Director of Product to lead product strategy, development, and innovation at Bobtail. This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.
The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.
You should apply if you have:
8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.
A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.
Experience conducting product discovery, customer research, and market analysis. Strong commercial instincts and the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value and business economics.
Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.
Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.
Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.
Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather than a venture-subsidized one.
Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to clearly communicate product strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership. The discipline to say no - comfortable deferring or killing ideas that don't earn their place on the roadmap, even when they're compelling in isolation or popular internally. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
Financial fluency - comfortable modeling and defending the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of a roadmap bet directly to the CFO and other finance stakeholders. A track record of measuring product success based on customer and business outcomes.
An obsession with the customer and the product - you can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and you know the product as well as the people using it, not just the roadmap slide.
You will be responsible for:
Decide What to Build: Develop and maintain a product strategy that clearly connects product investment to the company's broader strategic and financial objectives. Look beyond incremental feature improvements to identify opportunities for meaningful product innovation.
Process around decision making: Create a disciplined process for gathering and evaluating ideas without allowing the product roadmap to become a collection of stakeholder requests. Ensure completed functionality solves the underlying customer or business problem rather than simply meeting documented requirements.
Decide What Not to Build: Exercise real judgment about scope. Establish clear criteria for when to build, continue investing in a new product, change direction, or discontinue an initiative.
Execute at a High Level: Partner closely with engineering - and with design, go-to-market, and senior leadership - to turn the roadmap into shipped product on a predictable cadence, not just a plan.
Defend the Business Case: Build and defend the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of each major roadmap bet to the CFO, so product decisions hold up under financial scrutiny, not just strategic conviction.
Own the outcome: Ensure new products have clearly understood operational, financial, regulatory, and risk requirements before launch. Measure product success based on business outcomes - not simply whether features were delivered.
Own the Product: Take full, unbounded ownership of Bobtail's product. There are no lanes here; if it touches the customer or the platform, it's yours to shape.
Obsess Over the Customer and the Product: Establish a disciplined process for identifying and evaluating new product opportunities. Spend meaningful time talking directly with customers rather than relying exclusively on feedback filtered through Sales or Operations. Develop a strong understanding of competitors and adjacent providers within transportation finance and fintech. Live inside the carrier's day-to-day and inside the product itself. We want someone who can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and who knows the product as well as the people using it.
Evidence-Driven Decision Making: Build the muscle - data, customer research, experimentation - to validate bets before committing engineering resources, while being willing to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin.
Team Building: Hire and develop the product management function at Bobtail, defining process and hiring bar as the first dedicated product leader.
Market & Competitive Judgment: Track how freight-tech and fintech infrastructure are evolving, including AI-driven disruption and industry consolidation, and stress-test Bobtail's roadmap against it.
Benefits
Generous PTO
Monthly Mental Break Day
Parental leave
Comprehensive healthcare coverage
Life insurance
401k with company match
Work from home (or wherever)
Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is Bobtail’s nucleus. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace people of different backgrounds, cultures, religions, national origins, races, colors, genders, gender expressions, sexual orientations, ages, marital status, veteran status, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.
You should apply if you have:

items: 8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.
A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.

Experience conducting product discovery, customer research, and market analysis. Strong commercial instincts and the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value and business economics.
Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.
Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.
Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.
Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather than a venture-subsidized one.

Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to clearly communicate product strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership. The discipline to say no - comfortable deferring or killing ideas that don't earn their place on the roadmap, even when they're compelling in isolation or popular internally. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.

Financial fluency - comfortable modeling and defending the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of a roadmap bet directly to the CFO and other finance stakeholders. A track record of measuring product success based on customer and business outcomes.
An obsession with the customer and the product - you can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and you know the product as well as the people using it, not just the roadmap slide.

blocks.text: You will be responsible for:

items: Decide What to Build: Develop and maintain a product strategy that clearly connects product investment to the company's broader strategic and financial objectives. Look beyond incremental feature improvements to identify opportunities for meaningful product innovation.

Process around decision making: Create a disciplined process for gathering and evaluating ideas without allowing the product roadmap to become a collection of stakeholder requests. Ensure completed functionality solves the underlying customer or business problem rather than simply meeting documented requirements.
Decide What Not to Build: Exercise real judgment about scope. Establish clear criteria for when to build, continue investing in a new product, change direction, or discontinue an initiative.
Execute at a High Level: Partner closely with engineering - and with design, go-to-market, and senior leadership - to turn the roadmap into shipped product on a predictable cadence, not just a plan.

Defend the Business Case: Build and defend the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of each major roadmap bet to the CFO, so product decisions hold up under financial scrutiny, not just strategic conviction.

Own the outcome: Ensure new products have clearly understood operational, financial, regulatory, and risk requirements before launch. Measure product success based on business outcomes - not simply whether features were delivered.
Own the Product: Take full, unbounded ownership of Bobtail's product. There are no lanes here; if it touches the customer or the platform, it's yours to shape.

Obsess Over the Customer and the Product: Establish a disciplined process for identifying and evaluating new product opportunities. Spend meaningful time talking directly with customers rather than relying exclusively on feedback filtered through Sales or Operations. Develop a strong understanding of competitors and adjacent providers within transportation finance and fintech. Live inside the carrier's day-to-day and inside the product itself. We want someone who can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and who knows the product as well as the people using it.

Evidence-Driven Decision Making: Build the muscle - data, customer research, experimentation - to validate bets before committing engineering resources, while being willing to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin.
Team Building: Hire and develop the product management function at Bobtail, defining process and hiring bar as the first dedicated product leader.
Market & Competitive Judgment: Track how freight-tech and fintech infrastructure are evolving, including AI-driven disruption and industry consolidation, and stress-test Bobtail's roadmap against it.

jobs.text:
VP of Engineering Applications, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Required, Work From Home
As the VP of Engineering Applications, you will turn intelligence into a real product. The VP of Engineering Applications is responsible for the engineering systems, teams, and execution that turn Machine Learning (ML) capability into reliable, fast, and intuitive user experiences across backend, mobile, and desktop platforms. The VP of Engineering Applications role is a senior engineering leader who stays close to the product, makes hard technical decisions, and holds a high bar for quality and delivery. This position is 100% Remote.
MUST BE WILLING TO TAKE A 60 MINUTE CODING ASSESSMENT.
VP of Engineering Applications Responsibilities:
Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.
Lead and grow a small, senior applications team, including backend, mobile, and desktop engineers.
Set the architectural direction for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered product workflows, APIs, and client integrations.
Ensure AI capabilities are integrated into the product with clear abstractions, predictable behavior, and graceful failure modes.
Partner closely with Machine Learning leadership to translate model capability into shippable product features.
Make high-impact decisions across latency, cost, reliability, security, and user experience.
Establish clear ownership boundaries across backend, mobile, and desktop to prevent architectural drift.
Ensure production readiness: observability, monitoring, retries, fallbacks, privacy, and cost controls.
Balance speed and discipline shipping quickly without compromising long-term system quality.
VP of Engineering Applications Outcomes:
Reliable, low-latency Artificial Intelligence (AI) user experiences across backend, mobile, and desktop
Clear architectural boundaries that allow teams to move fast without constant rewrites.
Measurable improvements in system performance, stability, and production reliability.
Strong observability and operational discipline across all application systems.
A small, senior team that ships frequently, owns what they build, and raises the technical bar.
Team members are empowered, growing in their roles, and able to make high-impact contributions.
VP of Engineering Applications Qualifications:
Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) experience required.
Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.
Experience delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered products, with a deep understanding of model integration trade-offs.
Excellent system design skills across services, APIs, clients, and data flows.
Comfort operating across platforms (backend, mobile, desktop), even if your depth is in one.
Proven ability to make high-impact technical decisions under ambiguity.
A strong bias toward shipping, iteration, and learning from real-world usage.
Low ego, strong judgment, and the ability to raise the technical bar for the entire applications organization.
Benefits include medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Savings Plan Options, PTO, etc.

jobs.title: Executive Director of Product Management , Resiliency
jobs.text:
The Executive Director, Product Management – Supply Chain Resiliency reports to the VP, Product Management and owns the full product development lifecycle and go-to-market execution for GHX's Supply Resiliency Platform — the cross-application layer spanning two use-case tracks: Procure-to-Pay (hospital) and Order-to-Cash (manufacturer/supplier) workflows. This is a build-and-commercialize role: the Executive Director owns the platform requirements, product launch, and forward-deployed pilot through general availability, driving pilot customer selection and execution, product requirements and roadmap, commercial packaging and pricing, and cross-functional GTM alignment across Engineering, forward-deployed teams, Sales, Marketing, Implementation, Professional Services, Customer Care and Finance.
Areas of focus include, but are not solely limited to: pilot program design and stage-gate governance; product definition, roadmap execution, and technical alignment; commercial packaging, pricing, and profitability; competitive positioning; cross-functional consensus building; and executive/steering-committee reporting.
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Healthcare supply chain resiliency is now a contested category: well-funded, AI-native challengers are selling point solutions directly to hospitals. This role is chartered to win that fight — turning GHX's two-sided network of 600+ connected providers and their suppliers into a resiliency platform that out-executes single-sided competitors on speed, breadth, and proven customer outcomes. The Executive Director owns that competitive outcome end to end, from platform definition through GA and beyond.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Working with a broad group of stakeholders and partners — across GHX product pods, Forward-Deployed Engineering, current and prospective pilot customers, and the executive leadership team — the Executive Director develops and leads GHX Product Management execution for the Supply Resiliency use case. Responsibilities also include identification and qualification of future use case prioritization.
Specific responsibilities include:
Own end-to-end product development lifecycle (PDLC) for GHX Orchestration, from forward-deployed pilot and prototype through GA commercialization, across both use-case tracks (Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash).
Design, govern, and continuously refine the pilot selection engine: Layer 1 binary hard gates (data access, SME time, on-site access, feedback cadence, executive sponsor) and the Layer 2 weighted scorecard used to rank and select pilot candidates.
Own pilot cohort selection and all stage-gate decisions (entry, mid-pilot, exit), including go/kill/reallocate calls on stalled accounts.
Partner directly with the Forward-Deployed Engineering team to scope on-site pilot engagements, define track-specific entry criteria and success metrics, and translate pilot learnings into a repeatable deployment playbook.
Own product-level success criteria and report progress against exit bars: P0/P1 issue resolution, GA-candidate certification, referenceable-logo targets, and quantified ROI proof points, by persona and by track.
Lead product's input into the GTM execution plan, keeping the commercial (pricing/packaging), pilot delivery, and marketing workstreams synchronized against the shared milestone schedule and dependency chain.
Define and evolve the tiered commercial model (Foundation / Agentic / Outcome-Premium) and the hybrid pricing approach (base subscription plus metered/outcome layer); partner with Finance and Deal Desk on SOW structure, platform-level contracting, and pilot-to-GA conversion terms.
Translate persona- and value-based requirements (executive sponsor, operational champion, SME end-users, technical/integration owner, data steward) into a technical roadmap in partnership with Engineering.
Drive product-boundary clarity across adjacent and overlapping offerings (e.g., Price Workbench, Industry Data Alignment, Data Connect, Managed Services, and Resiliency Center capability) and own the resulting customer-facing positioning, flow documentation, and sales-enablement materials.
Analyze market trends and the competitive landscape — including well-funded, AI-native point-solution entrants — to defend and advance GHX's “orchestration” category positioning, and to win head-to-head competitive evaluations.
Build and sustain executive-level relationships with pilot customers and internal sponsors to unblock data access, named SME time, on-site access, and rapid structured feedback.
Lead through influence across Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute and deliver the roadmap and optimize product efficiency for implementation, supportability, and system reliability.
Develop and mentor Product Owners and Product Managers supporting the platform.
Utilize effective change management practices to execute the product roadmap and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the executive/steering committee.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
A minimum of 10 years of Product Management experience.
Experience leading Product Management initiatives within the healthcare space is required.
Demonstrated experience designing or running structured pilot programs, forward-deployed engineering models, or similar early-access/co-development customer AI engagements.
Experience developing or executing usage-based, outcome-based, or hybrid commercial pricing models for enterprise software.
Ability to clearly communicate; work in team environments, with a minimum of 3 years people management experience.
Proven software development experience managing product planning milestones from business concept through launch.
Competency at developing strategies and execution plans for new businesses or new platform offerings.
Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional project teams spanning Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services.
Strategic planning skills, including experience building and defending a go-to-market roadmap with executive stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills (oral and written communication).
Outstanding organizational skills and time management skills.
Travel is as needed (approximately 25%–50%), including on-site pilot customer visits.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
5+ years of healthcare software product management experience.
Experience managing healthcare supply chain products and services (Procure-to-Pay and/or Order-to-Cash) desirable but not necessary.
Experience launching or commercializing agentic AI or AI-enabled product capabilities.
Experience building pricing models that incorporate a metered or outcome-based component alongside a base subscription.
Experience showing ability to drive customer adoption of emerging technologies and solutions.
Track record winning head-to-head competitive evaluations against market challengers in enterprise or healthcare software.
Estimated Salary: $150,000 - $214,000 plus bonus

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

Define and evolve the tiered commercial model (Foundation / Agentic / Outcome-Premium) and the hybrid pricing approach (base subscription plus metered/outcome layer); partner with Finance and Deal Desk on SOW structure, platform-level contracting, and pilot-to-GA conversion terms.

Translate persona- and value-based requirements (executive sponsor, operational champion, SME end-users, technical/integration owner, data steward) into a technical roadmap in partnership with Engineering.

Drive product-boundary clarity across adjacent and overlapping offerings (e.g., Price Workbench, Industry Data Alignment, Data Connect, Managed Services, and Resiliency Center capability) and own the resulting customer-facing positioning, flow documentation, and sales-enablement materials.

Analyze market trends and the competitive landscape — including well-funded, AI-native point-solution entrants — to defend and advance GHX's “orchestration” category positioning, and to win head-to-head competitive evaluations.
Build and sustain executive-level relationships with pilot customers and internal sponsors to unblock data access, named SME time, on-site access, and rapid structured feedback.

Lead through influence across Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute and deliver the roadmap and optimize product efficiency for implementation, supportability, and system reliability.
Develop and mentor Product Owners and Product Managers supporting the platform.
Utilize effective change management practices to execute the product roadmap and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to the executive/steering committee.

Proven software development experience managing product planning milestones from business concept through launch.

Outstanding organizational skills and time management skills.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
The Vice President of Product is a senior leadership role responsible for defining and executing the product vision and strategy across One Park Financials funding platform and customer-facing experiences. Reporting to the Chief Technical Officer, the VP of Product will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — from strategy and discovery through delivery and iteration — and will lead a growing team of product managers, Scrum master, project managers and product operations professionals.
This leader will partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Risk, and Finance to align the roadmap with company priorities, accelerate our funding-automation initiatives, and ensure OPF delivers a differentiated, data-driven product experience. As AI becomes central to how we serve small businesses, the VP of Product is also expected to lead with an AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) mindset — embedding AI responsibly and rigorously across the product lifecycle. The ideal candidate is equal parts strategic thinker and hands-on operator, with a proven track record of building and scaling products in fintech, lending, or a comparably regulated, high-velocity environment.
Product Vision & Strategy
Define and communicate a compelling, multi-year product vision and strategy aligned with OPF’s mission and business objectives.
Translate market opportunities, customer needs, and competitive dynamics into a clear, prioritized product strategy.
Champion the strategic priorities of the business — including funding automation and credit underwriting — and ensure the product portfolio advances them.
Roadmap & Execution
Own the product roadmap end-to-end, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform investment.
Establish a rigorous prioritization framework that maximizes customer and business value against available capacity.
Drive disciplined product delivery in partnership with Engineering, ensuring on-time, high-quality releases and rapid iteration.
Define and track success metrics (OKRs/KPIs) for every major initiative and hold the organization accountable to outcomes.
Team Leadership
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing product management and product operations team.
Establish product management best practices, standards, and career development pathways.
Foster a culture of customer obsession, data-driven decision-making, accountability, and continuous learning.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Engineering to align technical architecture and delivery with product strategy.
Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and the Sales Co function to ensure the product enables efficient funding, servicing, and growth.
Work with Marketing to shape positioning, go-to-market, and customer messaging for new features and products.
Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, and Finance to ensure products meet regulatory, credit, and financial requirements.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team, providing clear, data-backed recommendations and status.
Data & Customer Insights
Instrument products for measurement and use analytics, experimentation, and customer research to guide decisions.
Develop deep empathy for OPF’s small-business customers through direct engagement, voice-of-customer programs, and usage data.
Establish feedback loops that continuously improve conversion, retention, funding velocity, and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
Ndustrial has delivered $100M+ in energy savings for food producers, storage operators and retailers across the cold chain. Our Nsight™ platform integrates existing systems to turn energy into a measurable production input. It deploys in weeks and verifies savings in real time, without disrupting operations. Trusted by industry leaders like Lineage, Americold and ABB, we’re revolutionizing the way the cold chain uses energy for a more sustainable future.
More About Us:
We are a Raleigh, NC based Series B startup backed by world class investors and serve global customers in energy-intensive sectors like cold storage, logistics, and manufacturing.
We live by our values: Teamwork, Customer First, Quality, and Curiosity. With a team of forward-thinkers and problem-solvers, we’re driving the digital transformation of industries globally.
Ndustrial builds software that helps the world's largest food, cold chain, and industrial operators understand and control their energy in real time.
If you want your work to make real change, this is the place.
About the Role:
The VP of Engineering is a key member of Ndustrial’s leadership team, responsible for leading, developing, and scaling our engineering organization while ensuring the team delivers against the company’s most important priorities.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this role requires a proven engineering leader who understands what it takes to build and lead teams in an early-stage, high-growth environment. The VP of Engineering will create clarity and accountability across the organization, develop and motivate a high-performing team, and ensure engineering priorities and execution are closely aligned with company objectives.
We are an AI-forward engineering organization, and this leader will help ensure our team is effectively using modern AI tools and practices to improve how we build, solve problems, and deliver value to customers. This is a people-oriented leadership role for someone who knows how to get things done through others and can build an engineering organization that consistently executes, grows, and adapts as the company evolves.
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, develop, and motivate a high-performing engineering team, creating clear expectations, ownership, and accountability.
Translate company objectives into clear engineering priorities and ensure the team understands both what they are working toward and why it matters.
Manage team and individual performance against defined objectives, providing direct feedback, coaching, and addressing performance issues when expectations are not being met.
Champion an AI-forward engineering culture, ensuring the team effectively uses AI-assisted tools across design, development, testing, problem-solving, and decision-making to improve both speed and quality.
Bring firsthand experience navigating the early-stage startup lifecycle, knowing when to introduce structure and process, when to move quickly with imperfect information, and how to keep teams focused and executing as company priorities evolve.
Partner with Product and other leaders to identify opportunities to incorporate AI into our platform and deliver meaningful customer value.
Provide strong technical judgment across architecture, cloud infrastructure, SaaS development, AI-enabled capabilities, security, reliability, and scalability while empowering the team to own implementation.
Own engineering execution, balancing speed, quality, scalability, technical health, and available resources.
Create visibility into engineering priorities, progress, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs for the CEO and leadership team.
Report directly and partner closely with the CEO by proactively bringing recommendations, surfacing risks, providing context, and constructively challenging assumptions when appropriate.
Serve as an active member of the leadership team, contributing to company strategy, priorities, organizational decisions, and growth beyond the engineering function.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and other functions to align Engineering with customer and business needs.
Drive decisions and execution in an environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and limited resources.
Build a culture that reflects what motivates strong startup talent: ownership, autonomy, urgency, collaboration, accountability, and meaningful impact.

jobs.text:
About Ogilvy
Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
OGILVY HEALTH: WE INSPIRE PEOPLE AND BRANDS TO IMPACT THE WORLD
Guided by this vision, Ogilvy Health, part of WPP, combines borderless creativity, scientific precision and cultural fluency to build healthcare’s most influential movements. We drive measurable impact and category-defining growth for brands ready to shape what’s next. Our approach is powered by fearless creativity that dares to be different, sparks emotional connections, and inspires action, ensuring cultural resonance. Scientific precision translates complex data into stories that resonate, while our impact-obsessed mindset focuses on delivering real-world outcomes.
For more information on us, visit OgilvyHealth.com, or follow Ogilvy Health on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Threads.
About the Role
Ogilvy Health Market Access brings together market access strategy, analytics, technology, and creative capabilities to help pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare clients navigate the complexities of reimbursement and patient access. We transform complex access information into actionable solutions that support clients and field organizations throughout the product lifecycle.
We are seeking an experienced Market Access Analytics leader to drive the data strategy, development, and delivery of our proprietary market access solutions and custom analytics offerings. This individual will work closely with clients and internal teams to translate complex pharmaceutical market access data into accurate, actionable solutions for clients and field teams.
The Director will manage and develop members of the analytics team while remaining hands-on with complex data challenges, solution design, validation, and client deliverables.
What You’ll Do
Lead the timely implementation of data solutions supporting proprietary market access products, field-facing tools, and custom client analytics.
Integrate and analyze pharmaceutical data sources, including formulary and coverage data, prescription and medical claims, HCP data, payer and plan hierarchies, lives, geographic alignment, and CRM data.
Translate complex business questions into analytical methodologies, business rules, data requirements, and scalable solutions.
Use MySQL, advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI and other analytic tools to manipulate, integrate, analyze, and validate large datasets and troubleshoot complex data issues.
Apply deep knowledge of pharmaceutical reimbursement, including payer channels, formulary coverage, utilization management, payer/PBM relationships, plan structures, and patient access dynamics.
Develop methodologies that translate market access data into actionable HCP-, account-, payer-, geographic-, and national-level insights and field-facing messages.
Own quality control and validation of analytical methodologies and client deliverables, including investigation and reconciliation of discrepancies across data sources and systems.
Serve as the analytics and market access subject matter expert throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements, development, testing and validation, launch, data migrations, recurring refreshes, and enhancements.
Partner with development, UX, account, strategy, production, and external data-provider teams to ensure solutions are accurate, scalable, actionable, and delivered on time.
Serve as a senior analytics subject matter expert in client meetings and pre- and post-sale discussions, clearly communicating complex methodologies, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
Establish efficient, repeatable processes and high standards for analytical rigor and quality.
Remain hands-on as needed to investigate data, troubleshoot MySQL queries, perform Excel-based analyses, validate methodologies, and resolve complex data challenges.
What You’ll Need
8+ years of analytics experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, market access, managed markets, or a closely related data environment.
Ideally, understanding of pharmaceutical market access and reimbursement, including commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels, payer and plan structures, formulary coverage, and utilization management.
Significant experience with pharmaceutical data, including formulary/coverage, prescription or medical claims, HCP, payer/plan, and lives data.
5+ years hands-on MySQL skills, with demonstrated ability to query, join, transform, aggregate, troubleshoot, and validate large datasets.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated ability to analyze, validate, and present complex data.
Experience harnessing AI to streamline data processes.
Experience designing analytical methodologies and translating business needs into detailed data and product requirements.
Strong understanding of data quality, integration, attribution, aggregation, and validation methodologies and experience using a revision control system in a production environment (i.e. SVN, Git, Perforce).
Exceptional client communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage multiple complex workstreams.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to develop innovative solutions to complex data challenges.
Bachelor's degree required; STEM degree, advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.
Preferred Experience
Experience with pharmaceutical market access data sources such as IQVIA, MMIT, Symphony Health, or similar platforms.
Experience developing HCP- or account-level market access analytics and field-facing solutions.
Familiarity with Veeva or other pharmaceutical CRM/field enablement platforms.
Experience with payer hierarchies, PBM relationships, geographic attribution, HCP alignment, product launches, or major data migrations.
How We’ll Support You
Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.
#LI-Remote
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.
Pay Range
$100,000—$230,000 USD
At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.
We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.
Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.
Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

Serve as a senior analytics subject matter expert in client meetings and pre- and post-sale discussions, clearly communicating complex methodologies, findings, limitations, and recommendations.
Establish efficient, repeatable processes and high standards for analytical rigor and quality.
Remain hands-on as needed to investigate data, troubleshoot MySQL queries, perform Excel-based analyses, validate methodologies, and resolve complex data challenges.

blocks.text: What You’ll Need

items: 8+ years of analytics experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, market access, managed markets, or a closely related data environment.

Ideally, understanding of pharmaceutical market access and reimbursement, including commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid channels, payer and plan structures, formulary coverage, and utilization management.
Significant experience with pharmaceutical data, including formulary/coverage, prescription or medical claims, HCP, payer/plan, and lives data.
5+ years hands-on MySQL skills, with demonstrated ability to query, join, transform, aggregate, troubleshoot, and validate large datasets.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated ability to analyze, validate, and present complex data.
Experience harnessing AI to streamline data processes.
Experience designing analytical methodologies and translating business needs into detailed data and product requirements.

Strong understanding of data quality, integration, attribution, aggregation, and validation methodologies and experience using a revision control system in a production environment (i.e. SVN, Git, Perforce).
Exceptional client communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and manage multiple complex workstreams.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to develop innovative solutions to complex data challenges.
Bachelor's degree required; STEM degree, advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.

blocks.text: Preferred Experience

items: Experience with pharmaceutical market access data sources such as IQVIA, MMIT, Symphony Health, or similar platforms.
Experience developing HCP- or account-level market access analytics and field-facing solutions.
Familiarity with Veeva or other pharmaceutical CRM/field enablement platforms.
Experience with payer hierarchies, PBM relationships, geographic attribution, HCP alignment, product launches, or major data migrations.

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Technology Operations
jobs.text:
About The Role
The RealReal is looking for a Vice President of Enterprise Technical Operations to lead the teams and systems that keep our business running — from core networking and device management to the enterprise applications and AI platforms that power our people. This leader will own technical operations at scale across our corporate, retail, and authentication center locations, drive enterprise AI enablement, and build a high-performing organization that attracts and grows top talent.
What You Get To Do Every Day
Own and evolve TRR's technical operations strategy across core networking, endpoint/device management, and infrastructure supporting corporate, retail, and authentication center locations
In Partnership with the VP of AI, lead enterprise AI enablement across the organization, driving adoption and governance of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise for employee productivity and workflow automation
Direct enterprise application support and roadmap for NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, and related systems, partnering closely with Finance, HR, and Sales/CX stakeholders
Build and mature enterprise incident and problem management practices — from real-time response and escalation to root-cause analysis and prevention — to minimize business disruption
Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure and connectivity for retail stores and authentication centers, where operational uptime directly impacts customer and consignor experience
Partner with Product & Technology leadership to align technical operations with broader enterprise architecture and AI platform strategy
Set and manage SLAs, operational metrics, and vendor relationships across managed services, telecom, and SaaS providers
Attract, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing technical operations team; build clear career paths and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
Drive automation and self-service across IT operations to reduce manual toil and free the team to focus on higher-value, strategic work
Serve as an escalation point and trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on technology operations, risk, and resilience
What You Bring To The Role
Minimum Requirements:
10+ years of progressive technical operations leadership, including experience running enterprise IT/infrastructure at scale in a multi-site environment (retail, distribution, or similar physical footprint a plus)
Demonstrated success leading enterprise AI enablement initiatives — deploying and driving adoption of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or similar across a workforce
Deep hands-on knowledge of core networking, endpoint/device management (MDM), and infrastructure supporting distributed retail or field locations
Strong track record managing enterprise applications (NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, or comparable systems) and the vendor/stakeholder relationships that come with them
Proven ability to build and run mature incident and problem management functions, including postmortem discipline and continuous improvement processes
A people-first leadership style with a demonstrated record of attracting, developing, and empowering top talent — you build teams people want to stay on
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Security, Product & Technology, Finance, and Retail Operations leaders
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing hands-on execution with strategic planning
Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing executive stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to travel up to 10%.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience with enterprise AI adoption and agentic workflows
Experience in e-commerce or marketplace technology
Experience managing vendor partnerships and budgets
Compensation, Benefits, + Perks
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
401K with Company Match
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
Paid Parental Leave
9 Paid Company Holidays
Flexible Time Off (With Manager Approval)
Find out more about our Benefits here.
The expected salary range for this role is $-$. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.
The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.
The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. jobs.title: SVP, Technology (Product & Engineering)
jobs.text:
Who We Are
SWTCH is pioneering EV charging solutions for multifamily and commercial properties across North America. Since 2016, our team of entrepreneurs, energy professionals, and technologists has been focused on unlocking the social, economic, and environmental benefits of widespread EV adoption. Today, our solutions are deployed in tens of thousands of locations —many of which are low-to-moderate income housing—helping to make clean mobility accessible for all.
With an expanding footprint across Canada and the U.S., we’re scaling quickly and looking for mission-driven talent to help accelerate our growth.
Job Opportunity
SWTCH is looking for a senior technology leader to lead our Product, Software Engineering and Hardware organizations as we enter our next stage of growth.
Reporting to the CEO and as a member of the executive team, the SVP, Technology will own SWTCH’s technology strategy and execution — connecting our product vision, software platform and hardware ecosystem into a clear and scalable roadmap.
This is a role for a leader who combines strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking and can move comfortably between long-term strategy and hands-on execution.
What You’ll Do
Lead Product, Software Engineering and Hardware, creating a unified technology organization with clear priorities, ownership and accountability.
Own SWTCH’s technology and product strategy, translating the company’s growth plans into a clear roadmap across product, software, hardware and infrastructure.
Shape the product roadmap by balancing customer needs, market opportunities, commercial priorities and longer-term platform investments.
Drive technical architecture and scalability, ensuring our platform and systems can support a growing customer base, charging network and evolving product ecosystem.
Raise the bar on reliability, safety, quality and security, embedding strong standards for testing, validation, releases and production performance.
Ensure seamless integration across hardware, firmware, software and cloud systems, with clear ownership across the full product lifecycle.
Strengthen engineering and product execution, creating greater predictability, discipline and accountability around priorities, commitments and delivery.
Build and develop a high-performing technology leadership team, ensuring we have the right structure, capabilities and talent to support our next stage of growth.
Partner closely with the CEO and executive team on company strategy, technology investments, business priorities and key technical decisions and trade-offs.
Bring the voice of the customer into technology decisions, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success and Operations to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable solutions.
Create a culture of technical excellence and ownership, where teams move with speed while maintaining a high bar for quality, collaboration and execution.
What We’re Looking For
15+ years of technology experience with significant senior leadership experience.
Experience leading large or complex Engineering and Product organizations.
Strong technical foundation with the credibility to engage deeply with engineers and architects.
Experience with hardware-enabled technology, connected devices, IoT or complex distributed systems.
Proven experience scaling technology organizations and platforms.
Strong track record in reliability, quality and operational excellence.
Commercial and customer-oriented approach to product and technology decisions.
Strong executive communication and leadership skills.
Experience in EV charging, energy, infrastructure, telecommunications or another hardware/software environment is an asset.
The Leader We’re Looking For
You are a builder and operator. You bring technical credibility, strong judgment and a high bar for execution. You know how to build great teams, create clarity in complex environments and balance speed with quality.
Most importantly, you understand how to turn technology into a competitive advantage — building products and platforms that customers trust and that can scale with the business.

Today, our solutions are deployed in tens of thousands of locations —many of which are low-to-moderate income housing—helping to make clean mobility accessible for all.
With an expanding footprint across Canada and the U.S., we’re scaling quickly and looking for mission-driven talent to help accelerate our growth.
Job Opportunity
SWTCH is looking for a senior technology leader to lead our Product, Software Engineering and Hardware organizations as we enter our next stage of growth.

Reporting to the CEO and as a member of the executive team, the SVP, Technology will own SWTCH’s technology strategy and execution — connecting our product vision, software platform and hardware ecosystem into a clear and scalable roadmap.
This is a role for a leader who combines strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking and can move comfortably between long-term strategy and hands-on execution.
What You’ll Do

items: Lead Product, Software Engineering and Hardware, creating a unified technology organization with clear priorities, ownership and accountability.
Own SWTCH’s technology and product strategy, translating the company’s growth plans into a clear roadmap across product, software, hardware and infrastructure.
Shape the product roadmap by balancing customer needs, market opportunities, commercial priorities and longer-term platform investments.
Drive technical architecture and scalability, ensuring our platform and systems can support a growing customer base, charging network and evolving product ecosystem.
Raise the bar on reliability, safety, quality and security, embedding strong standards for testing, validation, releases and production performance.
Ensure seamless integration across hardware, firmware, software and cloud systems, with clear ownership across the full product lifecycle.
Strengthen engineering and product execution, creating greater predictability, discipline and accountability around priorities, commitments and delivery.
Build and develop a high-performing technology leadership team, ensuring we have the right structure, capabilities and talent to support our next stage of growth.
Partner closely with the CEO and executive team on company strategy, technology investments, business priorities and key technical decisions and trade-offs.
Bring the voice of the customer into technology decisions, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success and Operations to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable solutions.
Create a culture of technical excellence and ownership, where teams move with speed while maintaining a high bar for quality, collaboration and execution.

blocks.text: What We’re Looking For

items: 15+ years of technology experience with significant senior leadership experience.
Experience leading large or complex Engineering and Product organizations.
Strong technical foundation with the credibility to engage deeply with engineers and architects.
Experience with hardware-enabled technology, connected devices, IoT or complex distributed systems.
Proven experience scaling technology organizations and platforms.
Strong track record in reliability, quality and operational excellence.
Commercial and customer-oriented approach to product and technology decisions.
Strong executive communication and leadership skills.
Experience in EV charging, energy, infrastructure, telecommunications or another hardware/software environment is an asset.

blocks.text: The Leader We’re Looking For

You are a builder and operator. You bring technical credibility, strong judgment and a high bar for execution. You know how to build great teams, create clarity in complex environments and balance speed with quality.
Most importantly, you understand how to turn technology into a competitive advantage — building products and platforms that customers trust and that can scale with the business.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Post-Purchase Experiences and Platforms)
jobs.text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
About the Product team
The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
About the role
Post-purchase experiences are one of Affirm’s most critical customer experiences, directly shaping customer trust, credit performance, and the economics of every loan we serve. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead the teams responsible for the end-to-end repayments journey—from how customers manage and make payments to how Affirm supports customers through delinquency, collections, credit reporting, bankruptcy, and financial hardship.
This leader will oversee a large, multi-domain product organization and set the long-term strategy for several foundational post purchase consumer experiences and platforms. The ideal candidate is a seasoned product leader who brings together customer-centered thinking, platform strategy, financial discipline, and strong organizational leadership.
What you’ll do
Lead and scale a high-performing product organization. Manage and develop a team of approximately 15 product managers, including people managers. Set a high bar for product craft, strategic thinking, execution, and talent development.
Own the end-to-end repayments strategy. Define the multi-year vision for how customers manage and repay their Affirm loans, including the app and web experiences, consumer payment platforms, payment success, and support for customers experiencing financial difficulty. Improve customer outcomes and recovery performance through smarter treatments, flexible payment options, payment retries, and scalable operational capabilities.
Transform collections and recoveries. Set the product strategy for Affirm’s collections and recoveries experiences and platforms.
Set the vision for critical platforms. Lead the strategy for communications, open banking, credit reporting, bankruptcy, and hardship platforms—ensuring these capabilities are scalable, compliant, and able to support Affirm’s continued growth.
Deliver meaningful business and customer impact. Establish clear goals and success metrics across customer experience, payment performance, delinquency, recoveries, transaction costs, complaints, and operational efficiency.
Balance customer needs, risk, and economics. Make thoughtful product decisions that strengthen customer trust while improving credit outcomes and long-term loan economics.
Drive cross-functional alignment at scale. Partner closely with Engineering, Analytics, Credit, Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to establish shared priorities and translate strategy into coordinated execution.
Enable global scale. Build platform capabilities that can support new products, international markets, regulatory requirements, and increasingly complex servicing needs.
Influence senior leadership. Clearly communicate strategy, investment priorities, performance, and tradeoffs to executive stakeholders. Help shape company-level decisions across the broader consumer and financial platform ecosystem.
What we look for
15+ years of product management experience, including leading large, high-performing teams of PMs and people managers across multiple domains
Deep experience in consumer fintech, lending, payments, servicing, collections, or another regulated financial environment
Proven ability to define and execute multi-year strategies spanning customer experiences, complex platforms, and operational capabilities
Strong customer, technical, and analytical judgment, with the ability to balance customer outcomes, risk, compliance, and business economics
Track record of driving alignment and execution across Engineering, Analytics, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and executive leadership
Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence senior stakeholders, and develop strong product leaders
Proficiency with AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, decision-making, and team effectiveness
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
Base Pay Grade - V
Equity Grade - USA 21
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, CT, NJ, NY, WA) per year: $340,000 - $375,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $305,000 - $340,000
#LI-Remote
Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.
By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.text:
Auto Electric Service Ltd. is seeking a Vice President of Product to lead one of the most important functions in our next stage of growth.
Founded in 1943, AES is a locally owned Saskatchewan wholesale distribution company serving the automotive aftermarket, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, PBE, commercial paint, retail, OEM dealer, jobber, and service markets across Southern Saskatchewan. We are investing heavily in our Distribution Centre, inventory capabilities, technology, people, and systems as we build toward our long-term growth strategy.
This is not simply a purchasing role.
The VP of Product will have executive accountability for Product Assortment, Inventory Strategy, Purchasing, Pricing, Category Management, and Product-related Technology and Analytics.
The Opportunity
The VP of Product will answer some of the most important commercial questions in our business:
What should we sell?
What should we stock, where, and how much?
Which suppliers and product lines should we grow?
How should we price by market, category, and customer?
Where should we enter new categories?
How can data and technology improve these decisions?
The mission is to build a disciplined, accountable, technology-enabled Product function that delivers broad product availability while improving inventory productivity, contribution margin, GMROI, and return on invested capital.
Key Outcomes
Build a Smarter Inventory Network
Lead AES’s enterprise-wide inventory strategy across our Distribution Centre and branch network. Improve fill rates and product availability while reducing excess, obsolete, and unproductive inventory.
Grow and Optimize the Product Assortment
Identify assortment gaps, rationalize underperforming SKUs, evaluate new categories, and ensure our product mix reflects actual customer and market demand across Automotive, Agriculture, Industrial, Heavy Duty, and PBE.
Lead Pricing Strategy
Drive the continued evolution from traditional cost-plus pricing toward more data-driven, market-aware pricing designed to improve contribution margin while maintaining competitiveness.
Elevate Purchasing
Transform purchasing into a more strategic, analytical function. Strengthen vendor relationships, improve supplier accountability, negotiate stronger commercial programs, and align purchasing decisions with demand, inventory, and financial outcomes.
Build a Disciplined New Product Process
Ensure new product lines and categories are supported by clear business cases, expected ROI, required inventory investment, launch plans, and post-launch accountability.
Use Data and Technology as a Competitive Advantage
Work with internal and external technology partners to improve pricing, demand forecasting, product recommendations, customer insights, inventory positioning, and master data.
Build the Team and Function
Develop the structure, people, processes, scorecards, and operating rhythms required to support AES’s growth. Participate as an active member of the Senior Leadership Team and work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Marketing, and Technology.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Science
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .
Reddit is seeking a Senior Director of Consumer Data Science to lead a multi-team organization that partners across Consumer, Product, Engineering, and the broader business. You will set the strategy and operating model for consumer data science, strengthen the systems and standards that make scientific outputs reliable, actionable, and scalable, and guide high-impact decisions through measurement, experimentation, causal inference, and ML.
This leader will help define how Reddit measures and improves relevance across the consumer journey—from retrieval and ranking to feed, search, recommendations, and community discovery—and will shape the organizational capabilities required to advance these systems over the long term. Accordingly, the role requires the technical depth to evaluate architecture and analytical investments, guide state-of-the-art ML system improvements, and the leadership presence to align senior leaders around difficult tradeoffs.
What you’ll do
Partner with senior leaders across Consumer, Product, Engineering, and business functions to define company-level bets, priorities, and tradeoffs.
Set the data science strategy for Reddit’s feed, recommendation, search, retrieval, and ranking systems, including objective design, candidate generation, ranking quality, relevance evaluation, experimentation, and long-term optimization.
Establish the measurement and experimentation framework for relevance optimization, including offline evaluation, online experimentation, counterfactual analysis, guardrail metrics, metric integrity, and the connection between model improvements and consumer and community outcomes.
Translate complex user and community behavior into clear, impartial insights that improve product strategy and consumer outcomes.
Establish durable standards for measurement, experimentation, causal inference, reproducibility, privacy, responsible AI use, and self-serve measurement, at scale.
Build multi-team roadmaps, operating cadences, and clear accountability that turn company direction into durable delivery.
Exercise strong technical judgment across architecture choices, analytical systems, hiring, and sponsorship of high-leverage programs.
Build or rebuild systems and practices that make analytical work reliable, adoptable, and scalable rather than dependent on individual heroics.
Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional Directors, managers, and IC5+ leaders across multiple teams or pillars.
Set a high talent bar through succession planning, calibration, and clear expectations for coaching, performance, accountability, and growth.
Create durable cross-org forums and operating mechanisms that improve coordination, culture, and decision quality.
Align senior product, engineering, and business leaders on measurement strategy, difficult tradeoffs, and decisions with material multi-year impact.
Represent Reddit externally and internally as an acknowledged thought leader and visible culture shaper for rigor.
Partner with teams advancing ML and analytical systems that deepen understanding of Reddit’s UGC and community ecosystem.
Skills and Qualifications
Deep data science expertise in measurement, experimentation, causal inference, ML, data platforms, and analytical systems, with the technical judgment to set company-scale standards.
Experience in UGC or community ecosystems and a strong point of view on how data science can improve consumer experiences while protecting analytical quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
Proven ability to connect model and system improvements to consumer value, content quality, trust, diversity, healthy participation, and long-term business outcomes—not only short-term engagement metrics.
Senior leadership experience leading multi-team or multi-pillar organizations and delivering attributable business impact through durable roadmaps, operating mechanisms, and long-range bets.
Proven organization builder with a track record of recruiting and retaining exceptional senior leaders, developing Directors and managers, and creating a healthy, high-trust leadership bench.
Exceptional communication and influence with experience aligning senior product, engineering, and business leaders; resolving conflict; and communicating uncertainty, risks, and tradeoffs with intellectual honesty.
Pay Transparency:
This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.
The base salary range for this position is:
$317,000—$443,800 USD
In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.
During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.
Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.
