jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Job Description | About the Role
The Product Manager ascertains what’s next for the product. Head of Product is a visionary who is also rich with applied experience. We’re looking for someone will work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, and marketing to bring unique value-based features to market across B2B2C.
This role moves at a fast pace while maintaining excellent quality and a positive working attitude to strategize the Fabulous product roadmap.
Expectations | Duties
Outreach and Data Accumulation
Connect with users: dig into user data, both qualitative and quantitative
Ascertains trends while being a champion for user-first experiences
Collaborate with researchers, data scientists, and business development teams to understand user needs and identify new product opportunities.
Immerse yourself in the psychology, pain points and behavior of users to develop strong intuition about solutions that will work for them.
Develop compelling roadmaps and metric targets that keep us on track towards our desired goals and continuously measure progress towards them.
Lead product ideation and prioritization within a key product area.
Evaluate ideas and lead product prioritization and releases
Have a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas that can help move the needle, through user research/feedback, driving brainstorms sessions, and doing competitive research
Ruthlessly prioritize these ideas in a robust, data-informed way, with an aim to have the most impact with limited resources – time, engineering resources, user volume, etc.
Leverage data to drive product development and experimentation.
Lead a cross-functional team through the product development cycle–UI/UX, engineering, QA, and data analysis.
Be the overall point-person to build compelling products and features for users.
Write design documents and web updates for new content/features/initiatives with input from curriculum, design & engineering partners.
Initiate data-driven experimentation and analysis on new products and features.
Requirements
Qualifications | Requirements
8+ years of relevant product management experience:
Experience in a prior startup or other high-ambiguity environment
Prior consumer-facing product development experience, ideally with mobile or subscription-based products
Prior experience with psychology-based products, gamification, or other user behavior-oriented apps
Additional PM skills we highly value:
Consumer user empathy & perspective
Driving strategy & big-picture thinking
Experience with data analysis, metrics, and goal-setting
Analytical dexterity a.k.a. critical problem solving
Scrappy–execution & outcome-focused
Curious and teachable
Benefits
About Us
An award-winning health, wellness, & coaching company that creates apps which fall the top ten internationally. Our science-based approach sits squarely in the tech-for-good lane, helping people live their best lives. Everyone who has joined this company is committed to using evidence-based research to find the absolute best ways to change lives for the better.
Our History
Three co-founders created the Fabulous app: Sami, Amine, and Taylor. Growing up in Tunisia, Sami and Amine were only 16 when they met. With their early iteration, they reached out to Taylor, an award-winning designer in Malaysia. Their vision was welcomed into an incubation lab for startups at Duke University led by world-renowned Behavioral Economics Professor Dan Ariely. Our Chief Storyteller Jaz co-founded the Introductory Psychology program at Stanford University.
Our Approach
We use a behavioral economics lens to help individuals find that 'on switch' inside them to achieve their fullest potential. What has emerged is a system that transforms tiny habits into profound long-term changes. A world in which people with ADHD thrive. A method for gratitude to reach through difficulty. A sanctuary to seek out your true purpose. A fountain of knowledge. A space for rest and self compassion.
Our Mission
Help every individual discover the wonderful person inside themselves by creating: beautiful, evidence-based, life-changing products.
Our Environment
The first thing that sets us apart is that we’re not a place at all. While we’re a remote company, it’s not unusual to feel you know your teammates better than those you’ve shared an office with in the past. Ours is a professionally nourishing environment that is flexible and fully remote. Team members enjoy in house challenges and Slack event and work across a variety of tools. Meetings are kept to a minimum and deep work is encouraged.
Our Awards
Apple Best Apps of 2018
Editor’s app choice in more than 30 countries
Winner of Google’s Material Design Award
Best App Finalist in Google Play Awards
Consistently ranking in the top ten Health & Fitness apps across platforms
Backed by Facebook Startup Lab and Microsoft Venture
Our Norms
Ownership: Be the CEO of your tasks. No one is watching over your shoulder. Be the proof.
Open Communication: Constructive ideas are always flying across time zones.
Deep Work: Disconnect. Find your flow. Become industrious. It’s about the work here.
Always Offer Context: Sharing rationale works wonders in asynchronous conversations.
Impeccable Agreement: Promise, then follow through. Everyone relies on everyone.
Egos are checked at the door. Those who join our workforce place themselves in service of our members.
Our Values
#collaboration #craftsmanship #feedback #respect #responsibility #simplicity #speed
Our Future
To this day, over 30 million people have started their journey to better themselves with our apps. We are creating a generation of change-makers, with the same drive to help others, each in their own way.
Our Invitation
At Fabulous, every team member is a sculptor in their own right. Together, we help millions of users step out of their block of stone and step into the fullest version of their life through behavioral science. Tell us what drives you; if you were to pick up your tools, what would you contribution look like?
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Fractional Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – SaaS & AI/LLM
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial Fractional CTO to join our team. This role is ideal for a hands-on technology leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and can take a product from concept to launch. You will be instrumental in shaping the technical direction of our next-generation SaaS platform, built with AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) at its core.
Key Responsibilities
Design and architect the product’s technical foundation.
Build and deliver the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
Lead the integration and experimentation with AI/LLM technologies.
Drive rapid prototyping to move from idea, working product quickly.
Ensure scalability and robustness of the product architecture.
Collaborate with founders and stakeholders to align technical execution with business goals.
Qualifications & Skills
5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior leadership role (CTO, Lead Engineer, or equivalent).
Strong hands-on coding ability (preferably full-stack).
Deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and LLM integration.
Expertise in SaaS architecture and cloud infrastructure.

jobs.title: Vice President, AI & Technology
jobs.text:
Job Title: Vice President, AI & Technology
Company: Solen Software Group
Location: US
Employment Type : Full-time
About Solen Software Group
Solen Software Group is an evergreen holding company that acquires and operates proven software businesses that have significant growth potential in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be market leaders in their niche industry. Solen owns several software companies in various market spaces: Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions in a variety of industries. Solen is backed by a group of advisors and investors that have built software businesses of material scale (10-100M in ARR) and advised many.
About the role
The Vice President of AI & Technology will serve as the technology leader across our growing portfolio of software businesses, partnering directly with the Portfolio Leader to drive AI transformation, engineering excellence, technology strategy, and innovation.
This role is responsible for transforming portfolio companies into AI-native organizations by modernizing engineering teams, implementing AI-first development practices, and identifying new technology-enabled growth opportunities. Beyond overseeing existing technology organizations, the VP will help incubate new AI-native businesses, support M&A diligence and integration, and establish portfolio-wide standards for engineering, security, architecture, and technology operations.
This is a highly strategic, hands-on leadership role that blends technology, product, operations, and venture creation.
Key Responsibilities
AI Strategy & Transformation
Serve as the portfolio's subject matter expert on AI, continuously evaluating emerging technologies, models, frameworks, and market trends.
Partner with the Portfolio Leader to define and execute the portfolio-wide AI strategy.
Lead the transformation of engineering organizations into AI-native teams by redesigning organizational structures, roles, workflows, and delivery models.
Establish an AI-first Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), embedding AI throughout planning, development, testing, documentation, deployment, and support.
Evaluate and implement AI tooling that improves engineering productivity, software quality, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
Drive AI adoption across engineering, product, customer support, sales, and internal operations where appropriate.
Technology Leadership
Establish portfolio-wide standards for architecture, security, infrastructure, engineering quality, and technology governance.
Guide technical roadmaps across portfolio companies to ensure scalability, modernization, and long-term maintainability.
Partner with executive leadership to prioritize technology investments that create measurable customer and enterprise value.
Standardize engineering metrics, tooling, and best practices while allowing flexibility for individual business needs.
Engineering & Talent Leadership
Lead engineering organizational strategy across the portfolio.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain exceptional technical talent and leaders.
Make organizational design, hiring, succession planning, and performance management decisions across engineering organizations.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.
AI Venture Creation
Identify opportunities to build standalone AI-native products and companies that leverage the portfolio's expertise and distribution channels.
Partner with the Portfolio Leader to evaluate market opportunities, product strategy, commercialization plans, and investment priorities.
Lead technical execution from concept through launch for new AI ventures.
Create reusable AI capabilities that can be deployed across multiple portfolio companies while also serving external markets.
Mergers & Acquisitions
Lead technical due diligence for prospective acquisitions.
Assess engineering organizations, architecture, security posture, technical debt, scalability, and AI readiness.
Develop technology integration strategies for newly acquired businesses.
Accelerate post-acquisition modernization and alignment with portfolio technology standards.
What Success Looks Like
Engineering organizations operate as AI-native teams.
Development velocity and software quality improve through AI-enabled workflows.
Portfolio companies adopt common technology standards while maintaining business agility.
New AI products and businesses are launched that create meaningful enterprise value.
Acquisitions are integrated efficiently with minimal technical disruption.
Engineering organizations become a competitive advantage across the portfolio.
Solen-isms (How We Operate)
· Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
· Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
· Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
· Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
· Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
· Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
· Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
· Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
· Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
· Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
· Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
· Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
· Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.
Recruitment Disclaimer
Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.
We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for a Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform to lead and evolve the engineering platforms and infrastructure that power Carousell Group at scale.
This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can operate across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and go deep in at least two of these areas.
You will help shape how our engineering organisation builds, operates and scales systems while driving the adoption of AI-native and agentic engineering practices across the organisation.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating at both strategic and technical depth. You should be able to engage with senior engineers on architecture and technical decisions while also leading managers and engineering organisations through complex, multi-year initiatives.
What You Will Do
Lead and evolve our platform, infrastructure and engineering capabilities to support highly scalable and reliable systems across Carousell Group.
Drive agentic engineering and AI adoption across engineering teams, leading from the front with hands-on experience applying AI to engineering workflows and software development.
Provide technical direction across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and make sound architecture decisions across these areas.
Lead the design and operation of highly scalable distributed systems with strong focus on reliability, performance, observability and operational excellence.
Partner with engineering leaders across the organisation to improve developer productivity, engineering velocity and system reliability.
Build and develop a strong engineering leadership layer and help principal and senior engineers grow their technical leadership.
Lead distributed engineering teams through managers and create an environment where senior technical talent can do their best work.
Drive engineering excellence across areas including service runtime, observability, scaling, service communication, data consistency, developer tooling, networking, security and infrastructure.
Own and influence significant infrastructure and platform investments including engineering efficiency and cloud cost optimisation.
Work closely with Product, Data, Engineering and executive stakeholders to shape technical strategy and influence business outcomes.
Operate effectively across multiple markets, teams and cultures within Carousell Group.
What Success Looks Like
In this role, success will mean:
Our engineering teams are increasingly AI-native and effective in using agentic engineering practices.
Our platform and infrastructure can scale reliably with the growth of the business.
Engineering teams have strong internal platforms, tooling and infrastructure that allow them to move faster without compromising reliability.
Senior technical talent is being developed into stronger technical and organisational leaders.
Platform and infrastructure investments are managed with a strong balance between engineering quality, reliability, developer productivity and cost.
You become a trusted technical partner to engineering and business leaders across Carousell Group.
What We're Looking For
Must Have
Significant experience leading large-scale engineering organisations in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and/or Data Engineering.
Deep technical expertise in at least two of the three areas while having enough breadth across all three to effectively lead teams with deeper specialists.
Strong hands-on experience driving AI-native or agentic engineering adoption within an engineering organisation.
Strong distributed systems architecture and design expertise.
A track record of successfully building, scaling and operating high-scale platforms or systems.
Experience leading complex technical initiatives from architecture through execution and operations.
Strong technical judgement with the ability to engage credibly with Principal and Senior Engineers.
Good to Have
Experience mentoring and developing Principal / Senior Engineers and building strong technical leadership pipelines.
Experience owning cloud infrastructure or platform costs at significant scale.
Experience leading distributed engineering organisations of 15–30+ engineers through an EM layer.
Experience working in a multi-brand, multi-market or multi-business-unit organisation.
Experience working across different geographies and cultures.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence.
By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.
About Carousell Group
Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).
As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of HEART, which is an acronym for Humility, Empathy, Accountability, Relentlessly resourceful and Teamwork. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.

jobs.title: Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design
jobs.text:
Join Us in Building the Future of Human Performance
At Viction, we're not building another health app — we're building a new category of human performance technology.
Our mission is to empower people to better understand themselves and continuously improve every aspect of their health and performance through scientifically grounded insights, intelligent coaching, and beautifully designed technology.
We believe sophisticated health science should feel simple, actionable, and inspiring. By combining biomarkers, wearable technologies, nutrition, recovery, behavioral science, and artificial intelligence into a unified platform, Viction will help individuals make better daily performance-based decisions, ultimately allowing them to realize their full potential.
We're seeking an experienced product leader who is energized by the opportunity to help define an entirely new category of human performance technology. This is a rare opportunity to shape not only a product, but the direction of a company.
The Opportunity
Product Strategy and Design are inseparable at Viction. As our Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design, you will serve as the steward of our product vision, translating strategy into execution while ensuring every feature contributes to a cohesive, differentiated, and compelling member experience.
This is a founding product leadership opportunity. You'll work directly with our founders, advisory board, UX/UI designers, engineers, AI specialists, and domain experts to determine what we build, why we build it, and how we deliver an experience that members genuinely love.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities
What You'll Own
What problems deserve solving
Which features matter most
Which features should wait
How features reinforce one another
What creates lasting competitive differentiation
What gets built, and why it gets built
Feature priorities, technical and business dependencies, and product sequencing
Release planning
Protection of MVP discipline while guiding long-term platform evolution
Core Responsibilities
Lead product strategy and evolve the long-term product vision
Translate strategy into product roadmaps, epics, user stories, and development plans
Lead product discovery, customer research, and journey mapping
Guide UX/UI direction to create a premium consumer-grade experience
Own the end-to-end member experience across onboarding, AI coaching, scoring, education, engagement, and retention
Partner across engineering, design, AI, clinical, marketing, and leadership teams
Champion a scalable design system and exceptional product quality
Continuously validate assumptions through customer feedback and analytics
Monitor emerging trends in AI, digital health, wearables, and human performance
Education & Experience
Who You Are
An experienced product leader with a passion for building consumer products
Equally comfortable discussing customer psychology, UX, AI, engineering trade-offs, and business strategy
A systems thinker who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys creating clarity
A collaborative leader who inspires teams without relying on formal authority
Someone who believes every feature should have a purpose and every interaction should build trust
Preferred Experience
Consumer mobile applications
Digital health, wellness, or human performance
AI-enabled products
Wearables and connected devices
Subscription platforms
Behavior-change or coaching products
Startup or early-stage company experience
Certifications
Industry related certifications are a plus
Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote, fractional engagement (~20 hours per week)
What Success Looks Like
Build the right product, not simply adding more features
Create a product experience that feels premium, intuitive, and motivating
Translate vision into disciplined execution
Help position Viction as a category leader in human performance
Why Join Viction?
This is an opportunity to influence the direction of a company from its earliest stages. You'll have meaningful experiences, direct access to founders, the ability to shape product strategy and experience, and the satisfaction of helping build technology that can genuinely improve people's lives.
If you're energized by creating products that blend science, design, technology, and human behavior, and want to leave your fingerprint on something extraordinary, we'd love to meet you.

Product Strategy and Design are inseparable at Viction. As our Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design, you will serve as the steward of our product vision, translating strategy into execution while ensuring every feature contributes to a cohesive, differentiated, and compelling member experience.

This is a founding product leadership opportunity. You'll work directly with our founders, advisory board, UX/UI designers, engineers, AI specialists, and domain experts to determine what we build, why we build it, and how we deliver an experience that members genuinely love.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities
What You'll Own
What problems deserve solving
Which features matter most
Which features should wait
How features reinforce one another
What creates lasting competitive differentiation
What gets built, and why it gets built
Feature priorities, technical and business dependencies, and product sequencing
Release planning
Protection of MVP discipline while guiding long-term platform evolution
Core Responsibilities
Lead product strategy and evolve the long-term product vision
Translate strategy into product roadmaps, epics, user stories, and development plans
Lead product discovery, customer research, and journey mapping
Guide UX/UI direction to create a premium consumer-grade experience
Own the end-to-end member experience across onboarding, AI coaching, scoring, education, engagement, and retention
Partner across engineering, design, AI, clinical, marketing, and leadership teams
Champion a scalable design system and exceptional product quality
Continuously validate assumptions through customer feedback and analytics
Monitor emerging trends in AI, digital health, wearables, and human performance
Education & Experience
Who You Are
An experienced product leader with a passion for building consumer products
Equally comfortable discussing customer psychology, UX, AI, engineering trade-offs, and business strategy
A systems thinker who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys creating clarity
A collaborative leader who inspires teams without relying on formal authority
Someone who believes every feature should have a purpose and every interaction should build trust
Preferred Experience
Consumer mobile applications

AI-enabled products
Wearables and connected devices
Subscription platforms
Behavior-change or coaching products
Startup or early-stage company experience

Build the right product, not simply adding more features

Help position Viction as a category leader in human performance

jobs.text:
Job Title: VP, Product Delivery & Growth - AI
Location: USA - Remote
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
Join us in redefining healthcare , so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
About the Team
The Integrated Care + SNF Reimbursement portfolio spans the connected workflows that carry a resident from referral through care delivery to payment: including, acute and payer care collaboration on the National Care Collaboration Network and Audacious platforms, Secure Conversations across our customer segments, practitioner EHR solutions, SNF admissions and managed care workflows, and SNF revenue cycle and reimbursement optimization.
The Outbound Product Management team within this portfolio is the bridge between strategic customer relationships, go-to-market execution, and product direction. The team is remote and hybrid across the US and Canada, and works shoulder to shoulder with inbound Product Management, Engineering, and every GTM function.
Key Responsibilities:
Go-To-Market Strategy & Portfolio Growth: Own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the portfolio from launch through scale. Define the growth thesis for each product line, set adoption and revenue targets with Sales and Revenue Operations, and drive cross-functional accountability for attainment.
Commercial Model & Monetization: Lead pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy for new and AI-enabled capabilities, including usage-based pricing, tiered access, and enterprise licensing. Partner with Pricing, Finance, and Revenue Operations on scalable models that protect margin.
Product Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with inbound Product Management leaders to shape portfolio direction, translating customer feedback, competitive signals, and adoption data into roadmap and investment recommendations. Serve as the commercial voice in portfolio planning and trade-off decisions.
Executive Customer Engagement & Market Leadership: Build executive relationships across strategic SNF, payer, practitioner, and acute accounts. Lead beta and co-development programs that generate real-world proof points, and represent PointClickCare with customers, industry bodies, and analysts.
Organizational Leadership & Talent Development: Lead and grow the Outbound Product Management function, including leaders of teams. Hire, coach, and develop talent, establish operating cadence and standards aligned with the product development lifecycle and go-to-market model, and foster accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Portfolio Performance & Market Insight: Define and track portfolio, customer engagement, and go-to-market KPIs. Lead competitive analysis, customer research, and thought leadership, and partner with legal, compliance, and governance teams to support responsible deployment of AI-enabled capabilities.

Executive Customer Engagement & Market Leadership: Build executive relationships across strategic SNF, payer, practitioner, and acute accounts. Lead beta and co-development programs that generate real-world proof points, and represent PointClickCare with customers, industry bodies, and analysts.

Hire, coach, and develop talent, establish operating cadence and standards aligned with the product development lifecycle and go-to-market model, and foster accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Portfolio Performance & Market Insight: Define and track portfolio, customer engagement, and go-to-market KPIs. Lead competitive analysis, customer research, and thought leadership, and partner with legal, compliance, and governance teams to support responsible deployment of AI-enabled capabilities.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
12+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or product growth, including 5+ years leading teams at the Director level or above.
Demonstrated ownership of go-to-market strategy for a multi-product portfolio, with accountability for adoption and revenue outcomes beyond launch execution.
Proven success building commercial models for SaaS and AI-enabled products, including pricing, packaging, and monetization, with fluency in ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, and churn.
Executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence and align senior leaders across Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Solutions, Pricing, and Professional Services.
Experience leading leaders, including hiring, developing, and scaling teams through organizational change.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills, using qualitative and quantitative signals to set priorities and make defensible trade-offs.
Ability to travel regularly to strategic customer sites and industry events, with occasional travel to PointClickCare offices.
Preferred Experience:
Background in post-acute care, senior care, or payer-provider collaboration models.
Experience taking AI-enabled products to market, including generative AI, large language model, and agentic capabilities.
Familiarity with interoperability, care transitions, and referral and authorization workflows.

jobs.title: Head of AI Solutions & Engineering  - Technology & Innovation
jobs.text:
Position Summary
To advance Teach For All’s 25-year vision, we are seeking a strategic AI leader developer to join our Technology & Innovation team and work globally to identify and implement transformative technology solutions to accelerate the impact of our global network.
This role will work across the network with partners or groups of partners in order to identify and deliver transformative AI-forward technology products to accelerate network impact, as well as internally across the global organization to increase efficiency and effectiveness of our work. The successful candidate will also be responsible for helping build and cultivate a community of technology enthusiasts across the network made up of network staff members, fellows and alumni who will contribute to these projects.
About the Team
The Technology & Innovation Team provides thought-leadership and solutions as well as foundational support in the use of technology to unlock potential and accelerate impact across the organization and the global network. The team leverages a deep understanding of the work and needs of the global organization, its teams and partners, our own expertise and global best practice to provide targeted solutions and technologies to accelerate our global impact. You will play a key role in this work.
Outcomes
Identifying and delivering key AI-forward technologies for network partners to support their work. These may include tools for common needs across the network – classroom data collection, professional development of fellows, scheduling and management of Assessment Centers (where teaching fellows are selected) or new platforms (connectivity tools, online learning) - which are identified and scoped in partnership with our network partners. Many if not all of these technologies will include AI components.
Similarly, identifying and delivering technology solutions to increase the impact of the global organization. This could include improvements to ourlearning portals for network staff, fellows and alumni, an online platform enabling teachers and teacher coaches across and beyond our network to engage in our global professional development learning community, or a new global “constituent voice” system that enables all our network partners to surface feedback from key constituents in ways that strengthen global learning loops.
Taking an AI-forward approach to increase organizational effectiveness, increase our impact in supporting network partners in their work, and evolve our systems and ways of working to incorporate new tools and technologies.
Successful management of two solutions engineers and a UI/UX specialist to deliver your ambitious strategy and goals.
Key Responsibilities :
Strategy Development
Working across network partners and internal stakeholders including our AI and Ed Tech Initiative team to build context and identify key potential technology solutions to accelerate impact
Developing a responsive and evolving strategy to prioritize and develop these key technologies, working closely with the Technology & Innovation team and key senior stakeholders to invest them in the strategy
Providing regular updates internally and externally regarding progress, and regularly revisiting and modifying the solutions strategy as needs change
Requirements Gathering, Analysis and Execution
Gathering requirements for prioritized projects through stakeholder interviews and discussion, ensuring that all projects are accessible, inclusive of the various needs of the network and sustainable for all network partners
Synthesizing requirements and developing holistic solutions to meet the needs of your stakeholders, ensuring that key needs and requirements are met within project and budgetary constraints
Working both individually and collaboratively across the Technology & Innovation team and any external vendors or collaborators needed to develop and deliver prioritized solutions
Ensuring that end users are trained and supported along with the Technology & Innovation Operations team
Identifying key metrics and measures of success, and reporting on those throughout the phases of each project
Identifying and managing key improvements through user and stakeholder interviews
Team Management
Lead a team of 2 within the broader Technology & Innovation team to deliver on your solutions strategy for the organization and broader network
Community Building and Management
Supplementing the work of the AI and Ed Tech Initiative team, helping develop a community of technology enthusiasts across the network, and working across key stakeholders internally and throughout the network to share best practice and amplify the impact of community members
Where possible, involving the community members in the development of the technology solutions identified as part of the three year strategy
Encouraging and supporting community-developed solutions
Qualifications
Computer Science or related degree and/or equivalent years of formal training and experience, with a clear track record of delivering AI-forward solutions in a broad range of contexts
7+ years of relevant working experience, including designing and delivering AI-powered solutions, with a proven portfolio showcasing high-impact, scalable implementations across diverse contexts
Strong experience with AI libraries and frameworks, as well as associated Typescript and Python skills
REST-based API integration experience, preferably including experience with popular Generative AI APIs and libraries
Proficiency in Git and other version control systems is essential, with a proven ability to effectively manage code repositories, track changes, and collaborate with team members using branching, merging, and pull request workflows.
Ability to design easy to use and compelling user interfaces and experiences
Experience with Cloud Technologies, including Google Cloud
Comfort and experience in engaging with new technologies
Participation in open-source development projects and communities
An understanding of working with technology in bandwidth-constrained environments
Passion about Education, AI and Ed Tech
History of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
Strong business analyst skills, communications skills and ability to manage multiple diverse stakeholders
Sensitivity to diversity in backgrounds and beliefs (e.g., racial, cultural, socioeconomic, political, etc.)
Deeply committed to the mission, vision and values of Teach For All
Additional desirable skills/experiences
Comfort and curiosity in engaging with new and emerging technologies
Participation in open-source development projects and communities
Experience working in bandwidth-constrained environments
Passion for Education, AI and EdTech
Proven track record of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
Sensitivity to diversity in backgrounds and beliefs (e.g., racial, cultural, socioeconomic, political, etc.)
Strong alignment with and commitment to the mission, vision, and values of Teach For All
What Teach For All Offers:
Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
All roles are 100% remote; in some locations we offer the option for in-office collaborations
Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
And much more!
Compensation
This role is a three-year fixed term contract. Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.
Work Authorization
This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.
Travel and Hours
Travel up to 20% is possible when it is safe to do so and in accordance with local travel guidelines. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role. This role will communicate and work globally regardless of location.
Apply now
If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all
About Teach For All
Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

items: Working across network partners and internal stakeholders including our AI and Ed Tech Initiative team to build context and identify key potential technology solutions to accelerate impact

Developing a responsive and evolving strategy to prioritize and develop these key technologies, working closely with the Technology & Innovation team and key senior stakeholders to invest them in the strategy
Providing regular updates internally and externally regarding progress, and regularly revisiting and modifying the solutions strategy as needs change

blocks.text: Requirements Gathering, Analysis and Execution

items: Gathering requirements for prioritized projects through stakeholder interviews and discussion, ensuring that all projects are accessible, inclusive of the various needs of the network and sustainable for all network partners
Synthesizing requirements and developing holistic solutions to meet the needs of your stakeholders, ensuring that key needs and requirements are met within project and budgetary constraints
Working both individually and collaboratively across the Technology & Innovation team and any external vendors or collaborators needed to develop and deliver prioritized solutions
Ensuring that end users are trained and supported along with the Technology & Innovation Operations team
Identifying key metrics and measures of success, and reporting on those throughout the phases of each project
Identifying and managing key improvements through user and stakeholder interviews

blocks.text: Team Management

items: Lead a team of 2 within the broader Technology & Innovation team to deliver on your solutions strategy for the organization and broader network

blocks.text: Community Building and Management

items: Supplementing the work of the AI and Ed Tech Initiative team, helping develop a community of technology enthusiasts across the network, and working across key stakeholders internally and throughout the network to share best practice and amplify the impact of community members
Where possible, involving the community members in the development of the technology solutions identified as part of the three year strategy
Encouraging and supporting community-developed solutions

7+ years of relevant working experience, including designing and delivering AI-powered solutions, with a proven portfolio showcasing high-impact, scalable implementations across diverse contexts
Strong experience with AI libraries and frameworks, as well as associated Typescript and Python skills
REST-based API integration experience, preferably including experience with popular Generative AI APIs and libraries

Ability to design easy to use and compelling user interfaces and experiences
Experience with Cloud Technologies, including Google Cloud
Comfort and experience in engaging with new technologies
Participation in open-source development projects and communities

Passion about Education, AI and Ed Tech
History of driving technology projects from inception to delivery
Strong business analyst skills, communications skills and ability to manage multiple diverse stakeholders

Deeply committed to the mission, vision and values of Teach For All

blocks.text: Compensation
This role is a three-year fixed term contract. Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.
Work Authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.
Travel and Hours

Travel up to 20% is possible when it is safe to do so and in accordance with local travel guidelines. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role. This role will communicate and work globally regardless of location.
Apply now

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all
About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Real people. Real service.
At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.
We are looking for a Director of Product to own our product operating model end to end: the practice of product management, the delivery engine that gets work shipped, and the annual roadmap that connects both to company strategy. Reporting into our COO, this individual will lead a team of Product Managers embedded in cross-functional pods and hold those pods accountable for measurable customer and business outcomes. The Director of Product will work in close partnership with the VP of IT, Senior Manager of UX, Director of Enterprise AI Adoption, and business leaders to connect customer needs, business priorities, technical strategy, and execution. If you’re passionate about building high-performing product organizations, enjoy turning strategy into action, and are excited to lead cross-functional teams in delivering product experiences that are strategically sound, technically feasible, thoughtfully designed, and impactful for customers and the business, we want to hear from you!
This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.
This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 6 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.
Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Location: Remote
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility
Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $193,389 to $276,270 within a full position range of $193,389 to $359,151 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.
What you will own:
Accountability across the pod structure
Pod ownership. Own outcome accountability for every product pod, ensuring each has a clear mission, a primary success metric, and explicit guardrail metrics.
Decision rights and shared accountability. Establish clear decision rights across Product, UX, and Engineering. Product leads customer problem definition, business outcomes, prioritization, and roadmap decisions; UX leads research and experience design; Engineering leads technical architecture and implementation. Hold each trio jointly accountable for delivering measurable outcomes, with unresolved tradeoffs escalated and decided quickly.
Cross-pod seams. Resolve cross-pod dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and platform-versus-feature tradeoffs before they become delivery risk.
Operating cadence. Define and maintain the standards that make pods legible to leadership: how bets are written, how success is defined up front, how results get reported, and what happens when we need to pivot.
Leading and developing product managers
People leadership. Directly manage and coach a team of product managers with clear leveling expectations and honest, specific feedback.
Craft development. Build Product Management craft across discovery and delivery: opportunity framing, jobs-to-be-done and customer problem definition, hypothesis writing, experiment design, and evidence-based prioritization.
Hiring. Recruit, onboard, and retain strong product talent. Own the hiring bar and the interview loop for the function.
Influence without authority. Coach Product Managers to lead through influence across Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Customer Service, and Engineering without relying on formal authority.
Managing to outcomes, not outputs
Outcome definition. Translate company strategy into a product strategy with a north star metric and a supporting metric tree, so every pod can trace its work to a business result.
Measurement. Replace feature-count reporting with outcome reporting: leading and lagging indicators, target versus actual, and a clear read on what we learned.
Continuous discovery. Partner with the Director of Customer Experience to establish a consistent customer research and usability practice across product teams, validate bets before they consume significant engineering capacity, and stop or pivot work that is not moving the intended metric.
Evidence-based prioritization. Ensure prioritization reflects qualitative customer insight, behavioral data, business performance, and operational feedback rather than stakeholder preference alone.
Customer proximity. Build direct exposure to professional tradespeople and internal users into the product management operating model.
Portfolio balance. Manage capacity as a portfolio of bets across core growth, platform health, and exploratory work, and be able to defend that allocation to the executive team.
Roadmap ownership
Annual roadmap. Build and publish the annual product roadmap, then maintain it as a living now / next / later view rather than a fixed feature calendar with dates attached to everything.
Quarterly planning. Run the quarterly planning process: OKR setting, bet selection, capacity modeling, and tradeoff decisions with clear rationale.
Executive alignment. Keep the roadmap credible with senior leadership and the board through clear, unhedged communication about what is committed, what is a bet, and what changed.
Backlog health. Maintain a rigorously prioritized backlog with a real definition of ready and definition of done, so pods are never blocked on ambiguity.
Project management and delivery
Integrated planning. Ensure significant initiatives have clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, resource assumptions, risks, decision points, and launch criteria.
Risk management. Establish a consistent process for identifying, escalating, and resolving delivery risks before they affect committed outcomes or timelines.
Delivery accountability. Hold product managers accountable for maintaining clear plans, decisions, status reporting, and stakeholder alignment from discovery through post-launch evaluation.
Cross-functional execution. Coordinate dependencies across Product, IT, UX, AI Enterprise Enablement, Marketing, Merchandising, Operations, Customer Service, and other impacted teams.
Commitment discipline. Differentiate committed work from discovery, experiments, and potential future investments so leadership has an accurate view of delivery confidence.
Change management and adoption. Ensure significant product launches include stakeholder communication, training, operational readiness, adoption planning, and feedback mechanisms. Hold product teams accountable for sustained adoption and value realization, not only technical release.
Post-launch accountability. Require adoption, performance, customer feedback, operational impact, and lessons learned to be reviewed after launch.
Delivery health. Measure and improve delivery health through indicators such as cycle time, throughput, and predictability.
Process stewardship. Improve the tools and operating rhythms that make delivery visible, while removing process that does not improve decisions, accountability, or execution.
Technical product leadership
Partner with the VP of IT and engineering leaders to align the product roadmap with technical strategy, architecture, capacity, security, reliability, scalability, and platform health.
Ensure product managers can translate business and customer needs into requirements that account for system dependencies, integrations, data flows, APIs, and nonfunctional requirements.
Evaluate build, buy, and partner options using customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, implementation risk, total cost, and long-term maintainability.
Balance customer-facing enhancements with platform modernization, technical debt reduction, system reliability, and foundational capabilities.
Ensure technical constraints and dependencies are surfaced early enough to inform prioritization, sequencing, and executive decisions.
Establish strong partnership between product managers and technical leads without expecting product managers to dictate engineering solutions.
AI-enabled product strategy
Partner closely with the Director of AI Enterprise Enablement to identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI opportunities across customer-facing products and internal workflows.
Translate validated AI opportunities into product roadmaps with clear users, business outcomes, success measures, data requirements, and adoption plans.
Ensure AI-enabled product decisions consider usability, data quality, security, responsible-use expectations, technical feasibility, and ongoing performance.
Distinguish between experimentation and scalable production capabilities, with clear criteria for piloting, measuring, expanding, or discontinuing AI solutions.
Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities and prevent fragmented tools or duplicative solutions from developing across product teams.
Data and analytics
Product measurement. Establish the analytics, instrumentation, and reporting needed to evaluate product adoption, customer behavior, operational impact, and business results.
Measurement readiness. Partner with data and technical teams to ensure product decisions are based on reliable information and that measurement requirements are defined before launch.
What you bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
10 or more years of experience in product management, including 4 or more years of experience directly managing Product Managers. Experience managing managers is a plus.
A track record of owning a business metric, not just a backlog. You can point to specific outcomes you moved and explain how you knew.
Demonstrated technical fluency across e-commerce platforms, APIs, integrations, data flows, enterprise systems, and platform dependencies. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to evaluate technical tradeoffs and earn credibility with engineering leaders.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, UX, Data, and business stakeholders.
Experience operating in a pod, squad, or cross-functional team model and establishing clear decision rights and shared accountability across functions that do not report through the same leader.
Strong understanding of user research, experience design, analytics, experimentation, and product adoption.
Experience evaluating and scaling AI-enabled products or emerging technology capabilities preferred.
Experience balancing customer-facing product investments with platform health, technical debt, security, reliability, and scalability.
Strong product delivery and program leadership. You have led complex initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption, can establish appropriate delivery discipline, and know when process is enabling progress versus creating unnecessary overhead.
Demonstrated ability to introduce product and delivery discipline without creating unnecessary process or slowing execution.
Executive communication skills. You can hold a room with senior leadership, defend a tradeoff with evidence, and say no clearly and respectfully.
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping and learning over waiting for certainty.
E-commerce, marketplace, or B2B distribution experience preferred. Familiarity with trade or industrial customers is a plus.
Why work with us:
We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
401(k) with up to 4% company match
Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 work from home stipend
$750 annual professional development budget
$25 monthly Grubhub credit
Company rewards and recognition program
And more!
We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
We support growth – We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.
Check us out and learn more at: https://www.supplyhouse.com/our-company!
Additional Details:
Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. SupplyHouse.com will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

jobs.text:
About your tasks:
Shape Retail Media & Marketplace: Set the engineering direction across both domains, deciding where the platforms should converge to create the most value for brands, sellers and Redcare.
Lead and grow the organisation: Develop your Engineering Managers and their teams, shaping the organisation as the domains evolve while creating an environment with clear ownership and autonomy.
Drive engineering excellence: Own delivery, reliability, architecture and technical debt, continuously raising engineering maturity and enabling teams to move quickly without compromising quality.
Turn technology into commercial impact: Co-own roadmaps with Product and Commercial, connecting engineering priorities to outcomes such as take rate, advertiser ROAS, seller economics and contribution margin.
Own strategic partnerships: Lead engineering relationships with external platforms, integrators and agencies, including build/buy/partner decisions, integrations, SLAs and vendor performance.
About you:
You have 3+ years of experience leading multiple engineering teams through managers or leads and have successfully led organisations through significant change, such as merging domains, introducing new scope or replacing a platform.
You have led development of commercial B2B platforms such as a marketplace, retail media, ad tech, payments or a seller/partner platform, with experience across high-traffic and transactional systems.
You combine strong technical judgement with commercial thinking, connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes and confidently partnering with senior Product and Commercial stakeholders.
You care deeply about engineering excellence, can demonstrate measurable improvements you have driven, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, external partners and competing priorities. Strong English communication skills are essential.
About your benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:
Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers.
Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
Vacation: 30 days paid vacation per annum (plus another day on Rosenmontag) and the option to take unpaid vacation of up to 10 days (after one year working with us).
Corporate pension plan: We offer a company pension scheme and have a dedicated external consultant to offer you the best guidance and advice.
About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.
About the role:
Retail Media and Marketplace are two of Redcare Pharmacy’s fastest-growing and most strategically important domains — and this is your opportunity to shape how they evolve together. Leading an engineering organisation of around 40 engineers across 5–7 teams, you will decide where these two distinct platforms should converge to create a seamless experience for brands and sellers, and where they should remain separate to perform at their best.
This is a high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly influence our customer experience and commercial growth. Reporting to our Executive Director of Engineering / VP of Engineering, you will lead through two Engineering Managers and partner closely with Product and Commercial leadership to turn engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director – Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.text:
About Re:Build
At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.
We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.
The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)
Who we are looking for
The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering is a hands-on leadership role in Re:Build Manufacturing's Digital Innovation Group (DIG). This role reflects the organization’s belief that digital innovation is key to scaling as a premier industrial company. In this position, the Director is responsible for hiring, leading, and developing a team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who are embedded across Re:Build sites and Resource Center functions, implementing full-stack digital solutions that solve real-world business problems and drive measurable business impact. Success in the role depends on the ability to build trust, ensure alignment, and partner effectively with internal stakeholders throughout the entire product lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines a strong software engineering background with proven experience managing software delivery and solution engineering that directly serves customers. They bring deep technical credibility, strong people leadership skills, and the judgment needed to keep engagements well prioritized and delivered quickly.
What you get to do
Partner with portfolio Manufacturing, Engineering Services, and Functional teams to identify difficulties, operational inefficiencies, and opportunities for digital solutions
Evaluate and prioritize digital solution opportunities based on business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment
Guide FDEs through sophisticated technical decisions, feature development, fixing issues, code reviews, and delivery execution across collaborator engagement
Define and implement engineering standards and coding practices across FDE projects to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security of delivered solutions
Build the repeatable delivery machine of reusable assets, playbooks, user documentation, and implementation approaches that strengthen delivery excellence and collaborator enablement
Establish metrics to measure solution impact and value post-deployment and gather feedback for continuous improvement
Evaluate and foster the adoption of emerging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, review, testing automation) across the FDE team to accelerate delivery velocity and code quality
Know the latest digital trends in AI, software development, manufacturing, Industry 4.0 technologies, and relevant SaaS solutions
Ability to travel 25% to customer sites (will only require domestic US travel)
What you bring to the Team
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field required; MBA or relevant advanced degree; or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred
8+ years of experience leading customer-facing software delivery, implementation, solution engineering, consulting, or technical delivery programs within enterprise SaaS, technology, or systems integrator environments
2+ years of people leadership or technical leadership experience leading and developing engineers, architects, consultants, or technical delivery teams
3-5 years of hands-on software development, solution engineering, integration development, or full-stack development experience, including technical leadership responsibilities
Experience with DevSecOps practices, secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, and Agile/SAFe delivery frameworks
Fluency in AI technologies applied to software development lifecycle
Proficiency with project and delivery management tools such as Jira and Confluence, with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent engagements
Experience in manufacturing operations, industrial engineering, or engineering services strongly preferred
The BIG payoff
We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!
We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate
Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.
Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at or you may call us at 617.909.6275.
Originally posted on Himalayas
