jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Engineering Director
College Board– Technology
Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.
Type: This is a full-time position
About Technology at College Board
We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.
About the Team
Create is a group of cross-functional teams responsible for building and evolving how educators author tasks and assessments. Create Core is the platform team within Create that builds the shared foundations the authoring applications are made from: a rich text editing library, canonical item and task data models, a centralized metadata service, and APIs/interfaces for interacting with assessment data.
Core'susers are other engineering teams as it builds and maintains foundational libraries and services for our applications. Its repositories run as an internal open-source project that engineers can propose changes to. The team does critical work that the rest of the ecosystem depends on, so quality, developer experience, and accessibility are fundamental aspects of the role.
About the Opportunity
As Engineering Director, Create Core, you will lead the platform team at the center of College Board's authoring ecosystem. This is direct team leadership: you will manage a small group of experienced engineers, work closely with Product to define the roadmap, and be accountable for team health, delivery, and the long-term coherence of the platform.
The role asks you to treat the platform as a product. Your users are the engineers on Create's application teams, and success looks like those teams shipping faster because Core's foundations are solid, well-documented, and easy to adopt. You will prioritize Core's investments against real application needs and steward the contribution model that lets consuming teams help build what they use.
Leaders in this space are expected to operate at or near a senior engineer level in system design and code quality, with the ability to review code, assess technical tradeoffs, and guide teams toward sound implementation decisions. You will partner closely with the domain's Principal Engineer on technical strategy, with application engineering directors on adoption and boundaries, and with product and design leaders on where the platform goes next. Success in this role is measured by the health and effectiveness of the Core team, the trust application teams place in the platform, the degree to which shared foundations reduce duplicated work, and the environment you create for engineers to learn, experiment, and do their best work.
In this role, you will:
Provide Platform Leadership & Delivery (40%)
Lead the Create Core team directly, setting clear goals and expectations while enabling engineers to own execution.
Work in close partnership with Product and the application teams to prioritize the Core roadmap, balancing new capabilities against the stability and support obligations.
Run the platform as a product: gather needs from consuming teams, make deliberate build/decline decisions, and communicate direction so application teams can plan against it.
Act as the point of decision for platform scope, adoption sequencing, and cross-team trade-offs involving Core.
Develop deep understanding of the business needs your team serves to provide leadership and consistent messaging around the work of the team.
Technical Leadership & Quality (30%)
Guide the architecture of shared libraries and services.
Hold a high bar for developer experience: documentation, paved paths, reference implementations, and local-first tooling that make Core easy to adopt
Ensure accessibility is built into the foundations, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA across Core components with assistive-technology testing in the definition of done
Partner with the Principal Engineer and architects to evolve data models, editor architecture, and platform boundaries as the ecosystem grows
Build a highly engaged, and high-performing team (30%)
Cultivate norms that support strong communication, a positive working culture, and an engaged team.
Define ceremonies that support your high-performing Agile team, while maximizing productive work time.
Actively cultivate the superpowers of team members and leverage these to develop products.
Support diversity and inclusion from the perspectives of demographics, skills, and experience.
Manage work culture to ensure the mission and operating principles of College Board are consistently recognized and utilized to promote a productive and fair work environment.
Support and invest in the growth of your team members.
About you, you have:
7 years’ experience in Agile software application development, applying knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques to a broad range of life-cycle activities to meet the requirements for highly secure, data-heavy applications.
Proven expertise delivering web-based products or platform-level features in cloud-first environment using modern development tools.
Written and reviewed production code using preferred technologies: TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React.
Ability to design and evaluate AWS-based architectures with best practices.
Experience managing teams of 4 to 8 direct reports, including both junior-level and higher-level individual contributors.
Accountability for the technical output of the team, either through personal experience or strong communication with engineers.
Experience overseeing product or platform features, infrastructure, and vendor management, ensuring compliance with internal policies.
Comprehensive experience in all aspects of people management, including hiring, engaging, and developing team members, with a proven track record of successful leadership.
Experience leading engineering and architecture discussions, bringing stakeholders to agreement.
Exceptional planning, prioritization, and execution skills, delivering results on time and on budget in fast-paced environments.
Experience establishing new teams and laying foundation for new products, ideally within a large organization.
Outstanding communication and leadership abilities, building trust quickly across teams and levels, and effectively coaching team members with timely, balanced feedback.
Able to travel 3-5 times a year to our NYC or Reston, VA office
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
All roles at College Board require:
A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.
About Our Process
Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
While thehiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.
What We Offer
At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck,we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.
A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation
The hiring range for this role is $140,000 - $175,000
Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.
You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, SyncOS
jobs.text:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands like Ford, Coca-Cola, and Kimberly-Clark — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
We started as roboticists ourselves. We know the pain of fragmented, proprietary systems that refuse to talk to each other. syncOS is our answer — and we believe it's what the industry has been waiting for. We are a young, passionate team chasing one big mission.
WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE FOR THIS ROLE
3 months:
Deep understanding of syncOS, the fleet it orchestrates, and how it runs in live customer environments
Release and deployment process owned end-to-end - every build clearly certified, every deployment owned and reversible
Established as the single technical point of contact for the delivery organisation
Team assessed, and the lead structure for scaling in place
6 months:
Site deployment reliability consistently at target across live customers — repeatable and process-driven
Interface contracts between syncOS and the fleet published and enforced; teams build to a clear spec
Manager layer running well, with depth behind every critical capability
Product discipline visible: platform work and custom work clearly separated, scoped, and priced
12 months:
SyncOS reliability is a competitive strength customers choose us for
A reusable integration catalog with owners and regression tests - each new integration cheaper and faster than the last
SyncOS engineering scales cleanly into new sites and geographies. A self-sufficient organisation with the bench strength to grow beyond you
Key Responsibilities:
Single technical owner of our software platform – SyncOS.
Lead the teams building fleet management, integrations, and the platform core, and own the discipline that gets our software running reliably at customer sites, at scale, across geographies.
The platform, end to end - You own syncOS engineering - fleet management, integrator and dashboard, integration modules, and the platform core and the technical definition of what syncOS is as a product.
Reliability and release quality - You own how software gets from a merged change to running dependably at a customer site: release gating, staged rollout, post-deploy verification, versioned and reversible deployments, and the observability that catches issues before customers do. Site deployment quality is a core measure of your success.
DevOps and site delivery of software - The syncOS DevOps function reports to you. Your team owns updates going onto customer sites as a controlled, repeatable release process.
Architecture and interfaces - You own the interface contracts and data models between syncOS and the integrations - published, enforced, and stable.
The team - You lead and grow the syncOS engineering organization through a layer of team leads: hiring, structure, mentorship, and building an org where no critical capability rests on a single person.
Product-mode engineering - You bring the discipline that keeps a platform a platform - a clear spec, a reusable integration catalog with owners and tests, and the judgment to keep bespoke, one-off work from fragmenting the product.
You will partner closely with:
Product: on what syncOS should do and for whom - you own how it's built and whether it's ready to ship.
Commissioning & Customer Success: who take your certified releases to customer sites - you are their single technical point of contact.
Quality: who independently certify releases - you build to the bar and ship what passes it.
Robotics Engineering: on the interface between the platform and the fleet.

jobs.title: Sr. Director Field Technology Office and Advisory, Senior Director
jobs.text:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
Who We Are
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Summary
As a Senior Director in the Identity Field Technology office, you will lead our global Technical Sales strategy for Palo Alto Networks’ identity solutions. You will work directly with customers, partners, and internal teams to construct compelling solutions, strengthen our thought leadership, and drive our technical go-to-market strategy. This role requires spending significant time in direct interactions with customer and prospect leaders to inspire confidence in our market leadership, with a regional focus on the US West.
Key Responsibilities
Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders at our most strategic customers and partners, leading co-innovation projects.
Act as the voice of the customer, identifying industry trends and technical gaps to inform product management and prioritization.
Drive repeatability by creating technical selling assets like executive briefing materials, use cases, and demonstration guidance.
Collaborate with go-to-market teams to prioritize industry-specific capabilities and drive our winning strategy into the market.
Partner with pre-sales and GTM leadership to scale winning motions by enabling the SE and business teams, particularly in the US West.
Identify, recruit, and map potential ISV partners and marketplace providers to target reference architectures and use cases.
Enable the technical sales team on industry trends, solution offerings, and lead EBC technical and roadmap discussions.
Contribute to industry marketing activities such as webinars, conferences, and blogs.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of experience.
Deep experience in identity and access management, privileged access management, and machine identity security.
Varied skillset in a leadership capacity across professional services, technical sales, field sales, or as a strategic overlay focusing on large, complex customers.
Proven experience as a dynamic presenter, with the ability to tailor communication to C-level and technical audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Idira (CyberArk) technologies.
Demonstrated ability to be geo-savvy and creative in a global role with a regional focus.
Experience leading technical go-to-market (GTM) strategy and execution.
A well-rounded technologist with a passion for the positive impact of ever-changing technology.
Compensation Disclosure
The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.
$239,000.00 - $278,750.00/yr
Our Commitment
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.
You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.
This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.
Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.
Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
AI and agentic product
Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Portfolio and operating model
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.
Team and accountability
Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.
In the first week, expect to:
Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.
In the first three months, expect to:
Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.
In the first year, expect to:
Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

AI and agentic product

Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.

Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

blocks.text: Portfolio and operating model

items: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.

blocks.text: Team and accountability

items: Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.

Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.

blocks.text: In the first week, expect to:

items: Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.

blocks.text: In the first month, expect to:

items: Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.

blocks.text: In the first three months, expect to:

items: Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.

Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.

Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Storage
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox's infrastructure supports over 100M DAUs and recently supported a world record 45M players at the same time. The scale is real.
As Director of Engineering, you will own the technical strategy, design, delivery, and operation of Roblox's storage systems. The challenge is scale, efficiency, reliability, and innovation all at once. We are mostly on-prem but also in the cloud — yes, we're actually building a lot of this ourselves, and yes, we know how hard that is. We've got the scale and the talent to do it.
You've spent your career deep in storage: databases, caches, queues, object storage. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any system. You care deeply about the success of the internal and external customers who depend on these systems. You're excited to shepherd a fast-growing platform from the nearly 1 exabyte we have today to a multi-exabyte deployment that will power some of the most interesting AI workloads in the industry.
You will
Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Roblox's storage systems, including distributed databases, caches, queues, object storage, and encryption infrastructure
Ensure our storage platform scales by orders of magnitude while remaining reliable and efficient
Partner closely with Data Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to align storage capabilities with Roblox's technical and business needs
Build, grow, and retain a world-class storage engineering team — and develop the next generation of technical leaders within it
Drive operational excellence: define and hold the bar on reliability, on-call practices, and incident response
Own your systems end-to-end, including participation in on-call rotation for critical incidents
You have
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
10+ years of experience in storage, infrastructure, or distributed systems roles, including hands-on experience building and operating custom database systems - not just deploying off-the-shelf solutions - plus depth in at least several of: caching systems, object storage, message queues, or data streaming
5+ years in engineering leadership, managing teams through ambiguity to deliver critical, production-scale systems
A track record of building reliable, high-availability systems at significant scale (millions of users, petabyte-scale data, or equivalent)
Strong operational instincts — you raise the bar on reliability and execution, not just vision
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and earn trust across engineering, product, and leadership
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward learning: you go deep on tech stacks that are new to you and bring others along
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Drive delivery and operational excellence.
Millennium is seeking a Director of Engineering. As the operational leader for the Engineering Business Unit, the Director of Engineering holds end-to-end accountability for delivery execution, unit economics, and operational scaling. Partnering directly with the VP of Strategic Solutions in a balanced commercial/operational dynamic, this role owns the business unit’s operational and financial performance—driving gross margin, EBITDA, cost structure, resource allocation, and talent development. While the commercial organization focuses on revenue growth and market strategy, the Director of Engineering ensures that delivery operations excel in precision, efficiency, client retention, and long-term profitability.
What You’ll Do
Own gross margin and EBITDA performance for the Engineering Business Unit
Own annual budget, forecasting, and staffing plans for the unit, translating project-level staffing input from the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) into a unit-wide plan.
Own cost structures and delivery economics, working with the VP where these connect to client-facing rate cards.
Design and monitor the unit's departmental KPIs — backlog strength, on-time delivery, unit cost per fiber-kilometer (KFM), margin by project — reported through NetSuite/Domo, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for producing the underlying measures.
Own backlog, workload forecasting, and resource allocation across projects, with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day backlog and workload monitoring, and Engineering Manager(s) consulted.
Own client retention — relationship health and proactive response to client needs — with the Head of Strategic Engineering responsible for day-to-day relationship management.
Own tool and technology evaluation and recommendation for the unit, incorporating Engineering Manager(s) input as it matures.
Own monthly reporting to management on status, performance, and metrics, with the Head of Strategic Engineering and Engineering Manager(s) responsible for generating the underlying reports.
Own succession planning and leadership development pipeline, including senior engineer training and technical development.
Partner with the VP on strategic planning and provide input on client retention risk that touches sales-facing accounts.
What You Bring
10+ years in telecom, fiber/broadband infrastructure, or a comparable capital-project environment, including direct accountability for a unit's margin, budget, and cost structure.
Direct experience coordinating OSP engineering, design, and permitting workflows with major national carriers (e.g., AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile).
Demonstrated experience owning KPI design and monthly management reporting for an operating unit.
Fluency with ERP/BI tools (NetSuite, Domo, or equivalent) and comfort presenting financial and delivery performance to executive and Board audiences.
Experience building and developing a leadership bench (director- and manager-level) and running succession planning.
Comfort operating as a peer to a commercially-focused VP without overlapping accountability
Why Join Millennium?
Millennium helps our clients to build broadband networks to connect communities across America. But we’re more than that – we offer our clients enterprise resources to plan out their builds, supplement their funding, manage their materials, and get the equipment they need to get networks up and running.
A collaborative work environment where you can influence the overall success of the company through your efforts and expertise. The growth mode we operate in provides tremendous opportunities for your career path and personal development.
Apply Today!

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.
You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.
You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.
You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.
This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.
AI and agentic engineering
Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Team, resourcing, and accountability
Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.
Platform and execution
Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.
In the first week, expect to:
Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.
In the first three months, expect to:
Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.
In the first year, expect to:
Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.
AI and agentic engineering

items: Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.

Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

blocks.text: Team, resourcing, and accountability

items: Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

blocks.text: Platform and execution

items: Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.

Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

blocks.text: In the first week, expect to:

items: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

blocks.text: In the first month, expect to:

items: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

blocks.text: In the first three months, expect to:

items: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

blocks.text: In the first six months, expect to:

items: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

blocks.text: In the first year, expect to:

items: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

blocks.text: Qualifications and Job Requirements:

items: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.

Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.

Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

blocks.text: Essential Job Functions

items: Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering Emerging Enterprises & Startups
jobs.text:
Req ID FEQ327R163
About the Role
As a Director, Field Engineering, you will lead a multi-team Field Engineering organization and own strategy, talent, operating model, and execution for a significant business area. You will scale customer and business impact through other leaders while influencing broader go-to-market, partner, Product, Engineering, and company priorities.
This role typically oversees a leadership team of approximately 3–5 leaders or an equivalent multi-team scope. Depending on the assignment, you may lead a broad business unit, multiple segments or countries, a major portfolio, or another strategically significant area.
The Impact You Will Have
Build and lead a strong leadership team that attracts, develops, and retains exceptional Field Engineering talent.
Own an end-to-end strategy across talent, customer coverage, technical priorities, operating model, execution, and business impact.
Translate customer, market, competitive, and technical trends into clear priorities and 6–12+ month plans.
Scale impact beyond individual teams through leaders, cross-functional GTM initiatives, partner ecosystems, and repeatable operating mechanisms.
Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including VP-level and equivalent audiences, and guide complex programs, escalations, and transformation roadmaps.
Establish operating norms and inspection cadences across the organization that create visibility, accountability, predictable execution, and fast course correction.
Shape resourcing and organizational design to support growth, customer outcomes, technical quality, and long-term business value.
Upgrade hiring rigor, talent practices, leadership development, performance management, and succession planning across the organization.
Influence broader Sales, Professional Services, Marketing, Partners, Product, Engineering, Support, and executive priorities through a clear point of view and strong cross-functional relationships.
Partner with GTM Strategy & Operations and other functions to create scalable tools, programs, dashboards, and mechanisms; use AI to drive one-to-many organizational impact.
Act as a recognized resource on data, AI, cloud, customer transformation, and evolving market trends.
Embed Databricks Culture Principles into hiring, development, recognition, decision-making, and daily operations while maintaining a high bar for performance and customer impact.
What We Look For
Extensive experience leading technical customer-facing organizations in enterprise software, cloud, data, AI, analytics, technical consulting, or a related environment.
Proven success leading through managers and building a high-performing leadership team.
Track record of recruiting exceptional talent, developing leaders, addressing complex performance situations, and evolving organizational structure for scale.
Strong strategic and business judgment, with the ability to connect customer and market insight to organizational priorities and measurable business outcomes
Experience designing and running operating models across multiple teams, portfolios, segments, geographies, or countries.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders across Sales, Professional Services, Marketing, Partners, Product, Engineering, Support, and executive stakeholders.
Executive-level customer-advisory skills, including the ability to guide complex programs, critical escalations, technical strategy, and long-term transformation roadmaps.
Strong technical credibility across data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud architecture, governance, security, networking, and enterprise adoption, with the judgment to pressure-test complex approaches.
An AI-first, builder mindset demonstrated through experimentation, adoption, and scalable application of AI to customer outcomes and organizational effectiveness.
Demonstrated alignment with Databricks Culture Principles and a track record of preserving and strengthening culture during growth and change.
Basic Qualifications
Experience leading multi-team technical customer-facing organizations and managing through other leaders.
Experience owning strategy and execution for a significant business area, portfolio, geography, segment, or comparable scope.
Experience leading complex customer transformations and cross-functional initiatives.
Experience in data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, software, technical consulting, or a related technical domain.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, strategic-planning, and executive-stakeholder skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Databricks or comparable data and AI platforms.
Experience leading across multiple business units, countries, customer segments, or Field Engineering practices.
Experience shaping broader GTM strategy, partner ecosystems, product priorities, or company-wide programs.
Experience building leadership pipelines, succession plans, communities of practice, and scalable talent systems.
Experience using AI, automation, analytics, or other technology to transform organizational operating models.
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
Benefits
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: SVP, Product - US-Based
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.
You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.
This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.
Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.
Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
AI and agentic product
Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Portfolio and operating model
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.
Team and accountability
Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.
In the first week, expect to:
Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.
In the first three months, expect to:
Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.
In the first year, expect to:
Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
