jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
As Director, Data Engineering you'll take charge of data across the whole Articore Group: Martech Engineering, Core Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science, each already running with its own manager. Your job is to turn four teams pulling in their own direction into one coherent strategy, one set of standards, and one voice Execs can trust, without stripping away what makes each team work.
You'll partner closely with our Melbourne-based Product Director for Data, and report to our SVP of Engineering.
Here's the real opportunity: every function has built exactly what it needed, locally, and now the group needs someone to build the global picture. Reliable pipelines with real SLAs. A warehouse finally consolidated across four brands instead of four different ways of doing things. A genuine plan to pay down the technical debt sitting underneath all of it. This is architecture at group scale, and you're the one drawing the blueprint.
The job is holding the tension between what the business needs right now and the long-term rationalization that makes everything else possible, without dropping either ball.
Core Responsibilities
You'll partner with Executives and stakeholders across Product, Marketing, and Analytics, owning your organization's roadmap end-to-end across three areas: Delivery, People, and Technology.
Delivery
Set direction for data technology across the group, coordinating roadmaps across data engineering, analytics engineering, martech, and data science to unlock key business initiatives.
Own prioritization across OKR-driven initiatives, ad-hoc requests, and platform work — owning intake and planning, and making the case for tradeoffs directly to the executive team.
Build the architecture behind reliable, business-critical pipelines: SLAs per layer, and technical debt retired to the point teams can trust the data they run the business on.
Coordinate with adjacent teams, including product and other engineering functions, to align roadmaps and land cross-functional initiatives.
People
Hire and build out the data organization, including key hires across Australia, the US, and India.
Manage engineering managers directly, with skip-level visibility into technical leads. Set clear ownership and handoff practices so no region waits on one person or timezone.
Partner with each manager on the practices that make execution predictable — sprint planning, delivery rituals, and reporting.
Own performance, development, and comp conversations at the manager layer, and calibrate standards across four functions without erasing what makes each work.
Technology
Steward technical direction across the full data stack, and consolidate technology to reduce cost while improving reliability and simplifying systems.
Drive architectural decisions on data flows between systems, the warehouse, and downstream analytics — balancing reliability, scalability, and delivery speed.
Own data governance and privacy practices — classification, retention, and data subject requests — aligned to GDPR, CCPA, and equivalent frameworks.
Champion AI across the teams, establishing efficiencies through agentic workflows and automation.

jobs.title: VP of Product, Foundation
jobs.text:
🚀 VP of Product, Foundation | United States | Remote | Pax8
Join Pax8 as our VP of Product, Foundation and shape the future of the world's leading cloud marketplace platform, driving the product strategy behind the commerce engine that powers thousands of managed service providers across the globe.
🌟 Why This Role?
This is a rare opportunity to own the product vision for Pax8's largest and most strategically important portfolio. Foundation sits at the heart of our marketplace, enabling everything from product discovery and purchasing to provisioning, billing, subscriptions, integrations, and partner growth.
As AI reshapes software development and customer experiences, you'll help define how a modern, intelligent commerce platform evolves. You'll influence how thousands of partners buy, sell, manage, and grow through technology while building capabilities that support both hypergrowth and enterprise-grade financial rigor.
You'll join at a pivotal moment where platform scale, artificial intelligence, automation, and operational excellence converge, giving you the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on both Pax8 and the wider technology ecosystem.
💜 Life at Pax8
At Pax8, business is personal. We're passionate about creating an environment where people can do their best work while continuously learning and growing. Guided by our values of Compassionate Candor, Seek to Understand, We Before Me, Do What You Say, Light Up Learning, and Driven by Passion, we foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
You'll join a global organization that embraces emerging technologies, invests heavily in learning, and empowers individuals to challenge conventional thinking while delivering exceptional outcomes for our partners.
🎯 What You'll Be Responsible For
📈 Define the Future of Commerce at Pax8
Establish and execute the long-term product vision for Foundation, Pax8's core commerce platform.
Create a strategic roadmap that balances operational excellence, compliance, financial controls, scalability, and growth.
Guide investment decisions across marketplace capabilities, billing, subscriptions, ordering, provisioning, analytics, integrations, and partner experiences.
💡 Drive Growth Through Product Innovation
Create frictionless experiences that improve partner acquisition, engagement, retention, and expansion.
Shape product experiences that help partners discover, purchase, manage, and maximize technology investments.
Identify new opportunities to increase platform adoption through analytics, recommendations, APIs, ecosystem integrations, and intelligent automation.
🤝 Lead Through Partnership
Act as the strategic product counterpart to the VP of Engineering, jointly driving outcomes across the Foundation platform.
Partner closely with Architecture, Finance, Operations, Commercial Leadership, Design, and User Research to align priorities and deliver results.
Establish clear ownership boundaries across a complex product ecosystem to ensure teams move quickly and effectively.
🧠 Build for an AI-Powered Future
Develop a point of view on how AI and agent-assisted experiences will transform partner commerce.
Guide teams through new ways of working that leverage AI to accelerate discovery, validation, delivery, and decision making.
Help evolve product practices to remain effective as technology and customer expectations continue to change.
👥 Develop Exceptional Product Talent
Lead and inspire a high-performing product management organization.
Create an environment where strategic thinking, commercial acumen, technical depth, and customer empathy flourish.
Coach leaders and product managers to operate effectively across a broad and complex portfolio.
🌍 Your Impact
Foundation is the engine behind the Pax8 marketplace. Your leadership will directly influence partner satisfaction, operational excellence, financial integrity, and future growth.
You'll help create the platform that thousands of businesses rely on every day while ensuring Pax8 is positioned to scale sustainably, innovate rapidly, and remain the trusted marketplace for technology professionals worldwide.
✅ What Success Looks Like
We're searching for someone who combines strategic vision with an ability to execute in highly complex environments.
You bring:
Demonstrated success leading large-scale product organizations with executive-level scope.
Proven experience owning complex marketplace, commerce, platform, SaaS, or partner ecosystem products.
Deep understanding of commerce journeys including purchasing, subscriptions, provisioning, billing, invoicing, and partner operations.
Strong experience balancing growth initiatives alongside governance, compliance, operational control, and scalability requirements.
Ability to influence across executive stakeholders, engineering leaders, operational teams, and commercial functions.
Strong understanding of platform architecture concepts and product decision-making within complex technical environments.
Experience leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve product strategy, delivery, prioritization, and organizational effectiveness.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to move seamlessly between executive strategy, technical discussions, and customer-focused outcomes.
A customer-first mindset grounded in real-world experience serving businesses, partners, marketplaces, or technology ecosystems.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity while maintaining strategic clarity and organizational alignment.
🛡️ Trust and Hiring
At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.
To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.
We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritising applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.
🌈 Inclusion Matters
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.
🎁 Benefits
Competitive executive compensation package based on skills, experience, and market location
Annual performance bonus opportunity
Equity participation through Pax8 stock programs
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible paid time off
Paid parental leave
Retirement savings plans with company contribution opportunities
Learning and development investment
LinkedIn Learning access
Wellbeing resources and coaching support
Remote-first flexibility
Employee recognition programs
Company events and celebrations
📚 Growth & Development
There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organisation. You'll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.
🚀 About Pax8
Our mission is to build the managed intelligence marketplace and empower small businesses to do more with smarter technology. We are a fast-growing, dynamic, and high-energy organisation with a start-up feel, allowing you to make a meaningful impact on the business. Culture is also important to us, and at Pax8, it's business, and it IS personal. We are passionate, creative, and unconventional. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best! We Elev8 each other. 🌟 Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to own the product vision for Pax8's largest and most strategically important portfolio. Foundation sits at the heart of our marketplace, enabling everything from product discovery and purchasing to provisioning, billing, subscriptions, integrations, and partner growth.

As AI reshapes software development and customer experiences, you'll help define how a modern, intelligent commerce platform evolves. You'll influence how thousands of partners buy, sell, manage, and grow through technology while building capabilities that support both hypergrowth and enterprise-grade financial rigor.

You'll join at a pivotal moment where platform scale, artificial intelligence, automation, and operational excellence converge, giving you the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on both Pax8 and the wider technology ecosystem.

At Pax8, business is personal. We're passionate about creating an environment where people can do their best work while continuously learning and growing. Guided by our values of Compassionate Candor, Seek to Understand, We Before Me, Do What You Say, Light Up Learning, and Driven by Passion, we foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

You'll join a global organization that embraces emerging technologies, invests heavily in learning, and empowers individuals to challenge conventional thinking while delivering exceptional outcomes for our partners.
🎯 What You'll Be Responsible For
📈 Define the Future of Commerce at Pax8

items: Establish and execute the long-term product vision for Foundation, Pax8's core commerce platform.

Guide investment decisions across marketplace capabilities, billing, subscriptions, ordering, provisioning, analytics, integrations, and partner experiences.

blocks.text: 💡 Drive Growth Through Product Innovation

items: Create frictionless experiences that improve partner acquisition, engagement, retention, and expansion.

Identify new opportunities to increase platform adoption through analytics, recommendations, APIs, ecosystem integrations, and intelligent automation.

items: Develop a point of view on how AI and agent-assisted experiences will transform partner commerce.
Guide teams through new ways of working that leverage AI to accelerate discovery, validation, delivery, and decision making.
Help evolve product practices to remain effective as technology and customer expectations continue to change.

blocks.text: 👥 Develop Exceptional Product Talent

items: Lead and inspire a high-performing product management organization.

Foundation is the engine behind the Pax8 marketplace. Your leadership will directly influence partner satisfaction, operational excellence, financial integrity, and future growth.

We're searching for someone who combines strategic vision with an ability to execute in highly complex environments.
You bring:

items: Demonstrated success leading large-scale product organizations with executive-level scope.

jobs.title: Vice President of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
Overview
To drive innovation and operational excellence through technology that enables teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. The Business Systems department delivers software to drive business process optimization through automation, intuitive workflows, and data governance. Our goal is to serve our internal customers (operators & support departments) with solutions that empower them to maximize their performance and enhance the customer journey.
Position Summary
The Vice President Data & Analytics leads the strategic direction, delivery, and operational maturity of RPM Living's Data & Analytics organization within Product & Engineering. This role partners directly with the SVP, Data & Analytics to build and scale internal data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities, reducing reliance on third-party contractors while establishing RPM Living as a data-driven, insight-led organization.
Responsibilities
Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.
Serve as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to executive leadership, influencing enterprise priorities and translating business strategy into actionable data, analytics, and technology initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, effectively communicating complex data and technology concepts, surfacing business implications, and driving alignment on strategic decisions.
Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.
Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.
Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross platform data integrations and business processes.
Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).
Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.
Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.
Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.
Twelve years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.
Five year’s experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.
Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.
Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.
Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications
Physical Requirements:• May be required to sit for extended periods of time • May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 15 pounds • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment • Must be able to read documents, computer screens, and data • Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
Work Environment:• This is a remote role. The associate must have a dedicated workspace that is free from distraction and has reliable internet.• Overnight travel may be required quarterly for various business reasons.
Company Information
Join RPM Living and experience exceptional benefits designed to enhance your life.
Weekly pay for all associates working onsite at an apartment community
Comprehensive healthcare coverage available for all full-time, regular associates
Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs
Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance
401(k) with robust company match
Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
Paid time off plus floating holidays and volunteer days
Discounted Perks (Costco membership, movie tickets, health & wellness, entertainment & travel discounts)
Employment with RPM Living is contingent upon successful completion of a background check as local and federal state requires. A valid driver’s license is preferred; candidates without a license will be provided a liability waiver.
RPM Living participates in E-Verify. For more information, see the E-Verify Participation Poster and the Right to Work Poster.
RPM Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: VP - Product Management, Digital Assets Proxy
jobs.text:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
Broadridge is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and execution-oriented VP, Product Management – Digital Assets Proxy to lead the strategy, development, delivery and ongoing management of Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy capabilities. This highly visible leadership role will define the product vision and roadmap for innovative, scalable, and compliant digital assets proxy solutions that address the evolving needs of institutional clients and support Broadridge’s long-term growth objectives.
The VP will operate at the intersection of product, technology, operations, commercial teams, legal, compliance, and risk. The successful candidate will combine deep product-management discipline with a strong understanding of digital asset market infrastructure, regulatory considerations, and the proxy ecosystem. They will translate market opportunity and client insight into differentiated product offerings, drive delivery from concept through launch, and continuously optimize the portfolio based on performance and market feedback.
What You’ll Do
Define and lead the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy products and capabilities
Develop a clear point of view on the evolution of digital assets, tokenization, governance, and governance related market infrastructure, translating market developments into actionable product priorities
Identify and assess client needs, market opportunities, competitive dynamics, and regulatory developments to inform product strategy and investment decisions
Own the evaluation, prioritization, development, launch, and enhancement of digital asset proxy focused products and features aligned with client demand, strategic objectives, and operational readiness
Build compelling business cases, including market sizing, financial analysis, pricing, return-on-investment assessments, and commercialization plans. This can also include development of white papers and related thought pieces
Partner closely with engineering and technology teams to establish product requirements, guide execution, manage trade-offs, and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
Collaborate with operations, legal, compliance, risk, and control functions to ensure products are operationally viable and aligned with applicable regulatory, risk, and governance requirements
Develop go-to-market strategies in partnership with sales, marketing, relationship-management, and client facing teams
Establish product performance measures and use adoption data, client feedback, commercial results, and market intelligence to improve product outcomes and portfolio performance
Serve as a senior thought partner and subject matter expert on digital assets proxy-related product strategy across Broadridge
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, and control functions
What We’re Looking For
Significant product-management experience, including a demonstrated record of leading complex products, platforms, or market-infrastructure capabilities from strategy through execution and commercialization
Strong knowledge of digital assets and related market infrastructure, including relevant experience with tokenized assets, blockchain-based products, custody, wallets, trading, settlement, staking, or adjacent capabilities
Experience developing products within a regulated financial services environment, ideally including exposure to SEC regulated businesses
Demonstrated understanding of proxy, corporate governance, issuer services, or related workflows is strongly preferred
Strong commercial acumen, with experience developing product strategies, business cases, pricing models, and go-to-market plans
Proven ability to lead through influence across technology, operations, legal, compliance, risk, sales, and other cross-functional stakeholders
Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, problem solving, communication, and decision making skills
Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical, regulatory, and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
A client focused, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a rapidly evolving market
What Sets You Apart
Deep understanding of trends shaping the digital assets landscape and their implications for institutional and enterprise clients
Experience building and scaling product offerings in emerging, regulated, or rapidly changing markets
Ability to balance innovation with strong operational, regulatory, and risk discipline
A strong network and credibility within digital assets, capital markets, proxy, governance, or financial market infrastructure communities
A collaborative leadership style that aligns diverse stakeholders around a clear product vision and measurable business outcomes
Why Join Us
You will have the opportunity to shape the future of digital assets products within a dynamic and highly visible leadership role. You will work with cross-functional teams to bring new capabilities to market, solve complex industry challenges, and help define how digital asset solutions evolve in a changing financial and regulatory landscape.
Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $240,000 to $250,000
Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible
Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.
Benefits Information: Please visit for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
Use of AI in Hiring
As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
US applicants: Click here to view the EEOC "Know Your Rights" poster.
Disability Assistance
We recognize that ensuring our long-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
If you need assistance or would like to request reasonable accommodations during the application and/or hiring process, please contact us at 888-237-7769 or by sending an email to .

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused Senior Director of Enterprise Data to lead the transformation and maturity of our data ecosystem. Having recently scaled to $2 billion in annual revenue, we are actively building the infrastructure, governance, and operational models required to sustain our trajectory to $4 billion and beyond.
In this role, reporting to the CIO, you will own the end-to-end data strategy, evolving our data platform architecture, scaling our Master Data Management (MDM) systems into an active operational hub, and institutionalizing federated data governance. You will bridge the gap between complex engineering and business execution, transforming data from a utility into a high-octane product that powers real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, agentic AI and operational efficiency across the global enterprise.
What You Will Be Doing
Data Strategy & Platform Evolution
Architect the Future: Design, execute, and evolve a scalable data platform roadmap capable of handling a multi-billion dollar enterprise’s volume, velocity, and variety of data.
De-bottleneck Legacy Infrastructure: Transition our centralized pipelines into a modern, decoupled data architecture.
Data as a Product: Implement a "Data as a Product" mindset across engineering teams, ensuring datasets have strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs), rigorous uptime, and high catalog discoverability.
Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Drive the evolution from purely batch-oriented processing to real-time event streaming for critical business domains like Engineering, Finance, and Customer Experience.
Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM)
Build the Golden Record: Evolve our current cross-referenced registry into a highly integrated, multi-domain operational MDM hub (Customer, Product, Vendor/Supplier).
Operational Syncing: Ensure mastered data seamlessly flows bidirectionally between analytic environments and core operational execution systems (ERP, CRM, eCommerce).
M&A Readiness: Standardize ingestion frameworks to quickly harmonize data from future acquisitions or new business units without interrupting daily operations.
Data Governance, Quality, & Compliance
Federated Governance: Establish an enterprise-wide data governance council. Move governance away from gatekeeping and toward a collaborative data stewardship model owned by business units.
Automated Observability: Implement modern, automated data lineage, cataloging, and quality testing tools to monitor data health and proactively catch pipeline degradation before it hits business dashboards.
Security & Compliance: Partner with Security and Legal teams to ensure the enterprise data platform natively adheres to global regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) through robust RBAC/ABAC and automated data masking.
Team Leadership & Operating Model
Scale the Organization: Restructure and grow a high-performing data team consisting of data engineers, MDM specialists, platform architects, and data governance managers.
Centralized Infrastructure, Embedded Analytics: Champion a hub-and-spoke operating model, providing a central platform layer while enabling embedded data analysts within business units to move fast safely.
Cultivate Data Ops: Instill software engineering rigor into data workflows, including CI/CD deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and comprehensive automated test suites.
What You Bring
Proven Scale Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of progressive leadership in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data management, with explicit experience inside an organization operating in a B2B environment at a $1B to $5B+ revenue scale.
Architectural Fluency: Deep hands-on and strategic familiarity with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS/Azure data suites) and enterprise MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Semarchy, Profisee).
Change Management Mastery: Documented success in leading complex corporate data migrations or massive MDM implementations across multi-business-unit enterprises.
Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business value, financial ROI, and strategic alignment for C-suite executives.
People Leadership: Minimum of 5 years managing manager-level and architect-level direct reports, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining top-tier engineering talent.
Bonus Points
Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments characterized by rapid organizational restructuring or frequent Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).
Expertise in setting up a Data Mesh or federated data architecture in a hybrid or multi-cloud environment.
Active engagement or understanding of integrating AI/ML infrastructure readiness into core enterprise data platforms.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

$212,100—$335,600 USD

$254,900—$403,200 USD

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. jobs.title: Director of Product, Logistics
jobs.text:
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Overview
About the Team
Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.
Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.
Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.
Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.
About You
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).
Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.
Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).
Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.
Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.
Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.
#LI-Remote
Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.
Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.
For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.
CA, NY, CT, NJ
$291,000—$307,000 USD
WA
$279,000—$294,500 USD
OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$266,000—$281,000 USD
All other states
$242,000—$255,500 USD

You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job

items: Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.

Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Salary: Up to £85,000 per annum + Annual Bonus
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Location: Warrington/London with regular travel across the Healthcare LIFT portfolio
Benefits: 25 days AL + BH, Life Insurance, Car Allowance, Pension Scheme, Employee Assistance Programme, salary sacrifice schemes, gym & retailer discounts.
Kudos Services is a specialist facilities management provider delivering high-quality Hard FM services across complex healthcare environments. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Head of Engineering to lead our Engineering & Maintenance team across our Healthcare LIFT portfolio.
Key Requirements
Significant experience managing Hard FM services across complex, multi-site estates within a PPP/PFI environment, ideally healthcare.
Strong technical knowledge of building services engineering, statutory compliance and healthcare maintenance requirements, including HTMs and HBNs.
Proven leadership experience managing engineering teams, contractors and multiple stakeholders.
Commercially aware, with experience of performance management, contract delivery and budget accountability.
HNC/HND (or equivalent) in a Mechanical, Electrical or Building Services Engineering discipline.
About the Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic and operational management of Engineering & Maintenance services across our Healthcare LIFT portfolio.
You will lead the Engineering Team, ensuring the safe, compliant and effective delivery of Hard FM services whilst maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and contractual performance. Working closely with Contract Managers and the Compliance Team, you will oversee statutory compliance, technical governance, engineering performance and quality assurance across the estate.
You will act as the lead representative for engineering audits and technical reviews, ensuring robust processes, clear audit trails and full compliance with contractual and statutory obligations. The role will also take ownership of engineering reporting, resource planning, contractor performance, asset management and lifecycle activities.
As a key member of the senior leadership team, you will contribute to commercial and financial performance, supporting budget setting, forecasting, procurement activities and business-wide continuous improvement initiatives.
About You
You are an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical expertise with excellent people management and stakeholder engagement skills. You thrive in complex, highly regulated environments and have a proven track record of delivering engineering services within healthcare, PPP or PFI contracts.
You are commercially aware, solutions-focused and capable of balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day operational demands. You are committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and compliance whilst developing strong working relationships with colleagues, clients and partners.
Most importantly, you are a proactive leader who can inspire teams, drive performance and support the continued success of our healthcare portfolio.
Our Values:
Supportive - We embrace partnership working.
Ethical - We act with integrity.
Innovative - We take ownership for understanding and improving our business.
Ambitious - We continually strive to deliver the best possible service.
Passionate - We are proud of the part we play and the service we deliver.

Application & CV Screening
First Stage Interview Head of HR & Kudos CEO
Final Stage Interview Asset CEO/Director & FIM CEO

jobs.title: Director of Analytics
jobs.text:
Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.
At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.
The Role
We're looking for a Director of Analytics to lead our lean, multi-disciplined, best-in-class analytics team. As director, you will set the mission, technical direction, and culture of the analytics function. You will provide technical direction on product analytics, experimentation, attribution, forecasting, and manage analytical frameworks. You will promote a culture of discovering and communicating insights, as well as enabling self-service analysis capabilities for stakeholders. You will also evangelise and inspire best practices across the company.
You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with the Director of Data Platform and Directors in other functions such as Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Finance and Marketing. Our stack includes AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Python, R and other best in class, modern tooling for business reporting, experimentation, and analysis. We are heavily invested in advanced AI-enhanced analytics tools across the company, and you will drive the evaluation, deployment and adoption of more powerful tools to scale self-serve analytics.
Responsibilities
Leadership and Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing, diverse analytics team
Foster a culture of deep analysis, commercial sense, innovation, best practices and evangelizing non-obvious insights (not simply reporting data)
Align team objectives with company goals and strategic initiatives
Apply strong commercial intuition, customer-focus and data analysis to drive strategic decision-making
Technical Direction and Innovation:
Provide expert guidance on horizontal technical analytical areas, including experimentation, attribution, forecasting, predictive analytics, and observability
Continuously identify opportunities for advanced analytics and data methodologies and enable implementation
Identify and track appropriate metrics to measure success across all areas of the business
Ensure trustworthiness and timeliness of data used by stakeholders from all departments of the company
Analytics and Strategy:
Collaborate with senior leadership to provide insights for decision-making around key initiatives and strategic objectives
Work with FP&A and product leads to align customer impact with commercial outcomes - working to a common growth-model/metric tree
Stay abreast of industry trends, the competitive landscape, advances in technology, methodologies and tools, and market dynamics to inform commercial strategies
Data Strategy and Governance:
Partner with the Director of Data Platform to define and execute the vision for how data can be leveraged effectively across the business
Work alongside the Data Platform team to ensure high data quality and robust data governance
Develop and maintain analytics roadmaps to support the progress of the data strategy
Crossfunctional Collaboration:
Empower the team to execute on reporting, analytics, and experimentation
Drive with product development to identify and apply new data opportunities
Drive understanding of key metrics and their importance across the business
Evangelize opportunities and trends discovered through insights across all stakeholders and ensure that insights and data leads to sound decision-making
Empower stakeholders through increased self-service usage of analytics tools, while freeing up analysts to contribute deeper insights requiring greater analytical skills

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect & Data Governance Head
jobs.text:
To supercharge this next decade of unprecedented growth, we are seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to join the Chief Digitalization Officer’s (CDO) Leadership Team.
Reporting directly to the CDO, s/he/they will serve as the strategic architect and technical anchor for Masdar’s global digital ecosystem. S/he/theywill spearhead the Enterprise Digital function, designing a flexible, best-of-breed composable architecture that seamlessly bridges modern corporate systems with agile, field-level renewable asset operations. Crucially, s/he/they will own and steer the global Data Management & Data Governance strategy, defining the universal data taxonomies that transform cross-border operational insight into a competitive advantage.
S/he/they will build up high-performing domain architects, to safeguard and scale our Digital Architecture and infrastructure, as well as a robust team of competent data management specialist. Masdar’s future Enterprise Digital Architecture will empower Masdar to continue scaling and expanding securely, rapidly, and intelligently, and powering the world's clean energy future.
Minimum Requirements
15+ years of progressive experience operating at a global, enterprise-level architecture capacity, preferably within heavily asset-intensive or energy environments.
10+ years of direct experience leading, managing, and developing a team of specialized domain architects.
10+ years of hands-on experience in ERP and Data architecture design, with a proven track record of transitioning legacy setups into modern, composable designs.
8+ years of experience architecting and managing global data management platforms.
5+ years of dedicated experience driving Data Governance initiatives (establishing policies, frameworks, and master data hierarchies), as well sa running governing bodies.
5+ years of people management and stakeholder management
Strong & clear Communicator who can translate complex technical design into business languages/value, while influencing peers and stakeholders for consensus.
Ability of resolving design difference, prioritizing enterprise architecture design build-up into phases that matter to Masdar operations and efficiency.
A collaborator and a team player, who can mentor and coach team members across the CDO team
Preferred & Plus Factors
Prior experience with SAP S/4HANA ERP Core and O&M (Operations & Maintenance) global deployment.
Deep familiarity with cybersecurity and industrial architectural frameworks specific to critical infrastructure (e.g., NIST, NERC CIP, or IEC 62443).
As part of the application process, we will collect, store and process personal information about you.
Masdar will use your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice, which provides details on the purposes for which your data is processed.
Established in 2006, Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) is a global clean energy leader, transforming how the world produces and consumes energy through bold innovation and commercial excellence.
Masdar is a clean energy investor, developer and operator, advancing renewable energy projects across key markets and technologies, with a global project portfolio capacity to date of over 65 gigawatts (GW).
Jointly owned by TAQA, ADNOC and Mubadala, Masdar is driving the scale-up of renewables worldwide, targeting a portfolio capacity of 100GW by 2030.

jobs.title: Director Procurement - Technology Tower Lead (Remote, Texas, US)
jobs.text:
About Foundever
Foundever® is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.
Job Summary
The Global Tech/IT Tower Lead is responsible for leading the global category management strategy across the organization's Technology/IT spend portfolio, including software, infrastructure, hardware, cloud, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and IT services.
This role serves as the strategic procurement partner to Technology and business leadership, and is accountable for category strategy development, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, supplier relationship management, and delivery of savings and broader procurement value objectives across the assigned portfolio.
The Tower Lead manages a globally distributed team and partners closely with executive and cross-functional teams to support enterprise priorities, procurement transformation initiatives, and operational scalability within a complex global environment. This role serves as a member of the Global Procurement Leadership team and contributes to broader procurement strategy, operating model evolution, and capability development initiatives.
Duties and Responsibilities
Strategic Category Leadership
Develop and execute category management strategies across the Technology/IT spend portfolio (7-10 subcategories across approximately $200-250M including multi-year roadmaps aligned to business priorities, savings objectives, supplier management, risk mitigation, and operational requirements.
Partner and engage with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, to align procurement strategies with enterprise objectives, transformation initiatives, and functional priorities.
Provide market intelligence, supplier insights, and category expertise to support strategic decision-making, long-term planning activities, evolving business and Technology priorities, and alignment of category strategies with key stakeholders.
Support and contribute to enterprise digitalization initiatives and evolving Technology strategies, including alignment to broader AI-related priorities where applicable.
Supplier & Commercial Management
Lead strategic sourcing activities, supplier selection decisions, contracting activities, and complex commercial negotiations across the assigned Technology categories.
Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, governance models, and risk mitigation approaches to support cost optimization, service quality, scalability, operational resilience, and broader risk management objectives.
Oversee contracting, supplier governance, and commercial management activities in partnership with Legal, Finance, Security, Privacy, Operations, and business stakeholders.
Support adherence to procurement governance standards, enterprise policies, and sourcing controls across the Technology procurement portfolio.
Financial & Business Value Delivery
Own category savings targets and identify opportunities for demand management, vendor consolidation, commercial optimization, process improvement, and broader procurement value creation.
Monitor supplier performance, category spend trends, contractual commitments, and market conditions to proactively identify risks and optimization opportunities.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and spend management activities related to the Technology procurement portfolio.
Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, develop, and mentor a globally distributed procurement team while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused, and high-performance environment.
Support capability development, knowledge sharing, and implementation of procurement best practices across category management and supplier management activities.
Coach and mentor procurement talent to support organizational capability growth and future procurement leadership development.
Qualifications - Experience
Minimum:
10+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience within complex global organizations.
5 years' experience supporting Technology/IT procurement categories, including software, infrastructure, cloud, hardware, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and/or IT services.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing category strategies across large and complex global spend portfolios.
Experience leading strategic supplier negotiations and managing executive-level supplier relationships.
Experience partnering with senior business and Technology stakeholders in a matrixed global environment.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong commercial, analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred:
Experience supporting procurement transformation, operating model redesign, or global centralization initiatives. Experience within multinational, technology, services, or BPO environments.
Familiarity with procurement technologies, source-to-contract processes, and supplier governance frameworks.
**Some global travel may be required (20-30%)
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Product
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees & Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. You will partner with engineering, operations, sales, compliance, and external service providers to ship complex changes that institutional counterparties trust and rely on.
What You’ll Be Doing
Clearly define product direction and roadmaps for Custody OES, drive its evolution and turn client and partner requirements into shipped features. Grow the client and partner base. Optimize operations through self-service portals and process automation.
Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.
What We Look For In You
PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.
Proven experience of leading strategic business reviews, facilitating on-site requirement discovery, and converting client feedback into prioritized product initiatives. Strong track record of partnering with Sales, BD, and Relationship Management teams in a B2B institutional setting.
Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Product Director, Localisation & AI Evals
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
Own the agentic translation system
Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.
Build the agentic QA and quality automation
Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.
Make it self-improving
Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
What We Look For In You
PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.
Nice to Haves
Built an agentic system from scratch
Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Director of Data Management
jobs.text:
Founded by the Sisters of Charity of New York, the University of Mount Saint Vincent is an academically excellent, authentically inclusive, Catholic and ecumenical liberal arts university. The University combines a strong core curriculum with a full array of majors in the liberal arts and, within the tradition of liberal education, selected professional fields of study.
At Mount Saint Vincent, a student’s education extends beyond knowledge, skills, and preparation for work. We seek the development of the whole person. In the spirit of Vincent de Paul and Elizabeth Ann Seton, we foster an understanding of our common humanity, a commitment to human dignity, and a full appreciation of our obligations to each other.
Position Summary:
The Director of Data Management serves as the School of Nursing's lead administrator for data analytics, reporting, compliance, and institutional effectiveness. Working closely with the Dean and academic leadership, this position oversees the collection, management, analysis, and reporting of data related to student success, faculty productivity, program outcomes, accreditation, and regulatory compliance. The Director transforms complex data into actionable insights that support strategic planning, continuous quality improvement, accreditation activities, and evidence-based decision-making across the School of Nursing.
Responsibilities:
Accreditation, Compliance, and Regulatory Reporting
Manage data collection and reporting processes required for accreditation, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
Prepare and submit reports for organizations including the New York State Education Department (NYSED), Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), and other regulatory bodies.
Monitor program outcomes, including retention, graduation, licensure and certification pass rates, employment outcomes, and student learning outcomes.
Ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance of institutional data in accordance with FERPA, HIPAA, and university policies.
Maintain and validate data reported on School of Nursing websites, publications, and external reports.
Data Analytics and Strategic Decision Support
Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics that support academic and operational decision-making.
Analyze trends related to enrollment, retention, progression, graduation, licensure outcomes, faculty workload, and resource utilization.
Provide data analyses and reports to support strategic planning, budgeting, program development, and growth initiatives.
Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and operational effectiveness.
Data Systems Management
Oversee the integration and management of institutional and program-specific data systems.
Coordinate data collection, validation, and reporting across academic and administrative departments.
Develop efficient processes for data entry, retrieval, analysis, and reporting.
Maintain data dictionaries, reporting procedures, and documentation standards.
Evaluate and implement technologies that enhance reporting and analytics capabilities.
Training and Collaboration
Serve as a resource to faculty and staff on data reporting requirements, dashboards, and data management practices.
Provide training and support related to data systems and reporting tools.
Collaborate with university offices including Institutional Research, Information Technology, Admissions, Registrar, Finance, and Academic Affairs to ensure data quality and consistency.

jobs.title: VP Architecture - Data Management
jobs.text:
Are you skilled at building client relationships and delivering impactful Data Management solutions? Are you passionate about data?
As an EXL VP of Data Management - Architecture, you will lead requirements, data modeling, data movement, transformation mapping, automation, testing, and solution design aligned to enterprise data standards. You will oversee large, complex EDM projects across Data Platforms and Architecture, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Engineering, Reporting, Analytics, and Data Visualization.
This role is strategic and tactical: you will select fit-for-purpose technologies, shape client solution visions, guide technical teams, and support business development by securing and growing client relationships.
Who will you work with?
This role works closely with client business and IT stakeholders, project teams, EXL Vertical Leads, Engagement Managers, and technical consultants across business analysis, data, cloud, engineering, reporting, and analytics.
Why Join EXL?
VPs of Data Management - Architecture work on high-visibility projects with measurable client impact.
· Business hours vary by client time zone, with occasional early or late meetings for multi-shore teams.
· Some U.S. client-site travel may be required; most work is remote using collaboration and video tools.
On any one day you might
Communicate with Account Executives and clients regarding scope and prioritization of work.
Collaborate with Analysts, Data Architects, and Engineers to improve processes and resolve issues.
Coach/mentor a team member by providing feedback to elevate their performance.
Support SOWs, RFPs, estimates, and resource planning for clients.
Support internal projects, training, documentation, and delivery methodology improvements.
Conduct assessments, discovery, proofs of concept, and technology evaluations.
Lead technical delivery at any stage of a project.
