jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
📋 DESCRIPTION (About Norbloc + Why This Role Matters + What You'll Own)
Norbloc builds the trust infrastructure behind modern financial compliance. Our RegTech and blockchain platform powers Know Your Customer (KYC) and secure data-sharing for banks, financial institutions and government bodies, replacing slow, fragmented, manual onboarding with a shared, distributed-ledger-backed ecosystem that regulators, banks and customers can all rely on.
Our clients are not forgiving of shortcuts: systemic banks, regulators and government bodies across Europe and the Middle East operate under some of the strictest security, resilience and compliance standards in the industry. Building for them means every architectural choice has to hold up under real scrutiny.
We're now looking for a Chief Technology Officer to take that foundation and scale it, leading technology through Norbloc's next phase of growth.
Why This Role Matters Now
Norbloc sits where two worlds meet: the pace and ambition of blockchain and data innovation versus the risk tolerance of enterprise banking. Few technology leaders are fluent in both. This role exists to be that bridge, someone who can architect for scale and security, lead engineering teams through rapid growth and sit across the table from a bank's CIO or a regulator's compliance officer and speak their language fluently.
This is a board-level seat with real ownership: over architecture, over the technology organization and over how Norbloc is perceived by the institutions that matter most to our growth.
What You'll Own
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Set Norbloc's end-to-end technology strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, in step with company vision and enterprise client needs
Architect secure, cloud-native systems that bridge banking-grade infrastructure with blockchain/DLT, cryptography and modern data and AI capabilities
Own the platform's operating model, including SLAs, observability, incident response and on-call practices, to a standard that satisfies regulated financial clients, not just internal targets
Make build-vs-buy and vendor/platform calls backed by clear-eyed cost, scalability and governance analysis. Be willing to defend the "boring" choice when it's the right one
Data, Governance & Compliance
Build the data governance, lineage, metadata and quality foundations that make the platform auditable and trustworthy at scale
Own technology risk management and IT governance, including compliance with KYC/AML, data residency and audit requirements across our operating jurisdictions
Work with Compliance and external legal counsel so that technical decisions are made with regulatory consequences already priced in, not discovered afterward
Team & Delivery Leadership
Lead, mentor and scale Engineering, Data, DevOps and QA, building strong managers under you, not just individual contributors
Instill the delivery discipline that enterprise clients expect: code quality, CI/CD, testing rigor, predictable roadmaps
Take ownership of any externally delivered components and bring them fully in-house where it makes sense to do so
Executive & Client Engagement
Be Norbloc's senior technical voice to C-level executives, IT leadership and compliance officers at bank and government clients
Represent Norbloc's technology vision to investors, partners and prospective enterprise clients

blocks.text: 📋 DESCRIPTION (About Norbloc + Why This Role Matters + What You'll Own)

Norbloc builds the trust infrastructure behind modern financial compliance. Our RegTech and blockchain platform powers Know Your Customer (KYC) and secure data-sharing for banks, financial institutions and government bodies, replacing slow, fragmented, manual onboarding with a shared, distributed-ledger-backed ecosystem that regulators, banks and customers can all rely on.

Our clients are not forgiving of shortcuts: systemic banks, regulators and government bodies across Europe and the Middle East operate under some of the strictest security, resilience and compliance standards in the industry. Building for them means every architectural choice has to hold up under real scrutiny.
We're now looking for a Chief Technology Officer to take that foundation and scale it, leading technology through Norbloc's next phase of growth.
Why This Role Matters Now

Norbloc sits where two worlds meet: the pace and ambition of blockchain and data innovation versus the risk tolerance of enterprise banking. Few technology leaders are fluent in both. This role exists to be that bridge, someone who can architect for scale and security, lead engineering teams through rapid growth and sit across the table from a bank's CIO or a regulator's compliance officer and speak their language fluently.
This is a board-level seat with real ownership: over architecture, over the technology organization and over how Norbloc is perceived by the institutions that matter most to our growth.
What You'll Own
Technology Strategy & Architecture

items: Set Norbloc's end-to-end technology strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, in step with company vision and enterprise client needs
Architect secure, cloud-native systems that bridge banking-grade infrastructure with blockchain/DLT, cryptography and modern data and AI capabilities
Own the platform's operating model, including SLAs, observability, incident response and on-call practices, to a standard that satisfies regulated financial clients, not just internal targets
Make build-vs-buy and vendor/platform calls backed by clear-eyed cost, scalability and governance analysis. Be willing to defend the "boring" choice when it's the right one

blocks.text: Data, Governance & Compliance

items: Build the data governance, lineage, metadata and quality foundations that make the platform auditable and trustworthy at scale
Own technology risk management and IT governance, including compliance with KYC/AML, data residency and audit requirements across our operating jurisdictions
Work with Compliance and external legal counsel so that technical decisions are made with regulatory consequences already priced in, not discovered afterward

blocks.text: Team & Delivery Leadership

items: Lead, mentor and scale Engineering, Data, DevOps and QA, building strong managers under you, not just individual contributors
Instill the delivery discipline that enterprise clients expect: code quality, CI/CD, testing rigor, predictable roadmaps
Take ownership of any externally delivered components and bring them fully in-house where it makes sense to do so

jobs.title: Director, Data Platforms and Operations
jobs.text:
About the Role
The Director of Data Platform & Operations serves as both the technical backbone and the people leader of our data organization: the architect who designs and builds our data infrastructure, the engineer who ships and maintains the pipelines that power it, and the primary technical point of contact bridging the business and the platform. This person will lead our Data Engineering, Data Governance, and BI/Analytics teams, own our BI strategy end to end, and lead the data foundation for our Glean AI implementation, ensuring the data feeding our AI search and knowledge tools is well-structured, governed, and trustworthy.
This is a hands-on leadership role: equal parts architect, engineer, people manager, and strategic partner to the business.
Why This Role Matters
Data is the foundation everything else gets built on: reporting, AI, and business decisions all depend on it being accurate, accessible, and well-architected. This role owns that foundation and is the go-to technical voice ensuring the rest of the business can trust and use it.
Responsibilities
Team Leadership
Lead and grow the Data Engineering, Data Governance, and BI/Analytics teams
Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards across the three functions, ensuring they operate as one cohesive data organization
Mentor and develop team members, balancing hands-on technical guidance with career growth
Own hiring, performance management, and resourcing decisions for the team
Data Architecture & Engineering
Design and own the overall data platform: warehouse/lakehouse structure, schema design, and data modeling standards
Build, orchestrate, and maintain reliable data pipelines that move data from source systems into governed, analytics-ready models
Establish and enforce standards for data quality, dimensional modeling, and pipeline reliability
Manage cloud data infrastructure and associated cost optimization
BI Strategy & Reporting
Own the BI strategy — define how the business accesses trusted data, from executive dashboards to self-serve reporting
Build and evolve centralized reporting with appropriate access controls (RBAC)
Partner with department leaders to turn raw data into decision-ready insights and KPIs
Technical Partnership to the Business
Manage and own Data Platform roadmap and prioritization
Serve as the primary technical point of contact between the data platform and business stakeholders
Translate business requirements into scoped, deliverable technical initiatives
Act as a trusted advisor on what's possible with our data, and set realistic expectations on delivery
AI / Glean Data Ownership
Own the data layer supporting our Glean implementation, ensuring source systems are properly connected, indexed, and governed for AI search
Partner with IT/AI stakeholders to define data access, quality, and security standards for AI-powered tools
Partner with the Agent Builder team to ensure AI agents are powered by trusted, governed data
Help shape the broader data strategy as AI becomes more embedded in daily workflows
Skills and Requirements
Experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and pipelines, including pipeline orchestration and scheduling (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, Apache Spark)
Strong SQL/DDL skills and working proficiency in Python (or similar) for data engineering tasks
Experience with dimensional modeling and schema design, and hands-on ownership of a data warehouse or lakehouse (medallion architecture experience a plus)
Track record of building BI reporting and dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) with governed, centralized access
Experience integrating and normalizing data from core business systems (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, or similar enterprise platforms)
Comfort operating as both an individual contributor and a leader — this role builds pipelines and leads people
Experience managing a team, ideally spanning data engineering, data governance, and/or BI/analytics functions
Excellent communication skills; ability to be the "face" of the data platform to non-technical stakeholders
Experience with (or strong interest in) enterprise AI/knowledge tools like Glean is a plus
Background in high growth companies, preferably companies with heavy acquisition growth motions
Compensation Philosophy
The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role.
Benefits:
Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
A comprehensive extended benefits package including health, dental and vision for you and your family, with company paid offerings.
An uncapped commissions structure.
Generous paid time off (PTO) is offered to support the ability to rest and recharge.
A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential.
Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment.
Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office.
Ongoing support for learning development so you can master your craft.
Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac).
Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other.
Company Description
As the industry-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. With a broad international portfolio of combined companies, products, and leading technologies, we are actively changing the way the world works with documents to make work better and life simpler.
Customers like IBM, Autodesk, DocuSign, Boeing, Microsoft (and many more!) come to us to realize their web and mobile strategies for document management, editing, and collaboration as the #1-ranked commercial document SDK of choice for companies worldwide. As a result, you can find our document technology in thousands of solutions, including those of household names, used by millions across virtually every industry. Our XODO app alone has 25M unique installs -- and counting -- and the highest ratings among PDF productivity apps on the largest online app marketplaces.
Ready to join our team?
If you are interested in helping Apryse deliver on its commitments and taking your career to the next level, we invite you to apply online now. Additionally, we view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. We welcome diverse and non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not have every requirement listed.
We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination. It is our policy to be an equal opportunity employer without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, citizenship status or any other factors prohibited by law. Apryse will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.text:
Join the Tilt team
At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
The opportunity: Head of [Product] Design
Tilt is looking for a Head of [Product] Design — an existing team of 6 designers and 1 researcher embedded across the pods building Cash Advance, Credit Card, Thrive, and the rest of our everyday money products. You'll report directly to the Head of Product and own the craft, quality, and user and business impact of design across everything our users touch.
The foundations are in place: a recent rebrand, an evolved design system, and embedded, strong designers.
What hasn't been built yet is a design practice that consistently shapes what we build, not just how it looks, and is known across the enterprise.
How you'll make an impact
Lead the design function: Set the vision, standards, and strategy for product design at Tilt in a manner that fits Tilt’s strategic objectives. Set the bar for craft and hold it across every surface we ship.
Operate with urgency for our users: Set ambitious timelines, but know when to afford space. We learn best from product in customers’ hands, and are comfortable with ambiguity.
Grow the team’s impact: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 6 product designers and 1 researcher — and own hiring as we scale. Build the career paths, deliver regular feedback, and rituals that builds stronger designers and ensures top performers stay. Celebrate and showcase work at company-wide rituals, not just among the Design team.
Move design upstream: Push design into problem definition and roadmap-setting, not just execution. Partner with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional leadership to build better operating systems.
Champion the user for the enterprise: Be the vocal, evidence-based advocate for the people who use our products. Bring research, verbatims, and influence into decisions across credit, growth, engineering, and more.
Own how we learn: Build Tilt's research practice — today getting started with our first researcher — into a durable capability that gets the team real signal on real users.
Scale the design system: Steward the Tilt Design System — from illustrations, type, color, copy, and more — as products in their own right, so a growing multi-product surface stays coherent.
Put agents to work: Hold an informed point of view on where AI genuinely improves design work, and turn it into practice rather than pilots. Own automation efforts to unleash the Design & broader delivery team on highest value work.
Partner with Creative: Work closely with Marketing's Creative team so product experience and brand expression reinforce each other — make the seam invisible between the disciplines.
Why you're a great fit
Depth in consumer product design: 8+ years designing and shipping consumer-facing mobile products, ideally in fintech or another domain with real complexity sitting behind a simple surface.
Proven people leadership: 5+ years managing designers, with a track record of building teams, raising the bar on craft, and developing people into stronger designers than you found them.
A strategic partner, not a service provider: You've operated at the leadership table — shaping roadmap and strategy alongside Product and Engineering peers, not receiving requirements from them. You’re interested in the business mechanics and financial impact you’ll have, in addition to our user.
A portfolio with consequences: Work that shows craft and outcome. You can walk through the user problem, the decisions you made, and what changed in the business.
Evidence-driven, but comfortable in ambiguity: You use research and data to sharpen design judgment rather than substitute for it, and you know how to get signal when there's no dedicated research team yet.
Clear at the exec level: You can make a design argument to a CEO or a credit lead without translating it into design jargon first.
Fluent in modern tooling: Deep in Figma, and genuinely curious about where AI belongs in a design workflow.
Our Interview Process
Initial recruiter call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.
Hiring manager interview: A deeper discussion about your background and approach to solving challenges.
Skills panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach through real-world scenarios.
Portfolio and leadership review: Walk the team through work you've led and how you build design organisations.
Leadership conversation: A conversation with a leader to discuss our mission and how you could contribute to it (and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way).
Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.
What you'll get at Tilt
Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.
The Tilt Way
We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.
Compensation Range: $250K - $300K

jobs.title: Interior Designer/ Head of Product
jobs.text:
About SQ1 Living
SQ1 Living is the furniture and interiors arm of the Square One Group. We sell turnkey, whole-apartment furniture bundles — designed, delivered, assembled and staged in seven days — to buyers (increasingly overseas investors) who would otherwise spend three to six months sourcing furniture from a dozen separate suppliers across Cyprus.
One package, one price, one week, with a single warranty and a single point of contact.
The Role
This is the founding design hire and the first of two people who start the business. It is best understood as an FF&E Design Manager with a commercial side, rather than a pure interior designer: you specify and curate what SQ1 Living sells, but you also own its cost, margin and roadmap as a product. You define what the company actually sells — a small number of curated, fully-specified apartment packages rather than an open catalogue — and you own that product end-to-end, from supplier selection through to the visual assets customers buy from, through to the eventual transition to our own manufactured designs.
What You'll Do
Design and specify six to eight curated FF&E packages covering every room, across multiple unit sizes — furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles, art, styling and kitchenware.
Source, shortlist and negotiate directly with suppliers and factories; agree trade terms and order and approve samples.
Own each package as a product: cost it, price it, and manage the margin and trade-offs between design intent and commercial viability.
Produce or direct the visual assets (renders, styling, photography direction) that let a remote buyer purchase an apartment's worth of furniture having only seen it visualised online.
Set and hold the quality bar: sample approval and field testing in live rental units before any item enters a package.
Own the long-term roadmap from imported packages to SQ1's own manufactured product line, including early input on sourcing and tooling as the company moves toward direct production in Asia.
Partner closely with the Business Development Manager to keep packages priced, buildable and sellable.

jobs.title: Director of Product Execution
jobs.text:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.
The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.
Overview:
Strategy is worth what gets delivered. At LegitScript, the Director of Product Execution owns that delivery. You will own the portfolio view, run the prioritization process, and build the operating discipline that turns product direction into shipped, measured outcomes. You are not the author of the strategy or the products — your product managers own that work — but this role exists to make it count for more.
You will run prioritization on consistent criteria in a forum where the reasoning is visible, so the ranking is trusted by the teams whose work is deferred, not only the teams whose work is chosen. You will protect focus as roadmaps grow, hold every bet to a shared readiness standard, and close the loop by measuring what actually happened after launch. This is a leadership role with hands in the work: you lead through your product managers while staying close enough to the details to catch a vague requirement, an unowned dependency, or a metric that will not tell us anything.
What You'll Do:
Own the portfolio view: what is committed, what is in flight, what is at risk, and what has been deliberately deferred.
Own the prioritization process end to end, including the cadence, the criteria, and the forum where bets are ranked and the outcome is published.
Set and hold the readiness bar for work entering the plan: a defined problem, an intended outcome, a measure, an owner, and both signatures.
Drive scope discipline, breaking large bets into increments that deliver value on their own and retiring work that no longer earns its place.
Identify and resolve cross-squad dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and capacity contention before they become delivery risk.
Own the operating cadence for product, including planning, prioritization, roadmap review, launch readiness, and retrospectives.
Run launches end to end from the product side, including readiness, enablement, communication, and post-launch measurement.
Lead, coach, and grow the product management team, owning hiring, performance, and career development.
Set the standard for product craft, including problem definition, discovery, requirements, and success metrics.
Review product managers' work and give feedback that raises the standard, from sharper problem statements to clearer requirements.
Define and track execution metrics, including delivery predictability, cycle time, scope change, and effort spent on abandoned work.
Report progress to engineering leadership, the strategy organization, and the executive team with clarity and a clear point of view.
What You'll Bring:
8+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers or product teams.
A track record of delivering complex B2B software, ideally in SaaS, fintech, regtech, compliance, trust and safety, or another domain where accuracy and defensibility matter as much as speed.
Demonstrated ownership of a multi-team product portfolio, including sequencing work with visible cross-team dependencies and managing capacity across competing demands.
Experience running a prioritization process across competing domains, with an output trusted by the teams whose work was deferred as well as the teams whose work was chosen.
Experience executing a strategy you did not author, converting direction from strategy owners into delivered, measured outcomes.
Experience partnering with an engineering counterpart as a peer, with a clean boundary between product intent and technical execution.
Fluency in modern delivery practice, including incremental delivery, iterative planning, and release approaches that get value to customers early.
Enough technical depth to engage credibly with architecture and platform trade-offs, and the judgment not to mistake that for owning them.
Strong analytical practice, including defining delivery and outcome metrics, instrumenting for them, and changing course when the data says to.
Excellent written communication, with the ability to make a complex trade-off legible to an executive, an engineer, and a customer in the same document.
Comfort operating through change, including establishing durable operating practices where none exist and improving them without disrupting delivery.
A four-year college degree or a comparable blend of education and experience. We value practical skills, a strong work ethic, and a passion for learning, regardless of formal education
Preferred:
Experience in products that combine software automation with expert human review.
Domain experience in payments, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, supplements, financial crime, marketplaces, or advertising platforms.
Experience with platform, API, or integration products serving enterprise partners.
Experience establishing product operating discipline in an organization that did not previously have it.
We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We cannot support international remote work.

Any candidate submission without a prior agreement will be considered the property of our company, and we will not be responsible for any fees or obligations related to such submissions. We encourage interested candidates to apply directly through our official channels.**

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering - RWD
jobs.text:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.
This role will work within our innovative Data & Technology group that continues to evolve to meet business needs, fuel Parexel's growth and enable improved support for stakeholders, including customers and ultimately patients, who will benefit from Parexel's integrated processes and systems.
This role can be based in the UK, Poland or Romania and can be fully home based and remote working anywhere in any of these locations only.
As the Director of Data Engineering - RWD , you'll be a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for enabling Parexel's real-world data movement within the Enterprise Data Lake and delivering standardized operational data products across clinical, safety, and corporate domains. You'll partner with our Data and Technology teams, Data and Analytics Center of Excellence, and business stakeholders to ensure trusted, high-quality, well-governed data with consistent definitions and reliable movement across the enterprise.
What You'll Lead:
Data Lake Engineering & Strategy
Contribute to the strategy, design, and roadmap for our lakehouse architecture based on medallion principles that supports reporting and analytics aligned to operational, clinical, financial, and safety needs
Direct engineering activities across data ingestion, transformation, storage, and optimization within the Enterprise Data Lake
Oversee performance, quality, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of data in the lake environment
Ensure scalable engineering pipelines across data domains, that align with governance requirements
Delivery Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a subject matter expert in data delivery, aligning data products and services with organizational priorities
Direct cross-functional prioritization and delivery processes to ensure cohesive, timely outcomes
Champion transparency and communication of data technology roadmaps across the organization
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Build, mentor, and direct global data engineering teams to deliver excellence
Champion capability development in cloud engineering, Databricks, CI/CD, SQL, and Python
Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer-focused delivery
What We're Looking For:
Experience & Track Record
Strong advanced level IT experience developing, implementing, and maintaining large-scale enterprise integration services and platforms across multiple hardware and software environments, with substantial expertise in emerging computing architectures
Exposure to Real World Data in the clinical/medical space
Experience with GxP regulations in a life sciences environment advantageous
Deep experience leading teams in data delivery management and execution, including major projects in data management, data integration, and analytics
Strong people and team management experience, including:
Successfully developing and implementing applications in new computing architecture environments using innovative technologies
Managing technical personnel across multiple project lifecycle phases with cross-functional experience
Managing financial resources to achieve goals across multiple projects
Developing efficient and effective solutions to complex business challenges
Technical Expertise
Extensive experience implementing and supporting enterprise data initiatives on cloud platforms
Demonstrated expertise in data and cloud platforms, particularly Azure Databricks
Significant experience with medallion architecture-based data lake implementations
Advanced proficiency in SQL querying and query tuning (mandatory)
Proficiency in modern data management and data-sharing tools, programming languages (especially Python), relational databases, data transformation, and development frameworks
Deep understanding of architectural best practices, application design, and estimation processes
Thorough knowledge of application architectures and enterprise application ecosystems
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (required)
In return we will be able to offer you a structured career pathway and encouragement to develop within the role including awareness and understanding of the industry. You will be well supported and in return for your hard work you will be rewarded with a competitive base salary, bonus, car allowance and holiday as well as other leading benefits you would expect with a top company in the CRO Industry.
Apply today to begin your Parexel journey!

jobs.title: VP Engineering
jobs.text:
Position Title: VP of Engineering
Reports to: CEO (interim)
Location: UK, Remote
Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent
About BibliU
BibliU is an award-winning, technology-led B2B company transforming the $65bn educational content industry. With a 90% CAGR the past 5 years, we are just getting started. We've cracked the code on Day 1 access to affordable digital course materials for students, while delivering comprehensive campus store solutions that foster human relationships, and increase our stickiness in the world of AI.
The result? Measurable impact: 10% higher student retention, 1-point GPA increases, and partnerships with 170 universities serving 600,000 students each year.
We've fundamentally changed how universities procure, distribute, and manage learning content. We partner with 4,000+ publishers, including Pearson, Oxford University Press, and Wiley to deliver content to universities, and provide rich engagement data and interactive tools like quizzes that help students actually learn.
Here's what makes our story compelling:
Founded in late 2015 as an Oxford University spin out, we've grown explosively with 90% CAGR over the last five years, including 65% in FY25, reaching $100m in annual revenue. Our Series B raised $23m led by Nesta Impact Investments (with Guinness Asset Management, Stonehage Fleming, and Oxford Sciences Enterprises). In late 2023, we acquired Texas Book Company (now 'BibliU Campus') to become the only fully vertically integrated player in the market, driving US organic growth which now represents 90% of our business.
We're hungry for more. We're actively building our M&A pipeline as we compete head-to-head against legacy bricks-and-mortar providers to improve the faculty and student experience while boosting the financial sustainability of universities.
Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.
Role Overview
BibliU is hiring a VP Engineering to lead and grow its engineering function. This role owns team leadership, engineering standards, technical governance, security posture, and delivery against the product roadmap.
The engineering organisation today is about 15 engineers across application and platform, primarily full stack TypeScript on AWS, with 1-2 managers but otherwise a fairly flat team structure. You'll inherit a function that has been through a period of change, and is in the middle of changing how software gets built.
The first six months are about earning the team's trust, getting delivery predictable, and landing AI-assisted development as a standard part of how the team works rather than scattered individual use. Beyond that, this is a build job: growing the team as the business grows, setting the architecture direction for the next stage, and taking BibliU's platform from $100m revenue to what comes after.
It is expected that product and engineering will sit under a single leader longer term, so you'll spend your time on engineering rather than on cross-functional alignment.
What Success Looks Like in year one
The team is stable, growing, and the engineering managers are developing under you.
Security posture is documented, owned and defensible, and customer security reviews are routine rather than fire drills.
Availability, performance and incident metrics are improving.
Delivery is predictable, with an honest roadmap and a release process the team trusts.
AI-assisted development is measurably in use across the team, under agreed review and quality standards, with quality and security metrics improved against the baseline set in month one.
Multiple engineering workflows have materially changed, with the before/after evidenced.
Engineering standards, architecture decisions and technical debt are documented, and there's a credible architecture plan for the next stage of scale.
What We Are Looking For
Must have
Significant experience leading software engineering or application development functions at VP, Director or CTO level.
A track record of leading teams through change.
Demonstrated accountability for delivery of complex web and mobile applications, including release governance.
Experience managing engineering teams and technical leads.
Full stack TypeScript and AWS experience is required.
Track record of owning application security: secure coding practice, vulnerability management, audit and customer security review.
Good to have
Experience implementing development governance, DevOps practice, CI/CD and quality assurance standards.
Proven ability to manage technical risk and align engineering output with commercial objectives, and to report both credibly to senior leadership.
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture and modern development frameworks.
A considered, practical position on AI-assisted development: tooling, guardrails, review, and how to measure real gains.
Experience in SaaS, EdTech, FinTech or other product-led digital environments.
Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and secure coding practices, and of the certifications customers ask about.
Familiarity with international product deployments and multi-region infrastructure.
Exposure to data-driven product optimisation and analytics frameworks.
Experience in a resource-constrained scale-up, where pragmatism and sequencing matter more than ideal solutions.
Benefits
Our benefits are all aimed at supporting a healthy work-life balance and cultivating a company culture where you can bring your whole, human self to work.
Here's what we offer:
🌴 35 days holiday per year (excluding public holidays!) - yep, that’s not a typo!
🎂 Your birthday off.
🌱 12 scheduled company wellness Fridays off per year.
❤️ Enhanced maternity & paternity allowance.
⏰ Flexible working hours - we’re a remote team spread across the US and UK.
💻 Work-from-home allowance to help you set up your dream WFH station.
🚴 Cycle-to-work scheme (UK).
🛟 Life Insurance up to 4 x salary .
❤️ Private health insurance.
👁️ Annual eye test and up to £100 towards frames for glasses required for DSE work.
We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds, experiences and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective and BibliU is committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can do rewarding work.
Please note: We do not work with external recruiters/recruitment agencies. This position will be filled directly by BibliU and we kindly request that external recruiters/recruitment agencies refrain from submitting candidates for this role.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
This role is on-site, 5 days a week, working from our Flatiron office in NYC.
About Seated
Seated exists to help restaurants thrive in an industry defined by thin margins and underutilized capacity. We connect thousands of restaurants with millions of high-intent diners through demand-driven pricing and rewards, helping restaurants fill empty tables, reach new guests, increase visit frequency, and drive profitable incremental revenue.
Since launching, billions of dollars in restaurant spend have flowed through Seated, and hundreds of millions of dollars in rewards have been paid to Seated consumers. Today, Seated operates across 20+ U.S. markets and continues to expand nationally.
Our core marketplace is thriving. Now, we’re focused on expanding the value Seated creates for restaurants and consumers and building the company’s next major growth engine.
See it for yourself: seatedapp.io (restaurant side) · getseated.seatedapp.io (diner side) · Seated on iOS · Seated on Android
Role Overview
Seated is hiring a VP of Product to own product strategy and execution across our consumer and restaurant businesses.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will be responsible for helping determine where Seated makes its next major product investment, strengthening critical parts of our underlying product infrastructure, and identifying new ways for product to drive growth.
This is a hands-on leadership role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with executives and the board while staying close to the work - talking to customers, digging into data, writing requirements, testing ideas, and working directly with Design and Engineering to ship great products.
The VP of Product will lead a Product and Design team and work as a close partner to Engineering. Scope may expand based on the individual, potentially including Analytics, Consumer, or broader GM responsibilities.
Responsibilities
Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products
Partner with the CEO and executive team to identify, evaluate, and validate Seated’s next major product bets
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, business-case development, and validation
Evaluate opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Strengthen critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, prioritization, and execution
Identify opportunities for product-led growth across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Build and lead a small, high-performing Product and Design team
Translate company strategy into a focused product roadmap with clear priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Personal Loans Growth
jobs.text:
About the Role
Upgrade is seeking a Director of Product Management to help drive the next phase of growth for our Personal Loans business. In this role, you’ll identify and develop high-impact growth opportunities across the customer journey — from acquisition and conversion to new loan programs, partnerships, market expansion, and deeper relationships with existing customers. You’ll operate as an individual contributor, working closely with Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Risk, Credit, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Operations. You’ll combine customer insights, data, and business economics to identify opportunities, build the case for investment, and lead cross-functional teams from strategy through execution. This is an ideal role for a highly analytical and commercially minded product leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning new ideas into measurable business results.
This is a hybrid role based in either our San Francisco, CA, or Wilmington, DE, office, with onsite work on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
What You’ll Do:
Own and evolve the growth product strategy for Personal Loans, identifying opportunities to grow funded volume, expand our addressable market, improve economics, and increase customer lifetime value.
Develop a deep understanding of the Personal Loans funnel, customer behavior, acquisition channels, credit and fraud constraints, and key drivers of business performance.
Identify, size, and prioritize new growth opportunities, including new loan programs, customer segments, credit capabilities, distribution partnerships, and conversion improvements.
Partner closely with Marketing to connect product strategy with acquisition, customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, and channel performance.
Partner with Partnerships to identify new distribution opportunities, develop partner-specific experiences, and improve performance across existing relationships.
Work with Risk, Credit, Finance, and Analytics to evaluate opportunities based on customer impact, credit performance, economics, and incremental profitability.
Lead high-impact initiatives that span multiple product and functional teams, creating alignment and driving execution from concept through launch.
Use experimentation, customer research, competitive insights, and data to identify growth constraints and uncover new opportunities.
Define clear hypotheses and success metrics, evaluate performance after launch, and determine where to iterate, scale, or change direction.
Serve as a senior thought partner to Personal Loans leadership on product strategy, prioritization, and investment decisions.
What We Look For:
9+ years of product management experience, including experience operating at a Principal or Director level and a track record of driving meaningful business outcomes.
Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and translate ambiguous problems into clear product strategies, prioritized roadmaps, and successful products.
Strong analytical and commercial instincts, with experience using data to understand customer behavior, conversion funnels, unit economics, and business tradeoffs.
Experience in consumer lending, credit cards, fintech, or another data-intensive consumer financial product strongly preferred.
Experience partnering closely with Marketing, Growth, Business Development, or Partnerships teams.
Familiarity with credit decisioning, payments, funding infrastructure, or loan origination is a plus.
Strong quantitative skills and comfort with experimentation, financial analysis, funnel analytics, and SQL.
Ability to understand and navigate tradeoffs across growth, customer experience, risk, fraud, compliance, and economics.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Risk, Finance, and other functions without direct authority.
Experience working with external partners or vendors to develop and test new capabilities is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems, develop compelling business cases, and create alignment around strategic decisions.
High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, quantitative, or technical degree a plus.
What We Offer You:
Competitive salary and stock option plan
Paid coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible PTO
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Paid parental leave
Health & wellness initiatives
The compensation range for this position is USD $190,000–$250,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. An individual’s base salary within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid) - regular travel expected, primarily to China, with occasional travel to the UK
Department: Technology
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
WHO WE ARE
At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.
With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.
YOUR NEXT ROLE
As VP of Engineering, you are the number two in Acclaro's technology organization - reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, deputizing for them, and owning the engineering org end to end. You will lead a globally distributed team across India and China that we expect to scale to 20–30 engineers when fully staffed.
You're joining at a pivotal moment. Acclaro is undergoing a major structural transformation, building our own proprietary AI platform to stay competitive, and evolving into a truly tech-enabled company. This role sits at the center of that shift - you'll build new technology from the ground up while keeping our existing systems running reliably through the transition.
Two things matter more than anything else in this job. The first is hiring: you will personally build the team that builds the platform, and the quality of that team is the single biggest determinant of whether this transformation works. The second is that you stay technical -s this is not a delegation-only leadership position. You'll be in the codebase, in the pull requests and on the incident calls, and the engineers you hire will judge you on it.
We are building AI-first in both senses: AI in the product, and AI in how the engineering team itself works. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, leadership and business impact, and want the kind of ownership that comes from building something rather than inheriting it, this is that opportunity.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Hire an exceptional team. Own engineering recruiting as your primary deliverable: Defining the bar and the scorecards, sourcing and pitching candidates yourself, running the technical loop, and closing senior hires. Scaling to 20–30 engineers across India and China without lowering the bar is the job.
Lead and grow them. Set org design, career ladders and a performance culture people want to be part of. Develop first-line managers and tech leads, give direct feedback, and act quickly on both high performers and mis-hires.
Stay hands-on. Write code where it counts - prototypes, spikes and the hard production problems - and be a regular, visible participant in code reviews and design reviews. Technical credibility is how you will lead this team, and how you will recruit into it.
Build the AI platform. Lead the build-out of Acclaro's proprietary AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation and quality harnesses, model selection and routing, latency and cost control, and human-in-the-loop review at production scale.
Make the engineering org AI-native in how it works. Set the standard for agentic coding tools, AI-assisted review and testing, and automated toil reduction - then measure the leverage it creates and raise it every quarter. You are expected to hold strong, current opinions here and to change them as the tooling changes.
Own the architecture. Drive architectural reviews and major technology and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing innovation, scalability, reliability, security and maintainability across both green-field and legacy estates.
Ship predictably. Establish and continuously improve engineering standards, development practices, CI/CD, testing and quality frameworks - and own delivery predictability, uptime and platform health through measurable goals and KPIs.
Partner across the business. Work with Product, Design, Operations and commercial leaders to translate company priorities into scalable execution plans and technology roadmaps.
Be there when it breaks. Be personally present during major incidents - not just briefed afterward - and own disaster recovery planning, security readiness and business continuity.
Deputize for the CTO. Represent engineering at executive level and act as a trusted technical voice with clients, partners and external stakeholders. Own engineering budgets, infrastructure investment and vendor relationships alongside the CTO.
Keep us safe and compliant. Ensure technology practices align with security, privacy and data protection requirements across global markets.
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU
Have 10+ years building software and 5+ years leading engineers, including responsibility for a team of 20 or more across multiple locations
Are still a genuinely strong engineer - you can design a system, review a pull request with authority, and debug a production issue yourself. Expect a technical deep dive as part of our process
Have hired at pace and at quality: senior and staff-level hires you closed personally, an interview process you designed that other teams trusted, and a track record of retaining the people you hired
Have built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes - retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model operations, and the latency, cost and quality trade-offs that come with them, including knowing when AI is the wrong answer
Use AI tooling in your own daily engineering work and have rolled it out across a team, with a clear view of what it did and didn't improve
Have done this in a startup or scale-up environment - comfortable with ambiguity, constrained budgets and no existing playbook, and energized by building rather than inheriting
Have run green-field development and legacy modernization in parallel without letting either one stall
Are experienced with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or GCP), APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and modern development practices such as CI/CD and infrastructure as code
Have led distributed engineering teams across multiple countries, cultures and time zones, and write clearly enough to lead asynchronously
Are an exceptional communicator who can adapt complex technical concepts for executive, customer and non-technical audiences, and who leads with clarity and empathy
Hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or have equivalent professional experience
YOU’LL STAND OUT IF YOU
Have been a CTO, VP of Engineering or founding engineer at an early-stage company that scaled successfully
Have taken a multi-tenant SaaS platform from zero to enterprise-grade, including the security and reliability work enterprise customer’s demand
Bring hands-on experience with localization technologies, translation management systems, or global content platforms
Have hired and led engineering teams in India and other countries.
Have led modernization projects that turned legacy systems into scalable, integrated solutions
Understand global compliance and security frameworks such as GDPR, SOC 2, or ISO certifications
Are multilingual, or have deep experience working across distributed, multicultural teams
Have a public body of technical work – open-source contributions, writing, or conference talks
WHAT SUCCESS LOOK LIKE
First 90 days. The hiring plan, scorecards and interview loop are in place, and the first senior hires are in flight. You have completed a clear-eyed assessment of the AI platform and the legacy estate - and you have shipped something yourself.
By six months. The team is growing to plan with no compromise on quality, first-line leadership is in place, and engineering standards and CI/CD are established. The AI platform has a predictable delivery cadence.
By twelve months. The team is at or near full strength at 20–30 engineers, retained and performing. The AI platform is live and carrying real client volume, and there is measurable improvement in delivery velocity and engineering leverage from AI-native ways of working.
INCLUSION & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY - Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.title: Field CTO, Public Sector
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As a Field CTO, Public Sector at GitLab, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor for public sector customers and prospects, helping them connect DevSecOps strategy, security, and compliance goals to real business and mission outcomes. You will work closely with executive stakeholders during the pre-sales process, offering strategic guidance on how GitLab can support secure software delivery, modernization efforts, and platform adoption across complex environments.
In this role, you will combine technical depth with executive communication. You will build relationships with leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects, while also partnering across GitLab with sales, marketing, and product teams. Your perspective from the field will help shape customer conversations, influence go-to-market strategy, and inform how GitLab continues to serve public sector organizations.
Note: This is an individual contributor, customer-facing technical advisory role; it does not include direct people management responsibilities.
This role is well suited for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology strategy, customer engagement, and market leadership. You will help customers understand the value of a single DevSecOps platform, contribute to industry conversations around standards and guidance, and represent GitLab in a way that reflects our values of transparency, collaboration, and results.
Some examples of our projects:
Supporting strategic public sector opportunities with executive-level DevSecOps and security guidance
Contributing to government working groups, standards discussions, and public sector thought leadership content
What you'll do
Engage with customers in a technical consulting and advisory role during the pre-sales process, providing technical assistance and strategic guidance.
Deliver executive-level thought leadership on DevSecOps, security, and compliance for strategic public sector opportunities, including new and growth accounts.
Build and maintain relationships with customer leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects.
Partner with the marketing team to develop content and support media engagement opportunities that increase awareness of GitLab in the public sector market.
Educate customers on the value of the GitLab platform and related technologies, and support conversations across multiple levels of the organization to help enable successful deployment.
Assist with requests for information and responses related to government publications and public-private partnership opportunities.
Participate in and contribute to working groups connected to government publications, standards, and demonstrations.
Curate and communicate public sector field feedback, collaborate on prioritization with marketing and product teams, and contribute to sales strategy, playbooks, enablement, and reusable technical content for the field.
What you'll bring
Demonstrated expertise in DevSecOps strategy, application security, and compliance for regulated environments, including providing risk-based guidance.
Experience selling to, supporting, or working within the public sector.
Experience creating and delivering technical thought leadership content (presentations, demos, written materials) independently.
Working knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including CI/CD and modern engineering and operations practices.
Experience with cloud computing and modern platform architectures that support secure software delivery.
Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical strategy effectively to audiences ranging from executives to engineers.
Comfort working in a fully remote, distributed, and asynchronous environment.
Ability to coordinate across time zones and adapt schedules to customer and internal stakeholder needs.
Experience in technical pre-sales, consulting, solutions architecture, or comparable customer-facing IT roles, including using GitLab (and willingness to learn quickly) to support customer conversations and demonstrations.
Living in the Washington D.C. Metro area preferred
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by applicable law.
About the team
The Field CTO, Public Sector role works across customer-facing and internal teams to help GitLab meet the needs of public sector organizations with clarity, credibility, and deep technical insight. jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do
Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.
About the team
The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

jobs.title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE
Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
