jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Data Management
jobs.text:
About Versapay
Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end- to-end cash flow clarity, ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms. By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.
About the Role
We are looking for a strategic, builder-minded Senior Director of Enterprise Data Management to own and execute Versapay’s enterprise data strategy at a pivotal moment in our evolution. This leader will drive the convergence of our transactional, operational, behavioral, relational and intent data layers into a unified operational backbone — the foundational unlock for AI- powered product features, semantic data models, externalized data products, and autonomous AR workflows.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role directly tied to our product and commercial roadmap, with a clear mandate and executive alignment behind it.
What You’ll Do
Data Strategy & Architecture
Define and drive Versapay’s enterprise data strategy, aligning the data roadmap to product, AI, and commercial objectives.
Lead the architectural convergence of our transactional, operational, and analytical data layers into a unified, bi-directional operational backbone.
Own a multi-year data maturity roadmap with clear milestones across architecture, semantics, governance, and accessibility.
Champion a business-first data modelling philosophy: canonical hierarchies, enterprise ontologies, and shared metric catalogues that allow humans and AI agents to interpret data consistently.
Data Governance & Quality
Operationalize data governance as a first-class concern — automated classification, RBAC enforcement, platform SLAs, and certified data objects.
Formalize the Enterprise Data Catalogue, replacing institutional knowledge with a searchable, self-service discovery layer.
Deploy and maintain an executive data health dashboard to provide ongoing visibility into the health and integrity of our data estate.
Enforce the data procurement gate, ensuring new tools and systems are reviewed and classified before entering the estate.
Build and own the Enterprise Data Asset Registry to enable secure, frictionless data sharing internally and with commercial partners.
AI Enablement & Agentic Readiness
Drive data infrastructure readiness to support Versapay’s AI roadmap — from ML pipelines and LLM serving layers
to agentic serving tiers.
Establish formal schema contracts and semantic modelling standards that guarantee deterministic outputs for safe,
scalable agent deployment.
Partner with Product and Engineering to enable agentic capabilities: reverse data flow, predictive model productization, and real-time data serving.
Govern data and AI exposure — ensuring sensitive data stays within approved platforms and all external data products meet strict quality, lineage, and privacy standards.
Data Accessibility & Commercialization
Evolve the function from ad hoc data requests to a design-first, product-oriented organization with a governed, discoverable asset registry.
Operationalize external data products for commercialization, delivering clear value to customers within consent
and compliance frameworks.
Partner with the commercial team on data product strategy — turning Versapay’s proprietary network data into defensible, recurring revenue.
Expand self-service data access for internal teams while protecting compute capacity and governance standards.
Team Leadership
Lead and grow the Data Platform Team, building a high-performing function with clear ownership across data strategy, engineering, consumption, AI compute; in tight partnership with the Embedded Analytics Team, Risk and Compliance.
Act as the cross-functional bridge between Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and Legal/Compliance- ensuring data serves every function from a shared, trusted foundation.
Build a culture of data discipline — standardizing how information is captured and governed so insight is consistent, discoverable, and trusted across the organization.
Represent the data function at the executive level, partnering closely with the CTO and contributing to the broader AI and product roadmap.
What You Bring
Required
• 10+ years of experience in data leadership, with at least 5+ years at the Director level owning enterprise data strategy, architecture, or governance.
• Demonstrated track record of modernizing and unifying complex, multi-source data environments at scale — ideally in a SaaS, fintech, payments context.
• Deep expertise in modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred), lakehouse architectures, ETL frameworks, and semantic/canonical modelling.
• Strong evidence of application of AI and ML infrastructure — including how data governance, observability, and semantic standards underpin safe, scalable AI deployment.
• Proven ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams and partner effectively across Product, Engineering, and Commercial functions.
• Experience governing data for commercial use: external data products, consent frameworks, lineage standards, and privacy compliance.
• Exceptional communication skills — able to translate complex data and architectural concepts for executive audiences and build alignment across functions.
• Experience with managing the cost of data warehouses and cost forecasting.
• Experience in hiring and managing talent across the entire data food chain – from BI and Analytics to Data Engineering to CI/CD of data platforms.
Preferred
• Experience with agentic AI architecture, MCP, or LLM serving layers and the data requirements that underpin them.
• Familiarity with AR/AP automation, payments, or working capital platforms and the data models they generate.
• Track record of commercializing data as a product — packaging data assets, building external APIs, or creating data-sharing programs with partners.
• Experience managing data maturity transformations with structured roadmaps, measurable milestones, and executive visibility.
• Hands-on experience with AWS-native data infrastructure (Glue, SageMaker, Bedrock) alongside Snowflake and modern BI tooling.
• Background in a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS environment.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Strategy & Product Management
jobs.text:
Position Overview
We are seeking a visionary and high-impact Senior Director, Strategy & Product Management to redefine the future of sterile processing workflows. This is a "legacy-building" opportunity. You will be the driving force of a product transformation, evolving our SaaS platform from a functional utility into an indispensable, AI-driven command center for hospital SPD operations.
The organization is looking for a hands-on product leader who has launched and scaled real software products used daily by non-technical customers. You will take full ownership of the platform's strategy, roadmap, and product organization. You will define what the platform becomes next, drive adoption and retention across an enterprise customer base, and partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to align product development with business growth.
You will report directly to the General Manager and lead the charge in making our software the gold standard for patient safety and departmental productivity. If you have demonstrated strengths of product intuition and financial acumen, this is the platform to execute your best work
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Transformation & Roadmap Ownership
Visionary Leadership: Completely overhaul the current product roadmap. Move beyond simple tracking to predictive analytics, automated compliance and decision support.
Customer-Centric Innovation: Spend significant time in the field to translate customer pain points into software features that delight users.
Agile Execution: Lead the product management team in a high-velocity environment, ensuring the engineering backlog is ruthlessly prioritized for rapid execution and maximum market impact.
2. Operational Excellence
Pricing & Packaging: Optimize SaaS pricing models to reflect the value of operational efficiency and risk mitigation.
Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner with Sales and Marketing to arm them with value propositions that wins in the hospital space.
Key Performance Indicators: Own key metrics e.g. LTV, CAC, NRR, ARR, Churn.
3. M&A
Buy vs. Build Analysis: Continuously evaluate the competitive landscape. Identify tuck-in acquisitions or strategic partnerships that provide immediate technological advantages or market access.
Deal Execution: Work alongside executive leadership to perform due diligence, develop integration plans, and ensure that acquired assets deliver immediate value to our core SaaS offering.
Market Positioning: Define the long-term moat for the business, ensuring our product strategy aligns with shifting healthcare reimbursement models and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications
10 to 15 years of experience in product management or product leadership within a SaaS, B2C application or enterprise software company
3 to 5 years leading product managers and product leadership directly
Proven ownership of an external-facing software product actively used by non-technical, paying customers in a hospital setup.
Demonstrated track record driving engagement, retention, and product-led revenue outcomes
5+ years of M&A experience, including buy-versus-build analysis, due diligence, and integration planning
Strong cross-functional experience partnering with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing
Experience defining product strategy, owning a roadmap, and launching new capabilities successfully to market
Solid understanding of agile methodologies and SaaS product development practices
Experience collaborating on product packaging, positioning, and monetization strategies is a plus
Familiarity with enterprise B2B buying dynamics and customer success motions is a plus
Bachelor's degree required; Computer Science, Engineering, or Business preferred. An MBA or advanced degree is highly preferred

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on, and battle-tested Head of Engineering to lead our core engineering teams as we scale our real-time verification and decision engines across Southeast Asia. In this role, you will bridge high-level system architecture with deep operational rigor.
You are not an abstract manager—you are an active technical leader who regularly participates in system design reviews, inspects critical PRs, fine-tunes performance bottlenecks, and drives incident management alongside your team. You will set the high mark for execution speed, engineering craftsmanship, system resilience, and clear communication across cross-functional product and business units.
Key Responsibilities
Lead system design, high-availability architecture, and API scalability across microservices, eKYC/eKYB pipelines, and database infrastructure.
Debug high-severity production incidents, conduct root-cause analysis, and improve database efficiency, lock contention, and system latency.
Lead live system migrations and zero-downtime maintenance strategies, including dual-write backfills and atomic cutovers.
Establish engineering guardrails around secure coding, security, and AI-assisted code generation.
Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, and precision.
Establish standard operating procedures for incident response, security compliance, continuous deployment, and logging.
Communicate complex technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with regional privacy and security requirements, including PDPA and GDPR.
Oversee identity management, automated testing, edge-case analysis, and third-party data integrations.

jobs.title: VP Product Management
jobs.text:
Our client is a leader in AP Payments as a Service, specializing in embedded B2B payments. They streamline the payment process by integrating electronic payment and cash flow solutions into accounts payable and procurement software.
Their vision is for finance leaders to decide only "what" to pay, while their software manages the "how" and "when."
The company is a major disruptor in B2B Payments and Fintech, growing revenue by over 100% annually. They've raised over $65M from investors like JP Morgan, Discover, NBH Bank, Mendon Venture Partners, and Valley Bankwho are also customers and partners.
Role Overview:
As the Vice President of Product Management, you will shape and drive our software roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and delivering top-notch results. You will lead a dynamic team, defining product vision, strategy, and execution to achieve market leadership.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, engineering, or related field; MBA preferred.
8-10 years in product management with a proven track record.
Strong leadership and communication skills.
Expertise in product development processes and methodologies.
Experience in B2B, technology, software, or SaaS industries.
Success in product innovation and revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities:
Act as the primary liaison between business P&L owners and the product development team.
Drive product vision, strategy, and execution to achieve market leadership.
Ensure leadership alignment and support for product management methodologies.
Define and manage internal and external product roadmaps.
Develop processes for customer feedback management and prioritize needs.
Install project plan methodology for efficient product commercialization.
Create C-suite/board-ready presentation materials on product strategy.
Develop external materials communicating product strategy and value.
Collaborate with P&L owners to develop business cases for product initiatives.
Execute product commercialization, planning, and go-to-market strategies.
Foster strong relationships with internal customers and support their needs.
Conduct market analysis to understand current and future needs.
Establish and track KPIs to measure and optimize product performance.
Lead and delegate product management and commercialization activities.
Benefits:
Fast-paced start-up environment with experienced leaders.
Opportunities to engage with the latest technologies and make a measurable impact.
Quarterly virtual team-building activities and monthly team lunches.
Competitive salary ($150,000 - $175,000) plus equity.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Unlimited vacation policy.
This is a remote position.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
At ITRS, we make society’s critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.
We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you’ll find:
• A culture that backs you – We’re proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
• Work that matters – Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
• Room to grow – Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we’re committed to your development. Just ask our team members who’ve been excelling here for 10+ years.
With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity–backed global partner
Scope
ITRS is looking for an experienced and accomplished, or aspiring, Director of Platform Engineering to join our collaborative and inclusive team. Reporting to our Global Head of Platform Engineering, this is a hybrid-working role, typically requiring 2 days per week in the office. The role will also include leadership of our Forward Deployed Engineers, ensuring this team is closely aligned with platform engineering practices, customer delivery priorities and operational standards.
The ITRS engineering teams are building a next-generation observability platform with the capability to collect, store and analyse the vast amount of data generated by banks and financial institutions.

jobs.title: Director of Product, AI
jobs.text:
The Elevator Pitch:
Evolv Technology is looking for a Director of Product, AI, a senior individual contributor who will work at the center of our AI engineering and research teams to build the industry's best weapons detection and computer vision capabilities. You will get deep into the mechanics of how we collect data, define annotation standards, evaluate models, run field trials, and deploy detection systems into the real world, translating that work into product decisions to keep people safe.
You will embed directly with AI engineering as the product lead for our detection capabilities, operating with the technical depth to make and defend decisions about data, models, and evaluation methodology.
What Winning Looks Like
In the first 30 days, you will: Pressure-test how we collect data, set annotation standards, evaluate models, and run field trials. Come back with a sharp read on the biggest gaps, risks, and decisions, and a plan to move on them.
Within 90 days, you will: Ship a prioritized data collection strategy across the scenarios and threats that matter most. Lock annotation, dataset quality, and validation standards with AI engineering. Define the release-readiness bar, including accuracy, false positive/negative rates, latency, throughput, and real-world load, then get alignment on it. Turn field-trial results into real product and model decisions. Build the operating cadence and decision framework that keeps detection performance moving.
Within 6 months, you will: Own detection. You're the accountable product lead driving data priorities, model evaluation, release readiness, trade-offs, in lockstep with AI engineering and research. Shape the roadmap, balancing performance against latency, compute cost, hardware limits, and customer experience. Make sure every external claim about detection performance is accurate and defensible, and push hard with legal and compliance to get there.
By the end of the first year, you will: Demonstrate measurable improvement in detection performance and release predictability across priority use cases. Show that the operating mechanisms you established are consistently identifying performance gaps, driving timely decisions, and improving deployed models. Influence the longer-term detection roadmap through clear evidence about customer needs, technical trade-offs, and business impact.
What you’ll own
AI/ML Lifecycle Ownership
Define data collection strategy: what scenarios, environments, and threat types need more or better training data
Own annotation guidelines in partnership with AI engineering
Partner with AI engineering on training methodology and validation approach
Define and own model evaluation metrics specific to weapons detection (false positive/negative rates, detection latency, throughput under real-world load) and the standards for when a model is ready to ship

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment. We are hiring a Sr. Director of Engineering to lead the people, systems, and practices behind reliable products.
Why it matters: This leader will develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders while closely guiding teams using AI to build and experiment. Working closely with the CTO, you will turn company technology direction into clear engineering decisions and execution.
Go deeper: The role spans engineering across Axios products, platforms, and workflows, from our CMS and axios.com to newsletters, Local products, internal tools, and systems supporting the Newsroom and business teams. Product, Newsroom, and business leaders set the goals. Engineering builds the systems and capabilities that help achieve them. The right leader will speed decisions, shorten the path from idea to product, spot risks early, and escalate issues before they grow. Responsibilities include:
Partner closely with the CTO and engineering leaders to shape engineering strategy and technical direction.
Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, supporting clear accountability and a healthy culture. Develop and retain strong talent, and hire thoughtfully as needs evolve.
Strengthen planning, delivery, quality, and reliability. Help teams make faster decisions, move ideas into products, spot risks, and escalate issues early.
Partner with Product, Design, Newsroom, and business leaders to turn priorities into technical plans and match engineering capacity to the most important work.
Bring strong judgment to architecture, platforms, and reliability, especially when tradeoffs span teams.
Own the operating standards, guidelines, and practices that help engineering teams plan, build, test, release, operate, and learn effectively.
Establish shared benchmarks and baselines for engineering health.
Lead vendor evaluation and selection for engineering tools, platforms, and services, balancing capability, cost, security, reliability, support, and long-term fit.
Help define modern engineering leadership inside an AI-native media company and shape how Axios builds, learns, and delivers at speed.
Worthy of your time: This leader must be a close partner to the CTO and senior leaders who can explain technical details clearly and dive deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions. Success means faster decisions, a shorter path from idea to product, strong engineering leadership, reliable systems, and an organization that sees around corners. What we’re looking for:
You have led and developed engineering managers and senior technical leaders, setting clear expectations and addressing performance directly.
You have helped teams use AI to improve how they build, test, and operate software and to experiment with new product capabilities.
You translate technical details for executives and nontechnical partners while going deep with engineers on technical and architectural questions.
You quickly understand unfamiliar areas, ask the right questions, and know when to bring in expertise, invest in platforms, simplify systems, or accept a short-term tradeoff.
Ideally, you have led teams responsible for high-traffic digital products and the platforms behind them.
You have a strong vision for how AI and technology will change engineering practices, product development, platforms, and internal workflows.
Starting salary for this role is in the range of $250,000 - $270,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.
Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.
What Axios brings to the table besides salary:
401(k) with employer match
Robust PPO and high-deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high-deductible health plan option
Dental and vision coverage
Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
One mental health day per quarter
Annual learning and development stipend
$100 monthly work-from-home stipend
Tele-mental health services through Headspace
OneMedical membership, including telehealth services
Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate
Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers
Virtual company-sponsored social events
A strong and positive work environment
A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture
Equal Opportunity Employer Statement
Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Venture Lead / Head of Gtrons (Product and Commercial)
jobs.text:
Gtrons is a joint venture between 2 main market listed companies - Solarvest Holdings Berhad and Agmo Holdings Berhad, formed to build the region's clean energy superapp: a single digital platform through which households and businesses discover, adopt, manage and pay for clean energy products and services.
Two solutions are already in market and form the foundation of the platform:
PowerBee — an electric vehicle charging platform serving site owners and drivers.
Vestech — a residential solar solution for homeowners.
The mandate is to grow both into profitable businesses, add further clean energy solutions to the platform over time, and extend the platform beyond Malaysia into the wider region.
This role exists to run that business. The successful candidate carries commercial accountability for the joint venture, owns the direction of the platform, and holds the appointed technology partner to account for delivery. It is a general management role with a strong product core, suited to someone who wants to build a category-defining business from an early base rather than administer an established one.
.
Key Responsibilities
.
1. Commercial Ownership and Financial Performance
Hold full profit and loss accountability for the joint venture, covering revenue, gross margin, operating cost and cash position.
Own and deliver the annual revenue and profitability targets approved by the Board, with quarterly forecasting and clear explanation of variance.
Build and maintain the operating budget; control spend against approved envelopes and seek Board approval for material variances.
Own the unit economics of every solution — cost to acquire, cost to serve and contribution margin — and drive them toward agreed targets.
2. Channel Partnerships and Market Development
Identify, negotiate and manage channel and distribution partnerships that give the platform reach across the clean energy value chain.
Structure commercial terms for partnerships — revenue share, exclusivity, service levels — and manage partner performance against them.
Develop the approach to markets beyond Malaysia, including partner selection, market-entry sequencing and the business case for each market.
Represent the joint venture externally with regulators, industry bodies and the wider clean energy ecosystem.
3. Customer Acquisition and Pricing
Own the customer acquisition strategy across all solutions, with accountability for acquisition volume, cost per acquisition and retention.
Set and execute pricing and packaging for each solution, testing and revising against demand, competitor movement and margin targets.
Own the customer lifecycle beyond acquisition: onboarding, engagement, cross-sell between solutions on the platform, and churn reduction.
Establish the customer insight and analytics capability that informs acquisition, pricing and roadmap decisions.
4. Market Understanding and Product Strategy
Proactively research, interrogate and build a deep working understanding of the market the product serves — customers, buyers, competitors, substitutes, pricing dynamics and the regulatory conditions that shape demand.
Ground every product decision in market and user evidence rather than internal opinion or stakeholder preference; be able to demonstrate the evidence behind any position taken.
Validate demand before development commitment and re-validate at each major roadmap checkpoint.
Define and maintain the product vision and strategy for the digital solutions portfolio, aligned to the business objectives approved by the Board.
Develop and own the business case for each product initiative, including target market, value proposition, revenue model and investment required.
5. Roadmap and Portfolio Management
Own, publish and maintain the product roadmap across the solution portfolio, with clearly sequenced releases, dependencies and decision gates.
Prioritise across competing initiatives and stakeholder requests using a transparent, criteria-based framework that stakeholders can see and challenge.
Define phased delivery with a minimum viable product for each solution, so that value is validated early rather than at the end of a full build cycle.
Recommend to the Board when an initiative should be continued, re-scoped, paused or stopped, with supporting evidence.
6. Requirements and Specification Governance
Translate business needs into clear, testable product requirements — user stories, functional and non-functional specifications, and process flows.
Define measurable acceptance criteria for every deliverable and milestone before development commences. Ensure acceptance criteria trace directly back to the agreed specification.
Maintain a single controlled source of truth for scope, and operate a formal change control process: all variations documented, impact-assessed for cost, timeline and quality, and approved at the appropriate level before work proceeds.
Maintain a requirements traceability matrix linking each specified requirement through to design, build, test and acceptance.
7. Delivery Oversight and Acceptance
Manage overall project delivery against roadmap, budget and quality expectations, coordinating resources across all contributing parties.
Chair regular delivery governance forums; maintain visibility of progress, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions.
Design and govern the testing and acceptance regime: define test scenarios against specification, coordinate user acceptance testing with named business owners of appropriate authority, and ensure results are documented and retained.
Formally accept or reject deliverables against acceptance criteria. Ensure sign-off is executed by an authorised representative and recorded, and that sign-off is understood to confirm conformance to specification.
Ensure all source code, documentation, technical materials and knowledge transfer are delivered to and retained by the business at each milestone.
8. Stakeholder Management and Reporting
Act as the primary bridge between business domain experts and the engineering delivery teams, ensuring domain knowledge is fully captured, understood and reflected in what is built.
Secure and structure input from subject matter experts and end users throughout the development lifecycle, not only at testing stage.
Manage expectations proactively across all stakeholders; surface misalignment early and drive it to resolution rather than allowing it to emerge at delivery.
Report to the Board on product performance, roadmap status, financial position, risks and decisions required.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Portugal
We have a small but strong group of team members in Portugal, having joined us from companies like Feedzai and OLX. As we continue to build out our engineering organisation across Europe, Portugal is a market we are actively hiring into.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Spain.
About The Role
Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.
Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like In The Role
The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.
Why Join Us
A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
What To Expect In The Hiring Process
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Product Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our ScraperAPIteam, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
We recently acquired Traject Data, home of SerpWow and Rainforest API, and now run an end-to-end data pipeline: from proxy and scraping infrastructure through to structured, ready-to-use data APIs. The next chapter is turning that into one coherent, AI-native platform and we're looking for a CTPO to lead the combined 25-person product and engineering org through it. You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table, and be the person who understands the stack down to the proxy layer while also setting where the product goes next.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Get hands-on with the heart of the product: proxy dynamics and anti-bot evasion, working directly with our Head of Ops to optimise vendor relationships and build up capacity.
Build real fluency in the product and the backend so you can operate as a genuine technical sparring partner to the CEO, not just receive direction.
Start bringing the ScraperAPI and Traject Data infrastructure together on a coherent technical roadmap
Your responsibilities
Own end-to-end product and technology strategy across our scraping infrastructure, proxy networks, and structured data API products (ScraperAPI, SerpWow, Rainforest API).
Lead, scale, and develop a 25+ person product and engineering organisation spanning multiple countries and time zones, building the management structure it needs as it grows.
Set technical architecture direction for high-scale, high-reliability infrastructure, including proxy management, anti-bot evasion, and large-scale scraping systems.
Drive AI and modern ML tooling into both the product itself and how the team builds and ships it.
Define and execute one product roadmap across the merged ScraperAPI and Traject Data lines.
Represent product and technology to the board, and work closely with the CEO and commercial leadership to keep product direction and business strategy aligned.
Stay close enough to the code and infrastructure to go in and troubleshoot, fix, or challenge a technical decision yourself when it matters.
What You bring to the table
Experience leading product and/or engineering at a highly technical company (CTO, CPO, VP Engineering or similar), at a 25+ person org or larger
Real hands-on depth in web scraping, proxies, or closely adjacent infrastructure. You understand the operational reality of this space and you don't rattle when a source breaks overnight and it's suddenly all hands on deck
A genuine track record with AI/ML, both shaping AI-powered product capability and pushing AI-native ways of working through an engineering team
Experience owning product vision and technical architecture together, not just one side of that line
Comfort operating at board level: a clear communicator who can hold their own with an ambitious, hands-on CEO and knows when to push back
Bonus: experience integrating product lines after a merger or acquisition
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Director, Product Strategy & Operations (Product Adoption)
jobs.text:
About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.
Our People:
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact:
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
Responsibilities:
Why this role exists :
We are looking for a Director, Product Strategy & Operations – Product Adoption to drive how customers discover, adopt, engage with, and derive value from HighLevel’s products and capabilities.
This role will sit at the intersection of Product Strategy, Product Management, Growth, Customer Success, Data, and Operations. The primary mandate is to identify adoption gaps across the customer journey, translate data and customer insights into clear strategic priorities, and partner with product teams to improve activation, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
This is not a traditional program management or product operations role. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, strong analytical depth, customer understanding, and execution to influence product roadmaps and materially improve adoption across the platform
What You'll Do
Product Adoption Strategy
Define and drive HighLevel’s product adoption strategy across key products, features, and customer segments.
Identify the biggest barriers preventing customers from discovering, activating, and repeatedly using high-value capabilities.
Develop frameworks to measure adoption across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and activation through sustained engagement and expansion.
Prioritize adoption opportunities based on customer impact, business value, and strategic importance.
Adoption & Growth Analytics
Establish clear adoption metrics and success criteria for strategic product initiatives.
Analyze customer journeys, funnels, cohorts, feature usage, and behavioral patterns to identify opportunities and friction points.
Partner with Data and Product teams to understand time-to-value, activation, feature penetration, engagement, retention, and churn.
Segment adoption by customer type, cohort, geography, product, and use case to uncover actionable insights.
Build executive-level visibility into product adoption performance and emerging risks.
Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence
Translate adoption insights into actionable product recommendations.
Partner with Product leaders to influence roadmaps based on customer behavior, adoption gaps, and business priorities.
Identify opportunities where onboarding, UX, education, packaging, cross-product journeys, or product capabilities need to change to improve adoption.
Develop business cases for high-impact adoption initiatives and help teams prioritize investments.
Cross-Functional Execution
Partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Revenue teams.
Drive cross-functional initiatives aimed at increasing adoption of strategic product capabilities.
Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, metrics, and accountability for adoption initiatives.
Ensure product launches go beyond shipping by defining how new capabilities will achieve meaningful customer adoption.
Customer & Market Insights
Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, pain points, and reasons for non-adoption.
Combine quantitative product data with qualitative customer insights to identify root causes.
Partner with customer-facing teams to establish systematic feedback loops into Product.
Benchmark adoption and customer experience against relevant SaaS and technology platforms.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:
Increase activation and adoption of strategic product capabilities.
Improve time-to-value for new and existing customers.
Increase feature penetration and depth of product usage.
Improve engagement and repeat usage of high-value workflows.
Reduce adoption-related friction and early customer drop-off.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
About the Role
We’re seeking a Executive Director of Data Engineering to lead the architecture, infrastructure, and engineering standards that power our global marketing intelligence capabilities. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Intelligence Officer, this leader will modernize our AI infrastructure, accelerate how we build and deliver, and set global data standards across every domain we touch — creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media data. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technologist and a strategic leader who can build best-in-class engineering practices at global scale while driving the move toward agile, automated, and AI-native data delivery.
What You’ll Do
AI Infrastructure & Engineering Modernization
Design and evolve scalable AI and data infrastructure that supports predictive, prescriptive, and generative use cases across the function.
Establish standards and tooling for accelerated delivery and faster coding — including AI-assisted development, reusable components, and automation that compresses time-to-value.
Evaluate and introduce new technologies that enable innovation across creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media data domains.
Mature our MLOps and deployment practices so models and data products move from prototype to production reliably and repeatably.
Data Standards, Taxonomies & Governance
Develop comprehensive, future-proof data taxonomies and data standards that bring consistency and interoperability across domains and regions.
Set and govern global data standards — architecture, quality, lineage, documentation, and metadata — that scale across the network and agency partners.
Embed data governance, privacy, and security by design, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and responsible AI practices.
Create a single, trusted foundation for data that improves accuracy, accessibility, and reuse across teams.
Delivery Excellence & AI Integration
Drive continuous progress toward agile, automated, and effective data delivery, embedding DevOps/DataOps practices and CI/CD across engineering workflows.
Define and uphold best-in-class standards for AI integration, from data pipelines through model deployment and monitoring.
Build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization, raising the bar on technical excellence, velocity, and reliability.
Partner with product, analytics, and agency teams to ensure infrastructure and standards translate into faster, higher-quality outcomes.
What You’ll Bring
20+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or platform engineering, including senior leadership of global or distributed engineering teams.
Deep expertise in modern data infrastructure, cloud platforms, and AI/ML engineering, with hands-on command of scalable pipeline and platform design.
Proven success establishing data taxonomies, standards, and governance frameworks across complex, multi-domain environments.
Experience modernizing engineering practices toward automation, agile delivery, and AI-assisted development.
Strong understanding of marketing and media data domains — creative, CX/site, CRM, audience, and media — ideally within automotive, broader industry, or agency/media agency contexts.
Track record of integrating AI responsibly and at scale, with fluency in MLOps, DataOps, and data governance.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills at the executive level.
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$155,000—$390,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Privacy, Product and Platform Security
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is looking for a Senior Director, Privacy, Product and Platform Security to lead the teams responsible for protecting the systems, products, services, and data that power the Roblox platform. This is an opportunity to define how security and privacy are engineered into one of the world’s largest and most ambitious platforms. You will work on problems that span product design, distributed systems, infrastructure, data, privacy, and emerging technology—helping protect the data and systems relied on by tens of millions of users and creators.
You will bring Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering together around a unified vision to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Roblox’s products, infrastructure, and data systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other business leaders to make security and privacy durable properties of how Roblox designs, builds, deploys, and operates.
Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will oversee a high-impact organization of security engineering leaders and senior individual contributors. You will operate as a peer to Infrastructure and Engineering leadership, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and well-executed engineering solutions.
You Will
Set the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Product Security, Platform Security, and Privacy Engineering.
Lead and grow a high-performing organization of managers and senior technical leaders, while building a culture of accountability, inclusion, and technical excellence.
Establish security and privacy architecture principles for Roblox products, services, production platforms, cloud environments, and data systems.
Raise the security bar across the software development lifecycle through security reviews, threat modeling, secure design, testing, vulnerability management, and risk-based remediation.
Drive the design and adoption of hardened, secure platforms at Roblox scale, partnering with Infrastructure Engineering on foundational security controls.
Advance Privacy Engineering by embedding privacy-by-design practices and scalable technical controls into product and platform architecture, data flows, and operating processes.
Translate regulatory and company privacy commitments into clear engineering requirements, measurable controls, and durable solutions.
Own cross-functional priorities, metrics, executive reporting, and delivery for product security, platform security, privacy engineering, and related risk-reduction programs.
You Have
15+ years of experience in security engineering, privacy engineering, infrastructure security, or a related technical field, including 8+ years leading and developing engineering or security organizations.
Deep technical expertise in at least one security or engineering discipline, with the breadth and judgment to lead across product, platform, infrastructure, cloud, data, and privacy domains.
A track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable security outcomes across large-scale products, platforms, or distributed systems.
Experience embedding security and privacy into the software development lifecycle through architecture, standards, tooling, automation, and risk-based prioritization.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment across modern production environments, including cloud, hybrid, distributed, containerized, and data-intensive systems.
A people-centered, results-oriented leadership style, with the ability to build high-performing teams, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate technical risk and tradeoffs clearly.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$457,970—$525,510 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Associate Director Information Technology
jobs.text:
Location:
Work from home (Pennsylvania)
Shift:
Days (United States of America)
Scheduled Weekly Hours:
40
Worker Type:
Regular
Exemption Status:
Yes
Job Summary:
Directs the activities of an Information Technology (IT) team assigned to support an organizational segment of the organization. Works with department, product line, or system leadership to develop Information Technology strategy. Conveys that strategy to staff and ensures it is fulfilled. Administratively responsible for assigned staff members. Oversees projects to ensure they are completed in a timely manner in accordance with established IT standards.
Job Duties:
Responsible for coordinating Information Technology support for assigned segment of the organization.
Strives to gain and maintain an understanding of the business policies and practices employed in the areas of responsibility.
Works with department, product line, or system leadership to develop and implement Information Technology strategy.
Conveys IT strategy to staff and ensures that plans are implemented in accordance with organizational need.
Ensures that staff members follow established IT project management guidelines to guarantee a successful implementation.
Responsible for vendor management, which includes but is not limited to, contract negotiations, invoice reconciliation, release updates, issues lists and new product evaluations.
Develops and administers IT budget for responsible area.
Practices fiscally sound budget management to ensure spending is held to allocated funds.
Responsible for the staff recruitment, development, retention, and disciplinary process.
Mentors staff in best practices for providing IT support and project management.
Develops and fosters the team approach to staff organization and interaction.
Formulates staff development plan to ensure members maintain highest level of technical, interpersonal and project management skills possible.
Attends all necessary management development courses so organizational policy is understood and effectively administered.
Ensures departmental and organizational policy changes are conveyed, understood and practiced by the staff.
Maintains individual work schedule and submits progress reports as requested by direct supervisor.
Supports IT departmental initiatives and ensures full cooperation of staff with other IT teams.
Maintains a high-level understanding of Information Technology in general and more in-depth knowledge of those facets particular to primary area of responsibility.
Establish and monitor operational KPIs, including productivity standards.
Work is typically performed in an office environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.
*Relevant experience may be a combination of related work experience and degree obtained (Associate’s Degree = 2 years; Bachelor’s Degree = 4 years).
Position Details:
Additional Requirements:
Understanding of enterprise data management ecosystems, including data warehousing, business-facing analytics delivery, and enterprise workload automation and scheduling.
Experience leading and managing an operations-focused team responsible for service delivery, operational excellence, and process improvement.
Education:
Bachelor's Degree- (Required), Master's Degree- (Preferred)
Experience:
Minimum of 8 years-Information Technology (Required), Minimum of 2 years-Managerial/Supervisory (Required)
Certification(s) and License(s):
Skills:
Critical Thinking, Interpersonal Communication, IT Project Planning And Organization, Leadership, Organizing, Problem Management
OUR PURPOSE & VALUES: Everything we do is about caring for our patients, our members, our students, our Geisinger family and our communities.
KINDNESS: We strive to treat everyone as we would hope to be treated ourselves.
EXCELLENCE: We treasure colleagues who humbly strive for excellence.
LEARNING: We share our knowledge with the best and brightest to better prepare the caregivers for tomorrow.
INNOVATION: We constantly seek new and better ways to care for our patients, our members, our community, and the nation.
SAFETY: We provide a safe environment for our patients and members and the Geisinger family.
We offer healthcare benefits for full time and part time positions from day one, including vision, dental and domestic partners. Perhaps just as important, we encourage an atmosphere of collaboration, cooperation and collegiality.
Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Business Banking
jobs.text:
In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure.
A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market.
Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Own the P&L, strategy, and product offering: accounts, user experience, payments, new rails, and agents
Build AI - and data-driven user experiences at scale better than the alternatives
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set an operating cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Deepen the core account and take new products 0-1 to scale: optimize what businesses run on, and invest in new rails, capabilities, and agents so customers can focus on building their companies
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the banking ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, sales, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A leader with great product chops, commercial instinct to grow the business, and discipline to run it safely
A high bar for craft – leading a creative, customer-centered, data-driven and experimentation-oriented approach
Enthusiasm for building AI- and agent-powered products that drive spectacular customer experiences
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, risk, compliance, finance, and partners
10+ years' experience, ideally in banking, payments, platforms, or financial products
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Command of how business banking works: account opening and KYB, deposits and liquidity, payment rails (ACH, wire, check, international, FedNow, RTP)
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 financial products, ideally in fintech or another high-growth environment, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Sound judgment in a regulated, risk-sensitive environment: balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting
Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. Documentation practices

Drive adoption of automated code quality tools and best practices
Ensure consistency across Backend, Frontend, and Mobile teams

Ensure fully automated build, test, and deployment processes
Drive DevOps best practices, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Environment and configuration management

jobs.title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
jobs.text:
In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.
Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.
Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, and partners
Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment
Sound judgment in a regulated environment: you balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting
