jobs.title: Head of Developer Relations, SEA and OCE
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As the Head of Developer Relations you will own the strategy, execution, and outcomes for Roblox developer growth strategies of Southeast Asia (SEA). You will work directly with publishers, developers, emerging studios, and industry partners across SEA to drive adoption, accelerate development, and build long-term ecosystem relationships.
You will serve as a strategic partner to developers, represent Roblox at industry events, and collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Creator, and International teams to scale Roblox as a destination for high-quality, game development.
You Will:
Proactively set team goals, monitor progress and conversation trends with key partners.
Partner with data scientists, product, engineering and leaders across the company.
Become the voice of your partners, identifying and quantifying the critical action items that will impact our product growth in the region.
Communicate risk factors of the region and make difficult decisions.
Actively share reports to reflect the impact of your work with the company.
Requirements:
Residency in Singapore or willing to relocate.
10+ years of experience in technical project management.
Able to proactively communicate with all key stakeholders.
Experience with launching a technical product in international markets.
Experience with using Roblox Studio or another game development engine. (eg. Unity or Unreal)
A researcher with a unique skill set to quickly ramp up and understand your target audience needs.
Passionate, full of positive energy, and a role model to others.
Driven by teamwork, naturally encourages people to work together.
Able to lead by example, building a clear high-level strategy and holding yourself and others accountable to the long-term company vision.
Data and feedback driven, your decisions are inspired by the product usage, the users’ qualitative insights, and your expertise.
Communication focused with excellent verbal and written skills.
Self-Directed with the ability to establish your work and processes.
Advance Educational degree or equivalent practical experience
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why United Kingdom
The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based. Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in the UK.
About The Role
Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.
The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:
Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
Own the developer experience end-to-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.
Who You Are
Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
Deep knowledge of API-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
Strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi-currency payment platform is a strong plus.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What To Expect In The Hiring Process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
A Panel interview session with two of our VPs of Engineering
A Technical Assessment with our Group CTO / Co-founder
A Behavioral and technical interview with our Group CEO / Founder
Technical Workshop with our Group CTO / Co-founder
Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with
Java (latest versions)
Spring and Spring Boot
Docker and Kubernetes
PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elastic search
Microservices architecture on AWS
What we can offer you
Own the payments infrastructure that thousands of businesses and developers build on, at a company processing hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually.
Work in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment at the core of how money moves in high-growth markets.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.text:
About OLX
OLX is a global leader in facilitating trade. It builds leading marketplace ecosystems enabled by tech, powered by trust, and loved by customers.
Serving tens of millions of people every month around the world, OLX helps people buy and sell cars, find housing, get jobs, buy and sell household goods, and much more. Its well-loved consumer brands (including OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more) offer safe, smart, and convenient online trading platforms and services for its customers.
OLX is powered by global teams, united in a common purpose to build a more sustainable world through trade. For more information, visit .
OLX is backed by Prosus, a global consumer internet group and one of the largest technology investors in the world. Prosus has a primary listing on Euronext Amsterdam (AEX:PRX) and a secondary listing on the JSE Limited (XJSE:PRX), and is majority-owned by Naspers. For more information on Prosus and its companies and investments, please visit .
The Opportunity
OLX is looking for an experienced and hands-on Product Director to lead product function for our core horizontal marketplace, spanning household goods, electronics, and other general merchandise categories. This is a global role with responsibility for the strategy and execution of Horizontal across a focused set of European markets. You'll be a key voice shaping how this business grows within the broader OLX portfolio.
You'll lead a product organization of around 15 people, working closely with engineering, design, and commercial leadership to define and deliver a product roadmap that drives growth, engagement, and monetization for both consumers and sellers on the platform.
This role reports to Michael Bullion, Chief Product Officer.
What You'll Do
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Horizontal, in partnership with the CPO and broader leadership team.
Drive customer-centric product innovation with a focus on growth, retention, and monetization across the buyer and seller journeys.
Lead AI transformation for the horizontal domain
Lead the incubation, development & transition to a fully agentic horizontal marketplace.
Lead a product organization of around 15 people, with an emphasis on strong product management fundamentals — experimentation, documentation, and upstream opportunity discovery.
Work closely with engineering and commercial teams across markets to align product development with business priorities.
Identify and execute strategic opportunities, including creative monetization levers, cross-market improvements, and long-term category positioning.
Establish and scale best practices in product thinking and execution across your teams.
Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product leaders.
Partner with senior stakeholders across finance, commercial, and other functions to build consensus around strategy and priorities.
Act as a thought partner and sparring peer to other product and business leaders in shaping the future of OLX.
What We're Looking For
Proven experience leading product teams in online B2C/B2B2C environments, ideally in marketplaces, e-commerce, or classifieds. Experience navigating the dynamics of two-sided marketplaces (consumer buyers and sellers).
Strong hands-on product management background—not just a strategic leader, but someone who has built products and worked closely with engineers and commercial stakeholders.
Several years of experience hiring, growing, and directly managing Product Managers at all stages of their careers, ideally leading teams of a similar size (~15 people).
Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.
Strategic thinker, able to balance long-term vision with short- and medium-term goals.
Experience in both 0->1 and scaling phases of product development.
Proven track record of jumping between domains and sectors. Ability to learn fast.
Experience in developing and managing AI-based products.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX
At OLX, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
Originally posted on Himalayas

For more information on Prosus and its companies and investments, please visit .
The Opportunity

OLX is looking for an experienced and hands-on Product Director to lead product function for our core horizontal marketplace, spanning household goods, electronics, and other general merchandise categories. This is a global role with responsibility for the strategy and execution of Horizontal across a focused set of European markets. You'll be a key voice shaping how this business grows within the broader OLX portfolio.

You'll lead a product organization of around 15 people, working closely with engineering, design, and commercial leadership to define and deliver a product roadmap that drives growth, engagement, and monetization for both consumers and sellers on the platform.
This role reports to Michael Bullion, Chief Product Officer.
What You'll Do
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Horizontal, in partnership with the CPO and broader leadership team.
Drive customer-centric product innovation with a focus on growth, retention, and monetization across the buyer and seller journeys.
Lead AI transformation for the horizontal domain
Lead the incubation, development & transition to a fully agentic horizontal marketplace.
Lead a product organization of around 15 people, with an emphasis on strong product management fundamentals — experimentation, documentation, and upstream opportunity discovery.
Work closely with engineering and commercial teams across markets to align product development with business priorities.
Identify and execute strategic opportunities, including creative monetization levers, cross-market improvements, and long-term category positioning.
Establish and scale best practices in product thinking and execution across your teams.
Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product leaders.
Partner with senior stakeholders across finance, commercial, and other functions to build consensus around strategy and priorities.
Act as a thought partner and sparring peer to other product and business leaders in shaping the future of OLX.
What We're Looking For

Proven experience leading product teams in online B2C/B2B2C environments, ideally in marketplaces, e-commerce, or classifieds. Experience navigating the dynamics of two-sided marketplaces (consumer buyers and sellers).
Strong hands-on product management background—not just a strategic leader, but someone who has built products and worked closely with engineers and commercial stakeholders.
Several years of experience hiring, growing, and directly managing Product Managers at all stages of their careers, ideally leading teams of a similar size (~15 people).
Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.
Strategic thinker, able to balance long-term vision with short- and medium-term goals.
Experience in both 0->1 and scaling phases of product development.
Proven track record of jumping between domains and sectors. Ability to learn fast.
Experience in developing and managing AI-based products.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

At OLX, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.

jobs.title: SVP, AI & Data
jobs.text:
SVP, AI & Data
Remote Opportunity
About Reveleer
Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.
About the role
Reveleer is hiring an SVP, AI & Data to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of the AI, machine learning, and data systems that power risk adjustment and quality programs across Medicare Advantage and value-based care. The role owns the platform that extracts ICD and HEDIS® information from medical charts, the data warehouse and business intelligence layers that surface that work, and the data science research that advances accuracy over time.
This is a working executive role. The SVP, AI & Data sets technical direction and architecture, partners with engineering and product leadership on delivery, and stays close enough to the systems to make sound build decisions — while giving team leaders the autonomy to own their domains. The position leads seven teams totaling roughly 27 engineers, data scientists, and analysts through their respective leaders.
What you will own
AI and machine learning for chart intelligence
Direct the engineering teams that extract medical codes and quality data from charts: retrospective risk extraction built on Textract OCR, Comprehend Medical, and Gemini; prospective risk extraction that runs PDF and CCDA charts through Gemini and a custom rules engine to surface candidate ICD codes; and quality and HEDIS extraction that applies large language models to chart content.
Own the internal API that returns extraction results to downstream engineering teams, including its contracts, accuracy, and reliability.
Guide the data science research program — a team including two PhDs and an MD — as it advances from model-based ICD extraction to a retrieval-augmented generation system on Gemini, and shepherd that research into production alongside the retrospective risk team.
Data warehouse and business intelligence
Set the architecture for the data warehouse on Azure Synapse and Microsoft Fabric, including ingestion from AWS SQL source databases.
Direct the business intelligence function that builds reporting in Looker on top of warehouse data, with quality assurance built into the delivery process.
Risk analytics
Oversee risk analytics expertise in determining Medicare Advantage value from coded medical charts, supporting a substantial share of the IVA business.
Core responsibilities
Technical strategy and architecture. Define the architecture for the AI, data, and analytics platform end to end, and make the build-versus-buy and model-selection decisions that shape it.
Innovation direction. Provide the guiding voice on innovation across all teams, evaluating new approaches in extraction, retrieval, and clinical AI while preserving each team’s autonomy to decide how to execute.
Delivery and reliability. Hold the teams accountable for accuracy, throughput, and uptime of the extraction of APIs and the data and reporting layers that depend on them.
Leadership and org development. Lead seven team leaders, grow technical talent, and redeploy team capacity toward higher-value clinical and research work as automation matures.
Cross-functional partnership. Work with product, engineering, and clinical leadership to align the AI and data roadmap with commercial and regulatory priorities.
Governance and compliance. Establish data governance, model evaluation, and privacy practices appropriate to protected health information and CMS-regulated programs.
What we are looking for
Required
A track record of leading AI and data organizations, with enough technical depth to evaluate architecture, model-selection, and build-versus-buy decisions made by the teams reporting in. Personally, building production systems is not required.
Deep experience with applied machine learning and large language models in production, including modern patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, OCR and document understanding, and clinical natural language processing.
Experience leading data warehouse and business intelligence functions, with working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable) and BI tools such as Looker.
Demonstrated leadership of multiple technical teams and their leaders, with a style that sets direction and architecture while granting autonomy on execution.
Working fluency in healthcare risk adjustment, medical coding (ICD), and quality measurement (HEDIS®), or the ability to reach it quickly.
Preferred
Direct experience with Medicare Advantage risk adjustment, IVA, or RADV audit workflows.
Familiarity with cloud AI services across providers, including Google Gemini, AWS Textract, and AWS Comprehend Medical.
Advanced degree in computer science, data science, biostatistics, or a clinical field, or equivalent applied experience.
How success is measured
Accuracy and coverage of code and quality extraction across retrospective, prospective, and HEDIS® workflows.
Reliability and adoption of the internal results API by downstream engineering teams.
Timeliness and trustworthiness of warehouse data and the reporting built on it.
Movement of data science research into production, measured by accuracy gains realized in live extraction.
Growth, retention, and autonomy of the team leaders and their teams.
WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE:
• Competitive salary
• Medical, Dental and Vision benefits
• 401k with Employer Match
• Generous PTO plan
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Reveleer E-Verifies all new hires.
Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.
Salary: $305,000 – $355,000 / year

jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About the Role
As an Associate Director, Analytics, you will lead complex analytics and data science engagements, bringing together strong quantitative expertise, strategic thinking, and client leadership.
This role requires a strong foundation in data science and advanced analytics. You should be comfortable working with sophisticated analytical methodologies, evaluating data science approaches and outputs, and translating complex quantitative findings into clear business recommendations.
At the Associate Director level, you will also lead teams and workstreams, influence senior stakeholders, and help shape the analytical approach to complex client challenges. You may not be coding or building models every day, but you should have sufficient data science depth to credibly guide the work and challenge the methodology.
Responsibilities
Data Science & Advanced Analytics
Lead advanced analytics and data science work across complex client engagements. Apply and guide approaches such as statistical modeling, predictive analytics, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, machine learning, or other advanced quantitative methodologies as appropriate to the business problem.
Evaluate analytical approaches and outputs, identify limitations and opportunities, and ensure that methodologies are rigorous, actionable, and connected to client objectives.
Complex Program & Engagement Leadership
Lead complex analytics projects or programs end to end across one or more accounts—shaping the analytical approach, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and owning outcomes at a senior level.
Strategic Analytics & Client Advisory
Translate sophisticated analysis and data science outputs into clear business implications and recommendations. Connect analytical findings to the client's broader marketing and business agenda.
Serve as a senior analytics partner to clients and internal stakeholders, helping frame ambiguous business questions into analytical problems that can be solved with data.
Team & Technical Leadership
Lead and develop analytics and data science talent, set expectations for analytical quality, and provide guidance on methodologies and approaches across multiple workstreams.
Partner effectively with data scientists, analysts, media teams, strategists, engineers, and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions.
Early Account Economics
Take first-line accountability for the economics of your workstreams—including utilization, scope discipline, and margin within your remit—and partner with account leadership on planning and resourcing.
Client Advisory & Growth
Build credible senior client relationships and identify opportunities where analytics, data science, measurement, or AI capabilities can address additional client needs.
AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation
Identify qualified AI use cases and opportunities to incorporate AI-enabled approaches into analytics and measurement. Help evaluate where emerging technologies can create measurable value rather than applying AI for its own sake.
About You
The Essentials
7+ years of experience in analytics, data science, quantitative consulting, measurement, or a related field across an agency, consultancy, holding company, technology company, or sophisticated in-house environment
Demonstrated data science experience is required, with a strong understanding of advanced quantitative methodologies such as statistical modeling, predictive analytics, experimentation, machine learning, forecasting, segmentation, or related approaches
Experience leading complex analytics or data science projects from business problem definition through analysis, interpretation, and recommendation
Ability to evaluate and guide sophisticated analytical work, including methodology, assumptions, limitations, and business implications
Ability to translate complex quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical and senior audiences
Experience partnering with or leading data scientists, analysts, and other technical specialists
Experience leading and developing teams
Demonstrated influence across functions, client teams, or portfolios
Credible senior client relationships and the ability to advise, not just deliver
Emerging account-economics literacy, including utilization, scope, and margin within a remit
Strong Plus
Hands-on experience with programming and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, or similar
Experience with experimentation, causal inference, marketing measurement, incrementality, attribution, or other advanced measurement approaches
Experience applying machine learning or predictive modeling to marketing or business problems
Experience integrating GenAI or agentic platforms with measurable outcomes
Quantified contribution to account growth or scope expansion
Recognized domain authority through frameworks, methodologies, or thought leadership
Experience developing reusable analytical methodologies, tools, or accelerators
Senior platform partnership experience with Google, Meta, Adobe, Amazon, or similar
Cross-domain experience across more than one IMA practice area

About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Remote-based in the US
Overview
GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.
Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.
GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.
Job Summary
GoodPower is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own our end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.
Key Responsibilities
Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance
Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for GoodPower’s core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture
Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.
Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance
Lead organization-wide information security initiatives across all corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit comprehensive enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries) across internal architectures in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Cross-Functional Alignment & Platform Boundaries
Partner closely with other leadership to turn high-level concepts and early-stage prototypes into operational reality. Evaluate alpha projects and PoCs built across departments and lead the execution to either seamlessly integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, highly scalable services.
Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.
Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight
Serve as the direct manager for the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), setting shared goals and ensuring alignment between product/engineering/data strategy and enterprise technology, infrastructure, and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Team Leadership & Operational Culture
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing, service-oriented IT and security team tailored to GoodPower's mission and growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for employees.
Qualifications
12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including as a Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or CTO.
Demonstrated experience running enterprise IT and IS stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, encompassing SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executives, and Board members.
Proven track record of building and leading technical staff across a wide range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through a period of organizational growth.
This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.
Compensation, Benefits, and Perks
Annual salary range: $220,000-$230,000, commensurate with experience
Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
2 weeks of US office closure
10 days of paid sick leave annually.
403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
8 weeks of paid parental leave
GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

We help financial and professional services firms work smarter, faster, and with less risk. We’re looking for people who want more than just a role. This is an opportunity to build, influence, and lead.

We are trusted by leading UK accountancy and insurance firms, and our work is driven by quality, innovation, and measurable outcomes.
We are particularly interested in individuals with experience in tax technology, tax workflow automation, or digital tax transformation, who can bring a strong understanding of how technology can improve compliance, efficiency, and client service.

The role sits across technology, delivery, and stakeholder management, with a focus on scaling, automation, and continuous improvement, making it particularly well suited to candidates who have led or supported tax technology initiatives within professional services firms.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Connected Experience
jobs.text:
Head of Product, Connected Experience
About Safeguard Global: We enable global expansion without the risk.
Safeguard Global has been at the forefront of global workforce enablement since we pioneered centralised global payments in 2008 and launched the employer of record (EOR) category globally in 2010. And we haven't stopped there.
Today, with our 500+ in-country HR experts, cutting-edge technology, and comprehensive solutions, we've helped over 2,000 organisations hire, recruit, pay, and manage employees in 170+ countries.
Because we created this category, we've learned that successful global expansion isn't driven by technology alone. It requires deep global expertise. We call this the marriage of expert and technology, human when it matters.
This means we have the people and the technology to ensure 100% compliance with local, regional, national, and international laws. Together, this ethos and our solutions portfolio allow businesses to scale up or down wherever, however, and whenever they want to expand, without the risk.
Overview of the role
We're looking for a Head of Product, Connected Experience to own the experiences shared across every application: things like home, user access, and knowledge, together with the integrations that connect us to the outside world. What makes them shared is that every application touches or relies on them.
The role is accountable for the experience, delivery, and outcome achievement across those shared surfaces, and for the standard other product teams build to wherever their work touches them, even though most of those teams sit outside your direct reporting line. You'll translate that target experience, combined with the product strategies set by the Directors of Product into a prioritised order of work; leading the product managers who deliver it and ensuring we deliver on business and customer experience objectives.
Several of our biggest growth opportunities for 2027 sit in this area.
What you will be responsible for
Shared surfaces and standards
Own the experience across the shared surfaces and services that sit between applications
Own the governance of shared components with the Lead Designer, so that changes to capability every team depends on are made deliberately and once
Own how external systems connect to the platform, through integrations
Own regulatory and compliance obligations as product requirements within your area, particularly where integrations, white labelling, and access to client data are concerned, working with legal and the in-country teams so that they are designed in rather than retrofitted
Prioritisation and roadmap
Translate the platform strategy and commercial priorities into a prioritised order of work for your area
Feed that prioritisation into the single prioritised roadmap owned by the SVP, Product
Recommend what is built, what is deferred, and what is retired within your area, and secure agreement with the SVP, Product and the Directors of Product
Build the case for significant investment, including the value expected, the payback, and the trade-off against the alternatives
Delivery
Hold accountability for delivery against commitment, on time and to the quality bar set in the definition of done
Work hand in hand with engineering and design leadership, from the earliest shaping of an idea through to release, so that trade-offs between client need, technical feasibility, and cost are made together
Work with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal so that what we build is understood, sellable, supportable, and compliant on the day it launches
Sequence work that other teams depend on so that shared capability lands ahead of the work requiring it
Identify conflicts between applications early, while there is still time to resolve them
Customer insight and product performance
Build the relationships, with clients, integration partners, and internal teams, that sustain a continuous understanding of customer and internal pain points, and of the opportunities they point to
Ground product decisions in client insight, usage data, and market evidence
Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams
Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it
Identify opportunities to cross-sell across the platform, drawing on usage and adoption data, and work with sales to act on them
Act as the product expert in senior client, prospect, and partner conversations, and represent the platform externally where it helps us win and keep clients
Team leadership
Line manage the product managers within your area
Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early
Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability
Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing
What will give you an advantage
Eight or more years in product
A proven track record of driving growth and commercial outcomes from product teams, including through product led growth
Proven experience owning platform, integration, or API products in B2B SaaS, with external developers or partners as users
A record of setting and holding shared standards across teams outside your reporting line, whether a design system, a component library, or an integration pattern
Technical enough to hold your own in a conversation on integrations, data flows, and data products, without needing to be an engineer yourself
Experience of building products in a regulated environment, where compliance shapes what can be built
At least five years leading people, including globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones
Primary performance metrics
Delivery:commitments delivered on time and to quality
Business impact:value delivered against the outcomes committed at the point of investment
Experience:platform NPS
Adoption:how widely the shared surfaces are used across the platform
Baselines and annual targets are set with the SVP, Product at the start of each financial year.
Competencies
Strategic thinking:sets a direction for the shared platform that connects client need, market direction, and commercial goals
Systems thinking:designs each service around what matters most to the customer, and focuses only on the work that delivers value
Technical fluency:holds a credible conversation with engineering leadership on integration patterns, data, and access
Delivery leadership:maintains a predictability and quality bar across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
Communication:strong written and verbal communicator at all levels of the organisation, from SLT to team
People development:understands what each individual needs and coaches them to grow
Influencing:gets other product teams to adopt standards for the shared surfaces, without formal authority over how they run their own area
Commercial judgement:determines what is worth building next, and evidences the case
Key personal attributes
Grit and determination:moves work forward despite obstacles, and does not give up easily
Curiosity:actively seeks out different points of view, customer needs, and the problems worth solving
A leader and a doer:operates strategically while staying close to the detail
Warm, open, honest, and fun to work with
We are hiring this position across multiple countries; compensation varies by hiring location. For target markets located within the European Union (EU), base salaries start from (Gross):
Spain: €100,000.00
Portugal: €95,000.00
Who we are and what we do:
Safeguard Global is…Global! We help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. ✈️
Our Global Benefits
👨‍💻 Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include school runs and gym breaks in your schedule all while maintaining a high standard of work.
🧑‍🍼 Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.
🎁 2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.
🏆 Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.
💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
🏢 Coworking Space: Need to meet with a client, utilize admin services or just get out of the house? We’ve got you covered with flexible workspace options based on location.
Why become a Guardian:
✈️ International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
⭐ Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.
Next Steps:
To express your interest, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.
Welcome to the Future of Work!
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

jobs.title: Director Of Engineering - Platform Services
jobs.text:
About Truveta
Truveta is the world’s first health provider-led data platform, with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care.
Achieving this vision requires a talented and diverse team with expertise across healthcare, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for people who are motivated by purposeful work and committed to building technology that can improve healthcare outcomes.
This position is based in Hyderabad, India.
Who We Need
Truveta is expanding its engineering presence in India to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges at global scale. We are seeking a collaborative and experienced engineering leader who can operate effectively across ambiguity, scale, and evolving requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. You should be comfortable balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management and working with distributed teams across India and the United States.
If you are motivated by purposeful work, enjoy building teams and platforms from the ground up, and want to shape how data, AI, and engineering systems are powered internally, Truveta may be the right fit for you.
This Opportunity
We are seeking a Director Of Engineering (POD Lead) to lead the Platform Services team in India.
The Platform Services team will build, manage, and operate the infrastructure that supports engineering teams across India and globally. The team will also own critical backend and platform services, including authentication, authorization, customer and consumer identity and access management, CI/CD, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, developer productivity tools, observability, and shared engineering services.
These services form the backbone of Truveta’s engineering platform and have dependencies across multiple Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Product, and Security teams.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role with people-management responsibilities. You will be accountable for technical direction, delivery excellence, platform reliability, and team growth. You will work closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams in India and the United States.
What You’ll Do
Technical and Platform Leadership
Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Platform Services and internal engineering platforms.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure and backend services.
Guide architecture decisions across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, developer tooling, and shared services.
Build and operate platforms that support engineering, data, machine learning, annotation, and internal workflow requirements.
Lead the development and management of Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud-native services.
Build and improve authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control services.
Drive the development of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code, and developer self-service capabilities.
Establish engineering standards for system design, API development, testing, code quality, observability, and operational readiness.
Improve platform availability, scalability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency.
Provide hands-on technical guidance through design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, production-readiness reviews, and incident responses.
Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term platform scalability, maintainability, and technical health.
Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, and improve engineering productivity.
Product and Delivery Leadership
Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and define priorities.
Translate business and engineering needs into clear technical strategies, milestones, and delivery plans.
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple platform initiatives.
Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively address execution risks.
Define and track success metrics related to platform adoption, reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to stakeholders and senior leadership.
POD and People Leadership
Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team in India.
Provide technical direction, coaching, and support to engineers at different career levels.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Establish effective processes for planning, execution, prioritization, and retrospective learning.
Encourage engineers to take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development through production operations.
Create an inclusive environment where team members can contribute, learn, and grow.
Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration
Work closely with engineering teams across India and the United States to develop shared platforms and services.
Partner effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders across time zones.
Represent the India Platform Services team in architecture, planning, and organizational forums.
Serve as a key technical voice in discussions about platform strategy, engineering effectiveness, and future growth.
Build strong relationships with internal customers and ensure that platform services meet the needs of the broader organization.
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years of experience in technical leadership, engineering management, or people management.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for shared platforms, infrastructure, backend services, or developer tooling.
Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and production-grade backend services.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies.
Strong understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, service discovery, and infrastructure operations.
Experience building engineering infrastructure, internal platforms, workflow-heavy systems, or developer productivity tools.
Experience with authentication, authorization, identity management, or security-focused backend services.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Go, Python, or similar.
Experience with modern API architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, and service integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence.
Familiarity with open-source technologies and the ability to evaluate and adopt open-source solutions.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices and Agile delivery methods.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, clinical data, or other highly regulated domains.
Experience building platforms that support data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or annotation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or other major cloud platforms.
Experience with identity and access management technologies and protocols such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
Experience with service mesh, API gateways, secrets management, policy enforcement, and zero-trust security models.
Experience defining service-level objectives, reliability standards, and platform maturity models.
Experience leading teams through significant organizational or platform growth.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, cost management, and optimization.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, EV/BESS
jobs.text:
About Us
Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.
Role Summary
The Director of Engineering leads Highland's engineering and design team — drafting, project engineering, and utility interconnection — that supports a fast-moving portfolio of EV charging, battery energy storage (BESS), and edge compute sites from qualified sites through construction-ready.
This leader owns the engineering standards, the design package content and quality gates, and the throughput of the entire function, and partners with Project Development to deliver build-ready sites at portfolio scale and on an aggressive timeline.
Reporting to the Vice President, Development & Construction, the Director builds and leads a team of internal and external engineering resources. The Director serves as Highland's senior technical authority on utility and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, owns the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget, and builds the standards, playbooks, and tooling that make design faster, more repeatable, and more cost-effective.
This position is remote with an expectation of approximately 10-15% travel.
Responsibilities Overview:
Lead and scale Highland's project engineering function — drafting, design engineering, and utility interconnection — with end-to-end accountability for taking a large portfolio of EV charging, BESS, and edge compute sites from qualified site to permit-ready and construction-ready.
Own the engineering function's throughput and quality: define the design package content and the internal approval gates for every stage — conceptual, 30%, Issued-for-Permit (IFP), and Issued for Construction (IFC) — and keep packages moving on an aggressive, portfolio-wide timeline.
Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of internal engineering resources
Own Highland's external engineering-partner strategy — select, contract, scale, and manage the performance of engineering design and interconnection consultants so that internal and external capacity flex with portfolio volume.
Set and enforce Highland's engineering, CAD, and design specifications and standards, and own the repositories of utility and AHJ requirements that make design compliant, consistent, and repeatable across the portfolio.
Serve as Highland's senior technical authority on utility interconnection and AHJ permitting across EV charging, BESS, and edge compute; resolve the most complex technical and jurisdictional issues and represent Highland's engineering position externally.
Own the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget — sequence and resource design, interconnection, and permitting milestones so each site is build-ready when construction needs it, and contribute to Highland's repeatable unit-cost installation model.
Partner cross-functionally with Development, Execution, Origination, Procurement, and Fleet Operations to align engineering with portfolio priorities and continuously improve the site-to-energized process.
Drive continuous improvement through tooling and process automation (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, template- and data-driven design) to increase design velocity and improve unit economics as the portfolio scales.
Provide engineering leadership on technical due diligence, estimating, and risk for new opportunities, supporting Origination and Development on feasibility, buildability, and cost.
Qualifications:
Required
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline, or 12+ years of directly related professional experience.
10+ years of progressive engineering experience in EV charging, renewable energy, power/electrical infrastructure, or utility-scale development, including design management from concept through construction.
5+ years leading engineering teams, including managing managers and building or scaling a design organization.
Demonstrated ownership of engineering standards, design package content, and QA/QC across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
Proven experience selecting, contracting, and managing external engineering consultants at scale.
Deep working knowledge of utility interconnection, new electrical service, and AHJ permitting requirements.
Familiarity with interconnection standards and processes (e.g., IEEE 1547, utility tariffs, and interconnection rules).
Expertise with CAD-based design delivery (AutoCAD) and design/review tooling (Procore, Bluebeam).
Preferred
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Experience delivering EV charging infrastructure, BESS, and/or edge compute / data-center power projects.
Experience building repeatable, unit-cost-driven design programs in a high-growth environment.
Master's degree in engineering or an MBA.
What You Can Expect from Highland:
Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus program
A supportive, highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward-thinking colleagues
Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees & their dependents
Generous Paid Time Off
401(k) program and company match
Highland Electric Fleets provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Highland Electric Fleets complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
We're hiring a VP of Engineering to take full ownership of one of our core engineering domains. You'll report to our CTO and own your domain outright, including strategy, architecture, delivery, and the team. This is a hands-on leadership role.
Responsibilities
Take full technical and delivery ownership of a core area of the business, which could span AI, trading, retail, or another part of the platform
Architect and build the core systems in your domain, from real-time generation and demand modelling through to high-volume consumption pipelines and the customer-facing app
Build and lead the engineering team in your domain, including hiring, structure, and standards
Set technical direction alongside the CTO and the wider leadership team
Ship alongside your team on the hardest problems

jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Data Management
jobs.text:
At Kailera, we are bold, authentic and committed to our mission of developing therapies that give people the power to transform their lives and elevate their overall health. Rooted in an entrepreneurial spirit and a team-oriented culture, we are working together to advance Kailera’s mission to advance novel therapies for obesity and related conditions.
We are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes collaboration, integrity, and excellence. As we expand, we seek the most talented individuals with diverse backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, and experiences to join our team.
What You’ll Do:
We are seeking an experienced Data Management leader to join us as the Senior Director, Data Management. Reporting to VP, head of Biometrics, this role will define and execute the global clinical data management strategy, scale the data infrastructure, and oversee end-to-end data integrity across all phases of clinical development. As a strategic and operational leader, this individual will drive data quality, standardize processes, and ensure inspection readiness.
Responsibilities:
Actively plan and manage full-lifecycle clinical data quality and integrity across all trials (including eCRF builds, edit checks, external data integrations, reconciliations, data cleaning, database locks, and submission readiness).
Build and scale a high-performing Data Management organization; drive departmental performance, resource allocation, and talent development to maintain a resilient, growth-oriented team.
Drive strict compliance with global regulatory standards and internal SOPs while supporting regulatory audits and maintaining inspection readiness.
Cultivate strong cross-functional partnerships and represent Data Management in key cross-functional forums and enterprise initiatives.
Manage CRO relationships to ensure timely, high-quality deliverables, establishing robust quality metrics and governance frameworks.
Required Qualifications:
10+ years of clinical data management experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including 5+ years in a people-management role.
Experience with large clinical trial data sets
Proven track record of providing strategic data management leadership across late-stage development programs, ensuring data integrity, data quality, and inspection readiness.
Proven track record of leading Data Management activities through successful global health authority filings (NDA, BLA, or MAA) and health authority interactions. .
Expert knowledge of clinical trial data management, CDASH standards, database lock execution, external data reconciliation (eCOA, central labs, PK, etc.), inspection readiness, and strict adherence to regulatory guidelines (e.g., ICH, GCP) and internal SOPs.
Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing teams while driving a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.
Deep expertise in global CRO oversight, vendor management, and strategic outsourcing models to ensure high-quality deliverables, timeline adherence, and cost control.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in cardiometabolic disease areas preferred
Education:
Advanced degree (Master) in Life Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
Salary Range
$241,000—$295,000 USD
For Full Time Roles: This range represents the company’s good-faith estimate of the salary at the time of posting. Actual pay may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, and internal equity. We also offer comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a year-end shutdown. Enjoy a monthly wellness stipend, generous 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement, commuter benefits, disability and life insurance, plus annual bonus opportunities and equity grants—because your well-being and future matter to us.
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY INFORMATION:
Kailera Therapeutics, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, creed, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age (40 and over), sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, domestic victim status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.
E-Verify:
Kailera Therapeutics, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.
