jobs.title: Product Director, Consumer Channels
jobs.text:
Does this position interest you? You should apply –even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.
A Brief Overview
Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.
We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.
What you will do
Lead the consumer product portfolio
• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards
Education Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience Required
Experience Qualifications
7-9 years of product management or digital product experience, including significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products at scale. Required
Experience leading and developing product managers, with a track record of raising product judgment and team performance. Required
Experience owning digital products from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. Required
Skills and Abilities
REQUIRED
Demonstrated success improving high-intent consumer journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service.
Strong analytical fluency and hands-on experience using digital analytics platforms such as Quantum Metric, Heap, Amplitude, FullStory, Mixpanel, or similar.
Demonstrated fluency using AI across product strategy, discovery, research synthesis, analysis, prototyping, experimentation, and optimization.
Experience using AI-native tools to investigate customer behavior, product performance, and emerging opportunities.
Strong experience with experimentation, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and evidence-based product decision making.
Ability to connect customer needs, behavioral signals, business strategy, and technology capabilities into clear product direction and investment priorities.
Experience working in continuous discovery and delivery environments where learning actively shapes the roadmap.
Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to create clarity in complex, ambiguous product environments.
TARGET EXPERIENCE
We are looking for a product leader who has led consumer digital experiences where customer behavior and business performance are tightly connected.
You have owned high-intent journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service and can show how product decisions changed conversion, revenue, satisfaction, or customer effort.
You have worked in environments where pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial decisions are part of the product experience, not separate from it.
You also know what strong product practice looks like. You have worked with dedicated cross-functional teams, continuous discovery, instrumented products, experimentation, and outcome-based goals, and you have helped raise the maturity of the product organization around you.
Relevant experience may come from marketplaces, on-demand services, travel and hospitality, omnichannel retail, home services, financial services, modern automotive experiences, or other businesses where digital demand connects to real-world service delivery.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience shipping AI-enabled, conversational, agentic, predictive, or personalized product capabilities.
Experience leading products that span both customer-facing and employee-facing digital experiences.
Experience with behavioral analytics, voice of customer, journey analysis, service design, and customer research methods.
Familiarity with APIs, data products, design systems, experimentation platforms, and the technical foundations of modern digital products.
Experience with products where digital conversion connects directly to operational capacity or service fulfillment.
CORE CAPABILITIES
Product Strategy. Turns customer, business, and technology signals into clear product choices, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Consumer Journey Leadership. Understands the end-to-end journey and identifies where product can materially improve customer behavior, confidence, and outcomes.
Growth and Business Acumen. Connects product decisions to conversion, revenue, margin, satisfaction, and operational performance.
Opportunity Identification. Uses customer behavior, evidence, and business context to identify and prioritize high-value opportunities.
People Leadership. Builds strong product managers and raises the quality of judgment, execution, and product practice across the team.
AI-Enabled Product Leadership. Uses AI directly to improve how the team learns and to identify where intelligent capabilities can create customer and business value.
Experimentation and Learning. Uses analytics, testing, research, and feedback loops to improve decisions and product performance continuously.
Cross-Functional Leadership. Aligns Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Pricing, Operations, and other partners around shared outcomes.
Execution Discipline. Turns strategy into sustained product progress while managing priorities, dependencies, risk, and performance.

• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio
Drive growth and journey performance
• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.
Build an AI-enabled product practice
• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences
• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.
Lead and develop the product team
• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.
Lead through partnership
• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards
Education Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience Required
Experience Qualifications
7-9 years of product management or digital product experience, including significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products at scale. Required
Experience leading and developing product managers, with a track record of raising product judgment and team performance. Required
Experience owning digital products from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. Required
Skills and Abilities
REQUIRED

items: Demonstrated success improving high-intent consumer journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service.
Strong analytical fluency and hands-on experience using digital analytics platforms such as Quantum Metric, Heap, Amplitude, FullStory, Mixpanel, or similar.
Demonstrated fluency using AI across product strategy, discovery, research synthesis, analysis, prototyping, experimentation, and optimization.
Experience using AI-native tools to investigate customer behavior, product performance, and emerging opportunities.
Strong experience with experimentation, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and evidence-based product decision making.
Ability to connect customer needs, behavioral signals, business strategy, and technology capabilities into clear product direction and investment priorities.
Experience working in continuous discovery and delivery environments where learning actively shapes the roadmap.
Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to create clarity in complex, ambiguous product environments.

blocks.text: TARGET EXPERIENCE

items: We are looking for a product leader who has led consumer digital experiences where customer behavior and business performance are tightly connected.
You have owned high-intent journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service and can show how product decisions changed conversion, revenue, satisfaction, or customer effort.
You have worked in environments where pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial decisions are part of the product experience, not separate from it.

You also know what strong product practice looks like. You have worked with dedicated cross-functional teams, continuous discovery, instrumented products, experimentation, and outcome-based goals, and you have helped raise the maturity of the product organization around you.

Relevant experience may come from marketplaces, on-demand services, travel and hospitality, omnichannel retail, home services, financial services, modern automotive experiences, or other businesses where digital demand connects to real-world service delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, Core Product
jobs.text:
The Opportunity
As a Senior Director of Engineering, Core Product at Coursedog, you'll own the day-to-day execution and engineering health of Coursedog's three core product clouds — Assessment, Curriculum, and Scheduling — so they ship reliably, hit their commitments, and defend the revenue base. You'll work closely with engineering managers, product leadership, and cross-functional partners to translate the roadmap into reliable, high-quality software. This is a delivery-and-execution leadership role — focused on building and running the products customers pay for today.
This role will be the single accountable leader for how core product engineering executes, week over week and quarter over quarter. You'll pioneer an AI-augmented development model where clear specifications unlock high-quality, AI-accelerated delivery. You'll be responsible for predictable shipping, quality, and reliability, and driving a step-change in engineering velocity through AI and spec-driven practices, while building a strong bench of engineering leaders in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment.
This role reports directly to the SVP, Software Engineering and collaborates cross-functionally. This role is well-suited for someone who operates with both strategic vision and operational rigor, takes ownership of hard problems, and is motivated by building systems and teams that scale sustainably.
If you're excited by the chance to lead a major engineering function, shape how a critical part of the product organization executes, and transform how an entire engineering org builds software through AI-augmented, spec-driven practices, this is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a high-growth company.
This position offers a competitive base salary between $175,000 - $200,000, based on experience and qualifications. The role also includes a performance-based variable compensation component, bringing total on-target earnings (OTE) to $210,000 - $250,000 when performance objectives are achieved.
What You'll Own:
Lead the AI transformation into a spec-driven development org: Own the shift from ad-hoc coding to a spec-driven model where well-defined specifications drive design, implementation, review, and testing — and where AI tooling is used to accelerate delivery without eroding quality. Set the standard for how specs are written, versioned, and used as the contract between product intent and shipped code. Make AI-assisted development a durable competitive advantage across all three clouds, and raise the quality bar as AI-generated code volume grows.
Lead through metrics: You run the org on data, not anecdote. Define the metrics that tell the truth about delivery, quality, and reliability; make them visible; and use them to drive decisions, expose risk early, and focus the teams. You model metric-driven leadership for your EMs and know when a number is a floor, a goal, or a distraction.
Hold teams accountable: You are the single accountable leader for core product delivery, and you build that same accountability into every team. Set clear commitments and a clear definition of done, make ownership unambiguous, follow through on outcomes, and address underperformance directly and fairly. Commitments mean something on your teams.
Build a continuous-improvement culture: Create an engineering culture that gets measurably better every quarter — where retros lead to change, standards rise over time, experimentation is safe, and improving the system is everyone's job. You partner with your engineering managers to make continuous improvement a habit, not an event.
Multi-cloud engineering leadership: Set the standard for how the Assessment, Curriculum, and Scheduling teams plan, build, review, test, and release. Hold the line on consistency across all three without flattening what makes each cloud distinct.
Day-to-day execution: Sprint health, throughput, and delivery against quarterly commitments are yours. Run the cadence through your engineering managers, clear blockers fast, and make the trade-off calls when scope, quality, and timeline collide.
Quality and reliability: Own the quality bar for core product — driving down Change Failure Rate and Escaped Defect Rate, keeping the bug backlog contained, holding SLA compliance across all severity tiers, and protecting production availability. Quality is a first-class outcome, not a cleanup task.
People leadership: Lead and grow a team of engineering managers and their pods. Hire, level, coach, and develop EMs; run calibration and performance cycles; build a bench. You are a manager of managers.
Cross-functional partnership: Operate as the engineering counterpart to product, design, and customer-facing leadership for the three clouds. Translate roadmap into deliverable specs and plans, surface risk early and honestly, and keep commitments realistic and met.
Engineering operating system: Strengthen the practices that make delivery compound rather than erode — spec quality, estimation discipline, definition of done, code review standards, release process, and metrics that tell the truth about where teams actually stand.
Outcomes you'll be measured on:
AI and spec-driven adoption — teams operating on a spec-driven model, with measurable velocity and quality gains from AI-assisted development
Epic completion rate across the three clouds against quarterly goals
Bug backlog containment — resolved-vs-created trending the right way, total open issues controlled
Quality signals — Change Failure Rate and Escaped Defect Rate, severity-weighted
SLA compliance across Urgent / High / Medium / Low tiers
Delivery predictability — DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, change failure rate) and consistent sprint commitment hit-rates
Production reliability and availability for core product
Team health — retention, engagement, and EM growth
Continuous improvement — quarter-over-quarter gains in delivery and quality metrics that show the system is getting better, not just holding

jobs.title: SVP of Software Development & Technology
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage is one of the nation’s leading direct mortgage lenders, driven by innovation, data, and a relentless focus on customer experience. For more than two decades, we have redefined how consumers access mortgage financing by combining digital technology with a high-performance sales organization. As AmeriSave continues expanding across mortgage, home equity, and consumer lending products, technology remains a core competitive advantage.
Position Summary
AmeriSave is seeking a Senior Vice President of Software Development & Technology to lead and scale our engineering organization across Marketing Technology, Sales Technology, Operations Technology, Automation, AI, and Enterprise Platforms.
This executive leader will oversee multiple engineering teams and engineering leaders while driving technology strategy, architecture, innovation, and execution across the company. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with exceptional leadership capabilities and maintains hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices.
What You'll Do
Lead software engineering functions across AmeriSave technology teams
Develop and execute technology strategy aligned with business objectives
Oversee engineering leaders responsible for Marketing, Operations, Sales, and Enterprise Technology
Drive large-scale platform modernization and architectural initiatives
Establish engineering standards, governance, and development best practices
Lead AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
Partner closely with Executive Leadership to identify strategic technology opportunities
Ensure scalability, security, compliance, and reliability across all platforms
Build and mentor high-performing engineering management teams
Drive delivery excellence, innovation, and operational efficiency throughout the organization
Evaluate emerging technologies and make strategic investment recommendations
Own engineering budget planning, resource allocation, and organizational growth
What You Bring
Required Qualifications
15+ years of progressive software engineering experience
8+ years leading large engineering organizations
Proven success leading Directors, VPs, and Engineering Managers
Deep hands-on experience with modern software architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, and microservices
Strong technical background with Java, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and enterprise application development
Experience leading AI and automation initiatives
Track record building highly scalable customer-facing and operational platforms
Demonstrated success aligning technology investments with measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
Preferred Qualifications
Mortgage, fintech, banking, or high-volume transaction experience
Experience leading remote and distributed engineering organizations
MBA and/or advanced technical degree
Experience with digital customer acquisition and marketing technology
Tech Stack
Languages:Java, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL
Architecture:API-driven architecture, microservices, cloud-based systems
Focus Areas:Marketing technology, operations technology, sales platforms, enterprise applications, AI, automation, analytics, and conversion optimization

jobs.title: Senior Director - Data Platform and Cloud Services
jobs.text:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.
We're seeking a Senior Director to lead and transform our data platform and cloud services architecture. This role is not about incremental improvements – we need someone who can lead and execute a leap forward in our data infrastructure capabilities, positioning Samba at the forefront of TV data analytics and AI-driven insights.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
At Inventi, we build payment infrastructure technology for payment service providers. Our payments platform connects customers to SEPA, SWIFT, TARGET2, and other payment systems through a single API.
We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer to set our technology direction and shape what we build next.
Why this could be interesting for you
There's no fixed roadmap waiting for you here - you'd build it yourself. You'd shape both the technology and the team, staying hands-on, on infrastructure banks and PSPs actually depend on. And you'd get real room to experiment with AI along the way.
The role:
Own our technology strategy and make the big architectural decisions.
Drive AI adoption across engineering - make it part of how we build.
Set the bar for technical quality and engineering standards.
Own reliability, security, and technical risk across the platform.
Build a delivery process the whole company can rely on.
Drive company wide engineering culture and strive for quality, passion and learning.
Be the technical voice with product, leadership, and key clients.
Protect our fast-moving culture as we grow - build the kind of org you'd want to work in yourself.
What you bring:
Technical depth - you can challenge architecture decisions.
AI is part of your daily toolkit - and something you've brought into your team's way of working.
Experience owning reliability and uptime for systems that can't go down.
You know how to handle a production incident with structure.
A track record of building or scaling an engineering team, with a high bar for who joins it.
You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in English.
Fintech, payments, or regulated infrastructure experience is a plus.
Our offer:
Ownership: shape the technology strategy of a growing fintech company and have a direct impact on how we build, scale, and operate.
Room to experiment: try new tools, new combinations, new ways of working.
Continuous learning: access to courses, conferences, and books.
Team culture: events, sports challenges, team-building.
Flexible & remote work: enjoy flexible hours and remote work options.
Private health insurance and optional 3rd pillar pension contributions.
Little perks that make a difference: pet-friendly office, snacks, free parking and a lot of ways to take a break - from board to digital.
Gross salary starting from 8000 Eur/month, depending on experience.
🔓Unlock your value! Shape the technology behind payments for banks and PSPs across Europe.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
Igloo is expanding its product engine and establishing a dedicated Tech Solutions hub in Pune. We are looking for a hands-on Lead Solutions Architect & Site Lead to drive platform architecture, govern technical design, and manage our multidisciplinary engineering organization in India.
In this dual-impact role, you will balance deep technical ownership—reviewing architecture, guiding system design, and auditing code—with people leadership across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, and Integration teams. You will ensure our high-throughput insurance and direct-to-consumer platform remains scalable, secure, and resilient.
Key Responsibilities:
Architecture & System Design
Architect, design, and govern high-availability, microservices-based platform solutions for global direct-to-consumer and partner-facing lines of business.
Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews; establish quality benchmarks, security controls, and robust release mechanisms.
Stay hands-on with system design and technical troubleshooting, guiding engineers through complex algorithmic and infrastructural challenges.
Team & Site Leadership
Lead overall strategy, capacity planning, and operating rhythm for the Pune technology hub.
Recruit, mentor, and scale multidisciplinary teams across backend, frontend, QA, DevOps/SRE, and platform integration.
Drive engineering culture, career pathing, succession planning, and retention initiatives across the India site.
Product Delivery & Operations
Partner with global product, architecture, and business teams (UAE, India, China) to align platform roadmap with technical execution.
Collaborate with DevOps/SRE and QA to optimize CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, observability, and incident response SLAs.
Leverage AI productivity tools responsibly for code synthesis, testing, documentation, and technical analysis.

jobs.title: B2B Tech Associate Director - Burson
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
More about the role:
As an Associate Director in our Technology practice, you will be working across some of our largest and most strategic enterprise/B2B clients. As well as an overall understanding of enterprise technology gleaned from your experience to date, the successful candidate will have experience working with brands in some or all of the following key sectors: datacentre, automotive, semiconductor/processor, and Internet of Things.
Alongside your relevant experience, you will be a dynamic and commercially astute thinker, creating strategic and innovative solutions to meet client challenges, yielding exceptional results. You will offer insightful and effective counsel to clients, manage expectations, proactively address issues, and ensure seamless execution of all client deliverables.
What you'll do:
Lead and grow senior client relationships, providing strategic counsel and ensuring communications programmes deliver against business objectives.
Develop and oversee integrated communications strategies and creative campaigns across multiple channels.
Partner closely with internal specialists and agency partners to deliver innovative, insight-led client solutions.
Drive account growth by identifying new opportunities, selling integrated programmes and supporting new business pitches and proposals.
Oversee project delivery, ensuring work is delivered on time, on budget and to an exceptional standard.
Champion the use of data, intelligence and AI-powered solutions to enhance client outcomes and uncover new opportunities.
Lead, inspire and develop team members through coaching, mentoring, performance management and career development planning.
Act as a senior ambassador for the agency, contributing to thought leadership, industry visibility, agency culture and continued business growth.
Experience that contributes to success:
Proven experience leading senior client relationships and acting as a trusted strategic advisor to technology and innovation-focused brands.
Strong integrated communications background across earned, social, content, influencer and corporate communications.
Demonstrated ability to develop high-impact strategies, compelling narratives and multi-channel campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Experience operating within complex, multi-agency environments and collaborating effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.Commercially minded, with a track record of driving account growth, uncovering new opportunities and contributing to business development.
Strong understanding of data-driven communications, measurement frameworks, AI tools and intelligence-led planning.
Experienced people leader with a passion for coaching, mentoring and developing high-performing teams.
Excellent presentation, pitching and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
#LI-CY1
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Develops and administers IT budget for responsible area.

jobs.title: Vice President, Revenue Cycle Technology Operations
jobs.text:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Vice President, Revenue Cycle Technology Operations leads the enterprise functions responsible for translating EnableComp's technology strategy into scalable, reliable, and measurable operational performance across revenue cycle service lines. Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Operations, this role owns the Technology Operations vision, investment portfolio, governance, and value-realization framework while setting the strategic direction, operating expectations, and performance framework for work delivered through EnableComp's global vendor partners. Serving as an executive bridge among Operations, Technology, Product, Data, Implementation, and external delivery partners, the VP aligns technology enablement, workflow design, capacity strategy, and partner performance with business growth and client commitments. The VP leads through internal leaders and designated vendor leadership, establishes decision rights and accountability, allocates resources, resolves cross-functional tradeoffs, and remains accountable for productivity, quality, cost, scalability, risk, employee experience, and client outcomes across the combined portfolio.
THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE
Define and lead the enterprise vision, multi-year roadmap, and operating model for technology operations in alignment with EnableComp's growth strategy, client commitments, and Operations priorities.
Own the portfolio of Operations technology, automation, workflow-transformation, and global-operations initiatives, including business-case development, prioritization, sequencing, funding recommendations, and executive governance.
Establish decision rights, accountability, and ways of working across Operations, Technology, Product, Data, Implementation, Finance, Information Security, Compliance, and global vendor partners.
Translate business strategy and service-line needs into enterprise capability, capacity, and delivery requirements, ensuring technology and global-operations plans address the highest-value opportunities and risks.
Sponsor workflow redesign and standardization across onshore and global operations teams before and alongside technology deployment, ensuring processes are scalable, controlled, and consistently executed.
Set portfolio-level goals and KPIs for productivity, quality, cost-to-serve, cycle time, utilization, vendor performance, client outcomes, and return on investment; report results and recommendations to executive leadership.
Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Technology Operations leadership teams, including the Senior Directors, Revenue Cycle Technology Adoption..
Set strategic direction while delegating day-to-day technology adoption, global production, inventory coordination, vendor-team support, and performance-management execution to the respective Senior Directors.
Partner with Technology, Product, and Data leaders to align operational and global-delivery requirements with platform architecture, product roadmaps, integration capacity, data availability, and delivery constraints.
Maintain executive oversight of governance, operational continuity, regulatory and contractual controls, information security, data protection, third-party performance, and change risk; use performance data, partner feedback, and client insight to drive continuous improvement.
Sponsor pilots and phased rollouts, establish readiness and scale criteria, and make data-informed decisions to expand, revise, pause, or retire solutions.
Build a continuous-improvement culture that uses performance data, frontline feedback, client insight, and market developments to identify and deliver the next generation of operational capabilities.
Other duties as required.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, information systems, engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree (MBA or similar) preferred.
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, healthcare operations, technology-enabled services, or a related environment, including 5+ years leading at the senior director or vice president level.
Demonstrated success building and leading an enterprise technology-operations, digital-transformation, automation, or operational-excellence portfolio with measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success leading operational change in a services or operations heavy business, including at least one transformation carried through technology-led workflow redesign from pilot through multi-team rollout to a measured result, with task-level planning, dependency and gate management, and delivery at or under budget on a program with executive visibility.
Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations, including complex claims, denials, reimbursement, revenue recovery, or adjacent workflows.
Experience governing cross-functional portfolios and partnering with Technology, Product, Data, Information Security, Finance, and Operations leaders in a matrixed organization.
Demonstrated financial and analytical acumen, including business-case development, investment prioritization, KPI design, benefits realization, and executive-level reporting.
Experience directing outsourced or global delivery partnerships, including vendor governance, service-level performance, capacity planning, commercial oversight, and risk management preferred.
Timely and regular attendance.
Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES
Practices and adheres to EnableComp's Core Values, Vision and Mission.
Enterprise mindset with the ability to balance growth, client, operational, financial, risk, and technology considerations when setting priorities.
Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational and technical topics into clear decisions, tradeoffs, and actions.
Proven ability to lead through other leaders, build high-performing teams, and distinguish strategic accountability from delegated program execution.
Financially disciplined and data-driven, with the ability to connect technology investments to measurable operational and client value.
Skilled at influencing senior stakeholders, resolving competing priorities, and making timely decisions with incomplete information.
Strong understanding of change leadership and technology adoption, with the judgment to set direction and hold accountable the leader responsible for day-to-day adoption execution.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and lead effectively in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.
EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.
Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying:
“I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.” – Revenue Specialist
“I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. This company is family oriented and flexible, along with understanding the balance of work, life, and fun.” – Supervisor, Operations

Sponsor workflow redesign and standardization across onshore and global operations teams before and alongside technology deployment, ensuring processes are scalable, controlled, and consistently executed.

Set portfolio-level goals and KPIs for productivity, quality, cost-to-serve, cycle time, utilization, vendor performance, client outcomes, and return on investment; report results and recommendations to executive leadership.
Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Technology Operations leadership teams, including the Senior Directors, Revenue Cycle Technology Adoption..

Set strategic direction while delegating day-to-day technology adoption, global production, inventory coordination, vendor-team support, and performance-management execution to the respective Senior Directors.

Partner with Technology, Product, and Data leaders to align operational and global-delivery requirements with platform architecture, product roadmaps, integration capacity, data availability, and delivery constraints.

Maintain executive oversight of governance, operational continuity, regulatory and contractual controls, information security, data protection, third-party performance, and change risk; use performance data, partner feedback, and client insight to drive continuous improvement.
Sponsor pilots and phased rollouts, establish readiness and scale criteria, and make data-informed decisions to expand, revise, pause, or retire solutions.
Build a continuous-improvement culture that uses performance data, frontline feedback, client insight, and market developments to identify and deliver the next generation of operational capabilities.
Other duties as required.

12+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, healthcare operations, technology-enabled services, or a related environment, including 5+ years leading at the senior director or vice president level.
Demonstrated success building and leading an enterprise technology-operations, digital-transformation, automation, or operational-excellence portfolio with measurable business outcomes.

Demonstrated success leading operational change in a services or operations heavy business, including at least one transformation carried through technology-led workflow redesign from pilot through multi-team rollout to a measured result, with task-level planning, dependency and gate management, and delivery at or under budget on a program with executive visibility.
Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations, including complex claims, denials, reimbursement, revenue recovery, or adjacent workflows.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to help shape and lead some of Chime’s most important opportunities for our members and our business. You’ll lead a product organization of approximately 10-15 people, setting the vision and strategy across a broad, high-impact area while developing the leaders and teams responsible for bringing that strategy to life. You’ll identify opportunities that can meaningfully expand Chime’s reach and impact, make consequential choices about where we invest, and turn those opportunities into products and experiences members love. This is a highly strategic leadership role for someone who can move fluidly between setting a multi-year vision, leading a scaled organization, and partnering with senior leaders across Chime to define what comes next.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $326,000 and up to $383,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Set a compelling product vision and strategy for a significant area of Chime, connecting member needs, market opportunities, and company priorities into a clear path forward.
Lead a product organization of approximately 10-15 people, creating the structure, leadership, and operating environment for teams to do their best work.
Identify and develop new opportunities to expand Chime’s impact, using deep member understanding, data, experimentation, and market insight to determine where we should place our biggest bets.
Own a broad portfolio of product initiatives and make thoughtful investment and prioritization decisions across near-term opportunities and longer-term strategic bets.
Lead through experienced product leaders, developing senior talent, strengthening the leadership bench, and creating clarity and accountability across multiple teams.
Partner with senior leaders across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and other functions to turn strategy into measurable member and business outcomes.
Serve as a senior product voice across Chime, influencing company-level decisions and helping shape how our products and product organization evolve as the business grows.
To thrive in this role, you have
Led a scaled product organization comparable to a 15–20 person team, including experience leading and developing experienced product leaders.
Owned a broad product portfolio or business area where you were accountable for strategy, investment, prioritization, and outcomes across multiple teams.
A track record of building and scaling products that delivered meaningful customer and business impact in a consumer technology environment.
Experience identifying significant new opportunities and translating customer, behavioral, and market insights into successful product strategies.
Built strong product teams and leadership benches, creating organizations that can move quickly and operate with significant autonomy while staying aligned around a common strategy.
Experience making consequential decisions in complex, ambiguous environments using a combination of data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgment.
Experience operating in consumer technology, financial services, marketplaces, subscription businesses, or another scaled digital product environment where trust, engagement, and customer experience matter deeply.
#LI-TP1 #LI-Onsite
Below is the base salary offered for this role and level of experience. Full-time employees may also be eligible for bonus(es), competitive equity, and benefits. For commissioned roles, the base salary listed in this job description does not include incentive/variable pay. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
Wage Notice
$309,000—$383,000 USD
A little about us
At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
Because if we don't—who will?
*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.
What we offer for our full-time, regular employees
🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress
We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.
To learn more about how Chime collects and uses your personal information during the application process, please see the Chime Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Company Background
Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.
Location: This position is remote within the United States or Canada.
As Director of Product Management, you will guide product development through all stages of the product life cycle: identifying customer needs and developing, launching, and sustaining products, shaping the next generation of our modules. You will represent Censys to customers, vendors, and partners, synthesizing information and communicating what you learn to internal stakeholders. You will build, maintain, and develop a world class team of product managers who care deeply about our mission to be THE authority for Internet Intelligence and Insights.
As Director of Product Management for Solutions, you will lead Censys’ evolution from a best-in-class Attack Surface Management (ASM) product to a unified exposure management solution, spanning 1st party and 3rd party risk visibility. You’ll shape the strategic direction and execution of products that define how organizations understand, monitor, and secure their presence on the Internet— working cross-functionally to deliver value to our customers and advance Censys’ leadership in Internet Intelligence.
This is a critical leadership role for a deeply technical, business-savvy product leader who can translate complex Internet-scale challenges into clear, executable product strategies. You’ll lead a high-performing team of product managers, partner with engineering, design and research, and collaborate across go-to-market functions to bring innovative solutions to market.
What You’ll Do
Lead and develop a world-class team of Product Managers focused on Censys’ attack surface management and supply chain intelligence
Define and drive the unified product vision across ASM and supply chain risk management, strategy, and roadmap, connecting core capabilities like asset discovery, ownership, risks, and analytics into cohesive customer workflows.
Partner closely with engineering leadership to prioritize and deliver features that scale, perform, and differentiate Censys’ platform in the cybersecurity market.
Partner with Design and AI teams to make exposure management insights more intuitive, conversational, and actionable within customer workflows.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Research to ensure customer feedback, market insights, and competitive signals are continuously integrated into product planning.
Establish and scale best-in-class product management processes, ensuring clarity of priorities, crisp execution, and data-driven decision-making.
Identify and validate new opportunities for Censys’ platform — including integration with third-party ecosystems, developer enablement, and next-generation intelligence capabilities.
Represent Censys externally with customers, partners, and at industry events, evangelizing our vision and shaping market perception of Internet Intelligence.
Measure success rigorously, using both quantitative (usage, adoption, ARR contribution) and qualitative (customer feedback, internal alignment) signals to iterate effectively.
About You
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing other PMs.
Proven success building and scaling enterprise SaaS or data platforms, ideally in cybersecurity or risk intelligence domains.
Deep understanding of Attack Surface Management (ASM), Internet data, or adjacent areas such as threat intelligence, network discovery, or cloud security posture management.
Strong technical acumen — you can comfortably discuss APIs, data pipelines, and architectural tradeoffs with engineers, and speak credibly with CISOs and technical buyers.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive strategy through data-driven insights and market storytelling.
Track record of driving cross-functional alignment and delivering measurable business outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Excellent communicator — able to craft compelling product narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Skilled at balancing strategy and execution — zooming out to define a market vision, and zooming in to ship value every quarter.
Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and retain top product talent.
Prior work in startups or high-growth SaaS environments where speed and adaptability were key.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
Bonus Points
Hands-on familiarity with Internet-scale systems and network protocols (e.g., TLS, DNS, BGP, etc. ).
Experience integrating AI/ML into cybersecurity or analytics workflow.
Experience leading product-led growth (PLG) or usage-based monetization strategies.
For candidates located in a high cost of living location, the base salary range is $238,000 USD and $257,000 USD.
This position is located remote with no expectations to come into an office regularly.
Censys is an equal opportunity employer.
Identity Verification
As part of our hiring process, all candidates who receive an offer of employment will be asked to complete an identity verification through CLEAR.
California Privacy Rights Notice
Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), we are providing you with notice that we collect personal information from job applicants for business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy for employment, conducting interviews, and, if applicable, completing the hiring process. The categories of information we may collect include identifiers (such as name and contact information), professional or employment-related information (such as work history, education, and references), and other information you provide in your application. We do not sell or share your personal information. For more information on how we use and protect your personal information, and your rights under the CCPA, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: VP of Product Specialists
jobs.text:
This is an exciting opportunity to join Luminance, a leading AI platform for contract intelligence. Luminance helps organisations understand and get more value from their contracts across the entire lifecycle, from drafting and negotiation through to post-signature management. By bringing together AI, automation and contract data, Luminance enables legal, procurement, finance, HR and business teams to work more efficiently, identify risk and make better decisions.
As Luminance continues to expand rapidly across the US and globally, we are looking for a VP of Product Specialists to lead and scale the Product Specialist organisation.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About the Role
The CTO will own technology for doit Holdings, our regulated investment platform in Malaysia. This is a build role. The platform does not exist yet, and it has to be built inside a technology risk framework that satisfies the Securities Commission's Guidelines on Technology Risk Management from the first line of code. The role runs from architecture and engineering execution through to the systems evidence the SC assesses at registration.
What you will be doing
Own architecture and major technical decisions for the platform, from onboarding and order routing through records, reporting and the partner interfaces.
Build and lead the engineering team, and set standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.
Implement the SC's technology risk requirements as engineering practice: change control and approvals, secure development, testing and acceptance, capacity and resilience.
Produce the systems evidence behind the readiness declaration a director and the Responsible Person must sign before the platform may operate.
Take the platform through the independent technology validation that gates registration, and close what it finds.
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, tested rather than documented.
Own cloud, vendor and outsourcing arrangements, where the board remains accountable for everything outsourced.
What you will need
Deep software engineering background with experience building and scaling production systems.
Strong knowledge of backend systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
Experience making architecture decisions across multiple products or engineering teams.
Strong technical judgement and ability to challenge engineering decisions at implementation level.
Capable of building world-class engineering teams.
Still technically hands-on - able to review code, architecture, incidents and difficult engineering problems directly.
Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.text:
Our client is a profitable, founder-led consumer healthcare and AI company building a full-stack digital care platform. The business serves more than 150,000 active patients each month, has grown to approximately $350 million in annual recurring revenue, and employs roughly 125 people.
We are hiring a Head of Product Growth to build and lead a new referrals and viral-loops function. Reporting directly to the founder and CEO, you will transform an existing referral program into a repeatable growth engine and own the full viral-growth surface across referrals, invite loops, user-generated content, social sharing, gifting, freemium, and product-as-marketing.
You will redesign and scale the referral program, lead a small team of engineers and designers, ship experiments daily, scope MVPs, work with the codebase, build the analytics stack for viral coefficients and loop performance, and establish the product-growth strategy and operating cadence from the ground up.

jobs.title: VP, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges
Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Who are we?
Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.
The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.
Reporting line and scope
You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.
The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.
What will you do?
Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.
Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Customer Care
jobs.text:
At Lyft, our mission is to improve people’s lives with the world’s best transportation. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.
Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product leaders who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company’s vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate product leaders to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our San Francisco and New York offices.
The Safety & Customer Care (SCC) Product team builds the platforms, products, and experiences that support riders and drivers when they need help most — and help keep them safe every time they ride. As the Director of Product, Customer Care, you’ll lead a team of product managers driving Lyft’s customer care strategy end to end: AI-powered support across chat and voice, the contact center platforms our support teams run on, and the underlying data layer which is critical to understand where our products can be improved. It’s a rare chance to shape how a category-defining company delivers support at scale — across emerging AI capabilities, global expansion, autonomous vehicle partnerships, and new lines of business.
Responsibilities:
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Lyft’s Customer Care product portfolio — spanning AI-driven support automation, contact center platforms, self-service and issue resolution, and the trust and safety products underpinning every interaction
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, execution, and career development
Partner with senior leaders across engineering, data science, design, operations, and finance to set priorities and deliver org-level outcomes
Drive Lyft’s shift to AI-first customer support — from agent-assist and automation to autonomous resolution across chat and voice
Set the strategy for the platforms and tooling that power a global support organization and its BPO partners. Make build/buy decisions to optimize for best and most efficient customer experiences.
Represent Customer Care product in executive and cross-functional forums, translating complex tradeoffs into clear recommendations and securing investment
Make disciplined prioritization and resourcing decisions across a broad portfolio, balancing near-term operational needs against long-term platform bets
Define the metrics that matter — cost, quality, and customer experience — and hold the organization accountable to measurable impact
Extend Lyft’s support capabilities into new frontiers, including autonomous vehicle partnerships, international markets, and emerging business lines
Experience:
10+ years of product management experience, including several years leading and managing product managers
Proven track record of building, scaling, and developing high-performing product teams
Experience owning a large, multi-workstream product portfolio and setting multi-year strategy
Experience in Vendor Management
Deep fluency in one or more of: customer support and contact center platforms, AI/ML-driven automation, or trust & safety products
Strengths:
Strategic vision: You define a compelling long-term direction and translate it into a roadmap the team can execute
People leadership: You hire, coach, and retain exceptional product managers and create the conditions for them to do their best work
Executive presence: You communicate crisply with senior leadership and build alignment across a complex stakeholder set
Technical depth: You engage credibly with engineering and data science on AI/ML systems, platform architecture, and technical tradeoffs
Operational rigor: You make data-informed decisions and drive measurable outcomes across cost, quality, and experience
Bias to action: You navigate ambiguity, decide with incomplete information, and move the organization forward with urgency
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, a related field, or equivalent experience
Benefits:
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have unlimited paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
401(k) plan to help save for your future
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Pre-tax commuter benefits
Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program
Lyft is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members are expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.
The expected range of pay for this position in the San Francisco or New York areas is $236,000 - $295,000. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Range is not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.
