jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you're ready to see your impact and embrace meaningful challenges, join us, and build real world value.
Every payment, every custody operation, and every line of code at Ripple runs on the infrastructure our platform teams build. We operate a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-native environment spanning multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions, engineered for the availability and security standards our financial institution customers expect — and for the developer velocity our engineers need. The systems this organization owns are the substrate for everything Ripple ships.
We have a big vision and the ambition to match. We are seeking the same in engineering leaders. You see infrastructure not as plumbing but as leverage: the difference between an engineering organization that ships weekly and one that ships continuously, between a platform that survives a regional outage and one that doesn't notice it happened.
We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to develop and guide the teams responsible for Ripple's cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform, and developer experience.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
As CTO, you will be the technical leader of the business, working closely with the founders to shape our product and technology strategy as we scale from Series A towards Series B.
You will lead our 6-person engineering team in India, while remaining sufficiently hands-on and responsible for the architecture, performance, and roadmap of Nina and Trace, and for building the engineering organization behind them whilst staying close enough to the code and models to make sharp technical calls.
Key responsibilities
Own the company’s technology and AI strategy, including the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for Nina and Trace.
Lead, mentor and scale the distributed engineering team, establishing the culture, standards, processes and hiring strategy needed for the next stage of growth.
Drive the evolution and performance of Nina and Trace, improving agent accuracy, reliability, latency, cost and scalability.
Establish robust approaches to AI agent evaluation, orchestration, safety & reliability.
Design and scale the underlying data pipelines, integrations, verification workflows and infrastructure supporting the agents.
Own technology practices around data privacy, security and responsible AI, particularly for sensitive candidate and background-check data.
Translate product, customer and commercial priorities into a clear technical roadmap and execution plan, working closely with founders, product and go-to-market teams.
Make strategic architecture, technology, build-vs-buy and model-vs-API decisions to optimise long-term capability, cost and scalability.
Shape the future technology organisation, including team structure, engineering processes and talent strategy.
Represent technology and engineering with customers, partners, the board and investors as required.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Global marketplaces — Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify and over a hundred others — are the engines of modern commerce. But the data sits locked inside each channel, fragmented and rarely adding up to a clear picture.
MerchantSpring is the API-first data infrastructure for the businesses that operate, advise on, and build for digital commerce. We consolidate cross-channel marketplace data into a single source of truth that our customers reach through a visualisation platform, an API gateway, MCP tools and embeddable widgets.
We are profitable, self-funded, and seven years in — scaling on our own revenue rather than someone else’s runway. We are headquartered in Australia with a growing presence in Kuala Lumpur, and we operate as a single team across sites.
Today the platform spans 120+ e-commerce channels, manages roughly 12TB of data across 35,000 seller accounts in 29 countries, serving agencies, enterprise brands, and ecosystem and technology partners.
The role
We are looking for a Head of Engineering to take full ownership of our engineering function and lead the next chapter: our evolution into a true API-first data platform. You will inherit a team of 11 engineers across our ETL, API and AI/MCP squads, report to our CEO, and own the technical vision, the architecture, and the culture that carries us from startup to scale-up.
This is a builder’s leadership role. We want someone who leads from within the architecture — setting direction, making the hard technical calls, and rolling up their sleeves to code when it helps the team move or unblocks a problem. As the team grows, the role is expected to evolve further toward organisational leadership, and we say so openly because we want someone who wants that trajectory.
What you’ll own
Technical vision and architecture. Translate business goals into a technical roadmap, set direction across the squads, and own the architectural bets — with our API-first data layer as the centrepiece.
Platform scale. Take our API and data platform from where they are today to scale: more channels, more volume, and more external builders relying on our endpoints, MCP tools and widgets.
Infrastructure economics. Own the unit economics of the platform. A large and growing share of our cost base sits in database and infrastructure spend, and you will be accountable for managing and driving it down as we scale with a focus on database cost:
TimescaleDB compression, retention and continuous aggregates
Postgres query and index optimisation and right-sizing
MongoDB indexing and sharding.
Data integrity and reliability. 35,000 accounts depend on financially accurate data. Own incident practices and resilience that keep serious problems rare — and provide visible, decisive leadership on the rare occasions they aren’t.
The team culture. Hire, mentor and grow engineers; set delivery standards and best practices from documentation to deployment; and build a team where engineers want to do their best work.
Set direction. Provide oversight and guidance to talented, junior teams in AI/MCP to DevOps and infrastructure.
Partnership and foresight. Bridge Engineering with Sales and Client Success so feedback, escalations and market signals reach the roadmap, and engage the CEO and co-founder proactively on technical strategy.

jobs.title: Sr Director, Data Strategy and Information Systems
jobs.text:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.
Job Details
The Senior Director of Data Strategy and Information Systems will lead the data strategy agenda for business units and enhance strategic decision making through the enablement of data assets. This role partners with business leaders to leverage data to drive revenue generation and cost savings, while ensuring regulatory compliance and effective risk management. In addition, this position is responsible for product management, data methodologies, data processing and quality control, and supporting both internal and external customers of the data asset.
Responsibilities
Manages development and deployment team members as well as Reporting Analysts in the delivery of value-added solutions and the implementation of best practices.
Serves as the primary technical representative for assigned business units and works directly with corporate and client IT teams to resolve issues, including but not limited to: completing security assessments, implementing new IT initiatives and communicates impacts, and addressing AWS infrastructure needs or issues, including SQL databases, servers, and application vulnerabilities.
Functions as a Product Owner to liaison with corporate data and development teams while providing data related expertise across programs and projects.
Develops and maintains data roadmap, prioritizing data work, and ensuring progress is made against the strategic roadmap. Manages data programs and supports strategic initiatives where data management is a critical factor.
Leads team members in monitoring, measuring and driving compliance with data governance, data quality and data sourcing policies.
Collaborates with business leaders to develop, implement and champion evolving data capabilities.
Serves as a thought leader, drives the use of data-driven approaches, and seeks to expand the range of fields in which data insight adds value to decision making.
Fosters the adoption of common terminology, language and perspectives for data management
The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.
Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, similar technical field of study, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
Master’s degree in computer science or similar technical field of study preferred.
Experience
10+ years of prior healthcare and/or PBM industries, required.
10+ years of management experience.
10+ years of experience with Data Warehouse methodologies as well as SQL database development, working with the full Microsoft SQL Server toolset (SSIS, SSRS, SSMS, SSAS, RDBMS).
Experience in healthcare technology, online pharmacy claims adjudication preferred.
Skills & Abilities
Proven ability to create, motivate and inspire interdisciplinary teams focusing on resolution(s) of identified issues by translating strategic plans into priorities and procedures for the work team and implementing tactical operating policies and procedures.
Demonstrated ability to articulate complex issues, plans, and concepts to diverse populations. Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as excellent presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions and take actions to improve the overall operational efficiencies for the team and service to the marketplace.
Demonstrated technical expertise in engineering, data and business analytics, business intelligence with experience in the following: agile methodology (Scrum, Kanban, Lean, etc.); PowerShell, Python; AWS, GitLab, Visual Studio; .NET, C#, JSON, XML, VisualCron, PowerBI, Tableau; and, cloud-based database solutions (e.g., Azure SQL Database, AWS RDS).
Advanced SQL skills, including data modeling, DBO creation, management, OLAP principles and indexing.
Expertise in identifying and diagnosing application and database related issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions.
Demonstrated ability to architect, design, develop and implement solutions around micro-service and monolithic architectures.
Proven knowledge of:
Non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) and big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark);
Pharmacy industry standards such as NCPDP, HL7, ANSI X12, and/or related drug database terminologies and classifications; and,
Medicare Part D, PDE submissions & returns, pharmacy claims and benefit management
Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.
Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.
Travel: Travel may be required for special organization or department events, department team meetings, trade shows, conferences, and other client engagements.
This is a remote position.
AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.
AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the evolution of our digital experience platform. This leader will shape how customers interact with our solutions, driving innovation in user experience, workflow efficiency, and intelligent automation.

Deep expertise in product discovery, customer research, experimentation, and product strategy.
Experience defining and measuring customer outcomes rather than feature delivery.

Background partnering closely with UX research and product design organizations.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Our Story
At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline. Our software empowers sales associates to have more personal, effective conversations with customers through AI-powered tools that drive measurable revenue.
Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, most platforms overlook the in-store experience. We’re changing that. We’re helping brands like Reformation, Gorjana, Glossier, Frame, and Mizzen+Main turn real customer relationships into growth powered by intuitive software and thoughtful design.
With rapid growth ahead, we’re scaling our Product organization and need a steady, capable leader to help us get there.
Position Overview
Endear is hiring a VP of Product to take day-to-day ownership of the product organization during a pivotal phase of growth. Partnering closely with leadership on long-term vision, you will translate company goals into clear product priorities and lead execution against the agreed mission.
This role is central to making Endear’s product team AI-native. You will improve how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, make decisions, and accelerate shipping—not just shape Endear’s AI product direction. You will bring a zero-to-one mindset, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and build the operating model needed for product, design, and engineering to move faster together.
This is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You will lead and develop the product team, partner deeply with Design and Engineering, assess team structure and resourcing, and hire additional product talent as needed. We are looking for someone who has shipped products in lean environments, can go deep when needed, and knows how to build scalable processes without adding unnecessary overhead
What You’ll Accomplish
In your first 6 months, you’ll…
Take clear day-to-day ownership of product, turning company priorities into an actionable roadmap and measurable outcomes.
Align leadership, Product, Design, and Engineering around a cohesive product vision and a clear path to execution.
Assess the current team, operating model, and resourcing; identify what needs to change to improve speed, ownership, and accountability.
Establish stronger product rituals and decision-making systems that help the team ship with more focus and less friction.
Build practical customer-feedback loops into roadmap and prioritization decisions.
Make the product organization more AI-native by improving how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, prioritize, and ship.
In your first year, you’ll…
Build a high-performing product organization with clear ownership, strong psychological safety, and the right team structure for the next stage.
Hire and develop product talent, including an additional PM, while evaluating the capabilities and resourcing the team needs.
Deliver high-impact roadmap work that improves product adoption and business outcomes.
Establish scalable planning, execution, and communication systems that keep teams aligned as Endear grows.
Help shape and execute Endear’s AI product direction while ensuring the team can move quickly from idea to shipped product.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If…
You Have Experience With
Leading product at a lean B2B SaaS company, with both strategic ownership and hands-on execution.
Turning company goals into clear product priorities, success metrics, and decisions.
Building and communicating product vision, then translating it into focused execution.
Partnering deeply with Design and Engineering, including going technical when needed.
Leading, mentoring, and growing Product Managers while maintaining a high bar for delivery.
Building product processes that add clarity and speed without creating unnecessary overhead.
Using AI tools in day-to-day product work—from research and problem framing to prototyping, prioritization, and execution.
Transforming how product teams work in an AI-native environment.
Using customer feedback, usage data, and market insight to guide roadmap decisions.
Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving growth-stage environments.
Align With What We Value
At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:
Customer First: Prioritize real customer problems over internal assumptions. Use research, feedback, and product data to ensure the roadmap delivers meaningful value to merchants and sales associates.
Take Ownership: Own outcomes, not just outputs. Take responsibility for product direction, team performance, and the impact product decisions have on the business.
Enable Autonomy: Build clear product strategy, priorities, and processes so product, design, and engineering teams can execute with confidence and independence.
Under Promise, Over Deliver: Set realistic expectations for product initiatives and deliver consistent, measurable improvements that build trust with customers and the team.
Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: Balance thoughtful strategy with a bias toward action. Test ideas, iterate quickly, and ship improvements that create real business impact.
About the Team
You’ll partner most closely with:
Executive Team: Align product strategy with company goals, provide visibility into roadmap priorities and performance, and partner on key decisions around growth and product direction.
Head of Product Design: strategy, feedback, and design system development
Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, and merchant needs
Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration
We’re a small team with big ambitions—collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Screen
Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager + Co-Founder
Panel interview with key Product and Engineering team members
Final conversation with Co-Founder + CTO
Offer 🎉
Compensation & Benefits
Base Salary: $190+240k
Equity Eligible
Fully remote team
Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
Co-working or home office stipend
Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation
Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry
Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. We care about skills, motivation, and how you think more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Data Governance and Analytics Architecture Director
jobs.text:
Overview
The Data Governance & Analytics Architecture Director is a leader within the Health Enablement Analytics organization responsible for ensuring all data, analytics, and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, standardized, and governed foundation. This role serves as a subject matter expert for data governance, analytics architecture, and AI/ML best practices across Health Enablement. This role provides advisory leadership, technical guidance, and architecture standards to ensure analytics and innovation efforts are aligned to enterprise data strategy and built in a scalable, sustainable manner.
This position operates as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Analytics, and Reporting teams helping shape how solutions are designed and delivered; enabling Health Enablement Analytics to operate as a reliable, high-impact capability, driving measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Data Governance & Standards
Contribute to the development of data governance standards, and best practices across analytics and reporting.
Provide guidance on data quality, consistency, and appropriate use of enterprise data assets.
Support the standardization of data models, business metrics, and reusable data assets to improve consistency and efficiency.
Implement governance frameworks, ensuring policies are embedded into day-to-day data and analytics workflows.
Establish clear data stewardship accountability across business and analytics teams.
Oversee data quality processes, metadata management, and governance monitoring to ensure sustained data integrity.
Serve as the primary point of contact for Information Governance, data risk, and compliance alignment.
Data Architecture & Platform Alignment
Drive standardization of data assets to reduce fragmentation and enable consistent cross-domain insights.
Provide subject matter expertise on analytics architecture across BI, reporting, and advanced analytics.
Partner with teams to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise data platforms and long‑term strategy.
Recommend architectural approaches that support scalability, interoperability, and reuse.
Technical Enablement & Scalable Delivery
Serve as a technical SME contributing to AI/ML standards and best practices.
Provide guidance to ensure analytic and AI solutions are designed for scalability and sustainability.
Advise on approaches to monitor performance, manage technical debt, and identify architectural risk.
Assess technical feasibility of innovation and analytics initiatives and provide input on viable solution approaches.
Consult on solution design to support production readiness and scalability.
Identify constraints in data or architecture and propose practical workarounds to enable business outcomes.
Define guardrails that enable faster decision-making and reduce execution friction.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Serve as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Data Science, Reporting, and broader enterprise teams.
Translate business and analytics requirements into technical solutions and executable designs.
Provide input on feasibility, architecture, and standards to support solution development.
Collaborate across teams to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise direction while meeting business needs.
Contribute technical expertise to vendor evaluations and platform decisions as needed.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field required.
10+ years of experience in data governance, data architecture, data engineering, and analytics roles.
5+ years of leadership experience driving data governance, data architecture, and analytics platform initiatives at enterprise scale.
Proven ability to define and implement data governance frameworks, standards, and data quality processes.
Strong expertise in: data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse architectures, cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.
Experience enabling analytics and AI/ML solutions to scale from prototype to production deployment.
Strong understanding of BI platforms, ETL/ELT frameworks, and data lifecycle management.
Experience working across analytics, product, engineering, and innovation teams in complex environments.
Ability to translate business and analytics priorities into scalable technical architecture and design.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making capabilities.
Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment as part of a distributed team with effective communication and collaboration skills.
Proven ability to handle stressful situations, multiple tasks, and deadline Enterprise project management methods and process management experience preferred.
Shares information with all appropriate stakeholders and escalates to director in a timely, effective.
Strong written and oral communication The ability to communicate effectively (clear, concise, and professionally) at all levels within Cotiviti.
Demonstrated teamwork, leadership, and project management discipline.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally to drive business outcomes.
Cognitive/Mental Requirements:
Communicating with others to exchange information.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Critical thinker and problem solver with strong analytic modeling and technical skills.
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
No adverse environmental conditions expected
Base compensation ranges from $150,000 to $200,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.
Date of posting: 08/27/2026
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 09/27/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.text:
Description
We're seeking an exceptional, hands-on Data Scientist with deep expertise in data science, MLOps, and building GenAI solutions to join our Enterprise Data & Data Science team. In this role, you'll identify, evaluate, and develop solutions at the intersection of data science, generative AI, and enterprise data strategy—including GenAI evaluation frameworks and semantic data layers. You'll also serve as a community champion, driving the adoption of best practices across a large, collaborative data science organization.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and evaluate generative AI solutions and agentic systems
Develop and maintain data semantic layers and knowledge graphs for enterprise-scale data accessibility
Build evaluation frameworks and tools to assess GenAI systems' performance, reliability, and safety
Collaborate with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and business partners
Champion best practices and tooling across a broad data science community
Lead cross-functional working groups and contribute to innovation in AI/ML methods
Communicate complex technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Serve as a technical consultant on complex, high-impact projects
Please note this is an individual contributor role
Qualifications
Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
Preferred Experience:
Strong foundation in data science and machine learning
Proven MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle
Experience building GenAI solutions and agentic systems
Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies
Experience with data semantic layers and/or knowledge graphs
Track record of cross-functional collaboration in a large enterprise environment
Ability to work ET hours

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
About Avo
Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence-based decision-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high-quality care. Avo changes that.
We are product-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities.
The Role
Avo is hiring a Senior Director of Product to lead product strategy and execution across our platform. This is a leadership role and the ideal candidate will work with our CPO to refine, and operationalize Avo's product vision, driving roadmap decisions that accelerate customer value and long-term platform differentiation. You’ll work directly with our Engineering, Product, Clinical , Customer, and Commercial teams to shape what we build and ship fast.
You will report directly to our Co-Founder/CPO and be a key voice in how Avo evolves its AI copilots, clinical decision support capabilities, and enterprise platform. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped complex, technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving environment - ideally in healthcare or with a deep interest in clinical workflows - and who thrives owning problems end-to-end rather than coordinating around them.
Avo operates as a highly distributed organization, this leader will also be responsible for driving alignment and execution across Product and Engineering teams spanning the United States and South Korea, ensuring strong collaboration, communication, and delivery across multiple time zones.
What You'll Do
Drive the product roadmap across Avo’s suite of products and platform infrastructure, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation
Translate insights from customers, clinicians, sales, and the market into a clear product direction, turning complex clinical workflows and user needs into actionable product requirements and differentiated customer value.
Translate complex clinical use cases into product requirements that engineering can act on and customers can clearly recognize
Demonstrate deep expertise and understanding in UI/UX design by translating complex clinical workflows and product functionality into intuitive, scalable, and customer-centric experiences. Lead the application of user-centered design best practices, driving usability, adoption, and measurable customer value through thoughtful interaction and visual design
Partner with implementation and customer success to close the loop between what we promise, what we ship, and what actually works at the bedside
Work hand-in-hand with engineering leads to scope, sequence, and ship features - from early spec through rollout and iteration, tracking adoption and engagement and various impact metrics
Drive clarity on requirements and tradeoffs, unblocking engineering rather than adding process.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across distributed Product and Engineering teams , establishing effective operating rhythms and communication practices that enable rapid execution across time zones
Maintain a strong perspective on emerging AI technologies, market trends, and competitive dynamics to help define where Avo product should lead
Contribute to sales cycles and customer conversations as a product authority, helping close and retain enterprise accounts.
Mentor junior product team members and help build Avo's product culture as the team scales
What You Bring
7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead PM role
Experience in clinical decision support, or enterprise SaaS serving regulated industries, a plus
Hands-on experience building or managing AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how LLM capabilities and limitations impact user-facing workflows and UX
Track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products and iterating them to scale
Strong instincts for product strategy - you can identify the right problem to solve before prescribing the solution.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you write crisp specs, give clear demos, and can hold your own in a room with health system executives
Experience working closely with engineering and clinical teams - you understand technical architecture well enough to have useful tradeoff conversations
Prior experience at a startup or high-growth company, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move quickly
Comfortable working across US and Asia-Pacific time zones, including early morning or evening hours as needed
Periodic travel to Korea 2–3 times per year, approximately one week per trip. This is not symbolic travel; dedicated in-person engagement is a core responsibility of the role.
Why Join Avo
Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.
Ownership: You will own the execution of our product roadmap from clinical discovery through roadmap decisions, launch, and iteration
High Agency: We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy.
Great Team: Work alongside a talented, low-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft.
Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you’re in the area we’d love the chance to work in-person together 2 days/week.
How We Take Care of Our Team
Generous Time Off: Flexible and generous PTO
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
401K Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future
Personal Device Allowance: Tax-free funds for personal device usage
Compensation and Equity: $200,000 - $225,000 base salary and equity
Avo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation
jobs.text:
Job Title:
Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation
Job Description:
AtEntegris, we’re enabling the technologies that power the world’s most advanced industries. Behind that mission is a modern, data‑driven people ecosystem—and we’re looking for a senior HR technology leader to help shape its future, and drive AI enabled HR excellence at Entegris.
The new Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation, will serve as a leader for theHR Technology COE, partnering closely with senior leaders to define strategy, solve complex enterprise challenges, and lead innovation acrossWorkday, payroll platforms, analytics, and emerging AI technologies.
If you thrive at the intersection ofstrategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and cutting‑edge HR technology, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape how HR operates at scale.
What You’ll Do:
Shape Strategy & Influence at the Enterprise Level
Act as a trusted advisor to senior HR and enterprise leaders on HR Operations, HRIS strategy, risk, controls, and long‑term capability roadmaps.
Represent HR Operations and HR technology perspectives in complex, high‑stakes discussions that impact multiple functions and geographies.
Define principles and governance models that elevate global HR data integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.
Lead Through Ambiguity & Complexity
Own resolution of enterprise‑impacting issues across Workday, payroll, and downstream systems—often with incomplete information and significant complexity.
Apply sound judgment, deep expertise, and systems thinking to drive outcomes that balance risk, user experience, and scalability.
Innovate Through AI, Analytics & Emerging Technologies
Drive innovative operating models and system enhancements leveragingWorkday, analytics, Agentic AI, and emerging HR technologies.
Use data, insights, and trends to identify root causes, uncover improvement opportunities, and influence smarter decision‑making.
Partner with cross‑functional teams and external vendors to test, implement, and scale new capabilities globally.
Enable Process Excellence at Scale
Design and sustain best‑in‑class HR operations through clear standards, controls, and continuous improvement routines.
Establish quality metrics, service benchmarks, and scalable processes that support long‑term growth and audit readiness.
Influence leaders and teams across regions to adopt consistent, high‑quality ways of working.
What Sets You Up for Success:
Strategic & Commercial Mindset
You think beyond systems—connecting technology, operating models, and business outcomes.
You’re comfortable making decisions that impact multiple functions and enterprise priorities.
Stakeholder Leadership
You build strong, credible relationships across HR, Finance, IT, and business leadership.
You know how to tailor communication, challenge thinking respectfully, and align diverse stakeholders toward outcomes.
Technology & Data Fluency
Strong appreciation foranalytics, data governance, and AI‑enabled process design, including emerging Agentic AI capabilities.
Passion for leveraging technology to simplify work, improve accuracy, and elevate employee experience.
Familiarity with Workday and ability to connect Workday to the broader technology landscape.
What we seek:
Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business, Management Information Systems, or a related field
12+ years of progressive experience in HR Technology, HRIS, HR Operations, Payroll, IT, or related enterprise environments
5+ years of people leadership experience, preferably leading teams in a matrixed and global environment
Ability to travel occasionally, both domestically and internationally
Proven experience leading enterprise technology operations strategy, governance, and large-scale transformation initiatives
Demonstrated success driving technology-enabled change in complex, global organizations
Experience working in a global environment with the flexibility to support stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia
Experience partnering with senior leaders across HR, IT, Finance, and business functions to influence strategy and drive organizational outcomes
Experience with Microsoft Co-Pilot a plus
What we offer:
Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.
Compensation: $158,500.00-$211,500.00 a year range with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills for the role
Annual bonus eligible
Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
Education assistance to support your learning journey
A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence
Company anticipates the application window closing approximately 5 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require Company to shorten or extend the application window
Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.
At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

Job Location: Remote Position (USA), Remote, US, US
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Job ID
REQ-10086352
Aug 21, 2026
USA
Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.
Job description summary
The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening oncology-focused data partnerships that sup-port the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across oncology brands, customer engagement, patient access, and field execution.
This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic oncology data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and oncology data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant oncology data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Implement the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial oncology brands, functions, and priority use cases.
Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic oncology data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external oncology data assets.
Apply deep understanding of oncology data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.
Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external oncology data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.
Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, and cross-functional oncology teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
Implement oversight mechanisms for external oncology data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.
Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that oncology data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.
Track oncology data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand oncology business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.
Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.
Experience:
Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing oncology data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of healthcare and oncology data, including the strengths, limitations, governance considerations, and business applications of external data assets. Prior experience working with or for a data vendor is strongly preferred, as this role requires the ability to assess vendor capabilities, challenge data assumptions, manage partnership performance, and translate oncology business needs into practical data solutions. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, and compliance, while building mutually beneficial vendor partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights, vendor expertise, and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.
Essential Requirements:
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 6+ years of experience establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on oncology, healthcare data, data governance, data management, or related roles.
Prior experience working with or for a data vendor, data provider, healthcare data platform, or analytics organization is strongly preferred.
Deep understanding of oncology data assets, including data sourcing, data coverage, refresh cadence, linkage, quality considerations, and fit-for-purpose business use cases.
Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to healthcare data privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of oncology data.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and change management skills in a complex organizational environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess vendor data quality, identify data gaps, manage risks associated with external data partnerships, and ensure the integrity, security, and quality of shared data.
Experience working with IQVIA, Komodo, MMIT, Symphony, Definitive Healthcare, Veeva, Flatiron, or similar healthcare and oncology data sources is highly desirable.
Ability to translate oncology business needs into data solutions and guide teams in selecting and leveraging the right data sets to support decision-making.
Novartis Compensation Summary:
The salary for this position is expected to range between $145,600.00 and $270,400.00 per year.
The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.
Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.
US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.
Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together?

Accessibility & Reasonable Accommodations

jobs.title: SVP of Engineering
jobs.text:
We're looking for our next Channel Champion to join the team as Senior Vice President of Engineering!
About Channelscaler
Channelscaler is transforming how companies scale through their partners. Our AI-powered platform automates and simplifies partner engagement — from onboarding and incentives to performance tracking — helping vendors and partners grow faster together.
With one unified system, companies manage their entire partner lifecycle with ease and clarity. We're building a category-defining company rooted in expertise, empathy, and innovation — and we're just getting started.
About the Role
As the Senior Vice President of Engineering, reporting directly to the CEO, you'll lead our next phase of growth as a builder who embraces AI-first development, rapid innovation, and customer obsession.
This is a transformational role. You'll partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to turn strategy into customer impact, while staying close to the architecture and code as a player-coach — not just an overseer. If you believe AI will fundamentally change how software is built, tested, deployed, and experienced, we want to talk to you.
You'll build and lead a world-class global engineering organization, own the technical roadmap, and represent engineering in customer meetings and executive briefings. This role is central to how Channelscaler scales its platform and establishes itself as the AI leader within the PRM and partner ecosystem market.
Responsibilities
In this role, you'll focus on delivering results that move both the team and company forward by:
Building and leading a world-class global engineering organization, developing managers and engineers who thrive in high-accountability environments.
Establishing clear operating rhythms, performance expectations, and execution discipline, scaling engineering processes without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
Embedding AI across the development lifecycle, from coding assistants and autonomous agents to automated testing and monitoring, and building a culture of fast experimentation.
Increasing velocity and reducing cycle time from concept to customer value, driving predictable execution against roadmap commitments.
Balancing technical debt, platform modernization, innovation, and customer requirements.
Creating visibility into delivery progress and operational metrics for executive leadership and the board.
Partnering closely with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing, and representing engineering in customer meetings and executive briefings.
Owning the technical roadmap and the data-driven infrastructure investments that support long-term growth, ensuring the platform is secure, reliable, performant, and scalable through excellence in architecture, cloud operations, DevOps, and observability.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12 months, you will:
Accelerate product release velocity.
Increase engineering productivity through AI-enabled development.
Attract and retain top engineering talent.
Deliver innovation that materially improves customer outcomes.
Create a scalable operating model capable of supporting the next phase of company growth.
Help establish Channelscaler as the AI leader within the PRM and partner ecosystem market.
Qualifications
Required:
10+ years of engineering leadership in cloud-native and/or modern SaaS environments, including managing distributed teams across multiple time zones through periods of rapid growth.
Strong technical depth in cloud-native architecture, modern development practices, and applied AI and machine learning, including SaaS capacity planning, infrastructure cost management, and margin optimization at scale.
A track record attracting and retaining top talent, and working closely with executive leadership and the board.
Core Competencies:
Player-coach mentality. You stay close to the architecture and code, not just the org chart.
Execution discipline. You balance innovation with delivery and drive predictable execution against roadmap commitments.
AI-native mindset. You see AI as core to how software gets built, tested, deployed, and experienced — not a bolt-on.
Cross-functional fluency. You communicate in a way that aligns technical and non-technical stakeholders and represent engineering credibly with customers and executives.
Low ego, high urgency. You're highly collaborative, comfortable challenging assumptions, and thrive when priorities shift fast.
Preferred (nice to have):
Experience in the PRM, partner ecosystem, or broader GTM/RevOps technology space.
Prior experience scaling engineering organizations through a company's next stage of growth (e.g., Series B/C to later stage, or pre- to post-IPO).
Direct board-level reporting experience.
Location & Work Environment
Channelscaler is a remote-first company with team members across the U.S., Ireland, India, and the U.K. Some travel expected for executive offsites, board meetings, and customer engagements.
What We Offer
We thrive in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment that values curiosity and ownership.
Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus or commission (where applicable)
25 days of paid time off annually
12 dedicated training days per year for professional development
Paid parental leave
Health insurance (PPO and HSA plan options)
401(k) match
Fully remote work environment with flexible hours
Annual team offsites and opportunities for in-person collaboration
Equal Opportunity Employer
Channelscaler is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that diverse teams create better outcomes. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or perform the essential functions of the job, please contact .
Salary: $350K OTE

Job description summary

The Director, Data Strategy defines and advances data strategies for priority US functional domains, translating business priorities into integrated roadmaps, investment recommendations, and scalable data capabilities.

This role leads two functional coverage areas, Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing Organization and focuses on horizontal data needs that cut across brands and therapeutic areas while complementing therapeutic area-specific Data Strategy roles. items: Lead functional data strategy for two priority US coverage areas, Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing Organization, defining roadmaps, priorities, capability needs, and success measures aligned to enterprise data strategy.

jobs.title: Vice President of Information Technology & Chief Information Security Officer (V
jobs.text:
About Multiview
Multiview is The Healthcare ERP Company. Purpose-built for healthcare finance teams, Multiview delivers a powerful, scalable, and cost-effective ERP that unites financials, supply chain management, reporting, and analytics in a single platform. Backed by deep expertise in healthcare finance and recognized by KLAS Research as the #1 ERP for healthcare organizations under 300 beds, Multiview helps mid-sized healthcare organizations gain clarity, move faster, make better decisions, and stay focused on care.
We are a values-led organization:
People First. Client Obsessed. Stronger Together. Work Smart. Believe in Better.
Position Summary
Reporting to the President and CEO, the Vice President of Information Technology & Chief Information Security Officer (VP of IT/CISO) is responsible for leading the organization's overall internal technology strategy, IT operations, cybersecurity programs, and regulatory compliance initiatives. This executive role serves as both the senior technology leader and the principal information security officer, ensuring that technology investments, security controls, and governance programs enable business growth while protecting critical company assets and client data.
As a SaaS ERP provider supporting clients who maintain highly sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI), the VP of IT/CISO is accountable for developing and maintaining a best-in-class security and compliance program that meets the requirements of HIPAA, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and other applicable privacy and security regulations. The role will be responsible for the protection of internal corporate systems and cloud infrastructure. This is not a DevOps role, nor is there DevOps responsibility, however our compliance and security are owned by this position.
The ideal candidate is a strategic executive capable of balancing innovation, scalability, risk management, compliance, and execution at a high level of operational excellence in a high-growth SaaS environment. A successful VP of IT/CISO will combine the strategic mindset of a technology executive with the rigour of a security leader.
This role is not suited for someone who prefers delegation or high-level oversight alone. The VP of IT/CISO must be eager to roll up their sleeves, dive into day-to-day IT activities, and personally influence the employee and stakeholder experience.
We are a proud award winning employer and intend to continue to improve the company as a place to work so that we can be worthy of the incredible talent we have.
We are a remote-first company and welcome candidates across Canada. The expectations are that in-person meetings or in-person work will be less than 10% of the time.
We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
If you bring strong IT leadership, a passion for security, and a willingness to work directly at both strategic and tactical levels, we want to hear from you.
The salary for this role is $180,000.00 to 250,000.00 CAD plus variable. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
Key Responsibilities
Executive Leadership & Strategy
Develop and execute the organization's IT and cybersecurity strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on technology investments, cybersecurity risk, compliance obligations, and operational scalability.
Establish IT and security roadmaps that enable growth, scalability and employee effectiveness.
Lead annual technology planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation processes.
Present regular updates to leadership regarding cybersecurity posture, risk landscape, compliance status, and strategic initiatives.
Build and lead a high-performing technology and security organization focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Support and participate as required on the Security & Privacy Committee.
Cybersecurity & Information Security Leadership
Serve as the company's Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) with enterprise-wide responsibility for information security governance.
Implement and maintain an enterprise cybersecurity program based on recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
Maintain appropriate security architecture, policies, procedures, and standards across all systems and environments.
Lead security monitoring, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat intelligence, security operations, and incident response capabilities.
Ensure implementation of robust identity and access management, privileged access controls, multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and zero-trust principles.
Oversee third-party security reviews and vendor risk management programs.
Direct forensic investigations, incident response activities, and breach notification processes when required.
Conduct regular cybersecurity risk assessments and maintain enterprise risk registers.
Data Privacy & Compliance
Maintain responsibility for protecting sensitive data and ensuring continued compliance with applicable standards including:
HIPAA
Provincial, state and federal privacy regulations
SOC 2 Type II requirements
Client contractual security obligations
Partner with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Client Success teams to ensure proper handling of PHI and Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
Oversee security controls protecting client data throughout its lifecycle including collection, transmission, storage, processing, backup, archival, and destruction.
Ensure implementation of appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for all regulated information.
Lead client security reviews, audits, and due diligence assessments.
Serve as executive sponsor for external audits, compliance certifications, and client risk assessments.
Serves as Privacy Officer
IT Infrastructure & Operations
Lead all internal IT operations including corporate systems, service desk, networking, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and collaboration platforms.
Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and resilience testing programs.
Monitor and maintain appropriate service-level agreements (SLAs), operational metrics, and performance standards.
Drive modernization, automation strategies, and operational excellence programs, including support functions to improve security posture, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
Support organizational wide adoption of AI to increase velocity of stakeholder impact.
Ensure secure remote workforce capabilities and endpoint management practices.
SaaS Platform Security
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Champion secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles.
Oversee application security programs and cloud-native security controls across AWS and applicable multi-cloud environments with Engineering.
Ensure corporate applications maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
Support the completion of RFP/RFQs from prospective and current clients and other stakeholders as required.
Risk Management & Governance
Maintain applicable enterprise technology governance structures and security oversight programs.
Develop risk management methodologies and reporting mechanisms.
Maintain cybersecurity insurance readiness and support annual policy renewals.
Create meaningful executive dashboards and KPIs related to:
Security risk
Compliance posture
System availability
IT performance
Audit findings
Incident response metrics
Lead business continuity and crisis management planning efforts.
Team Development & Vendor Management
Recruit, develop, and retain top-tier IT and cybersecurity talent.
Foster a culture of accountability, security awareness, and client-centric service.
Manage strategic technology vendors, managed service providers, cloud providers, and security partners.
Negotiate and manage technology contracts and licensing agreements.
Develop succession plans for critical technology and security leadership positions.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field.
12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
7+ years leading enterprise cybersecurity programs.
Experience serving as a CISO, VP of IT, CIO, or equivalent
Experience within SaaS, cloud software, healthcare technology, ERP software, or highly regulated industries with specific data-handling considerations.
Strong understanding of applicable security, privacy and compliance standards, certifications and frameworks including:
HIPAA
NIST Cybersecurity Framework
ISO 27001
Experience managing IT budgets and technology organizations.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Professional certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CCSP, HCISPP
Experience leading organizations through significant growth and scaling initiatives.
Experience supporting rapidly growing SaaS businesses.
Strong understanding of data privacy and protection laws.
Experience and curiosity surrounding the advancements of AI in SaaS operations.
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS
Please submit your resume, and a cover letter describing, why you are a unique fit for this position by applying to this posting. We thank all applicants for expressing their interest in Multiview; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Multiview is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs.
ACCESSIBILITY & DIVERSITY:
Multiview promotes a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. By embracing diversity, we are building a more effective organization that empowers our employees to be the best that they can be. We know that diversity of thought makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encouraging everyone to apply.
Multiview is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to creating a barrier-free working environment for all. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and Ontario Human Rights Code, Multiview will provide accommodation throughout the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process for applicants with disabilities, upon request.

jobs.title: Director, Creative Technology (US)
jobs.text:
The Director of Creative Technology leads enterprise transformations by architecting scalable, AI-native visual production pipelines across 3D asset generation, motion design, and generative AI architectures. You will lead cross-functional pods of creative technologists, set production engineering standards, and navigate high-stakes technical diplomacy across executive marketing, IT, and creative leadership.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Architect enterprise visual automation systems connecting 3D DCC environments, motion graphics renderers, generative APIs (Adobe Firefly Services), and client DAM platforms
Establish technical standards for local GPU compute vs. cloud API load balancing, render token efficiency, and failover architecture across global rollouts (30+ regional markets)
Serve as the senior technical lead and creative diplomat in client engagements, building trust with skeptical Executive Creative Directors and lead 3D artists
Drive adoption of modern pipeline paradigms, including MCP-driven agentic workflows, custom node-graph architectures, and automated render pipelines
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
8+ years in Creative Technology, 3D Pipeline Engineering, or Visual R&D leadership
Track record of architecting scriptable 3D and motion pipelines (Python, USD/glTF, Blender, After Effects)
Expertise in enterprise generative architectures, hybrid render infrastructures (on-prem GPU vs. cloud API), and enterprise DAM integrations
Superior executive presence and technical diplomacy skills
ABOUT US
Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.
Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.
The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.
The compensation range for this role is $160,000 – $225,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.
