jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
jobs.text:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw
We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.
We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.
About the role: What's in the Box
HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.
The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.
What you’ll do: The Recipe
WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level
What you’ll bring: The Ingredients
Technical/Engineering Experience
10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies
Product Experience
Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
What we offer: The Toppings
Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.
Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.
Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.
Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.
Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Risk (Parameter Management & Price Protection)
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.
You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.
What You’ll Be Doing
Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.
Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.
Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.
Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.
Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.
Stay close to markets and users. Maintain regular communication with traders, institutional clients, and market-making teams. Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.
Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..
What We Look For In You
Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.
An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.

Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.
As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.
What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:
Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.
Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.
Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.
Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.
Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.
Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.
Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.
Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.
Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.
Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.
Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.
Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.
Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.
Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.
Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.
Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).
How to be successful in this role:
10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.
A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.
Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.
Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.
A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.
Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.
Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.
Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.
A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.
A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.
Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.
Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.
Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
11 company-paid holidays
Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.
#LI-remote
At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
Referral Instructions
If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

jobs.title: VP of Product, Growth and Monetization
jobs.text:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in!
Our Product Managers (PMs) have ownership over product optimizations and features, from independently run experiments to major product decisions. Backed by strong analytical skills and business acumen, and inspired by access to senior leadership and transparency into how they make product decisions, our PMs develop insights that lead to new product ideas and Duolingo’s next beloved feature.
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
About the role...
Duolingo’s business runs on two numbers: Daily Active Users and revenue. This role owns both. As VP of Product for Growth and Monetization, you'll lead our largest product organization through a team of experienced pillar leads. Your teams shape how learners come back every day and why they choose to pay. You'll run one of the highest-velocity experimentation engines in consumer tech, with a mandate to grow DAUs and revenue sustainably and never at the expense of learners. This role reports to the Chief Product Officer, joins Duolingo's Product Leadership and Senior Leadership Team (SLT), and is based in New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA on a hybrid (4+1) schedule.
🧠 You will...
Own DAUs and revenue, Duolingo's two hero metrics, and deliver both against forecast.
Manage the pillar leads who run Growth and Monetization, an org of roughly 20 PMs and our largest.
Coach and develop senior product leaders, and raise the bar for product talent across the company.
Partner with Engineering and Design leadership to make clear tradeoffs and ship quickly.
Build world-class product operating mechanisms: Clear north star metrics, planning and review rituals, and rigorous A/B testing.
Allocate resources across Growth and Monetization, balancing steady optimization with bigger swings.
Be the single voice for Growth and Monetization at the executive level: progress, risks, and the plan to hit both numbers.
✅ You have...
Executive product leadership in consumer tech, with multi-year measurable impact on DAUs or revenue at scale.
High judgment and operational rigor, with a record of hitting forecasts without sacrificing user experience.
A track record of leading managers of managers and developing strong product leaders.
Experience leading through change: reorgs, new operating models, faster execution.
Cross-functional range, aligning Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing on clear priorities.
Deep fluency in growth and monetization for freemium and subscription products, grounded in experimentation.
Ability to work from or relocate to New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA on a hybrid (4+1) schedule.
⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...
Delivered stellar results growing a leading consumer app, whether in DAUs or revenue.
Demonstrated success balancing user growth and revenue expansion without degrading core user experience in a mission-driven product.
Experience communicating product strategy and results to executive and board-level audiences.
Developed product leaders who've gone on to run product orgs of their own.
Familiarity with ads, subscriptions, and in-app purchase ecosystems, including experimentation at scale across these surfaces.
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!
Salary Range:
$367,500—$612,500 USD
Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.
Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.
Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.
Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.
By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: VP, Global Solution Engineering
jobs.text:
See what you can do with Prophix
At Prophix, we’re building the platform that helps finance teams stop managing spreadsheets and start driving strategy. Prophix One™ brings planning, reporting, consolidation, and automation together in a single place, and we are expanding its AI capabilities faster than ever. If you want to work on a product that genuinely changes how finance teams operate, and do it alongside people who care about getting it right, this is where you want to be.
We’re headquartered in the Greater Toronto Area, with teams and offices across North America, Europe, and Australia. Trusted by more than 3,000 finance teams across 100+ countries, Prophix One™ is built for organizations that want to plan smarter and move faster.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
THE ROLE
Zeta Global is seeking a strategic, client-facing Director to join our ZX Data Science & Analytics team. This role is ideal for an experienced analytics leader who excels at transforming complex data into compelling narratives, influencing client strategy, and driving measurable business outcomes.
The Director will serve as a trusted analytics partner to clients and internal teams, bringing together marketing measurement, advanced analytics, media strategy, and data storytelling to make insights actionable. This individual will also help scale analytics best practices across clients and categories, strengthen partnerships with Sales and cross-functional teams, and contribute to the continued evolution of ZX Analytics solutions and measurement products.
This position reports to the VP of Data Science & Analytics.
Responsibilities:
Lead with Storytelling: Translate complex analytics and media performance into clear, persuasive narratives that connect insights to client business priorities and inspire action.
Shape Client Strategy: Develop analytics approaches aligned with client objectives, using insights to inform acquisition, retention, lifetime value, media, and optimization strategies. Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal partners.
Drive Measurement Excellence: Apply and advocate for best-in-class measurement methodologies, including Test/Holdout-based incrementality measurement. Help clients and internal teams understand the strengths, limitations, and business implications of different measurement approaches.
Scale Best Practices: Identify learnings across clients, campaigns, and categories and translate them into repeatable best practices, frameworks, and recommendations that improve the quality and consistency of analytics deliverables.
Team Leadership: manage and develop a team of analysts, including coaching, onboarding, workload prioritization, performance management, feedback, recognition, and career development. Mentor mid-level analysts in both technical and client-facing skills.
Lead Strategic Initiatives: Serve as analytics lead and subject matter expert for select strategic initiatives, helping define solutions, align stakeholders, and move work from concept through implementation.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner effectively with Sales, Client Services, Client Development, Operations, and other teams to solve client challenges, improve processes, and deliver high-quality analytics solutions with limited senior leadership intervention.
Innovate with AI: Support the development, application, and adoption of predictive and adaptive ML/AI solutions, helping translate model outputs into clear business recommendations and client value.
REQUIREMENTS
10+ years of professional experience in analytics, marketing measurement, data science, media analytics, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression in responsibility and client impact.
Proven ability to translate complex analytics into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for client and business audiences.
Strong client-facing experience with excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to command an audience and serve as a model for effective client communication.
3+ years in analytics leadership roles, ideally with team management experience.
Demonstrated subject matter expertise in one or more analytics, measurement, media, or industry domains, with the ability to share knowledge and elevate the capabilities of others.
Working familiarity with Python, SQL, Tableau or comparable analytical and visualization tools, as well as experience working with predictive analytics and/or ML/AI models.
Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions in support of clients and the business, give and receive feedback effectively, and challenge existing approaches constructively.
Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred in Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, or related fields.
Experience in Retail, Financial Services, Telecom, or Travel verticals is a plus.
This is a remote role based out of the United States.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Flexible PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance
SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this role is $150,000-$165,000 depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Director of Product, Search and Curated Experiences
jobs.text:
About AlphaSense:
The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
About the Team
AlphaSense's Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions. Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.
If you're passionate about creating industry-leading tools that shape the future of business intelligence, we'd love to meet you.
About the Role
We are seeking a senior, deeply technical product leader to own Search and Curated Experiences AlphaSense. Search is the front door to a corpus of hundreds of millions of business documents, and the relevance, ranking, document-type coverage, filtering, and performance you own sit underneath every product surface. Curated Experiences define how AlphaSense’s content, functionality, and intelligence show up in pre-built experiences that act as a launchpad for our customers’ research - everything from company profiles and industry profiles, to monitoring and beyond.
This is a leadership role, not a feature role. You will set the search strategy, own the metrics, and be the person the organization turns to drive impact with both Search and Curated Experiences. You will lead a small team, including a domain-expert for Curated Experiences. We expect you to own these programs end to end, with the judgment, drive, and initiative to take them all the way.
What You'll Do
Own both Search and Curated Experiences: Relevance, ranking, query understanding, document-type coverage, filters, latency, and reliability across every surface that depends on search are your ownership areas, alongside adoption and engagement of company profiles and future new curated experiences.
Define the strategy: Set and defend a roadmap that balances relevance quality, coverage, and performance against clear business priorities.
Build evaluation and measurement: Stand up the metrics, benchmarks, and experimentation needed to know whether search is getting better, and to prove it.
Collaborate across teams: Partner closely with Knowledge Graph, SuperAnalyst / AI, Engineering, and Design so that search and the experiences built on top of it move together.
Lead and grow a team: Manage and mentor the curated-experiences / domain-expert PM, set clear ownership, and raise the bar for the search org as it grows.
Execute and deliver: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - from strategy and experimentation through launch, post-launch analysis, and iteration.
Who You Are
Deeply Technical: You have built search and relevance systems at scale - e.g., a Google Search-caliber background or equivalent depth in ranking, retrieval, query understanding, and evaluation. You can reason fluently about representation, freshness, quality, and system-design tradeoffs.
Strong Ownership & Drive: You take programs end to end and operate autonomously. You set direction, make the calls, and are accountable for the outcome.
A People Leader: You can manage and grow PMs, set clear lines of ownership, and resolve ambiguity rather than create it.
Analytical & Data-Driven: You balance business goals with technical capability and let metrics, not opinion, settle questions of search quality.
Strong Customer Orientation: You understand how sophisticated users search and form conviction, and you use interviews, usability testing, and behavioral data to validate hypotheses.
Clear Communicator: You can align engineering, design, and product marketing around a roadmap and gain buy-in to drive high-impact work.
Domain Experience a Plus: Direct experience in financial services, capital markets, or with our core customers (financial services, corporate strategy, consulting) is a plus, but not required.
For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
Base Compensation Range
$275,000—$290,000 USD
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:
AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.
If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.text:
Job Title: Director, AI Foundations Engineering (2 Openings)
Job Location: Remote Position (USA), Remote, US, US
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Job ID
REQ-10086116
Aug 21, 2026
USA
Summary
The Director, AI Foundations Engineer will drive the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.
There are 2 positions available.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the design and development and ongoing improvement of the organization's AI foundations that will enable use cases through a disciplined engineering approach
Define and implement an agentic AI foundational system, engineering standards, and development practices that promote scalability, reliability, repeatability, and continuous improvement
Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise needs and strategic priorities.
Oversee engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that enable agentic AI products and workflows.
Drive modernization and integration efforts to connect existing systems and processes with AI capabilities.
Monitor agentic operations and user feedback to identify improvements, resolve issues, and support continuous optimization.
Establish effective operating models, support processes, and governance practices to ensure consistent delivery of AI capabilities
Communicate platform priorities, delivery progress, technical risks, and investment needs to senior leaders and cross functional stakeholders.
Essential Requirements:
Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.
8 plus years of AI engineering experience, with a strong track record of leading product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for complex digital, data, or AI enabled products.
Demonstrated experience in AI and data driven product environments, including translating business needs into scalable product solutions and partnering closely with technical teams to bring innovative products to market.
Strong cross functional leadership skills, with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Innovation, Design, Data Science, Commercial, and other business teams to drive alignment and execution.
Experience managing and developing product managers or junior product leaders, including coaching, prioritization support, and fostering strong product management practices.
Excellent strategic, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, make informed tradeoffs, and clearly communicate product vision, priorities, and outcomes to stakeholders.
Novartis Compensation Summary:
The salary for this position is expected to range between $194,600 and $361,400 per year.
The final salary offered isdeterminedbased on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
Company Overview
At Fluency, we come together under two shared passions that drive our culture: the scaling of digital ad operations, and fostering a workplace environment rooted in open communication, inclusivity, and a growth-oriented mindset. These passions not only set us apart in the industry, but also fuel our collective drive to reshape the industry and reinvent ourselves along the way. We're not just revolutionizing the digital advertising horizon, we're shaping an organization where every member feels a sense of pride and is inspired to do their best work.
Job Summary
The VP of Engineering is a strategic executive leader responsible for the long-term technical vision, organizational health, and scalable architecture of the Fluency platform. This role moves beyond day-to-day tactical ownership to focus on building high-leverage organizational structures, cross-functional alignment at the executive level, and a platform foundation that supports massive customer growth without proportional increases in technical debt. Crucially, this leader brings a proven track record of designing and executing large-scale system implementations within the high-volume advertising technology (Ad-Tech) or digital advertising ecosystem to fuel our next phase of scale.
Key Executive Responsibilities
Executive Strategy & Influence: Partner with the CTO and C-Suite to define the long-term engineering roadmap and ensure continuous alignment with overarching company strategy and platform stability requirements.
Organizational Architecture: Continuously refine and oversee the engineering organizational structure (e.g., Squad model) to ensure directors and leads are empowered to operate independently, preventing the VP from becoming a tactical constraint.
Platform Resilience & Ad-Tech Scale: Maintain and evolve the strategic architectural direction of the Fluency platform—particularly blending our cellular/isolated database architecture with the high-concurrency, low-latency requirements characteristic of large-scale advertising systems. Ensure robust resilience under massive data volumes for hundreds of enterprise customers.
Experimentation Framework: Define and enforce engineering standards and clear operational boundaries between experimental product R&D (Labs) and stable core engineering to safeguard platform integrity.
Remote Leadership Excellence: Lead and foster a high-performance, geographically distributed remote engineering culture, ensuring seamless communication, accountability, and operational excellence across all time zones.
Talent Strategy: Develop and manage the long-term talent strategy, overseeing hiring, professional development pipelines, and succession planning to ensure staffing aligns with future technical and business needs.
What We Look For
Strategic Visionary: A leader who can articulate the business impact of technical debt and infrastructure investments to non-technical stakeholders.
Systems Thinker: Proven ability to build "systems of people" that solve complex problems without needing direct executive intervention.
Ad-Tech Scale Expertise: Deep operational understanding of high-throughput distributed systems, heavy data pipeline mechanics, and ecosystem integrations unique to the advertising world.
Crisis Management Executive: Ability to remain calm and decisive during high-stakes incidents while simultaneously building the frameworks to prevent their recurrence.
Executive Presence: Comfortable navigating organizational resistance and building compelling business cases for modernization.
Required Experience
10+ years of progressive experience in engineering leadership.
5+ years of engineering leadership experience specifically within the advertising industry (Ad-Tech, Mar-Tech, or high-volume digital media platforms), successfully delivering large-scale system implementations.
Proven track record of scaling a SaaS platform through significant revenue and customer growth.
Experience managing multiple managers or directors in a squad-based or departmental structure.
Deep familiarity with AI-powered development tools and their impact on engineering productivity.
Fluency pays all employees based on U.S. nationwide averages for each role, designed to ensure pay equity. This is a full-time, remote position that requires legal authorization to work in the U.S. Starting pay range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and knowledge. The role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package including:
• Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families
• 401(k) plan with company match
• Four weeks of Combined Time Off (CTO), flexible schedule, and twelve holidays
• Maternity and parental leave
• Employee wellness programs and mental health support
• Remote work flexibility and home office stipends
Starting Pay Range
$172,000—$220,000 USD
At Fluency, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.
Employment decisions at Fluency are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications—without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. The service is designed for high throughput, and 99.999 availability. We're looking for a technical leader to help us to continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective and efficient infrastructure, processes and tooling.
As the Director of Site Reliability Engineering you will oversee the SRE organization focused on Okta platform, Databases, Edge networking, K8s platform, CI/CD, Observability, FinOps, and automation platform & tooling.
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
Build and lead a high-caliber India-based SRE organization supporting Okta’s production fleet.
Partner with global engineering, product, and infrastructure leaders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure services.
Define and execute the India SRE strategy in alignment with global reliability goals.
Lead post-incident reviews, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure long-term corrective actions. Participate in incident management, on-call rotations, and blameless RCAs.
Implement automation and observability to reduce manual toil and improve operational efficiency. Drive adoption of modern infrastructure practices: infrastructure as code (Terraform), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and AI within Infrastructure org.
Hire, mentor, and develop top SRE talent across India; build a strong engineering culture centered on reliability and innovation.
Foster collaboration across time zones with U.S. and EMEA teams.
Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.
Maintain a deep knowledge of industry best practices, evolving trends, and technologies.
Manage service and business expectations and prioritize resource allocation.
Accelerate the velocity of SRE and product engineering by developing robust platforms, powerful tooling, and intuitive self-service capabilities.
Improve SDLC processes for Cloud infrastructure as a code, including the maturity of CI/CD pipelines, change and release management.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
16+ years of experience in site reliability, infrastructure, or production engineering roles.
8+ years of experience in technical leadership & people management including managing managers. Strong expertise in automation, observability, performance optimization, and incident response.
Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-cultural collaboration skills—particularly in a global matrixed setup.
Experience building or scaling offshore SRE teams that partner with global counterparts.
4+ years of experience running the SRE org supporting a SaaS/Cloud service in a public Cloud, preferably AWS. Experience supporting a multi-Cloud environment will be a plus.
Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures, containerization (Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage large-scale programs
Effective verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills
Education and Training:
Computer Science Degree or related degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer:in (m/w/d)
jobs.text:
das erwartet dich bei ida
Als CTO übernimmst du die strategische Leitung unserer Tech-Unit und den rund 40 Mitarbeiter:innen, die zur Unit gehören.
Dein Fokus liegt dabei nicht auf der operativen Arbeit in Projekten, sondern auf dem Steuern: Du gibst der Unit Richtung, sorgst für Verbindlichkeit und schaffst die Rahmenbedingungen, unter denen unsere Teams ihr Bestes geben können.
Gemeinsam mit unseren Teamleads verantwortest du die fachliche und personelle Weiterentwicklung der Unit: Du entwickelst also Menschen und Strukturen, statt selbst zu programmieren.
Unterdessen behältst du selbstredend die Auslastung und Kapazitäten der Unit im Blick und sorgst mit vorausschauender Ressourcen- und Kapazitätsplanung dafür, dass unsere Teams weder über- noch unterlastet sind.
Als unser:e CTO verfolgst du Technologie-Trends für ida, kennst die aktuellen Entwicklungen und Workflows bei der Umsetzung komplexer Softwareprojekte und treibst insbesondere das Thema KI aktiv voran – von der strategischen Einordnung bis zum konkreten Nutzen für unsere Arbeit und die unserer Kund:innen.
Apropos: Ohne unsere Kund:innen wären wir nichts. Daher stimmst du die technologische Vision eng mit ihnen ab und begleitest sie als Sparringspartner:in auf ihrem Weg.
Zudem challengst du unsere Aufwandsschätzungen und technischen Konzepte für größere Projekte und Ausschreibungen, hinterfragst sie konstruktiv und hilfst uns auf diese Weise, realistisch zu planen und sauber zu liefern.
Darüber hinaus bist du ein zentraler Teil des ida-Managements, nimmst wesentlichen Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung sowie die Portfolioentwicklung unserer Agentur und bist verantwortlich für relevante KPIs und Budgets.
Du arbeitest lieber remote oder im Office? Wir können beides, ganz wie du willst.
Besonders schön: Bei ida hast du die Möglichkeit, die Angebote der öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunkanstalten und anderer Medienhäuser maßgeblich mitzugestalten und zu verbessern – und damit einen positiven Beitrag für unsere Gesellschaft zu leisten.
das bringst du mit
Unerlässlich: Du hast fundierte Führungserfahrung im agilen Kontext und Erfahrung im Führung von Führungskräften. Das heißt, du verstehst dich in erster Linie als Manager:in und Enabler:in und nicht als operativ mitarbeitende:r Entwickler:in.
Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit und Eigeninitiative sind deine echten Stärken. Das bedeutet, du triffst Absprachen, hältst sie ein und gehst Themen von dir aus an, statt darauf zu warten, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.
Daher ist es auch besonders wichtig, dass du Probleme nicht nur benennst, sondern sie auch selbst löst und so in deiner Rolle maßgeblich die Kultur bei ida mitprägst: Vorbildwirkung und so ...
Zudem bringst du ein gutes technologisches Verständnis mit und hast ein Gespür für Technologie-Trends, Tools und Practices sowie ihre Relevanz fürs Geschäft, aber again: tiefe Hands-on-Coding-Praxis ist ausdrücklich keine Voraussetzung für den Job.
Klar, dass du unterdessen auch ein sehr gutes Netzwerk in der Tech-Branche pflegst und es stetig weiter ausbaust.
Und wenn du darüber hinaus bereits Erfahrungen in einer Digitalagentur und/oder in einem Medienhaus gesammelt hast, dann wäre das natürlich die Kirsche auf dem Milchshake.
was uns besonders wichtig ist
Diversität ist etwas, wonach wir streben. FLINTA* , BIPoC, LGBTQIA+ und Menschen mit Behinderung möchten wir daher ganz ausdrücklich ermutigen, sich bei ida zu bewerben. Wir haben hier einige Anforderungen aufgeschrieben, aber du erfüllst nicht alle? Macht nix. Wir freuen uns auf dich.
Du sagst, das könnte passen? Dann lass uns miteinander reden! Schick deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung direkt an uns über unser Bewerbungsformular.

Darüber hinaus bist du ein zentraler Teil des ida-Managements, nimmst wesentlichen Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung sowie die Portfolioentwicklung unserer Agentur und bist verantwortlich für relevante KPIs und Budgets.
Du arbeitest lieber remote oder im Office? Wir können beides, ganz wie du willst.

Besonders schön: Bei ida hast du die Möglichkeit, die Angebote der öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunkanstalten und anderer Medienhäuser maßgeblich mitzugestalten und zu verbessern – und damit einen positiven Beitrag für unsere Gesellschaft zu leisten.
das bringst du mit

Unerlässlich: Du hast fundierte Führungserfahrung im agilen Kontext und Erfahrung im Führung von Führungskräften. Das heißt, du verstehst dich in erster Linie als Manager:in und Enabler:in und nicht als operativ mitarbeitende:r Entwickler:in.

Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit und Eigeninitiative sind deine echten Stärken. Das bedeutet, du triffst Absprachen, hältst sie ein und gehst Themen von dir aus an, statt darauf zu warten, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.
Daher ist es auch besonders wichtig, dass du Probleme nicht nur benennst, sondern sie auch selbst löst und so in deiner Rolle maßgeblich die Kultur bei ida mitprägst: Vorbildwirkung und so ...

Zudem bringst du ein gutes technologisches Verständnis mit und hast ein Gespür für Technologie-Trends, Tools und Practices sowie ihre Relevanz fürs Geschäft, aber again: tiefe Hands-on-Coding-Praxis ist ausdrücklich keine Voraussetzung für den Job.
Klar, dass du unterdessen auch ein sehr gutes Netzwerk in der Tech-Branche pflegst und es stetig weiter ausbaust.
Und wenn du darüber hinaus bereits Erfahrungen in einer Digitalagentur und/oder in einem Medienhaus gesammelt hast, dann wäre das natürlich die Kirsche auf dem Milchshake.
was uns besonders wichtig ist

Diversität ist etwas, wonach wir streben. FLINTA* , BIPoC, LGBTQIA+ und Menschen mit Behinderung möchten wir daher ganz ausdrücklich ermutigen, sich bei ida zu bewerben. Wir haben hier einige Anforderungen aufgeschrieben, aber du erfüllst nicht alle? Macht nix. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Du sagst, das könnte passen? Dann lass uns miteinander reden! Schick deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung direkt an uns über unser Bewerbungsformular.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Engineering
jobs.text:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.
Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.
Why join Solaris?
🚀 We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
🎯 We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
💡 Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
⚖️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.
The Head of Product & Engineering is a dual-domain leadership role reporting directly to the Executive Director of Technology. In this position, you will be primarily responsible for driving our Product Foundations and Business Enablement initiatives. You will own both the product vision and engineering delivery for foundational capabilities - such as core APIs, developer tools, and internal automation platforms - that power our broader technology ecosystem and enable internal business units to scale efficiently.
Your Role
Dual-Domain Leadership (Product & Engineering)
Serve as the ultimate owner of both the what/why (Product Roadmap) and the how (Engineering Execution) for foundational technical products.
Lead, mentor, and scale teams composed of both Product Managers and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and engineering excellence.
Product Foundation & Core APIs
Oversee the development and scaling of our most critical technical capabilities, including Authentication services, API proxies, Policy engines, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Webhook architectures.
Ensure these foundational tech products reliably power the entirety of Solaris's external and internal-facing API suite, maintaining high availability, security, and low latency.
Developer Productivity & Experience (DevEx)
Lead the teams responsible for developer productivity, managing tools like Backstage and defining SRE capabilities.
Create a frictionless development environment that allows Solaris engineers to build, test, and deploy securely and autonomously.
Business Enablement & Internal Automation
Drive the internal automation platform to support and scale various business units across Solaris.
Oversee the integration of internal toolings, the implementation of complex workflow systems, and the creation of robust build-automation frameworks.
Identify manual bottlenecks in business processes and deploy technical solutions to automate them, enabling the company to scale efficiently without an increase in overhead.
We'd love to see
Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.
Have proven experience as a senior engineering leader with hands-on architectural experience in distributed systems, microservices, and Core APIs.
Demonstrated success in product leadership, specifically managing internal platforms, developer tools, or highly technical API-as-a-Product offerings.
3+ years of experience leading product and engineering organisation.
Experience implementing and managing internal developer portals (like Spotify's Backstage) and a deep empathy for the developer journey.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders, and vice versa.
Have successfully scaled both technology platforms and the organizational structures that support them in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Strong understanding of IAM, authentication flows (OAuth, OIDC), API gateways/proxies, webhook infrastructure, and SRE best practices.
Track record of designing workflow systems and automation frameworks that streamline business operations.
Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.
Benefits
Home office budget.
Learning & development budget of €1000 per year and a transparent growth framework to support your career goals.
Competitive salary and a variable remuneration program.
Monthly meal allowance.
Deutschland ticket subsidy.
28 vacation days, increasing by 2 days after 2 years and 3 days after 3 years with Solaris.
Opportunity to work abroad for up to 12 weeks per year.
While job ads usually paint an ideal picture of a candidate, studies show that most applicants meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Unfortunately, many promising candidates tend to apply only if they meet all the criteria. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single item in the job description, please contact us anyway. We'd love to talk with you and find out if you might be a good fit for us.
At Solaris, we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment, where all Solarians feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of color, ethnicity, religion, sex, origin, disability, marital status, citizenship, or gender identity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
If your application is successful, you will be required to complete pre-employment background checks through our screening provider Zinc. These include, but not limited to identity verification, educational records, references, a criminal record check, etc. The processing is based on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Please see below Privacy Information for Job Applicants for details, including recipients, retention, and your rights.
Information on data processing:
DE: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr_notice_de
EN: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr_notice_en
The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€120.000—€140.000 EUR

jobs.title: Director Engineering - Investment & Pension domain (m/f/d)
jobs.text:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
For further development and expansion of our successful business, Raisin is looking for a highly motivated, driven, and experienced Director of Engineering to lead both strategically and operationally our Investment and Pension (IPP) teams (25+ engineers)
This embraces high-quality conceptual and delivery performance of the teams, the health of the IPP engineering organization and system landscape, an efficient and compliant development process, technical and business ownership of the Raisin’s IPP platform, and vendor relationships.
At Raisin, we work in a domain driven organization with a binary-star leadership model. In this model, every Director of Engineering has a Product partner (Head of Product/ Director of Product).
The Director Engineering (DE) leads both strategically and operationally across multiple cross-functional teams.
This embraces the six impact areas (in details below):
Delivery quality and speed
Domain ownership
Team and culture
Data strategy
Process and compliance
Your Responsibilities
Delivery quality and speed
The DE is:
accountable for fulfilling the agreed team commitments to their business-owners in time, scope, and budget
responsible for the performance of their teams
resolving impediments for their teams
nurturing a culture of accountability, pragmatism, and reusability
ensuring a strong delivery oriented collaboration between the different engineering teams
leading both complex technical and important business projects
leading internal software engineering projects and initiatives
Domain ownership
The DE:
drives long-term value creation for their domain
is fostering an environment of passion and fun for the business processes in their tribe
builds resilient domain expertise in their teams
has a deep understanding of the existing system landscape of their teams
collaborates closely with their Business Owner and other stakeholders
vendor management (evaluating, onboarding, and managing vendors)
Tech Strategy
The DE:
shapes the technical strategy for their teams according to the Raisin's business needs
collaborates closely with other Sr. Engineering Leads in shaping and implementing Raisin's Tech Strategy
actively initiates and contributes to strategic technical and architectural decisions
is always considering the strategic benefits and price of:
keeping an existing technical solution
introducing a new alternative (e.g framework, tech stack, tooling, process)
Team and Culture
The DE is:
fully responsible for the health, resilience high performance, and development of their teams
offering direct leadership of engineering leads and sometimes also tech leads as well
encouraging accountability, creativity, risk-taking, and ownership by delegating responsibility
attracting, hiring, and retaining top technical talent for Raisin from around the world
proactively mentoring and coaching individual team members
ensuring a strong delivery-oriented collaboration between the different engineering teams
organizing workshops/hackathons
representing the company in external tech events advancing Raisin’s tech brand recognition
shaping and driving knowledge transfer best practices
nurturing and protecting our culture of trust
initiating, owning and nurturing tech initiatives (like guilds, workshops, regular meetups)
recognizing high performance and rewarding accomplishments within their teams
Process and Compliance
The DE:
drives, improves, and applies existing Raisin standards and policies, regulation and data privacy
contributes to an optimal toolchain with a high level of automation
develops, establishes, and continually improves documentation standards for the engineering organization
develops guidelines and best practices to ensure a lean software development process across different product teams
is responsible for the KPI-based reporting for their teams
actively monitors, analyses, and drives initiatives to continuously reduce their teams' technical debt
Your Profile
You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields or have equivalent practical experience
Leadership experience 10y+. You are a senior engineering leader, across projects and teams, with a natural aptitude and passion for growing and developing high-performing teams
You have at least 4y experience in FinTech
Domain knowledge of Investment products is a strong advantage
Strong business mindset
Strong AWS knowledge, Java, SQL, Kafka or other messaging solutions
You are pragmatic and can handle the balance between both taking and delegating the lead in challenging situations
You bring both strong strategic and excellent operational leadership skills
You motivate and inspire by outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal, including communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
You possess solid engineering background and distinct hands-on mentality
You are experienced with OKR and KPI-based target agreements
You are familiar with architecturally-heavy systems, including designing, implementing, and evolving these system constraints
You are fluent in English, knowledge of German or another European language would be a plus
Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!
At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.
As part of our team, you will benefit from:
Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.
Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.
Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy
We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
