jobs.title: Director, Product (physical) (f/m/x)
jobs.text:
Reporting Relationships
Primary Manager: COO and Co-MD
Dotted Line: CMO and Co-MD
Direct Reports: ~10 people spanning Culinary, Product Innovation, Product Strategy, Product Operations, and Product Analytics
The Opportunity
Factor is a healthy, ready-to-heat meal delivery service that has built a category-defining business in the US and Canada. Now we're building Factor in Europe — and although we have strong blueprints from North America, we have the opportunity to leverage the very rich multi-cultural environment in Europe to tailor both our physical and digital products to five different markets.
As our Director, Product, you will own the full product vision and execution for Factor Europe. You will lead a multi-layered team of ~10 people, sit on the Factor Europe leadership team, and maintain a close dotted-line relationship with our CMO to ensure product and marketing move as one.
This is a rare kind of role: senior strategic ownership and real infrastructure, with the pace and ambition of an early-stage scale up. If you are a visionary builder who leads with curiosity, earns conviction through data, and holds your team to the same high standard you hold yourself — we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Do
Lead and Develop a High-Performance Product Team
Build, inspire, and manage a multi-disciplinary team — setting a clear vision, establishing the operating rhythms that allow the team to move fast, and investing in the people who will drive Factor Europe's next chapter.
Own and Challenge the Product Vision
Define a clear and compelling vision for what Factor's physical product must become in Europe — grounded in customer insight, commercially rigorous, and differentiated enough to win. Develop a deep, independent point of view on where the North American model translates and where European markets demand something different.
Push the team and the business to think beyond the current roadmap — challenging assumptions, interrogating trade-offs, and ensuring we are always working on the highest-leverage version of the product.
Act as the liaison to our global Digital Product team — representing Factor Europe's priorities in the feature roadmap and collaborating on shared global initiatives that benefit the wider business.
Drive Customer Retention and Commercial Performance
Own customer retention levers as your north star. Build a rigorous, evidence-based view of what drives it and rally the team around interventions that move the needle.
Make product decisions with full awareness of their P&L implications. Take calculated risks, track outcomes honestly, and move quickly to learn and adjust when bets don't pay off.
Build for Multiple European Markets
Lead our effort to find product-market fit across five distinct markets — understanding how consumer preferences vary by culture, and building a proposition that resonates locally while scaling efficiently.
Share learnings across geographies and partner with peers across the HelloFresh Group to continuously raise the bar.
Support new channel strategies, understanding and adapting products for different customer bases.
Align Product and Marketing Strategy
Work closely with the brand & marketing team to ensure product roadmap and marketing strategies are fully synchronised — so what we build, how we talk about it, and how we sell it form one coherent proposition.
Act as the product voice on the leadership team, articulating a compelling vision for where the product needs to go and why.
Who You Are
A visionary leader who executes. You set a compelling direction, bring your team with you, and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
Customer-obsessed and analytically rigorous. Sharp instincts backed by disciplined discovery. Comfortable querying your own data and stress-testing assumptions.
Commercially minded. You understand how product decisions flow through to the P&L — and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.
A cross-functional influencer. You build trust quickly, drive execution through others, and get the right priorities onto other teams' roadmaps.
Internationally curious. You find the complexity of building for multiple European cultures energising, and you seek out the nuances that matter.
An exceptional communicator. You write and present with clarity and conviction — from strategy narratives to leadership updates to product briefs.
Food and/or nutrition obsessed!
Requirements
Experience: 8–10+ years in Product, Strategy, or a closely related commercial leadership role; 3+ years managing multi-disciplinary teams.
Technical toolkit: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; AI proficiency and curiosity required.
Strong preference for:
○ Experience in D2C subscription businesses — retention, lifecycle, and recurring revenue models.
○ Multi-market European experience and an understanding of how consumer preferences vary across the continent.
○ Experience in physical products or FMCG, especially food & beverage.
○ A track record of scaling a product in a new market and finding product-market fit.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.
You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2025 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).
Health & Wellbeing
Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.
Get a 10% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.
Flexibility & Work-Life
Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.
Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.
Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.
Career & Development
Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: participate in Pantry Staple trainings, access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.
Culture & Environment
Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€3.00/day), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

jobs.title: Director, AI & Agentic Engineering
jobs.text:
About the job
Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?
With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!
Who We Are
Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.
We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.
Find out more at artefact.com.
What you will be doing
You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.
AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.
What we are looking for
The ideal candidate has a substantial software engineering and AI background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering — context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and agentic coding — and in cloud-native software architecture, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on command of agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor), and modern full-stack frameworks (TypeScript/React front ends; Python/Node backends).
Experience designing cloud architectures: microservices, serverless, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Solid grasp of AI system design: agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and LLMOps.
Experience with data & context modeling and ingestion/processing pipelines on data lakes and data warehouses, including vector and graph storage strategies (embeddings, knowledge graphs).
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.
Why Join Us
We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.
There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.
The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
VP, Product
Role Overview
Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.
We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.
Platform Ownership & Impact
ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.
The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.
ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Roadmap
Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.
Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.
Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.
Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.
Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building
Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.
Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).
Governance, Prioritization & Intake
Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.
Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).
Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.
Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.
Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.
Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.
Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.
Client & Partner Orientation
Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.
Ensure ARM Suite produces standardized, credible artifacts for sales, planning, and renewal motions rather than bespoke, one-off deliverables.
Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Required Experience
10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership (Director, Sr. Director, or VP) at a SaaS, agency-tech, ad-tech, mar-tech, or analytics platform company.
Demonstrated experience owning a B2B platform or product line end-to-end — vision, roadmap, prioritization, governance, and stakeholder management.
Track record of leading internal product ownership through transitions away from third-party engineering vendors, contractors, or outsourced build partners.
Experience operating in environments that combine internal teams with external engineering partners, with a clear philosophy on what should be owned in-house vs. outsourced.
Deep, hands-on capability with API-driven product design — including standing up API pipelines, integrating third-party data sources for user-facing enrichment, and shipping products built on APIs from scratch.
Preferred Experience

blocks.text: VP, Product
Role Overview

Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.
Platform Ownership & Impact

ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.

The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.

ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Roadmap

Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.
Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.
Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.

Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.
Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building
Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.
Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).
Governance, Prioritization & Intake

Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.
Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).
Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.
Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.

Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.
Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.
Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.
Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.

Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.

Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Director of Product Management
Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)
Shape the Future of Privacy
Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.
We are looking for a Director of Product Management to own the strategy, outcomes, and people of one of our product pillars. This is a fully accountable leadership role: you'll set the direction for your team, develop product talent, and make sure the work your team ships connects clearly to company-wide goals. You'll combine hands-on team leadership with pillar-level strategy, working closely with peers across Product, Engineering, and the broader business.
How We Work: AI-Native by Default
Usercentrics is actively pushing AI adoption across Product for real efficiency gains. This isn't background context, it's a working expectation. As a Director, you're expected to actively drive AI-native ways of working within your team: using AI to speed up research synthesis, discovery, spec writing, and prototyping, and building the judgment in your PMs to use it well rather than uncritically. This is a real, current expectation on how you'll run your team from day one, not an aspirational nice-to-have.
What You Will Do
Own product strategy
Take full ownership of your team's outcomes: adjust strategy, roadmap, or process proactively when results aren't tracking, and spot diminishing returns before they bite.
Define clearly what your team should focus on, why the investment matters, and what outcomes Usercentrics can expect
Contribute meaningfully to pillar-level strategy and connect your team's work to the priorities of the management team
Identify novel areas of investment that advance the product vision, and build the case for new strategic initiatives
Drive product execution
Set and uphold high standards for specification, delivery, and quality across your team, reviewing and shaping key product work
Make the tough trade-off calls between projects and investment areas to maximize the value your pillar delivers
Build and maintain best practices for specification, delivery, and quality, and hold your team accountable for outcomes
Anticipate your team's resourcing, skills, and tooling needs based on the roadmap ahead, and act before gaps become blockers
Stay close to the domain
Align market insight across teams and pillars, grounding strategy in a deep understanding of customer needs, competitive dynamics, and market opportunity
Partner closely with engineering leadership to align technical strategy and address cross-functional challenges
Lead cross-team efforts to address industry trends and regulatory challenges, ensure compliance across product areas, and help position Usercentrics as an industry leader
Turn insight into direction
Make sure your team has the data, user feedback, and market insight it needs to make informed decisions, and use that data to set and communicate quarterly goals
Coach your product managers to use data and customer insight to shape recommendations and roadmap direction, not just to report on results
Strengthen the relationship between PMs and design, and push for design that keeps pace with how AI is changing product experiences, not just how it's changing engineering
Lead and grow your people
Identify strengths and development areas for each team member, and proactively close skills gaps across the team
Manage your team's careers, not just their performance, and look for opportunities to help them grow into product leaders
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across the company, keeping key partners informed and avoiding last-minute surprises
Influence prioritization and resourcing decisions at the pillar level, and ensure your team's progress has visibility and support at the VP level.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, Generative AI
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Senior Director, Generative AI
About the Role
Roblox Build is our generative creation product, the platform where creators design, build, and publish 3D experiences. We are looking for a Senior Director of Generative AI to lead the Applied AI organization inside Build, responsible for turning state-of-the-art foundation models into high-quality, reliable creation systems at Roblox scale. This leader will own the full applied AI stack: model strategy and routing, model adaptation and fine-tuning, code generation (CodeGen), 3D layout generation (LayoutGen), and the evaluation science and infrastructure that tells us what actually works.
You Will
Own model strategy and routing for Build. Design and build an intelligent model layer that selects the right model for each creation task based on quality, capability, latency, cost, and safety, leveraging both frontier models and Roblox-adapted open-source models.
Lead model adaptation across the Applied AI org, including fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data generation, human feedback pipelines, and preference optimization for Roblox-specific creation tasks such as Luau code generation and 3D scene understanding.
Drive CodeGen capabilities forward by building AI systems that understand creator intent, reason across multi-file Roblox experiences, execute tools, and reliably make complex changes to existing games, going well beyond code completion.
Build LayoutGen intelligence by developing the AI capability that turns a creator's intent into coherent 3D scenes, including object selection, spatial reasoning, placement, aesthetic quality, and iterative editing.
Own evaluation as a core technical discipline. Build the benchmarks, quality metrics, judge methodologies, experiment infrastructure, and human evaluation pipelines that answer whether model, prompt, or routing changes actually improve creator outcomes.
Close the feedback loop between model development, evaluation, and production, ensuring that quality signal flows continuously from creator outcomes back into training data, model updates, and release decisions, rather than operating as separate silos.
You Have
10+ years of experience in machine learning and AI, with 5+ years in senior technical leadership roles overseeing applied AI or ML engineering organizations that have shipped generative AI systems into production at scale.
Deep technical grounding across multiple areas of applied AI, including LLM post-training (RLHF, DPO, distillation), model routing and adaptation, agentic systems, code generation, or evaluation science, with enough depth to recruit, challenge, and lead exceptional scientists and engineers in each area.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing organizations that span both AI research scientists and production engineers, including hiring, developing talent, and making difficult personnel decisions.
Strong evaluation fluency, with a track record of building eval frameworks that predict production outcomes, designing benchmarks that measure what matters, and building the infrastructure to run experiments continuously at model, prompt, and routing level.
Experience operating cross-functionally in complex technical organizations, with the ability to influence and align across research, product engineering, and platform teams without relying on hierarchy.
Genuine interest in the creation problem. You find the specific challenge of AI-assisted 3D world creation and domain-specific code generation compelling, not just as a vehicle for building AI systems.
You Are
A builder and a shipper who cares about getting things into production and measuring whether they actually work, not just publishing promising results.
Technically credible across the stack. You can engage deeply with scientists on evaluation methodology, data quality, and model behavior, and equally deeply with engineers on architecture, inference latency, and reliability.
Decisive under ambiguity. You make principled tradeoffs between rigor and velocity, know when good enough is good enough, and can articulate your reasoning clearly.
Direct and honest. You give clear feedback, surface problems early, and create an environment where your team can do the same.
Mission-driven. You care about the people building on Roblox, and you connect the technical work of the Applied AI org to the experience of the millions of creators using the tools.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Senior Director, Generative AI
About the Role

Roblox Build is our generative creation product, the platform where creators design, build, and publish 3D experiences. We are looking for a Senior Director of Generative AI to lead the Applied AI organization inside Build, responsible for turning state-of-the-art foundation models into high-quality, reliable creation systems at Roblox scale. This leader will own the full applied AI stack: model strategy and routing, model adaptation and fine-tuning, code generation (CodeGen), 3D layout generation (LayoutGen), and the evaluation science and infrastructure that tells us what actually works.
You Will

items: Own model strategy and routing for Build. Design and build an intelligent model layer that selects the right model for each creation task based on quality, capability, latency, cost, and safety, leveraging both frontier models and Roblox-adapted open-source models.

Lead model adaptation across the Applied AI org, including fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data generation, human feedback pipelines, and preference optimization for Roblox-specific creation tasks such as Luau code generation and 3D scene understanding.

Drive CodeGen capabilities forward by building AI systems that understand creator intent, reason across multi-file Roblox experiences, execute tools, and reliably make complex changes to existing games, going well beyond code completion.

Build LayoutGen intelligence by developing the AI capability that turns a creator's intent into coherent 3D scenes, including object selection, spatial reasoning, placement, aesthetic quality, and iterative editing.

Own evaluation as a core technical discipline. Build the benchmarks, quality metrics, judge methodologies, experiment infrastructure, and human evaluation pipelines that answer whether model, prompt, or routing changes actually improve creator outcomes.

Close the feedback loop between model development, evaluation, and production, ensuring that quality signal flows continuously from creator outcomes back into training data, model updates, and release decisions, rather than operating as separate silos.

blocks.text: You Have

items: 10+ years of experience in machine learning and AI, with 5+ years in senior technical leadership roles overseeing applied AI or ML engineering organizations that have shipped generative AI systems into production at scale.

Deep technical grounding across multiple areas of applied AI, including LLM post-training (RLHF, DPO, distillation), model routing and adaptation, agentic systems, code generation, or evaluation science, with enough depth to recruit, challenge, and lead exceptional scientists and engineers in each area.

Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing organizations that span both AI research scientists and production engineers, including hiring, developing talent, and making difficult personnel decisions.

Strong evaluation fluency, with a track record of building eval frameworks that predict production outcomes, designing benchmarks that measure what matters, and building the infrastructure to run experiments continuously at model, prompt, and routing level.

Experience operating cross-functionally in complex technical organizations, with the ability to influence and align across research, product engineering, and platform teams without relying on hierarchy.

Genuine interest in the creation problem. You find the specific challenge of AI-assisted 3D world creation and domain-specific code generation compelling, not just as a vehicle for building AI systems.

blocks.text: You Are

items: A builder and a shipper who cares about getting things into production and measuring whether they actually work, not just publishing promising results.

Technically credible across the stack. You can engage deeply with scientists on evaluation methodology, data quality, and model behavior, and equally deeply with engineers on architecture, inference latency, and reliability.
Decisive under ambiguity. You make principled tradeoffs between rigor and velocity, know when good enough is good enough, and can articulate your reasoning clearly.
Direct and honest. You give clear feedback, surface problems early, and create an environment where your team can do the same.
Mission-driven. You care about the people building on Roblox, and you connect the technical work of the Applied AI org to the experience of the millions of creators using the tools.

jobs.title: Director of Digital & Product Management
jobs.text:
Position Summary
The Director of Digital & Product Management leads ACCC’s digital product strategy and is accountable for ensuring the organizations digital products, platforms, and experiences support its strategic, operational, and client-service objectives.
This role owns the digital product roadmap and provides leadership across the full product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through design, development, testing, implementation, adoption, performance management, and continuous improvement. The Director serves as the primary connection between ACCC’s business areas and Information Technology, ensuring that business needs are translated into well-defined, user-centered, compliant, and measurable digital solutions.
Operating within ACCCs operating system, the Director owns the Digital & Product Management function on the accountability chart and is responsible for establishing clear priorities, rocks, scorecard measures, operating rhythms, and team accountabilities.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
This job description does not limit management’s ability to assign or adjust duties and responsibilities at any time.
•Develop and maintain ACCC’s digital product vision, strategy, multiyear roadmap, translating organizational priorities, client needs, and operational needs into actionable initiatives.
•Establish product goals, business outcomes, success measures, and value propositions in partnership with business leaders.
•Lead a structured process for evaluating, prioritizing and managing digital product requests based on strategic alignment, user impact, risk, effort, and expected value.
•Balance new product development with enhancements, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies, platform maintenance, and defect resolution.
•Identify opportunities to improve digital client experiences, employee tools, self-service capabilities, and operational workflows.
•Partner with IT to assess feasibility, define and document requirements, manage dependencies, and support delivery.
•Oversee user acceptance testing, launch readiness, communications, training coordination, implementation, and post-launch support.
•Monitor product performance, adoption, user feedback, and business impact, using results to drive continuous improvement.
•Maintain visibility into product priorities, active initiatives, risks, dependencies, and progress, and communicate recommendations to senior leadership.
•Lead, coach, and develop the Digital & Product Management team.
•Support vendor evaluations and partnerships related to digital products and platforms.
•Ensure digital products incorporate accessibility, privacy, security, compliance, and operational considerations.
MA Pay Transparency Salary: $150,000

jobs.title: Director of Data Operations and Governance
jobs.text:
Our Future Health is an ambitious collaboration between the public, charity and private sectors, designed to help people live healthier lives for longer through better prevention, earlier detection and improved treatment of diseases. With over 2.7 million volunteers across the UK, we’re now the world’s largest health research programme of our kind, with a volunteer group that is more diverse than other similar health research programmes.
Data is at the heart of our mission. We bring together health records, genetic and laboratory data, questionnaires and other participant-generated data to create an incredibly rich resource for health research. We use this data to support discovery research, recruitment into clinical trials, and health insights for participants. As we grow, both the volume and variety of data we manage will increase considerably.
We are looking for an experienced Director of Data Operations & Governance to lead how we operationally manage and govern data across Our Future Health.
This is a Senior Leadership role reporting to the Chief Data Officer, with responsibility for the operational management and governance of data across Our Future Health. You will help ensure data moves efficiently and securely from source to user, while maintaining the quality, provenance and controls required of one of the world's largest health research programmes.
This is fundamentally a data operations and delivery leadership role. You will develop the operating models, standards and ways of working that allow us to onboard and release data efficiently, improve its quality and ensure governance, security and compliance are considered from the outset.
You will join an established Data Management capability, initially managing a senior Data Management lead with five Data Managers within the wider team, alongside additional budgeted roles expected to report directly to you. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future structure and capability of the function as we grow.
What makes this exciting?
Help define what good looks like at the forefront of health data. Few organisations are working with our combination of data volume, variety, sensitivity and potential research use. You'll help create the operational approach rather than simply inherit one.
Work on complex data challenges at scale. Our data comes from the NHS, laboratories, technology partners and participants. You'll shape how that data moves from source through to being trusted and available for research.
Shape a growing capability. You'll join an established team, but the future operating model isn't fixed. You'll help determine how the function evolves as our data landscape becomes increasingly complex.
Work collaboratively across the organisation. You'll bring together colleagues across Data Engineering, Product, Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance and Security to establish practical standards, clarify responsibilities and improve how we manage data.
Bring experience from another sector. Healthcare experience isn't essential. We're interested in people from complex, regulated and data-intensive environments who can bring useful experience of data operations at scale.
Responsibilities
Data Operations & Delivery
Lead the end-to-end operational management of data, from supplier onboarding and acquisition through to clinic laboratory operations, data release, retention and withdrawal
Create clear responsibilities, milestones, dependencies and escalation routes across complex data flows, drawing on support from our delivery team
Develop scaling strategies for onboarding and using data at increasing volumes and variety, setting out the volume targets and working with the data engineering team on technical implementation
Oversee the operational aspects of data releases, including the cross-functional coordination required to make these successful
Develop effective reporting across operational performance, data volumes, quality, risks and issues
Oversee reliable, customer-focused managed data services, including the airlock service that researchers use to move data and tooling into and out of our trusted research environment
Help teams navigate and resolve complex operational issues so that data can be delivered efficiently
Data Governance & Quality
Embed governance, security, privacy and compliance requirements into data processes from the outset
Develop practical data standards and controls, helping teams across the organisation understand their responsibilities for data on topics such as quality and retention and overseeing implementation
Improve how we understand and manage data quality, integrity, provenance and lifecycle
Partner with colleagues in Data Protection, Security, Legal and Compliance to ensure data is managed ethically, securely and appropriately
Partners & People
Manage data-facing operational relationships and negotiations with the NHS, laboratories, technology partners and other data suppliers
Lead, support and develop a team of Data Managers and governance professionals
Shape the future structure and capability of the function as Our Future Health grows
Build trusted relationships with senior colleagues across Data, Technology, Product, Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance and Security
Bring people together around shared priorities and help establish clarity where responsibilities cross teams

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Operations Planning
jobs.text:
S'more about the team
The Operations Data and Decisions Tribe at HelloFresh is responsible for driving operations planning by creating high quality, reusable data assets, data science models, and algorithmic solutions. Additionally, the tribe. This team has a direct impact on the customer experience and is constantly optimising for various Business KPIs. They build in-house products using modern technologies to handle a massive scale of transactions (>8.5 million active customers) and continuously improve the SDLC for fast flow and continuous delivery.
As a Director of Operations Planning Engineering, you will lead engineering teams (Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, & Analytics) and Staff Engineers across the mid-term planning domain, supporting their technical decision-making processes. Your responsibilities will include spearheading initiatives that traverse multiple teams and domains, such as those focused on network planning, demand planning, and production planning. Drawing upon your comprehensive understanding of the domain, you will own the planning architecture strategy and drive the long-term vision for how our planning systems should be integrated and scaled.
Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for
Lead an engineering squad comprising 10-15 engineers, managing Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers across Warsaw, Berlin, & USA.
Own the GenAI transformation — define and drive a concrete roadmap for becoming a genuinely AI-native engineering organisation: from AI-assisted development and automated incident response, to agentic workflows and LLM-powered tooling embedded in day-to-day operations.
Own the availability and reliability of HelloFresh's planning infrastructure — drive SRE practices, incident management, SLOs/SLIs, and on-call maturity across high-throughput systems serving multiple markets.
Set technical direction across Python, GoLang, PostgreSQL, Kafka, React, and React Native services on AWS, ensuring systems.
Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Procurement providers to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage, coach, and develop Engineering Managers & Engineers — holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated through evolving priorities.
Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for
AI proficiency and advocacy. Hands-on familiarity with AI technologies and a demonstrable track record of championing their adoption — whether through AI-assisted development workflows, LLM-powered tooling, or driving team-wide GenAI-native ways of working.
Deep Technical Expertise. Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to Operations Planning — including planning systems, data science modeling, data engineering, database systems, distributed computing, and backend development frameworks. Hands-on familiarity with full stack application development.
Systems Thinking. The ability to understand complex systems holistically, recognising how components interact and impact each other, and leveraging this to design scalable, resilient solutions in a high-throughput environment where downtime means direct revenue loss.
Proven Leadership at Scale. 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing Engineering Managers — not just individual contributors. Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams across multiple offices, building trust and maintaining high engineering standards without daily co-location.
Operational Excellence Mindset. Strong grounding in SRE practices — SLOs/SLIs, incident management, on-call culture, and observability tooling (Grafana or similar). Experience owning payments infrastructure in regulated, multi-market environments is a strong plus.
Cross-Functional Collaboration. Exceptional ability to work across engineering disciplines, Product, business stakeholders, and external service providers — fostering alignment towards common goals and translating business outcomes into engineering priorities.
Effective Communication Across Disciplines. Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here
Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing: Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Flexibility & Work-Life: Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings. Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Career & Development: Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.
#LI-HYBRID
HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$174,300—$184,300 CAD

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
jobs.text:
Career Category
Information Systems
Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will advance Enterprise Data Governance, FAIR data practices, and a data product operating model that makes trusted, reusable, and responsibly accessible data available for analytics, automation, and AI innovation.
The successful candidate will lead cross-functional data strategy and delivery across data domains, translating scientific and business priorities into scalable governance, metadata, quality, semantic interoperability, and data product capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the enterprise Data Governance, FAIR, and data product strategy and roadmap, aligning investments to scientific and business priorities.
Establish a value-realization framework to measure business outcomes, adoption, and return on investment from data initiatives.
Execute the Enterprise Data Strategy, including data ownership, reusable data products, lifecycle management, data contracts, and adoption measures.
Evolve a federated governance operating model with clear decision rights, data ownership, stewardship accountabilities, data councils, data standards, and escalation paths.
Evolve FAIR maturity across the enterprise, including embedding FAIR practices in the data lifecycle, metadata standards, persistent identifiers, controlled vocabularies, and access patterns.
Advance active metadata, data catalog, lineage, business glossary, semantic and knowledge graph capabilities to improve discovery, context, interoperability, and trust.
Set governance policies and controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, retention, and responsible use; ensure fit-for-purpose data for regulated and AI-enabled use cases.
Partner with Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Digital, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to operationalize governed data products across platforms and domains.
Enable responsible AI by defining and enforcing data readiness criteria.

jobs.title: Director Data Management & Intelligence
jobs.text:
You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.
The Director, Data Management & Intelligence, is responsible for leading the Company's enterprise data strategy, governance, business intelligence, analytics, and data management capabilities. As the steward of enterprise data, this leader ensures information is trusted, accessible, secure, and actionable, enabling data-driven decision making and alignment with strategic business priorities.
This highly visible role partners with executive, operational, clinical, and technology leaders to translate business needs into scalable data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-ready data foundations. The Director is accountable for advancing data quality, governance, metadata management, and architecture practices that support analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and emerging agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise.
Success in this role requires strong leadership, influence, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and execution across a complex organization.
The Director leads teams responsible for data governance, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data services, and data product management, ensuring the Company can effectively leverage trusted data as a strategic asset to improve operational performance, customerexperiences, growth, innovation, and the responsible adoption of AI.
Qualifications
Education Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information
Systems/Technology or related field.
Work Experience Required:
• 10+ years of experience leading data management, governance, and business intelligence
functions that deliver measurable business value and continuous improvement.
• 3+ years of experience with healthcare industry data.
• 2+ years hands-on experience with Snowflake, certified/semantic data layers.
• 7+ years of leadership experience; 3+ years leading managers.
Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.:
• Master’s Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science or related field.
• Experience with the Epic EMR data model (Clarity)
Expertise with healthcare business processes within physician practices and associated application software necessary to support those processes within an integrated delivery system.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Experience in leading healthcare data warehouse design and builds, specifically using Snowflake.
• Proven experience establishing data governance frameworks, data catalog solutions, quality standards, scorecards, access controls, and data-sharing policies – with the goal to enable self-service analytics across key business areas
• Demonstrated success delivering enterprise BI and data platform enhancements, including requirements gathering, technology partnership, implementation, and change management.
• Strong track record of building trusted relationships and influencing senior leaders across multiple business functions in support of enterprise-wide initiatives
• Ability to present data strategy, governance, and business performance insights to executive audiences.
• Experience with Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar analytics and visualization platforms
• Advanced SQL skills and deep experience with cloud data warehouse technologies, with Snowflake required.
• Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals, including Azure services (VMs, Azure SQL, IaaS, and PaaS).
• Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams and leaders.
• Strong people leadership skills with experience managing managers and individual contributors.
• Ability to set clear priorities, align teams to business objectives, and drive accountability for results.
• Effective change leadership skills, with the ability to guide teams through organizational and technology transformations.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Successfully complete current Snowflake optimization tasks, certified data and semantic layer efforts.
• Deliver actionable insights to the business and leadership to better inform decisions and provide timely feedback on key performance indicators.
• Establish the governance, performance metrics and quality standards practices (committees, roles, data standards, processes, policies, etc.) for the organization's data management and ensures compliance across the organization.
• Responsible for defining a data cataloging strategy, data dictionary, data lineage, data and metric definitions in support of driving single source of truth and self-service.
• Lead the design, measurement, and monitoring of company key performance indicators as well as high priority metrics in partnership with areas such as finance, marketing and joint venture operations.
• Influence and align executive leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, and external partners to establish enterprise priorities, drive decision-making, and ensure delivery of high-value data and analytics initiatives.
• Champion enterprise data literacy and serve as a recognized thought leader who promotes the effective use of data, analytics, and performance insights across the organization
Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams responsible for enterprise data governance, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data services, and data product management.
• Provide ongoing leadership through performance management, coaching, feedback, succession planning, and career development to build a highly engaged, high-performing team and leadership pipeline.
• Develop a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement that enables the team to deliver meaningful business impact while maintaining a highly collaborative and supportive work environment.
Key AI-Readiness Responsibilities
• Establish and maintain enterprise data governance, quality, lineage, and metadata standards needed to support AI and advanced analytics.
• Create a trusted, scalable, and discoverable data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, machine learning, and AI applications.
• Partner with business, technology, and AI leaders to prioritize and operationalize data products that power automation, predictive analytics, and agentic AI solutions.
• Ensure enterprise data assets are managed in accordance with security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI principles.
• Develop a multi-year data strategy and roadmap that positions GoHealth to maximize the value of AI and emerging technologies.
GoHealth Core Values
GoHealth’s Core Values, listed below, are essential functions of this position:
• Collaboration: Takes ownership for collectively establishing productive partnerships and relationships and seek to gain joint understanding of priorities and objectives so that the greater good of the organization and those we serve is always at the forefront.
• Innovation: Consistently uses good judgment, applying creativity to overcome obstacles and increasing effectiveness and efficiency through process and other forms of innovation.
• Diversity & Inclusion: Fosters diversity and inclusion, to be able to better understand team members, our customers and partners. Engages the strengths and talents of each
GoHealth team member, creating an environment of involvement, respect and connection where the richness of ideas, backgrounds and perspectives are harnessed.
• Courage & Integrity: Models and practices the highest ethical and professional standards; demonstrates pride and personal interest in our patients, partners and fellow team members, deeply engaging in the business. Makes decisions, with a focus on doing the right thing; treats team members, our customers, partners and vendors with dignity, consideration, open-mindedness and respect.
• Accountability: Always shows initiative, demonstrates a bias to action and gets things done. Actively accepts responsibility for diverse roles, obligations and actions that positively influence patient and customer outcomes, our partnerships and the healthcare needs of our communities.
GoHealth Leadership Principles
GoHealth’s Leadership Principles, listed below, are essential functions for this position:
• Create Shared Purpose: Breathe life into our vision and mission. Speak to our future and create a line of sight for our team members. Set goals and communicate a plan of action.
Empower others to deliver.
Inspire and Motivate: Celebrate and share success. Grow and develop our team members.
Provide direct feedback that enables others to reach their potential. Identify when to lead and embrace the opportunity to follow.
Additional Requirements
• Office Environment: Tasks may be conducted within a climate-controlled office setting.
• Physical Activity: The role may require the ability to lift, carry, push, or pull materials, supplies, and equipment (up to 15 lbs.) Duties typically involve a combination of sitting, standing, and walking, with frequent changes in position.
• Travel: Travel may be required, including travel between Company locations and out-oftown destinations as needed, up to 15%.
• Safety Equipment: May require the use of safety equipment for infection prevention.
Note: This Job Description is not inclusive of all the duties of the position. You may be asked by Leaders to perform other duties. Leadership may revise this job description at any time.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
The Company and its affiliates, joint venture partners and entities under common management are Equal Opportunity Employers. They do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.
ADA Accommodation Statement
Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities upon request.
This role defines success by achieving essential function outcomes, not by the method of completion.
Compliance Statement
This job will be performed consistent with ADA, FMLA, FLSA, and other applicable federal, state, and local laws regulating employment

All qualified persons are granted an equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity or expression, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, genetic information, medical condition, family care leave status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, otherwise qualified disabled or veteran status. The company will comply with all fair employment laws in each of the jurisdictions where we conduct business.

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will advance Enterprise Data Governance, FAIR data practices, and a data product operating model that makes trusted, reusable, and responsibly accessible data available for analytics, automation, and AI innovation.

The successful candidate will lead cross-functional data strategy and delivery across data domains, translating scientific and business priorities into scalable governance, metadata, quality, semantic interoperability, and data product capabilities.

items: Lead the enterprise Data Governance, FAIR, and data product strategy and roadmap, aligning investments to scientific and business priorities.
Establish a value-realization framework to measure business outcomes, adoption, and return on investment from data initiatives.
Execute the Enterprise Data Strategy, including data ownership, reusable data products, lifecycle management, data contracts, and adoption measures.
Evolve a federated governance operating model with clear decision rights, data ownership, stewardship accountabilities, data councils, data standards, and escalation paths.
Evolve FAIR maturity across the enterprise, including embedding FAIR practices in the data lifecycle, metadata standards, persistent identifiers, controlled vocabularies, and access patterns.
Advance active metadata, data catalog, lineage, business glossary, semantic and knowledge graph capabilities to improve discovery, context, interoperability, and trust.
Set governance policies and controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, retention, and responsible use; ensure fit-for-purpose data for regulated and AI-enabled use cases.
Partner with Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Digital, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to operationalize governed data products across platforms and domains.
Enable responsible AI by defining and enforcing data readiness criteria.
Serve as the data engagement lead for an assigned business function, driving adoption of data management practices, including FAIR, to deliver measurable data improvements and business value.
Manage large-scale data programs, cross-functional initiatives, and external partners; communicate outcomes, risks, dependencies, and value realization to senior leadership.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Global Payouts
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Ripple's cross-border payment offering that enables global institutions to bridge stablecoins and fiat instantly.
This person will lead the roadmap driving the next phase of growth for our flagship payouts products. They will use the power of digital assets and blockchain to bridge traditional financial infrastructure. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Sales and Account Management, Risk/Fraud, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to build payment experiences that are customer-first, resilient, and built to scale.
The ideal candidate has deep payments expertise and a strong curiosity about digital assets. You're a problem solver; you work best when you're driving early stage solutions to achieve next-level scale. You'll excel working in a fast-past environment, and you are adept at and handling cross-functional initiatives across geographies.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Product Strategy and Vision: Define and communicate a product vision, strategy and roadmap for our Global Payouts product.
Product Quality and Delivery: Partner with engineering to ensure clear requirements, strong acceptance criteria, and high-quality launches..
Payments Experience: Lead the end-to-end payments experience across Ripple payouts, crafting capabilities that balance customer experience, conversion, and regulatory controls.
Cross-functional Leadership: Lead high-impact initiatives and align collaborators across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk/Fraud, and Operations; remove blockers and drive decisions.
Collaborator Management and Influence: Deliver concise, committed communication to ensure alignment and drive outcomes.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
12-15 years of total professional experience in financial services, fintech, or the crypto industry, with at least 5-10 years in a core product management role.
A passion for payments and a deep curiosity about digital assets and blockchain.
Demonstrated track record of scaling and evangelizing successful products
Ability to translate complex topics into clear, concise language for different audiences.
Strong technical competence and understanding.
A knack for establishing relationships and driving alignment across teams with different priorities.
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$248,000—$300,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.
