jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
About Abridge
Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.
Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
As the Director of Data Science at Abridge you will be responsible for building a world-class data team, implementing a comprehensive data strategy that can help democratize data in the age of AI and use data to drive actionable insights. We’re looking for a leader who has high-agency, strong taste, and wants to make a high impact while growing our U.S. based team.
This role is crucial to our company as the data science team will serve as a central resource to provide insight and clarity while speeding up decision making. Your key cross-functional partners will include our Product, Engineering and Science teams, as well as our commercial and finance teams to ultimately help guide our decision making.
What You’ll Do
As the leader of our data science function, you’ll be responsible for:
Build and manage a world-class team of data scientists, providing guidance, mentorship and high standards while growing the team
Foster a high impact and collaborative team culture, focused on having agency, providing clarity of thinking to the organization and pride in authorship
Drive product strategy through data-driven insights across our growing product portfolio, including user behavior analysis, deep-dives into product performance metrics, causal inference experimentation
Partner with our product, strategy, and research teams to develop sophisticated ROI frameworks for our customers, ingesting real-time data and demonstrating impact
Collaborate with our world-class research team on models and model evaluation, including shaping our model evaluation frameworks, production performance monitoring, and defining quality metrics that matter clinically
Effectively communicate our data strategy, complex analyses and key insights to cross-functional partners including the executive team
Structure the company’s data strategy, working closely with our Data Engineering team to identify gaps in data sources, ingest internal & external data, and structure that data for optimal use across the company
Make critical technical infrastructure decisions for the data organization, including tooling choices, build vs buy tradeoffs for analytics platforms, and setting technical standards that enable the team to move fast without creating technical debt
Build the data science org of the future, incorporating the current and soon-to-come best practices in order to utilize AI to speed up data ingestion and insight generation
What You’ll Bring
MS or PhD in quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics, or related)
12+ years in data-science or analytics, especially in product-facing roles where you had to drive impact by using data to shape product strategy, goal setting and execution
Depth of experience using Python, R, SQL for large-scale analytics
Comfort building data capabilities from the earliest stages through rapid growth, including interfacing closely with data engineering and machine learning
Experience with data visualization tools, both BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, Sigma) and code-based tools (e.g. Seaborn, ggplot2)
Excellent communicator capable of effectively delivering quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and compelling fashion.
A strong leader who is able to help build great teams, drive urgency in execution while ensuring we prioritize appropriately in a rapid growth environment
Bonus Points
Knowledge of healthcare settings, electronic health records (EHR), and healthcare billing
Experience diving into / shaping Analytics Engineering (recruiting & supporting)
We value people who are eager to learn new things and recognize that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.
Why Work at Abridge?
At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.
Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.
Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.
We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.
If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.
How we take care of Abridgers:
Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.
Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.
Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.
Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.
401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.
Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.
Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.
Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.
Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.
Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.
... and much more!
Equal Opportunity Employer
Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.
Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud
We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.
Compensation Range: $250K - $325K

Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.
If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.
How we take care of Abridgers:
Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.
Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.
Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.
Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.
401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.
Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.
Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.
Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.
Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.
Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.
... and much more!
Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.
Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.title: VP, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
Role Summary
Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As VP, Infrastructure Engineering, you'll shape the platforms that make that mission possible by enabling every engineering team to build, deploy, and operate software at scale.
You'll lead an Infrastructure Engineering organization responsible for the cloud platforms, developer experience, data infrastructure, reliability, observability, and engineering productivity capabilities that power HubSpot's products. Reporting to senior engineering leadership, you'll be responsible for defining how infrastructure engineering evolves in an AI-first software company. This is a transformational leadership opportunity to influence HubSpot's technical strategy, accelerate engineering velocity, and help hundreds of engineers deliver remarkable experiences for millions of customers worldwide.
Team Overview
The Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the shared platforms, services, and tooling that every HubSpot product team depends on. From cloud infrastructure and developer platforms to data infrastructure, reliability engineering, observability, and AI-enabled engineering productivity, the team enables product engineers to move faster while delivering secure, reliable, and scalable customer experiences.
What You'll Do
Define and execute the long-term vision for Infrastructure Engineering, ensuring HubSpot's platforms continue to scale with our customers, products, and engineering organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing organization of engineers, building leadership depth and succession across the organization.
Drive the evolution of HubSpot's engineering platforms, including cloud infrastructure, platform as a service, data infrastructure, observability, and reliability engineering.
Lead the transformation of Infrastructure Engineering for an AI-first future by identifying opportunities where AI fundamentally changes how software is built, operated, and supported.
Accelerate global infrastructure expansion while ensuring platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with company strategy and product priorities.
Champion modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to platform reliability and developer experience.
Drive adoption of scalable platform capabilities that improve engineering velocity while reducing operational complexity.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, inclusion, and customer focus across the Infrastructure Engineering organization.
Build strategic relationships with key technology partners, including hyperscale cloud providers, to maximize long-term platform capabilities and business value.
What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
Significant executive engineering leadership experience leading large, multi-layer engineering organizations.
Proven success building and scaling Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Cloud Platform organizations within modern cloud-native SaaS businesses.
Experience operating highly available, globally distributed systems serving millions of users or customers at internet scale.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, developer platforms, reliability engineering, observability, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery.
Demonstrated ability to define long-term technical strategy while delivering measurable business outcomes.
Experience partnering with executive leadership to shape organizational strategy and technology investment decisions.
Strong track record developing engineering leaders, building inclusive organizations, and creating high-performing teams.
Excellent executive communication, organizational leadership, and cross-functional influencing skills.
Passion for leveraging AI to transform engineering, infrastructure, operations, and the entire software lifecycle.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Experience operationalizing modern database technologies and large-scale data platforms.
Experience building or evolving internal developer platforms that significantly improve engineering productivity.
Experience partnering strategically with AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
Track record improving cloud efficiency and operational cost optimization at enterprise scale.
Active participation in the broader engineering community through technical writing, speaking, or open-source contributions.
Pay & Benefits
The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.
This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.
Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.
At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.
Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$401,895—$643,005 USD
We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.
If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.
At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.
If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot
HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.
At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.
We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.
Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
Overview
To drive innovation and operational excellence through technology that enables teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. The Business Systems department delivers software to drive business process optimization through automation, intuitive workflows, and data governance. Our goal is to serve our internal customers (operators & support departments) with solutions that empower them to maximize their performance and enhance the customer journey.
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Data & Analytics leads the strategic direction, delivery, and operational maturity of RPM Living's Data & Analytics organization within Product & Engineering. This role partners directly with the SVP, Data & Analytics, to build and scale internal data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities, reducing reliance on third-party contractors while establishing RPM Living as a data-driven, insight-led organization.
Responsibilities
• Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.• Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.• Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.• Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross-platform data integrations and business processes.• Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).• Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.• Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.• Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.• Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.• Ten years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.• Five years’ experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).• Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.• Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.• Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.• Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.• Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.• Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications
Physical Requirements:• May be required to sit for extended periods of time • May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 15 pounds • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment • Must be able to read documents, computer screens, and data • Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
Work Environment:• This is a remote role. The associate must have a dedicated workspace that is free from distraction and has reliable internet.• Overnight travel may be required quarterly for various business reasons.
Company Information
Join RPM Living and experience exceptional benefits designed to enhance your life.
Weekly pay for all associates working onsite at an apartment community
Comprehensive healthcare coverage available for all full-time, regular associates
Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs
Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance
401(k) with robust company match
Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
Paid time off plus floating holidays and volunteer days
Discounted Perks (Costco membership, movie tickets, health & wellness, entertainment & travel discounts)
Employment with RPM Living is contingent upon successful completion of a background check as local and federal state requires. A valid driver’s license is preferred; candidates without a license will be provided a liability waiver.
RPM Living participates in E-Verify. For more information, see the E-Verify Participation Poster and the Right to Work Poster.
RPM Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: VP, Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Why We Stand Out
Seeking a career-defining opportunity where your leadership, strategic vision, and client expertise are recognized and rewarded? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you.
As one of the top accounting firms in the country, our foundation is “people first.” In the words of James Kaufman, “we prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day.”
Kaufman Rossin is a privately owned, independent public accounting firm, which means we are not beholden to outside investors or private equity influence. This independence allows us to prioritize long-term client relationships, maintain objectivity in our advisory approach, and make strategic decisions that benefit our people and clients, not external stakeholders. Our structure fosters agility, entrepreneurial thinking, and a collaborative culture where leadership is accessible, and innovation is encouraged.
Celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida over a dozen times, Kaufman Rossin has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area, including sister entities Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
Think you have what it takes?
How You’ll Contribute
Kaufman Rossin is seeking a VP of Platform Engineering to join our growing Information Technology team. In this role, you will lead the strategy, delivery, and governance of KR’s Platform Engineering function, including AI application development, Salesforce CRM, Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, automation and application integration, M Files document management, and our global delivery team in Bengaluru.
Platform Engineering Leadership & Strategy
Define the technical roadmap for cloud platforms, DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and AI assisted engineering tools
Build, develop, and retain a high performing global engineering team across South Florida and Bengaluru
Manage the Platform Engineering budget, including headcount, cloud costs, tools, and vendor contracts
Lead transformational initiatives while fostering professional development, accountability, and strong performance AI Applications (Internal & Client-Facing)
AI Applications
Establish the AI use case roadmap, model selection strategy, and governance framework
Oversee the development of Azure based AI applications, including retrieval augmented generation, document intelligence, conversational agents, and client solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices through content filtering, data isolation, audit logging, and appropriate governance controls
Salesforce CRM
Provide strategic oversight of Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud
Partner with Marketing leadership to support campaign management, client engagement, and relationship strategies
Ensure Salesforce solutions align with business objectives, integration standards, and user needs
Azure and AWS Cloud Infrastructure
Lead cloud infrastructure strategy across Azure and AWS, including architecture, governance, security, and cost management
Oversee the migration from AWS to Azure and the transition from Citrix to Azure Virtual Desktop

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About LeafLink
LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.
Our team, backed by funding from leading VC's, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology. LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company's 'Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020', joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC's 'Best Places to Work in 2021'; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we're just getting started!
The Role
LeafLink is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our entire engineering organization. This role owns the technical vision, architecture, and health of every engineering function and is accountable for how well our teams turn strategy into shipped, reliable software. You'll report directly into executive leadership, partner closely with Product, and represent engineering at the leadership table.
As Head of Engineering, you are the senior-most technical leader responsible for building the org itself: hiring and developing engineering managers, setting standards for how we plan and execute, and making the calls on architecture, tooling, and headcount that determine whether we can keep moving fast without breaking things. You'll work with modern technologies and concepts such as containerized and serverless design patterns, Python, Kubernetes, AWS-managed and self-hosted services, third-party integrations, and event-driven and distributed architectures. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just a roadmap, but the operating model of an engineering org at a pivotal size, big enough to need real structure, small enough that one leader can still touch everything that matters.
Ideal candidates possess a strategic mind for solving unique challenges with fitting solutions, and a track record of building high-performing teams and the managers who run them. They should be personable, decisive, flexible, and communicative, with a strong desire to implement change, grow the org thoughtfully, and bring a genuine passion for their craft. This role comes with the opportunity to define engineering leadership at a fast-paced, dynamic, and quickly growing company.
What You'll Be Doing
Translate company, product, and technology objectives and goals into a 1 - 3-year engineering plan, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap. Lead rebuild versus refactor decisions related to platform enhancement and integration across all of our platforms
Create the right engineering organizational structure and lead the engineering team. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent and set the bar for how the engineering team operates day to day
Set engineering-wide standards for planning, estimation, and delivery, and hold teams accountable to them without turning process into bureaucracy
Establish engineering metrics, operating rhythms, and governance that provide executive visibility into execution. Own and manage the technical architecture, infrastructure, security and technical debt speed and long-term stability.
Improve engineering velocity while reducing technical debt and operational risk.
Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate customer requirements into engineering priorities, ensuring engineering capacity, sequencing, and constraints are represented in roadmap decisions and the team delivers features that have measurable customer impact and move adoption., ensuring
Manage the engineering budget: headcount planning, vendor and tooling spend, and cloud cost, with a clear view of TCO
Establish company-wide engineering practices for code quality, testing, CI/CD, and on-call/incident response as the team scales past the size where informal norms hold
Own SOC 2 and broader security/compliance posture across engineering, partnering with IT and any external auditors
Create long-term sustainable mechanisms such as feedback loops, retros, postmortems, and eng-wide metrics for continuous improvement across performance, scale, delivery and org health.
Build and protect engineering culture as headcount grows: the norms around ownership, blameless problem-solving, and technical excellence that are easy to lose past 80 people
Champion agentic AI, LLM-powered code generation, and multi-agent orchestration to reimagine how services are built and operated at scale, compressing delivery timelines and raising engineering velocity.
What You'll Bring to the Team
12+ years of experience in software engineering, with 7+ years leading engineering managers (not just ICs)
Experience in working in marketplaces or enterprise platforms and building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems. Experience in e-commerce, B2B SaaS, or marketplace businesses (and their mobile counterparts) a plus
Direct experience building an engineering org from the ground up or through a major scaling inflection point, you've made the "when do we add a second team" calls before
Strong track record setting technical vision and translating it into a roadmap that executive leadership and the board actually trust
Strong balance of technical depth, strategic thinking, and operational leadership. Extensive experience communicating engineering strategy, risk, and resourcing to non-technical executives and board members
Proven experience building and scaling engineering organizations in high-growth or mission-critical environments balancing execution versus management
Hands-on background (even if not day-to-day anymore) with modern cloud-native architecture: AWS-managed services (EKS, ECR, R53, SES, ElastiCache, RDS, etc.), infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible), and containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience owning security and compliance programs, including SOC 2 controls and audit management
Strong experience with CI/CD tooling and practices (Jenkins, CircleCI, ArgoCD, Spinnaker, or similar) and a point of view on developer experience
Experience with API management and service-oriented, API-driven architectures, and the operational challenges they create at scale
Proven ability to manage budget, vendor relationships, and cost efficiency for an engineering org
A genuine passion for developing people, you measure your success by the managers and engineers who grow under you
LeafLink Perks & Benefits
Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off with no cap!
A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in LeafLink’s success
5 Days of Volunteer Time Off (VTO) - giving back is important to us and we want our employees to prioritize cultivating a better community
Competitive compensation and 401k
Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
Commuter Benefits through our Flexible Spending Account
LeafLink’s employee-centric culture has earned us a coveted spot on BuiltInNYC’s Best Places to Work for in 2021 list. Learn more about LeafLink’s history and the path to our First Billion in Wholesale Cannabis Orders here.
Base salary range
$240,000—$270,000 USD

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are an early-stage wearable sensing startup building a body-worn sensing platform at the frontier of hardware engineering. This is a pivotal moment for the company, and we're looking for a technically deep, hands-on Head of Engineering to own technical execution from architecture through shipping — while leading a distributed team across India and San Francisco.
You'll be based full-time in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of systems thinking, embedded hardware, and team leadership — and who has a proven track record of shipping real products into real users' hands.
Note: This role is open to US citizens and US visa holders only. Visa sponsorship is not available.
What You'll Do
Own end-to-end technical execution of a body-worn sensing platform — from system architecture through production shipment.
Lead and coordinate a distributed team of hardware, firmware, and mechanical specialists across India and San Francisco.
Make weekly design and integration decisions across power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware/embedded Linux, and mechanical structure.
Define and maintain the complete hardware system architecture, ensuring all subsystems integrate coherently into a wearable product.
Translate product requirements into clear, precise engineering briefs for the distributed team to execute against.
Review and critique mechanical designs with engineering justification, focusing on wearability, durability, and real-world deployment constraints.
Debug firmware and system-level issues using schematics, logic analyzers, and serial logs.
Shape hiring criteria and interview processes to grow overall team capability.
Own meaningful systems from day one and measure direct impact on product quality and model capabilities.
What We're Looking For
Dealbreakers (all required):
US citizen or US visa holder.
6+ years of hardware engineering experience focused on wearable hardware, robotics, motion capture, or field-deployed devices.
Hands-on experience designing multi-rail battery-powered hardware, including power protection circuits, regulator topology selection, and ability to analyze inrush/brownout behavior on first power-on; must be comfortable reading schematics.
At least one hardware product shipped from first prototype to real users.
Willing to live in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month.
Required:
Experience operating as a staff, principal, or founding engineer — not solely as an engineering manager.
Proven ability to lead distributed teams across time zones and maintain engineering quality without daily in-person presence.
Deep expertise in sensor synchronization across mismatched sample rates and variable bus latencies, including firmware-level timestamping and diagnosing real misalignment in datasets.
Firmware and embedded Linux experience: bringing up SoM/SBC platforms, debugging timing, interrupt, and buffer issues.
Strong mechanical judgment: able to critique load paths, tolerance stack-up, strain relief, and wearable-specific requirements.
Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to translate product needs into precise engineering briefs and influence hiring decisions.
Nice to Have:
Experience with supply chain and vendor management for hardware components.
Experience with regulatory compliance (UL/IEC) for wearable devices.
Experience shipping hardware at scale, including mass production and manufacturing handoff.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: $140,000 – $210,000 USD annually
Competitive equity in an early-stage company at a pivotal growth stage
Regular travel to San Francisco (approximately one week per month) covered by the company
Location
This is a full-time, on-site role based in India. You will travel to San Francisco, CA, USA approximately one week per month to collaborate with the local team. Candidates must already be located in or willing to relocate to India.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence. We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers.
Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated. Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers.
At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!
What We’re Looking For:
AmeriSave is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our Enterprise Technology & AI organization, software engineering, infrastructure, and security function responsible for our proprietary technology stack, including our Digital Mortgage platform and the systems that run our loan origination business end to end.
This is an executive role for a hands-on technology leader who has run large engineering organizations at scale, ideally within the mortgage industry or at a well-known lender, and who is equally credible discussing Azure architecture with a principal engineer, disaster recovery posture with an auditor, and technology strategy with the Board. You will own the reliability, security, scalability, and roadmap of the systems that power the company, while building and developing the engineering talent that maintains them.Seeking candidates with expertise and hands-on experience with Aloha software.
What You'll Do:
Engineering Organization Leadership:Lead a software engineering organization that designs, builds, and maintains AmeriSave's proprietary technology platforms, setting engineering standards, architecture direction, and delivery cadence across multiple product and platform teams.
Cloud & Database Infrastructure:Own the Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server database environments that run the company's proprietary systems, including architecture, cost management, performance tuning, and long-term platform strategy.
Reliability & Uptime:Hold accountability for system uptime and reliability in the high 99.99% range across production systems; drive the monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and engineering discipline required to sustain that bar at scale.
Information Security:Own the organization's information security posture and security infrastructure, partnering with Compliance and Risk to ensure systems, data, and customer information are protected against evolving threats, and that the company meets regulatory and investor security requirements.
AI Strategy:Set direction for the company's AI strategy and investment, overseeing in-house AI initiatives (including proprietary AI-powered platform capabilities, automation, and applied AI/ML use cases) and evaluating where AI can responsibly improve efficiency, customer experience, and decisioning.
Networking Infrastructure:Own enterprise networking architecture, including data center, cloud, and remote/hybrid workforce connectivity, ensuring performance, security, and scalability of the network as the business grows.
Disaster Recovery:Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for all critical systems, including recovery time/point objectives, failover testing, and readiness, ensuring the business can withstand and recover from major disruptions.
Capacity Planning:Lead capacity planning across infrastructure and applications, forecasting growth and ensuring systems scale ahead of business demand without over-provisioning cost.
Development Resource Management:Build, develop, and retain engineering talent and leadership; manage development resourcing and prioritization across competing business and technology initiatives; establish career paths and a strong engineering culture.
Executive Partnership & Communication:Partner with the CEO, CIO/CISO, and executive leadership team to translate business strategy into a technology roadmap; represent Technology in Board and investor conversations, and communicate complex technical topics in terms executives and non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Budget Ownership:Manage the technology budget, including infrastructure spend, tooling, and headcount, balancing innovation investment against operating efficiency.
What You’ll Need:
Deep Industry Experience:15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years in a senior executive technology role (CTO, VP Engineering, or similar), preferably within the mortgage industry, and preferably with a well-known mortgage lender or financial services company.
Scale of Engineering Leadership:Demonstrated experience leading a software engineering organization that builds and maintains proprietary systems, not a primarily vendor/SaaS-managed environment.
Cloud & Database Expertise:Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server environments at production scale, including architecture, performance, security, and cost management.
Reliability Track Record:Proven track record of sustaining system uptime in the high 99.99% range for business-critical, customer-facing systems.
Security Expertise:Strong background in information security management and security infrastructure, including familiarity with financial services regulatory and audit expectations.
AI Experience:Experience directing applied AI/ML initiatives within a production engineering organization, translating AI capability into real business and customer outcomes.
Networking Expertise:Solid grounding in enterprise networking infrastructure, including cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, and network security.
Disaster Recovery Expertise:Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including failover testing and recovery objectives, for mission-critical systems.

We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers.

Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated. Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers.
At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!

AmeriSave is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our Enterprise Technology & AI organization, software engineering, infrastructure, and security function responsible for our proprietary technology stack, including our Digital Mortgage platform and the systems that run our loan origination business end to end.

This is an executive role for a hands-on technology leader who has run large engineering organizations at scale, ideally within the mortgage industry or at a well-known lender, and who is equally credible discussing Azure architecture with a principal engineer, disaster recovery posture with an auditor, and technology strategy with the Board. AI Experience:Experience directing applied AI/ML initiatives within a production engineering organization, translating AI capability into real business and customer outcomes.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.text:
Linah Group is seeking a Head of Technology to define and drive the company's technology strategy, lead digital transformation across all business sectors under the Group while enabling each business unit to innovate within its own market and manage a cross-functional IT organization spanning helpdesk support, software development, and enterprise systems (ERP).
This role will oversee Linah Group portfolio spanning Head office, agriculture sector, manufacturing sector, retail, and hospitality (the 5-star Sultan Gardens Resort in Sharm El Sheikh) and other subsidiaries.
Group-Wide Technology Leadership
Define and drive the overarching technology strategy and roadmap for Linah Group, ensuring alignment with business objectives across all sectors
Provide technology leadership and governance across Manufacturing, Head Office, Agriculture, and Hospitality, ensuring consistency in standards, security, and infrastructure while respecting each sector's specific needs
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing technology organization, including sector-level technology leads for each business unit
Oversee IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and enterprise systems across all four sectors
Manage the Group-wide technology budget, ensuring optimal allocation of resources and timely reinvestment in upgrades across sectors
Establish technology policies, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and scalability across the Group
Act as a key advisor to the executive leadership team and Board on technology strategy, risk, and investment decisions
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all technology functions within the Group
Manufacturing
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of production systems, ERP, and plant automation
Identify and implement technologies that improve manufacturing efficiency, quality, and safety
Head Office
Oversee core corporate IT systems, networks, and enterprise software supporting all business functions
Ensure Head Office systems remain current, secure, and integrated with sector-level platforms
Agriculture
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of farming operations, including smart farming and agri-tech solutions
Evaluate and implement emerging agri-technology (IoT sensors, precision farming, automation) to improve yield and efficiency
Hospitality (5-Star Hotel)
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of guest-facing and back-of-house systems, including property management systems and service platforms
Drive technology initiatives that enhance guest experience and operational efficiency in line with 5-star service standards

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Viseven Group is a leading global B2B MarTech service provider, empowering Pharma and LifeScience companies since 2009. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and excellence, offering comprehensive end-to-end software and digital marketing services tailored to the pharmaceutical industry. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies.
At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success.
With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele.
Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe.
Role description: Viseven is looking for a Head of Product to own and drive the success of the entire products and services portfolio, create synergies across solutions, and increase overall portfolio value and profitability.
Responsibilities:
Define and lead product portfolio vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals and a coherent value proposition.
Decide portfolio composition (invest/grow/maintain/change/sunset) to maximize market opportunity and business impact, ensuring products synergy and competitive advantage.
Continuously analyze market trends, competition, customer needs, stakeholder insights and synthesize it into product decisions and choices.
Identify and validate new product and business opportunities, including building business cases and managing new products before they are transferred to separate business lines.
Oversee product lifecycle (development, launch, evolution), balancing innovation and improvement.
Monitor and manage product performance (revenue, profitability, adoption, retention) and optimize accordingly.
Set cross-product priorities and allocate resources based on impact, ROI, and strategic fit, including the balance between building core and customer desired functionality.
Build and lead the product management function, including capabilities, standards, and best practices organization-wide, owning and building company-wide expertise related to products knowledge and product application.
Align and active cooperate with cross-functional stakeholders to drive go-to-market, customer acquisition and retention, adoption, and overall portfolio growth.
Hard skills required:
5+ years in product management with leadership of multi-product SaaS portfolios; MarTech/Pharma or regulated domain experience preferred.
Proven ownership of portfolio strategy and P&L, including product launches and scaling in international markets.
Strong strategic and analytical skills: portfolio decisions (invest/grow/sunset), business cases, pricing, ROI, SaaS metrics.
Deep product management expertise (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization, experimentation) across full product lifecycle.
Experience balancing innovation vs. optimization and core vs. customer-driven development.
Ability to build and scale product organizations, define standards, and develop product managers.
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment in a multinational environment.
Clear communication and data-driven, customer-centric, outcome-oriented mindset.
Soft skills required:
Both in-depth and agile mindset.
Strong leadership, planning, effective management of self and the team.
Advanced communication and presentation skills.
Great team player – optimistic, organized, flexible, helpful.
Wholistic, creative and critical thinking – ability to develop and create new ideas, systems, and relationships for the success of the company, analyze root causes and provide solutions.
What we provide:
We know our team members are key to achieving our goals, so we value and empower them to share their vision. We reward this passion with exceptional benefits, including:
Competitive Compensation: Regular performance-based salary and career development reviews.
Experienced Team: Join a passionate, experienced team in a friendly atmosphere.
Career Growth: Opportunities for professional and career advancement.
Paid Time Off: 18 business days per year (20 business days after 2 years of service).
Sick Leave:
Non-documented: 4 business days per year.
Documented: 20 business days per year.
Family Leave: 3 paid business days for marriage, childbirth, or bereavement.
Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage.
English Courses: Learning opportunities to improve your language skills.
Professional Development: Participation in forums and conferences.
Corporate Events: Regular team-building activities and events.
Work Environment: Enjoy a comfortable, fully equipped office and the possibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.text:
The CVO Tribe
CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.
The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.
As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.
What you'll do
Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.
Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.
Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.
Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
What you'll bring
Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
What we offer
Global collaboration across HelloTech's hubs in Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto.
High-leverage, technically diverse work spanning ML, backend, data, and product engineering, with a direct line to business outcomes.
A genuinely AI-native environment with a mandate to scale that approach further.
Technical and engineering leadership in an autonomous, product-led setup, with end-to-end ownership from problem definition to production.
Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).

blocks.text: Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

requirements: Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.

jobs.title: Director UX, Growth
jobs.text:
Director of UX, Growth
Location: Toronto or New York
Team: UX, Growth Mega-Alliance
Level: Director (people leadership). For the right person there's a clear path to Senior Director as the alliance scales.
Reports to: Global VP of UX
About HelloFresh
Our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. We're the world's leading meal-kit provider and a global digital-native FMCG company, reaching more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of brands, from HelloFresh and Factor to Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, YouFoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.
About the role
We're looking for a Director of UX to lead the Growth experience end to end, across the brands in our portfolio, with HelloFresh and Factor the biggest. This is the team that owns how people discover our brands, sign up, get to their first great box, and keep coming back. Most funnels are something people endure. We want ours to be something they remember. Your job is to turn each step into a moment worth having, so the journey feels effortless, true to each brand, and sticky enough that people want to stay, and to grow the business while you do it.
You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and lead a team of 6 UX designers and collaborate closely with content design and research strategy. You set the quality bar for the alliance and work shoulder to shoulder with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering across web and app, and across 16 markets. You care about the numbers and the experience, and you know the best growth work improves both at once.
This is a hands-on leadership role, and a build-and-scale one rather than a maintenance one. You are exceptional at craft and stay close enough to the work to lead with credibility. You're also a visionary: you bring our brands to life and express them clearly across every touchpoint, and you have a strong feel for content and how words shape an experience. You're happy in ambiguity, and you'd rather write the playbook than follow one.
What you'll own
A funnel worth remembering. You lead the experience across the full customer journey: acquisition and activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation of lapsed customers. You do more than reduce drop-off and smooth out onboarding. You make each step sticky and memorable, so people feel something at sign-up, come back because they want to, and tell a friend. You give lapsed customers a real reason to return.
Experimentation and evidence. You run a team that tests its way to the answer. You treat behavioral data as a primary design input, not just something to validate a decision after the fact. You set clear hypotheses, design experiments and A/B tests with statistical rigor alongside data science, read the results honestly, and balance quick wins with the changes that compound over time.
Strategy before screens. You decide which problems are worth solving and why, and you tie design choices to the business outcomes this role is measured on, like conversion, activation rate, and retention [confirm the exact KPIs for this role]. You set direction before design work begins.
Craft and quality. You define what excellent looks like for Growth and hold the bar. You set a high standard for craft yourself and raise it in others, and you build and evolve the systems and patterns that let the team ship consistent, high-quality work at speed across web and app.
Brand expression. You bring our portfolio of brands to life, from HelloFresh and Factor to the rest, and give each a clear, distinct voice and look in the experience. You know how to hold what makes a brand itself while keeping the funnel coherent across all of them. You have a strong understanding of content and how design and words work together to express who each brand is.
Make us AI-native. You lead a team that treats AI as an active part of how the work gets done, from insight synthesis to rapid prototyping to the path from design to code. You define the quality bar AI-assisted work has to meet, and you help rewrite how growth experiences get built in the AI era. You are a driving force in this transformation, not a passenger, and you help your team see the shift as opportunity rather than threat.
A team of generalists. You lead a team of UX Designers with a generalist profile that move across design, content, research and code. You attract, develop, and retain strong talent, coach through feedback and influence rather than authority, and build a place where people do the best work of their careers.
What you bring
10+ years in product design, including experience leading and growing teams in a consumer (B2C) or product-led environment with a track record of moving metrics like activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
Exceptional craft. You are a top-tier designer who sets and holds a high bar, and you stay hands-on enough to lead with credibility and a visionary eye for the brand. You can bring distinct brands to life and express them clearly and consistently across an experience.
High agency. You push for the right solution over the convenient one and make things happen without waiting for permission.
AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow, for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design to code, and you have a clear point of view on scaling it responsibly at a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma and Claude is expected, and you can show your team what excellent AI-assisted work looks like.
Strong data fluency. You read behavioral data and experiment results well, know what they are and aren't telling you, and use them to sharpen design, not just defend it. You're comfortable partnering with data science on experimentation quality.
Command of experimentation: hypothesis design, A/B testing, and funnel analysis as a connected system rather than isolated moments.
A partnership mindset with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering. You navigate constraints with engineers and shape research and synthesis with researchers.
People leadership experience: building teams, coaching designers, and setting a quality bar others rally around.
Nice to have
Experience shaping cross-channel communication strategy across app, email, push, and web, so the message a customer gets is consistent and well-timed wherever they meet us.
Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization design.
A track record building 0-to-1 growth systems, or fixing broken acquisition and retention loops.
What success looks like
Your team consistently ships high-quality growth work at speed, and the metrics move.
You've hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and judgment.
Experience quality across the funnel is visibly higher, and customers feel it.
Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.
AI-native ways of working in your domain make the whole team faster without giving up craft.
Each brand feels distinctly itself in the experience, while the funnel stays coherent across all of them.
What we offer
Scale and impact. Shape experiences for millions of customers across our brands and 16 markets.
A craft-and-AI-first culture, championed from the top of the organization.
Real ownership of your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.
A defined leadership track and the chance to grow your scope as the alliance scales.
Global collaboration with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Access wellness resources including fitness discounts and mental health support.
Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings.
Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
How we work
We're moving UX to work AI-native, and we expect our leaders to help drive that shift. You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders in the region.
Equal opportunity
We believe that sharing a meal brings people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures together, and we're committed to celebrating every dimension of diversity in the workplace. We're an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. We provide reasonable accommodations to candidates at any stage of the process. If you need one, please let us know.
Please note that for this position employees are eligible to equity on top of the base pay.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$143,850—$153,850 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering (CPG & Retail)
jobs.text:
REQ ID: FEQ427R375
Mission:
As the Director of Field Engineering, you will be responsible for partnering with our enterprise Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) and Retail customers to democratize Data and AI within their organizations, leveraging Databricks solutions and expertise to address their most critical business challenges.
Reporting to the Tech GM of Field Engineering for Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), the Director, Field Engineering will lead a team of pre-sales Managers and Solutions Architects focused on acquiring new customers and expanding strategic relationships across the Retail and CPG industry. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders to drive strategy and execution against our ambitious growth goals.
You will foster a culture of psychological safety while developing and scaling a high-performing team with expertise in enterprise software, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and cloud technologies. Your experience partnering with Sales will help drive complex enterprise opportunities while coaching managers and field engineering teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will guide your team through strategic engagements, communicate complex technical solutions in terms of business value, support enterprise sales cycles, and build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders across the Retail and CPG industry.
The impact you will have:
Hire and manage first-line Managers and a growing team of technical pre-sales
Solutions Architects.
Build a collaborative culture within a rapid-growth team. Embody and promote
Databricks' customer-obsessed, truth-seeking, diverse culture, and first principles
mindset.
Develop trusted, long-term executive relationships with customers while maintaining a
deep understanding of the Retail and CPG industry, including key business trends,
competitive dynamics, and digital transformation priorities.
Help customers accelerate their Data and AI strategies across areas such as customer
experience, merchandising, supply chain, demand forecasting, marketing, and
operations.
Promote a solution- and value-based Field Engineering organization.
Display an understanding of customer business priorities and revenue opportunities
across the assigned region and industry.
Serve as a thought leader for Databricks and within the Retail, CPG, Data, and AI
ecosystem.
What we look for:
At least 3 years of second-line leadership experience managing teams of 30+
individuals, with 10+ years of overall leadership experience.
Proven success leading high-growth enterprise software pre-sales organizations
within Retail, CPG, cloud, data, analytics, or AI.
Experience partnering with Retail and/or CPG customers on large-scale data,
analytics, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
Ability to elevate executive engagement, with a track record of driving large strategic
transactions and expanding high-growth enterprise accounts.
Proven leadership ability to influence, develop, and empower teams to achieve
ambitious business objectives through collaboration.
Drive operational rigor to manage a high-growth business, establishing the right
operating cadence while ensuring visibility into customer priorities, escalations, and
product feedback.
Proven track record of delivering transformational customer outcomes and
measurable business value.
Track record of building strong customer relationships and cross-functional
partnerships across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Experience positioning technical solutions within complex enterprise environments
and helping customers realize long-term value and platform adoption with Databricks.
Strong operational leadership with experience implementing scalable processes that
improve the effectiveness and productivity of technical field organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or
equivalent practical experience.
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
Benefits
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.
