jobs.title: Engineering Director, Mobile Infrastructure
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced engineering leader to join our Mobile Infrastructure team and drive the technical foundation that powers OKX's app for millions of daily active users. In this role, you will lead and grow a team of mobile infrastructure engineers, set the technical direction for our platform layer, and work closely with product engineering teams to ensure the OKX app is fast, reliable, and built to scale.
This is not a feature delivery role. You will own the engineering systems, tooling, and frameworks that enable the broader mobile organisation to ship with speed and confidence. We are actively embedding AI into how our teams build and operate — and we're looking for a leader who embraces that shift and brings others along with them.
What You'll Be Doing
Lead, mentor, and develop a mobile infrastructure engineering team, driving ownership and accountability across platform milestones.
Set the technical direction for mobile infrastructure — including tooling, shared frameworks, performance systems, and developer experience toolchain.
Champion the adoption of AI tools and workflows across the team — from code generation and review to testing and incident analysis — to raise the quality and velocity of delivery.
Drive architecture decisions and engineering standards across the mobile platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability at scale.
Partner with product engineering teams to deliver infrastructure solutions, unblock development, and raise the bar on engineering quality across the organisation.
Own performance engineering across the platform — memory, package size, startup time, and UI rendering — in production environments serving millions of users.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including product, design, backend, and security teams to align on platform goals and execute effectively.
Serve as the go-to technical expert for complex infrastructure challenges, maintaining the robustness and scalability of the mobile platform.
What We Look For In You
8+ years of mobile engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a team lead or management role focused on infrastructure, platform, or architecture.
Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams, with strong technical judgement and a high level of drive.
Deep expertise in iOS or Android development, with a strong understanding of the mobile platform layer — performance, toolchain, architecture, and developer experience.
Actively uses AI tools in your engineering workflow — you don't just know about them, you've integrated them into how you and your team work.
Strong communicator who can align cross-functional teams and work effectively across stakeholders at different levels.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and making sound technical decisions in a fast-paced environment.
Nice to Haves
Hands-on experience leading a dedicated mobile architecture or infrastructure team with deep platform specialisation.
Track record of driving performance optimisation at scale — memory, package size, startup time, and rendering performance.
Experience shipping AI-powered features or integrating AI tooling into engineering workflows at team or org level.
Familiarity with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter.
Experience in fintech, crypto, or other high-scale consumer app environments.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.text:

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are, too, let's talk.
The Role
We are looking for a driven, curious, and empathetic product management leader to push the envelope of Okta’s market footprint by growing our integration ecosystem. As Director of Product Management for Okta integration ecosystem, you will be responsible for product strategy, and managing a PM team dedicated to evolving the Okta built integrations across all the product lines. This is a high-impact role, and if you’re passionate about improving customer security and engaging with a vibrant community, we’re looking for you.
Work Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Work Mode: Hybrid (2-3 days Onsite per week)
Responsibilities:
Own the strategy and growth of Okta’s build integrations through product vision.
Connect with key partners and customers to distill down feature asks and pain points into true requirements that deliver broad customer value.
Develop roadmaps that make hard tradeoffs and prioritize the highest value work first.
Build compelling hypotheses and find ways to validate assumptions at low cost.
Collaborate with global cross-functional teams, including engineering, ISVs, tech partnerships, and marketing, to ensure the successful launch and adoption of ISV experience enhancements.
Work with development scrum teams (PM, UX, Dev) to deliver valuable new integration targeted features and product improvements to customers.
Conduct research and analysis to identify integration needs, and use this information to inform strategic vision, innovation, product decisions, prioritization and roadmap.
Define and communicate product requirements, including features, user experience, and technical specifications, to engineering teams.
Leverage product data to continually get smarter about how to improve our existing products, and work across the business to drive adoption and success
Track industry trends and think strategically to develop solutions that are differentiated from the competition
Required:
10+ years of technology product management, experience in enterprise scale SaaS products.
Experience building or product managing the user experience of a partner joining, engaging, and building upon a core enterprise software platform.
Strong leadership, communication (presentation, verbal and written) and collaboration skills. You easily work with customers and colleagues across different functions and backgrounds.
Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects - you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details
Demonstrated business results from products, features or capabilities you have shipped.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. You can produce solid action plans from often incomplete, conflicting or ambiguous inputs.
Passion for Okta’s huge opportunity and growth potential, and general thirst for learning with an ability to go broad and deep across business and technical contexts.
Preferred:
Experience with identity and access management (IAM) platforms and security products.
Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise products or services, partner considerations surfaced in the user experience in particular
Familiarity with Identity and Access management protocols and products
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience that allows you to rationalize and influence technical design decisions.
Advanced degree in technical or business field, MBA helpful

jobs.title: VP/GM, Product Management- Asana for Services Management
jobs.text:
As the Vice President of Asana Services Management, you’ll own Product Management, GTM strategy, and the incubation Sales Engineering / Forward Deployed team for Asana Service Management, Asana’s most promising 0→1 product. Asana Service Management unifies ticketing and project execution for IT, HR, facilities, and other service teams to resolve key issues without human touch. This is a rare role with a direct reporting line across both Product Management and Sales Engineering / Forward-Deployed Engineering, combined with full P&L responsibility.
In this high-leverage VP-level role, you will act as an entrepreneurial leader. You will sit at the intersection of sales, technical execution, and product development—owning the GTM strategy, engaging directly with mid-market customers to close business, and translating front-line market insights into a concrete product roadmap and product execution. This is a "player-coach" role designed for someone who thrives in ambiguity and knows how to scale a technical GTM motion within a fast-growing SaaS environment.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Own Product Roadmap and Product Execution: Act as the strategic voice of the market; synthesize deep customer feedback, competitor gaps, and field insights to define, prioritize and execute on the product roadmap.
Drive Incubation GTM Strategy: Architect and execute the global commercial and go-to-market strategy for Asana for Service Management, taking it from early-stage concepts to repeatable, revenue-generating engines.
Engage with Customers & Assist in Closing Deals: Serve as a key executive sponsor and technical seller on strategic deals, regularly interfacing with enterprise customers to understand their complex workflows and build trust.
Foster Cross-Functional Alignment: Bridge the gap internally between Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure seamless execution of the services growth strategy.
Establish Metrics and Guardrails: Define, monitor, and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) for the SE/FDE teams, incubation sales velocity, and partner services attach rates.
About you
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Proven Product Leadership: 12+ years of experience in a Senior Director or VP-level capacity leading technical GTM, Product Management and/or Solutions Engineering within a prominent B2B SaaS environment (ideally within the ITSM, ESM spaces).
The "Startup" Mindset: A highly entrepreneurial, proactive builder who is comfortable operating with ambiguity and possesses a strong "player-coach" mentality—willing to roll up your sleeves to map out a technical architecture or pitch to a CIO.
Deep Technical Credibility: Strong background managing highly technical field resources (SEs, FDEs, or Solutions Architects) and a deep understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, and SaaS architecture.
Market-Driven Product Vision: While formal Product Management (PM) experience is optional but preferred, you have a proven track record of translating complex customer and market needs into structured, actionable product requirements and priorities.
Commercial & Strategic Muscle Selling into IT Buyers: Demonstrated success selling to the IT buyer, managing a business unit's P&L, and designing scalable GTM frameworks.
Masterful Communicator: Exceptional ability to distill highly technical concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and customers alike.
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
What we’ll offer
Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $399,000 - $470,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales/GTM roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:
Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences
These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Deep Technical Credibility: Strong background managing highly technical field resources (SEs, FDEs, or Solutions Architects) and a deep understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, and SaaS architecture.

Market-Driven Product Vision: While formal Product Management (PM) experience is optional but preferred, you have a proven track record of translating complex customer and market needs into structured, actionable product requirements and priorities.
Commercial & Strategic Muscle Selling into IT Buyers: Demonstrated success selling to the IT buyer, managing a business unit's P&L, and designing scalable GTM frameworks.
Masterful Communicator: Exceptional ability to distill highly technical concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and customers alike.

jobs.title: Directeur principal, Gestion des produits / Senior Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Aperçu du poste:
Nous recherchons un directeur senior de la gestion des produits pour diriger et faire évoluer notre organisation des produits vers sa prochaine phase de croissance. Ce poste est idéal pour un dirigeant pragmatique et axé sur l'exécution, qui excelle dans la mise en place de structures, le renforcement des équipes et la création d'impact dans un environnement B2B, en collaboration avec une équipe composée de directeurs de produit et de chefs de produit.
Votre journée en un coup d'œil :
Favoriser une culture de gestion de produit axée sur les résultats et l’impact
Mettre en place et appliquer des processus de gestion de produit évolutifs, des cadres axés sur les résultats, une livraison agile et une optimisation post-lancement
Assurer la structure et la discipline tout au long du cycle de vie du produit (planification, hiérarchisation des priorités, exécution, livraison)
Mettre en place des indicateurs de performance mesurables fournissant des informations sur l’impact et l’efficacité de l’équipe produit
Direction et développement de l’équipe
Diriger, encadrer et faire progresser l’équipe de gestion de produit, en l’amenant à un niveau supérieur de maturité et de performance
Identifier les lacunes en matière de compétences, puis développer et encadrer l’équipe afin de la renforcer
Favoriser une culture d’équipe collaborative, performante et accessible
Vision du portefeuille et réussite commerciale
Élaborer et communiquer une stratégie de portefeuille alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux, la culture d’innovation et les besoins du marché
Assurer la réussite commerciale grâce à une compréhension claire du marché et du paysage concurrentiel, des tendances sectorielles et technologiques, ainsi que de l’écosystème des partenaires.
Piloter et mesurer le succès des produits grâce à une vision axée sur la création de valeur ajoutée et la résolution des problèmes du marché
Influence stratégique et leadership interfonctionnel
Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance et bon communicant auprès de l’équipe de direction
Traduire les feuilles de route et les initiatives complexes liées aux produits en résultats commerciaux et en prévisions de chiffre d’affaires
Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de vente, de marketing et des opérations
Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :
~ 20 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits, y compris à des postes de direction
Capacité avérée à mettre en œuvre des processus de gestion de produits et des cadres opérationnels
Expérience dans le développement d'équipes produit au sein d'organisations de taille similaire
Être disposé et en mesure de se déplacer jusqu’à 15 % du temps
Solide expérience dans les environnements B2B et technologiques
Expérience avec un portefeuille de produits par abonnement
Formation en ingénierie (un atout)
Capacité avérée à s'aligner sur les attentes des dirigeants
Expérience des principes de marketing pragmatiques (un atout)
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)
Votre profil de leadership :
Dirigeant axé sur l'exécution, soucieux de mettre en place des structures solides et d'obtenir des résultats
Accessible, collaboratif et capable de s'adapter
Excellent communicateur, capable de simplifier les sujets complexes
En parfaite adéquation avec la culture d'entreprise et moteur d'une évolution positive
Voilà ce que nous offrons !
Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être
Si vous souhaitez savoir à quoi ressemble l’environnement de travail chez Genetec, voici le lien vers notre vidéo d’entreprise: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA
Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler – votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!
Merci pour votre candidature, mais veuillez noter que seul(e)s les candidat(e)s sélectionné(e)s seront contacté(e)s. Les chasseurs de têtes et les agences de recrutement ne sont pas autorisés à soumettre des CV par l'intermédiaire de ce site web ou directement aux gestionnaires.

Job overview:
We are seeking a Senior Director of Product Management to lead and evolve our product organization through its next phase of growth. This role is ideal for a pragmatic, execution-focused leader who excels at building structure, strengthening teams, and driving impact in a B2B environment, working with a team consisting of Product Directors and Product Managers.
Your day at a glance:
Foster an outcome- and impact-driven product management culture
Establish and implement scalable product management processes, outcome-driven frameworks, agile delivery and post-launch optimization
Drive structure and discipline across the product lifecycle (planning, prioritization, execution, delivery)
Implement measurable performance indicators providing insights on the impact and the effectiveness of the product team
Team leadership and development
Lead, mentor, and elevate the product management team, bringing it to the next level of maturity and performance
Identify skill gaps and to develop and coach to strengthen the team
Foster a collaborative, high-performing, and approachable team culture
Portfolio vision and commercial success
Elaborate and communicate portfolio strategy aligned with business goals, innovation culture and market needs
Drive commercial success with a clear understanding of market and competitive landscape, industry and technology trends and partner ecosystem.
Drive and measure product success with a vision oriented towards delivering incremental value and addressing market problems
Strategic influence & cross-functional leadership
Act as a trusted advisor and good communicator to the executive team
Communicate complex product roadmaps and initiatives into business outcomes and revenue forecasts
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, sales, marketing, and operations
What makes you a great fit:
~20 years of experience in product management, including senior leadership roles
Proven ability to implement product processes and operational frameworks
Experience scaling product teams in organizations of similar size
Willing and able to travel 15% of the time
Strong background in B2B and technological environments
Experience with subscription-based product portfolio
Engineering background (preferred)
Demonstrated ability for aligning with executive stakeholders
Experience with pragmatic marketing principles (asset)
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written (this role requires interaction with our international collaborators and customers)
Your Leadership Profile :
Execution-oriented leader with a focus on building structure and delivering results
Approachable, collaborative, and adaptable
Strong communicator with the ability to simplify complexity
Aligns well with company culture and drives positive evolution
Let’s talk perks!
Attractive compensation package
Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule
Subsidized meals in our amazing Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Free, unlimited coffee and fruits
Private, free parking for all employees
Onsite fitness facility with personal trainer, and multiple wellness and health workshops
If you’d like to see what the work environment at Genetec looks like, check out our corporate video: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA
We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!
Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Shopping & Offers)
jobs.text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
About the Product team
The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
About the role
Our Shopping & Offers program is a fast-growing platform that operates with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader, delivering Shopping and Offers experiences directly to our Consumers and Conversion for our Merchant partners alike. You will be a pivotal strategic leader responsible for defining the next chapter of Affirm's DTC shopping and offers experience. You will lead a portfolio of high-impact consumer journeys—including Agentic Search, Home, and Profile experiences—that directly influence conversion, engagement, and revenue. This is a role for a seasoned product leader obsessed with consumer experiences, two sided marketplaces, and disrupting the payments & credit landscape.
What you’ll do
Strategic Leadership: Define and socialize a long-term Shopping & Offers vision and strategy, and translate that vision into clear roadmaps and decisions that teams can execute against
Portfolio Oversight: Manage and scale a portfolio of consumer-facing surfaces, including Home, Search, and Profile/Settings, ensuring a simple and consistent experience across platforms
Lead and grow a high-performing PM team. Build, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, including people managers. You'll set the bar for craft, create development paths, and cultivate a culture of ownership, rigor, and candor.
Executive Communication: Proactively align senior leadership on strategy, execution risks, and mitigation plans, ensuring organizational clarity during complex initiatives
Drive cross-functional alignment at scale: Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Revenue leaders to optimize the marketplace ecosystem, balancing merchant value with consumer experiences
Operational Excellence: Establish frameworks for rigorous experimentation and funnel analysis to drive measurable gains in completion rates and customer retention
What we look for
Experience: 10+ years of product management leadership, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale consumer products in fintech, e-commerce, or marketplace environments
Strategic Clarity: Demonstrated ability to bring "clarity when things feel messy," turning ambiguous problems into crisp narratives and structured execution plans
AI/LLM Fluency: Familiarity with AI-native product development, including agentic patterns and LLM-powered discovery experiences, to lead our highest-leverage bets in search
Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to use data (including LTV/CAC and profitability assessments) to guide prioritization and quantify the impact of product features
People Leadership: Experience operating through layers of leadership, delegating ownership effectively, and scaling decision-making across diverse product lines
Consumer Empathy: A "consumer-first" mindset with a high bar for design polish and a commitment to delivering honest financial product
Pay Grade - T
Equity Grade - USA 18
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $300,000 - $360,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $267,000 - $327,000
#LI-Remote
Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.
By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product & Technology Finance
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
Reddit is seeking a solid, analytical, strategic, creative, knowledgeable, and visionary finance leader to join our Finance team as a Senior Director, Product and Technology Finance . In this role, you will provide strategic and value-added financial leadership in partnership with our Engineering organization. You will partner with the Engineering teams to drive alignment and resourcing planning decisions, helping to align the needs of the business to the financial plan for the company. This person will be a thought partner, owning and driving the agenda in their area of responsibility, by driving financially responsible opportunities, and improving accuracy of reporting/insights. Additionally, you will be involved in continuing to stand up a financial process for evaluating and tracking Global Technology decisions, including working cross-functionally with other organizations within Reddit to ensure decisions are well-thought through (tax, legal, accounting, audit, etc.).
If you are someone who is passionate about growing with a rising business, values efficiency and creative problem-solving using financial/quantitative metrics, and thrives in a fast-paced, open and fast-growing environment, then this is a great role for you!
Responsibilities
Develop and Build a Product Finance Function - Spearhead the development and evolution of the Product Finance function, establishing robust processes that align financial rigor with product velocity. This includes designing and implementing a strategic framework for evaluating investments with ambiguous or long-term returns, enabling leadership to make data-informed decisions even in the face of uncertainty.
Support Reddit’s Engineering Organization - Partner with Engineering leadership to provide financial modeling assistance for key business decisions including prioritizing resources and investments to get the best ROI. Develop understanding of Engineering related issues and priorities; reconcile those matters with long term forecasts.
Strong Thought Leadership - Bring insights from industry knowledge and your business acumen to show a capability of influencing business leadership to drive results. You will have a passion for improving existing processes and be able to work across teams to achieve results.
Deliver engineering P&Ls - Own financial forecasts, annual operating plan, budget tracking, and long range plan by partnering with various stakeholders. Establishing and communicating information about financial targets on a quarterly and annual basis; identifying and reporting risk and opportunity levels determined for the overall financial plan; providing actionable insights (e.g. productivity analysis, ROI, contractor spend optimization, capex management, etc).
Cloud Reporting - Work closely with our team to track and report our KPIs against our most strategic Cloud Hosting agreements. Continue to optimize costs by working with engineers to balance workloads across our dual cloud environment. Run strategic projects in partnership with program management and engineering leaders to drive efficiencies and accountability for promised returns.
Business Development and Corp Dev related to Tech and Product Initiatives - Partner closely with the business development and corporate development teams to drive growth initiatives, assess M&A and evaluate post deal results.
Engineering Productivity and Resource Allocation - Obtain a deep understanding of resource allocation and support the CTO and CPO in product rationalization discussions, as well as evaluate how strategic developer productivity decisions correlate to financial efficiencies.
Communications and Presentations – Provides strategic input for business decisions by overseeing the production of complex financial models that incorporate assumptions, expectations, and known risks; preparing presentations and other supporting materials for recommendations.
Talent and Leadership – Develops and implements strategies to attract and maintain a highly skilled and engaged workforce by diagnosing capability gaps; recruiting, selecting, and developing talent
Qualifications
BA/BS degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics or similar quantitative discipline (MBA, CPA, not required, but highly preferred)
15+ years in FP&A experience with 2+ years of experience supporting cloud infrastructure and cloud cost analysis, and 5+ years of people management (role will be actively managing a small but highly productive team)
Must have experience working with AWS or GCP cloud products
Experience working in investment banking or consulting required
Experience working with Engineering a plus
Strong understanding of financial statements including B/S, P&L and drivers for margin.
Experience with owning and leading planning and forecasting, large data sets and sophisticated models, proven proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint presentations and deck creation
Strategic thinker who demonstrates leadership, vision, and insight
Hands-on manager with a strong finance background
Strong work ethic; high sense of urgency; ability to learn and deliver results in tight timeline
Experience partnering with stakeholders across the organization and drive projects forward
Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines while managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
Benefits:
Annual Personal & Professional development funds
Comprehensive Health benefits
Workspace benefits for your home office
401k Matching
Family Planning Support
Flexible Vacation (please use them!) & Monthly Global Wellness Days
4+ months paid Parental Leave
Paid Volunteer time off

This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

$260,000—$390,000 USD

jobs.title: Engineering Director, EU
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits
Engineering at Monzo
Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.
The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.
Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.
As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.
Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.
This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.
What you’ll work on
Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.
You should apply if
You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.
The interview process
After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:
Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)
Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.
At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.
How we work 💻:
Locations & Flexible Working :
Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.
We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨
Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.
Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.
At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.
You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨
Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼
What’s in it for you
💰Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
You will have the opportunity to join a team responsible for designing the industry's leading Crypto trading system, including Spot, Margin, Perpetuals, Futures, Options, and various risk control models such as simple account, single-currency margin, multi-currency margin, and portfolio margin.
This system supports daily trading volumes of over ten billion USD for both retail and institutional clients.
What You’ll Be Doing
The plumbing of the exchange. Order management, matching, margin, risk engine, lending/borrowing — across both spot and derivatives. When you ship, millions of trades route through your work the same day.
Infrastructure that holds up where others can't operate. You'll work directly with Legal, Compliance, and local market teams — not to check boxes, but to design systems that clear the highest regulatory bar in finance. That bar is our moat.
Outlearning the competition. Talk to traders, take apart competing systems, and decide where we lead vs. fast-follow — across crypto and TradFi.
The instruments that show us the market first. Build the data and monitoring layer that gives us situational awareness of our own stack and the broader industry. If something's drifting, breaking, or shifting — you know before anyone else.
The 3–12 month direction. Decide what we build next, and when, based on product lifecycle, competitive landscape, and what our capacity actually is — not what makes the deck look good.
Shipping through. From spec to launch, you're the person who gets it out the door — pulling engineering, design, ops, and marketing into alignment without becoming the bottleneck.
The AI harness and agent architecture for your domain. Design and ship multi-step agent workflows — tool use, retrieval, evaluation, human-in-the-loop checkpoints — that power how Core Trading operates. Spec agents the way you spec products.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree or above in mathematics, physics or computer science major.
5+ years experience in building sophisticated backend systems in either crypto or Traditional Finance industry.
AI native skillset that allow you to ship at 10x because you automate the work flow first.
Possess rigorous logical thinking, excellent teamwork, communication skills and be able to coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals between different departments.
You possess a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
You are proactive, enthusiastic and sensitive to customers' feedback from a product lens.
Fluent in English and Mandarin (to communicate with Mandarin speaking clients / cross-teams).

Trading experience in sophisticated institutions.
Excel in quantitative research with various mathematics tools.

jobs.title: Executive Director / Director, AI Data Science (Fixed Income/Investment Banking)
jobs.text:
At TWG Group Holdings, LLC (“TWG Global”), we drive innovation and business transformation across a range of industries—including financial services, insurance, technology, media, and sports—by leveraging data and AI as core assets. Our AI-first, cloud-native approach delivers real-time intelligence and interactive business applications, empowering informed decision-making for both customers and employees.
We prioritize responsible data and AI practices, ensuring ethical standards and regulatory compliance. Our decentralized structure enables each business unit to operate autonomously, supported by a central AI Solutions Group, while strategic partnerships with leading data and AI vendors fuel game-changing efforts in marketing, operations, and product development.
You will collaborate with management to advance our data and analytics transformation, enhance productivity, and enable agile, data-driven decisions. By leveraging relationships with top tech startups and universities, you will help create competitive advantages and drive enterprise innovation.
At TWG Global, your contributions will support our goal of sustained growth and superior returns, as we deliver rare value and impact across our businesses.
The Role
As Executive Director on the AI Science team, you will lead the design and execution of high-impact AI and data science initiatives across TWG Global's fixed income and investment banking businesses. Reporting to the Managing Director of AI & Data, you will act as the senior technical leader for the function. You will drive enterprise-critical projects, set technical direction, and mentor a small team of data scientists working on pricing, risk, and capital markets problems.
You will partner closely with traders, bankers, risk leaders, and senior executives to align data science solutions with the firm's commercial priorities, ensuring advanced AI and quantitative methods are adopted responsibly and at scale. This role demands deep technical expertise in both machine learning and the mechanics of fixed income markets, paired with the ability to influence decision-makers and deliver measurable outcomes on the desk and across the enterprise.
Key Responsibilities
Lead flagship AI/ML projects that drive measurable value across fixed income trading, credit, rates, and investment banking workflows, from pricing and execution to risk and origination.
Direct the development of models for valuing illiquid instruments, forecasting price and spread movements, modeling prepayment and default risk, and analyzing the yield curve and interest rate dynamics.
Act as senior technical authority on advanced AI methods (generative AI, causal inference, LLM-based analytics, RAG, simulation) and on their application to quantitative finance.
Translate complex desk-level and banking challenges into enterprise-grade data science solutions with tangible P&L and risk-adjusted ROI.
Mentor and guide a small team of data scientists, building technical excellence, modeling rigor, and responsible AI adoption.
Partner with trading desks, banking coverage teams, risk, MDs, and executive committees to ensure AI initiatives align with firm-wide priorities.
Represent TWG Global in external technical forums and partnerships with universities, regulators, and technology leaders.
Define standards for experimentation, reproducibility, and model governance, consistent with the controls expected in a regulated capital markets environment.
Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI/ML and quantitative finance, advising on adoption and firm-wide capability building.

jobs.title: Head of Product Management
jobs.text:
AccuScan Sciences is a liquid biopsy biotechnology company developing whole-genome sequencing solutions for minimal residual disease detection in oncology. The team is focused on turning complex clinical and genomic insights into products that can support more informed cancer care and broaden the impact of precision diagnostics.
In this role, you will shape product strategy for a growing oncology portfolio, helping connect scientific innovation, clinical evidence, and market needs. You will work across internal teams and external stakeholders to guide how products are defined, positioned, and advanced in regulated global markets.
Responsibilities
Define the product roadmap for MRD assays across multiple indications.
Translate clinical data into product requirements, claims, and market positioning.
Support regulatory and reimbursement strategies, including work related to MolDx, IVDR, and PMDA.
Drive global market strategy.
Coordinate cross-functional execution from development through launch.
Engage key opinion leaders, partners, and consortia to inform product direction.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Channel Infrastructure & Mobile
jobs.text:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.
Klaviyo’s mission is helping businesses grow by owning their data and experiences. The Director of Product, Channel Infrastructure and Mobile will lead shared infrastructure for all channels, with deep ownership of email, push, and in-app messaging. This leader will advance robust, global infrastructure and manage the full product lifecycle, focusing on mobile ecosystems (iOS, Android, and SDKs). You will own the strategic roadmap and collaborate across engineering, design, and marketing to deliver impactful customer solutions.
Influence how top brands communicate at scale within a fast-growing company. You will work with industry leaders to foster a culture of innovation and excellence aligned with Klaviyo’s values. This unique opportunity places you at the helm of a transforming omnichannel platform. Your contributions will shape global business interactions and leave a lasting mark on Klaviyo’s growth journey.
How You’ll Make a Difference
Define, develop, and execute a strategic roadmap for Klaviyo's messaging platforms to enhance their scalability and performance across multiple channels. This effort will directly support our mission of customer data ownership.
Lead cross-functional teams to innovate and implement new features in mobile ecosystems, increasing our value proposition for iOS and Android. Strengthening these platforms will fortify Klaviyo's leadership in the market.
Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle management, from ideation through delivery, ensuring product offerings meet high-quality standards and align with customer expectations. This will contribute to customer satisfaction and retention.
Establish key performance metrics for the channel infrastructure and use data-driven insights to make informed decisions that propel performance improvements. This approach will foster data ownership and business growth.
Cultivate relationships with major platform partners and stakeholders to strengthen Klaviyo's market position and enhance collaborative innovation. Such partnerships are essential for maintaining our customer-first proposition.
Manage a team of talented product managers, providing mentorship and guidance to develop their skills and align their work with Klaviyo's strategic goals. Talented teams are crucial to achieving our mission.
Continuously assess market trends and consumer feedback to identify opportunities for new channel features or enhancements. Responding to changing dynamics will ensure competitiveness and relevance.
Enhance communication processes to better coordinate and unify efforts across Klaviyo's global teams, ensuring the seamless integration of channel and mobile functionalities. Streamlining communication maximizes efficiency.
Champion an agile development approach to bring flexibility and adaptability to product development processes. This methodology supports rapid iteration and faster time-to-market for new features.
Facilitate feedback loops with customers to ensure product developments resonate with end-user needs, reinforcing Klaviyo's commitment to customer-first solutions.
Implement rigorous testing methodologies to ensure product reliabilities, such that each channel release is dependable and meets enterprise-grade standards.
Advocate for a customer-centric approach in all development initiatives, ensuring that our channels deliver personalized and impactful experiences that resonate with our clients' audiences.
Who You Are
You have at least 3+ years of direct management experience and 10 years of experience in product management with a proven track record in scaling messaging platforms like email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and mobile push notifications.
Your technical depth is exemplary, with robust understanding of iOS, Android, and mobile SDK ecosystems, enabling you to make informed strategic decisions that drive innovation and scalability.
You excel at cross-functional leadership, effectively bringing together teams from engineering, marketing, and customer success to deliver cohesive and effective product strategies.
Your data-driven mindset is impeccable, enabling you to employ analytics effectively in monitoring success metrics and iterating product strategies that enhance user experiences and business growth.
Familiarity with AI and machine learning technologies is a plus, as these are increasingly influential in designing intuitive, predictive customer communication strategies.
You are a visionary leader, capable of inspiring and mentoring teams to achieve strategic objectives while fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.
Your strategic acumen is backed by hands-on experience in managing end-to-end product development lifecycles, from ideation and planning through to launch and iteration.
You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can deliver results in high-pressure situations, maintaining a focus on customer satisfaction and business value creation.
Your exceptional communication skills allow you to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, thereby facilitating mutual understanding and stakeholder alignment.
A natural innovator, you enjoy exploring uncharted territories, taking risks, and seizing opportunities to disrupt markets with new, compelling product adventures.
You demonstrate a customer-first mindset, continuously advocating for the end-user and striving to enhance customer engagement, satisfaction, and loyalty through groundbreaking tech solutions.
Nice to Haves
An advanced degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or an MBA is advantageous, reflecting a sophisticated grasp of business and technology integration.
Experience working with global teams and managing products in international markets will be beneficial, offering a broader perspective on diverse customer needs and market dynamics.
Previous experience in a startup or rapidly scaling tech company is valued, granting agility and insight into navigating high-growth environments effectively.
A track record of successful product launches in a highly competitive landscape will further differentiate candidates, showcasing an ability to manage complexity and deliver impactful results.
A track record of experience working with large Enterprise customers, understanding their needs around scale, data governance, and data reliability.
Why This Role Matters
The Director of Product, Channel Infrastructure and Mobile is essential to Klaviyo's goal of leading in personalized customer experiences. As businesses grow, they require the scalable and flexible communication platforms this role oversees.
Tasked with enhancing omnichannel messaging, the director empowers customers to maximize their preferred channels, driving engagement and substantive growth. This position highlights technology's power to forge deeper relationships and expand businesses.
Ideal candidates will lead Klaviyo's product development during this high-growth phase, impacting how global brands interact with millions of consumers. This role offers a unique opportunity for professional impact at the forefront of innovation.

We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.

blocks.text: At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo’s mission is helping businesses grow by owning their data and experiences. The Director of Product, Channel Infrastructure and Mobile will lead shared infrastructure for all channels, with deep ownership of email, push, and in-app messaging. This leader will advance robust, global infrastructure and manage the full product lifecycle, focusing on mobile ecosystems (iOS, Android, and SDKs). You will own the strategic roadmap and collaborate across engineering, design, and marketing to deliver impactful customer solutions.

Influence how top brands communicate at scale within a fast-growing company. You will work with industry leaders to foster a culture of innovation and excellence aligned with Klaviyo’s values. This unique opportunity places you at the helm of a transforming omnichannel platform. Your contributions will shape global business interactions and leave a lasting mark on Klaviyo’s growth journey.
How You’ll Make a Difference

items: Define, develop, and execute a strategic roadmap for Klaviyo's messaging platforms to enhance their scalability and performance across multiple channels. This effort will directly support our mission of customer data ownership.

Lead cross-functional teams to innovate and implement new features in mobile ecosystems, increasing our value proposition for iOS and Android. Strengthening these platforms will fortify Klaviyo's leadership in the market.

Drive the end-to-end product lifecycle management, from ideation through delivery, ensuring product offerings meet high-quality standards and align with customer expectations. This will contribute to customer satisfaction and retention.

Establish key performance metrics for the channel infrastructure and use data-driven insights to make informed decisions that propel performance improvements. This approach will foster data ownership and business growth.

Cultivate relationships with major platform partners and stakeholders to strengthen Klaviyo's market position and enhance collaborative innovation. Such partnerships are essential for maintaining our customer-first proposition.

Manage a team of talented product managers, providing mentorship and guidance to develop their skills and align their work with Klaviyo's strategic goals. Talented teams are crucial to achieving our mission.
Continuously assess market trends and consumer feedback to identify opportunities for new channel features or enhancements. Responding to changing dynamics will ensure competitiveness and relevance.

Enhance communication processes to better coordinate and unify efforts across Klaviyo's global teams, ensuring the seamless integration of channel and mobile functionalities. Streamlining communication maximizes efficiency.
Champion an agile development approach to bring flexibility and adaptability to product development processes. This methodology supports rapid iteration and faster time-to-market for new features.
Facilitate feedback loops with customers to ensure product developments resonate with end-user needs, reinforcing Klaviyo's commitment to customer-first solutions.
Implement rigorous testing methodologies to ensure product reliabilities, such that each channel release is dependable and meets enterprise-grade standards.
Advocate for a customer-centric approach in all development initiatives, ensuring that our channels deliver personalized and impactful experiences that resonate with our clients' audiences.

blocks.text: Who You Are

items: You have at least 3+ years of direct management experience and 10 years of experience in product management with a proven track record in scaling messaging platforms like email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and mobile push notifications.
Your technical depth is exemplary, with robust understanding of iOS, Android, and mobile SDK ecosystems, enabling you to make informed strategic decisions that drive innovation and scalability.
You excel at cross-functional leadership, effectively bringing together teams from engineering, marketing, and customer success to deliver cohesive and effective product strategies.
Your data-driven mindset is impeccable, enabling you to employ analytics effectively in monitoring success metrics and iterating product strategies that enhance user experiences and business growth.
Familiarity with AI and machine learning technologies is a plus, as these are increasingly influential in designing intuitive, predictive customer communication strategies.
You are a visionary leader, capable of inspiring and mentoring teams to achieve strategic objectives while fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.
Your strategic acumen is backed by hands-on experience in managing end-to-end product development lifecycles, from ideation and planning through to launch and iteration.
You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can deliver results in high-pressure situations, maintaining a focus on customer satisfaction and business value creation.
Your exceptional communication skills allow you to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, thereby facilitating mutual understanding and stakeholder alignment.
A natural innovator, you enjoy exploring uncharted territories, taking risks, and seizing opportunities to disrupt markets with new, compelling product adventures.
You demonstrate a customer-first mindset, continuously advocating for the end-user and striving to enhance customer engagement, satisfaction, and loyalty through groundbreaking tech solutions.

blocks.text: Nice to Haves

items: An advanced degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or an MBA is advantageous, reflecting a sophisticated grasp of business and technology integration.
Experience working with global teams and managing products in international markets will be beneficial, offering a broader perspective on diverse customer needs and market dynamics.
Previous experience in a startup or rapidly scaling tech company is valued, granting agility and insight into navigating high-growth environments effectively.
A track record of successful product launches in a highly competitive landscape will further differentiate candidates, showcasing an ability to manage complexity and deliver impactful results.
A track record of experience working with large Enterprise customers, understanding their needs around scale, data governance, and data reliability.

blocks.text: Why This Role Matters

The Director of Product, Channel Infrastructure and Mobile is essential to Klaviyo's goal of leading in personalized customer experiences. As businesses grow, they require the scalable and flexible communication platforms this role oversees.

Tasked with enhancing omnichannel messaging, the director empowers customers to maximize their preferred channels, driving engagement and substantive growth. This position highlights technology's power to forge deeper relationships and expand businesses.

Ideal candidates will lead Klaviyo's product development during this high-growth phase, impacting how global brands interact with millions of consumers. This role offers a unique opportunity for professional impact at the forefront of innovation.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.text:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
About the role
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating.
What you’ll do
Sell
Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements
Deliver
Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time
Manage People
Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume
You may be a fit if
You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

jobs.title: FBS Senior Director Finance Data & Analytics
jobs.text:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers Insurance operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.
We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.
Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.
What to expect on your journey with us:
A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
Continuous learning and development
This position is part of a newly established team created to enhance enterprise decision-making through timely, accurate, and forward-looking financial and operational insights. This role leads the development and implementation of finance advanced modeling capabilities, leveraging data, actuarial analysis, predictive analytics, and statistical techniques to strengthen enterprise decision-making. The position is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and forward-looking financial and operational insights that support strategic planning, business performance, and enterprise objectives.
Key Responsibilities
•Directs the development and implementation of advanced modeling techniques to optimize finance strategies. Ensures modeling efforts contribute to profitable revenue growth.
•Leads technical analysis of market intelligence, predictive modelling, and pricing assumptions. Establishes analytics philosophies that align with financial objectives and measure progress toward targets.
•Adjusts finance strategies based on performance metrics and market demands.
•Applies knowledge of key business drivers and the factors that maximize performance to provide insights for annual financial plans including rate activity, policies in force, revenue growth, loss trends, and other key components.
•Oversees financial projections and scenario analyses to support strategic planning and risk assessment. Uses predictive analytics to generate accurate forecasts that align with business objectives.
•Develops and implements customer behavior segmentation and targeting strategies using predictive modeling. Drives marketing decisions that optimize customer selection and revenue.
•Guides product development by leveraging advanced modeling and actuarial analysis to inform product innovation, market alignment, and revenue growth potential.
•Establishes data-driven strategies to enhance customer retention and loyalty.
•Collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve customer experience and promote long-term engagement.
•Analyzes performance metrics for direct marketing and media investments while providing insights to balance profitability, customer engagement, and competitive positioning.
•Builds team capabilities in data analytics, predictive modeling, and actuarial analysis to drive continuous improvement.
